**信号** 请求句 Is there any chance。男士在确认席别后用 Is there any chance we could have a window seat for one of those? 主动提出一个"额外要求"，这种请求句式是答案信号；前半 Second class is fine. 是先答售票员问题，真正的 other request 在 chance 之后。
**替换** a window seat for one of those↔One window seat.数量+席位类型逐项对齐
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 与原文相反男士明确说 Second class is fine.——选的是二等座，不是头等座；A 项盗用了对话里讨论过的 first class 话题词，但极性反了。借用原文： Second class is fine.
B) 张冠李戴I've booked those seats next to each other for you. 是售票员主动给出的服务，不是男士提出的请求；B 项盗用了 next to each other = together 的语义，但来源不是男士——属于把售票员的话安到男士头上。借用原文： I've booked those seats next to each other for you.
D) 未提及One seat near the exit. 里的 exit 在录音中完全没念，属于凭常识或对窗口座位的反义臆造出的干扰项。
questions.quote: Second class is fine. Thanks. Is there any chance we could have a window seat for one of those?

options.text: Two first class seats.
Two seats together.
One window seat.
One seat near the exit.

questions.prompt: Where should the man wait for the train?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题） At the far end of the platform.
**题目译文**
这位男士应该在哪里等火车?
A) 在站台中间。
B) 在站台最远端。
C) 在黄线后面。
D) 在候车室。
**定位** 你们要做的就是在站台的最远端等候。
**信号** All you need to do 的指示句。All you need to do is wait at the far end of the platform. 用 All you need to do 这种强调式的祈使指示句，等于给出一条明确指令，是答案信号；后面紧跟 When the train arrives, tell the train guard... 是补充流程，不是该等的地点。
**替换** at the far end of the platform↔At the far end of the platform.原句完整搬运
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱录音只说在 the far end of the platform 等车，没有说 middle；A 项盗用了原文里的platform 一词，把方位偷换成 middle。借用原文： at the far end of the platform
C) 未提及录音里完全没提 yellow line；这是日常乘车经验里的安全规则，主体考生容易凭母语常识硬选。
D) 未提及录音里也没提 waiting room；男士被告知直接到 the far end of the platform 等车，不是去候车室。
questions.quote: All you need to do is wait at the far end of the platform.

options.text: In the middle of the platform.
At the far end of the platform.
Behind the yellow line.
In the waiting room.

questions.prompt: What should the man do to collect the bicycles?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题） Give the ticket to the train guard.
**题目译文**
这位男士应该做什么来取自行车?
A) 排队等候轮到他。
B) 去行李提取区。
C) 为这项服务支付额外费用。
D) 把车票交给列车员。
**定位** 等你们到了伦敦，把票交给乘务员，他会把自行车还给你们。
**信号** When you arrive 的时间状语+祈使。When you arrive in London, hand the ticket to the guard and he will return the bicycles to you. 这一句的 When you arrive in London 正好对应题干 to collect the bicycles 的"到达后"语境；hand the ticket 是祈使动词，他/还给你 是结果——这是地道的答案信号。
**替换** hand the ticket to the guard↔ Give the ticket to the train guard.同义动词替换he will return the bicycles to you↔Give the ticket to the train guard.因果配套印证
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 未提及录音里没有 wait in a queue 或类似的排队动作；A 项是凭常识"想象车站要排队"硬塞的。
B) 偷换概念baggage claim area 是机场用语；录音里说的是 he will help you secure the bicycles in the last carriage——在火车最后一节车厢交接，不存在行李提取区。B 项盗用了与"取回"语义相似的航空场景词。借用原文： he will help you secure the bicycles in the last carriage
C) 与原文相反售票员明确说 It's no extra cost. The price will be the same.——不会再收额外费用；C项却说要 pay an extra fee，与原文极性正相反。借用原文： It's no extra cost.
questions.quote: When you arrive in London, hand the ticket to the guard and he will return the bicycles to you.

questions.prompt: What do we learn about hat factories in Britain?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题） Nearly all of them closed down decades ago.
**题目译文**
关于英国的帽子工厂，我们了解到什么？
A) 它们几乎全都在亏损经营。
B) 它们全都已被改造成电影院。
C) 它们几乎全都在几十年前就关闭了。
D) 它们已经适应了时尚变化。
**定位** 英国曾经有很多帽厂，一直延续到 1950 年代左右；但后来潮流变了，大多数人不再戴帽子，所以那些工厂几乎全都倒闭了。
**信号** but + So 的双重连接信号。but fashion changed 的 but 把话题从「曾经繁荣」掰向「后来衰落」，紧接 So practically all of those factories had to close down. 的 So 又把因果一锤定音——「but 转折 + So 结论」这一组连贯信号，正是答案句的标志。
**替换** practically all of those factories had to close down ↔Nearly all of them closed down decades ago. practically ≈ nearly，1950s = decades ago
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 未提及录音从头到尾没提帽厂亏损的事，Almost all of them were operating at a deficit. 是把「衰落」这个事实换成了「亏损」这个具体的财务原因，原文并未给出。
B) 原词陷阱They have all been turned into movie theatres. 盗用了 we transformed it into a movie theater 中「改造成电影院」的措辞——但录音明说这件事只发生在「这一家」帽厂（This one, in particular, was closed for 47 years before we transformed it into a movie theater.），把单数案例扩大到全部，是典型张冠李戴。借用原文： This one, in particular, was closed for 47 years before we transformed it into a movie theater.
D) 与原文相反录音说 fashion changed and most people stopped wearing hats 才导致工厂关门——是被潮流「抛弃」，而非 They have adapted to meet fashion changes. 所说的「成功顺应潮流」，极性正好相反。借用原文： fashion changed and most people stopped wearing hats
questions.quote: There used to be many hat factories in Britain until around the 1950s, but fashion changed and most people stopped wearing hats. So practically all of those factories had to close down.

options.text: Almost all of them were operating at a deficit.
They have all been turned into movie theatres.
Nearly all of them closed down decades ago.
They have adapted to meet fashion changes.

questions.prompt: What is special about Cube Movie Theater?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题） It shows foreign movies exclusively.
**题目译文**
Cube电影院有什么特别之处？
A) 它专门放映外国电影。
B) 它放映20世纪50年代的电影。
C) 它是伦敦最古老的电影院。
D) 它位于一家帽子工厂旁边。
**定位** 我们是全国唯一一家只放外语电影的影院。
**信号** the only + only 双重独家信号。the only movie theater in the whole country 用 the only 给独特性钉了第一颗钉子，that only shows foreign movies 又用 only 把范围进一步缩死——「the only ... only」这种双重限定，是答案句最强的信号。
**替换** only shows foreign movies ↔ It shows foreign movies exclusively. only ↔ exclusively 的同义替换
questions.tip:
**排除**
B) 原词陷阱It shows movies from the 1950s. 把第 12 题里出现过的 until around the 1950s 这个时间数字盗过来当影院题材，制造「听到 1950s 就想选」的诱惑——可 1950s 在录音里讲的是「帽厂的年代」，而非影院上映的电影年代，是典型的张冠李戴。借用原文： until around the 1950s
C) 未提及It is the oldest theatre in London. 录音里压根没提「最老」，反而说 Cube Movie Theater has been around now for 11 years.——只有 11 年的影院显然算不上 oldest。借用原文： Cube Movie Theater has been around now for 11 years.
D) 原词陷阱It is located next to a hat factory. 利用了录音里 It's located in what used to be a hat factory. 的措辞——但原文说的是「影院开在原先的帽厂里」，next to（紧邻）与 in what used to be（开在旧址里）位置关系完全不同，是典型的偷换位置概念。借用原文： It's located in what used to be a hat factory.
questions.quote: We are the only movie theater in the whole country that only shows foreign movies.

options.text: It shows foreign movies exclusively.
It shows movies from the 1950s.
It is the oldest theatre in London.
It is located next to a hat factory.

questions.prompt: What does the man say about most people in London?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题） They don't speak foreign languages.
**题目译文**
关于伦敦的大多数人，这位男士说了什么？
A) 他们在社交场合戴帽子。
B) 他们不会说外语。
C) 他们喜欢看外国电影。
D) 他们不常去电影院。
**定位** 这种电影真有那么多人看吗？我本以为伦敦的大多数人是不懂外语的。
**信号** I would have thought + most people don't 的观点信号。I would have thought that... 是男方亮出自己看法的标志性结构，紧跟其后的 most people don't speak foreign languages 就是他对伦敦多数人的判断——「I thought / I would have thought」之后那句是观点句，必抓。
**替换** most people don't speak foreign languages↔They don't speak foreign languages.几乎原句对原句，主语等值替换
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱They wear hats on social occasions. 利用录音里反复出现的 most people stopped wearing hats 这个词组制造熟悉感——但原文是说英国人「不再戴帽」，并非「在社交场合戴帽」，且这句话是关于「英国人对帽子的态度」，不是「伦敦人对外语的态度」，话题与说话人都对不上。借用原文： most people stopped wearing hats
C) 与原文相反They enjoy watching foreign movies. 的极性正好和男方观点相反——男方明说 most people don't speak foreign languages，正是在质疑「demand 够不够」，而非肯定他们爱看外语片；而后女方才反驳说外语片仍有市场，但那是女方的话，不是男方的。借用原文： most people don't speak foreign languages
D) 未提及They don't go to movie theatres often. 是关于伦敦人「去影院频率」的描述，录音里从未提及伦敦人「常不常去影院」，属于无中生有。
questions.quote: Is there enough demand for that? I would have thought that in London, most people don't speak foreign languages.

options.text: They wear hats on social occasions.
They don't speak foreign languages.
They enjoy watching foreign movies.
They don't go to movie theatres often.

questions.prompt: What does the woman say about foreign movies shown in London?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题） They have an English translation on the screen.
**题目译文**
关于在伦敦放映的外国电影，这位女士说了什么？
A) 它们主要是为移民准备的。
B) 它们吸引大批年轻的伦敦人。
C) 它们对英国人来说很难欣赏。
D) 它们在屏幕上有英文翻译。
**定位** 另外我得补一句，所有的电影都在屏幕下方配有英文文字，所以哪怕听不懂演员说什么，你也能读字幕。
**信号** Furthermore + I might add 的补充强调信号。女方一连用 Furthermore 和 I might add两个补充强调标志把这条信息推到台前，紧跟其后给出「屏幕下方有英文」这一具体事实——「Furthermore + I might add」组合是答主特别想让人记住的那一句的信号灯。
**替换** all movies come with English text at the bottom of the screen↔They have an English translation on the screen. English text ↔ English translation；at the bottom of the screen ↔ on the screen even if you don't understand what the actors say, you can still read it↔They have an English translation on the screen.补充句佐证字幕功能
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 未提及They are meant mostly for immigrants. 把外语片的受众限定为「移民」，录音里完全没出现 immigrants 这个话题，是凭常识脑补出来的无中生有。
B) 原词陷阱They attract large crowds of young Londoners. 利用了录音中 lots of people interested in watching such movies 与 London 的搭配——但原文只说「有很多人感兴趣」，并未限定为「年轻伦敦人」；选项把宽泛的 lots of people 偷换成具体的 young Londoners，加了原文没有的修饰语 young。借用原文： lots of people interested in watching such movies
C) 与原文相反They are hard for English people to appreciate. 的极性和女方观点相反——女方一直在反驳「外语片在伦敦没人看」的怀疑，强调 there's enough demand 和 lots of people interested，没有任何「难以欣赏」的意思。借用原文： there's enough demand
questions.quote: Furthermore, I might add, all movies come with English text at the bottom of the screen. So even if you don't understand what the actors say, you can still read it.

options.text: They are meant mostly for immigrants.
They attract large crowds of young Londoners.
They are hard for English people to appreciate.
They have an English translation on the screen.

transcriptTranslations: 无论喜欢还是讨厌，智能手机已经成为我们日常生活中不可或缺的一部分。但它们应该被拒之于课堂之外吗？
英格兰学校标准大臣Nick Gibb认为，学校应该禁止学生携带智能手机。
中学数学教师Astrid Natley在课堂上使用手机。她说："我的学校没有钱买平板电脑。当学生用手机做研究时，他们会意识到自己手中握有一个强大的工具。如果我们禁止孩子使用手机，我们就是在拒绝他们关心的东西。"
与此同时，在社区教育部门工作的注册护士Helen Lockhart支持全面禁止。"我在工作时被禁止使用手机,而且必须上交手机。如果我被发现口袋里有手机,我将受到纪律处分,这会影响我的职业生涯。我们需要教会孩子们如何表现得像他们努力成为的专业人士。"
英语教师Richard Stone认为学校和家庭之间应该有明确的界限。"学生在这两种环境中应该做不同的事情。孩子们在生活中已经有足够多的屏幕时间,没有必要把手机带进课堂。互联网作为研究工具过于便捷且不够可靠,所以让我们把手机和笔记本电脑留在家里,在课堂上向他们展示一个不同的世界——一个书本和笔的世界。"他说。
六岁女孩Kate帮哥哥擦窗户，以获得母亲承诺的奖励——她想要的一个紫色玩偶。她看着母亲在网上订购这个玩偶。第二天Kate问能否查看物流状态，于是她妈妈点开网页后走出了房间。Kate看到她的玩偶将在第二天下午送达，但随后她注意到了别的东西——关于她可以订购的其他玩偶和玩具的推荐。15分钟和几次点击之后，购物车里装着价值超过350美元的玩偶，Kate下了单并跑去玩了。

第二天，在查看另一个网上订单时，她母亲注意到了一长串在途的玩偶。她能够取消其中两个，但已经来不及取消其余的了。她告诉女儿这些玩偶将被退回。当包裹到达时，Kate想打开它们，但她父母说不行。她父亲建议把玩偶送给当地儿童医院，而不是退回去。于是下周，Kate一家装满了他们的车，把所有玩偶送到了儿童医院的游戏室。Kate起初很沮丧，但随后她和几个住院的女孩坐在一起，她们一起打开了所有盒子，笑着玩着。她玩得很开心，并学到了非常好的一课。

出生日期能否影响你的人生成功程度？根据澳大利亚最近进行的研究，答案是肯定的。研究人员发现，一个人开始上学的时间对其一生有持久的影响。那些与同学相比年龄相对较大的人比他们具有某些优势。先前的研究发现年龄较大的学生取得更好的成绩。他们也更有可能上大学，成为职业运动员、首席执行官甚至重要的政治家。但澳大利亚研究人员想要发现是什么驱动了这些差异。他们怀疑年龄较大、更成熟的学生因为取得更好的成绩而获得比同龄人更多的自信。

为了验证这一点，他们进行了两项研究。一项针对高中生，另一项针对一千多名年龄在24至60岁之间的澳大利亚成年人。在第一项研究中，600多名高中生接受了关于他们冒险倾向和自信心的调查。在第二项研究中,那些出生在入学截止日期两侧的人被要求完成在线数学题并评估自己的表现。他们还被问及骑自行车和管理财务时所冒的风险。研究人员发现年龄较大的学生表现出更大的冒险倾向。虽然冒险可以被视为一种负面特质，但它也是成功人士的特征，包括运动员、政治领袖和企业家。

questions.prompt: What do we learn about Astrid Natley, a secondary school math teacher?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题） She incorporates smartphones into her teaching.
**题目译文**
关于中学数学教师Astrid Natley，我们了解到什么？
A) 她认为智能手机无法替代平板电脑。
B) 她将智能手机融入她的教学中。
C) 她无法阻止孩子们使用智能手机。
D) 她认为智能手机会分散注意力。
**定位** Astrid Natley是一位中学数学老师，她把手机融入到了自己的课堂里。
**信号** 人物登场首句即定调。原文Astrid Natley, a secondary school math teacher, incorporates phones into her classroom.是该人物在文中首次出现的那句话，篇章独白介绍人物时通常"姓名+身份+核心做法"一句话点题，这种"登场首句"就是关于该人物事实的答案信号。
**替换** incorporates phones into her classroom ↔ incorporates smartphones into her teaching phones=smartphones、classroom≈teaching
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱录音里她说My school doesn't have money for tablets，意思是"学校没钱买平板，所以才用手机"，盗用了原文的tablets一词，做成"她不认为手机能替代平板"这种相反观点，属于原词陷阱+与原文相反。借用原文： My school doesn't have money for tablets
C) 偷换概念录音If we stop children using phones, we're rejecting something they care about.是"如果我们阻止孩子用手机，等于拒绝他们在乎的东西"——是"不愿阻止"的价值判断；选项She cannot stop children using smartphones.盗用stop children using phones原词，却换成"无法阻止"，偷换了情态。借用原文： If we stop children using phones, we're rejecting something they care about.
D) 与原文相反原文她把手机视为a powerful tool in their hands，是正面评价；选项She regards smartphones as a distraction.却说她把手机视为"干扰"，立场与原文相反。借用原文： a powerful tool in their hands
questions.quote: Astrid Natley, a secondary school math teacher, incorporates phones into her classroom.

options.text: She doesn't think smartphones can replace tablets.
She incorporates smartphones into her teaching.
She cannot stop children using smartphones.
She regards smartphones as a distraction.

questions.prompt: Why does Helen Lockhart, a registered nurse, support a complete ban on smartphone use in the classroom?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题） To help children grow up to be professionals.
**题目译文**
注册护士Helen Lockhart为什么支持在课堂上完全禁止使用智能手机？
A) 为了执行学校纪律。
B) 为了让学生集中注意力。
C) 为了帮助孩子们成长为专业人士。
D) 为了培养孩子们良好的学习习惯。
**定位** 我们需要教孩子们像他们将来要努力成为的那些专业人士一样去行事。
**信号** 段尾"need to"目的陈述。原文We need to teach children how to behave like the professionals they are striving to become.位于Helen段落末尾，以We need to开头的句子是她整段论证的结论与目的——"need to"是表目的的强信号词，是答案信号。
**替换** teach children how to behave like the professionals they are striving to become↔To help children grow up to be professionals behave like professionals=grow up to be professionals
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱录音I will be subject to disciplinary procedure是她讲自己工作场所的纪律后果，作为引出"教孩子像专业人士"目的的铺垫；选项To enforce school discipline.盗用disciplinary原词，扭成"她支持禁手机的目的是维护校纪"，张冠李戴。借用原文： I will be subject to disciplinary procedure
B) 未提及录音里Helen段没有任何关于concentration/focus/attention的表述，选项To make students concentrate.是听上去合理但原文未提及的干扰项。
D) 未提及录音里Helen段没有提到study habits或类似的"养成学习习惯"，选项To cultivate children's good study habits.是另一个"听上去禁手机的合理理由"，属于未提及陷阱。
questions.quote: We need to teach children how to behave like the professionals they are striving to become.

options.text: To enforce school discipline.
To make students concentrate.
To help children grow up to be professionals.
To cultivate children's good study habits.

questions.prompt: What should students do in the classroom according to Richard Stone, an English teacher?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题） Use books and pens only.
**题目译文**
根据英语教师Richard Stone的说法，学生在课堂上应该做什么？
A) 只使用书本和笔。
B) 减少他们的屏幕使用时间。
C) 充分利用电子设备。
D) 学习使用互联网进行研究。
**定位** 所以让我们把手机和笔记本电脑都留在家里，在课堂上向他们展示一个不一样的世界——一个由书本和钢笔构成的世界。
**信号** let's+破折号定义结论句。原文so let's leave phones and laptops at home, and show them a different world in their lessons—one of books and pens以"so let's…"建议式结构开头，又用破折号引出对"a different world"的同位语解释"one of books and pens"——这是典型的"结论+具象化"信号，是答案句。
**替换** leave phones and laptops at home↔Use books and pens only把手机和电脑留家=不用电子设备show them a different world in their lessons—one of books and pens↔Use books and pens only books and pens的世界=只用书本和钢笔
questions.tip:
**排除**
B) 原词陷阱录音Children are getting more than enough screen time in their lives without the need to bring their phone into the classroom.提到screen time，是Richard用以解释"为什么不该带手机进课堂"的背景论据，并非他对学生课堂行为的主张；选项Cut down their screen time.盗用screen time原词来制造听到就想选的诱惑。借用原文： Children are getting more than enough screen time in their lives without the need to bring their phone into the classroom.
C) 与原文相反Richard明确主张let's leave phones and laptops at home，是反对在课堂用电子设备；选项Make full use of electronic devices.反过来说"充分利用电子设备"，立场反向。借用原文： let's leave phones and laptops at home
D) 与原文相反录音The internet is too easy and too unreliable a research tool里，Richard明明在批评"互联网作为研究工具太简单、太不可靠"；选项Learn to use the internet for research.盗用internet、research原词，反过来说"学会用网做研究"，立场翻转。借用原文： The internet is too easy and too unreliable a research tool
questions.quote: so let's leave phones and laptops at home, and show them a different world in their lessons—one of books and pens

options.text: Use books and pens only.
Cut down their screen time.
Make full use of electronic devices.
Learn to use the internet for research.

questions.prompt: How did Kate earn the reward from her mother?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题） By helping her brother wash windows.
**题目译文**
Kate 是如何从她母亲那里获得奖励的?
A) 通过清洁厨房地板。
B) 通过照顾她的小弟弟。
C) 通过帮助她母亲洗碗。
D) 通过帮助她弟弟擦窗户。
**定位** 凯特，一个六岁的小女孩，帮哥哥擦窗户，为的是拿到妈妈答应的奖励——一只她想要的紫色娃娃。
**信号** to get a reward 的目的状语。helped her brother wash windows to get a reward promised by her mother 这句里 to get a reward 是目的状语，前面的动作（helped her brother wash windows）就是为了拿奖励而做的事，正是题目问的 how earn the reward。
**替换** helped her brother wash windows↔helping her brother wash windows几乎原词复现，仅时态变形
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 未提及By cleaning the kitchen floor. 是常见家务但录音里完全没提，属于未提及型干扰，专骗那些把做家务挣奖励脑补成打扫卫生的考生。
B) 原词陷阱By looking after her baby brother. 盗用了录音里的 brother 一词制造熟感，但录音里说的是 helped her brother wash windows，是凯特帮哥哥，而不是照看弟弟。借用原文： helped her brother wash windows
C) 原词陷阱By helping her mother do the dishes. 蹭了录音里 helped 与为妈妈做事的氛围，但录音里凯特帮的是 brother、做的是 wash windows，不是帮 mother do the dishes。借用原文： promised by her mother
questions.quote: Kate, a six-year-old girl, helped her brother wash windows to get a reward promised by her mother, a purple doll that she wanted.

options.text: By cleaning the kitchen floor.
By looking after her baby brother.
By helping her mother do the dishes.
By helping her brother wash windows.

questions.prompt: What did Kate do after her mother left the room?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题） She ordered a large number of dolls.
**题目译文**
Kate 的母亲离开房间后她做了什么?
A) 她订购了大量娃娃。
B) 她查看是否订购了紫色娃娃。
C) 她错误地取消了她妈妈的订单。
D) 她订购了一个更贵的娃娃。
**定位** 15 分钟和几次点击之后，购物车里装着价值 350 多美元的娃娃，凯特下了单，跑去玩了。
**信号** 总结性结尾句加数量爆炸。15 minutes and a few clicks later, with more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart, Kate placed the order 这句是这一段动作的收束句，350 美元、placed the order 几个反常细节直接交代了凯特在妈妈走后做了什么——她下了一大堆娃娃的订单。这种数量或价格爆表的细节，几乎一定是答案信号。
**替换** more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart↔She ordered a large number of dolls.数量上的同义改写Kate placed the order↔ She ordered a large number of dolls.动词短语到单动词的等值替换
questions.tip:
**排除**
B) 原词陷阱She checked if a purple doll was ordered. 盗用了录音里 purple doll 和 check the shipping status 制造她检查了紫娃娃订单的幻觉，但录音里 check 的是 shipping status（物流），而且那是动作的起点不是后果，她做了什么的真正答案是后面的下单。借用原文： Kate asked if she could check the shipping status
C) 张冠李戴She mistakenly canceled her mom's order. 录音里恰恰是 cancel 这个词出现了，但执行者是妈妈第二天才取消的两单，不是凯特；凯特做的事是反方向的加单。借用原文： She was able to cancel two of them
D) 偷换概念She ordered a more expensive doll instead. 录音里凯特的问题不是换了一只更贵的，而是在原本一只之外又加了一大堆，重点是数量爆炸而不是单只价格升级，是过度推断式的偏移。借用原文： more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart
questions.quote: 15 minutes and a few clicks later, with more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart, Kate placed the order and ran off to play.

options.text: She ordered a large number of dolls.
She checked if a purple doll was ordered.
She mistakenly canceled her mom's order.
She ordered a more expensive doll instead.

questions.prompt: What did Kate's family do after the packages arrived?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题） They took all of them to the children's hospital.
**题目译文**
包裹到达后 Kate 一家做了什么?
A) 他们请儿童医院来取这些包裹。
B) 他们把所有包裹带到了儿童医院。
C) 他们逐一打开了所有包裹。
D) 他们讨论了把这些包裹放在哪里。
**定位** 她父亲提议不要把娃娃寄回去，而是捐给当地的儿童医院。于是第二周，凯特一家装了一车，把所有娃娃送到了儿童医院的活动室。
**信号** 结果句 So 加 took all the dolls。So the next week, Kate's family loaded up their car and took all the dolls to the playroom at the children's hospital. 中的 So 是因果结果信号，把前面父亲提议的话变成实际行动，直接给出全家把所有娃娃送去了医院这个确定答案。
**替换** took all the dolls to the playroom at the children's hospital↔They took all of them to the children's hospital.几乎原句直译
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱They asked the children's hospital to pick them. 蹭了录音里的 children's hospital 制造熟感，但录音里是家里人把娃娃送去，不是请医院来挑，动作方向完全相反。借用原文： took all the dolls to the playroom at the children's hospital
C) 张冠李戴They opened all of them one by one. 盗用了录音里 opened up all the boxes 这个动作，但执行人是凯特和医院里的小女孩患者们，不是凯特一家，而且发生地点也在医院里、不是包裹一到家就打开。借用原文： they opened up all the boxes together
D) 未提及discussed where to keep them. 这个动作完全没出现，录音直奔父亲提议捐医院，没经过商量放哪儿。
questions.quote: Instead of sending back the dolls, her father suggested giving them to the local children's hospital. So the next week, Kate's family loaded up their car and took all the dolls to the playroom at the children's hospital.

options.text: They asked the children's hospital to pick them.
They took all of them to the children's hospital.
They opened all of them one by one.
They discussed where to keep them.

questions.prompt: According to recent research conducted in Australia, what has a lasting impact on one's life?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题） The time one starts school.
**题目译文**
根据最近在澳大利亚进行的研究,什么对一个人的一生有持久影响?
A) 一个人开始上学的时间。
B) 课堂氛围。
C) 一个人就读的学校。
D) 与同学的关系。
**定位** 研究者发现，一个人开始上学的时间会对其一生产生持久的影响。
**信号** researchers found 这一研究结论信号。篇章独白里 The researchers found that 是典型的结论提示词——后面紧跟的句子就是研究的核心发现，几乎必然是答案句。再加上 has an enduring impact on their lives 与题干 lasting impact on one's life 完全对应，可以确认就是这一句。
**替换** the time when a person starts school↔The time one starts school.句式压缩同义替换has an enduring impact on their lives↔a lasting impact on one's life形容词同义替换
questions.tip:
**排除**
B) 未提及录音从头到尾没有出现 atmosphere、classroom environment 这类表达，The classroom atmosphere. 属于教育话题里常用的凑数干扰，没有任何原文支撑。
C) 原词陷阱The school that one attends. 借了录音里反复出现的 school 一词来制造熟悉感，但录音说的是 the time when a person starts school——重点在 time 不在 school 本身，把入学时间偷换成了上的什么学校，是典型的原词陷阱。借用原文： the time when a person starts school
D) 原词陷阱The relationship with classmates. 提到的 classmates 虽然在录音里以 compared to their classmates 出现过一次，但录音只是用 classmates 来做参照对象，没有讨论同学关系本身对人生的影响，属于借词不传义。借用原文： compared to their classmates
questions.quote: The researchers found that the time when a person starts school has an enduring impact on their lives.

options.text: The time one starts school.
The classroom atmosphere.
The school that one attends.
The relationship with classmates.

questions.prompt: What was the purpose of the Australian research?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （目的题） To find causes for differences in the participants' performance.
**题目译文**
澳大利亚这项研究的目的是什么?
A) 帮助家长决定何时送孩子上学。
B) 找出参与者表现差异的原因。
C) 识别有潜力成为职业运动员的学生。
D) 为制定教育政策提供建设性建议。
**定位** 但澳大利亚的研究者们想要弄清楚究竟是什么在驱动这些差异。
**信号** but + wanted to discover 这一双重信号。But the Australian researchers wanted to discover what was driving these differences. 既有转折信号 but，又有目的结构 wanted to discover，两个信号叠加，几乎可以确认这就是研究目的的官方表述句。
**替换** wanted to discover what was driving these differences↔To find causes for differences in the participants' performance.同义动词与名词改写
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 偷换概念To help parents decide when to send their children to school. 借了 starts school 的话题词，把研究目的偷换成给家长的择校建议，但录音从未提及 parents 或 advice，是典型的应用层偷换。借用原文： the time when a person starts school
C) 原词陷阱To identify students having potential to be professional athletes. 借了录音里professional athletes 一词来制造听到就想选的诱惑，但录音里 athletes 只是顺带列举的成功人士之一，不是研究目的。借用原文： professional athletes
D) 过度推断To offer constructive suggestions for making educational policies. 把研究目的拔高到教育政策层面，录音里完全没有出现 policy、policymaker 或 suggestion 等表达，属于无中生有。
questions.quote: But the Australian researchers wanted to discover what was driving these differences.

options.text: To help parents decide when to send their children to school.
To find causes for differences in the participants' performance.
To identify students having potential to be professional athletes.
To offer constructive suggestions for making educational policies.

questions.prompt: Who were the participants in the researchers' first study?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题） High-school students.
**题目译文**
研究人员第一项研究的参与者是谁?
A) 政治领袖。
B) 金融分析师。
C) 职业运动员。
D) 高中生。
**定位** 在第一项研究中，超过六百名高中生接受了关于其冒险倾向与自信感的调查。
**信号** In the first study 这一段落标志。In the first study 是典型的研究步骤标志词，后面紧跟的就是该研究的被试群体，是非常明确的定位信号；紧随其后的 high school students 就是答案。
**替换** more than 600 high school students↔High-school students.数量修饰被剥离的概括式替换
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱Political leaders. 借了录音末尾 political leaders 一词制造熟悉感，但 political leaders 是在 including athletes, political leaders and entrepreneurs 这一举例结构里出现，是成功人士的例子，不是第一项研究的被试。借用原文： including athletes, political leaders and entrepreneurs
B) 未提及Financial analysts. 在录音里完全没有对应表达，录音只在 managing their finances 中出现过 finances 一词，但讲的是受试者管理财务时的冒险行为，与金融分析师这个职业身份毫不相关。
C) 原词陷阱Professional athletes. 借了录音里反复出现的 professional athletes 一词，但录音里athletes 始终是作为成功人士的例子出现，从未被列为第一项研究的被试群体，属于借词换位。借用原文： professional athletes
questions.quote: In the first study more than 600 high school students were surveyed about their tendency to take risks and feel confident.

options.text: Political leaders.
Financial analysts.
Professional athletes.
High-school students.

questions.prompt: According to the researchers, what is one characteristic of successful people?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题） Risk-taking.
**题目译文**
根据研究人员的说法,成功人士的一个特征是什么?
A) 领导能力。
B) 对工作的投入。
C) 冒险精神。
D) 自信。
**定位** 尽管冒险有时被视为一种负面特质，但它同时也是成功人士的一种特征，包括运动员、政界领袖与企业家在内。
**信号** while 让步 + it's also 转折强调。While risk-taking can be considered a negative attribute, it's also a characteristic of successful people 用 while 引导让步、随后 it's also 强调真正想说的一面——这种让步+强调结构里的强调句几乎必然是答案。
**替换** it's also a characteristic of successful people↔one characteristic of successful people句式结构高度复现risk-taking↔ Risk-taking.代词指代回填
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 过度推断Leadership ability. 利用了录音末尾 political leaders 一词制造领导力联想，但录音说成功人士包括政界领袖，并没有把 leadership ability 列为他们的共性特征。借用原文： including athletes, political leaders and entrepreneurs
B) 未提及Commitment to work. 是非常常见的成功学描述，但录音里完全没有出现 commitment、dedication、hard work 等字眼，属于无中生有。
D) 原词陷阱Self-confidence. 借了录音里多次出现的 self-confidence 与 feel confident，但录音只把self-confidence 作为研究的假设变量，最终结论强调的特征是 risk-taking，不是 self- confidence。借用原文： it's also a characteristic of successful people
questions.quote: While risk-taking can be considered a negative attribute, it's also a characteristic of successful people, including athletes, political leaders and entrepreneurs.

options.text: Leadership ability.
Commitment to work.
Risk-taking.
Self-confidence.

transcriptTranslations: 非洲领导人计划将该大陆变成一个无边界的大陆。他们将推行单一护照政策,允许各国之间自由流动。这一来自非洲联盟的想法是以欧盟申根自由流动协议为蓝本的。欧洲已经取消了许多内部边界,这使得整个大陆可以免签证自由流动。目前,13个非洲国家之间已经建立了免签证协议。这些协议允许公民无需签证即可访问另一个国家。一些国家提供落地签证。相比之下,美国人能够在无需签证或获得落地签证的情况下前往该大陆的20个国家。代表54个国家的非洲联盟希望取消非洲人访问其他非洲国家的签证要求。它还希望在不久的将来在整个大陆建立自由贸易协定,因为非洲大陆内部的贸易成本高于任何其他地区。

冰岛的研究人员发现了一种应对气候变化的新方法，即将二氧化碳泵入地下并将其转化为石头。其他碳捕获和储存方法以气体形式储存二氧化碳。但问题包括成本高昂以及对泄漏的担忧。据《卫报》报道，这种埋藏二氧化碳并将其转化为石头的新方法更便宜、更安全。为了将二氧化碳转化为石头，CarbFix项目的研究人员将气体泵入火山岩中，并加速了火山岩与气体反应形成碳矿物的自然过程。气体仅在两年内就转化为固体,远快于研究人员预测的数百年或数千年。该研究在冰岛的Hellisheidi发电厂进行。冰岛的该项目规模已经扩大,每年可埋藏10,000吨二氧化碳。一个潜在的困难是,每埋藏一吨二氧化碳,该技术需要25吨水。然而,首席研究员表示可以使用海水。
法国一家磨坊协会表示,法国人正在远离细长的法式棍子面包,转而选择更健康、更便宜的食品。法国全国磨坊协会称,面包消费量正在下降,法国人的食用量比前一年减少了9克。该协会对这一趋势将对其行业产生的影响表示担忧,并提出了造成这种情况的三个原因。
首先,该协会指出饮食习惯的改变,特别是转向低热量饮食,是面包消费量减少的一个因素。这可以解释为什么性别之间的消费差异如此之大。如今,男性平均每天吃大约140克面包,而女性吃80到90克。他们所说的第二个原因是该国生活方式的变化,人们用于早餐的时间减少了,而早餐传统上会搭配黄油和果酱吃面包。最后,面包价格上涨被认为是一个因素,法式棍子面包的价格在过去10年中上涨了近25%。

questions.prompt: What is the news report mainly about?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （主旨题） A proposed policy allowing Africans to travel in Africa without a visa.
**题目译文**
这则新闻报道主要是关于什么的?
A) 一项允许非洲人在非洲境内免签旅行的拟议政策。
B) 13个非洲国家之间建立自由贸易区的协议。
C) 一项邀请所有非洲国家加入非洲联盟的计划。
D) 一项允许游客免签访问非洲的重要倡议。
**定位** 非洲各国领导人计划把整个非洲大陆变成一个没有边界的大陆。他们将推出统一护照政策，允许各国之间自由通行。
**信号** 开头点题即主旨。新闻类听力的导语句几乎就是主旨句。African leaders plan to turn the continent into a continent without borders. 这一句开门见山讲"非洲领导人要让整个非洲免边界（即免签）"，紧接着 They will introduce a single passport policy, allowing free movement between countries. 直接落到具体政策上——"政策+对象"全在这里。
**替换** turn the continent into a continent without borders↔ travel in Africa without a visa "无边界"="免签通行" allowing free movement between countries ↔ Africans to travel in Africa free movement=travel The African Union, which represents 54 states, wants to abolish the requirement of a visa for Africans visiting other African countries.↔ A proposed policy allowing Africans to travel in Africa without a visa.原文反复点 Africans+visa
questions.tip:
**排除**
B) 原词陷阱B 盗用了录音 Currently, 13 African countries have visa-free deals in place with each other. 里的 13 African countries 这个数字原词，但原文说的是"目前已有 13 国互相免签"，根本不是"13 国设立自贸区"——自贸区在原文里是另一桩"未来要做的事"，不限于 13国。借用原文： Currently, 13 African countries have visa-free deals in place with each other.
C) 原词陷阱C 盗用了原文 The African Union, which represents 54 states（非盟代表 54 个国家）中的 African Union 这一专名，制造"听到非盟就想选"的诱惑；但原文谈的是非盟"代表"54 国并推动免签自贸，根本没说要"邀请各国加入非盟"——加入与否不是本新闻的话题。借用原文： The African Union, which represents 54 states
D) 张冠李戴D 用 tourists 替换了原文里的 Africans——原文 Americans are able to travel to 20 of the continent's countries without a visa 是在拿"美国人（外来游客的代表）现状"与"非洲人现状"作对照，目的恰恰是说"非洲人反而不如外人方便、所以才要改"。把主体从"非洲人"偷换到"游客"，正好与新闻核心相反。借用原文： Americans are able to travel to 20 of the continent's countries without a visa
questions.quote: African leaders plan to turn the continent into a continent without borders. They will introduce a single passport policy, allowing free movement between countries.

options.text: A proposed policy allowing Africans to travel in Africa without a visa.
An agreement among 13 African countries to set up a free-trade zone.
A plan to invite all African countries to join the African Union.
An important initiative to permit tourists to visit Africa without a visa.

questions.prompt: What benefit will a free trade deal bring to African economy?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题） It will reduce the cost of trade between African countries.
**题目译文**
自由贸易协议将为非洲经济带来什么好处?
A) 它将吸引来自世界各地的更多投资。
B) 它将帮助许多非洲国家减少贸易逆差。
C) 它将降低非洲国家之间的贸易成本。
D) 它将使非洲人在世界贸易中发挥更大作用。
**定位** （非盟）还希望在不久的将来在整个非洲大陆建立自由贸易协定，因为目前非洲大陆内部的贸易成本比其他任何地区都要高。
**信号** as 引出原因即落点。答案句里出现因果信号词 as trade within the African continent costs more than any other region——as 在这里是"因为"。"自贸要解决的问题=非洲内部贸易最贵"，反过来推就是"自贸的好处=降低非洲内部贸易成本"。这就是听力"信号词后是落点"的典型用法。
**替换** trade within the African continent costs more than any other region ↔reduce the cost of trade between African countries因果对调＋反义改写
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 未提及录音通篇没提到 investment / invest 任何形式的词。A 听起来"很正确"是因为它符合考生对"自贸好处"的常识联想，但题目问的是录音里给出的好处，不是考生想到的好处。
B) 偷换概念B 用 trade deficits（贸易逆差）替换了原文真正说的 trade costs（贸易成本）。"贸易成本"和"贸易逆差"是两个完全不同的经济概念——前者是"做生意要花多少钱"，后者是"进口比出口多多少"。选项利用了 trade 这个原词来诱选。借用原文： trade within the African continent costs more than any other region
D) 过度推断D 说的 a bigger role in world trade（在世界贸易中扮演更大角色）把范围从"非洲内部"扩到了"全世界"。原文里 free trade deal 限定的范围是 across the continent（在整个非洲大陆），目标是降低非洲国家之间的贸易成本，并未谈到非洲在世界贸易里的地位变化。借用原文： establish a free trade deal across the continent
questions.quote: It also wants to establish a free trade deal across the continent in the near future, as trade within the African continent costs more than any other region.

options.text: It will attract more investments from all over the world.
It will help many African countries reduce trade deficits.
It will reduce the cost of trade between African countries.
It will allow Africans to play a bigger role in world trade.

questions.prompt: What new method has been developed to help fight climate change?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题） Pumping carbon dioxide underground to form stone.
**题目译文**
已经开发出什么新方法来帮助对抗气候变化？
A) 用海水冷却火山岩。
B) 以气体形式将二氧化碳储存在地下。
C) 捕获二氧化碳并将其埋在海底。
D) 将二氧化碳泵入地下使其形成石头。
**定位** 冰岛的研究人员发现了一种应对气候变化的新方法：把二氧化碳泵入地下，将其变成石头。
**信号** 首句点题信号 a new way。Researchers in Iceland found a new way of tackling climate change 中的 found a new way 与题干 new method 形成同义对接，是新闻典型的开门见山首句点题，这一句直接承载新方法是什么的答案。
**替换** pumping carbon dioxide underground ↔ Pumping carbon dioxide underground原词同形复现turning it into stone↔to form stone turn into = form 的动词同义替换
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱选项把录音里两处出现的 volcanic rock 与 sea water 拼成 cooling down volcanic rock with sea water，但录音从未说过冷却火山岩这件事，cooling 是凭空造的动作。借用原文： pumped the gas into volcanic rock
B) 张冠李戴录音原文 Other carbon capture and storage methods store carbon dioxide as a gas.明确说把二氧化碳以气体形式储存是其他/已有方法，本则新闻要讲的恰恰是与之对照的新方法；选项 B 把旧方法当成新方法的答案，是典型张冠李戴。借用原文： Other carbon capture and storage methods store carbon dioxide as a gas.
C) 偷换概念录音说的是 burying carbon dioxide and turning it into stone，埋的地方是地下（underground / volcanic rock），但选项 C 写成 burying it under the sea，把地点偷换成海底；只是单词长得像，意思完全偏。借用原文： burying carbon dioxide and turning it into stone
questions.quote: Researchers in Iceland found a new way of tackling climate change by pumping carbon dioxide underground and turning it into stone.

options.text: Cooling down volcanic rock with sea water.
Storing carbon dioxide underground as a gas.
Capturing carbon dioxide and burying it under the sea.
Pumping carbon dioxide underground to form stone.

questions.prompt: What is a potential difficulty in applying the new technique?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题） High consumption of water.
**题目译文**
应用这项新技术的潜在困难是什么？
A) 缺乏掩埋场地。
B) 处理时间长。
C) 水消耗量大。
D) 能源成本巨大。
**定位** 一个潜在的困难是，每埋藏一吨二氧化碳，这项技术需要 25 吨水。
**信号** 题干原词信号 One potential difficulty。One potential difficulty is that 与题干potential difficulty 用词几乎完全一致，是录音替我们点出的答案句信号词；这是新闻收尾段最常见的转折/补充结构，信号词后那一句就是承载答案的句子。
**替换** requires 25 tons of water↔ High consumption of water数量级 → 程度词，动词 → 名词化for each ton of carbon dioxide buried, the technique requires 25 tons of water↔High consumption of water 1∶25 比例支撑 High 这一判断
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 未提及录音并未提到埋藏地点不够这件事，反而提到 the project in Iceland has been increased in scale to bury 10,000 tons of carbon dioxide each year，说明埋藏规模在扩大，不是缺地的问题；选项 A 属于无中生有。
B) 与原文相反录音说的是 The gas turned into solid in just two years, much faster than the hundreds or thousands of years researchers had predicted.，明确强调这项技术比预期快得多，并不是耗时长；选项 B 取了 hundreds of years 这一原词却反了方向。借用原文： The gas turned into solid in just two years, much faster than the hundreds or thousands of years researchers had predicted.
D) 原词陷阱录音里的 Other carbon capture and storage methods store carbon dioxide as a gas. But problems include a high cost and concern about leaks. 中的 high cost 是描述其他/旧方法的问题，且讲的是费用而非 energy；选项 D 把 cost 与 energy 拼到一起，既张冠李戴（说的是旧方法）、又偷换概念（cost ≠ energy）。借用原文： problems include a high cost and concern about leaks
questions.quote: One potential difficulty is that for each ton of carbon dioxide buried, the technique requires 25 tons of water.

options.text: Lack of burying ground.
Long time for processing.
High consumption of water.
Enormous cost of energy.

在生日前后感到焦虑或悲伤并不完全罕见。生日会触及人们担心的很多事情，包括他们过去十年的人生成就，或者过去一年的成绩。许多人开始寻找自己存在的意义，导致一些行为，比如结束或开始一段关系，或者制定计划，比如开始严格的饮食或健身计划。
我有很棒的朋友，我也喜欢庆祝他们的生日。但我不喜欢成为关注的焦点，收礼物，被大家围着忙活。这似乎会引发一种社交焦虑。我觉得社交媒体也会让事情更严重，因为现在生日更多是公开展示的。生日提醒可能有帮助,但我有点担心我没法把自己的生日搞得看起来像应该的那么激动人心。
嗯，要应对生日忧郁，你不应该把自己孤立起来。最好是和你信任的人一起逐渐面对你的生日。这会帮助你学会自我接纳，或者说成为焦点也没关系。
也许吧。或者我可以把生日看作是为别人做点什么的机会，比如请人们捐款而不是买礼物。
没错。或者甚至可以简单地把你的生日看作是把大家聚在一起让他们开心的机会。
今天早上地铁真是糟糕透了。
哦,是晚点了吗?

如果用拼车软件就不贵了。

**信号** 结尾处女士的建议句。题干限定 at the end，而这正是对话最后一句女士的话 see your birthday as an opportunity to bring people together for them to have fun，see…as an opportunity to 是明显的建议口吻，落在末尾，正是答案信号。
**替换** bring people together for them to have fun↔View it as a chance for people to socialize and have fun.聚人=socialize、机会=chance
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 答非所问对话前段女士确实围绕生日焦虑(birthday blues)给过"别孤立自己、逐步面对"的话，Hold it on a modest scale to remove birthday anxieties. 借"消除焦虑"设套；但"小规模操办以消焦虑"并非女士结尾(at the end)所说，且原文没说"小规模"，定位错位。借用原文： to deal with the birthday blues, you should not isolate yourself
C) 原词陷阱录音 gradually face your birthday with people you trust 出现了 trust，Extend invitation to those he trusts most. 盗用 trust 设套；但那是女士在对话中段说的，且原文是"和你信任的人一起逐步面对"，不是"只邀请最信任的人"，既非结尾建议、内容也被改了。借用原文： It's best to gradually face your birthday with people you trust
D) 张冠李戴录音里 asking people to make a donation instead of buying a gift 提到捐款，Make it an occasion to collect donations. 盗用 donation；但这是"男士"自己提出的想法，题干问的是"女士"在结尾的建议，张冠李戴了。借用原文： asking people to make a donation instead of buying a gift
questions.quote: Exactly. Or even simply see your birthday as an opportunity to bring people together for them to have fun.

options.text: Hold it on a modest scale to remove birthday anxieties.
View it as a chance for people to socialize and have fun.
Extend invitation to those he trusts most.
Make it an occasion to collect donations.

questions.prompt: What does the woman say about her subway ride?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题） It was absolutely exhausting.
**题目译文**
女士对她乘坐地铁的经历有何评价?
A) 绝对令人精疲力竭。
B) 有一股难闻的气味。
C) 延误时间太长了。
D) 她在错误的站下车了。
**定位** 不是(晚点)，但车厢太挤了，我几乎动不了，连呼吸都困难……等我终于挤出来，已经累得精疲力竭了。
**信号** 先否定再描述，落点在收尾。她先用 No否掉"晚点"，再细数挤、喘不上气，最后用 I was totally exhausted收束——"totally(完全)"的加重语气正是答案信号，整段抱怨归到"累"上。
**替换** I was totally exhausted↔It was absolutely exhausting.同义词+主被动改写
questions.tip:
**排除**
C) 原词陷阱男方问 was there a delay?，女方明确回 No。选项 There was too long a delay.正是盗用了录音里反复出现的 delay 一词，但"晚点"恰恰是她否认的，属听到原词就想选的陷阱。借用原文： No, but the train was so packed
B) 未提及录音说 it was difficult to breathe too，原因是太挤、不是有味道。There was a terrible smell.借"呼吸"联想出"异味"，是无中生有的过度引申，原文并未提到任何 smell。
D) 偷换概念录音只说她 could hardly get out(挤得几乎下不了车)，是"难下车"不是"下错站"。She got off at the wrong station.把"下车困难"偷换成"下错站"，原文无此意。借用原文： When I got to my station, I could hardly get out
questions.quote: No, but the train was so packed that I could barely move, and it was difficult to breathe too... Once I did get out, I was totally exhausted.

options.text: It was absolutely exhausting.
There was a terrible smell.
There was too long a delay.
She got off at the wrong station.

questions.prompt: Why hasn't the woman got her own car?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题） She hasn't saved enough money.
**题目译文**
女士为什么没有自己的汽车?
A) 她还没有攒够钱。
B) 她担心交通堵塞。
C) 她还没有通过驾驶考试。
D) 她习惯了乘坐公共交通工具。
**定位** 我有驾照，但也就这样了。我正在攒钱想买辆小巧可爱点的车，但对我来说还是有点贵，得过一阵子才能攒够钱。
**信号** 转折 but 后才是真原因。她先说 I've got a driver's license(有驾照)，紧接 but it's still a bit expensive for me——转折 but 之后的"贵、还没攒够钱"才是真正没车的原因，前半句"有驾照"是用来排除C的。
**替换** it'll take a while before I have enough money↔She hasn't saved enough money.肯否转换+概括
questions.tip:
**排除**
C) 与原文相反选项 She hasn't passed the driving test yet.借"driving"语境制造混淆，但录音开口就是I've got a driver's license(已有驾照)，正好与"还没考过"相反——没车的卡点在钱，不在证。借用原文： I've got a driver's license
B) 张冠李戴She is worried about traffic jams.里的"拥挤/慢"其实对应她吐槽地铁公交 The bus takes twice as long and it's just as crowded.，与"为什么没车"无关，把别处的抱怨安到这题上。借用原文： it's just as crowded
D) 与原文相反She is used to taking public transport.与原文相反：她一开口就在抱怨地铁、还在saving up to buy车，分明想摆脱公共交通，并非"习惯并满足于"它。借用原文： I'm saving up to buy something
questions.quote: I've got a driver's license, but that's all. I'm saving up to buy something reasonably small and cute, but it's still a bit expensive for me, and it'll take a while before I have enough money.

options.text: She hasn't saved enough money.
She is worried about traffic jams.
She hasn't passed the driving test yet.
She is used to taking public transport.

questions.prompt: What does the woman say about electric motorbikes?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （态度观点题） They are dangerous.
**题目译文**
女士对电动摩托车有何评价?
A) 它们很受欢迎。
B) 它们很危险。
C) 对她来说它们有点贵。
D) 它们环保。
**定位** 我也就考虑了大概一分钟。但说实话，我见过太多那些"危险怪物"造成的可怕事故了。
**信号** But honestly 后的强烈贬词。她先敷衍"考虑了一分钟"，转折 But honestly后甩出horrible accidents与 dangerous monsters——"honestly"加重、"dangerous/horrible"是强烈负面评价，态度信号集中在此。
**替换** those dangerous monsters↔ They are dangerous.原词点评直接对应
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 张冠李戴They are popular.盗用了男方下一句 those popular shared bikes里的 popular，但那是评价"共享单车"、且出自男方之口，并非女方对电摩的看法，张冠李戴。借用原文： those popular shared bikes
C) 张冠李戴They are a bit expensive for her.盗用了她在买车时说的 it's still a bit expensive for me，但"贵"评价的是要买的小车，对电动摩托车她说的是危险、从未说贵。借用原文： it's still a bit expensive for me
D) 未提及They are environmentally friendly.听起来很符合"电动"的常识联想，但全篇没有任何一句说电摩环保，属凭电动二字脑补出来的未提及项。
questions.quote: I consider that for maybe a minute. But honestly, I've just seen too many horrible accidents involving those dangerous monsters.

options.text: They are popular.
They are dangerous.
They are a bit expensive for her.
They are environmentally friendly.

questions.prompt: How was the woman going to get to work?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题） By sharing a ride.
**题目译文**
女士打算如何去上班?
A) 乘公交车。
B) 慢跑。
C) 租一辆自行车。
D) 拼车。
**定位** 男：用拼车app就不贵了。女：好主意。我这就下载一个。谢谢。
**信号** 结尾"Good idea+这就去做"的拍板。前面公交、单车、慢跑、出租都被她一一否掉或挑刺，直到男方提 a ride sharing app，她答 Good idea. I'll download one immediately——"Good idea"+立刻行动是明确的最终拍板信号。
**替换** use a ride sharing app↔By sharing a ride.动名词概括+去掉app Good idea. I'll download one immediately↔By sharing a ride.认可信号坐实最终选择
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱By bus.盗用对话里讨论过的 bus，但她明确说 The bus takes twice as long and it's just as crowded.——又慢又挤，早被否掉，属"提过即否"的陷阱。借用原文： The bus takes twice as long and it's just as crowded.
C) 原词陷阱By renting a bike.对应 those popular shared bikes，她回 that's a possibility——只是"一种可能"，并未像拼车那样"Good idea+这就去做"，停在备选阶段。借用原文： that's a possibility
B) 原词陷阱By jogging.盗用她自己提的 jog to work，但她紧接着说 the air pollution is a real problem，因污染把慢跑否了，并非最终选择。借用原文： the air pollution is a real problem
questions.quote: M: Not if you use a ride sharing app. W: Good idea. I'll download one immediately. Thank you.

options.text: By bus.
By jogging.
By renting a bike.
By sharing a ride.

questions.tip:

A) 原词陷阱选项 Considering the promotion of its regular classes. 借用了录音里 regular classes 的原词，但原文是 the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes——常规课程恰恰是「不打折」的对象，健身房并未推广常规课程。借用原文： the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes
B) 过度推断选项 Taking measures to expand its exercise programs. 里的「扩展锻炼项目」在录音里没有任何句子支撑——录音只说推出了两门新课的折扣，并未提「扩张/扩展」。属于把「推新课折扣」过度推断为「扩张项目」。
C) 原词陷阱选项 Recruiting coaches for hot yoga and advanced spinning. 把录音 hot yoga, and advanced spinning 这两个原词照搬过来，但行为是「招教练」——录音里从未提到招聘，是听到课程名就想选的典型原词陷阱。借用原文： two of our brand new classes, hot yoga, and advanced spinning
questions.quote: Currently we are offering existing members discounts off two of our brand new classes, hot yoga, and advanced spinning, but the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes I'm afraid.

questions.prompt: What does the man say is a pity for the woman?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题） She missed out on the gym's general discount.
**题目译文**
男士说对这位女士来说什么是遗憾的?
A) 她错过了10周课程的报名截止日期。
B) 她错过了健身房的普遍折扣。
C) 她没有及时注册会员资格。
D) 她对高温瑜伽不太感兴趣。
**定位** 首月对所有人在现场都按「先到先得」提供同样的 20% 折扣。可惜你错过了这个普通折扣。
**信号** 惋惜句标志 It's a shame…。It's a shame you missed out on the general discount 用It's a shame 把男方的「惋惜」明明白白说出口，正与题干 a pity 一一对应；shame 之后跟的就是「错过了什么」。
**替换** you missed out on the general discount↔ She missed out on the gym's general discount.几乎原词复现的同义改写
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱选项 She missed the deadline for the 10-week course. 借用录音里 the 10-week course on Thursday evenings 的原词，但 10-week course 是女士最后真正报上的课、不存在「错过截止日」；男方的惋惜对象是 general discount，不是 10-week course。借用原文： Can you sign me up for the 10-week course on Thursday evenings?
C) 与原文相反选项 She didn't sign up for membership in time. 与录音 I signed up two months ago直接冲突：女士两个月前已经入会，根本不存在「没及时入会」的问题。借用原文： I signed up two months ago
D) 与原文相反选项 She wasn't so much interested in hot yoga. 与录音 I am only really interested in hot yoga 完全相反——女士只对热瑜伽感兴趣，而非「不感兴趣」。属盗用 hot yoga 原词的反向陷阱。借用原文： I am only really interested in hot yoga
questions.quote: The same discount of 20% is being offered to everyone at the door on a "first come, first served" basis for the first month. It's a shame you missed out on the general discount.

options.text: She missed the deadline for the 10-week course.
She missed out on the gym's general discount.
She didn't sign up for membership in time.
She wasn't so much interested in hot yoga.

questions.prompt: Why is the woman unwilling to pay in advance?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题） She doesn't want to reveal her card details over the phone.
**题目译文**
为什么这位女士不愿意提前付款?
A) 她不想通过电话透露她的银行卡信息。
B) 她认为在参加任何课程之前付款是不明智的。
C) 她可能随时不得不取消她的注册。
D) 她更愿意将费用加到她的月账单上。
**定位** 不用，反正我也不喜欢在电话里报我的卡号细节。
**信号** 表态句 No+理由句 I don't like… 紧贴在一起。No 是女士对 Would you prefer to pay in advance? 的明确拒绝，紧跟其后的 I don't like giving my card details over the phone就是拒绝的原因——这种「先表态、后给因」的结构是对话原因题的标志答案句。
**替换** I don't like giving my card details over the phone↔She doesn't want to reveal her card details over the phone. don't like giving = doesn't want to reveal
questions.tip:
**排除**
B) 未提及选项 She doesn't think it wise to pay before attending any class. 听起来合理，但录音里女士的原因仅围绕「电话里报卡号」，完全没有「上课前付不明智」这种判断——属凭常识替原文补理由。
C) 未提及选项 She might have to cancel her registration any minute. 中「随时可能退课」在录音里没有任何句子支持——女士反而紧接着报了 10-week course，并未表现出要退的迹象。
D) 原词陷阱选项 She prefers to have the fee added to her monthly bill. 借用 the fee of the class will just be added to your monthly bill 的原词，但 monthly bill 是男方在女士拒绝预付之后才提出的替代方案，并不是女士拒绝预付的原因——属把「结果」当「原因」的原词陷阱。借用原文： the fee of the class will just be added to your monthly bill
questions.quote: No, I don't like giving my card details over the phone anyway.

questions.prompt: Why are the speakers in China?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题） To research new markets.
**题目译文**
说话者为什么在中国?
A) 进行投资。
B) 签署商业合同。
C) 研究新市场。
D) 开设新办公室。
**定位** 这里中国市场潜力很大。我相信我们回去把调研结果汇报给伦敦总部，他们一定会满意的。
**信号** research 一词定位。答案落点不靠『目的信号词 to do』，而是靠对此行成果的总结句present our research。当对话里一方在概括『我们这趟做了什么/带回什么』，那句往往就是目的题的答案句——做的事就是来此的目的。
**替换** present our research ↔ To research new markets.名词化转动作potential markets here in China ↔ To research new markets.潜在=新
questions.tip:
**排除**
A)录音从头到尾没有 invest/investment/money 之类的词，To make investments. 属于『未提及』型干扰，靠的是听众对『商务出差=投资』的常识联想。
B) 未提及录音没出现 contract/sign/deal 等词，To sign a business contract. 是『未提及』型干扰，与 A 同属『商务=签合同』的常识误判。
D) 原词陷阱录音多次出现 the head office in London，To open a new office. 盗用了 office 这个原词，让人听到 office 就想选；但录音里 office 始终指『已经存在的伦敦总部』，没有任何『开设新办公室』的动作。借用原文： the head office in London
questions.quote: There are lots of great potential markets here in China. So I'm sure that the head office in London will be pleased once we get back and present our research.

options.text: To make investments.
To sign a business contract.
To research new markets.
To open a new office.

questions.prompt: Where will the man stop over on his way to London?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题） Dubai.
**题目译文**
男士在去伦敦的途中将在哪里中转?
A) Dubai。
B) 北京。
C) Amsterdam。
D) Earl's Court。
**定位** 有一班次日早晨到达、在迪拜中转两小时的航班；还有一班晚上 11:30 到达、在阿姆斯特丹中转五小时的航班。
**信号** 两项并列与男方应答。答案不在女方那句『二选一』里，而在男方第 5 段的应答 Well, that's obvious then, isn't it? 之后、女方第 6 段的确认 okay, so that's Dubai. ——这是对话题的标志性信号：被问者/被选方的应答才是落点。
**替换** so that's Dubai↔Dubai.确认句直给
questions.tip:
**排除**
B) flights from Beijing to London 里 Beijing 是出发城市，不是中转地。Beijing. 盗用了这个原词，制造『一听到 Beijing 就选』的陷阱。借用原文： flights from Beijing to London C) a five-hour stopover in Amsterdam 中 Amsterdam 确实是中转，但属于男方放弃的『晚到+长候机』那条线——男方那句 Well, that's obvious then, isn't it? 暗示选 short stopover（两小时的 Dubai）。Amsterdam. 盗用 Amsterdam 原词，但选错了那条线。借用原文： a five-hour stopover in Amsterdam D) The nearest metro station is Earl's Court. 中 Earl's Court 是伦敦酒店附近的地铁站，是男方到达伦敦后的活动地点，与『中转』毫无关系。Earl's Court. 盗用了一个完全异类的地名做干扰。借用原文： The nearest metro station is Earl's Court.
questions.quote: There's a flight arriving the following morning, with a two-hour stopover in Dubai, or a flight arriving at 11:30 in the evening, with a five-hour stopover in Amsterdam.

options.text: Dubai.
Beijing.
Amsterdam.
Earl's Court.

questions.prompt: What does the man ask the woman to do?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题） Send him a map of the hotel area.
**题目译文**
男士请女士做什么?
A) 为他租一辆自行车以便在镇上出行。
B) 在总部预订一间会议室。
C) 帮他准备演示文稿。
D) 给他发送一份酒店区域地图。
**定位** 你能找一份显示酒店位置的地图，然后线上发给我吗？
**信号** Can you 请求信号。Can you find a map that shows where the hotel is and send it to me online? 是男方说出口的请求句，Can you 是最经典的请求信号——本题答案就在这一句里。
**替换** find a map that shows where the hotel is and send it to me online↔Send him a map of the hotel area.详述变概括send it to me online↔ Send him a map of the hotel area.代词与人称转换
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) I want to see if I can get one of those rental bicycles and ride to the office just for fun. 这是男方自己想做的事，主语是 I，不是请求女方。Rent a bike for him to get around the town. 盗用了 rental bicycles 这个原词，制造『听到 bike 就选』的陷阱。借用原文： I want to see if I can get one of those rental bicycles and ride to the office just for fun. B) Do you remember the capacity of their meeting room? 男方只是问女方『记不记得容量』，I'll check. 是女方主动表示要去查，没人请她去『预订（reserve）会议室』。Reserve a meeting room in the head office. 盗用 meeting room 原词、把 capacity 偷换成 reserve。借用原文： Do you remember the capacity of their meeting room? C) For the presentation, I'll bring my own laptop and hook it up to their projector. presentation 由男方自己准备（I'll bring…），没有请求女方帮忙。Help him prepare his presentation. 盗用 presentation 原词，制造『听到就选』。借用原文： For the presentation, I'll bring my own laptop and hook it up to their projector.
questions.quote: Can you find a map that shows where the hotel is and send it to me online?

options.text: Rent a bike for him to get around the town.
Reserve a meeting room in the head office.
Help him prepare his presentation.
Send him a map of the hotel area.

questions.prompt: What did the woman remind the man to do at the end of the conversation?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题） Keep all his receipts.
**题目译文**
对话结束时女士提醒男士做什么?
A) 带上他的投影仪。
B) 保留他所有的收据。
C) 提交他的报销单。
D) 用他的信用卡支付。
**定位** 没问题。记得把所有发票留好。你记得上次遇到的麻烦吧。
**信号** Just remember to 提醒信号。答案信号是 Just remember to keep all your receipts.中的 Just remember to——这是英语里最典型的『提醒』句式，直接对应题干 remind…to do。
**替换** Just remember to keep all your receipts.↔ Keep all his receipts.祈使变陈述
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) hook it up to their projector 中 projector 指对方公司已有的，男方说 I'll hook it up——根本没有『自带投影仪』的意思，更不是女方的提醒。Bring his projector. 是张冠李戴 + 与原文相反双重错。借用原文： hook it up to their projector C) I'll submit my claims form afterwards. 是男方自己说『事后我会提交报销单』，主语是I，不是女方提醒。Submit his claims form. 盗用 claims form 这个原词制造陷阱，让人听到 submit/claims 就选。借用原文： I'll submit my claims form afterwards. D) I'll pay everything with my own card, right? 是男方自己交代会用自己的卡付款，并非女方提醒。Pay with his credit card. 盗用 card 原词。借用原文： I'll pay everything with my own card, right?
questions.quote: No problem. Just remember to keep all your receipts. You remember the trouble you had last time.

transcriptTranslations: Steve Miller 在 20 世纪 80 年代末开始了他的 IT 职业生涯。作为一名科技行业的失聪人士,需要在组织协调方面付出巨大努力。因为那时没有电子邮件或短信服务,一切都必须面对面进行,或者通过电话完成。在会议中交流非常困难。他每次会议都需要一名手语翻译,但协调这件事需要付出巨大努力。
Miller 说,如今尽管挑战依然存在,但对于科技行业的失聪人士来说是个好时代。语音识别技术的重大进步使得通信工具能够在智能手机或笔记本电脑上实时将现场语音转换为文本,也能将手语转换为文本。
新技术加上助听器技术的改进和医学进步,意味着 Miller 能够更加专注于他的工作。他从耳中的一个微型助听设备中获益匪浅。它给了他一定程度的听力,他可以根据情况使用各种交流方式。他可以使用唇读,通过视频而不是电话进行会议。这些事情带来了巨大的改变。他不再需要担心自己能否理解。他可以只专注于会议可能有多有趣,以及他需要从中获得什么才能取得进展。
色彩正在我们的家中蔓延，爬上楼梯，延伸至木框架和天花板，填充着中性色空间。
据一位室内设计师说,当人们回到家时,他们想看到能让他们振奋精神、给予他们拥抱的色彩。纯白色的墙壁根本做不到这一点。它们不会照顾你。
另一位室内设计师评论说,某些色彩组合可以触及更深层次的东西,将你带到不同的时刻。这就是色彩的力量。
如果你正在考虑在一些中性色墙面上尝试色彩,建议非常简单:选择一个你真正喜欢的颜色。
不要因为某种颜色流行或你在杂志上看到过就选择它。
如果你对全彩色心存疑虑,可以用较小的空间测试你的接受度,比如橱柜内部或明亮的窗框。如果每次打开橱柜它都能给你带来快乐,你就可以开始进一步尝试。
人们还可以将木框架漆成与墙壁相同的颜色,帮助房间看起来更大。在厨房里,将吊柜和墙壁漆成相同的颜色可以让空间感觉更宽敞。
在粉刷厨房台面时,大胆的色彩可以让一切感觉更开阔、更轻盈。此外,粉刷天花板是一件神奇的事情,既不会太明显,也能影响空间的感觉。
家长们经常听说给孩子读书对支持其发展至关重要，而且这一信息正在被他们接受。事实上，在美国，2007年有略高于一半的三至五岁儿童每天被朗读，而2012年同一国家该年龄段83%的儿童每周被朗读三次或更多次。
这是个好消息,因为给幼儿读书有助于他们的语言和大脑发育。事实上,最近的研究发现,婴儿期共享读书的质量和数量都能预测儿童后期的词汇量和阅读技能。换句话说,父母花在阅读上的时间越多,他们四岁孩子的发育益处就越大。
这是一个重要的发现。但父母读什么书重要吗?一项新研究调查了这个问题。该研究跟踪了婴儿生命中第二个六个月的情况,发现当父母给婴儿展示有面孔或带有特定标签的物体的书籍时,他们学到的更多。这与那些不标注图像名称的书籍或每张图像下都有相同标签的书籍形成对比。标注不同角色名称的书籍也促进了更多的学习。那么这对父母意味着什么呢?并非所有书籍都是一样的,因此父母需要非常谨慎地选择与孩子分享的书籍。

questions.prompt: What do we learn about Steve Miller?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题） He is a deaf person working in IT.
**题目译文**
关于Steve Miller我们了解到什么?
A) 他是一名手语翻译员。
B) 他是一名在IT行业工作的聋人。
C) 他不喜欢在会议上发言。
D) 他不使用电子邮件或短信。
**定位** 史蒂夫·米勒在上世纪80年代末开始了他在 IT 行业的职业生涯。作为科技行业里的一名聋人，这需要在组织安排上付出巨大的努力。
**信号** 开篇直接交代身份。篇章开头第一句就点出他的处境——Being a deaf person in tech，介绍人物的篇章往往一开口就交代身份，这句即是答案句。
**替换** a deaf person in tech↔ a deaf person working in IT tech 与 IT 同义、in 改 working in began his career in IT↔ working in IT'开启IT生涯'='在IT工作'
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 张冠李戴原文确实念到 He needed a sign language interpreter for every meeting，但那是说他'需要'一名手语翻译，不是说他'是'手语翻译；选项 He is a sign language interpreter.把'他需要的人'安到他自己头上。借用原文： He needed a sign language interpreter for every meeting
C) 偷换概念原文说 Communicating in meetings was very difficult.(开会沟通'很困难')，这是客观障碍；选项 He doesn't like speaking at meetings. 偷换成'他不喜欢在会上发言'的主观好恶，文中从未提他喜不喜欢。借用原文： Communicating in meetings was very difficult.
D) 与原文相反原文是 there was no email or text message service——当年(80年代末)根本'没有'这种服务，是时代背景；选项 He doesn't use email or text messages. 偷换成'他(现在)不用'电邮短信，把'当时不存在'歪曲为'他个人不用'。借用原文： there was no email or text message service
questions.quote: Steve Miller began his career in IT back in the late 1980s. Being a deaf person in tech required a huge amount of effort in organization.

He is a deaf person working in IT.
He doesn't like speaking at meetings.

questions.prompt: What does Miller say is making things better for people like him?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题） Speech recognition technology.
**题目译文**
Miller说什么正在改善像他这样的人的处境?
A) 沟通技能的提升。
B) 语音识别技术。
C) 手语的巨大进步。
D) IT行业的变革。
**定位** 语音识别技术的巨大进步，使得沟通工具能够在智能手机或笔记本电脑上实时把现场语音转成文字，也能把手语转成文字。
**信号** 因果信号 enabled 点出真正推动者。句子主语 Big advances in speech recognition technology 后接 have enabled(使……得以)，enabled 是因果信号，前面那个名词正是'带来改善'的诱因，即答案句。
**替换** Big advances in speech recognition technology↔Speech recognition technology选项是原文核心名词的浓缩
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱原文反复出现 communication(如communicationtools)，选项 Improved communication skills. 借这个熟词造干扰，但原文说变好的是'沟通工具'靠技术运转，不是'沟通技能'提高了，文中也没说他技能改善。借用原文： communication tools
C) 原词陷阱原文确实念到 sign language into text as well，选项 Big advances in sign language. 借sign language 造干扰，但原文的'大进步(advances)'是修饰 speech recognition technology 的，并非'手语本身的大进步'。借用原文： sign language into text as well
D) 过度推断原文话题虽在 IT 行业，但带来改善的是一项具体技术；选项 Transformation in the IT industry. 借 IT 一词把'语音识别技术'夸大成'整个 IT 行业的变革'，范围被无限放大，原文没说行业整体变革。借用原文： a good time to be a deaf person in tech
questions.quote: Big advances in speech recognition technology have enabled communication tools to turn live speech into text in real time on your smartphone or laptop, and sign language into text as well.

options.text: Improved communication skills.
Speech recognition technology.
Big advances in sign language.
Transformation in the IT industry.

questions.prompt: In what way can Miller benefit from attending meetings via video?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题） He can understand with ease.
**题目译文**
Miller通过视频参加会议能在哪方面受益?
A) 他可以避免被误解。
B) 他可以当场做笔记。
C) 他可以轻松理解。
D) 他可以看到发言者的影像。
**定位** 他可以借助唇读，并通过视频而非电话开会。这些做法带来了巨大的改变。他再也不必担心自己能否听懂了。
**信号** 结果句 no longer has to worry 点出好处。在 have meetings via video 之后，原文用These things have made a huge difference 收束，再接 He no longer has to worry about whether or not he can understand——'不再担心能否听懂'正是视频开会带来的好处，即答案句。
**替换** He no longer has to worry about whether or not he can understand↔He can understand with ease'不再担心能否听懂'=肯否转换为'能轻松听懂'
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 未提及选项 He can avoid being mistaken. 说'能避免被误解'，原文谈的是他能否'听懂'，从未提到'被误解'这回事，属凭空添加。
B) 未提及选项 He can take notes on the spot. 说'能当场记笔记'，原文虽提到技术能把语音转成text(文字)，但从没说他'记笔记'，是把'转文字'歪联想成'记笔记'。
D) 原词陷阱题干和原文都念到 have meetings via video，选项 He can see the speakers' images. 借video 字面推出'能看到说话人画面'，但原文说视频开会的好处是'不再担心能否听懂'，而非'看到画面'本身；越和 video 字面像，越是诱人下钩的原词陷阱。借用原文： have meetings via video
questions.quote: He can employ lip-reading and have meetings via video instead of on the phone. These things have made a huge difference. He no longer has to worry about whether or not he can understand.

options.text: He can avoid being mistaken.
He can take notes on the spot.
He can understand with ease.
He can see the speakers' images.

questions.prompt: What do people want upon returning home according to the passage?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题） To see cheerful colours all around.
**题目译文**
根据文章,人们回到家后想要什么?
A) 发现纯白色的墙壁闪闪发光。
B) 进入一个照料良好的房子。
C) 得到家人的拥抱。
D) 看到周围都是令人愉快的色彩。
**定位** 人们回家时，想看到能让自己振奋、给自己一个拥抱的色彩。
**信号** want 直陈诉求。录音用 they want to see colours that cheer them up 直接点出回家想要什么，want to 后面就是答题落点；紧接着 Pure white walls simply don't do that. 又用否定把白墙排除，进一步确认想要的是彩色而非白墙。
**替换** colours that cheer them up ↔ cheerful colours动词转形容词see colours ↔ see cheerful colours all around动作原词保留
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱To find pure white walls shining. 盗用了原文里 Pure white walls 这个原词，但原文紧接着说 Pure white walls simply don't do that.，白墙恰恰是被否定的、不能给人拥抱的东西，听到 white walls 就选正好掉坑。借用原文： Pure white walls simply don't do that.
B) 偷换概念To enter a house well looked after. 借用了原文 They don't look after you. 里的 look after，但原文说的是色彩照顾人（you），不是人想进入一座被照看好的房子，主语和对象都被偷换了。借用原文： They don't look after you.
C) 未提及To get a hug from family members. 用了原文的 hug，但原文是 give them a hug——给拥抱的是色彩，根本没提 family members，把拥抱的来源安给了原文没说的家人。借用原文： give them a hug
questions.quote: When people return home, they want to see colours that cheer them up and give them a hug.

options.text: To find pure white walls shining.
To enter a house well looked after.
To get a hug from family members.
To see cheerful colours all around.

questions.prompt: What does the passage say people should avoid doing in home decoration?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题） Choosing a colour because it is fashionable.
**题目译文**
文章说人们在家居装饰中应该避免做什么?
A) 因为流行而选择一种颜色。
B) 粉刷橱柜的内部。
C) 自己完成所有粉刷工作。
D) 把所有窗框设计成同样的样式。
**定位** 不要因为某种颜色正流行、或你在杂志上见过它，就去选它。
**信号** Don't 否定建议。录音用祈使否定句 Don't go for a colour because it's in fashion 直接给出劝阻——别因为时髦而选色，Don't 就是该避免做法的信号词，这句即答案句。
**替换** because it's in fashion↔because it is fashionable名词短语转形容词go for a colour↔ Choosing a colour动词同义替换
questions.tip:
**排除**
B) 与原文相反Painting the interior of their cupboards. 盗用了原文 the inside of a cupboard，但原文把刷柜子内部当作试色的好办法来推荐，而非要避免的事，态度正好相反。借用原文： test your tolerance with smaller spaces, such as the inside of a cupboard
C) 未提及Doing the painting job all by themselves. 里 all by themselves（亲力亲为）原文从未提及，录音只谈选什么色、刷哪里，没说该不该自己动手。
D) 原词陷阱Designing all window frames the same way. 借了原文出现过的 window frame（a bright window frame），但原文说的是把窗框作为试色的小空间，没说所有窗框要设计成同一款式，更没说要避免。借用原文： a bright window frame
questions.quote: Don't go for a colour because it's in fashion, or you've seen it in a magazine.

options.text: Choosing a colour because it is fashionable.
Painting the interior of their cupboards.
Doing the painting job all by themselves.
Designing all window frames the same way.

questions.prompt: What can one do to make a room look bigger?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题） Paint the wooden frameworks and walls the same colour.
**题目译文**
怎样做可以让房间看起来更大?
A) 把大部分橱柜嵌入墙内。
B) 在四周悬挂风景画。
C) 使房间的天花板与所有家具颜色相配。
D) 把木制框架和墙壁刷成同一颜色。
**定位** 也可以把木质框架刷成与墙壁相同的颜色，这有助于让房间显得更大。
**信号** helping…look bigger 因果。录音里 paint the wooden frameworks the same colour as the walls 后面紧跟 helping the rooms look bigger，用 helping 把做法和显大的效果直接连起来，正对应题干 look bigger，这句即答案句。
**替换** paint the wooden frameworks the same colour as the walls↔Paint the wooden frameworks and walls the same colour近乎原句改写helping the rooms look bigger↔ Paint the wooden frameworks and walls the same colour效果直接对上题干
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱Fit most of the cupboards into walls. 借了原文反复出现的 cupboards，但原文谈柜子是说把柜子和墙刷同色（painting the overhead cupboards and the walls in the same colour），没说把柜子嵌进墙里，做法被改造成原文没说的内容。借用原文： painting the overhead cupboards and the walls in the same colour
B) 未提及Hang landscape paintings all around. 里挂风景画原文完全没说，录音只谈刷颜色，没有任何挂画的内容。
C) 张冠李戴Match the room's ceiling with all the furniture in colour. 借用了原文出现过的 ceiling（a painted ceiling）和同色概念，但原文让显大的同色是框架与墙，天花板只是另说能影响空间感，没说要与家具同色，把同色的双方张冠李戴。借用原文： a painted ceiling is a magical thing without being too obvious
questions.quote: One can also paint the wooden frameworks the same colour as the walls, helping the rooms look bigger.

options.text: Fit most of the cupboards into walls.
Hang landscape paintings all around.
Match the room's ceiling with all the furniture in colour.
Paint the wooden frameworks and walls the same colour.

questions.prompt: What does the passage say parents increasingly understand?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题） Reading to their children is important.
**题目译文**
文章指出父母越来越理解什么?
A) 孩子必须每周至少阅读3次。
B) 阅读是每个孩子都能养成的习惯。
C) 给孩子读书很重要。
D) 孩子应该在3岁开始阅读。
**定位** 父母常听到『给孩子读书对支持其发展至关重要』这一说法，而且这个信息正在被他们接收（理解）。
**信号** 开篇点题句 + getting through 表领悟。答案信号是开篇直接点题：reading to their children is critical for supporting development，紧跟 the message is getting through to them，getting through 正对应题干的 understand，是承载答案的那一句。
**替换** reading to their children is critical for supporting development↔Reading to their children is important. critical=important 同义替换
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱选项 Children must read at least 3 times a week. 把原文 three or more times per week 的频次盗来，但原文说的是『父母给孩子读』的统计数据，不是『孩子自己必须每周读3次』的要求，答非所问。借用原文： three or more times per week
B) 未提及选项 Reading is a habit every child can develop. 听起来很正确很顺耳，但全文只谈父母给孩子读书的好处与选书，从未说『阅读是每个孩子都能养成的习惯』，属凭常识脑补、原文无据。
D) 原词陷阱选项 Children should start reading at age 3. 借用原文 between the ages of three and five 里的 three，但那是统计样本的年龄段，不是『孩子应3岁开始读书』的建议，数字真听到了、意思全拧了。借用原文： between the ages of three and five
questions.quote: Parents often hear that reading to their children is critical for supporting development, and the message is getting through to them.

options.text: Children must read at least 3 times a week.
Reading is a habit every child can develop.
Reading to their children is important.
Children should start reading at age 3.

questions.prompt: What can predict children's reading skills according to recent research?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题） The number and quality of books parents read to them in infancy.
**题目译文**
根据近期研究,什么可以预测孩子的阅读能力?
A) 他们在四岁前读过的书籍数量。
B) 他们婴儿期大脑发育的速度。
C) 父母在婴儿期给他们读的书籍的数量和质量。
D) 父母与他们玩耍所花费时间的质量和数量。
**定位** 事实上，最近的研究发现，婴儿期共同读书的质量和数量都预测了孩子日后的词汇和阅读能力。
**信号** 研究发现信号 recent research has found + predicted。答案信号是表研究结论的recent research has found 和动词 predicted，predicted 直接对应题干 predict，其前面的主语 the quality and quantity of shared book reading in infancy 就是被点名的预测因素。
**替换** the quality and quantity of shared book reading in infancy↔The number and quality of books parents read to them in infancy. quantity=number、shared book reading=books parents read
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱选项 The number of books they have read by age four. 借用原文 four-year-old children 的 four，但原文 four 是说『四岁孩子身上的发展益处』，从没说『到四岁读了多少本书』能预测能力，数字听到了、意思编造了。借用原文： four-year-old children
B) 原词陷阱选项 The speed of their brain development in infancy. 借了原文 brain development，但原文是说『读书有助于语言和大脑发育』，大脑发育是『结果/益处』，不是『预测阅读能力的原因』，把因果位置弄反了。借用原文： reading to young children helps their language and brain development
D) 偷换概念选项 The quality and quantity of time parents spend playing with them. 几乎照抄原文的 quality and quantity 结构，却把核心动作从『读书』换成 playing（玩），原文谈的始终是 reading，不是陪玩，偷换了概念。借用原文： the quality and quantity of shared book reading in infancy
questions.quote: In fact, recent research has found that both the quality and quantity of shared book reading in infancy predicted later childhood vocabulary and reading skills.

options.text: The number of books they have read by age four.
The speed of their brain development in infancy.
The number and quality of books parents read to them in infancy.
The quality and quantity of time parents spend playing with them.

questions.prompt: What kind of books are said to help babies learn more?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题） Books with specifically labeled images.
**题目译文**
什么样的书据说能帮助婴儿学到更多?
A) 带有明确标注图像的书。
B) 带有玩偶和玩具图片的书。
C) 描述动物生活的书。
D) 讲述非常有趣故事的书。
**定位** 研究跟踪了出生后第二个半年的婴儿，发现当父母给婴儿看『带有具体标签的面孔或物体』的书时，他们学得更多。
**信号** 因果/条件句 when…they learned more。答案信号是条件结果句 when parents showed babies books that had faces or objects with specific labels, they learned more，learned more 正对应题干 learn more，其条件部分点名的书就是答案；后文 This is in contrast to 进一步用对比反衬，强化了这一类。
**替换** books that had faces or objects with specific labels↔Books with specifically labeled images. faces or objects=images、specific labels=specifically labeled
questions.tip:
**排除**
B) 过度推断选项 Books with pictures of dolls and toys. 把原文 objects（物体）具体化为『玩偶和玩具』，原文从未指明是玩偶玩具，是凭常识把抽象的 objects 想象成具体玩具，属脑补。借用原文： faces or objects with specific labels
C) 未提及选项 Books describing the lives of animals. 看似贴近『讲动物』，但原文 P3 全程没提animals，更没说『描写动物生活的书』有用，纯属无中生有。
D) 偷换概念选项 Books telling very interesting stories. 把『有用的书』偷换成『很有趣的故事书』，原文判定标准是『有没有具体标签』，不是『故事有不有趣』，换了一套评价维度。借用原文： books that had faces or objects with specific labels
questions.quote: It followed infants across the second six months of life and found that when parents showed babies books that had faces or objects with specific labels, they learned more.

options.text: Books with specifically labeled images.
Books with pictures of dolls and toys.
Books describing the lives of animals.
Books telling very interesting stories.

questions.prompt: What are parents advised to do at the end of the passage?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题） Choose carefully what to read to their children.
**题目译文**
文章结尾建议父母做什么?

transcriptTranslations: 世界风笛乐队锦标赛将于周六在格拉斯哥举行。
超过120支世界顶尖风笛乐队将参加锦标赛。预计超过4000名风笛手和鼓手将涌入该市参加这一年度盛事。
比赛将于5月18日周六上午10点至晚上7点在格拉斯哥的St. James运动场举行。该活动免费入场。此外,将有免费班车往返于活动停车场和比赛场地之间。班车从上午8点至晚上8点每15分钟一班。
格拉斯哥市议会表示,预计该活动将为当地经济带来30万英镑的收益。
首届世界风笛乐队锦标赛于1947年在爱丁堡举行。该活动于1948年首次在格拉斯哥举办。自1986年以来一直定期在格拉斯哥举行。
距离夏季开始还有两天,但科学家们已经对格陵兰岛目前正在发生的危险冰层融化发出警报。
这座广袤的岛屿通常将足够多的淡水锁在其冰盖中,如果融化可使全球海平面上升六米。研究表明,近年来其冰层融化速度比以往任何时候都快。本月,随着格陵兰岛西北部气温接近历史最高值,研究人员在该地区遇到了异常且令人惊讶的冰层融化水平。
这里最重大的担忧是这一切发生得如此之早。格陵兰岛经历着年度冰层融化和增长周期。但今年,融化季节始于五月初。这比正常情况提前了一个月,而且在历史记录中只在2016年发生过一次。
这意味着冰层不仅融化得非常快,而且今年夏天它有比正常气候系统中更多的时间融化。像这样更长的融化季节似乎会导致对海平面上升的贡献远大于前几十年。
据警方称,在英格兰北部的Blackhall Colliery街道上不断出现装有数千英镑现金的捆包。这个村庄的居民一直在Durham郡这个前矿业村发现成捆的20英镑纸币——通常价值2000英镑。
最近一次发现是在周一,这意味着今年已有四个这样的现金捆包被上交,自2014年以来共有13个。
这些捆包通常被放置在显眼位置,散布在这个沿海小村庄各处。据Peterlee警方称,失主有两周时间来认领现金,如果无人认领,现金将归还给发现者。
Durham警方发言人表示,除了昨天的情况外,所有案例中的钱款都已归还给幸运的发现者。
警察John Forster在一份声明中说:"具体情况仍是一个谜,因此我们欢迎任何能帮助我们查明这些随机事件真相的信息。"
他告诉The Northern Echo:"这里并不是一个富裕的地方,所以他们发现那么多现金后立即想到送到警察局,这显示了当地的社区精神。"

questions.prompt: What event will take place in Glasgow?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题） A pipe band contest.
**题目译文**
什么活动将在格拉斯哥举行?
A) 一场免费车展。
B) 一场年度音乐会。
C) 一场体育比赛。
D) 一场风笛乐队比赛。
**定位** 「世界风笛乐队锦标赛」将于周六在格拉斯哥举行。
**信号** 开篇点题句。新闻首句 The World Pipe Band Championships will take place in Glasgow on Saturday. 与题干 What event will take place in Glasgow? 在结构上几乎一一对应(willtakeplaceinGlasgow完全相同)，这就是新闻「导语 = 答案」的强信号。
**替换** The World Pipe Band Championships ↔ A pipe band contest championships 同义替换为 contest
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱录音通篇没出现任何 car show、汽车相关表述，A free car show. 属凭空想象。它唯一沾边的是 free 这个词——录音里 The event is free. 确实说了 free，于是把「免费」错按到「车展」上，是典型的把原词嫁接到错对象。借用原文： The event is free.
B) 原词陷阱录音说的是 the annual event，annual 与选项里的 yearly 同义，但核心活动是 pipe band championships，不是 concert(音乐会)。yearly 这个原义被偷出来盖到一个录音从未提到的 concert 上。借用原文： the annual event
C) 偷换概念A sports competition. 中 competition 与 D 项的 contest 几乎同义——录音里的Championships 翻译成 competition 也讲得通，但风笛比赛属于音乐文化赛事，不是体育(sports)赛事。把 sports 这一定语换成 pipe band 才对。借用原文： Over 120 of the world's best pipe bands will compete at the championships.
questions.quote: The World Pipe Band Championships will take place in Glasgow on Saturday.

questions.prompt: What does Glasgow City Council say the event will do?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题） Contribute a lot to the local economy.
**题目译文**
格拉斯哥市议会说这个活动将会做什么?
A) 改善格拉斯哥市的形象。
B) 丰富格拉斯哥的当地文化。
C) 为当地经济做出很大贡献。
D) 娱乐当地社区的人们。
**定位** 格拉斯哥市议会表示，预计本次活动将为当地经济带来 30 万英镑的收入。
**信号** 题干主语 + 金额词同时命中。原文 Glasgow City Council says it is estimated to bring£300,000 to the local economy. 与题干 What does Glasgow City Council say the event will do? 在「Glasgow City Council says」上几乎逐字对接，再叠加金额£300,000，是双重答案信号。
**替换** bring £300,000 to the local economy ↔ Contribute a lot to the local economy. bring 金额 = contribute a lot
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 未提及录音通篇无 image / reputation 等谈论城市形象的字眼。它和 C 在「为城市好」的方向上同方向，容易让考生「感觉对」，但题目问的是 Council 实际说了什么，没说就是没说。
B) 张冠李戴录音里 The first World Pipe Band Championships were held in Edinburgh in 1947. 等句确实交代了赛事历史，乍听有文化色彩，但「丰富格拉斯哥本地文化」 (Enrich the local culture of Glasgow.) 这一定性并不是 Glasgow City Council 给的，更不是题干所问。借用原文： It has been held regularly in Glasgow since 1986.

questions.prompt: What is scientists' warning in the news report?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （主旨题） Dangerous ice melts in Greenland.
**题目译文**
新闻报道中科学家们发出了什么警告?
A) 全球海平面出人意料地上升。
B) 格陵兰岛危险的冰层融化。
C) 夏季天气模式的变化。
D) 格陵兰岛冰盖创纪录的增长。
**定位** 夏天还有两天才开始，但科学家们已经在为格陵兰岛正在发生的危险融冰拉响警报。
**信号** 导语 + 转折 but + sounding the alarm。答案信号有三层叠加：第一，这是新闻第一句（导语，新闻惯例第一句点题）；第二，句中 but 是强转折，新闻里 but 之后才是真正要说的事；第三，紧跟 sounding the alarm（拉响警报）正是题干 warning 的同义信号，三者合在一起把答案句钉死在这一句。
**替换** sounding the alarm↔ scientists' warning拉响警报等于发出警告dangerous ice melts going on right now in Greenland↔Dangerous ice melts in Greenland.几乎是原句压缩
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱A 借用原文第 2 段 raise global sea levels by six meters 里的 sea levels 做诱饵，但原文那句只是『如果冰盖融化，可能抬升海平面 6 米』，是一个假设性的后果，且 surprising rise in global sea levels 并未在录音中实际宣布，把『潜在后果』当成『已经发生的警告』，属偷换概念。借用原文： which if melted can raise global sea levels by six meters
C) 未提及C 盗用原文里 Summer 与第 3、4 段反复出现的『季节、夏季』语境，把话题悄悄从『冰融』扩大到『夏季天气模式的变化』。整则新闻没有讨论 weather patterns（如降雨、风暴等气象格局），范围被无故放大。借用原文： Summer doesn't begin for two more days
D) 与原文相反D 把录音里 ice melts、ice sheet 这些原词搬过来，但把动作整个反过来说成 record growth of Greenland's ice sheets（『创纪录地增长』），与原文 its ice has melted faster than ever before 方向相反，是典型的『反向』诱饵。借用原文： its ice has melted faster than ever before
questions.quote: Summer doesn't begin for two more days, but scientists are already sounding the alarm about dangerous ice melts going on right now in Greenland.

options.text: Surprising rise in global sea levels.
Dangerous ice melts in Greenland.
Changing weather patterns in summer.
Record growth of Greenland's ice sheets.

questions.prompt: What do we learn about this year's ice melting?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题） It started a month earlier than usual.
**题目译文**
关于今年的冰层融化我们了解到什么?
A) 它始于五月下旬。
B) 它持续了三个月。
C) 它比往常提前一个月开始。
D) 它比以前提前一个月结束。
**定位** 但今年，融冰季在 5 月初就开始了。这比往年提前了一个月，是历史上仅在 2016 年出现过一次的情况。
**信号** 转折 But this year 加时间反常。信号有两层：第一，But this year 是强转折，前面在讲『通常的融冰周期』，But 一拐就来到『今年反常』的落点；第二，紧跟出现的 a month earlier than normal 与题干 this year 严丝合缝，正是答案承载句。
**替换** the melting season began in early May ↔ It started a month earlier than usual. began 对应 started a month earlier than normal ↔ a month earlier than usual than normal 等于 than usual
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱A 借用原文 began in early May 里的 May 做诱饵，但把 early May（5 月初）偷换成 late May（5 月底）；只要听清 early 与 late 这一字之差，就能识破。借用原文： the melting season began in early May
B) 未提及B 项 It lasted three months. 在录音中完全没有出现『三个月』或任何与 three months 对应的时长表述，是利用考生听到 Longer melt seasons 就想去补一个具体时长的心理凭空捏造的数字。
D) 与原文相反D 与正确项 C 只差一个动词：started 变 ended。原文清清楚楚说的是融冰季『开始』提前一个月（began in early May），而非『结束』提前一个月；D 把动作整个反向，是典型的『开始或结束』互换陷阱。借用原文： the melting season began in early May
questions.quote: But this year, the melting season began in early May. That's a month earlier than normal and something that's happened only once before in the historical record in 2016.

options.text: It began in late May.
It lasted three months.
It started a month earlier than usual.
It ended a month earlier than before.

questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题） Bundles of £20 notes kept turning up.
**题目译文**
Blackhall Colliery 的街道上发生了什么？
A) 成捆的20英镑纸币不断出现。
B) 一位村民正在寻找他丢失的现金。
C) 当地警察偶然发现了成捆的20英镑纸币。
D) 一捆装有数千英镑的现金被盗。
**定位** 据警方称，装有数千英镑现金的成捆钞票不断出现在英格兰北部布莱克霍尔矿区的街道上。
**信号** 新闻导语首句即落点。答案信号是"导语首句"：Bundles containing thousands of pounds in cash keep turning up on the streets 正是全篇第一句，新闻把核心事件放在开头，无需转折、就是它。
**替换** keep turning up on the streets ↔ kept turning up时态变体的同一短语Bundles containing thousands of pounds in cash ↔ Bundles of £20 notes概括与具体互指同物
questions.tip:
**排除**
B) B 说 A villager was searching for his lost cash.（一名村民在找他丢失的现金），但录音是钱不断"出现"、村民是"捡到"，从无谁在"找丢失的钱"，方向与原文相反。
C) 原词陷阱C 盗用了录音原词 came across 与 policemen 拼成 Local policemen came across bundles of £20 notes.，但原文是 Residents of the village have been coming across bundles of £20 notes——"撞见"现金的是村民居民，不是警察，把发现者张冠李戴了。借用原文： Residents of the village have been coming across bundles of £20 notes
D) 原词陷阱D 说 A bundle containing thousands of pounds got stolen.（一捆数千英镑被偷），盗用了原文 Bundles containing thousands of pounds 的措辞，却把"出现并被上交"歪曲成"被偷"，与全篇"现金被发现、还给失主"的事实相反。借用原文： Bundles containing thousands of pounds in cash

transcriptTranslations: 一项新研究证明了女性权利的重要性。该研究的研究人员指出,世界许多地区取得了良好的经济进步,但女性权利往往被忽视。因此,他们想确定女性权利保护与公共健康之间是否存在联系。
研究人员分析了包含162个国家2004年至2010年期间信息的数据库。
各国根据其对女性经济和社会权利的尊重程度进行分类。分为三个类别:高、中等和低。
数据分析显示,女性权利保障强的国家比那些不太尊重女性权利的国家拥有更好的健康状况。
研究的健康指标包括疾病预防、生殖健康、死亡率和预期寿命。
此外,在最尊重女性权利但医院和医生资源低于平均水平的国家,健康结果仍然优于被评为中等或低的国家。这证实了即使在资源匮乏的情况下,如果一个国家拥有强有力的女性权利保障,健康结果也会更好。
因此,研究人员认为性别平等不仅仅是女性权利问题,也是发展问题。这是因为更好的健康状况有助于经济发展。他们指出,女性权利的价值常常从经济角度受到质疑。有些人认为确保这些权利会限制进步,但这项研究表明情况恰恰相反。
阳光和高温可能意味着野餐、公园和海滩之旅,但它们也会让你的身体产生一些奇怪的反应。
首先,阳光实际上会影响你的口气。你可能认为夏天是约会或与有魅力的男孩或女孩聊天的完美时机。但过度的高温会导致你失水,而这已被证明会产生一个相当不讨人喜欢的副作用——口臭。
当你缺水时,你的口腔会变得干燥。细菌会积聚,因为口腔中没有足够的水分来冲走它们。阳光也会阻止你出汗。身体的正常温度是36到37摄氏度。但如果温度升高到40到41度,你可能会发现自己中暑。在那时,你的体温调节系统基本上会停止工作,这会阻止你出汗,因为你的身体试图在重要器官周围保留水分。
然而,阳光可以通过提高你的能量水平对你的身体产生积极影响。你可能会觉得阳光给你的一天带来了额外的能量,而这确实正在发生。
而且来自阳光的维生素D可以帮助你的身体吸收某些矿物质,这些矿物质与增强骨骼有关。因此,我建议你多花时间和朋友在公园里,但一定要涂抹大量的防晒保护,也要把水瓶装满。
左撇子在做某些事情时可能会感到不便,比如在笔记本上写字,但左撇子也有许多优势。研究发现,在格斗运动中,左撇子的比例过高。左撇子选手获胜的机会也更高。这证实了战斗理论。
左撇子在记忆事件方面可能也更出色。解释是左撇子的两个大脑半球联系更紧密。

左撇子的思维方式可能有所不同。在一项研究中,研究人员向参与者展示了几列抽象插图,并询问他们更喜欢哪些。左撇子更可能喜欢左边的图像。右撇子更喜欢右边的图像。两组人都不喜欢相反一侧的东西。
左撇子在职业互动性运动中也占比过高。研究人员研究了左撇子对互动性运动表现的影响。那些需要最快反应的运动给左撇子带来最大优势。因此,如果你有一个左撇子孩子,你应该鼓励他们打乒乓球、棒球和网球。左撇子最大化了他们在这些运动中的成功机会。

questions.prompt: What did the researchers of the new study try to determine?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题） Whether a country's protection of women's rights is related to its public health.
**题目译文**
这项新研究的研究人员试图确定什么?
A) 一个国家的教育水平是否与妇女权利相关联。
B) 妇女权利在世界范围内是否正在取得良好进展。
C) 一个国家对妇女权利的保护是否与其公共卫生相关。
D) 妇女权利在欠发达国家是否更常被忽视。
**定位** 因此，他们想要确定女性权利的保护与公共健康之间是否存在某种联系。
**信号** 因果信号 Thus 引出研究目的句。Thus, they wanted to determine if there was a link between protection of women's rights and public health. 由 Thus 引出，是前文铺垫之后的结论性目的句；同时 wanted to determine 与题干 try to determine 是同义改写，双重信号锁定本句为答案句。
**替换** if there was a link between protection of women's rights and public health↔Whether a country's protection of women's rights is related to its public health. if↔Whether、a link↔is related to 的同义替换
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 未提及选项 Whether a country's educational level is linked to women's rights. 用了一个录音根本没提的 educational level；录音只谈 protection of women's rights and public health，根本没有把教育水平作为研究对象，属于未提及式干扰。
B) 原词陷阱选项 Whether women's rights are making good progress around the world. 借用了录音 many parts of the world have made good economic progress 里的 good progress与 the world 两个原词，但录音说的是经济进展不错而女性权利常被忽视，并不是在问女性权利本身有没有进展；属于盗用原词答非所问。借用原文： many parts of the world have made good economic progress, but women's rights are often overlooked
D) 原词陷阱选项 Whether women's rights are more often overlooked in less-developed countries. 盗用录音原词 often overlooked，但录音只说 women's rights are often overlooked，并没有把这种忽视限定到 less-developed countries；选项擅自加了一个原文没有的范围限定。借用原文： women's rights are often overlooked
questions.quote: Thus, they wanted to determine if there was a link between protection of women's rights and public health.

questions.prompt: What does the passage say about countries lacking in medical resources?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题） Their people still have better health if women's rights are respected.
**题目译文**
关于缺乏医疗资源的国家,文章说了什么?
A) 如果妇女权利得到尊重,这些国家的人民仍然拥有更好的健康状况。
B) 它们必须努力增加妇女获得医疗保健的机会。
C) 这些国家的人民倾向于重视妇女权利。
D) 它们需要在医院人员和设施方面投入更多资金。
**定位** 此外，在那些最尊重女性权利但医院与医生资源低于平均水平的国家里，健康结果仍然要好于那些评级为中等或较差的国家。
**信号** 转折信号 but+still 锁定反差结论。in countries where women's rights were most respected, but where access to hospitals and doctors was below average, health outcomes were still better 中的 but 与 still 是双重转折/让步信号，听到 but…still 几乎就等于答案句敲钟，篇章里这种条件下仍如何的句子是出题点的常态。
**替换** access to hospitals and doctors was below average↔Their people still have better health if women's rights are respected.缺医疗资源↔lacking medical resources 同义概括health outcomes were still better↔still have better health health outcomes↔health、still better↔still better 的近乎逐词等值in countries where women's rights were most respected↔if women's rights are respected where 从句条件化↔if 条件句的等值改写
questions.tip:
**排除**
B) 原词陷阱选项 They must make efforts to increase women's access to health care. 借用录音里access to hospitals and doctors 的 access 一词，但录音是在客观描述这些国家医疗资源不足下仍有好的健康结果，根本没有说他们必须做什么；选项把客观陈述偷换成主观对策，又强加了 women's access to health care 这种原文没有的提法。借用原文： access to hospitals and doctors was below average
C) 张冠李戴选项 Their people tend to attach importance to women's rights. 把录音里关于这些国家本身尊重女性权利的客观描述，偷换为这些国家的人民倾向于重视女性权利；录音说的是国家层面的尊重程度，并没有谈人民的态度倾向。借用原文： in countries where women's rights were most respected
D) 原词陷阱选项 They need to invest more in hospital staff and facilities. 借用了录音 hospitals and doctors 里的 hospitals，但录音从未说这些国家需要投入更多在医院上；选项把缺资源仍健康好这一反差客观结论，偷换成需要加大投入的对策。借用原文： access to hospitals and doctors was below average
questions.quote: Furthermore, in countries where women's rights were most respected, but where access to hospitals and doctors was below average, health outcomes were still better than in countries rated as moderate or poor.

questions.prompt: What has often been questioned regarding women's rights?

**答案** D （细节题） Their positive effect on economic development.
**题目译文**
关于妇女权利,什么经常受到质疑?
A) 妇女权利与一个国家公共卫生的关联。
B) 妇女权利对社会进步的潜在影响。
C) 妇女权利对一个国家国际形象的价值。
D) 妇女权利对经济发展的积极作用。
**定位** 他们指出，女性权利的价值常常从经济角度受到质疑。
**信号** 题干同根词 questioned 直接对应。the value of women's rights has often been questioned from an economic standpoint 几乎是题干 What has often been questioned regarding women's rights? 的逐词同根回响：questioned 对 questioned、women's rights 对 women's rights，定位极其稳。
**替换** the value of women's rights has often been questioned from an economic standpoint ↔Their positive effect on economic development. from an economic standpoint↔on economic development 的角度替换ensuring those rights would limit progress, but this study indicates the opposite↔positive effect on economic development否定的反面=正面效应的等值推理
questions.tip:
**排除**
A) 原词陷阱选项 Their link with a country's public health. 借用了录音前文 protection of women's rights and public health 的 public health 一词，但 18 题问的是被质疑的内容，而录音里女性权利与公共健康的关系是被研究证实的，并非被质疑的对象；属于盗用原词答非所问。借用原文： protection of women's rights and public health
B) 偷换概念选项 Their potential impact on social progress. 借用了录音 ensuring those rights would limit progress 里的 progress，但录音里的 progress 是与 economic 挂钩的，且选项加了一个 social 修饰；录音从未谈过对 social progress 的潜在影响，属于偷换概念。借用原文： Some have argued that ensuring those rights would limit progress
C) 未提及选项 Their value to a country's international image. 谈的是对国家国际形象的价值，录音从头到尾都没谈过 international image 或与之相关的概念，属于未提及式干扰。
questions.quote: They note that the value of women's rights has often been questioned from an economic standpoint.
