**定位** 在数量无限、零风险的模型里探索、实验并反复运用新知的能力，正是让 simulation 成为最高效学习方式之一的原因。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念Its capability of saving time by accelerating the immersive learning experience.把 accelerates time 拎出来当主因，但原文里它只是 simulation 优点的描述之一，不是 is what makes 强调结构所归的原因。
B) 偷换概念Its potential for learners to examine their skills, knowledge and learning process.取自 skills, processes and knowledge all can be highlighted，但原文是 processes（业务流程/作业过程），选项改成了 learning process（学习过程），主体偷换；且原文是 simulation 来 highlight，不是 learners 来 examine。
C) 以偏概全Its capability of providing all participants with a practical learning experience. 用practical learning experience 模糊概括 simulation，未含 risk-free、reflect、experiment 等核心元素；原文 is what makes 主语处也并未用 practical 来归因。
D) ✓ 正确The ability to explore, experiment and repeatedly apply new knowledge ↔Its potential for learners to explore, experiment and practice without any risk. in unlimited, risk-free models ↔ without any risk The ability ↔ Its potential D 保留了原文的三动词并列与 risk-free 条件，是唯一同时满足两项核心的选项。
questions.quote: The ability to explore, experiment and repeatedly apply new knowledge in unlimited, risk- free models is what makes simulation one of the most productive forms of learning.

options.text: Its capability of saving time by accelerating the immersive learning experience.
Its potential for learners to examine their skills, knowledge and learning process.
Its capability of providing all participants with a practical learning experience.
Its potential for learners to explore, experiment and practice without any risk.

questions.prompt: What should participants do in a simulation to reap the greatest benefits possible?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
参与者在模拟中应该做什么才能获得最大可能的收益?
A) 将这种体验仅仅当作游戏。
B) 将所学内容迅速应用到工作中。
C) 培养深层次的理解。
D) 努力与领导者建立紧密联系。
**判型** What should participants do in a simulation to reap the greatest benefits possible?是问明确做法的标准细节题。
**拆句** What should participants do in a simulation to reap the greatest benefits possible?主干 What should participants do，in a simulation 是地点状语，to reap the greatest benefits possible 是目的不定式，possible 后置修饰 benefits。无陷阱。
**定位** 为最大化从模拟中获得的收益，参与者应立刻把从体验中所学应用到工作中，以打通「学」与「做」之间的桥梁。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反Take the experience as a mere game. 让参与者「把体验当作单纯的游戏」，但 If they don't, they will view the experience as a game, which can be difficult to apply on the job 明确把「视为游戏」当作负面后果。
B) ✓ 正确participants should immediately apply the learning from the experience↔Apply promptly what they learn to their jobs. to forge a smooth link between learning and doing ↔ to their jobs B 在副词（promptly ↔ immediately）、核心动作（apply what they learn ↔ apply the learning）与落点（to their jobs ↔ between learning and doing）三处与定位句完全对位。
C) 答非所问Develop a deep level of understanding. 取自 enable individuals and groups to develop a deep level of understanding，那是 simulation 的功效（果），不是参与者「应当做什么以最大化收益」（因）。
D) 无中生有Strive to connect closely with their leaders. 让参与者「努力与领导紧密联系」，但全文从未要求 participants 去与 leaders 建立紧密联系，原文 forge a link 的对象是learning 与 doing，不是 participants 与 leaders。
questions.quote: To maximize benefits from simulation, participants should immediately apply the learning from the experience to forge a smooth link between learning and doing.

options.text: Take the experience as a mere game.
Apply promptly what they learn to their jobs.
Develop a deep level of understanding.
Strive to connect closely with their leaders.

title: The slow progress of women in elective office…

sentences.text: The slow progress of women in elective office is frustrating for some political observers and experts—including myself.
Achieving gender equality in Congress is an important goal.
This is because the number of women involved in legislative decisions has significant (26)____ for all the policies that governments (27)____ .

Female legislators are more likely than men to introduce, speak about and work to pass policies that disproportionately affect women and girls, such as paid family leave, pay (28)____and gender-based violence.

passage.translation: 女性在民选职位上的缓慢进步令一些政治观察家和专家——包括我自己——感到沮丧。在国会中实现性别平等是一个重要目标。这是因为参与立法决策的女性人数对政府制定的所有政策都有重大影响。女性立法者比男性更有可能提出、讨论并致力于通过那些对女性和女孩产生不成比例影响的政策,例如带薪家庭假、同工同酬和基于性别的暴力问题。

sentences.text: Having more women in Congress also fosters a greater sense of connection between female voters and government.
In addition, it (29)____ women's sense that government cares about their concerns and inspires young women to become more politically engaged.

passage.translation: 国会中有更多女性还能培养女性选民与政府之间更强的联系感。此外,这还能增强女性对政府关心她们关切的认知,并激励年轻女性更积极地参与政治。

sentences.text: While women are underrepresented in governments around the globe, it is a particularly (30)____problem in the United States.
Currently, the U.S. ranks 73rd in the world when it comes to female representation in government.

passage.translation: 虽然女性在全球各国政府中代表性不足,但这在美国是一个尤其严峻的问题。目前,美国在女性政府代表性方面排名世界第73位。

sentences.text: But the reason women are so (31)____ underrepresented in U.S. government is not because they face resistance from voters or struggle to raise money.
On the contrary, decades of research shows that female candidates raise as much money and win as often as male politicians with similar (32)____ .

passage.translation: 但女性在美国政府中代表性如此严重不足的原因,并非她们面临选民的抵制或难以筹集资金。恰恰相反,数十年的研究表明,女性候选人筹集的资金与具有相似资历的男性政治家一样多,获胜率也与他们相当。

sentences.text: Rather, the slow progress of women in politics is a tale of two political parties.

passage.translation: 相反,女性在政治领域进步缓慢是一个关于两个政党的故事。

sentences.text: In the next Congress, there will be 107 female Democratic lawmakers and 42 female Republican lawmakers in the Senate and House combined.

passage.translation: 在下届国会中,参议院和众议院合计将有107名民主党女性立法者和42名共和党女性立法者。

sentences.text: In order for women to gain half of the seats in Congress, more women need to run, (33)____ on Republican tickets.
This will require the Republican Party as a whole to (34)____ recruiting women—and not just for one election cycle, but in a (35)____ way.

passage.translation: 为了让女性获得国会半数席位,需要有更多女性参选,尤其是在共和党选票上。这将要求共和党作为一个整体优先考虑招募女性——而且不仅仅是一个选举周期,而是要持续进行。

groups.instructions: In this section, there is a passage with ten blanks. You are required to select one word for each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage. Read the passage through carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not use any of the words in the bank more than once.
groups.content:
The slow progress of women in elective office is frustrating for some political observers and experts—including myself. Achieving gender equality in Congress is an important goal. This is because the number of women involved in legislative decisions has significant {{26}} for all the policies that governments {{27}} . Female legislators are more likely than men to introduce, speak about and work to pass policies that disproportionately affect women and girls, such as paid family leave, pay {{28}}and gender-based violence.

Having more women in Congress also fosters a greater sense of connection between female voters and government. In addition, it {{29}} women's sense that government cares about their concerns and inspires young women to become more politically engaged.

While women are underrepresented in governments around the globe, it is a particularly {{30}}problem in the United States. Currently, the U.S. ranks 73rd in the world when it comes to female representation in government.

But the reason women are so {{31}} underrepresented in U.S. government is not because they face resistance from voters or struggle to raise money. On the contrary, decades of research shows that female candidates raise as much money and win as often as male politicians with similar {{32}} .

Rather, the slow progress of women in politics is a tale of two political parties.

In the next Congress, there will be 107 female Democratic lawmakers and 42 female Republican lawmakers in the Senate and House combined.

In order for women to gain half of the seats in Congress, more women need to run, {{33}} on Republican tickets. This will require the Republican Party as a whole to {{34}} recruiting women—and not just for one election cycle, but in a {{35}} way.

options.text: bolsters
formidable
consequences
impetus
credentials
lavish
dramatically
prioritize
enact
suffices
equity
sustained
especially
tenured
evasively

questions.explanation:
**答案** B) consequences 名词
**词性槽** 形容词 significant + ___ + for 介词短语
**依据** have consequences for 是高频固定搭配，意为'对…产生影响'本句解释'女性议员数量对所有政策都有重要影响'，与 Female legislators are more likely than men to introduce, speak about and work to pass policies 一脉相承，consequences for policies 完全贴合。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
C) credentials '资历'与 for policies 搭配不成立credentials 指个人证书、资格，对应的是 candidate 本身，不能说'议员数量对政策有 credentials'。
F) equity 义为'公平'，与 have ... for 搭不成立have significant equity for policies 既不成搭配，也不通逻辑。
J) impetus '推动力'常用 give/provide impetus to，不用 have impetus for impetus 与 for 共现表'对…的推动'虽可，但句意偏'对政策有影响'而非'推动'，consequences更贴。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 J) —— impetus 看似也能与 for 搭，'对…的推动'',词性也对。考生易被 has significant impetus for policies 的字面看似通顺骗到；防坑点是 have consequences for 才是英语里'对…有影响'的固定搭配，且本段紧接的例证 Female legislators are more likely than men to introduce, speak about and work to pass policies 说的是'影响政策内容'而非'推动政策出现'。

questions.explanation:
**答案** E) enact 动词
**词性槽** 定语从句 that governments + ___，缺谓语动词
**依据** enact policies 是固定搭配'颁布/制定政策'上文谈'女性议员推动政策通过' work to pass policies that disproportionately affect women and girls，governments enact policies 与之同义，且 enact 与 policies/laws 是公认搭配。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
L) prioritize '优先处理'语义偏'排序'，且要被 34 题占用prioritize policies 也能说，但语义在'优先排序'而非'制定'；而且 34 题需要 prioritize 与recruiting 搭配，词只能用一次。

questions.explanation:
**答案** F) equity 名词
**词性槽** 并列名词项 paid family leave, pay ___ and gender-based violence
**依据** pay equity = 同工同酬，影响女性的典型议题本段例证 policies that disproportionately affect women and girls 列举与女性相关的政策议题，pay equity（同工同酬）与 paid family leave、gender-based violence 同属'女性权益'范畴，是英语世界讨论性别平等的高频术语。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
J) impetus pay impetus 不成搭配，且与女性议题无关impetus 是'推动力'，不与 pay 构成复合名词，也无法作为'议题'与 paid family leave 并列。

questions.explanation:
**答案** A) bolsters 动词
**词性槽** 主语 it + ___ + 宾语 women's sense
**依据** bolster one's sense 是'增强某人的…感'的常见搭配上文 Having more women in Congress also fosters a greater sense of connection 已用 foster；本句用并列动词继续推进同向语义，bolsters women's sense that government cares 自然衔接。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
M) sufficessuffices 是不及物动词，不能带宾语suffice 表'足够'，常说 it suffices to do/that...，后面跟从句或不定式；不能直接接 women's sense 作宾语，语法不通。

questions.explanation:
**答案** I) formidable 形容词
**词性槽** 不定冠词 a + 副词 particularly + ___ + 名词 problem
**依据** 与 problem 构成常见搭配'棘手的问题'上下文交代美国排名第 73 the U.S. ranks 73rd in the world，说明这一问题在美国'尤其棘手'；formidable problem 是英语高频搭配，与 particularly 程度副词自然衔接。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
K) lavish 词义指向'奢华、铺张'，与 problem 不搭lavish 多形容花费、款待，无法描述社会问题的严重程度。
O) tenured 义为'终身聘任的'，专用于职位tenured 常见搭配是 tenured professor/position，修饰 problem 完全不通。

questions.explanation:
**答案** D) dramatically 副词
**词性槽** be 动词 are + ___ + 过去分词 underrepresented
**依据** 强调'代表性偏低'的程度，呼应美国排第 73上文已用 particularly formidable 渲染问题严重，本句继续追问'为何如此严重地代表不足'；dramatically underrepresented 是英文报道里固定的'程度极大'表达。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
G) especially 意为'尤其'，常引出比较或例子especially 通常需要一个比较对象或后接具体范畴（especially on Republican tickets 那种），单独修饰 underrepresented 表程度则不自然，且 G 已被 33 题强需占用。
H) evasively 义为'回避地、含糊地'，与 underrepresented 逻辑不通evasively 多修饰 answer/respond 等言语动词，描述'代表性不足'毫无语义关联。

questions.explanation:
**答案** C) credentials 名词
**词性槽** 介词 with + 形容词 similar + ___
**依据** candidates with similar credentials = '资历相当的候选人'本段反驳一种误解 not because they face resistance from voters or struggle to raise money，再以研究为据 female candidates raise as much money and win as often as male politicians with similar __(32)__. 进行同等条件下的对比，credentials（资历）正是这种'公平比较'的基准。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
J) impetus '推动力'不可用 similar 衡量，且与候选人能力比较无关similar impetus 在政客比较语境下毫无意义，无法构成对照基准。

questions.explanation:
**答案** G) especially 副词
**词性槽** 逗号后 + ___ + 介词短语 on Republican tickets
**依据** 聚焦到共和党票上，呼应'两党之别'主旨上文 there will be 107 female Democratic lawmakers and 42 female Republican lawmakers 表明共和党女议员人数远少；本句强调 more women need to run, especially on Republican tickets，正是把'更多女性参选'的火力点向共和党聚焦。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
H) evasively 义不搭evasively 描述'回避地、含糊地'参选毫无意义，逻辑指向反。

questions.explanation:
**答案** L) prioritize 动词
**词性槽** 情态动词 to + ___ + 动名词 recruiting
**依据** prioritize doing 是'优先去做某事'的固定搭配上文已点出共和党女议员稀少 42 female Republican lawmakers，本句号召共和党把'招募女性'放到优先级首位，prioritize recruiting women 既合搭配也合语义。

**答案** N) sustained 形容词
**词性槽** 介词 in + 限定词 a + ___ + 名词 way
**依据** 与 not just for one election cycle 形成时间维度的对照——'持续的'本句要点 not just for one election cycle, but in a __(35)__ way：not just one cycle 暗含'不止一次性'，与之对照的正是'持续地、长期地'，in a sustained way 是英文里强调长期坚持的固定写法。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
K) lavish 义为'奢华的'，与时间维度无关in a lavish way 形容方式'铺张奢侈'，与'不止一次选举周期'的对照无任何逻辑联系。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 K) —— lavish 与 way 搭配看似通顺。in a lavish way 字面读起来似乎成立，考生不细看上下文易误选；防坑点是利用 not just A, but B 的对照结构——A是 one election cycle（短期），B 必为'长期持续'，sustained 才合方向。

title: Women have historically been paid less.…

sentences.text: Women have historically been paid less.
But in the US in the 1980s, they began to catch up—fast.
During that decade, the gender pay gap closed by about one percentage point a year.
Had that trend continued, the gender wage gap would have been closed by 2017.

passage.translation: 历史上女性的薪酬一直较低。但在20世纪80年代的美国,她们开始迅速追赶。在那十年间,性别薪酬差距每年缩小约一个百分点。如果这一趋势持续下去,性别工资差距本应在2017年消除。

sentences.text: But the trend didn't continue, and the gap remains yawning.

passage.translation: 但这一趋势并未持续,差距依然巨大。

sentences.text: According to a new study from academics at Harvard, the stagnation can be put down, perhaps counterintuitively, to the introduction of state and federal family leave policies.

passage.translation: 根据Harvard学者的一项新研究,这种停滞或许可以归因于州和联邦家庭休假政策的出台,尽管这看似违反直觉。

sentences.text: The academics argue that during the 1990s, as governments began to introduce leave policies, it was mainly women who took advantage of them.
Though the leave policies might have helped those women to stay in the workplace—instead of dropping out to have families—those who returned saw their wages had increased at lower rates than the men.

passage.translation: 学者们认为,在20世纪90年代,当政府开始推行休假政策时,主要是女性利用了这些政策。尽管休假政策可能帮助那些女性留在职场——而不是退出去组建家庭——但那些返回职场的女性发现她们的工资增长速度低于男性。

sentences.text: After family leave was introduced in the US, in fact, the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year, and has remained there ever since.

passage.translation: 事实上,在美国引入家庭休假之后,性别工资趋同的速度降至每年仅0.03个百分点,并一直维持至今。

sentences.text: Those monitoring the process towards salary equity at work have long watched as progress slowed in many countries around the world.
In fact, that progress began to reverse during the pandemic(大流行病).

passage.translation: 那些监测职场薪酬公平进程的人长期以来一直关注着许多国家进展放缓的情况。事实上,这一进展在大流行病期间开始出现倒退。

sentences.text: The gender pay gap is one of the most outstanding examples of that lack of parity(平等), and still exists just about everywhere.
The motherhood penalty has become a shorthand for describing why: In many places, especially rich countries, women earn the same as men until they reach their childbearing years.
Women who have children begin to see their salaries slip behind their male counterparts.

passage.translation: 性别薪酬差距是缺乏平等的最突出例子之一,几乎无处不在。母职惩罚已成为描述其原因的简略说法:在许多地方,尤其是富裕国家,女性的收入与男性相同,直到她们进入生育年龄。生育子女的女性开始发现自己的薪水落后于男性同事。

sentences.text: Part of this is because women take on more of the unpaid labor at home, which can eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement.

But it's also because mothers are passed over for raises and promotion, and because time out of the workplace sets women back, even if that time is taken voluntarily, and supported by company or government policy.

passage.translation: 部分原因是女性在家中承担了更多无偿劳动,这会占用可用于工作的时间和职业发展的精力。但也因为母亲们在加薪和晋升时被忽视,还因为离开职场会让女性落后,即使这段时间是自愿的,并得到公司或政府政策的支持。

sentences.text: What would have happened if leave policies hadn't been introduced?
The study doesn't go into that question, other than to say that if the 1980s trend continued, we would have been at parity by now.

passage.translation: 如果没有引入休假政策会发生什么?该研究没有深入探讨这个问题,只是说如果20世纪80年代的趋势持续,我们现在应该已经实现平等了。

sentences.text: It's possible, however, that the journey towards wage parity would have stalled either way.

If women's gains in the 1980s were made through the erasure of things like bias, once those less uncontrollable problems had been addressed, there would still have been an issue with women—who are the ones to bear children and take care of them in the early weeks because of biological factors like the ability to breastfeed, forcing them to take breaks, whether or not those breaks were mandated.

passage.translation: 然而,通往薪酬平等之路无论如何都可能停滞。如果女性在20世纪80年代的进步是通过消除偏见等因素实现的,那么一旦这些较易控制的问题得到解决,仍然会存在女性的问题——由于生育子女并在早期照顾他们这类生物因素(如哺乳能力),迫使她们必须休息,无论这些休息是否有强制规定。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What do we learn about the gender pay gap in the US during the 1980s?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
关于20世纪80年代美国的性别薪酬差距,我们了解到什么?
A) 它正在缓慢缩小。
B) 它正在迅速缩小。
C) 它开始扩大。
D) 它仍然很大。
**判型** What do we learn about the gender pay gap in the US during the 1980s 直接问一个客观时间段的客观状况，没有 infer / imply / main idea 这类信号。
**拆句** 题干主干是 What do we learn about the gender pay gap，in the US during the 1980s是修饰 "the gender pay gap" 的时间地点状语，句子结构简单、无陷阱。
**定位** 但在美国 1980 年代，女性的薪酬开始追赶——而且速度很快。在那十年里，性别薪酬差距以每年约一个百分点的速度在缩小。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反It was being slowly closed 把原文的 fast 偷换成 slowly，方向完全相反。
B) ✓ 正确they began to catch up—fast ↔ shrinking rapidly closed by about one percentage point a year ↔ rapidly预判强调"差距在 1980 年代快速缩小"，It was shrinking rapidly 与之完全等值，且未引入任何额外含义，直接锁定 B。
C) 张冠李戴It started to yawn 借用 the gap remains yawning 制造关联，但 yawning 在原文描述的是 P2 之后趋势停滞后差距依旧巨大的状态，不是 1980 年代发生的事，属于张冠李戴。
D) 答非所问It remained substantial 描述的是 Women have historically been paid less 这种历史背景下的总体状态，并不针对题干所问的 1980 年代特征。
questions.quote: But in the US in the 1980s, they began to catch up—fast. During that decade, the gender pay gap closed by about one percentage point a year.

options.text: It was being slowly closed.
It was shrinking rapidly.
It started to yawn.
It remained substantial.

questions.prompt: What happened with the introduction of state and federal family leave policies?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
州和联邦家庭休假政策出台后发生了什么?
A) 工作中薪酬平等的进程开始逆转。
B) 性别工资趋同的速度开始明显下降。
C) 女性产后重返工作的趋势开始出现。
D) 性别薪酬差距的缩小引起了更多关注。
**判型** What happened with the introduction of... 问的是政策推行这一具体事件之后的客观结果，是典型的事实型提问。
**拆句** with the introduction of state and federal family leave policies 是介词短语作状语，提示时间背景；句子无从句、无否定，结构平铺直叙。
**定位** 事实上，美国引入家庭休假政策之后，性别工资收敛率降至每年仅 0.03 个百分点，并自此一直停留在这个水平。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 张冠李戴The process towards salary equity at work began to reverse 借用 that progress began to reverse during the pandemic，但原文的"反转"发生在大流行期间，不是家庭休假政策引入之后。
B) ✓ 正确the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year ↔The rate of gender wage convergence started to fall noticeably选项几乎逐词保留了 the rate of gender wage convergence...fell 的主干，只把后面的具体数字抽象化，是最高度等值的同义替换，直接锁定 B。
C) 无中生有The trend of women returning to work after childbirth started 借用 helped those women to stay in the workplace—instead of dropping out to have families，但原文只说政策让一些女性留下来，没有说"产后返岗成为新趋势"，且这不是题干"introduction后发生了什么"的核心结果。
D) 无中生有The narrowing of the gender pay gap attracted more attention 把"差距缩小"和"引起更多关注"拼接在一起，但原文从未提及关注度变化，是凭空捏造。
questions.quote: After family leave was introduced in the US, in fact, the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year, and has remained there ever since.

options.text: The process towards salary equity at work began to reverse.
The rate of gender wage convergence started to fall noticeably.
The trend of women returning to work after childbirth started.
The narrowing of the gender pay gap attracted more attention.

questions.prompt: What partly accounts for the slip in women's salaries?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
女性薪酬下滑的部分原因是什么?
A) 女性在职业晋升方面普遍缺乏足够的动力。
B) 众多女性为加薪和晋升而放弃的机会。
C) 女性在照顾家庭上花费的大量时间和精力。
D) 政府和商业公司缺乏政策支持。
**判型** What partly accounts for the slip in women's salaries 问的是导致薪水下滑的部分原因，答案应在原文有明确文本对应，不需推断。
**拆句** 题干主干 What partly accounts for the slip，in women's salaries 修饰 slip；副词 partly提示原文只承担"部分"原因，不要求穷尽所有因素。
**定位** 部分原因在于女性在家承担了更多无偿劳动，这会侵蚀她们可用于工作的时间，以及用于职业发展的精力。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有The insufficient motivation women generally have for career advancement 把原因归结为女性自身"职业发展动力不足"，原文从未做出此种心理动机层面的归因。
B) 与原文相反The opportunities numerous women give up for pay raise and promotion 暗示女性"主动放弃"涨薪机会，但原文 mothers are passed over for raises and promotion是被动语态——她们是"被跳过"，不是"主动放弃"。
C) ✓ 正确women take on more of the unpaid labor at home ↔ taking care of the family eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement ↔The huge amounts of time and energy C 同时包含"时间和精力"与"照顾家庭"两个核心要素，对应定位句的两段含义，是定位句的高度同义改写，直接锁定 C。
D) 与原文相反The lack of policy support from government and business corporations 把原因归为"缺乏政策支持"，但原文恰恰相反：政策（family leave）已经引入并提供支持，问题反而出在政策支持的副作用上。
questions.quote: Part of this is because women take on more of the unpaid labor at home, which can eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement.

options.text: The insufficient motivation women generally have for career advancement.
The opportunities numerous women give up for pay raise and promotion.
The huge amounts of time and energy women spend taking care of the family.
The lack of policy support from government and business corporations.

questions.prompt: What does the new study say about wage parity?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
新研究对薪酬平等是怎么说的?
A) 如果这些可控问题没有得到解决,它就会停滞不前。
B) 如果企业和政府没有共同努力,它就会停滞不前。
C) 随着性别偏见的完全消除,它本可以实现。
D) 随着20世纪80年代趋势的延续,它本可以实现。
**判型** What does the new study say about wage parity 要求复述研究的明确表述，而非读者推论，属于细节复述。
**拆句** 题干是简单疑问句，about wage parity 是介词短语作 say 的状语；结构简单。
**定位** 这项研究没有深入探讨那个问题，只是说如果 1980 年代的趋势延续下去，我们现在本应已经实现了薪酬平等。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反It would have stalled if those controllable problems had not been addressed 借用once those less uncontrollable problems had been addressed 制造对应，但原文是"问题已被解决之后还会有别的问题"，选项却说"如果没解决就会停滞"，方向颠倒。
B) 无中生有It would have halted if company and government had not worked together 把"公司和政府合作"作为条件，但原文从未提及二者协同与否，只是说休假可由 company or government policy 支持。
C) 过度推断It would have been achieved with the complete erasure of gender biases 借用through the erasure of things like bias，但原文用了 things like bias 这种举例口吻，且只是 if 假设下的推测，并未说"完全消除偏见就能实现"。
D) ✓ 正确if the 1980s trend continued ↔ with the continuation of the 1980s trend we would have been at parity by now ↔ It would have been attained D 把虚拟条件 if the 1980s trend continued 和结果 would have been at parity 一一对应，无缺漏无外加，是定位句最严格的同义改写。
questions.quote: The study doesn't go into that question, other than to say that if the 1980s trend continued, we would have been at parity by now.

options.text: It would have stalled if those controllable problems had not been addressed.
It would have halted if company and government had not worked together.
It would have been achieved with the complete erasure of gender biases.
It would have been attained with the continuation of the 1980s trend.

questions.prompt: What prevents women from achieving parity with men in the final analysis?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
归根结底,是什么阻止女性实现与男性的平等?
A) 忽视工作场所对女性的偏见。
B) 生育和抚养孩子。
C) 未能强制规定生育和照料的休假。
D) 缺乏解决生理问题的资源。
**判型** What prevents women from achieving parity with men in the final analysis 询问作者最终归因，答案对应原文末段一句明确归因句，不需多步推理。
**拆句** prevents women from achieving parity with men 是 prevent sb from doing sth 结构；in the final analysis 是状语，意为"归根结底"，需要识别这个固定搭配才能锁定原文末段。
**定位** 如果 1980 年代女性的进步是通过消除偏见之类的东西取得的，那么一旦这些相对可控的问题被处理掉之后，女性身上仍然会存在一个问题——她们是承担生育以及在最初几周照料孩子的人，因为像哺乳能力这样的生理因素，迫使她们休假，无论这种休假是否被强制规定。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反Ignoring biases against women in the workplace 把原因归为"忽视偏见"，但原文through the erasure of things like bias 恰是说偏见已被消除，且作者强调即便消除之后仍有问题——并非"忽视"导致。
B) ✓ 正确who are the ones to bear children and take care of them in the early weeks↔Giving birth to children and taking care of them B 把末段长句中的两个核心动作（生育 + 照护）抽出并列，正好对应预判中的"生育和照顾孩子"两层根因，是最纯粹的同义改写，直接锁定 B。
C) 与原文相反Failing to mandate breaks for childbirth and care 把"不强制规定休假"作为最终原因，但原文 whether or not those breaks were mandated 明确指出强制与否都没用，最终原因不是强制不强制。
D) 无中生有Lacking resources to address biological problems 借用 biological factors like the ability to breastfeed，但原文从未说"缺乏资源去解决生物学问题"，且作者立场是生物学因素本身就难以绕开，不是资源问题。
questions.quote: If women's gains in the 1980s were made through the erasure of things like bias, once those less uncontrollable problems had been addressed, there would still have been an issue with women—who are the ones to bear children and take care of them in the early weeks because of biological factors like the ability to breastfeed, forcing them to take breaks, whether or not those breaks were mandated.

options.text: Ignoring biases against women in the workplace.
Giving birth to children and taking care of them.
Failing to mandate breaks for childbirth and care.
Lacking resources to address biological problems.

title: Why are we so worried about our careers?…

sentences.text: Why are we so worried about our careers?
Partly it's to do with money, but there's a psychological aspect to our fears as well.

passage.translation: 我们为什么如此担心自己的职业？部分原因与金钱有关,但我们的恐惧也有心理方面的因素。

sentences.text: We worry because we suspect—not wrongly—that the world is full of a frightening sort of person ready to judge us ruthlessly and swiftly: a person we can call a snob.

passage.translation: 我们担心是因为我们怀疑——并非毫无根据——这个世界充满了一种可怕的人,他们随时准备无情而迅速地评判我们:我们可以称之为势利之人。

sentences.text: A snob is anyone who takes a relatively small part of us and uses it to come to a rigid conclusion about how much of their attention we deserve.
In the past, that might be your ancestry and royal connections.
Nowadays, the snob cares about one thing only: what you do for a living.

passage.translation: 势利之人是指任何只看我们相对渺小的一部分,就据此对我们配得多少关注做出僵化结论的人。在过去,那可能是你的祖先和皇室关系。如今,势利之人只在乎一件事:你以什么为生。

sentences.text: This explains why the first question we will be asked in any new social context is 'What do you do?' and according to how we answer, snobs will either welcome us with broad smiles, or leave us in the cold.

passage.translation: 这解释了为什么在任何新的社交场合我们会被问到的第一个问题是'你做什么工作?'而根据我们如何回答,势利之人要么用灿烂的笑容欢迎我们,要么把我们晾在一边。

sentences.text: And that is why we are fired up by such a desperate urge to achieve and impress.

passage.translation: 这就是为什么我们被如此迫切的成就欲和表现欲所驱使。

sentences.text: Sometimes our behaviour is mistaken for greed and vanity, but it is more than this.
A lot of our interest in fancy cars, jobs and houses has nothing to do with materialism.
It has to do with a hunger for the respect and esteem that is only available in our societies through the acquisition of material goods.
It isn't the goods themselves we seek, it is the love we stand to gain through our possession of them.
The next time we see someone driving a Ferrari, we shouldn't condemn them for their greed, we should pity them for the intensity of their need for love from the world.

passage.translation: 有时我们的行为被误解为贪婪和虚荣,但远不止如此。我们对豪车、工作和房子的大量兴趣与物质主义无关。它与对尊重和敬重的渴望有关,而在我们的社会中,这种尊重和敬重只能通过获得物质商品才能得到。我们追求的不是商品本身,而是通过拥有它们而可能获得的爱。下次当我们看到有人开Ferrari时,我们不应该谴责他们的贪婪,而应该同情他们对来自世界的爱的强烈需求。

sentences.text: At the root of snobbery is a lack of imagination and confidence about how to decide who in the world is valuable.
The snobs are brutally misguided and slavish in their beliefs about how the superior individuals can be identified.
For snobs, it is the already acclaimed and already successful who are the only ones worthy of respect.

There is no room in their timid regimented minds to imagine that someone might be clever, kind or good—and yet somehow have been overlooked entirely by society, their qualities lying hidden beneath an unfamiliar veil, and having as yet discovered no obvious outlet.

passage.translation: 势利的根源在于缺乏想象力和信心,不知道如何判断世界上谁是有价值的。势利之人在关于如何识别优秀个体的信念上严重误入歧途且盲目服从。对势利之人来说,只有已经获得赞誉和已经成功的人才值得尊重。在他们胆怯刻板的头脑中没有空间去想象,某人可能聪明、善良或优秀——却不知何故完全被社会忽视,他们的品质隐藏在陌生的面纱之下,至今还没有找到明显的出口。

sentences.text: The true answer to snobbery is not to say that there is no such thing as a better or worse person, but to insist that better or worse exist in constantly unexpected places and carry none of the outward signs of distinction.
And because we are such poor judges of the worth of others, our ultimate duty remains to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path.

passage.translation: 对势利的真正回应不是说不存在更好或更差的人,而是坚持认为更好或更差存在于不断出人意料的地方,并且不带任何外在的卓越标志。正因为我们如此不善于判断他人的价值,我们的终极责任仍然是对几乎每一个与我们相遇的人保持善良、良善、好奇和富有想象力。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What gives rise to our worry about careers apart from money?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
除了金钱之外，是什么引发了我们对职业的担忧?
A) 害怕被以势利的方式评判。
B) 面对吹毛求疵的管理者的前景。
C) 员工经常受到无情对待的方式。
D) 对求职困难的恐惧。
**判型** What gives rise to our worry about careers apart from money? 问的是一个具体原因，且用排除句式锁定方向，属典型细节题而非推断题
**拆句** 主干 What gives rise to our worry，gives rise to 是固定搭配，等于 cause；apart from money 是介词短语作状语，意为「除金钱之外」，提示原文里还另有一因。结构简单，无陷阱。
**定位** 部分原因与金钱有关，但我们的恐惧还有一个心理层面。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确a psychological aspect to our fears ↔ Fear of being judged in a snobbish manner ready to judge us ruthlessly and swiftly: a person we can call a snob ↔ in a snobbish manner预判要的是「金钱之外的心理因 = 怕被评判」，A 项 Fear of being judged in a snobbish manner 把「心理因—怕—被评判—被势利者」四要素全部覆盖
B) 无中生有原文谈的是 a person we can call a snob，并未把恐惧对象限定为 fault-finding managers——经理只是势利者的一种可能，但原文没说
C) 偷换概念原文是「我们怕被人评判」（we are judged），主体是 we；选项 The ruthless way employees are often treated 主语变成 employees，且 treated 把视角换成了「被对待」，与原文 judge us ruthlessly 的「评判」含义不一致
D) 答非所问Fright at the difficulty in hunting for a job 谈的是「找工作难」，本质仍属经济或金钱因；而题干用 apart from money 明确把金钱因排除在外
questions.quote: Partly it's to do with money, but there's a psychological aspect to our fears as well.

options.text: Fear of being judged in a snobbish manner.
The prospect of facing fault-finding managers.
The ruthless way employees are often treated.
Fright at the difficulty in hunting for a job.

questions.prompt: What do we learn from the passage about today's snobs?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
从文章中我们对当今的势利之人了解到什么?
A) 他们努力挖掘一个人的过去。
B) 他们对人们得出僵化的结论。
C) 他们通过职业来评判一个人。
D) 他们倾向于将人置于社会语境中。
**判型** What do we learn from the passage about today's snobs? 问的是当代势利者的客观特征，未含推断信号
**拆句** 主干 What do we learn from the passage about today's snobs，about today's snobs作 learn 的间接宾语，about 引出询问对象。结构简单，无陷阱。
**定位** 如今，势利者只在乎一件事：你以何为生。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反原文说今天势利者只看职业；至于 dig into a person's past（挖某人的过去），对应的是 In the past, that might be your ancestry and royal connections——但那是说「过去势利者看祖宗」，不是「今天势利者挖过去」，正话反说
B) 答非所问A snob is anyone who takes a relatively small part of us and uses it to come to a rigid conclusion 是势利者的通用定义，不专属于今天；题问的是 today's snobs 与过去相比的独有特征，应取 cares about... what you do for a living
C) ✓ 正确what you do for a living ↔ judge a person by their occupation the snob cares about one thing only ↔ judge a person by预判核心是「只看职业」，C 项 They judge a person by their occupation. 把「只看」显性化为「以...为判断依据」，吻合
D) 偷换概念in any new social context is 'What do you do?' 是描写「在新社交场合问问题」的情境，不是「势利者把人放在某种社交语境里评判」；选项 tend to place people in a social context 把这一场景偷换成势利者的主动行为
questions.quote: Nowadays, the snob cares about one thing only: what you do for a living.

options.text: They try hard to dig into a person's past.
They draw a rigid conclusion about people.
They judge a person by their occupation.
They tend to place people in a social context.

questions.prompt: What does the author say about people's interest in material goods?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者关于人们对物质商品的兴趣说了什么?
A) 这是谴责他们贪婪的原因。
B) 这与物质商品提供的舒适度有很大关系。
C) 这引起富人的怜悯而非尊重。
D) 这源于他们对社会认可的渴望。
**判型** What does the author say about people's interest in material goods? 问的是作者就该现象给出的明示论断，仍属细节题范畴
**拆句** 主干 What does the author say about people's interest in material goods，介词about 引出谈论对象 people's interest in material goods。结构简单，无陷阱。
**定位** （人们对豪车好工作好房子的兴趣）与对尊重和敬意的渴求有关——而在我们的社会里，这种尊重只能通过占有物质来获得。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反we shouldn't condemn them for their greed 明确反对「把对物质的兴趣等同于贪婪并加以谴责」；选项 It is the cause for condemnation of their greed 把「对物质兴趣」说成「谴责其贪婪的原因」，与作者立场相反
B) 无中生有the comforts they provide 指物质带来的「舒适」，但 P6 谈的是「通过物质获得尊重」，不是「物质提供舒适」——comfort 维度是选项凭空添加的
C) 张冠李戴原文 we should pity them for the intensity of their need for love 说「我们应怜悯豪车车主对爱的渴求」——施动者是「我们」，对象是「豪车车主」；选项 It arouses pity rather than respect from the wealthy 却说「（兴趣）引起富人的怜悯而非尊重」，施动者变成了 the wealthy、且把 respect 与 pity 错误对立
D) ✓ 正确a hunger for the respect and esteem ↔ their craving for social recognition only available in our societies through the acquisition of material goods ↔ arises from预判的核心三要素：第一是「渴求」（hunger 对应 craving）、第二是对象是「社会层面的尊重」（respect and esteem 对应 social recognition）、第三是驱动了对物质的兴趣（arises from）。D 项三要素全中
questions.quote: It has to do with a hunger for the respect and esteem that is only available in our societies through the acquisition of material goods.

options.text: It is the cause for condemnation of their greed.
It has a lot to do with the comforts they provide.
It arouses pity rather than respect from the wealthy.
It arises from their craving for social recognition.

questions.prompt: What kind of people do snobs deem worth respect and esteem?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
势利之人认为什么样的人值得尊重和敬重?
A) 那些拥有名望和财富的人。
B) 那些思想受到严格管束的人。
C) 那些拥有智慧和想象力的人。
D) 那些品质隐藏在伪装之下的人。
**判型** What kind of people do snobs deem worth respect and esteem? 问的是被势利者认定值得尊重的具体人群类别，是文中明示的事实
**拆句** 主干 What kind of people do snobs deem worth respect and esteem，deem 是「认为、视为」的正式动词，等于 consider；worth respect and esteem 作 deem 的宾语补足语。需注意 deem 不是常见词，但句式 deem sb. worth doing/sth. 与 consider sb. worth 同构。
**定位** 在势利者眼中，唯有那些已经获得赞誉、已经取得成功的人，才是值得尊重的对象。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确the already acclaimed and already successful ↔ Those with fame and fortune预判核心是「已获得外在声名地位的人」，A 项 Those with fame and fortune 用名词fame and fortune 浓缩了 acclaimed 与 successful 两个分词
B) 张冠李戴There is no room in their timid regimented minds 中的 regimented minds 是描写势利者 their 的心智状态（胆怯、刻板），不是「被尊重的对象」；选项把势利者的特征张冠到「被尊重者」头上
C) 与原文相反At the root of snobbery is a lack of imagination and confidence 说势利者缺乏想象力；someone might be clever, kind or good—and yet somehow have been overlooked entirely by society 说「聪明、善良的人反而被社会忽略」——这部分人恰恰是势利者「看不到」的，而不是势利者尊敬的对象
D) 与原文相反their qualities lying hidden beneath an unfamiliar veil 中的「品质藏于陌生面纱之下」，主体仍是被社会忽略的、品质未显的人，正是势利者「看不见」而非「尊敬」的对象
questions.quote: For snobs, it is the already acclaimed and already successful who are the only ones worthy of respect.

options.text: Those with fame and fortune.
Those with regimented minds.
Those with intelligence and imagination.
Those with qualities lying hidden in disguise.

questions.prompt: What does the author imply we should do to avoid being snobbish?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （推断题）
**题目译文**
作者暗示我们应该做什么来避免势利?
A) 意识到从来就不存在更好或更差的人这回事。
B) 对我们生活中碰巧遇到的人保持善意和好奇。
C) 认识到更好或更差以意想不到的方式不断变化。
D) 根据人们独特的性格特征来评判他们。
**判型** What does the author imply we should do 中的 imply 是明确的推断信号词，要求由作者明示主张做「一步逻辑延伸」得出建议
**拆句** 主干 What does the author imply we should do，to avoid being snobbish 是不定式作目的状语；being snobbish 是 avoid 的动名词宾语（avoid 后只跟 v-ing）。结构简单，无陷阱。
**定位** 正因为我们其实并不善于判断他人的价值，所以我们最根本的义务始终是——对几乎每一个与我们相遇的人保持善良、温厚、好奇与想象力。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反原文 The true answer to snobbery is not to say that there is no such thing as a better or worse person 明确反对「无所谓好人坏人」这种说法；选项 there has never been such a thing as a better or worse person 却正是被作者明确否定的命题
B) ✓ 正确to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path↔ Be kind to and curious about those who we happen to meet in our lives our ultimate duty remains↔ Be kind to...预判三要素：第一是态度（善良、好奇）、第二是对象（每一个相遇者）、第三是语气（建议、应该）。B 项以祈使句 Be kind to and curious about those who we happen to meet 三要素全中
C) 偷换概念better or worse exist in constantly unexpected places 说的是「好坏的人出现在意想不到的地方」——位置出乎意料；选项 better or worse keeps changing in unexpected ways 把它偷换成「好坏不断以意想不到的方式变化」——把空间分布偷换成动态变化
D) 与原文相反carry none of the outward signs of distinction 直白说「不带任何显赫的外在标志」；选项 Judge people on the basis of their distinctive character traits 却要求依据「显著的性格特征」判断人，与原文明确否定的方向一致
questions.quote: And because we are such poor judges of the worth of others, our ultimate duty remains to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path.

options.text: Be aware there has never been such a thing as a better or worse person.
Be kind to and curious about those who we happen to meet in our lives.
Realize that better or worse keeps changing in unexpected ways.
Judge people on the basis of their distinctive character traits.

title: No beast on Earth is tougher than the…

sentences.text: No beast on Earth is tougher than the tiny tardigrade(缓步类动物).
It can (26)____ being frozen at-272° Celsius, being exposed to the vacuum of outer space and even being (27)____ with 500 times the dose of X-rays that would kill a human.
In other words, the creature can endure conditions that don't even exist on Earth.
And researchers are looking to the microscopic animals to learn how to prepare humans and crops to handle the (28)____ of space travel.

passage.translation: 地球上没有哪种动物比微小的缓步类动物更顽强。它能在零下272摄氏度的环境中存活,能暴露在外太空的真空中,甚至能承受500倍于致人死亡剂量的X射线照射。换句话说,这种生物能够忍受地球上根本不存在的条件。研究人员正在研究这些微小的动物,以学习如何让人类和农作物适应太空旅行的严酷环境。

sentences.text: The tardigrade's indestructibility stems from its (29)____ to its environment—which may seem surprising, since it lives in (30)____ comfortable places, like the cool, wet patches of moss(⻘苔) that dot a garden wall.

passage.translation: 缓步类动物的坚不可摧源于它对环境的适应——这似乎令人惊讶,因为它生活在看似舒适的地方,比如点缀在花园墙上的凉爽潮湿的青苔斑块中。

sentences.text: But it turns out that a tardigrade's damp, mossy home can dry out many times each year.
Drying is pretty (31)____ for most living things.
It does damage to cells in some of the same ways that freezing, vacuum and radiation do.
Tardigrades, however, have (32)____ special strategies for dealing with these kinds of damage.

passage.translation: 但事实证明,缓步类动物潮湿多苔的栖息地每年可能会干涸多次。干燥对大多数生物来说是相当灾难性的。它对细胞造成的损害在某些方面与冰冻、真空和辐射相同。然而,缓步类动物已经进化出应对这些损害的特殊策略。

sentences.text: As a tardigrade dries out, its cells produce several strange proteins that are unlike anything found in other animals.
In water, the proteins are shapeless.
But as water disappears, the proteins self-assemble into long fibers that fill the cell's (33)____ .
The fibers support the cell's membranes(细胞膜) and proteins, preventing them from breaking or (34)____ .

passage.translation: 当缓步类动物干燥时,它的细胞会产生几种奇特的蛋白质,这些蛋白质不同于其他任何动物体内的蛋白质。在水中,这些蛋白质是无定形的。但随着水分消失,蛋白质会自我组装成长纤维,填充细胞内部。这些纤维支撑细胞膜和蛋白质,防止它们破裂或展开。

sentences.text: Emulating tardigrades could one day help humans colonize outer space.
Food crops could be engineered to produce tardigrade proteins, allowing these organisms to grow more efficiently on spacecraft where levels of radiation are elevated compared with on Earth.

passage.translation: 模仿缓步类动物有朝一日可能帮助人类殖民外太空。食用作物可以被改造成产生缓步类动物蛋白质,使这些生物能够在辐射水平高于地球的航天器上更有效地生长。

sentences.text: So if humans ever succeed in reaching the stars, they may accomplish this (35)____ , in part, by standing on the shoulders of the tiny eight-legged endurance specialists in your backyard.

passage.translation: 因此,如果人类最终成功到达星际,他们可能会部分地通过站在你家后院那些微小的八足耐力专家的肩膀上来实现这一壮举。

groups.instructions: In this section, there is a passage with ten blanks. You are required to select one word for each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage. Read the passage through carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not use any of the words in the bank more than once.
groups.content:
No beast on Earth is tougher than the tiny tardigrade(缓步类动物). It can {{26}} being frozen at-272° Celsius, being exposed to the vacuum of outer space and even being {{27}} with 500 times the dose of X-rays that would kill a human. In other words, the creature can endure conditions that don't even exist on Earth. And researchers are looking to the microscopic animals to learn how to prepare humans and crops to handle the {{28}} of space travel.

The tardigrade's indestructibility stems from its {{29}} to its environment—which may seem surprising, since it lives in {{30}} comfortable places, like the cool, wet patches of moss(⻘苔) that dot a garden wall.

But it turns out that a tardigrade's damp, mossy home can dry out many times each year. Drying is pretty {{31}} for most living things. It does damage to cells in some of the same ways that freezing, vacuum and radiation do. Tardigrades, however, have {{32}} special strategies for dealing with these kinds of damage.

As a tardigrade dries out, its cells produce several strange proteins that are unlike anything found in other animals. In water, the proteins are shapeless. But as water disappears, the proteins self-assemble into long fibers that fill the cell's {{33}} . The fibers support the cell's membranes(细胞膜) and proteins, preventing them from breaking or {{34}} .

Emulating tardigrades could one day help humans colonize outer space. Food crops could be engineered to produce tardigrade proteins, allowing these organisms to grow more efficiently on spacecraft where levels of radiation are elevated compared with on Earth.

So if humans ever succeed in reaching the stars, they may accomplish this {{35}} , in part, by standing on the shoulders of the tiny eight-legged endurance specialists in your backyard.

options.text: adaptations
rigors
blasted
seemingly
catastrophic
survive
evolved
tempt
feat
thrill
interior
unanimously
probing
unfolding
recurrence

questions.explanation:
**答案** K) survive 动词
**词性槽** 情态动词 can 后需动词原形
**依据** 与开篇"地球最坚韧"主旨吻合，survive doing 是地道搭配全文开篇 No beast on Earth is tougher than the tiny tardigrade 在强调它能 "挺过" 各种极端条件；survive 后接动名词意为"挺过、幸存于"，正好对应 being frozen / being exposed / being blasted 这一连串极端待遇。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
L) tempt "引诱"语义牛头不对马嘴tempt 是"诱惑/吸引"，宾语通常是人，且后接不定式 to do；说"它诱惑被冷冻在 -272 度"既不搭配也与文意完全相反。

questions.explanation:
**答案** B) blasted 动词
**词性槽** being ___ with 结构需被动语态过去分词
**依据** be blasted with 是"被…强力照射/轰击"的固定搭配空后接 500 times the dose of X-rays（500 倍剂量的 X 射线），动作是"被高剂量 X 射线轰击"；blast with 表"用…猛烈轰击/照射"，与 X-rays 搭配标准，且与前面 being frozen、being exposed 三件"极端遭遇"形成排比。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
D) evolved evolve 是不及物动词，没有被动义evolve 意为"进化"，本身不能说"被进化"；evolve with X-rays 也无固定搭配，更与本句"承受极端伤害"的语义方向相反。

questions.explanation:
**答案** I) rigors 名词
**词性槽** 定冠词 the 后接介词 of，需名词作 of 短语中心词
**依据** the rigors of space travel 是新闻文本中描述"太空旅行严酷条件"的高频搭配上文刚说缓步类动物能 endure conditions that don't even exist on Earth，研究者要让人类与作物准备应对 the __(28)__ of space travel，需要 handle 的应是"严酷条件"；the rigors of X（X 的严酷条件）正是六级阅读常见的固定搭配，与 handle 的宾语"困难/考验"语义匹配。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
H) recurrence "复发"与"太空旅行"搭配不成立recurrence 用于事件再次发生，the recurrence of space travel 意思变成"太空旅行的复发"，与"应对严酷条件"的因果链完全错位。

questions.explanation:
**答案** A) adaptations 名词
**词性槽** 形容词性物主代词 its 后需名词
**依据** adaptation to environment 是地道搭配，且与下文进化呼应本句说"不可摧毁性源自它对环境的某物"，下文 Tardigrades, however, have __(32)__special strategies for dealing with these kinds of damage 直接给出"特殊策略"，正是"适应"的具体表现；adaptations to its environment 意为"对环境的（多项）适应"，完全贴合。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
H) recurrence "复发"与"环境适应"语义无关recurrence to its environment 不是固定搭配，且"对环境的复发"在语义上不成立。
I) rigors rigors 表外部严酷，不是它"自己的"特质rigors to its environment 不通；况且 its rigors 意为"它自己的严酷"，与"不可摧毁性来源"的因果链方向不对，应是"环境的严酷"而非"它的严酷"。

questions.explanation:
**答案** J) seemingly 副词
**词性槽** 形容词 comfortable 前需副词修饰
**依据** 与下文的极端耐受形成转折反差上一段刚说缓步类动物的不可摧毁源自对环境的适应，作者紧接着用 which may seem surprising 提示读者：它住的地方其实 cool, wet patches of moss，看着挺舒服。所以这里要的就是"看似、表面上"——seemingly comfortable 与后文实际会反复干涸的真相形成反差。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
N) unanimously 语义牛头不对马嘴unanimously 意为"一致地"，描述群体投票或意见，与单数主语 it 的居住环境舒适程度无关，代入 lives in unanimously comfortable places 完全讲不通。

questions.explanation:
**答案** C) catastrophic 形容词
**词性槽** be 动词 is 后接表语，需形容词
**依据** 与下句"破坏细胞、堪比冷冻真空辐射"等量齐观紧接着的下一句 It does damage to cells in some of the same ways that freezing, vacuum and radiation do 把"干燥"的伤害与冷冻、真空、辐射并列；这种伤害程度只能用"灾难性的"来形容，catastrophic 程度恰好对得上。

**答案** D) evolved 动词
**词性槽** have ___ special strategies 需过去分词构成现在完成时
**依据** evolve 在此作及物动词，意为"演化出"前句指出干燥具有破坏性，本句用 however 转折，强调缓步类动物却"已经演化出"特殊策略；evolve special strategies 表示"（通过进化）形成了特殊策略"，与全段"它的适应性来源"主旨一致，并与 29 题 adaptations 形成主旨内回环。
questions.tip:
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 B) —— blasted 也可作过去分词，词性陷阱。have + 过去分词 +名词宾语的现在完成时框架里，blasted 与 evolved 都是过去分词，词性符合；但 blast strategies 搭配不成立，且本句靠 however 引出的"它却演化出策略"才是文意。识破法：动词不仅看词性，还要看与宾语 special strategies 是否能搭配。

questions.explanation:
**答案** F) interior 名词
**词性槽** 形容词性所有格 the cell's 后需名词
**依据** fill ... interior 是描述细胞内部空间的典型搭配上下文谈到蛋白质组装成长纤维并 fill the cell's __(33)__，下文还说这些纤维 support the cell's membranes(细胞膜) and proteins——能被纤维"填满"且能支撑膜与蛋白的，只能是细胞的"内部空间"，interior 名词义"内部"完全契合。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
A) adaptations义为"适应性变化"，不可被纤维填满adaptations 指生物层面的适应性特征，是抽象概念，不存在"被长纤维填满"的物理空间含义，与 fill 在语义上不兼容。
E) feat"壮举"是抽象成就，不能被填满feat 用于人或行为的伟大成就（如下文 they may accomplish this __(35)__ 才是它的归宿），与细胞物理结构毫无关系。
H) recurrence "复发"指事件重复，不指空间recurrence 是"再次发生"的动作性名词，不是一个可以被纤维 fill 的位置或空间。
I) rigors"严酷条件"指环境而非细胞内部rigors 表抽象的"艰难考验"，复数语义偏外部环境，且后文马上要用它来描述太空旅行的严酷（见 26 题语境），与本句"细胞内部"语义错位。

questions.explanation:
**答案** O) unfolding 动词
**词性槽** 介词 from 后并列的动名词
**依据** unfold 是生化语境下"蛋白质解折叠/结构散开"的标准说法本句说纤维 support the cell's membranes(细胞膜) and proteins，防止它们 breaking 或本空所表的另一种损坏；蛋白质受损的两种典型方式就是"断裂"（breaking）与"解折叠/散开"（unfolding），二者并列正好构成对细胞膜/蛋白损伤的全面描述。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
G) probing "探测"是主动动作，与被防止的损坏无关probe 意为"探查、调查"，主语应是"探查者"；细胞膜或蛋白被防止"探查"在语义上完全说不通，与 breaking 也不成对。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 G) —— probing 与 unfolding 同为 -ing 形态，易混。在preventing them from breaking or __(34)__ 处，两词词性一致；但 probing"探测"是主动动作，与被并列项 breaking"断裂"不在同一语义场。防坑法：or 并列项必须同语义方向，立刻砍掉异类。

questions.explanation:
**答案** E) feat 名词
**词性槽** 指示代词 this 后需单数名词
**依据** accomplish a feat 是"完成壮举"的固定搭配前文 if humans ever succeed in reaching the stars 把人类抵达星辰定调为巨大成就，this feat 正好回指这一壮举，并与 accomplish 构成最地道的"完成壮举"搭配。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
H) recurrence "复发"与"完成壮举"语义相反recurrence 暗示"再次发生"，常用于疾病或负面事件复发，accomplish this recurrence 既不搭配也与本段"人类首次抵达星辰"的壮举语境完全冲突。

title: After earning a bachelor's degree, I was determined…

sentences.text: After earning a bachelor's degree, I was determined to do what I love.
I headed straight to graduate school to investigate the social problems that fascinated me.

passage.translation: 获得学士学位后,我决心做自己热爱的事情。我直接进入研究生院,去研究那些令我着迷的社会问题。

sentences.text: For almost a decade, I told everyone I encountered that they should do the same.
"Follow your passion," I counseled.
"You can figure out the employment stuff later."

passage.translation: 在近十年的时间里,我告诉每一个遇到的人,他们也应该这样做。"追随你的激情,"我建议道,"你可以之后再解决就业问题。"

sentences.text: It wasn't until I began to research this widely accepted career advice that I understood how problematic it really was.

passage.translation: 直到我开始研究这个被广泛接受的职业建议时,我才明白它实际上有多么成问题。

sentences.text: As a sociologist, I interviewed college students and professional workers to learn what it really meant to pursue their dreams, which I will refer to here as the passion principle.
I was stunned by what I found out about this principle in the research for my new book.

passage.translation: 作为一名社会学家,我采访了大学生和职场人士,以了解追寻梦想的真正含义,我在此将其称为激情原则。在为我的新书进行研究时,我对这一原则的发现感到震惊。

sentences.text: Surveys show the American public has long held the passion principle in high regard as a career decision-making priority.
And its popularity is even stronger among those facing job instability.

passage.translation: 调查显示,长期以来,美国公众一直高度重视激情原则,将其作为职业决策的优先考虑因素。而且它在那些面临工作不稳定的人群中更受欢迎。

sentences.text: Advocates of the passion principle found it compelling because they believed that following one's passion can provide workers with both the motivation necessary to work hard and a place to find fulfillment.

passage.translation: 激情原则的倡导者认为它很有说服力,因为他们相信追随自己的激情既能为工作者提供努力工作所需的动力,也能让他们找到成就感。

sentences.text: Yet, what I found is that following one's passion does not necessarily lead to fulfillment, but is one of the most powerful cultural forces perpetuating overwork.

I also found that promoting the pursuit of one's passion helps perpetuate social inequalities due to the fact that not everyone has the same economic resources to allow them to pursue their passion with ease.

passage.translation: 然而,我发现追随自己的激情并不一定能带来成就感,反而是使过度工作长期存在的最强大的文化力量之一。我还发现,提倡追寻自己的激情有助于使社会不平等长期存在,因为并非每个人都拥有相同的经济资源来让他们轻松地追寻自己的激情。

sentences.text: While the passion principle is broadly popular, not everyone has the necessary resources to turn their passion into a stable, good-paying job.
Passion-seekers from wealthy families are better able to wait until a job they are passionate about comes along without worrying about student loans in the meantime.
They are also better situated to take unpaid internships to get their foot in the door while their parents pay their rent.
And they often have access to parents' social networks to help them find jobs.

Surveys revealed that working-class and first-generation college graduates, regardless of their career field, are more likely than their wealthier peers to end up in low-paying unskilled jobs when they pursue their passion.

passage.translation: 虽然激情原则广受欢迎,但并非每个人都拥有必要的资源将自己的激情转化为稳定、高薪的工作。来自富裕家庭的激情追寻者更有能力等待他们热爱的工作出现,而不必在此期间担心学生贷款。他们也更有条件接受无薪实习来获得入门机会,而由父母支付房租。而且他们通常可以利用父母的社交网络来帮助他们找工作。调查显示,工人阶级和第一代大学毕业生,无论其职业领域如何,在追寻激情时比他们更富裕的同龄人更有可能最终从事低薪的非技术性工作。

sentences.text: Colleges, workplaces and career counselors who promote the "follow your passion" path for everyone, without leveling the playing field, help perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities among career aspirants.

passage.translation: 大学、工作场所和职业顾问向所有人推广"追随你的激情"这条道路,却不创造公平的竞争环境,这有助于使职业追求者之间的社会经济不平等长期存在。

sentences.text: It's not just well-off passion-seekers who benefit from the passion principle.
Employers of passionate workers do, too.
Potential employers showed greater interest in passionate applicants in part because they believed the applicants would work hard at their jobs without expecting an increase in pay.
They even sacrifice a good salary, job stability and leisure time to work in a job they love.

passage.translation: 不仅是富裕的激情追寻者从激情原则中受益。充满激情的员工的雇主也从中受益。潜在雇主对充满激情的求职者表现出更大的兴趣,部分原因是他们相信这些求职者会在工作中努力工作,而不期望加薪。他们甚至会牺牲高薪、工作稳定性和休闲时间,去从事他们热爱的工作。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section. Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements. For each of them there are four choices marked A) , B) , C) and D) . You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What did the author advise people do for almost a decade?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者在近十年里建议人们做什么?
A) 弄清楚什么是最令人着迷的工作。
B) 遵循广泛接受的职业建议。
C) 满怀热情地追求自己的职业。
D) 做任何他们热衷的事情。
**判型** What did the author advise people do for almost a decade 用 What did 直接问事实，没有 infer/suggest/imply/mainly about 等推断或主旨信号。
**拆句** What did the author advise people do for almost a decade 是 What 引导的特殊疑问句，主干 the author advise people do，advise sb. do 处省略 to（口语化结构），for almost a decade 是时间状语修饰整个动作，无陷阱。
**定位** 在将近十年的时间里，我告诉我遇到的每一个人：他们应该和我做一样的事。我劝告说：「追随你的激情」「就业那些事儿你以后再琢磨」。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念Figure out what is the most fascinating job 把 fascinated 这个形容作者自己研究方向的词嫁接到 job 上，原文 P2 是作者劝别人 follow passion，不是劝别人去找最有趣的工作。
B) 张冠李戴Follow widely accepted career counsel 把作者自己当年发出的建议描述为去跟随别人的建议，但原文 I counseled 表明作者本人就是 counsel 的发出者。
C) 偷换概念Pursue their careers with passion 是『用激情去追求事业』，原文是『追随你的激情』，二者并不等价：前者是把激情当工作态度，后者是把激情当工作方向。
D) ✓ 正确Follow your passion ↔ Do whatever they are zealous for预判答案是『追随激情/做自己热爱的事』，Do whatever they are zealous for 用zealous for 同义替换 passion，正中预判。
questions.quote: For almost a decade, I told everyone I encountered that they should do the same. "Follow your passion," I counseled. "You can figure out the employment stuff later."

options.text: Figure out what is the most fascinating job.
Follow widely accepted career counsel.
Pursue their careers with passion.
Do whatever they are zealous for.

questions.prompt: How did the author feel about the passion principle through his research?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者通过研究对热情原则有何感受?
A) 他对其后果感到震惊。
B) 他进一步确信了其合理性。
C) 他贯彻执行它实际上是正确的。
D) 他对其广泛流行感到震撼。
**判型** How did the author feel about the passion principle through his research 直接问研究后的具体感受，是有明确指向的事实题。
**拆句** How did the author feel about the passion principle through his research 是 How 引导的特殊疑问句，主干 the author feel about the passion principle，through his research 作方式状语，限定感受产生的途径，无陷阱。
**定位** 在为新书做的研究中，我被自己关于这一原则的发现震惊了。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确I was stunned by what I found out ↔ He was astonished by its consequences预判是『被研究发现震惊』，astonished by its consequences 把震惊源具体落到consequences 上，与原文 P7 起列举的负面后果一致。
B) 与原文相反He was further convinced of its soundness 说作者更加确信激情原则的正确性，但原文 how problematic it really was 与 stunned 均显示作者发现了它的问题，立场是反向的。
C) 与原文相反He was actually right to follow it through 说作者证实自己当初跟随激情是对的，但原文 does not necessarily lead to fulfillment 表明作者得出的是『追随激情未必带来满足』的反思结论，并非自我肯定。
D) 答非所问He was struck by its broad popularity 把震惊对象错挂到『大众接受度』上，但题干问的是 through his research，原文 P5 谈大众接受度但用的是中性动词 hold ... in high regard，作者并未对此 struck。
questions.quote: I was stunned by what I found out about this principle in the research for my new book.

options.text: He was astonished by its consequences.
He was further convinced of its soundness.
He was actually right to follow it through.
He was struck by its broad popularity.

questions.prompt: What is important to turning one's passion into a stable, good-paying job?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
将热情转化为稳定、高薪工作的关键是什么?
A) 愿意接受无薪实习和低薪工作。
B) 充分的学业准备和合理的职业咨询。
C) 努力工作和牺牲休闲时间。
D) 经济支持和社会关系。
**判型** What is important to turning one's passion into a stable, good-paying job 问的是某事的关键条件，是事实层面的细节题。
**拆句** What is important to turning one's passion into a stable, good-paying job 中 turning... job 是动名词短语作介词 to 的宾语，a stable, good-paying job 中两个形容词并列修饰job，无陷阱。
**定位** 出身富裕家庭的激情追随者更有能力等到自己真正热爱的工作出现，同时不必担心助学贷款；他们也更有条件接受无薪实习以打开职业大门，因为有父母替他们付房租；而且，他们往往可以借助父母的社会人脉帮自己找工作。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念Willingness to take unpaid internships and low-paying jobs 把『愿意做无薪实习和低薪工作』当成转化成功的关键，但原文里无薪实习是富裕者的专利（while their parents pay their rent），而低薪非技能岗位则是工薪阶层 end up in low-paying unskilled jobs 的不利结局，二者都不是『成功条件』。
B) 无中生有Full academic preparedness and sound career counseling 提到的『学业准备充分』在 P8 中根本没有任何线索；P9 虽出现 career counselors 但是被批评的对象、不是关键条件。
C) 张冠李戴Hard work and sacrifice of leisure time 在原文中是 P10 雇主对激情员工的期待与员工实际付出的代价，与题 53 问的『把激情变成稳定高薪』的关键条件无关。
D) ✓ 正确wait until a job they are passionate about comes along without worrying about student loans ↔Financial backing access to parents' social networks to help them find jobs ↔ social connections预判要点是经济和人脉两个维度，Financial backing and social connections 一项即覆盖两条，是与原文论据结构最完整匹配的概括。
questions.quote: Passion-seekers from wealthy families are better able to wait until a job they are passionate about comes along without worrying about student loans in the meantime. They are also better situated to take unpaid internships to get their foot in the door while their parents pay their rent. And they often have access to parents' social networks to help them find jobs.

options.text: Willingness to take unpaid internships and low-paying jobs.
Full academic preparedness and sound career counseling.
Hard work and sacrifice of leisure time.
Financial backing and social connections.

questions.prompt: What happens when everyone is encouraged to follow their passion?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
当每个人都被鼓励追随自己的热情时会发生什么?
A) 更多的职业追求者最终失业。
B) 人们不太关心社会经济不平等。
C) 社会经济不平等可能持续存在。
D) 职业顾问将失去公信力。
**判型** What happens when everyone is encouraged to follow their passion 问的是一个已发生在原文里的具体结果，不需推断。
**拆句** What happens when everyone is encouraged to follow their passion 是 What 引导的疑问句加 when 时间从句，主干 What happens，everyone is encouraged to follow their passion 是被动语态从句，无陷阱。
**定位** 那些向所有人推行『跟随激情』路径却不去拉平起跑线的高校、用人单位与职业顾问，正在加剧职业追求者之间的社会经济不平等。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有Many more career aspirants end up unemployed 中的『失业』在原文中没有出现，P8 只说工薪阶层会落入 low-paying unskilled jobs（低薪非技能岗），那是有工作而非失业。
B) 与原文相反People are less concerned with socioeconomic inequality 说人们对不平等的关注度下降，原文 P9 说的是不平等本身被延续，并不涉及关注度的变化，且 less 反向于作者的批评立场。
C) ✓ 正确help perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities ↔ Socioeconomic inequality is likely to persist预判结果是『不平等被延续』，C 用 persist 同义、用 is likely to 对应 help 的中等程度，结构性等值，是 54 的最佳概括。
D) 过度推断Career counselors are going to lose credibility 推断职业顾问会失去公信力，原文 P9只是批评他们推行『跟随激情』而不拉平起跑线，并未说他们会丧失公信力。
questions.quote: Colleges, workplaces and career counselors who promote the "follow your passion" path for everyone, without leveling the playing field, help perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities among career aspirants.

options.text: Many more career aspirants end up unemployed.
People are less concerned with socioeconomic inequality.
Socioeconomic inequality is likely to persist.
Career counselors are going to lose credibility.

questions.prompt: What does the author say about employers of passionate workers?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者对雇用充满热情的员工的雇主有何看法?
A) 他们为这些员工提供工作稳定性和良好的薪水。
B) 他们利用这些员工的热情为自己谋利。
C) 他们为这些员工实现目标创造公平的竞争环境。
D) 他们鼓励这些员工实现自己的抱负。
**判型** What does the author say about employers of passionate workers 问的是作者就特定对象明示了什么观点，属于事实定位类。
**拆句** What does the author say about employers of passionate workers 主干 What does the author say about employers，of passionate workers 是 of 短语限定 employers 的范围（雇佣激情工作者的雇主），无陷阱。
**定位** 雇用激情员工的雇主也同样受益。潜在雇主对激情型应聘者更感兴趣，部分原因是他们相信这些应聘者会卖力工作而不会指望涨薪。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反They provide these workers with job stability and a good salary 说雇主给激情员工稳定和高薪，但 They even sacrifice a good salary, job stability 明示员工是在牺牲稳定和高薪、不是获得它。
B) ✓ 正确Employers of passionate workers do, too↔They exploit these workers' passion to benefit themselves work hard at their jobs without expecting an increase in pay↔exploit these workers' passion预判定性为『雇主占便宜』，exploit 准确对应『利用他人 passion 为自己获利』，是对P10 整段事实最贴近的概括。
C) 张冠李戴They level the playing field for these workers to reach their goals 把『拉平起跑线』归给雇主，但原文 without leveling the playing field 表明这事根本没人做，更不是雇主在做。
D) 偷换概念They encourage these workers to realize their aspirations 用『鼓励员工实现抱负』的正面表述粉饰雇主行为，但 P10 揭示的恰是雇主借此让员工 work hard ... without expecting an increase in pay，本质是利用而非成就员工。
questions.quote: Employers of passionate workers do, too. Potential employers showed greater interest in passionate applicants in part because they believed the applicants would work hard at their jobs without expecting an increase in pay.

options.text: They provide these workers with job stability and a good salary.
They exploit these workers' passion to benefit themselves.
They level the playing field for these workers to reach their goals.
They encourage these workers to realize their aspirations.

title: Nationally, one in six children miss 15 or…

sentences.text: Nationally, one in six children miss 15 or more days of school in a year.
Education officials have deplored all this missed instruction.

passage.translation: 在全国范围内,每六个儿童中就有一个在一年内缺课15天或更多。教育官员对这些被错过的课程表示遗憾。

sentences.text: These chronically absent students suffer academically because of all the classroom instruction they miss out on.
In 2015, the U.S. secretary of education responded to this crisis, urging communities to support every student to attend every day and be successful in school.
His open letter stated that missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason—excused or unexcused—is a primary cause of low academic achievement.

passage.translation: 这些长期缺勤的学生由于错过了大量课堂教学而在学业上受到损害。2015年,美国教育部长对这一危机作出回应,敦促社区支持每个学生每天上学并在学校取得成功。他的公开信指出,无论出于何种原因——无论是准假还是旷课——一年内缺课达到上课天数的10%是学业成绩低下的主要原因。

sentences.text: Worrying about whether children attend school makes sense.
After all, if students don't show up, teachers can't teach them.

passage.translation: 担心儿童是否上学是有道理的。毕竟,如果学生不到校,教师就无法教他们。

sentences.text: But what if America's attendance crisis is about much more than students missing class?

What if, instead, it is a reflection of family and community crises these students face—such as being ejected from the family apartment, fearing for their safety in their neighborhood or suffering an illness?

passage.translation: 但是,如果美国的出勤危机远不止学生缺课这么简单呢?如果它实际上反映的是这些学生面临的家庭和社区危机——比如被赶出家庭公寓、担心自己在社区的安全或遭受疾病,又该如何呢?

sentences.text: As social scientists we investigated how excused and unexcused absences relate to children's academic achievement.

passage.translation: 作为社会科学家,我们调查了准假缺勤和旷课与儿童学业成绩的关系。

sentences.text: We find that absences excused by a parent do little to harm children's learning.
In fact, children with no unexcused absences—but 15 to 18 excused absences—have test scores equal to their peers who have no absences.

passage.translation: 我们发现,经家长准假的缺勤对儿童的学习几乎没有什么损害。事实上,没有旷课记录但有15至18次准假缺勤的儿童,其考试成绩与那些没有任何缺勤的同龄人相当。

sentences.text: Meanwhile, the average child with even just one unexcused absence does much worse academically than peers with none.

passage.translation: 与此同时,即使只有一次旷课的普通儿童,其学业表现也比没有旷课的同龄人差得多。

sentences.text: We believe unexcused absence is a strong signal of the many challenges children and families face, including economic and medical hardships.
Unexcused absences can be a powerful signal of how those out-of-school challenges affect children's academic progress.

passage.translation: 我们认为旷课是儿童和家庭面临的诸多挑战(包括经济和医疗困难)的强烈信号。旷课可以成为这些校外挑战如何影响儿童学业进步的有力信号。

sentences.text: Our evidence suggests unexcused absences are problematic, but for a different reason than people often think.
Absence from school, and especially unexcused absence, matters mainly as a signal of many crises children and their families may be facing.
It matters less as a cause of lower student achievement due to missed instruction.

passage.translation: 我们的证据表明旷课确实有问题,但原因与人们通常认为的不同。缺课,尤其是旷课,主要作为儿童及其家庭可能面临的诸多危机的信号而重要。它作为因错过教学而导致学生成绩下降的原因则不那么重要。

sentences.text: How we choose to think of school absences matters for educational policy.
School attendance policies typically hold schools and families accountable for the days children miss, regardless of whether they were excused or unexcused absences.

passage.translation: 我们如何看待缺课问题对教育政策很重要。学校出勤政策通常让学校和家庭为儿童缺课的天数负责,无论这些缺勤是准假还是旷课。

sentences.text: These policies assume that missing school for any reason harms children academically because they are missing classroom instruction.
They also assume that schools will be able to effectively intervene by reducing student absences.
We find neither to be the case.

passage.translation: 这些政策假定,无论出于何种原因缺课都会因为错过课堂教学而在学业上损害儿童。它们还假定学校能够通过减少学生缺勤来有效干预。我们发现这两种情况都不成立。

sentences.text: As a result, these attendance policies end up disproportionately punishing families dealing with out-of-school crises in their lives and pressuring schools who serve them to get students to school more often.

passage.translation: 结果,这些出勤政策最终不成比例地惩罚了那些正在应对生活中校外危机的家庭,并给为这些家庭服务的学校施加压力,要求它们让学生更频繁地到校。

sentences.text: We instead suggest using unexcused absence from school as a signal to channel resources to the children and families who need them most.

passage.translation: 我们建议将旷课作为一种信号,用来向最需要帮助的儿童和家庭提供资源。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section. Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements. For each of them there are four choices marked A) , B) , C) and D) . You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What does the U.S. secretary of education say in his open letter?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
美国教育部长在他的公开信中说了什么?
A) 及时应对学校缺勤危机至关重要。
B) 长期缺勤学生的学业表现令人担忧。
C) 学业成绩低下主要归因于学校缺勤。
D) 学校缺勤对美国教育的影响令人担忧。
**判型** What does the U.S. secretary of education say in his open letter? 问的是某人具体说的内容，答案就在原文某句话里，不需推断。
**拆句** 结构是 What does the U.S. secretary of education say in his open letter?——典型what 引导的特殊疑问句，主语 the U.S. secretary of education，谓语 say，介词短语 in his open letter 限定 say 的发生场景；无从句、无否定、无陷阱。
**定位** 他的公开信指出，一年缺课 10%——无论是否有故——是低学业成就的一个主要原因。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 过度推断公开信里没有任何关于 "必须迅速回应" 的话——urging communities to support every student 是劝学校社区支持学生出勤，不是对 respond promptly 的呼吁；A 项把作者（urging）的动作改写成信件内容，且加了原文没有的 "vital importance /promptly" 程度词。
B) 偷换概念deplored 在原文里描述的是 Education officials 对 "all this missed instruction" 的态度，B 项把它偷换成了 "chronically absent students 的 academic performance is deplorable"——主语从 "缺课现象" 偷换成 "学生的学业表现"，evaluatee 错位。
C) ✓ 正确missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason ↔ school absences is a primary cause of low academic achievement ↔Low academic achievement is mainly attributed to C 项把 missing 10% of school days … is a primary cause of low academic achievement 的主动因果倒装为 "低学业主要归因于缺课" 的被动因果，与预判 "缺课是学业差的主因" 完全吻合。
D) 张冠李戴公开信原文用 primary cause 的客观因果定性，并未对 "school absences 对美国教育的影响" 作 worrisome 这种情感色彩评价——D 项把 Worrying 段的句首词搬到这里，但那是作者对 "担心缺勤" 的转述，并非教育部长公开信的内容。
questions.quote: His open letter stated that missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason—excused or unexcused—is a primary cause of low academic achievement.

options.text: It is of vital importance to respond promptly to the school absence crisis.
The academic performance of chronically absent students is deplorable.
Low academic achievement is mainly attributed to school absences.
The effect of school absences on American education is worrisome.

questions.prompt: What do the authors find about school absences?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者对学校缺勤有什么发现?
A) 请假缺勤对儿童学习影响很小。
B) 无故缺勤和请假缺勤之间几乎没有差别。
C) 请假缺勤导致相对更好的学业表现。
D) 无故缺勤对学校和家庭都是一个巨大挑战。
**判型** What do the authors find about school absences? 问的是作者的客观发现，原文必有对应陈述句，不属于推断。
**拆句** 结构是 What do the authors find about school absences?——What 作 find 的宾语，主语 the authors，介词短语 about school absences 限定 find 的话题范围；句法简单，没有陷阱。
**定位** 我们发现，由家长请假的 excused absences 对孩子的学习几乎没有伤害。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确absences excused by a parent ↔ Excused school absences do little to harm children's learning ↔ have little impact on children's learning A 项是 P6 第一句的字面同义改写——主语 excused absences、谓语 do little to harm 全部一一对应，无任何添加或扭曲，与预判完全吻合。
B) 与原文相反原文 the average child with even just one unexcused absence does much worse academically than peers with none 明确指出 unexcused 与 excused 差异很大——B项 little difference 与原文 much worse 直接相反。
C) 过度推断原文只说 excused absences do little to harm、有 excused 缺勤的孩子 have test scores equal to their peers who have no absences——是 "equal to"（相当），不是 comparatively better（相对更好）。"持平" 被悄悄抬升为 "更好"。
D) 答非所问Unexcused absences are a big challenge to both schools and families 谈的是unexcused 对学校和家庭构成挑战——题干 Q47 问的是 "authors 关于 school absences 的发现"，作者的核心发现是 excused 不损学（P6），而非 unexcused 对学校家庭有多挑战。话题偏离。
questions.quote: We find that absences excused by a parent do little to harm children's learning.

options.text: Excused school absences have little impact on children's learning.
There is little difference between unexcused and excused absences.
Excused absences lead to comparatively better school performance.
Unexcused absences are a big challenge to both schools and families.

questions.prompt: What do the authors believe concerning unexcused school absences?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者对无故缺勤持什么看法?
A) 由于错过了教学,它们可能导致学生学业成绩下降。
B) 它们直接指向儿童及其家庭面临的许多校外挑战。
C) 在制定教育政策时,美国政府通常会忽视这些问题。
D) 它们向儿童及其家庭发出了未来可能面临危机的明确信号。
**判型** What do the authors believe concerning unexcused school absences? 问的是作者已经明说的观点，原文有原句，属于细节题。
**拆句** 结构是 What do the authors believe concerning unexcused school absences?——concerning 等于 about，是介词，引出讨论对象；与 Q47 唯一的差异在限定词unexcused，读题时务必圈出。
**定位** 我们认为，无故缺勤是孩子和家庭所面临诸多挑战的强烈信号，包括经济与医疗方面的困难。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反They are likely to cause a decrease in students' academic achievements due to missed instruction 是作者明确反对的观点——It matters less as a cause of lower student achievement due to missed instruction 中 "matters less as a cause" 直接否定了 "缺课通过 missed instruction 导致学业下降" 这一因果。A 项把作者反对的观点扣给作者本人。
B) ✓ 正确is a strong signal of ↔ point directly to the many challenges children and families face ↔many of the out-of-school challenges confronting children and their families B 项把 is a strong signal of 改写为 point directly to——"信号" 与 "指向" 是六级常见的隐喻互换，与预判 "无故缺勤指向校外挑战" 完全吻合。
C) 无中生有原文未说政府 typically ignores unexcused absences——恰恰相反，P10 说政策hold schools and families accountable for the days children miss，是 "管太严" 而非 "忽视"。C 项凭空捏造 "政府忽视" 这一事实。
D) 偷换概念原文 is a strong signal of the many challenges children and families face 用一般现在时 face，指 "当下面对" 的挑战；D 项改成 the crises they are likely to face in the future 把时间挪到未来——把 "反映当下危机" 偷换成 "预测未来危机"。
questions.quote: We believe unexcused absence is a strong signal of the many challenges children and families face, including economic and medical hardships.

options.text: They are likely to cause a decrease in students' academic achievements due to missed instruction.
They point directly to many of the out-of-school challenges confronting children and their families.
They are matters the American government typically ignores when formulating educational policies.
They give a clear signal to children and their families of the crises they are likely to face in the future.

questions.prompt: What is the assumption underlying education policies in the U.S.?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
美国教育政策所基于的假设是什么?
A) 儿童的学业表现取决于减少缺勤次数。
B) 学校可以通过有效干预提高儿童的学业表现。
C) 学校和家庭都应对校外危机负责。
D) 儿童的学业表现与教学质量密切相关。
**判型** What is the assumption underlying education policies in the U.S.? 问的是原文已经写明的预设，不是要读者推断政策背后的隐含逻辑。
**拆句** 结构是 What is the assumption underlying education policies in the U.S.?——主语是the assumption，underlying 是现在分词作后置定语（= that underlies），限定assumption 是 "作为政策基础的" 那种预设；不要把 underlying 误读为时间状语。
**定位** 这些政策还预设，学校能通过减少学生缺勤来有效进行干预。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念原文 missing school for any reason harms children academically 是 "缺课损学业"——A 项 Children's academic performance depends on reducing the number of absences 把它倒过来说 "学业取决于减少缺勤"，表面相近但因果主语错位：原文主语是 "缺课"，A 项主语变成 "学业"，且 depends on 把单向因果偷换为 "取决于" 这一更强的依存关系。
B) ✓ 正确schools will be able to effectively intervene ↔Schools can boost children's academic performance by effective intervention by reducing student absences + These policies assume that missing school for any reason harms children academically↔ boost children's academic performance B 项把第二个 assume（学校能有效干预）与前一句的因果（缺课损学业）合起来——干预 → 减少缺勤 → 提升学业，是政策预设的完整逻辑，与预判吻合。
C) 张冠李戴原文 hold schools and families accountable for the days children miss 说政策让学校和家庭对 "缺课天数" 负责，而不是对 out-of-school crises 负责——"out-of-school crises" 是 out-of-school challenges 里的概念，C 项把它扣到了 "政策让学校家庭负责的对象" 头上，移花接木。
D) 无中生有原文从头到尾在讨论 attendance / absences / missed instruction（错过的教学），从未讨论 the quality of instruction（教学质量）——D 项凭空引入 "教学质量" 概念，与原文核心论域无关。
questions.quote: They also assume that schools will be able to effectively intervene by reducing student absences.

options.text: Children's academic performance depends on reducing the number of absences.
Schools can boost children's academic performance by effective intervention.
Schools as well as families should be held responsible for out-of-school crises.
Children's academic performance is closely related to the quality of instruction.

questions.prompt: What do the authors suggest doing regarding school absences?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者建议如何处理学校缺勤问题?
A) 找出其根本原因。
B) 重新制定学校出勤政策。
C) 将资源用于帮助有需要的儿童。
D) 向学校施压以减少无故缺勤。
**判型** What do the authors suggest doing regarding school absences? 问的是作者明说的建议，原文有原句，不需推断。
**拆句** 结构是 What do the authors suggest doing regarding school absences?——suggest doing 是 suggest 接动名词的固定搭配，What 在动名词 doing 后充当宾语；regarding= about，限定话题。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 我们反而建议：把无故缺勤作为信号，把资源调配给最需要这些资源的孩子和家庭。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 答非所问原文 P13 的建议是 "把 unexcused absence 当信号 → 把资源调配给需要者"，不是Identifying their underlying causes（找缺勤的根本原因）——作者已经在前文给出原因（家庭/社区危机），末段不再建议 "找原因"，而是 "用信号导资源"。
B) 过度推断原文 P10–P12 批评了现行政策，但 We instead suggest 的建议内容是 "用unexcused absence 当信号导资源"，而不是 Reframing school attendance policies（重构考勤政策）——作者直接给出替代做法，没把 "重构政策" 作为建议本身提出。
C) ✓ 正确channel resources to↔ Directing resources to the children and families who need them most↔needy children C 项把 channel resources to 直接对应 Directing resources to，把 who need them most 压缩为 needy——两步同义改写都是六级高频考法，与预判完全吻合。
D) 与原文相反原文 P12 明确指出现行政策 pressuring schools who serve them to get students to school more often 是负面后果，作者是 "批评施压"——D 项 Pressuring schools to reduce unexcused ones 反而把 "施压学校" 作为作者的建议，与原文立场完全相反。
questions.quote: We instead suggest using unexcused absence from school as a signal to channel resources to the children and families who need them most.

options.text: Identifying their underlying causes.
Reframing school attendance policies.
Directing resources to helping needy children.
Pressuring schools to reduce unexcused ones.

title: In her second year, Charlene Duong learned of…

sentences.text: In her second year, Charlene Duong learned of the use of poisonous, synthetic pesticides on her college campus.
Shocked but not surprised, she knew she had to do something.

Along with a couple of classmates, Charlene did a quick web search and discovered a small but growing movement led by the organization, Herbicide-Free Campus (HFC), to rid college campuses of artificial herbicides(灭草剂).
They were (26)____ .

passage.translation: 在大二那年,Charlene Duong得知她所在的大学校园使用有毒的合成农药。她感到震惊但并不意外,她知道自己必须做点什么。Charlene与几位同学一起快速进行了网络搜索,发现了一个由Herbicide-Free Campus(HFC)组织领导的小型但不断发展的运动,旨在清除大学校园中的人工除草剂。他们对此产生了浓厚兴趣。

sentences.text: Like many, Charlene experiences climate anxiety—a (27)____ fear of a climate catastrophe—and was, at the time, looking for an (28)____ .

When she discovered the HFC movement, she said she felt she "had found a specific area to focus on that still fit into the larger picture of fighting for a healthier, safer, cleaner (29)____ for all."

passage.translation: 与许多人一样,Charlene经历着气候焦虑——一种对气候灾难的长期恐惧——并且当时正在寻找一个出口。当她发现HFC运动时,她说她感觉自己"找到了一个可以专注的具体领域,而这仍然符合为所有人争取更健康、更安全、更清洁的环境这一更宏大目标"。

sentences.text: Toxic herbicide use in university land care is not unique.
Most institutions of higher education rely on synthetic pesticides and fertilizers to achieve (30)____ goals.
Having a "beautiful" campus means green and perfectly maintained lawns along with flower beds and paved sidewalks.
But these (31)____managed campuses can come at a cost: increased cancer risk, (32)____ waterways, poisoned wildlife and lifeless soil.

passage.translation: 在大学土地养护中使用有毒除草剂并非个例。大多数高等教育机构依赖合成农药和化肥来实现美学目标。拥有一个"美丽"的校园意味着绿色且维护完美的草坪,以及花坛和铺设的人行道。但这些按传统方式管理的校园可能会付出代价:癌症风险增加、水道受污染、野生动物中毒以及土壤失去生机。

sentences.text: Pesticide use on college campuses also contributes to our global climate crisis.
The use of chemicals to get rid of insects or unwanted plant life can increase indirect (33)____ as they can include petroleum-based ingredients.

Pesticide use also decreases the life in soil, (34)____ the ability of soils to absorb carbon or retain water and thus reducing campuses' ability to recover quickly from climate-related extreme weather events like droughts and floods.

passage.translation: 大学校园使用农药也加剧了我们的全球气候危机。使用化学品清除昆虫或不需要的植物会增加间接排放,因为它们可能包含石油基成分。农药使用还会减少土壤中的生物,削弱土壤吸收碳或保持水分的能力,从而降低校园从干旱和洪水等与气候相关的极端天气事件中快速恢复的能力。

sentences.text: Instead of using toxic chemicals, students working with HFC help out with (35)____ the campus grounds.

passage.translation: 与HFC合作的学生不使用有毒化学品,而是帮助清除校园场地的杂草。

sentences.text: "This work reminds me to be in the present moment as I play my role in reducing herbicide use and keeping my campus safe and healthy," says Charlene.

passage.translation: Charlene说:"这项工作提醒我活在当下,因为我在减少除草剂使用、保持校园安全和健康方面发挥着自己的作用。"

groups.instructions: In this section, there is a passage with ten blanks. You are required to select one word for each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage. Read the passage through carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not use any of the words in the bank more than once.
groups.content:
In her second year, Charlene Duong learned of the use of poisonous, synthetic pesticides on her college campus. Shocked but not surprised, she knew she had to do something. Along with a couple of classmates, Charlene did a quick web search and discovered a small but growing movement led by the organization, Herbicide-Free Campus (HFC), to rid college campuses of artificial herbicides(灭草剂). They were {{26}} .

Like many, Charlene experiences climate anxiety—a {{27}} fear of a climate catastrophe—and was, at the time, looking for an {{28}} . When she discovered the HFC movement, she said she felt she "had found a specific area to focus on that still fit into the larger picture of fighting for a healthier, safer, cleaner {{29}} for all."

Toxic herbicide use in university land care is not unique. Most institutions of higher education rely on synthetic pesticides and fertilizers to achieve {{30}} goals. Having a "beautiful" campus means green and perfectly maintained lawns along with flower beds and paved sidewalks. But these {{31}}managed campuses can come at a cost: increased cancer risk, {{32}} waterways, poisoned wildlife and lifeless soil.

Pesticide use on college campuses also contributes to our global climate crisis. The use of chemicals to get rid of insects or unwanted plant life can increase indirect {{33}} as they can include petroleum-based ingredients. Pesticide use also decreases the life in soil, {{34}} the ability of soils to absorb carbon or retain water and thus reducing campuses' ability to recover quickly from climate-related extreme weather events like droughts and floods.

Instead of using toxic chemicals, students working with HFC help out with {{35}} the campus grounds.

"This work reminds me to be in the present moment as I play my role in reducing herbicide use and keeping my campus safe and healthy," says Charlene.

vibrations
