Getting those big jumps will need better jobs in factories and cities.

passage.translation: "如果我们真的想让人们脱贫,我们必须资助能让他们获得至少每月100美元收入的项目,这样他们才能支付医疗保健和教育费用,"Ngetich先生说。"那些让他们通过种植豆类或玉米每月多赚2美元的项目不会让他们达到那个目标。"实现这些大幅提升需要工厂和城市的更好工作。

groups.instructions: In this section, you are going to read a passage with ten statements attached to it. Each statement contains information given in one of the paragraphs. Identify the paragraph from which the information is derived. You may choose a paragraph more than once. Each paragraph is marked with a letter. Answer the questions by marking the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2.

questions.prompt: It is said that agricultural productivity in many African countries has remained low for a century.
questions.explanation:
**答案** E 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
据说许多非洲国家的农业生产率一个世纪以来一直很低。
**锚点** 一百年未提升的农业生产率
**定位** 非洲许多地方的农业生产率已经一百年没有改善了。
**改写** agricultural productivity in many African countries has remained low for a century ↔Farm productivity hasn't improved in many parts of Africa for 100 years数字单位换写 + 否定改善 = 维持低位
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
D D 段 output per worker has improved by more than half over the past 30 years in Africa 给的时间是 30 年、方向是「提升过半」，与题干 remained low for a century 的「停滞一百年」结论完全相反，属于只覆盖局部 + 方向相反，不是源头段。output per worker has improved by more than half over the past 30 years in Africa, that is still far behind the 2.5 times improvement in Asia
questions.quote: Farm productivity hasn't improved in many parts of Africa for 100 years.

questions.prompt: Building connections between farms and major purchasers of their produce can promote African farmers' use of advanced farming techniques.
questions.explanation:
**答案** H 段（弱锚点）
**题目译文**
在农场与其农产品的主要购买者之间建立联系可以促进非洲农民使用先进的农业技术。
**锚点** 把农场连到大买家以推广技术
**定位** 传播知识的一种方式，是把农场与他们农产品的大买家连起来。
**改写** Building connections between farms and major purchasers of their produce ↔link farms to big buyers of their harvests建立连接 = link；大买家 = big buyers；农产品 = harvests can promote African farmers' use of advanced farming techniques ↔One way of spreading knowledge传播知识即让农民用上先进做法
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
F F 段重心在 getting small farmers to use fertiliser and, more important, better seeds，讲的是「输入端」做法，没有「把农场连到大买家」这件事，与题干 Building connections between farms and major purchasers 的渠道连接路径不同。Much of the focus has been on getting small farmers to use fertiliser and, more important, better seeds G G 段 Many of their neighbours do not follow the advice 走的是「邻里看效果再跟」的路径，与 Building connections between farms and major purchasers 的「连到买家」机制不同。Small coffee farmers in Kenya are able to increase their incomes by 40% by following a few simple guidelines on caring for their bushes
questions.quote: One way of spreading knowledge is to link farms to big buyers of their harvests.

questions.prompt: Parts of Africa are getting warmer much faster than the average, with southern Africa witnessing roughly twice the global warming rate over the last half century.
questions.explanation:
**答案** B 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
非洲部分地区的气温上升速度远快于平均水平,南部非洲在过去半个世纪见证了大约两倍于全球的变暖速度。
**锚点** 南部非洲约两倍全球升温速度
**定位** 非洲部分地区已经在以远高于平均的速度变暖：过去 50 年里，南部非洲的气温升幅约为全球升温速率的两倍。
**改写** southern Africa witnessing roughly twice the global warming rate ↔temperatures in southern Africa have increased by about twice the global rate roughly = about，witness 等价于 have increased by 的概括说法over the last half century ↔ over the past 50 years half century = 50 years Parts of Africa are getting warmer much faster than the average ↔Parts of the continent are already warming much more quickly than the average continent = Africa 上下位换名；getting warmer = warming
questions.quote: Parts of the continent are already warming much more quickly than the average: temperatures in southern Africa have increased by about twice the global rate over the past 50 years.

questions.prompt: Improved farming practices have enabled Kenyan farmers to increase farm produce remarkably.
questions.explanation:
**答案** G 段（弱锚点）
**题目译文**
改进的农业实践使肯尼亚农民能够显著增加农产品产量。
**锚点** 改良耕作法显著提高肯尼亚农产量
**定位** 肯尼亚的小咖啡农只要遵循几条简单的护树建议——比如把茎全部修剪到只剩三根——就能把收入提高 40%。
**改写** Improved farming practices ↔ a few simple guidelines on caring for their bushes上位词 farming practices 覆盖下位的 simple guidelines Kenyan farmers ↔ Small coffee farmers in Kenya Kenyan farmers 与 farmers in Kenya 等价increase farm produce remarkably ↔ increase their incomes by 40%40% 即 remarkably；produce 与 incomes 通过因果换皮
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
F F 段 Improved varieties of sorghum 与 from about 8 tonnes per hectare to 35 tonnes 讲的是高粱与马铃薯增产，不是肯尼亚咖啡农剪枝的故事，主体不同。Improved varieties of sorghum, for instance, can produce a crop that is 40% larger than the usual variety H H 段 link farms to big buyers of their harvests 走的是渠道型推广，不是题干Improved farming practices 的耕作做法改良。When Diageo, a British drinks giant, built a brewery in western Kenya
questions.quote: Small coffee farmers in Kenya are able to increase their incomes by 40% by following a few simple guidelines on caring for their bushes, such as trimming all but three of their stems.

questions.prompt: Africa is especially susceptible to the effects of global warming partly because it has difficulty feeding its increasing population even without climate change.
questions.explanation:
**答案** C 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
非洲特别容易受到全球变暖影响,部分原因是即使没有气候变化,它也难以养活不断增长的人口。
**锚点** 气候变化叠加人口增长的双重脆弱
**定位** 非洲格外脆弱，部分原因是它本就难以养活自己，而且即便没有气候变化，它也得大幅提高产量和生产率，才能喂饱一个快速增长的人口。
**改写** especially susceptible to the effects of global warming ↔ particularly vulnerable especially = particularly；susceptible = vulnerable has difficulty feeding its increasing population ↔ struggling to feed itself has difficulty doing = struggling to do；fast-growing 同义 increasing even without climate change ↔ even without climate change短语原样复现
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
B B 段 About 40% of the land now used to grow maize would no longer be suitable for it 给的是气候导致的种植带变化，而题干 has difficulty feeding its increasing population even without climate change 要的是「即使没气候变化也喂不饱」的人口端理由，方向不同。Even if the world were to cut emissions enough to keep global warming below 1.5℃, heat-waves would intensify in Africa
questions.quote: Africa is particularly vulnerable, in part because it is already struggling to feed itself and it will have to vastly increase yields and productivity if it is to put food on the plates of a fast- growing population, even without climate change.

questions.prompt: The use of fertiliser and improved seeds can help Africa's small farmers impressively increase crop yields.
questions.explanation:
**答案** F 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
化肥和改良种子的使用可以帮助非洲小农户大幅提高作物产量。
**锚点** 化肥与改良种子帮小农大幅增产
**定位** （重新重视农业的）重点很大程度上落在让小农使用化肥，以及更重要的——使用更好的种子上。
**改写** The use of fertiliser and improved seeds ↔getting small farmers to use fertiliser and, more important, better seeds fertiliser 原样 + improved seeds = better seeds can help Africa's small farmers impressively increase crop yields ↔The results can be impressive impressively 与 impressive 同根同义
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
G G 段 trimming all but three of their stems 走的是修剪指南，不是题干 The use of fertiliser and improved seeds 要的两类输入。by following a few simple guidelines on caring for their bushes, such as trimming all but three of their stems
questions.quote: Much of the focus has been on getting small farmers to use fertiliser and, more important, better seeds.

questions.prompt: It has proved even more important to shift from traditional farming to setting up businesses that can bring technology and investment to small farmers in Africa.
questions.explanation:
**答案** I 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
事实证明,从传统农业转向建立能够为非洲小农户带来技术和投资的企业更为重要。
**锚点** 从传统耕作转向科技+投资的商业模式
**定位** 一个更重要的变化是：从传统耕作转向建立那些能把技术与投资带给小农、且能赚钱的企业。
**改写** shift from traditional farming to setting up businesses ↔the move from traditional farming to building businesses shift = move；setting up = building bring technology and investment to small farmers ↔profitably bring technology and investment to small farmers除 profitably 外短语逐词一致It has proved even more important ↔ An even more important change「更重要」整体平移
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
J J 段 Illuminum's success shows how technology can help even small farms become more productive 是对 I 段案例的提炼，并不重新陈述「从传统耕作转向建立企业」这件事；题干 shift from traditional farming to setting up businesses 的源头是 I 段那句首提的转型断言。Illuminum's success shows how technology can help even small farms become more productive
questions.quote: An even more important change is the move from traditional farming to building businesses that can profitably bring technology and investment to small farmers.

questions.prompt: Everyone in the world will have to bear the consequences of climate change, especially Africans.
questions.explanation:
**答案** A 段（弱锚点）
**题目译文**
世界上每个人都将承受气候变化的后果,尤其是非洲人。
**锚点** 全人类共担、非洲尤其要承受气候后果
**定位** 气候变化是一个会影响地球上每个人的议题，但对非洲人来说，其后果将尤其苦涩。
**改写** Everyone in the world will have to bear the consequences of climate change ↔Climate change is an issue that will affect everyone on the planet everyone in the world = everyone on the planet；bear consequences = be affected especially Africans ↔ For Africans its consequences will be particularly bitter especially = particularly（程度副词同义）
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
B B 段 global warming represents one of the main threats to Africa's prosperity 是具体威胁论证，与题干 Everyone in the world will have to bear the consequences的「全体共担」总论调性不对位。global warming represents one of the main threats to Africa's prosperity
questions.quote: Climate change is an issue that will affect everyone on the planet. For Africans its consequences will be particularly bitter.

questions.prompt: Improvement in farm output per worker in Africa falls far short of that in Asia.
questions.explanation:
**答案** D 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
非洲每个工人的农业产出改善远远落后于亚洲。
**锚点** 非洲人均产出提升远落后于亚洲
**定位** 尽管过去 30 年里非洲的人均产出提升了一半以上，这仍远落后于亚洲的 2.5 倍提升。
**改写** Improvement in farm output per worker in Africa ↔output per worker has improved by more than half over the past 30 years in Africa动词句 → 名词化短语falls far short of that in Asia ↔ far behind the 2.5 times improvement in Asia fall far short of = far behind
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
E E 段 Farm productivity hasn't improved in many parts of Africa for 100 years 没有提到亚洲，与题干 falls far short of that in Asia 中作为对比标杆的亚洲缺失，不是源头段。Farm productivity hasn't improved in many parts of Africa for 100 years
questions.quote: And although output per worker has improved by more than half over the past 30 years in Africa, that is still far behind the 2.5 times improvement in Asia.

questions.prompt: In the long term, the potential for small farms in Africa to increase productivity is quite limited, especially owing to the warming climate and a growing population.
questions.explanation:
**答案** J 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
从长远来看,非洲小型农场提高生产力的潜力相当有限,特别是由于气候变暖和人口增长。
**锚点** 长期看小农增产潜力有限
**定位** 但从更长远看，小规模农业能走的也就这么远，尤其是面对气候变化和人口压力的时候。
**改写** In the long term, the potential for small farms in Africa to increase productivity is quite limited ↔over the longer run small-scale farming can go only so far long term = longer run；quite limited = can go only so far especially owing to the warming climate and a growing population ↔especially in the face of climate change and population pressure owing to = in the face of；warming climate ≈ climate change；growing population ≈population pressure
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
I I 段 Illuminum Greenhouses, has sold more than 1,400 greenhouses that provide livelihoods to about 6,000 people 给的是「小农通过科技获得收益」的正面案例，与题干 the potential for small farms in Africa to increase productivity is quite limited 的「潜力有限」断言方向相反，是 42 题的归属段而非本题。An even more important change is the move from traditional farming to building businesses that can profitably bring technology and investment to small farmers K K 段 Projects that give them an extra $2 a month from growing beans or maize aren't going to get them there 给的是收入门槛论证，没有「长期看 + 气候变化 +人口」这套与题干 especially owing to the warming climate and a growing population 完全对位的双因表述。Getting those big jumps will need better jobs in factories and cities
questions.quote: But over the longer run small-scale farming can go only so far, especially in the face of climate change and population pressure.

title: Spiders make their presence felt in late August…

sentences.text: Spiders make their presence felt in late August and through early autumn.

This is the mating season of some of the most common varieties, when male house spiders come out of hidden corners to look for females, and garden spiders reach adult size and spin their most dazzling webs.

passage.translation: 蜘蛛在八月下旬至初秋期间频繁出现。这是一些最常见品种的交配季节，此时雄性家蛛从隐蔽的角落爬出寻找雌性，而园蛛则长到成年体型并织出最令人眼花缭乱的蛛网。

sentences.text: Yet while the spider is a familiar fixture of nursery poems or songs and Halloween decorations, its relationship with humans is complicated.
Fear of spiders is common and has serious impacts on the lives of sufferers.
Its prevalence appears unrelated to any rational assessment of risk.
Spiders in the UK are almost all harmless.
Farmland species perform valuable ecosystem services, by preying on insects that are our competitors for crops.
But they are a constant source of human anxieties—with a cultural association with witches and wickedness dating back to the middle ages.

passage.translation: 然而，尽管蜘蛛是童谣或儿歌以及万圣节装饰中常见的固定形象,它与人类的关系却很复杂。对蜘蛛的恐惧很常见，并对患者的生活产生严重影响。这种恐惧的流行程度似乎与对风险的任何理性评估无关。英国的蜘蛛几乎都是无害的。农田物种通过捕食与我们争夺农作物的昆虫,发挥着宝贵的生态系统服务功能。但它们却是人类焦虑的持续来源——与女巫和邪恶的文化联系可以追溯到中世纪。

sentences.text: Does this perhaps explain, in part, the lack of data about how spiders are faring in our age of ecological crisis?
British butterflies are the most studied group of insects in the world, due to the long tradition of collecting and observing them.
But spider conservationists point out that it was only in the 1980s that the classification of house spiders was properly sorted out.
And while information about insect populations is gathered by experiments that measure the numbers hitting windscreens or traps, there have been few attempts to count spiders.

passage.translation: 这或许在一定程度上解释了为什么在我们这个生态危机时代，关于蜘蛛生存状况的数据如此缺乏？由于长期以来采集和观察的传统，英国蝴蝶是世界上研究最充分的昆虫类群。但蜘蛛保护者指出，直到20世纪80年代，家蛛的分类才得到妥善整理。而且，尽管通过测量撞击挡风玻璃或陷阱的数量来收集昆虫种群信息的实验很多，但很少有人尝试统计蜘蛛的数量。

sentences.text: The huge reductions in the numbers of flying insects can only mean a reduction in spiders' food supply.
A recent landmark study identified a 75% fall in insect populations between 1989 and 2016, with pesticide use thought to be to blame along with the destruction of wild areas for development.
This means the overall picture for spiders is worrying, as it is for most creatures.
But conservationists are most concerned about those varieties that are threatened due to habitat loss and fragmentation, which makes it impossible for them to migrate.

passage.translation: 飞行昆虫数量的大幅减少只能意味着蜘蛛食物供应的减少。最近一项具有里程碑意义的研究发现，1989年至2016年间昆虫种群数量下降了75%，人们认为杀虫剂的使用以及为开发而破坏野生区域是罪魁祸首。这意味着蜘蛛的总体状况令人担忧，大多数生物也是如此。但保护者最担心的是那些因栖息地丧失和破碎化而受到威胁的品种，这使它们无法迁徙。

sentences.text: Of around 650 spider species regularly recorded in the UK, the majority thrive in marshes and wasteland.
Conservation efforts, often led by determined individuals, have helped some species to recover by reintroducing them to new areas.

With rewilding now firmly on the environmental policy agenda, the hope is that in future, spiders will be enabled to migrate by themselves, adapting to climate change by moving along wildlife corridors.

passage.translation: 在英国定期记录到的约650种蜘蛛中，大多数在沼泽和荒地中繁衍生息。通常由坚定的个人主导的保护工作，通过将一些物种重新引入新地区，帮助它们恢复。随着rewilding（野化）现在已牢固地列入环境政策议程，人们希望未来蜘蛛能够自行迁徙，通过沿着野生动物廊道移动来适应气候变化。

sentences.text: It seems unlikely that spiders will ever attract the same level of human enthusiasm as bees, birds or butterflies, in spite of their unique status as nature's spinners.
But as they reveal themselves in all their splendour this autumn, it would be a good thing if more animal lovers recognised the ways in which spiders are simply terrific.

passage.translation: 尽管蜘蛛作为大自然的纺织者拥有独特地位，但它们似乎不太可能吸引与蜜蜂、鸟类或蝴蝶同等程度的人类热情。但当它们在这个秋天展现出全部的壮丽时，如果更多动物爱好者认识到蜘蛛在哪些方面确实了不起，那将是一件好事。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What do we learn about spiders in the UK since the middle ages?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
关于英国的蜘蛛,我们了解到自中世纪以来发生了什么?
A) 它们普遍被误解了。
B) 它们对农作物生长产生了不利影响。
C) 它们一直是厄运的持续提醒。
D) 它们在织网时让人感受到了它们的存在。
**判型** What do we learn about spiders in the UK since the middle ages? 用 What do we learn about 引出，问的是关于某对象的客观事实，没有 infer/imply/suggest 等推断信号
**拆句** 题干主句是 What do we learn about spiders in the UK since the middle ages，主干是What do we learn about X，X 是 spiders in the UK，后面 since the middle ages 是表时间起点的介词短语，整体平铺直叙、无陷阱。
**定位** 但它们一直是人类焦虑的来源——与女巫和邪恶的文化关联可追溯至中世纪。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确a cultural association with witches and wickedness ↔ generally misconceived its prevalence appears unrelated to any rational assessment of risk ↔ misconceived预判落在蜘蛛被文化误解上，A They have been generally misconceived 用misconceived 概括了原文女巫、邪恶等不实联想，与预判完全对应，是定位句的高度抽象同义替换。
B) 与原文相反B 选项 They have adversely impacted crop growth 称蜘蛛对农作物生长有不利影响，但原文 Farmland species perform valuable ecosystem services, by preying on insects that are our competitors for crops 明确说农田蜘蛛吃掉与人类争粮的昆虫，是有利的；B 把有利说成有害，与原文相反。
C) 偷换概念C 选项 They have been a constant reminder of bad luck 说蜘蛛是坏运气的提醒，但原文说的是与女巫、邪恶（witches and wickedness）的文化关联，witches/wickedness 是邪恶/巫术，不等于坏运气（bad luck）；二者是不同的文化概念，C 偷换了概念。
D) 答非所问D 选项 They have made their presence felt when spinning webs 取自首段 Spiders make their presence felt in late August and through early autumn，讲的是晚夏初秋的自然现象，与题干 since the middle ages 的时间范围毫无关系；属答非所问。
questions.quote: But they are a constant source of human anxieties—with a cultural association with witches and wickedness dating back to the middle ages.

options.text: They have been generally misconceived.
They have adversely impacted crop growth.
They have been a constant reminder of bad luck.
They have made their presence felt when spinning webs.

questions.prompt: What have spiders been associated with in the UK for centuries?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
在英国,蜘蛛几个世纪以来一直与什么相关联?
A) 伤害。
B) 邪恶。
C) 痛苦。
D) 攻击性。
**判型** What have spiders been associated with in the UK for centuries? 用 What 引出过去完成时的事实问句，问的是被关联的对象，没有任何推断信号
**拆句** 题干主干是 What have spiders been associated with，spiders 为主语，谓语为现在完成时被动 have been associated with，介词 with 后的宾语正是要回答的内容；in the UK 是地点状语，for centuries 是时间状语，结构清晰。
**定位** 但它们一直是人类焦虑的来源——与女巫和邪恶的文化关联可追溯至中世纪。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念A Harm 意为有形的伤害，对应原文应是 spiders 对人造成的实质损害；但原文Spiders in the UK are almost all harmless 明确说英国蜘蛛几乎都无害——蜘蛛被关联的是文化上的邪恶，而不是实际伤害；A 偷换概念。
B) ✓ 正确wickedness ↔ Evil witches ↔ Evil由预判 与巫术与邪恶相关联，选项 B Evil 把 witches 与 wickedness 两个并列宾语用一个上位词 Evil 同时归纳，是定位句的精准同义替换。
C) 张冠李戴C Suffering 指痛苦/折磨，原文 Fear of spiders is common and has serious impacts on the lives of sufferers 出现 sufferers 一词——但 sufferers 描述的是怕蜘蛛的人所承受的影响，而题干问蜘蛛被关联的对象，主体错位；C 张冠李戴。
D) 无中生有D Aggression 指攻击性，原文从未把蜘蛛与攻击性联系起来——焦虑、恐惧、邪恶都不等于攻击；这是文中没有的概念，属无中生有。
questions.quote: But they are a constant source of human anxieties—with a cultural association with witches and wickedness dating back to the middle ages.

options.text: Harm.
Evil.
Suffering.
Aggression.

questions.prompt: What partly accounts for the reduction in spiders' food supply?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
什么在一定程度上解释了蜘蛛食物供应的减少?
A) 收集昆虫的悠久传统。
B) 它们的竞争者快速繁殖。
C) 用于杀灭昆虫的化学物质。
D) 大量野生动物的灭绝。
**判型** What partly accounts for the reduction in spiders' food supply? 用 What accounts for 直接问原因，是典型的因果型细节题，不是推断
**拆句** 题干主干是 What partly accounts for X，partly 修饰 accounts for，X 为名词短语 the reduction in spiders' food supply，其中 spiders' 是所有格修饰 food supply；句子结构简单，重点是 partly 这一限定词。
**定位** 近期一项标志性研究发现，1989 到 2016 年间昆虫种群下降了 75%，元凶是杀虫剂使用以及为开发而破坏野生区域。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 答非所问A The long tradition of collecting insects 取自 British butterflies are the most studied group of insects in the world, due to the long tradition of collecting and observing them，那里讲的是蝴蝶被研究多的原因，与蜘蛛食物减少没有任何因果关系；A 答非所问。
B) 无中生有B Fast reproduction of their competitors 称蜘蛛竞争者快速繁殖导致食物减少；但原文 preying on insects that are our competitors for crops 说的是昆虫是人类的庄稼竞争者，主体是人类的庄稼竞争者，并非蜘蛛的竞争者；且原文从未提及 fast reproduction；属无中生有。
C) ✓ 正确pesticide use ↔ Chemicals used for killing insects thought to be to blame ↔ Chemicals used for killing insects由预判 杀虫剂，C Chemicals used for killing insects 是 pesticide 的标准释义，是定位句最直接的同义替换，无任何外加信息。
D) 过度推断D The extinction of a lot of wildlife 称大量野生动物灭绝；原文说的是 the destruction of wild areas for development——破坏野生区（栖息地），不是野生动物灭绝；二者范围与程度都不同，D 过度推断。
questions.quote: A recent landmark study identified a 75% fall in insect populations between 1989 and 2016, with pesticide use thought to be to blame along with the destruction of wild areas for development.

options.text: The long tradition of collecting insects.
Fast reproduction of their competitors.
Chemicals used for killing insects.
The extinction of a lot of wildlife

questions.prompt: What does the passage say is conservationists' biggest worry?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
文章说保护主义者最大的担忧是什么?
A) 由于沼泽和荒地的污染,多种蜘蛛受到威胁。
B) 由于失去自然栖息地,某些蜘蛛物种濒临灭绝。
C) 越来越多的蜘蛛正被致命的杀虫剂杀死。
D) 越来越多的蜘蛛物种被发现正在失去迁徙能力。
**判型** What does the passage say is conservationists' biggest worry? 用 What does the passage say 直接问文中陈述的事实/观点，是细节题
**拆句** 题干是嵌套疑问句：主干 What does the passage say is X，间接引语 the passage say (that) X is conservationists’ biggest worry 被改写成 What...is...的疑问形式；要回答的是What 所代的 X，即保护者最担心的事，结构稍复杂但无陷阱。
**定位** 但保护者最担忧的是那些因栖息地丧失与碎片化而受威胁的物种，这种碎片化使得它们无法迁徙。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有A A variety of spiders are threatened due to pollution of marshes and wasteland称蜘蛛因沼泽与荒地受污染而受威胁；但原文 the majority thrive in marshes and wasteland 说蜘蛛多在沼泽与荒地繁衍，从未提到污染；A 用了原文出现的 marshes and wasteland 字眼，但污染（pollution）是无中生有。
B) ✓ 正确those varieties ↔ Certain species of spiders are threatened ↔ are endangered habitat loss and fragmentation ↔ loss of their natural homes由预判 栖息地丧失威胁某些物种，B Certain species of spiders are endangered due to loss of their natural homes 与原文 those varieties、are threatened、habitat loss 三处词一一对应，是定位句的高度同义替换。
C) 答非所问C An increasing number of spiders are being killed by deadly pesticides 称越来越多蜘蛛被杀虫剂直接杀死；但原文 pesticide use thought to be to blame 说杀虫剂杀的是昆虫（飞虫）、进而影响蜘蛛食物，并非杀虫剂直接杀蜘蛛；C 答非所问，且与题干 biggest worry 不符。
D) 过度推断D More and more spider species are found losing their ability to migrate 称越来越多物种正失去迁徙能力；原文 habitat loss and fragmentation, which makes it impossible for them to migrate 说的是栖息地丧失与碎片化导致无法迁徙——无法迁徙是栖息地丧失的结果，而题干问的是最担忧的原因/对象；D 把结果当作主担忧，且加入了原文没有的 more and more（递增趋势），属过度推断。
questions.quote: But conservationists are most concerned about those varieties that are threatened due to habitat loss and fragmentation, which makes it impossible for them to migrate.

options.text: A variety of spiders are threatened due to pollution of marshes and wasteland.
Certain species of spiders are endangered due to loss of their natural homes.
An increasing number of spiders are being killed by deadly pesticides.
More and more spider species are found losing their ability to migrate.

questions.prompt: What wish does the author express close to the end of the passage?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者在文章接近结尾处表达了什么愿望?
A) 更多人会认识到蜘蛛在生态系统中的独特地位。
B) 人们对蜘蛛表现出比对蝴蝶更大的热情。
C) 会有足够的通道供蜘蛛沿着移动。
D) 会有更多人欣赏蜘蛛的壮丽。
**判型** What wish does the author express close to the end of the passage? 直接问作者在末尾表达的具体愿望，是局部细节题，不是整篇主旨/态度题
**拆句** 题干主干 What wish does the author express，倒装疑问句，主语 the author、谓语express、宾语 what wish；close to the end of the passage 是位置状语，限定答题范围在末段附近；句子无生词、无难句。
**定位** 但当它们在这个秋天展现出全部精彩时，如果有更多动物爱好者能认识到蜘蛛之妙，那真是一件好事。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念A More people would recognise spiders' unique status in the ecosystem 称作者希望更多人认识到蜘蛛在生态系统中的独特地位；但原文 in spite of their unique status as nature's spinners 说蜘蛛的独特地位是 纺织者，而非 生态系统中的地位；且 unique status 出现在 in spite of 让步状语里，不是作者愿望句的内容；A 偷换了概念。
B) 与原文相反B People would show greater enthusiasm for spiders than for butterflies 称作者希望人们对蜘蛛比对蝴蝶更热情；但原文 It seems unlikely that spiders will ever attract the same level of human enthusiasm as bees, birds or butterflies 是作者承认蜘蛛不太可能 像蜜蜂/鸟/蝴蝶那样受欢迎，这是事实判断而非作者愿望——B 把作者认为不可能的对照句反向当成愿望，与原文相反。
C) 答非所问C There would be sufficient corridors for spiders to move along 称作者希望有足够的廊道供蜘蛛通行；但 wildlife corridors 出现在 spiders will be enabled to migrate by themselves, adapting to climate change by moving along wildlife corridors，属于上一段保护政策的内容；题干已限定 close to the end of the passage，C 位置不对、答非所问。
D) ✓ 正确more animal lovers ↔ more people recognised the ways in which spiders are simply terrific↔appreciating spiders' splendour由预判 更多人能欣赏到蜘蛛的精彩，D There would be more people appreciating spiders' splendour 用 more people 概括 animal lovers，用 appreciating spiders’ splendour 概括 recognised the ways in which spiders are simply terrific——一一对应，是定位句的精准同义替换。
questions.quote: But as they reveal themselves in all their splendour this autumn, it would be a good thing if more animal lovers recognised the ways in which spiders are simply terrific.

options.text: More people would recognise spiders' unique status in the ecosystem.
People would show greater enthusiasm for spiders than for butterflies.
There would be sufficient corridors for spiders to move along.
There would be more people appreciating spiders' splendour.

title: Research is meant to benefit society by raising…

sentences.text: Research is meant to benefit society by raising public awareness and creating products and innovations that enhance development.
For research to serve its full purpose, the results must leave the confines of research laboratories and academic journals.

passage.translation: 研究旨在通过提高公众意识和创造促进发展的产品与创新来造福社会。为了让研究充分发挥其作用,研究结果必须走出研究实验室和学术期刊的限制。

sentences.text: Findings effectively communicated can go a long way to serve the interests of the public.
They can help address social injustices or improve treatments offered to patients.

passage.translation: 有效传播的研究发现可以在很大程度上服务于公众利益。它们可以帮助解决社会不公或改善为患者提供的治疗。

sentences.text: Many researchers seem to be content with sharing the results of their studies in academic journals or at conferences.
But few journals allow everybody to read the findings.
Even articles freely available are usually written in academic language incomprehensible to the average reader.

passage.translation: 许多研究人员似乎满足于在学术期刊或会议上分享其研究结果。但很少有期刊允许所有人阅读这些研究发现。即使是可以免费获取的文章通常也是用普通读者无法理解的学术语言撰写的。

sentences.text: For researchers in the tenure-track system, their main goal is winning tenure, which in part can be achieved by getting a number of papers published in prominent journals.
Pressures like this mean community-level outreach is not prioritised.

passage.translation: 对于终身教职制度中的研究人员来说,他们的主要目标是获得终身教职,而这在一定程度上可以通过在知名期刊上发表一定数量的论文来实现。这样的压力意味着社区层面的推广工作没有被优先考虑。

sentences.text: Many researchers lack the writing skills to describe their results to a general audience.
They may also worry about whether the public will understand their findings, or about findings being used to influence controversial policies.
These concerns cause some researchers to shy away from communicating their findings outside the academic community.

passage.translation: 许多研究人员缺乏向普通受众描述其研究结果的写作技能。他们可能还担心公众是否会理解他们的研究发现,或担心研究发现被用来影响有争议的政策。这些担忧导致一些研究人员回避在学术界之外传播其研究发现。

sentences.text: Propagating research findings beyond academic publications is particularly crucial for addressing certain social discrepancies.
It can help families, communities, healthcare providers, policymakers, government agencies and other stakeholders to understand and respond to crises that plague society.

passage.translation: 在学术出版物之外传播研究发现对于解决某些社会差异尤为关键。它可以帮助家庭、社区、医疗保健提供者、政策制定者、政府机构和其他利益相关者理解和应对困扰社会的危机。

sentences.text: The benefits of sharing findings flow both ways.
Engaging with other researchers and the public can lead to unexpected new connections and new ideas that could suggest fruitful new directions for research.

passage.translation: 分享研究发现的好处是双向的。与其他研究人员和公众互动可以带来意想不到的新联系和新想法,这些可能为研究提示富有成效的新方向。

sentences.text: To benefit both researchers and the communities, the need to find innovative, accessible ways to share the work cannot be overstated.

passage.translation: 为了使研究人员和社区双方受益,找到创新的、易于理解的方式来分享研究工作的必要性怎么强调都不为过。

sentences.text: Institutions and funding organisations should support more researchers to publish in open access journals so that the public doesn't have to pay to read them.
Institutions and researchers should invest in partnerships that expand capacity for sharing results more broadly.

passage.translation: 机构和资助组织应该支持更多研究人员在开放获取期刊上发表文章,这样公众就不必付费阅读它们。机构和研究人员应该投资于扩大更广泛分享研究结果能力的合作伙伴关系。

sentences.text: Furthermore, ethics committees should make it mandatory for researchers to share their results with the public.
Every research participant should opt in or out of receiving results, as part of the process of giving informed consent.

passage.translation: 此外,伦理委员会应该强制要求研究人员与公众分享其研究结果。每个研究参与者都应该选择接受或拒绝接收研究结果,作为知情同意过程的一部分。

sentences.text: There could be misunderstanding of the findings presented by the researcher because of technical terms.

But this can be resolved by researchers engaging the services of professional writers or communication officers to help with translating their study into more accessible language and share it widely with media outlets and the public.

passage.translation: 由于专业术语的原因,公众可能会误解研究人员提出的研究发现。但这可以通过研究人员聘请专业作家或传播官员来帮助将其研究转化为更易理解的语言,并通过媒体和公众广泛分享来解决。

sentences.text: Sharing results with the people who are most affected by them makes us better researchers and ensures that our work can be used to improve people's lives.
Institutions and collaborators must recognise the value of doing so.

passage.translation: 与受研究结果影响最大的人分享结果使我们成为更好的研究人员,并确保我们的工作可以用于改善人们的生活。机构和合作者必须认识到这样做的价值。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: How can research serve its full purpose according to the author?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
根据作者的观点,研究如何才能充分发挥其作用?
A) 研究人员意识到公众利益
B) 研究成果发表在知名期刊上
C) 研究人员创造促进社会发展的产品
D) 研究成果在学术圈之外得到恰当传播
**判型** How can research serve its full purpose according to the author? 问的是"通过什么方式"，要求从文中找到作者明示的条件句。
**拆句** 题干 How can research serve its full purpose according to the author? 是一个标准How 类疑问句：情态动词 can 提到主语 research 前，谓语 serve 带宾语 its full purpose；according to the author 是状语，只是限定信息来源，不影响理解。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 要让研究充分发挥其作用，研究结果必须走出实验室和学术期刊的范围。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有With researchers being aware of public interests 说"研究者要意识到公众利益"，原文从未谈论"研究者的觉察"这一前提，P1 强调的是"传播"而非"觉察"。
B) 与原文相反With its findings published in prominent journals 把"发表在顶级期刊上"当作答案，但 P1 恰恰指出"必须离开学术期刊"——发表在顶级期刊只是 P4 中讲到的研究者评职称的手段，与"研究发挥充分作用"相反。
C) 张冠李戴With researchers creating products that enhance social development 把 creating products and innovations that enhance development 这句"研究的目标之一"挪用来作为"研究发挥作用的方式"——这是研究的目的描述，不是 serve its full purpose 的条件。
D) ✓ 正确the results must leave the confines of research laboratories and academic journals ↔With its findings properly communicated beyond the academic circle选项 With its findings properly communicated beyond the academic circle 用同义替换还原了预判的"研究结果必须走出学术圈"，是定位句的标准转述。
questions.quote: For research to serve its full purpose, the results must leave the confines of research laboratories and academic journals.

options.text: With researchers being aware of public interests.
With its findings published in prominent journals.
With researchers creating products that enhance social development.
With its findings properly communicated beyond the academic circle.

questions.prompt: Why do ordinary readers find it difficult to access the results of researchers' studies?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
为什么普通读者难以获取研究人员的研究结果?
A) 他们无法理解报告这些结果时使用的学术语言
B) 他们对研究人员用来描述其发现的术语感到畏惧
C) 他们不参加可以免费获取这些结果的会议
D) 他们几乎没有机会找到发表这些研究成果的期刊
**判型** Why do ordinary readers find it difficult to access the results of researchers' studies?问具体原因，且原因点是"读不懂研究结果"这一具体行为，需回原文找直接陈述。
**拆句** 题干 Why do ordinary readers find it difficult to access the results of researchers' studies? 主干是 readers find it difficult to access，find sth difficult to do 是常见结构，it 是形式宾语，真正宾语是后面的不定式 to access...；the results of researchers' studies 是多重 of 修饰的名词短语。无难点。
**定位** 即便那些免费可读的文章，通常也是用普通读者无法理解的学术语言写成。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确academic language incomprehensible to the average reader ↔They cannot understand the academic language used for reporting these results选项 They cannot understand the academic language used for reporting these results 是定位句"X 对 Y 不可理解"到"Y 不能理解 X"的标准视角转换，与预判完全吻合。
B) 无中生有They feel intimidated by the jargon researchers use to describe their findings 中feel intimidated（感到畏惧）原文从未提及；jargon（行话）原文也未出现这个词。
C) 偷换概念They do not attend conferences where these results are freely available 把 freely available 从"免费可读"偷换为"会议上免费提供"；原文是说"少数期刊允许人人阅读，即便免费可读也用艰涩语言"，不是说在 conferences 上免费提供。
D) 答非所问They have few chances to locate the journals that publish these findings 说"普通读者找不到这些期刊"，但原文 But few journals allow everybody to read the findings 说的是"少数期刊允许所有人阅读"——即"读到"的问题，而非"找到"的问题；且题干问的是 difficult to access the results（读懂结果），不是 difficult to locate the journals（找到期刊）。
questions.quote: Even articles freely available are usually written in academic language incomprehensible to the average reader.

options.text: They cannot understand the academic language used for reporting these results.
They feel intimidated by the jargon researchers use to describe their findings.
They do not attend conferences where these results are freely available.
They have few chances to locate the journals that publish these findings.

questions.prompt: What is one of the reasons some researchers won't prioritise communicating their findings to the public?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
一些研究人员不会优先考虑向公众传播其研究成果的原因之一是什么?
A) 他们可以凭借发表的论文获得成功
B) 他们的首要考虑是获得终身教职
C) 他们的主要目标是在其领域获得认可
D) 他们必须努力接触社区
**判型** What is one of the reasons some researchers won't prioritise communicating their findings to the public? 直接问"原因之一"，要求从原文找明示因果句。
**拆句** 题干 What is one of the reasons some researchers won't prioritise communicating their findings to the public? 主干是 What is one of the reasons...；reasons 后的 some researchers won't prioritise... 是省略 that 的定语从句修饰 reasons；communicating 后的 their findings to the public 是 V-ing 短语的双宾语结构。结构略长但语义清晰。
**定位** 对处在终身教职轨制度中的研究者来说，他们的主要目标是获得终身教职，而获得终身教职部分可以通过在顶级期刊上发表若干论文实现。诸如此类的压力意味着面向社区层面的对外传播不被优先考虑。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 答非所问They can thrive on the papers published 说"他们靠发表的论文茁壮成长"——题干问的是"为什么不优先对外传播的原因"，A 描述的是"发文的结果/好处"，而非"不愿对外传播的原因"，且 thrive on 的积极语义与原文"压力"对应不上。
B) ✓ 正确their main goal is winning tenure ↔ Their top consideration is to win tenure选项 Their top consideration is to win tenure 是定位句 their main goal is winning tenure 几乎逐词的同义替换，且与预判"首要目标是 tenure"完全一致。
C) 无中生有Their main goal is gaining recognition in their field 把研究者目标改成"在领域内获得认可"——原文 their main goal is winning tenure 明确写的是 winning tenure（拿到终身教职），不是 recognition；这是把因果中段的"靠发文"过度泛化为"求认可"。
D) 与原文相反They have to struggle to reach out to the community 说"他们必须努力对外传播"，但原文 community-level outreach is not prioritised 是说"不优先做"——不是"努力做"，方向完全相反。
questions.quote: For researchers in the tenure-track system, their main goal is winning tenure, which in part can be achieved by getting a number of papers published in prominent journals. Pressures like this mean community-level outreach is not prioritised.

options.text: They can thrive on the papers published.
Their top consideration is to win tenure
Their main goal is gaining recognition in their field.
They have to struggle to reach out to the community.

questions.prompt: How can sharing findings benefit researchers themselves?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
分享研究成果如何使研究人员自身受益?
A) 帮助他们确定新的研究方向
B) 使他们能够理解困扰社会的危机
C) 使他们能够有效解决社会差异
D) 帮助他们与政府机构建立联系
**判型** How can sharing findings benefit researchers themselves? 问"如何受益"，需要在原文找具体受益机制的陈述。
**拆句** 题干 How can sharing findings benefit researchers themselves? 主干 sharing findings作主语（动名词短语），benefit 是及物动词，researchers themselves 是宾语+反身代词强调。themselves 是理解关键，标明"受益方是研究者自己"。
**定位** 与其他研究者及公众的互动可能催生意想不到的新联系和新想法，进而可能指明富有成果的新研究方向。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确could suggest fruitful new directions for research ↔By helping them to identify new research directions选项 By helping them to identify new research directions 是定位句 could suggest fruitful new directions for research 的同义改写，且 By Ving 结构正好回应题干 How。
B) 张冠李戴By enabling them to understand crises plaguing society 借用了 respond to crises that plague society 的措辞——但 P6 讲的是"分享有助于其他主体（家庭、社区、政策制定者等）理解危机"，受益者并非"研究者自身"；与题干 researchers themselves错位。
C) 张冠李戴By enabling them to effectively address social discrepancies 借用 addressing certain social discrepancies 的措辞——同样是 P6 讲对社会的好处，而非对研究者自身的好处；与题干 themselves 错位。
D) 无中生有By helping them to forge ties with government agencies 说"帮助他们与政府机构建立关系"——原文虽提过 government agencies（P6 列举受益方时），但从未把"与政府机构结盟"作为研究者自身的受益方式。
questions.quote: Engaging with other researchers and the public can lead to unexpected new connections and new ideas that could suggest fruitful new directions for research.

options.text: By helping them to identify new research directions.
By enabling them to understand crises plaguing society.
By enabling them to effectively address social discrepancies.
By helping them to forge ties with government agencies.

questions.prompt: Why are researchers advised to engage the services of professional writers or communication officers?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
为什么建议研究人员聘请专业作家或传播官员的服务?
A) 满足伦理委员会对研究人员的强制性要求
B) 将他们的研究翻译成海外读者可理解的语言
C) 使他们的出版物被公众正确理解
D) 使他们的研究成果被知名期刊接受
**判型** Why are researchers advised to engage the services of professional writers or communication officers? 问"为何建议聘请"，需要从原文找明示的目的或结果状语。
**拆句** 题干 Why are researchers advised to engage the services of professional writers or communication officers? 是被动语态：are advised to do（被建议做）；engage 在此为正式词义"聘请"；professional writers or communication officers 是并列名词词组。结构清晰，注意 engage 不是"参与"而是"聘用"。
**定位** 但这可以通过研究者聘请专业写手或传播官来解决，让他们帮助把研究"翻译"成更通俗易懂的语言，并广泛地向媒体和公众分享。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 张冠李戴To satisfy ethics committees' mandatory requirements of researchers 把 ethics committees should make it mandatory 这一伦理委员会的强制要求挪用来作为聘请写手的目的；但 P10 与 P11 是两个独立建议——伦理委员会强制研究者分享是一回事，聘请写手帮助翻译是另一回事，两者目的不同。
B) 偷换概念To translate their study into languages accessible to readers overseas 把 more accessible language 偷换为 languages accessible to readers overseas（让海外读者读懂）——原文从未提及 overseas / readers abroad 等概念，只说"通俗易懂"，不涉及外语翻译。
C) ✓ 正确to help with translating their study into more accessible language↔To make their publications correctly understood by the public There could be misunderstanding of the findings presented by the researcher because of technical terms.↔ correctly understood by the public选项 To make their publications correctly understood by the public 是 P11 整段问题（误解）与解决（翻译成通俗语言）的目的合成，与预判完全吻合。
D) 与原文相反To render their findings acceptable by prominent journals 说"让顶级期刊接受研究"——这是 P4 中谈到的另一动机（评 tenure 时投顶级期刊），且 P1 明确批判"留在期刊里就发挥不了作用"；聘请写手的目的恰恰是"走出期刊面向公众"，方向相反。
questions.quote: But this can be resolved by researchers engaging the services of professional writers or communication officers to help with translating their study into more accessible language and share it widely with media outlets and the public.

options.text: To satisfy ethics committees' mandatory requirements of researchers.
To translate their study into languages accessible to readers overseas.
To make their publications correctly understood by the public.
To render their findings acceptable by prominent journals.

title: Modern U.S. cities were designed to make exercise…

sentences.text: Modern U.S. cities were designed to make exercise unnecessary.
Cars and elevators once symbolized urban areas as machines for more efficient living.
Now it is clear that these improvements provide great benefits but also (26)____ health costs.
Recent studies show that urban (27)____ encourages more driving and is associated with heavier weight.
This (28)____ suggests that the layout and design of cities can hinder or promote healthier lifestyle choices and it is (29)____ that urban planners bear this in mind.

passage.translation: 现代美国城市的设计使锻炼变得不必要。汽车和电梯曾经象征着城市地区是更高效生活的机器。现在很明显，这些改进提供了巨大的好处，但也带来了健康代价。最近的研究表明，城市扩张鼓励了更多的驾车出行，并与体重增加相关。这种相关性表明，城市的布局和设计可以阻碍或促进更健康的生活方式选择，城市规划者必须牢记这一点。

sentences.text: Unfortunately, urban planning still centers in large part on solving the problems of the past.
Of course cities still need to (30)____ standard public health practices, such as separating toxic facilities from homes and restricting heavy truck traffic through (31)____ residential areas.
But it's also important to create healthier cities—and the discussion is already underway.
More and more city planners are paying increasing attention to encouraging physical activity by making it easier and safer for people to recreate, walk, bike and take public transportation.
Many studies of (32)____ show that people live the longest in environments where physical activity is part of everyday life.

passage.translation: 不幸的是，城市规划在很大程度上仍然集中于解决过去的问题。当然，城市仍然需要促进标准的公共卫生实践，例如将有毒设施与住宅分开，限制重型卡车交通穿越密集的住宅区。但创建更健康的城市也很重要——相关讨论已经在进行中。越来越多的城市规划者越来越关注通过让人们更容易、更安全地娱乐、步行、骑自行车和乘坐公共交通来鼓励体育活动。许多关于长寿的研究表明，人们在体育活动是日常生活一部分的环境中活得最长。

sentences.text: Providing more walkable spaces, better protected bike lanes and more (33)____ spaces are important steps.
But even smaller changes can be effective.

passage.translation: 提供更多适宜步行的空间、更好保护的自行车道和更多的休闲空间是重要的步骤。但即使是更小的改变也可以有效。

sentences.text: Cities can close off streets on weekends to encourage communities to get out and walk.
They also can provide more seating in public places, so that less-fit residents can rest during their journeys.

Using public spaces in cities as places where people can exercise promotes (34)____ , rather than allowing physical activity to become restricted to private gyms with often-expensive monthly fees that (35)____less wealthy people from joining.

passage.translation: 城市可以在周末封闭街道，以鼓励社区居民外出步行。它们还可以在公共场所提供更多座位，以便身体状况较差的居民在旅途中可以休息。将城市的公共空间用作人们可以锻炼的场所促进了公平，而不是让体育活动仅限于私人健身房，这些健身房通常收取昂贵的月费，阻碍了较不富裕的人加入。

groups.instructions: In this section, there is a passage with ten blanks. You are required to select one word for each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage. Read the passage through carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not use any of the words in the bank more than once.
groups.content:
Modern U.S. cities were designed to make exercise unnecessary. Cars and elevators once symbolized urban areas as machines for more efficient living. Now it is clear that these improvements provide great benefits but also {{26}} health costs. Recent studies show that urban {{27}} encourages more driving and is associated with heavier weight. This {{28}} suggests that the layout and design of cities can hinder or promote healthier lifestyle choices and it is {{29}} that urban planners bear this in mind.

Unfortunately, urban planning still centers in large part on solving the problems of the past. Of course cities still need to {{30}} standard public health practices, such as separating toxic facilities from homes and restricting heavy truck traffic through {{31}} residential areas. But it's also important to create healthier cities—and the discussion is already underway. More and more city planners are paying increasing attention to encouraging physical activity by making it easier and safer for people to recreate, walk, bike and take public transportation. Many studies of {{32}} show that people live the longest in environments where physical activity is part of everyday life.

Providing more walkable spaces, better protected bike lanes and more {{33}} spaces are important steps. But even smaller changes can be effective.

Cities can close off streets on weekends to encourage communities to get out and walk. They also can provide more seating in public places, so that less-fit residents can rest during their journeys. Using public spaces in cities as places where people can exercise promotes {{34}} , rather than allowing physical activity to become restricted to private gyms with often-expensive monthly fees that {{35}}less wealthy people from joining.

options.text: correlation
longevity
dense
navigate
deter
recreational
equity
rotten
foster
sprawl
imperative
vibrate
impose
vicinity
irrespective

questions.explanation:
**答案** G) impose 动词
**词性槽** also 后并列谓语缺动词
**依据** impose costs 是固定地道搭配impose costs/burden/restrictions on… 是英语里高频搭配，表"强加、招致（成本/负担）"。本句用 but also 把"带来好处"与"招致健康代价"形成转折并列：provide great benefits but also __(26)__ health costs，impose 在 cost 前正是最自然的动词。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
J) navigate "导航健康代价"搭配不成立navigate 不与 costs 搭配；意义上也无法表达"招致"。
N) vibrate 义为"振动"，与抽象 health costs 不搭vibrate 是物理动词，与抽象代价宾语无法搭配。

questions.explanation:
**答案** M) sprawl 名词
**词性槽** 形容词 urban 后需名词作主语
**依据** urban sprawl 是地道术语，对应"城市蔓延招致开车多+肥胖" urban sprawl（城市无序扩张）是城市规划/健康研究里高度固定的术语，指城市低密度向外摊大饼。摊得越大，居民越依赖开车、越少步行，自然 encourages more driving and is associated with heavier weight——因果链严丝合缝。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
A) correlation下一题 28 才需要 correlation correlation 多表"相关性"，更适合下句 This __(28)__ suggests that… 指代"上一句揭示的相关性"，留给 28 题更恰当；而且 urban correlation 也不是常见说法。
D) equity "城市公平鼓励开车"逻辑荒诞equity 本意"公平"，与"鼓励更多开车、体重更重"的负面后果在逻辑上矛盾。34 题的 promote___ 才是它的归宿。
I) longevity"城市寿命鼓励开车"语义不通longevity "长寿" 与 "鼓励开车、体重增加" 的负面因果对不上；32 题的 studies of ___ 才与它匹配。
O) vicinity"城市附近鼓励开车"指代不清vicinity 指"附近地区"，多用于 in the vicinity of 短语，单独作 "urban + vicinity" 搭配不成立，也无法解释"鼓励开车"。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 O) —— vicinity 看着也能配 urban。urban + 名词的位置最容易被vicinity 干扰——"城市的附近地区"似通非通。但比对学科术语 urban sprawl 才是城市规划的固定说法，且后文"鼓励开车/体重增加"只能由"无序扩张"解释。防坑句：拿不准就回看后续 encourages more driving 因果链是否成立。

questions.explanation:
**答案** A) correlation 名词
**词性槽** 指示词 This 后需单数名词
**依据** 回指上句"扩张→开车多→更胖"的相关性上一句 Recent studies show that urban __(27)__ encourages more driving and is associated with heavier weight. 描述的就是"城市蔓延"与"体重"之间的关联——is associated with 的标准说法正是 correlation。本句用 This correlation 回指，紧扣"相关性"语义。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
D) equity "这种公平"无回指对象上句没有讨论"公平"，equity 在此找不到回指意义；语段焦点是"扩张和体重的关联"。
I) longevity 上句谈"体重增加"不谈"寿命" longevity "长寿" 与上句"鼓励开车、体重增加"语义对不上号。
O) vicinity vicinity 表地点，不指代研究结论This vicinity 只能指"这一带"，无法回指上句揭示的关系。

questions.explanation:
**答案** F) imperative 形容词
**词性槽** it is ___ that 句型中需形容词作表语
**依据** "城市规划者必须铭记这一点至关重要" imperative "至关重要的、势在必行的" 恰好是 it is imperative that 的高频搭配，并且that 从句里 bear this in mind 用了 bear（虚拟语气的原形动词），正与 imperative 引导的虚拟语气句型对得上。语义上承接上文 Recent studies show that urban __(27)__encourages more driving and is associated with heavier weight.，把"城市规划要顾及健康"提到一个必须做的高度。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
H) irrespective 不用于 it is ___ that 句型irrespective 只能搭配 of，不进入 "it is + adj. + that" 句型，结构上排除。
L) rotten 色彩与作者立场相反作者整段在呼吁城市规划者重视健康，是正面倡导；代入 it is rotten that…（"这件事真糟糕"）情感色彩完全相反。

questions.explanation:
**答案** E) foster 动词
**词性槽** 情态动词 need to 后需动词原形
**依据** "推行/促进标准公共卫生做法" foster 表"促进、推行、培育"，与 standard public health practices 搭配恰好表达"城市仍需推行/促进标准公共卫生做法"。本句承接 urban planning still centers in large part on solving the problems of the past，foster 体现"继续保留并落实传统做法"的正面动作。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
C) deter "阻止公共卫生做法"与全文立场相反deter 表"阻止"，城市不可能去"阻止"公共卫生措施；它的归宿在 35 题的"deter…from joining"句式里。
G) impose impose 强调"强加"，色彩偏重 + 留给 26 题用impose 多与 burden/cost/tax/restriction 搭配，强调强行加诸；与 standard public health practices 的正面语义不搭。26 题的 impose health costs（招致健康代价）是它的真正归宿。
J) navigate "导航公共卫生做法"搭配不通navigate 指"穿行、操纵"，常配 navigate the system/streets，不与 practices 直接搭配表示"推行"。
N) vibrate 义为"振动"，与公共卫生主题南辕北辙vibrate 是物理动作，与抽象的 practices 完全无法搭配。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 G) —— impose 也能后接抽象宾语。动词空填 impose 看似可行（"施加公共卫生做法"似乎也通），但 impose 色彩偏"强加、施压"，与 standard public health practices 的正面/中性语义不合；况且 26 题的 impose health costs 才是 impose真正的归宿。防坑句：动词色彩要与宾语色彩一致。

questions.explanation:
**答案** B) dense 形容词
**词性槽** 名词 areas 前需形容词作定语
**依据** "限制重型卡车穿越人口稠密的居民区"语义最顺句子讲的是公共健康措施——把有害设施与住宅隔开、限制重卡穿行居民区。能让"限制重卡"具有现实意义的形容词，最自然的就是"人口稠密的"：人越密，重卡穿行的健康风险越大。代入后 restricting heavy truck traffic through __(31)__ residential areas 读作dense residential areas，搭配地道、语义贴。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
F) imperative 义为"至关重要的"，与 residential areas 语义不搭imperative 通常修饰任务、需求（it is imperative that…），不用来形容"居民区"的物理属性；而且后面 29 题正需要 it is imperative that… 的句式，留给那里更合适。
H) irrespective 几乎只用作 irrespective of 短语，做后置状语irrespective 几乎不放在名词前作前置定语，本句也没有 of 引出的比较对象，结构上就用不了。
K) recreational "娱乐的居民区"语义不通recreational 通常修饰 spaces、activities、facilities；与 residential 一起说"娱乐的居民区"逻辑奇怪。况且 33 题的 more __(33)__ spaces 正等着 recreational。
L) rotten 色彩太负面，超出此处中性描述rotten 强调"腐败""糟糕透顶"，色彩极重；文章只是中性地讲"哪些居民区要保护"，没有要把这些社区贬为"破败"之意。

questions.explanation:
**答案** I) longevity 名词
**词性槽** 介词 of 后需名词作宾语
**依据** "长寿研究"与 live the longest 完美呼应that 从句 people live the longest in environments where physical activity is part of everyday life 中 live the longest 直接对应 longevity（长寿）。"长寿研究"自然得出"在日常活动的环境里活得最久"。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
D) equity "公平研究"与活得最久无关equity 与 live the longest 没有语义指向；equity 留给 34 题正合适。
O) vicinity "附近地区研究"语义空泛studies of vicinity 不是常见搭配，也不指向"寿命/活得久"这个研究结论。

questions.explanation:
**答案** K) recreational 形容词
**词性槽** 形容词 more 与名词 spaces 之间需形容词
**依据** "更多娱乐空间"呼应"鼓励市民活动"第三段在讲"提供促进活动的城市要素"，与 walkable spaces（步行空间）、protected bike lanes（受保护的自行车道）并列的第三项理应是同一逻辑的活动空间。recreational spaces "娱乐/休闲空间" 正好契合：让人有地方运动、玩耍，呼应 encouraging physical activity by making it easier and safer for people to recreate, walk, bike and take public transportation 里的 recreate。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
F) imperative 义"必要的"，不用来描述空间属性imperative spaces 不是英语里的常见搭配，且把"空间"说成"势在必行的"语义不通。
H) irrespective 几乎只用于 irrespective of 短语不能作前置定语，结构上排除。
L) rotten 贬义"破败"，与正面措施清单矛盾本段在列"重要的良性改造"，提供"破败空间"显然不是 important steps。

questions.explanation:
**答案** D) equity 名词
**词性槽** 动词 promotes 后需名词作宾语
**依据** "促进公平"恰是与昂贵私人健身房对立面rather than 后的反面情境是 private gyms with often-expensive monthly fees that__(35)__ less wealthy people from joining——昂贵会员费把低收入者排除在外，本质是"不公平"。promotes equity "促进公平"正是它的反面，并紧扣公共空间面向所有人这一公共健康主旨。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
O) vicinity "促进附近地区"语义混乱vicinity 表"附近"，promotes vicinity 不成搭配，也无法对应 rather than 后"将穷人挡在门外"的不公平反面。

questions.explanation:
**答案** C) deter 动词
**词性槽** that 引导的定语从句缺谓语
**依据** deter sb. from doing 是固定搭配deter "使打消念头/阻止"，固定搭配 deter sb. from doing sth.。代入恰好表达"昂贵会员费让低收入者打消加入健身房的念头"，与 34 题的 equity 形成正反对照，把"私人健身房不公平"这层意思讲透。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
G) impose impose 不跟 sb. from doing 结构impose sth. on sb. 是其正确搭配，不能说 impose sb. from doing。26 题才是它的归宿。
J) navigate navigate 不带 from doing 结构navigate 是"穿行、操纵"，与"阻止某人做某事"语义和结构都不匹配。
N) vibrate 义为"振动"，与抽象的"阻止加入"无关vibrate 是物理动词，无法承接 sb. from doing。

title: Psychologists have long been in disagreement as to…

sentences.text: Psychologists have long been in disagreement as to whether competition is a learned or a genetic component of human behavior.
Whatever it is, you cannot but recognize the effect competition is exerting in academics and many other areas of contemporary life.

passage.translation: 心理学家长期以来对竞争究竟是人类行为中的习得成分还是遗传成分存在分歧。无论它是什么,你不能不认识到竞争正在学术界和当代生活的许多其他领域产生的影响。

sentences.text: Psychologically speaking, competition has been seen as an inevitable consequence of human drives.
According to Sigmund Freud, humans are born screaming for attention and full of organic drives for fulfillment in various areas.
Initially, we compete for the attention of our parents.
Thereafter, we are at the mercy of a battle between our base impulses for self-fulfillment and social and cultural norms which prohibit pure indulgence.

passage.translation: 从心理学角度来说,竞争被视为人类驱动力的必然结果。根据西格蒙德·弗洛伊德的观点,人类生来就尖声呼喊以获得关注,并充满了在各个领域寻求满足的本能驱动力。最初,我们为获得父母的关注而竞争。此后,我们受制于自我满足的基本冲动与禁止纯粹放纵的社会和文化规范之间的斗争。

sentences.text: Current work in anthropology(人类学) has suggested, however, that this view of the role of competition in human behavior may be incorrect.

Thomas Hobbes, one of the great philosophers of the seventeenth century, is perhaps best remembered for his characterization of the "natural world," that is, the world before the imposition of the will of humanity, as being "nasty, brutish, and short."
This image of the pre-rational world is still widely held, reinforced by Charles Darwin's highly influential work, The Origin of Species, which established the doctrine of natural selection.

This doctrine, which takes for granted that those species best able to adapt to and master the natural environment in which they live will survive, has suggested that the struggle for survival is an inherent human trait which determines a person's success.
Darwin's theory has even been summarized as "survival of the fittest"—a phrase Darwin himself never used—further highlighting competition's role in success.
As it has often been pointed out, however, there is nothing in the concept of natural selection that suggests that competition is the most successful strategy for "survival of the fittest."
Darwin asserted in The Origin of Species that the struggles he was describing should be viewed as metaphors and could easily include dependence and cooperation.

passage.translation: 然而,当前人类学领域的研究表明,这种关于竞争在人类行为中作用的观点可能是不正确的。托马斯·霍布斯,十七世纪伟大的哲学家之一,最为人铭记的或许是他对"自然世界",即在人类意志施加之前的世界的描述,认为它是"肮脏、野蛮和短暂的"。这种对前理性世界的描绘仍然被广泛持有,并因查尔斯·达尔文极具影响力的著作《物种起源》而得到强化,该书确立了自然选择学说。这一学说理所当然地认为那些最能适应并掌控其生存的自然环境的物种将会存活下来,这表明生存斗争是决定一个人成功的固有人类特征。达尔文的理论甚至被概括为"适者生存"——这是达尔文本人从未使用过的一个短语——进一步强调了竞争在成功中的作用。然而,正如人们经常指出的那样,自然选择的概念中并没有任何内容表明竞争是"适者生存"最成功的策略。达尔文在《物种起源》中断言,他所描述的斗争应被视为隐喻,并可以很容易地包括依赖和合作。

sentences.text: Many studies have been conducted to test the importance placed on competition as opposed to other values, such as cooperation—by various cultures, and generally conclude that Americans uniquely praise competition as natural, inevitable, and desirable.

In 1937, the world-renowned anthropologist Margaret Mead published Cooperation and Competition among Primitive Peoples, based on her studies of several societies that did not prize competition, and, in fact, seemed at times to place a negative value on it.
One such society was the Zuni Indians of Arizona, and they, Mead found, valued cooperation far more than competition.

After studying dozens of such cultures, Mead's final conclusion was that competitiveness is a culturally created aspect of human behavior, and that its prevalence in a particular society is relative to how that society values it.

passage.translation: 许多研究已经进行,以测试不同文化对竞争相对于其他价值观(如合作)的重视程度,并普遍得出结论认为美国人独特地将竞争赞颂为自然的、不可避免的和值得追求的。1937年,世界著名人类学家玛格丽特·米德发表了《原始民族的合作与竞争》,该书基于她对几个不重视竞争的社会的研究,事实上,这些社会有时似乎对竞争持负面评价。其中一个这样的社会是亚利桑那州的祖尼印第安人,米德发现,他们对合作的重视远远超过竞争。在研究了数十个这样的文化之后,米德的最终结论是,竞争性是人类行为中由文化创造的一个方面,它在特定社会中的普遍程度取决于该社会对它的重视程度。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What does the author think is easy to see in many areas of contemporary life?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者认为在当代生活的许多领域中什么是容易看到的?
A) 对竞争不可避免性的分歧。
B) 心理学研究的后果。
C) 人类驱动力的影响。
D) 竞争的影响。
**判型** 题干What does the author think is easy to see in many areas of contemporary life?问的是作者在"当代生活的许多领域"中明确认为容易见到的东西，属于对原文某一具体表述的复述题，没有 infer/imply/mainly about 等推断或主旨信号。
**拆句** Q51主干是 What ... is easy to see；the author think 是插入的宾语从句性插入语，问的实际是 What is easy to see；in many areas of contemporary life 是地点状语，限定范围。句式平铺，无陷阱。
**定位** 不管竞争是什么（天生还是习得），你都不得不承认竞争正在学术界以及当代生活的许多其他领域中所产生的影响。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念The disagreement on the inevitability of competition.借的是Psychologists have long been in disagreement as to whether competition is a learned or a genetic component of human behavior这一句，但原文说"心理学家一直有分歧"，而题干问的是"你不得不看到"的东西，把分歧与显而易见混为一谈；而且原文的分歧点是 learned or genetic（天生还是习得），不是 inevitability（必然性），偷换了概念。
B) 无中生有The consequence of psychological investigation.中 psychological investigation 在P1里找不到对应——第 1 段只提到 psychologists in disagreement，没有提任何investigation 的 consequence；且 consequence（后果）也不是原文 effect 的对应词。属凭空捏造。
C) 张冠李戴The effect of human drives.借了human drives这个词，但 human drives 出现在第 2段心理学内部解释里，是"竞争"的原因之一；题干问的是"在当代生活各领域中容易见到的东西"，对应第 1 段尾句，而非第 2 段。属张冠李戴。
D) ✓ 正确the effect competition is exerting in academics and many other areas of contemporary life↔The impact of competition.预判落在"竞争在当代生活中产生的影响"上，The impact of competition.就是它的最简同义改写，词义、对象、范围都对得上。
questions.quote: Whatever it is, you cannot but recognize the effect competition is exerting in academics and many other areas of contemporary life.

options.text: The disagreement on the inevitability of competition.
The consequence of psychological investigation.
The effect of human drives.
The impact of competition.

questions.prompt: According to psychology, what do people strive to do following the initial stage of their life?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
根据心理学,人们在生命的初始阶段之后努力做什么?
A) 满足个人需求而不招致人类驱动力的不良影响。
B) 沉溺于文化追求的同时抑制其基本冲动。
C) 获得广泛认可而不暴露纯粹的放纵。
D) 在遵守社会习俗的同时满足自己的欲望。
**判型** 题干According to psychology, what do people strive to do following the initial stage of their life?问"心理学认为人在初始阶段之后努力做什么"，要的是具体行为描述，属于细节题。
**拆句** Q52主干是 what do people strive to do；According to psychology 是来源状语；following the initial stage of their life 是介词短语作时间状语。strive to do = 努力去做，注意题干问的是"努力的内容"而不是"努力的结果"。
**定位** 在那之后，我们便受制于一场拉锯战——一边是我们自我满足的本能冲动，另一边是禁止纯粹放纵的社会与文化规范。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反Fulfill individual needs without incurring adverse effects of human drives.把原文中的两个对立面（本能冲动 vs 社会规范）改写成"满足需求且不引发本能冲动的负面效应"——但原文里 human drives 本身是积极的追求自我满足的力量，不是"会带来负面后果的东西"；且原文中真正的对立面是 social/cultural norms，与 human drives 无关。属与原文相反兼偷换概念。
B) 与原文相反Indulge in cultural pursuits while keeping their base impulses at bay.中"沉湎于文化追求、压制本能冲动"完全把原文反过来——原文说的是文化规范禁止放纵、人的本能冲动想要放纵；选项却说人沉湎在文化里、压制本能。属与原文相反。
C) 张冠李戴Gain extensive recognition without exposing pure indulgence.把"获得广泛认可"放在答案核心——但 recognition 对应的是we compete for the attention of our parents的初始阶段，是题干所问"之后"的前一阶段，时段错位；且 extensive（广泛）也是对 attention of our parents 的过度扩大。属张冠李戴。
D) ✓ 正确base impulses for self-fulfillment↔ Satisfy their own desires social and cultural norms which prohibit pure indulgence ↔while observing social conventions预判要求同时包含"追求自我欲望"和"受社会规范约束"两端，且两端关系是同时进行的"边追求边受约束"；Satisfy their own desires while observing social conventions.的 while 把两端缝在一起，与原文 a battle between ... and ... 等值。
questions.quote: Thereafter, we are at the mercy of a battle between our base impulses for self-fulfillment and social and cultural norms which prohibit pure indulgence.

options.text: Fulfill individual needs without incurring adverse effects of human drives.
Indulge in cultural pursuits while keeping their base impulses at bay.
Gain extensive recognition without exposing pure indulgence.
Satisfy their own desires while observing social conventions.

questions.prompt: What do we learn about the "natural world" characterized by Thomas Hobbes?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
关于Thomas Hobbes所描述的"自然世界",我们了解到什么?
A) 它被哲学家和人类学家错误地呈现。
B) 它在Darwin的《物种起源》中被扭曲。
C) 它不受人类理性干预的影响。
D) 它是当今很少被欣赏的前理性世界。
**判型** 题干What do we learn about the "natural world" characterized by Thomas Hobbes?问"我们从原文中了解到 Hobbes 所刻画的自然世界是什么"，要的是对术语含义的复述，属于细节题。
**拆句** Q53主干是 What do we learn about the "natural world"；characterized by Thomas Hobbes 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 natural world，含义="由 Hobbes 所刻画的"。这里要扣的是 Hobbes 给 natural world 下的定义，不是后人的评价。
**定位** Thomas Hobbes 这位 17 世纪的大哲学家，最为人记得的或许是他对"自然世界"——也就是人类意志介入之前的世界——的刻画："令人厌恶、野蛮且短暂"。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有It gets misrepresented by philosophers and anthropologists.说自然世界被哲学家和人类学家"歪曲表述"——但原文只说 Hobbes 这一形象"被达尔文的工作强化"（reinforced by Charles Darwin's highly influential work），后来又说当代人类学研究"质疑了这一观点"（questioned），并没有说 Hobbes 关于 natural world 的描述被哲学家和人类学家共同歪曲。属无中生有。
B) 与原文相反It gets distorted in Darwin's The Origin of Species.说自然世界在达尔文的书里被歪曲——但原文是This image of the pre-rational world is still widely held, reinforced by Charles Darwin's highly influential work，达尔文是"加强"而非"歪曲"，方向相反。属与原文相反。
C) ✓ 正确the world before the imposition of the will of humanity ↔It is free from the rational intervention of humans.预判要求答案体现"无人类理性介入"这一特征；It is free from the rational intervention of humans.正是同位语的直接同义改写——free from 完美匹配 before（按时间顺序的不及）。
D) 与原文相反It is the pre-rational world rarely appreciated nowadays.说 pre-rational world"当今很少受到欣赏"——但原文紧接着说This image of the pre-rational world is still widely held，明确说这一形象"仍被广泛持有"，与选项的 rarely 完全对立。属与原文相反。
questions.quote: Thomas Hobbes, one of the great philosophers of the seventeenth century, is perhaps best remembered for his characterization of the "natural world," that is, the world before the imposition of the will of humanity, as being "nasty, brutish, and short."

options.text: It gets misrepresented by philosophers and anthropologists.
It gets distorted in Darwin's The Origin of Species.
It is free from the rational intervention of humans.
It is the pre-rational world rarely appreciated nowadays.

questions.prompt: What can we conclude from Darwin's assertion in The Origin of Species?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （推断题）
**题目译文**
从Darwin在《物种起源》中的论断我们可以得出什么结论?
A) 所有物种本质上都依赖其他物种生存。
B) 生存斗争并不排斥相互支持。
C) 作为生存策略,竞争与合作同等重要。
D) 最强的物种被证明是自然选择中最适合的。
**判型** 题干What can we conclude from Darwin's assertion in The Origin of Species?用conclude from 引导，要求从达尔文的断言中得出结论，属于"一步推断题"。
**拆句** Q54主干是 What can we conclude from Darwin's assertion；in The Origin of Species是地点状语限定该断言出自哪本书。conclude from 重在"从断言本身推出"，所以答案必须紧贴 Darwin 那句原话，不能拿别的句子做依据。
**定位** 达尔文在《物种起源》中断言：他所描述的那些斗争应当被视为隐喻，完全可以涵盖依赖与合作。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 过度推断All species inherently depend on others for survival.中 All species（所有物种）+inherently（天生地）是绝对化用语；原文只是说"斗争可以包含依赖与合作"，并未推出"所有物种都天生依赖他者才能生存"。属过度推断。
B) ✓ 正确the struggles he was describing should be viewed as metaphors and could easily include dependence and cooperation↔ Struggles for survival do not exclude mutual support.预判说斗争不排斥互助；Struggles for survival do not exclude mutual support.中do not exclude 与原文 could include 等值，mutual support 概括 dependence and cooperation，逻辑等值、范围一致。
C) 过度推断Competition weighs as much as cooperation as a survival strategy.中"竞争与合作作为生存策略权重相当"，把两者并列等值——但原文只说斗争"可以包含"合作，并未在"权重相当"的层面比较两者；权重比较是凭空引入。属过度推断。
D) 偷换概念The strongest species proves to be the fittest in natural selection.说"最强的物种被证明是最适合的"——但原文的关键点是"survival of the fittest 这个短语达尔文自己从未使用"，且本句要的是"Darwin's assertion"（达尔文的断言），不是社会上对"适者生存"的概括；况且 fittest 也不等于 strongest，原文专门指出自然选择并不暗示竞争才是最优策略。属偷换概念。
questions.quote: Darwin asserted in The Origin of Species that the struggles he was describing should be viewed as metaphors and could easily include dependence and cooperation.

options.text: All species inherently depend on others for survival.
Struggles for survival do not exclude mutual support.
Competition weighs as much as cooperation as a survival strategy.
The strongest species proves to be the fittest in natural selection.

questions.prompt: What conclusion did Margaret Mead reach after studying dozens of different cultures?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
Margaret Mead在研究了数十种不同文化后得出了什么结论?
A) 具有竞争性是人类的特征。
B) 美国人独特地反对合作。
C) 竞争在西方社会中相对更为普遍。
D) 人们对竞争的态度实际上受文化束缚。
**判型** 题干What conclusion did Margaret Mead reach after studying dozens of different cultures?问"Mead 得出了什么结论"，是对原文最后一句明文表达的结论的复述，属于细节题。
**拆句** Q55主干是 What conclusion did Margaret Mead reach；after studying dozens of different cultures 是时间状语。注意问的是"Mead 的结论"，所以答案必须是 Mead's final conclusion 那一句的同义改写，而不是 Mead 研究过程的具体发现（那是中间结论，不是 final conclusion）。
**定位** 在研究了数十个这样的文化之后，Mead 的最终结论是：竞争性是人类行为中由文化塑造出的一面；它在某个具体社会中的普遍程度，取决于该社会对它的评价。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反It is characteristic of humans to be competitive.说"竞争是人类的天性"——但这正是Mead 想要驳斥的观点，Mead 的结论恰恰相反：竞争性不是天生的，而是文化塑造的。属与原文相反。
B) 偷换概念Americans are uniquely opposed to cooperation.说美国人"独一无二地反对合作"——但原文是Americans uniquely praise competition as natural, inevitable, and desirable，说美国人独一无二地"赞美竞争"，并未说他们反对合作；"赞美 X"与"反对Y"不可直接对调。属偷换概念。
C) 过度推断Competition is relatively more prevalent in Western societies.说"竞争在西方社会中相对更普遍"——但 Mead 的最终结论是"竞争普遍程度取决于社会评价"，并未把社会分成"西方/非西方"两类、也未声称"竞争在西方更普遍"是普遍规律。属过度推断兼以偏概全。
D) ✓ 正确competitiveness is a culturally created aspect of human behavior↔People's attitude towards competition is actually culture-bound. its prevalence in a particular society is relative to how that society values it↔actually culture-bound预判要求答案体现"竞争性受文化决定"；People's attitude towards competition is actually culture-bound.中 culture-bound 直接等值于 culturally created，是 Mead结论的最简同义改写。
questions.quote: After studying dozens of such cultures, Mead's final conclusion was that competitiveness is a culturally created aspect of human behavior, and that its prevalence in a particular society is relative to how that society values it.

options.text: It is characteristic of humans to be competitive.
Americans are uniquely opposed to cooperation.
Competition is relatively more prevalent in Western societies.
People's attitude towards competition is actually culture-bound.

title: Could you get by without using the internet…

sentences.text: Could you get by without using the internet for four and a half years?
That's exactly what singer and actress Selena Gomez has done in a bid to improve her mental health.

passage.translation: 你能在不使用互联网的情况下生活四年半吗?这正是歌手兼演员Selena Gomez为了改善心理健康而做的事情。

sentences.text: She has spoken extensively about the relationship between her social media usage and her mental wellbeing, recalling feeling like "an addict" when she became Instagram's most followed user in 2016.
"Taking a break from social media was the best decision that I've ever made for my mental health", says she.
"The unnecessary hate and comparisons went away once I put my phone down."

passage.translation: 她广泛谈及社交媒体使用与心理健康之间的关系,回忆起2016年成为Instagram粉丝数最多的用户时感觉自己像个"瘾君子"。她说:"远离社交媒体是我为心理健康做出的最好决定。一旦我放下手机,那些不必要的仇恨和比较就消失了。"

sentences.text: Ditching the web at large, however, is a far more subtle and complicated prospect.

The increasing digitisation of our society means that everything from paying a gas bill to plotting a route to a friend's house and even making a phone call is at the mercy of your internet connection.
Actively opting out of using the internet becomes a matter of privilege.

passage.translation: 然而,彻底抛弃互联网是一个更加微妙和复杂的问题。我们社会日益数字化意味着从缴纳燃气费到规划去朋友家的路线,甚至拨打电话,一切都取决于你的互联网连接。主动选择不使用互联网成为一种特权。

sentences.text: Ms Gomez's multi-millionaire status has allowed her to take the "social" out of social media, so she can continue to leverage her enormous fame while keeping the trolls(恶意挑衅的帖子) at bay.

The fact that she's still the second most-followed woman on Instagram suggests it's entirely possible to maintain a significant web profile to promote various projects—by way of a dedicated team—without being exposed to the cruel comments, hate mail and rape or death threats.

passage.translation: Gomez女士的千万富翁身份使她能够将社交媒体中的"社交"部分剥离,这样她可以继续利用自己的巨大名气,同时让恶意挑衅的帖子无法靠近。她仍然是Instagram上粉丝数第二多的女性这一事实表明,完全可以通过专门团队维持重要的网络形象来推广各种项目,而不必暴露于恶意评论、仇恨邮件以及强奸或死亡威胁之下。

sentences.text: It goes without saying that this is fundamentally different from how the rest of us without beauty deals and films to publicise use the likes of Instagram, TikTok and Twitter, but even the concept of a digital detox(戒瘾) requires having a device and connectivity to choose to disconnect from.

passage.translation: 不言而喻,这与我们其他没有美容代言和电影要宣传的人使用Instagram、TikTok和Twitter等平台的方式有着根本不同,但即便是数字戒瘾的概念也需要拥有设备和网络连接才能选择断开连接。

sentences.text: The UK's digital divide has worsened over the past two years, leaving poorer families without broadband connections in their homes.

Digital exclusion is a major threat to wider societal equality in the UK, so witnessing companies like Facebook championing the metaverse(元宇宙) as the next great frontier when school children are struggling to complete their homework feels particularly irritating.

passage.translation: 英国的数字鸿沟在过去两年中有所恶化,使得贫困家庭的家中没有宽带连接。数字排斥是对英国更广泛社会平等的重大威胁,因此当学童们还在努力完成家庭作业时,看到Facebook这样的公司将元宇宙作为下一个伟大前沿来推广,让人感到特别恼火。

sentences.text: Consequently, it's worth bearing in mind that while deleting all social media accounts will undoubtedly make some feel infinitely better, many other people benefit from the strong sense of community that sharing platforms can breed.

passage.translation: 因此,值得记住的是,虽然删除所有社交媒体账户无疑会让一些人感觉好得多,但许多其他人却受益于分享平台所能培育的强烈社区感。

sentences.text: Internet access will continue to grow in importance as we edge further towards web 3.0, and greater resources and initiatives are needed to provide the underprivileged with the connectivity they desperately need to learn, work and live.

It's crucial that people who feel that social media is having a detrimental effect on their mental health are allowed to switch off and for those living in digital exclusion to be able to switch on in the first place.

passage.translation: 随着我们进一步迈向web 3.0,互联网接入将继续变得越来越重要,需要更多的资源和举措来为弱势群体提供他们迫切需要的网络连接以进行学习、工作和生活。至关重要的是,让那些感到社交媒体对其心理健康产生不利影响的人能够选择关闭,并让那些生活在数字排斥中的人首先能够开启连接。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What do we learn about singer and actress Selena Gomez in the past four and a half years?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
在过去四年半里,我们对歌手兼演员Selena Gomez有何了解?
A) 她的心理问题日益恶化。
B) 她赢得了Instagram最多的关注者。
C) 她克制自己不使用社交媒体。
D) 她在互联网上的竞标中取得了成功。
**判型** What do we learn about singer and actress Selena Gomez in the past four and a half years? 指向「她过去四年半发生了什么」这一具体事实，没有 infer/imply/mainly。
**拆句** What do we learn about singer and actress Selena Gomez in the past four and a half years? 是一般疑问句，主干 What do we learn；介词短语 in the past four and a half years 作时间状语，限定考察范围。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 远离社交媒体是我为心理健康做过的最好的决定。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反原文说她远离社媒是为改善心理健康（the best decision that I've ever made for my mental health），而 She has had worsening mental problems 把「为改善心理健康」反过来说成「心理问题加重」，与原文方向相反。
B) 偷换概念原文说她「在 2016 年成为 Instagram 关注最多的用户」（she became Instagram's most followed user in 2016），是过去某一时点的事实；She has won Instagram's most followers 用现在完成时把这件 2016 年的事说成「过去四年半内取得」，与题干in the past four and a half years 不符。
C) ✓ 正确Taking a break from social media was the best decision that I've ever made for my mental health↔ She has refrained from using social media预判「远离社媒」与 She has refrained from using social media 完全吻合，且原文-选项之间的替换属于六级阅读高频同义替换模式。
D) 偷换概念原文 in a bid to improve her mental health 中 bid 意为「努力、尝试」（熟词僻义），整个短语意为「为改善心理健康所作的努力」；She has succeeded in a bid on the internet 把 bid 当作「竞拍」用，与原文意思完全两回事。
questions.quote: Taking a break from social media was the best decision that I've ever made for my mental health

options.text: She has had worsening mental problems.
She has won Instagram's most followers.
She has refrained from using social media.
She has succeeded in a bid on the internet.

questions.prompt: Why does actively opting out of using the internet become a matter of privilege?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
为什么主动选择不使用互联网成为一种特权问题?
A) 大多数人发现放弃使用互联网既微妙又复杂。
B) 大多数人在避免仇恨和比较的同时很难摆脱网络。
C) 由于数字化程度不断提高,大多数人没有互联网几乎无法生活。
D) 大多数人在不知不觉中已经严重沉迷于网络。
**判型** Why does actively opting out of using the internet become a matter of privilege? 已把结论摆出，要在原文找直接给出的原因，属于原因型细节题。
**拆句** Why does actively opting out of using the internet become a matter of privilege? 主干 does opting out become a matter of privilege；动名词短语 actively opting out of using the internet 作主语；a matter of privilege 是表语。Why 直接问原因。
**定位** 我们社会日益数字化意味着——从交一笔煤气费、规划一条去朋友家的路线，甚至打一通电话——一切都受制于你的网络连接。主动选择不使用互联网由此变成一种特权。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 答非所问Most people find it subtle and complicated to give up using the internet 改写自Ditching the web at large, however, is a far more subtle and complicated prospect，描述的是「难度」，并未回答题干「为何成为特权」。
B) 张冠李戴Most people can hardly ditch the web while avoiding hate and comparisons 把「避开仇恨与攀比」塞给「为何不上网是特权」这一问题；但 The unnecessary hate and comparisons went away once I put my phone down 讲的是 Gomez 远离社媒后的结果，与 Q47 的因果无关。
C) ✓ 正确The increasing digitisation of our society means that everything from paying a gas bill to plotting a route to a friend's house and even making a phone call is at the mercy of your internet connection↔ Most people can hardly get by without the internet due to growing digitisation Could you get by without using the internet for four and a half years? ↔Most people can hardly get by without the internet预判的因果（数字化 → 离不开网 → 不上网成特权）与 Most people can hardly get by without the internet due to growing digitisation 一一对应。
D) 无中生有Most people have been seriously addicted to the web without being aware of it拿 like "an addict" 套到「普通人不自觉成瘾」上，但原文只说 Gomez 自己感觉像addict，并没有「普通人不自觉成瘾」这一论断，且与 Q47 因果无关。
questions.quote: The increasing digitisation of our society means that everything from paying a gas bill to plotting a route to a friend's house and even making a phone call is at the mercy of your internet connection. Actively opting out of using the internet becomes a matter of privilege.

options.text: Most people find it subtle and complicated to give up using the internet.
Most people can hardly ditch the web while avoiding hate and comparisons.
Most people can hardly get by without the internet due to growing digitisation.
Most people have been seriously addicted to the web without being aware of it.

questions.prompt: Why does the author say "witnessing companies…feels particularly irritating"(Lines 2-4, Para. 6)?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （推断题）
**题目译文**
作者为什么说"目睹各公司……感到特别恼火"(第6段第2-4行)?
A) 英国的数字鸿沟会因元宇宙而进一步恶化。
B) 元宇宙的概念被认为仍然相当虚幻。
C) 学龄儿童会被拉得离现实世界更远。
D) 英国大多数家庭没有稳定的宽带连接。
**判型** Why does the author say "witnessing companies…feels particularly irritating" 问的是作者使用此评价语背后的逻辑，需要把「为何 irritating」这层因果挖出来。
**拆句** Why does the author say "witnessing companies…feels particularly irritating"(Lines 2-4, Para. 6)? Why 引导主干，宾语从句 the author say + 直接引语；括号 (Lines 2- 4, Para. 6) 是定位说明。直接引语本身是动名词短语作主语 + feels 系动词 + irritating表语。
**定位** 英国的数字鸿沟在过去两年里加剧，导致较贫困家庭家中没有宽带。数字排斥是英国社会整体公平的一大威胁，因此当学童正为完成作业犯难时，看到 Facebook 之类的公司还在把元宇宙鼓吹成下一个伟大前沿，就让人尤其感到刺目。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确The UK's digital divide has worsened over the past two years ↔The UK digital divide would further worsen due to the metaverse championing the metaverse(元宇宙) as the next great frontier when school children are struggling to complete their homework↔ due to the metaverse预判「鼓吹元宇宙会加深数字鸿沟」与 The UK digital divide would further worsen due to the metaverse 完全对应，且推断只走一步，未越界。
B) 无中生有The concept of the metaverse is believed to be still quite illusory 评价的是「元宇宙是否虚幻」，原文只用 the next great frontier 描述公司的宣传口径，并未对metaverse 概念本身的「虚幻与否」作判断。
C) 答非所问School children would be drawn farther away from the real world 把焦点放在「学童被拉离现实世界」，但原文中学童的位置是 struggling to complete their homework——他们是因为没有宽带连作业都做不了，而不是被元宇宙拉离现实。
D) 以偏概全Most families in the UK do not have stable broadband connections 把原文leaving poorer families without broadband connections in their homes 的「较贫困家庭」扩大为「大多数家庭」；同时这只是引发 irritating 的背景之一，而不是作者觉得 irritating 的核心原因。
questions.quote: The UK's digital divide has worsened over the past two years, leaving poorer families without broadband connections in their homes. Digital exclusion is a major threat to wider societal equality in the UK, so witnessing companies like Facebook championing the metaverse(元宇宙) as the next great frontier when school children are struggling to complete their homework feels particularly irritating.

options.text: The UK digital divide would further worsen due to the metaverse.
The concept of the metaverse is believed to be still quite illusory.
School children would be drawn farther away from the real world.
Most families in the UK do not have stable broadband connections.

questions.prompt: What is worth bearing in mind concerning social media platforms?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
关于社交媒体平台,什么值得牢记?
A) 它们有助于促进社会平等。
B) 它们帮助许多人感到与他人相连。
C) 它们为数字排毒提供了必要的设备。
D) 它们在互联网上创建了一个虚拟社区。
**判型** What is worth bearing in mind concerning social media platforms? 问的是作者明确提示要记住的事实，对应原文一处明确陈述。
**拆句** What is worth bearing in mind concerning social media platforms? 主干 What is worth bearing in mind；动名词短语 bearing in mind 作 worth 的宾语；介词短语concerning social media platforms 限定话题。结构清晰无陷阱。
**定位** 因此，值得记住的是：虽然删除所有社交媒体账号无疑会让一些人感觉好得多，但许多其他人则从共享平台所孕育的强烈社群感中获益。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 张冠李戴They are conducive to promoting societal equality 借用了上一段 wider societal equality in the UK 的高敏感词 societal equality，但原文是说「数字排斥威胁公平」，并未说社交媒体平台「促进」公平。
B) ✓ 正确many other people benefit from the strong sense of community that sharing platforms can breed↔ They help many people feel connected with others预判的「连接感」和 They help many people feel connected with others 完美对应，且 They 指代 social media platforms / sharing platforms。
C) 与原文相反They provide a necessary device for a digital detox 颠倒了原文逻辑：even the concept of a digital detox(戒瘾) requires having a device and connectivity to choose to disconnect from 说的是「做数字戒瘾本身就要先有设备和网络」，设备/网络是 digital detox 的前提，而非由社交媒体平台提供。
D) 偷换概念They create a virtual community on the internet 用 virtual community 偷换原文的strong sense of community。原文强调的是「社群归属感」（用户主观感受），而virtual community 指「线上社群」这一实体，重点偏离；并且原文用 breed（孕育）描述的是「感受」被催生，而非「社群」被创造。
questions.quote: Consequently, it's worth bearing in mind that while deleting all social media accounts will undoubtedly make some feel infinitely better, many other people benefit from the strong sense of community that sharing platforms can breed.

options.text: They are conducive to promoting societal equality.
They help many people feel connected with others.
They provide a necessary device for a digital detox.
They create a virtual community on the internet.

questions.prompt: What does the author think is really important for those living in digital exclusion?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者认为对于生活在数字排斥中的人们来说,什么才是真正重要的?
A) 能够接入互联网。
B) 进一步迈向web 3.0。
C) 获得更多教育资源。
D) 开设更多社交媒体账户。
**判型** What does the author think is really important for those living in digital exclusion?问作者明示的观点，且原文有 crucial 一句直接对应，归为细节题。
**拆句** What does the author think is really important for those living in digital exclusion? What 作 think 后宾语从句的主语；is really important 是表语；介词短语 for those living in digital exclusion 限定对象，其中 living in digital exclusion 是现在分词短语作后置定语修饰 those。
**定位** 至关重要的是：让那些觉得社交媒体正在损害自己心理健康的人能够「关掉」，也要让那些深陷数字排斥的人首先能够「打开」。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确for those living in digital exclusion to be able to switch on in the first place↔Having access to the internet greater resources and initiatives are needed to provide the underprivileged with the connectivity they desperately need↔ Having access to the internet预判「先能联网」与 Having access to the internet 完全对应，且与同段两处描述都能挂上。
B) 偷换概念Edging further towards web 3.0 改自 Internet access will continue to grow in importance as we edge further towards web 3.0，但 edge further towards web 3.0 在原文是描述时代背景，而非「对数字排斥者真正重要的事」。
C) 以偏概全Getting more educational resources 把原文 greater resources and initiatives are needed to provide the underprivileged with the connectivity they desperately need to learn, work and live 中的 resources 缩到「教育资源」。原文 resources 指的是「用于提供网络连接的资源」，learn 只是 connectivity 的用途之一。
D) 与原文相反Opening more social media accounts 与全文论调（提醒社媒对心理健康有害、Gomez 主动远离社媒）相反；原文要那些 digital exclusion 的人 switch on 的是「网络连接」，并非「更多社媒账号」。
questions.quote: It's crucial that people who feel that social media is having a detrimental effect on their mental health are allowed to switch off and for those living in digital exclusion to be able to switch on in the first place.

options.text: Having access to the internet.
Edging further towards web 3.0.
Getting more educational resources.
Opening more social media accounts.

title: Our brains respond to language expressing facts differently…

sentences.text: Our brains respond to language expressing facts differently than they do to words conveying possibility, scientists at New York University have recently found.
