questions.explanation:
**答案** K 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
即使在快餐国度美国,素食者的数量也在增加。
**锚点** 「fast-food nation America」+「vegetarians is on the rise」
**定位** 2017 年，6% 的美国消费者自称是严格的素食主义者，比 2014 年的 1% 有所上升。
**改写** Even in the fast-food nation America ↔ Even in the United States—the fast-food nation「fast-food nation America」≈ 原文同名表述the number of vegetarians is on the rise ↔6 per cent of US consumers claimed to be strictly vegetarian, up from 1 per cent in 2014数据上升 = 「数量上升」
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
J J 段确实讲 Slow Food movement 起源与扩张，但聚焦 in Italy in the 1980s 与more than 160 countries 的概览，并没有具体到美国素食者比例上升，因此不是本题源头。Under the leadership of Carlo Petrini, the Slow Food movement began in Piedmont
questions.quote: In 2017, 6 per cent of US consumers claimed to be strictly vegetarian, up from 1 per cent in 2014.

questions.prompt: The deterioration of the ecological system is accelerating because of the dramatic increase of human production and consumption.
questions.explanation:
**答案** D 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
由于人类生产和消费的急剧增长,生态系统的恶化正在加速。
**锚点** 「dramatic increase of human production and consumption」导致生态恶化加速
**定位** 人类生产、消费与出行的加速已经改变了生物与非生物的世界，并在我们依赖的自然过程中产生回响。物种灭绝、毁林、河流筑坝、洪水频发、臭氧消耗、海洋系统退化等众多领域都在经历加速。
**改写** The deterioration of the ecological system is accelerating ↔Species extinction, deforestation, damming of rivers, occurrence of floods, the depletion of ozone, the degradation of ocean systems and many other areas are all experiencing acceleration生态领域清单的加速 = 「生态系统恶化加速」because of the dramatic increase of human production and consumption ↔The acceleration of human production, consumption and travel has changed the animate and inanimate spheres. It has echoed through natural processes on which humans depend「人类生产消费加速影响自然」= 「生产消费剧增导致生态恶化」
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
C C 段虽然也说 environmental threats…are multiplying at a dizzying rate，但归因模糊（只笼统讲「搜寻温暖与舒适」），并未明确指向「生产消费的剧增」这一陈述句的关键原因；本题严格要求因果两端对齐，故排除。Year after year, faster and faster, consumption outpaces the biological capacity of our planet
questions.quote: The acceleration of human production, consumption and travel has changed the animate and inanimate spheres. It has echoed through natural processes on which humans depend. Species extinction, deforestation, damming of rivers, occurrence of floods, the depletion of ozone, the degradation of ocean systems and many other areas are all experiencing acceleration.

questions.prompt: It is obvious that solutions must be found to curb the fast worsening environment and social acceleration.
questions.explanation:
**答案** G 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
显然必须找到解决方案来遏制迅速恶化的环境和社会加速。
**锚点** 「solutions must be found to curb」环境与社会加速
**定位** 这一点是清楚的：我们需要找到办法，把那条反映生态破坏与社会加速越来越快的「曲棍球棒」曲线压平。
**改写** It is obvious that solutions must be found ↔ This much is clear: we need to find ways「显然要找方法」= 「we need to find ways」to curb the fast worsening environment and social acceleration ↔flatten the hockey-stick curves that reflect our ever-faster pace of ecological destruction and social acceleration「压平曲线」= 「遏制」+ 术语原样复现
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
F F 段以问句 So what do we do? 结尾，意在引出后文，但没有出现「social acceleration」这一关键术语，也没有「This much is clear: we need to find ways」式的明确主张，因此不是本题源头。Global heating and environmental degradation are not technological problems. They are highly political issues that are informed by powerful interests
questions.quote: This much is clear: we need to find ways that help us flatten the hockey-stick curves that reflect our ever-faster pace of ecological destruction and social acceleration.

questions.prompt: Many people believe changing the world is possible, though it may take time and involve setbacks.
questions.explanation:
**答案** A 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
许多人相信改变世界是可能的,尽管这可能需要时间并涉及挫折。
**锚点** 「changing the world is possible」+「take time and involve setbacks」
**定位** 我们的世界充满了大多未被讲述的「慢希望」故事，它们由「改变是可能的」这一信念所驱动。它们的展开是缓慢的，因为它们伴随挫折。
**改写** Many people believe changing the world is possible ↔ driven by the idea that change is possible「人们相信」= 「被这一信念驱动」it may take time and involve setbacks ↔They are 'slow' in their unfolding, and they are slow because they come with setbacks「展开缓慢 + 伴随挫折」= 「需要时间 + 伴随挫折」
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
H H 段也提到 slow hope，但它的命题是「我们需要多重故事而非英雄叙事」，强调对策方向；并未直接表述「人们相信改变可能且过程会有挫折」的总观点，那是 A 段的开篇定调。we need stories, not only of what Rob Nixon of Princeton University has called the 'slow violence' of environmental degradation…but also stories of what I call 'slow hope'
questions.quote: Our world is full of—mostly untold—stories of slow hope, driven by the idea that change is possible. They are 'slow' in their unfolding, and they are slow because they come with setbacks.

questions.prompt: It might be wrong to expect that our world would be saved at one stroke with some miraculous technology.
questions.explanation:
**答案** F 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
期望我们的世界会通过某种神奇技术一举得救可能是错误的。
**锚点** 「saved at one stroke with some miraculous technology」是错的
**定位** 我们现在能整体地想象这个星球，这并不意味着对它的「拯救」会来自一次全球性的天才与技术的妙笔；它更可能由许多小行动促成。
**改写** It might be wrong to expect that our world would be saved at one stroke with some miraculous technology↔we envisage our salvation to come from a deus ex machina, from a divine engineer or a tech solutionist who will miraculously conjure up a new source of energy or another cure-all with revolutionary potency, we might be looking in the wrong place「找错地方」= 「这种期待可能是错的」our world would be saved at one stroke ↔the 'rescue' of our planet will come with one big global stroke of genius and technology「一举」表述原样复现
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
E E 段确实提到 we too, like Prometheus, will be saved by a new Hercules, a divine engineer 这一技术救世幻想，但只是描述这种说法，没有判断「这是错的」；而陈述句 It might be wrong to expect 带明确批判态度，应去 F 段。Some of today's narratives about the future seem to suggest that we too, like Prometheus, will be saved by a new Hercules, a divine engineer
questions.quote: The fact that we now imagine our planet as a whole does not mean that the 'rescue' of our planet will come with one big global stroke of genius and technology. It will more likely come by many small acts.

questions.prompt: It is human nature to cherish hopes for a better world.
questions.explanation:
**答案** I 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
珍视对更美好世界的希望是人的天性。
**锚点** 「human nature to cherish hopes for a better world」
**定位** 让我们作为人类「本真」的，是对自身「潜能」的种种愿景。换句话说：活在希望中让我们成为人。
**改写** It is human nature to cherish hopes ↔ living in hope makes us human「A让我们成为人」= 「A是人性」for a better world ↔ the outlines of a better world「更好世界」原词复现
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
A A 段确实提到 driven by the idea that change is possible，但只把「改变可能」当作驱动故事的信念，并未把希望或追求更好世界定义为「人性」；本题要求的是「人性= 怀抱希望」这一定义性命题，故而去 I 段。Our world is full of—mostly untold—stories of slow hope, driven by the idea that change is possible
questions.quote: What makes us 'authentic' as humans are visions of our 'potential'. In other words: living in hope makes us human.

questions.prompt: Technology has given us humans the power to change the natural world, but we have paid a price for the change.
questions.explanation:
**答案** B 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
技术赋予了我们人类改变自然世界的力量,但我们为这种改变付出了代价。
**锚点** 「Technology」改变自然 +「paid a price」
**定位** 正如神话所讲，技术——最初是火与石器，后来是农业、蒸汽机和工业、化石燃料、化学品和核能——让我们得以改造并控制自然界。神话也提醒我们，这些进步是付出代价的：作为对普罗米修斯之罪的惩罚，众神创造了潘多拉，并给了她一个装满邪恶与诅咒的盒子。
**改写** Technology has given us humans the power to change the natural world ↔technology—first fire and stone tools, and later farming, the steam engine and industry, fossil fuels, chemicals and nuclear power—has allowed us to alter and control the natural world「允许我们改造」= 「给了我们改变的力量」we have paid a price for the change ↔ these advances have come at a price「付出代价」原样复现
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
C C 段确实在讲 the ecological curses that we have released，但它承袭的是 B 段提出的「技术付代价」命题、展开其后果；陈述句要求的「技术赋予改造自然之力 + 已付代价」总命题首次完整出现在 B 段，故 C 段不是源头。In engineering and exploiting and transforming our habitat, we have opened tens of thousands of Pandora's boxes
questions.quote: Just as in the myth, technology—first fire and stone tools, and later farming, the steam engine and industry, fossil fuels, chemicals and nuclear power—has allowed us to alter and control the natural world. The myth also reminds us that these advances have come at a price: as a punishment for Prometheus' crime, the gods created Pandora, and they gave her a box filled with evils and curses.

title: The Challenges for Artificial Intelligence in Agriculture

passage.label: A

sentences.text: A group of corn farmers stands huddled around an agronomist(农学家) and his computer on the side of an irrigation machine in central South Africa.

The agronomist has just flown over the field with a hybrid unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) that takes off and lands using propellers yet maintains distance and speed for scanning vast hectares of land through the use of its fixed wings.

passage.translation: 一群玉米种植者聚集在南非中部一台灌溉机械旁边,围着一位农学家和他的电脑。这位农学家刚刚用一架混合动力无人机飞越了这片田地,这种无人机使用螺旋桨起飞和降落,但通过使用固定翼来保持距离和速度,以扫描大片公顷土地。

passage.label: B

sentences.text: The UAV is fitted with a four spectral band precision sensor that conducts onboard processing immediately after the flight, allowing farmers and field staff to address, almost immediately, any crop abnormalities that the sensor may have recorded, making the data collection truly real-time.

passage.translation: 该无人机配备了一个四光谱波段精密传感器,可在飞行后立即进行机载处理,使农民和田间工作人员能够几乎立即处理传感器可能记录到的任何作物异常情况,从而使数据收集真正实现实时化。

passage.label: C

sentences.text: In this instance, the farmers and agronomist are looking to specialized software to give them an accurate plant population count.

It's been 10 days since the corn emerged and the farmer wants to determine if there are any parts of the field that require replanting due to a lack of emergence or wind damage, which can be severe in the early stages of the summer rainy season.

passage.translation: 在这种情况下,农民和农学家正在使用专业软件为他们提供准确的植株数量统计。玉米出苗已有10天,农民希望确定田地是否有任何部分因出苗不足或风害而需要补种,这种情况在夏季雨季早期可能很严重。

passage.label: D

sentences.text: At this growth stage of the plant's development, the farmer has another 10 days to conduct any replanting before the majority of his fertilizer and chemical applications need to occur.

Once these have been applied, it becomes economically unviable to take corrective action, making any further collected data historical and useful only to inform future practices for the season to come.

passage.translation: 在植株发育的这个生长阶段,农民还有10天时间进行补种,之后他的大部分肥料和化学品施用就需要进行了。一旦这些施用完成,采取纠正措施在经济上就变得不可行,使得任何进一步收集的数据都只具有历史意义,只能用于为下一季的未来实践提供信息。

passage.label: E

sentences.text: The software completes its processing in under 15 minutes producing a plant population count map.

It's difficult to grasp just how impressive this is, without understanding that just over a year ago it would have taken three to five days to process the exact same data set, illustrating the advancements that have been achieved in precision agriculture and remote sensing in recent years.

With the software having been developed in the United States on the same variety of crops in seemingly similar conditions, the agronomist feels confident that the software will produce a nearly accurate result.

passage.translation: 该软件在不到15分钟内完成处理,生成了一张植株数量统计图。如果不了解就在一年多前处理完全相同的数据集还需要三到五天时间,就很难理解这有多么令人印象深刻,这说明了近年来精准农业和遥感技术所取得的进步。由于该软件是在美国针对相似条件下的同一品种作物开发的,农学家确信该软件将产生近乎准确的结果。

passage.label: F

sentences.text: As the map appears on the screen, the agronomist's face begins to drop.

Having walked through the planted rows before the flight to gain a physical understanding of the situation on the ground, he knows the instant he sees the data on his screen that the plant count is not correct, and so do the farmers, even with their limited understanding of how to read remote sensing maps.

passage.translation: 当地图出现在屏幕上时,农学家的脸色开始变得难看。由于在飞行前曾穿过种植的行列以获得对地面情况的实际了解,他在屏幕上看到数据的那一刻就知道植株计数是不正确的,农民们也知道,即使他们对如何解读遥感地图的理解有限。

passage.label: G

sentences.text: Hypothetically, it is possible for machines to learn to solve any problem on earth relating to the physical interaction of all things within a defined or contained environment by using artificial intelligence and machine learning.

passage.translation: 从理论上讲,机器有可能通过使用人工智能和机器学习,学会解决地球上与定义或封闭环境中所有事物的物理交互相关的任何问题。

passage.label: H

sentences.text: Remote sensors enable algorithms(算法) to interpret a field's environment as statistical data that can be understood and useful to farmers for decision-making.
Algorithms process the data, adapting and learning based on the data received.
The more inputs and statistical information collected, the better the algorithm will be at predicting a range of outcomes.
And the aim is that farmers can use this artificial intelligence to achieve their goal of a better harvest through making better decisions in the field.

passage.translation: 远程传感器使算法能够将田地环境解读为统计数据,这些数据可以被理解并对农民的决策有用。算法处理数据,根据接收到的数据进行调整和学习。收集的输入和统计信息越多,算法预测一系列结果的能力就越强。目标是农民可以利用这种人工智能通过在田间做出更好的决策来实现更好收成的目标。

passage.label: I

sentences.text: In 2011, IBM, through its R&D Headquarters in Haifa, Israel, launched an agricultural cloud- computing project.

The project, in collaboration with a number of specialized IT and agricultural partners, had one goal in mind—to take a variety of academic and physical data sources from an agricultural environment and turn these into automatic predictive solutions for farmers that would assist them in making real-time decisions in the field.

passage.translation: 2011年,IBM通过其位于以色列海法的研发总部启动了一个农业云计算项目。该项目与多个专业IT和农业合作伙伴合作,只有一个目标——从农业环境中获取各种学术和物理数据源,并将这些转化为自动预测解决方案,帮助农民在田间做出实时决策。

passage.label: J

sentences.text: Interviews with some of the IBM project team members at the time revealed that the team believed it was entirely possible to "algorithm" agriculture, meaning that algorithms could solve any problem in the world.
Earlier that year, IBM's cognitive learning system, Watson, competed in the game Jeopardy against former winners Brad Rutter and Ken Jennings with astonishing results.
Several years later, Watson went on to produce ground-breaking achievements in the field of medicine.

passage.translation: 当时对IBM项目团队成员的一些采访显示,该团队认为完全有可能将农业"算法化",意味着算法可以解决世界上的任何问题。那年早些时候,IBM的认知学习系统Watson在智力竞赛节目Jeopardy中与前冠军Brad Rutter和Ken Jennings竞争,取得了惊人的成绩。几年后,Watson在医学领域取得了突破性成就。

passage.label: K

sentences.text: So why did the project have such success in medicine but not agriculture?
Because it is one of the most difficult fields to contain for the purpose of statistical quantification.
Even within a single field, conditions are always changing from one section to the next.
There's unpredictable weather, changes in soil quality, and the ever-present possibility that pests and diseases may pay a visit.
Growers may feel their prospects are good for an upcoming harvest, but until that day arrives, the outcome will always be uncertain.

passage.translation: 那么为什么该项目在医学领域取得了如此成功而在农业领域却没有?因为农业是最难为统计量化目的而封闭的领域之一。即使在单个田地内,条件也总是从一个部分到另一个部分不断变化。有不可预测的天气、土壤质量的变化,以及病虫害可能造访的永恒可能性。种植者可能觉得即将到来的收成前景良好,但在那一天到来之前,结果始终是不确定的。

passage.label: L

sentences.text: By comparison, our bodies are a contained environment.
Agriculture takes place in nature, among ecosystems of interacting organisms and activity, and crop production takes place within that ecosystem environment.
But these ecosystems are not contained.
They are subject to climatic occurrences such as weather systems, which impact upon hemispheres as a whole, and from continent to continent.
Therefore, understanding how to manage an agricultural environment means taking literally many hundreds if not thousands of factors into account.

passage.translation: 相比之下,我们的身体是一个封闭的环境。农业发生在自然中,在相互作用的有机体和活动的生态系统之中,而作物生产发生在该生态系统环境内。但这些生态系统不是封闭的。它们受到气候现象如天气系统的影响,这些系统影响整个半球,从一个大陆到另一个大陆。因此,理解如何管理农业环境意味着确实要考虑数百甚至数千个因素。

passage.label: M

sentences.text: What may occur with the same seed and fertilizer program in the United States' Midwest region is almost certainly unrelated to what may occur with the same seed and fertilizer program in Australia or South Africa.

A few factors that could impact on variation would typically include the measurement of rain per unit of a crop planted, soil type, patterns of soil degradation, daylight hours, temperature and so forth.

passage.translation: 在美国中西部地区使用相同种子和肥料方案可能发生的情况,几乎肯定与在澳大利亚或南非使用相同种子和肥料方案可能发生的情况无关。可能影响变化的几个因素通常包括每单位种植作物的降雨量测量、土壤类型、土壤退化模式、日照时数、温度等等。

passage.label: N

sentences.text: So the problem with deploying machine learning and artificial intelligence in agriculture is not that scientists lack the capacity to develop programs and protocols to begin to address the biggest of growers' concerns; the problem is that in most cases, no two environments will be exactly alike, which makes the testing, validation and successful rollout of such technologies much more laborious than in most other industries.

passage.translation: 因此,在农业中部署机器学习和人工智能的问题不在于科学家缺乏开发程序和协议以开始解决种植者最大关切的能力;问题在于在大多数情况下,没有两个环境会完全相同,这使得此类技术的测试、验证和成功推出比大多数其他行业更加费力。

passage.label: O

sentences.text: Practically, to say that AI and Machine Learning can be developed to solve all problems related to our physical environment is to basically say that we have a complete understanding of all aspects of the interaction of physical or material activity on the planet.
After all, it is only through our understanding of "the nature of things" that protocols and processes are designed for the rational capabilities of cognitive systems to take place.

And, although AI and Machine Learning are teaching us many things about how to understand our environment, we are still far from being able to predict critical outcomes in fields like agriculture purely through the cognitive ability of machines.

passage.translation: 实际上,说人工智能和机器学习可以被开发来解决与我们物理环境相关的所有问题,基本上就是说我们完全理解地球上物理或物质活动交互的所有方面。毕竟,只有通过我们对"事物本质"的理解,才能为认知系统的理性能力设计协议和流程。而且,尽管人工智能和机器学习正在教会我们许多关于如何理解我们环境的知识,但我们仍然远未能够纯粹通过机器的认知能力预测农业等领域的关键结果。

passage.label: P

sentences.text: Backed by the venture capital community, which is now investing billions of dollars in the sector, most agricultural technology startups today are pushed to complete development as quickly as possible and then encouraged to flood the market as quickly as possible with their products.

passage.translation: 在风险投资界的支持下,该界目前正在该领域投资数十亿美元,今天大多数农业技术初创公司被推动尽快完成开发,然后被鼓励尽快用他们的产品充斥市场。

passage.label: Q

sentences.text: This usually results in a failure of a product, which leads to skepticism from the market and delivers a blow to the integrity of Machine Learning technology.

In most cases, the problem is not that the technology does not work, the problem is that industry has not taken the time to respect that agriculture is one of the most uncontained environments to manage.
For technology to truly make an impact on agriculture, more effort, skills, and funding is needed to test these technologies in farmers' fields.

passage.translation: 这通常导致产品失败,从而引发市场怀疑,并对机器学习技术的完整性造成打击。在大多数情况下,问题不在于技术不起作用,问题在于行业没有花时间尊重农业是最不封闭的管理环境之一这一事实。要使技术真正对农业产生影响,需要更多的努力、技能和资金在农民的田地中测试这些技术。

passage.label: R

sentences.text: There is huge potential for artificial intelligence and machine learning to revolutionize agriculture by integrating these technologies into critical markets on a global scale.
Only then can it make a difference to the grower, where it really counts.

passage.translation: 人工智能和机器学习通过在全球范围内将这些技术整合到关键市场中,具有彻底改变农业的巨大潜力。只有这样,它才能在真正重要的地方对种植者产生影响。

groups.instructions: In this section, you are going to read a passage with ten statements attached to it. Each statement contains information given in one of the paragraphs. Identify the paragraph from which the information is derived. You may choose a paragraph more than once. Each paragraph is marked with a letter. Answer the questions by marking the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2.

questions.prompt: Farmers will not profit from replanting once they have applied most of the fertilizer and other chemicals to their fields.
questions.explanation:
**答案** D 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
一旦农民已经向田地施用了大部分化肥和其他化学品,重新播种将不会带来利润。
**锚点** 施肥施药后补种 + 不再获利
**定位** 在玉米这一生育阶段,农户还有 10 天时间可以进行任何补种,之后他大部分的肥料和化学品施用就要进行了。一旦这些施下去,再采取补救行动在经济上就不划算了,后续采集到的数据就只剩历史价值、只能为下一季的实践提供参考。
**改写** will not profit from replanting ↔ it becomes economically unviable to take corrective action “不获利”=“经济上不划算”once they have applied most of the fertilizer and other chemicals to their fields ↔Once these have been applied句式直接对应 + 代词回指
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
C C 段的核心是 the farmer wants to determine if there are any parts of the field that require replanting due to a lack of emergence or wind damage,只解释了为什么要补种、补种动机是什么,完全没有题干所说的“施肥施药之后再补种就不获利”这一经济判断,因此并不是题干信息所出之处。the farmer wants to determine if there are any parts of the field that require replanting due to a lack of emergence or wind damage
questions.quote: At this growth stage of the plant's development, the farmer has another 10 days to conduct any replanting before the majority of his fertilizer and chemical applications need to occur. Once these have been applied, it becomes economically unviable to take corrective action, making any further collected data historical and useful only to inform future practices for the season to come.

questions.prompt: Agriculture differs from the medical science of the human body in that its environment is not a contained one.
questions.explanation:
**答案** L 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
农业与人体医学科学的不同之处在于其环境不是一个封闭的环境。
**锚点** 农业与人体医学的“受限/不受限”之别
**定位** 相比之下,我们的身体是一个受限的环境。农业则发生在自然中、发生在彼此相互作用的生物与活动构成的生态系统里,而作物生产又发生在那个生态系统的环境之中。但这些生态系统并不受限。
**改写** the medical science of the human body ↔ our bodies are a contained environment “人体医学”上位 = 原文具体的“我们的身体”its environment is not a contained one ↔ these ecosystems are not contained “农业的环境”=“这些生态系统”
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
K K 段同样把 medicine 和农业放在对比中讨论(开头Sowhydidtheprojecthavesuchsuccessinmedicinebutnotagriculture?),很容易让人误以为就是 37 题的源头段;但 K 段强调的是“农业难以量化、条件不断变化”,并没有提到“contained/受限”这个关键概念,只对上了题干“差异”这一半,缺少“受限/不受限”这另一半,因此排除。So why did the project have such success in medicine but not agriculture? Because it is one of the most difficult fields to contain for the purpose of statistical quantification
questions.quote: By comparison, our bodies are a contained environment. Agriculture takes place in nature, among ecosystems of interacting organisms and activity, and crop production takes place within that ecosystem environment. But these ecosystems are not contained.

questions.prompt: The agronomist is sure that he will obtain a nearly accurate count of plant population with his software.
questions.explanation:
**答案** E 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
农学家确信他将通过他的软件获得几乎精确的植物种群数量统计。
**锚点** 农学家相信软件会给出近乎准确的植株计数
**定位** 由于这套软件是在美国就同种作物、在看似相似的条件下开发出来的,农学家相信软件这次也会给出近乎准确的结果。
**改写** is sure that he will obtain a nearly accurate count of plant population ↔the agronomist feels confident that the software will produce a nearly accurate result “相信会给出”的同义对应
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
C C 段虽与 38 题共享 specialized software、accurate plant population count 这样的关键词,但段落主旨是 the farmer wants to determine if there are any parts of the field that require replanting,谈的是农户“想知道是否需要补种”这个诉求,从未出现“农学家相信会得到近乎准确结果”这一心态,因此不是 38 题源头段。the farmers and agronomist are looking to specialized software to give them an accurate plant population count F F 段的核心是 the agronomist's face begins to drop 与 he knows the instant he sees the data on his screen that the plant count is not correct,描述的是结果呈现之后农学家“判断结果不对”的反应,与题干“事前相信会准确”在时间顺序与态度上都相反,因此不是源头段。the agronomist's face begins to drop
questions.quote: With the software having been developed in the United States on the same variety of crops in seemingly similar conditions, the agronomist feels confident that the software will produce a nearly accurate result.

questions.prompt: The application of artificial intelligence to agriculture is much more challenging than to most other industries.
questions.explanation:
**答案** N 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
人工智能在农业领域的应用比在大多数其他行业要更具挑战性。
**锚点** AI 用于农业比多数其他行业更难
**定位** 因此,把机器学习和人工智能用在农业上的难处,并不在于科学家没能力开发出程序和协议来开始解决种植者最大的关切;难处在于多数情况下没有任何两个环境会完全相同,这使得这类技术的测试、验证以及成功推广,远比在多数其他行业里费力得多。
**改写** The application of artificial intelligence to agriculture is much more challenging than to most other industries↔makes the testing, validation and successful rollout of such technologies much more laborious than in most other industries “挑战大”=“费力得多”
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
O O 段核心是 we are still far from being able to predict critical outcomes in fields like agriculture purely through the cognitive ability of machines,强调的是“AI 目前能力的边界”,而不是“AI 用在农业比用在其他行业更难”这一比较;少了“跨行业比较”这一关键要件,因此排除。we are still far from being able to predict critical outcomes in fields like agriculture purely through the cognitive ability of machines
questions.quote: So the problem with deploying machine learning and artificial intelligence in agriculture is not that scientists lack the capacity to develop programs and protocols to begin to address the biggest of growers' concerns; the problem is that in most cases, no two environments will be exactly alike, which makes the testing, validation and successful rollout of such technologies much more laborious than in most other industries.

questions.prompt: Even the farmers know the data provided by the UAV is not correct.
questions.explanation:
**答案** F 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
即使是农民也知道无人机提供的数据是不正确的。
**锚点** 连农户都知道无人机数据不对
**定位** 由于他在飞行之前走过种植行、对地里实情有了亲身了解,屏幕上一出数据他立刻知道植株计数不对;就连那些农户们也看得出不对,虽然他们对怎么读遥感图理解有限。
**改写** Even the farmers know the data provided by the UAV is not correct ↔he knows the instant he sees the data on his screen that the plant count is not correct, and so do the farmers, even with their limited understanding of how to read remote sensing maps “even”+倒装 = 让步关系一致
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
E E 段核心 the agronomist feels confident that the software will produce a nearly accurate result 表达的是数据出来之前农学家“相信结果会准确”的态度,与题干“农户看出数据不对”在时间(事前vs事后)和态度(信心vs否定)两个维度上都相反,因此排除。the agronomist feels confident that the software will produce a nearly accurate result
questions.quote: Having walked through the planted rows before the flight to gain a physical understanding of the situation on the ground, he knows the instant he sees the data on his screen that the plant count is not correct, and so do the farmers, even with their limited understanding of how to read remote sensing maps.

questions.prompt: The pressure for quick results leads to product failure, which, in turn, arouses doubts about the applicability of AI technology to agriculture.
questions.explanation:
**答案** Q 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
对快速结果的压力导致产品失败,而这反过来又引发了对人工智能技术适用于农业的怀疑。
**锚点** 求快导致产品失败 → 引发对 AI 适用性的怀疑
**定位** 这通常导致产品失败,而产品失败又引起市场对它的质疑,并对机器学习技术的信誉造成打击。
**改写** The pressure for quick results ↔ This代词回指上一段的“快”压力leads to product failure ↔ results in a failure of a product “leads to”=“results in”,直接同义arouses doubts about the applicability of AI technology to agriculture ↔leads to skepticism from the market and delivers a blow to the integrity of Machine Learning technology “引起怀疑/质疑”的同义改写
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
P P 段只交代了“被资本推着尽快开发、尽快上市”这一压力,即 pushed to complete development as quickly as possible and then encouraged to flood the market as quickly as possible,但没有任何关于“导致产品失败、引发对 AI 适用性怀疑”的表述——只对上题干的“原因”一半,缺少题干的核心结果两环,因此排除。pushed to complete development as quickly as possible and then encouraged to flood the market as quickly as possible with their products
questions.quote: This usually results in a failure of a product, which leads to skepticism from the market and delivers a blow to the integrity of Machine Learning technology.

questions.prompt: Remote sensors are aimed to help farmers improve decision-making to increase yields.
questions.explanation:
**答案** H 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
远程传感器旨在帮助农民改善决策以提高产量。
**锚点** 遥感器 → 帮助农户改进决策 → 提高产量
**定位** 遥感器使算法能够把田间环境读为可被理解的统计数据,从而服务于农户的决策。算法处理这些数据,并根据接收到的数据进行自我调整与学习。采集到的输入和统计信息越多,算法对一系列结果的预测就越好。其目标是让农户借助这种人工智能,通过在田间做出更好的决策来达成更好的收成。
**改写** Remote sensors are aimed to help farmers ↔Remote sensors enable algorithms to interpret a field's environment as statistical data that can be understood and useful to farmers “aimed to help”=“enable…useful to”improve decision-making ↔ making better decisions in the field名词化与动词化的互换to increase yields ↔ to achieve their goal of a better harvest “更好的收成”=“提高产量”
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
B B 段核心 a four spectral band precision sensor that conducts onboard processing immediately after the flight, allowing farmers and field staff to address, almost immediately, any crop abnormalities 讲的是传感器的硬件配置与即时处理,没有提到“决策→收成”这条目标链,只对上题干“sensors”这一个词,缺少“目的→决策→产量”这一关键论点,因此排除。a four spectral band precision sensor that conducts onboard processing immediately after the flight, allowing farmers and field staff to address, almost immediately, any crop abnormalities
questions.quote: Remote sensors enable algorithms to interpret a field's environment as statistical data that can be understood and useful to farmers for decision-making. Algorithms process the data, adapting and learning based on the data received. The more inputs and statistical information collected, the better the algorithm will be at predicting a range of outcomes. And the aim is that farmers can use this artificial intelligence to achieve their goal of a better harvest through making better decisions in the field.

questions.prompt: The farmer expects the software to tell him whether he will have to replant any parts of his farm fields.
questions.explanation:
**答案** C 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
农民期望软件告诉他是否需要在他的农田的任何部分重新播种。
**锚点** 农户期望软件告诉自己是否要补种
**定位** 在这一场景里,农户和农学家指望专业软件给出准确的植株密度计数。玉米出苗已经有 10 天了,农户想确定是否有田块由于出苗不齐或风灾而需要补种——夏季雨季初期的风灾可能非常严重。
**改写** The farmer expects the software ↔the farmers and agronomist are looking to specialized software to give them an accurate plant population count “expects”=“are looking to”to tell him whether he will have to replant any parts of his farm fields ↔the farmer wants to determine if there are any parts of the field that require replanting due to a lack of emergence or wind damage “告诉他是否要补种”=“想要确定是否需要补种”
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
D D 段核心是 the farmer has another 10 days to conduct any replanting before the majority of his fertilizer and chemical applications need to occur 与 Once these have been applied, it becomes economically unviable to take corrective action,谈的是“还有 10 天可补种、施肥后再补救就不划算”,没有提“农户希望软件告诉自己是否补种”这一诉求,因此排除。the farmer has another 10 days to conduct any replanting before the majority of his fertilizer and chemical applications need to occur E E 段核心 the agronomist feels confident that the software will produce a nearly accurate result 描述的是农学家“相信结果会近乎准确”的心态,主语是农学家而非农户,内容是“信心”而非“想知道是否补种”,因此不是 43 题源头段。the agronomist feels confident that the software will produce a nearly accurate result
questions.quote: In this instance, the farmers and agronomist are looking to specialized software to give them an accurate plant population count. It's been 10 days since the corn emerged and the farmer wants to determine if there are any parts of the field that require replanting due to a lack of emergence or wind damage, which can be severe in the early stages of the summer rainy season.

questions.prompt: Agriculture proves very difficult to quantify because of the constantly changing conditions involved.
questions.explanation:
**答案** K 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
由于涉及不断变化的条件,农业被证明很难量化。
**锚点** 条件不断变化 → 农业极难量化
**定位** 因为农业是为统计量化划定边界最难的领域之一。即便在同一块田里,各区块之间的条件也在不断变化。
**改写** Agriculture proves very difficult to quantify ↔it is one of the most difficult fields to contain for the purpose of statistical quantification “难量化”=“为统计量化划界最难”because of the constantly changing conditions involved ↔conditions are always changing from one section to the next “不断变化的条件”=“条件总是从一处到另一处在变”
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
L L 段核心 these ecosystems are not contained 与 understanding how to manage an agricultural environment means taking literally many hundreds if not thousands of factors into account 谈的是“生态不受限、因素多”,不是直接讲“难量化的原因是条件不断变化”。题干的关键词“quantify”在 L 段并未出现,因此排除。understanding how to manage an agricultural environment means taking literally many hundreds if not thousands of factors into account
questions.quote: Because it is one of the most difficult fields to contain for the purpose of statistical quantification. Even within a single field, conditions are always changing from one section to the next.

questions.prompt: The same seed and fertilizer program may yield completely different outcomes in different places.
questions.explanation:
**答案** M 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
相同的种子和化肥方案可能在不同地方产生完全不同的结果。
**锚点** 同样的种子和肥料方案在不同地方结果可能完全不同
**定位** 在美国中西部地区用同一种子和肥料方案可能发生的情况,几乎一定与在澳大利亚或南非用同样的种子和肥料方案可能发生的情况无关。
**改写** The same seed and fertilizer program ↔ the same seed and fertilizer program原样复现may yield completely different outcomes in different places ↔What may occur … in the United States' Midwest region is almost certainly unrelated to what may occur … in Australia or South Africa用具体地点对比表达“不同地方结果不同”
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
L L 段核心 They are subject to climatic occurrences such as weather systems, which impact upon hemispheres as a whole, and from continent to continent在上位讲气候影响范围之大,但并没有把“同一种子和肥料方案在不同地区差异巨大”这一具体论点搬出来,缺少题干的核心名词短语,因此排除。They are subject to climatic occurrences such as weather systems, which impact upon hemispheres as a whole, and from continent to continent
questions.quote: What may occur with the same seed and fertilizer program in the United States' Midwest region is almost certainly unrelated to what may occur with the same seed and fertilizer program in Australia or South Africa.

title: Imagine that an alien species landed on Earth…

sentences.text: Imagine that an alien species landed on Earth and, through their mere presence, those aliens caused our art to vanish, our music to homogenize, and our technological know-how to disappear.
That is effectively what humans have been doing to our closest relatives—chimps(大猩猩).

passage.translation: 想象一下，如果外星物种降落在地球上，仅仅通过它们的存在，这些外星人就导致我们的艺术消失、我们的音乐趋于同质化、我们的技术知识消失殆尽。这实际上就是人类一直在对我们的近亲——大猩猩所做的事情。

sentences.text: Back in 1999, a team of scientists led by Andrew Whiten showed that chimps from different parts of Africa behave very differently from one another.
Some groups would get each other's attention by rapping branches with their knuckles(指关节), while others did it by loudly ripping leaves with their teeth.
The team identified 39 of these traditions that are practiced by some communities but not others—a pattern that, at the time, hadn't been seen in any animal except humans.
It was evidence, the team said, that chimps have their own cultures.

passage.translation: 早在1999年，由Andrew Whiten领导的一个科学家团队发现来自非洲不同地区的大猩猩彼此之间的行为方式非常不同。一些群体会通过用指关节敲击树枝来引起彼此的注意，而另一些群体则通过用牙齿大声撕扯树叶来做到这一点。该团队确定了39种这样的传统，这些传统被一些群体实践但其他群体不实践——这种模式在当时除了人类之外还没有在任何动物身上被发现过。该团队表示，这是大猩猩拥有自己文化的证据。

sentences.text: It took a long time to convince skeptics that such cultures exist, but now we have plenty of examples of animals learning local traditions from one another.

passage.translation: 说服怀疑者相信这种文化的存在花了很长时间，但现在我们有大量的例子表明动物会相互学习当地的传统。

sentences.text: But just when many scientists have come to accept the existence of animal cultures, many of those cultures might vanish.
Ammie Kalan and her colleagues have shown, through years of intensive fieldwork, that the very presence of humans has eroded the diversity of chimp behavior.
Where we flourish, their cultures wither.
It is a bitterly ironic thing to learn on the 20th anniversary of Whiten's classic study.

passage.translation: 但就在许多科学家开始接受动物文化存在的时候，这些文化中的许多可能会消失。Ammie Kalan和她的同事们通过多年的密集田野工作表明，人类的存在本身就削弱了大猩猩行为的多样性。在我们繁荣的地方，它们的文化就会衰退。在Whiten经典研究发表20周年之际得知这一点，是一件极具讽刺意味的事情。

sentences.text: "It's amazing to think that just 60 years ago, we knew next to nothing of the behavior of our sister species in the wild," Whiten says.
"But now, just as we are truly getting to know our primate(灵⻓类) cousins, the actions of humans are closing the window on all we have discovered."

passage.translation: Whiten说："令人惊讶的是，就在60年前，我们对野生姊妹物种的行为几乎一无所知。但现在，就在我们真正开始了解我们的灵长类表亲时，人类的行为正在关闭我们所发现的一切的窗口。"

sentences.text: "Sometimes in the rush to conserve the species, I think we forget about the individuals," says Cat Hobaiter, a professor at the University of St.
Andrews.
"Each population, each community, even each generation of chimps is unique.
An event might only have a small impact on the total population of chimps, but it may wipe out an entire community—an entire culture.
No matter what we do to restore habitat or support population growth, we may never be able to restore that culture."

passage.translation: 圣安德鲁斯大学教授Cat Hobaiter说："有时在匆忙保护物种的过程中，我认为我们忘记了个体。每个种群、每个群体，甚至每一代大猩猩都是独特的。一个事件可能只对大猩猩的总数量产生很小的影响，但它可能会消灭整个群体——整个文化。无论我们做什么来恢复栖息地或支持种群增长，我们可能永远无法恢复那种文化。"

sentences.text: No one knows whether the destruction of chimp culture is getting worse.
Few places have tracked chimp behavior over long periods, and those that have are also more likely to have protected their animals from human influence.

passage.translation: 没有人知道大猩猩文化的破坏是否正在恶化。很少有地方长期追踪大猩猩的行为，而那些追踪的地方也更有可能保护它们的动物免受人类影响。

sentences.text: Obviously, conservationists need to think about saving species in a completely new way—by preserving animal traditions as well as bodies and genes.
"Instead of focusing only on the conservation of genetically based entities like species, we now need to also consider culturally based entities," says Andrew Whiten.

passage.translation: 显然，自然保护主义者需要以一种全新的方式来思考拯救物种——不仅保护身体和基因，还要保护动物传统。Andrew Whiten说："除了只关注保护基于遗传的实体如物种之外，我们现在还需要考虑基于文化的实体。"

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What does the author say we humans have been doing to chimps?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者说我们人类一直在对黑猩猩做什么?
A) 毁坏它们的文化。
B) 加速它们的灭绝。
C) 把它们当作外来物种对待。
D) 使它们的生活习性同质化。
**判型** What does the author say we humans have been doing to chimps? 用 What…doing直接问一个具体行为，不含 infer/imply/main idea 等词，属常规细节题。
**拆句** What does the author say we humans have been doing to chimps? 是双层嵌套疑问：主干是 What does the author say…？say 后面接的是宾语从句 we humans have been doing to chimps，用现在完成进行时表示“一直在做”，提示动作持续至今。we humans 是同位结构，we 与 humans 同指。
**定位** 那就是人类一直在对我们最近的亲戚——黑猩猩——所做的事情。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确caused our art to vanish, our music to homogenize, and our technological know-how to disappear↔ Ruining their culture预判“破坏黑猩猩的文化”后在四项中找含 culture 与“破坏”语义的选项，只有 Ruining their culture 同时满足两点，锁定 A。
B) 无中生有原文谈的是文化的消亡而非物种的灭绝（extinction），首段没有任何extinction/extinct 的措辞，Accelerating their extinction 属凭印象自造。
C) 偷换概念原文是以“外星人对人类”类比“人类对黑猩猩”，并非说我们把黑猩猩当外星物种对待；Treating them as alien species 把比喻的本体与喻体倒置。
D) 偷换概念原文中 homogenize 修饰的是 music（音乐），且是外星人对人类做的比喻内容；选项把它直接搬到“黑猩猩的生活习性”上，搭配错误且对象错位。
questions.quote: That is effectively what humans have been doing to our closest relatives—chimps(大猩猩).

options.text: Ruining their culture.
Accelerating their extinction.
Treating them as alien species.
Homogenizing their living habits.

questions.prompt: What is the finding of Andrew Whiten's team?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
Andrew Whiten团队的研究发现是什么?
A) 黑猩猩展现出高度发达的交流技能。
B) 黑猩猩在交流时严重依赖它们的肢体语言。
C) 黑猩猩的行为方式与人类的行为方式十分相似。
D) 不同的黑猩猩群体在交流方式上存在差异。
**判型** What is the finding of Andrew Whiten's team? 直接问“某团队的发现是什么”，是对原文具体研究结论的客观提问，无推断词。
**拆句** 句式简单：主系表结构。What 作表语，主语 the finding 由 of 短语修饰；无从句、无否定，平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 早在 1999 年，由 Andrew Whiten 领导的一个科学家团队就证明：来自非洲不同地区的黑猩猩，行为方式彼此差异显著。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 过度推断原文只说不同群体方式不同，没有评价它们的交流技能“高度发达”；highly developed skills of communication 是程度词擅自拔高。
B) 过度推断原文只举了敲树枝、撕树叶两种方式，并未称这是“肢体语言”，更未说“重度依赖”；rely heavily upon their body language 是凭印象生造的论断。
C) 与原文相反本段说的是黑猩猩群体内部行为有别，没有说黑猩猩与人类的行为相似；behave in ways quite similar to those of human beings 把研究结论反向编造。
D) ✓ 正确chimps from different parts of Africa behave very differently from one another ↔Different chimp groups differ in their way of communication Some groups would get each other's attention by rapping branches with their knuckles(指关节), while others did it by loudly ripping leaves with their teeth↔ Different chimp groups differ in their way of communication预判“不同地区的黑猩猩行为方式不同”后，四项里同时含“差异”与“交流/沟通”要素的只有Different chimp groups differ in their way of communication，且有原文两处例证支撑，锁定 D。
questions.quote: Back in 1999, a team of scientists led by Andrew Whiten showed that chimps from different parts of Africa behave very differently from one another.

options.text: Chimps demonstrate highly developed skills of communication.
Chimps rely heavily upon their body language to communicate.
Chimps behave in ways quite similar to those of human beings.
Different chimp groups differ in their way of communication.

questions.prompt: What did Ammie Kalan and her colleagues find through their intensive fieldwork?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
Ammie Kalan和她的同事们通过深入的田野调查发现了什么?
A) Whiten的经典研究对黑猩猩行为多样性影响甚微。
B) 随着人类活动的增加,黑猩猩的行为变得更加单一。
C) 黑猩猩改变它们的文化以快速适应变化的环境。
D) 现在可能已经太迟,无法阻止动物文化的灭绝。
**判型** What did Ammie Kalan and her colleagues find through their intensive fieldwork? 直接询问发现内容，过去式动词 find 指向原文已陈述事实，非推断。
**拆句** 句子主干 What did A and B find，through 引导方式状语；过去式 did find 强调具体一次研究的结论。
**定位** Ammie Kalan 及其同事通过多年密集的田野调查证明：仅仅人类的存在就已经侵蚀了黑猩猩行为的多样性。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 张冠李戴本题问 Kalan 团队的发现，Whiten's classic study has little impact on the diversity of chimp behavior 转去说 Whiten 研究无影响，与题干主体错配；且原文 bitterly ironic thing to learn on the 20th anniversary of Whiten's classic study 是讽刺意味，不是论断 Whiten 研究无影响。
B) ✓ 正确the very presence of humans has eroded the diversity of chimp behavior ↔Chimp behavior becomes less varied with the increase of human activity预判“人类越多→黑猩猩行为越单一”后，四项中只有 Chimp behavior becomes less varied with the increase of human activity 同时覆盖“多样性下降”与“人类影响”两要素，锁定 B。
C) 与原文相反原文是 chimp behavior 的多样性被人类侵蚀（被动受害），Chimps alter their culture to quickly adapt to the changed environment 改成黑猩猩主动改文化以适应环境，主被动方向反了。
D) 过度推断It might already be too late to prevent animal cultures from extinction 表“为时已晚”，原文 Kalan 团队的发现只是“被侵蚀”，并未声明已经晚到无法挽回；类似感慨出现在 Whiten 引语，且未说“extinction”。
questions.quote: Ammie Kalan and her colleagues have shown, through years of intensive fieldwork, that the very presence of humans has eroded the diversity of chimp behavior.

options.text: Whiten's classic study has little impact on the diversity of chimp behavior.
Chimp behavior becomes less varied with the increase of human activity.
Chimps alter their culture to quickly adapt to the changed environment.
It might already be too late to prevent animal cultures from extinction.

questions.prompt: What does Cat Hobaiter think we should do for chimp conservation?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
Cat Hobaiter认为我们应该为黑猩猩保护做些什么?
A) 努力理解我们姐妹物种在野外的行为。
B) 努力保护每个单独的黑猩猩群落。
C) 研究每一代黑猩猩的独特特征。
D) 努力恢复黑猩猩的栖息地以扩大其总体数量。
**判型** What does Cat Hobaiter think we should do for chimp conservation? 问某专家的具体主张，原文有其直接引语，可一一对应，是细节题而非推断题。
**拆句** 主干 What does Cat Hobaiter think + 宾语从句 we should do…；for chimp conservation 是目的状语；think 后省略 that。
**定位** “在急于保育物种的时候，我们有时忘了个体，”圣安德鲁斯大学教授 Cat Hobaiter 说，“每个种群、每个社群，甚至每一代黑猩猩都是独特的。一件事情对黑猩猩总数的影响可能很小，却可能抹掉一整个社群——一整套文化。不管我们怎样恢复栖息地、支持种群增长，那种文化我们也许永远无法再造。”
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 张冠李戴Try to understand our sister species' behavior in the wild 与原文 we are truly getting to know our primate(灵长类) cousins 才对得上，是 Whiten 第 5 段的感慨，与 Hobaiter 立场无关。
B) ✓ 正确I think we forget about the individuals ↔Make efforts to preserve each individual chimp community Each population, each community, even each generation of chimps is unique ↔Make efforts to preserve each individual chimp community预判“按社群/个体单位保护”后，四项中只有 Make efforts to preserve each individual chimp community 准确体现 Hobaiter“不要遗忘个体/社群”的立场，锁定 B。
C) 偷换概念原文 Each population, each community, even each generation of chimps is unique 是说明每一代都独特、需要被保护，而非要求“研究每一代的独特特征”；Study the unique characteristics of each generation of chimps 把保护诉求歪成研究任务。
D) 与原文相反原文 No matter what we do to restore habitat or support population growth, we may never be able to restore that culture 是说即便恢复栖息地、扩大种群也救不回那种文化——这是 Hobaiter 强调不足以解决问题的反例。Endeavor to restore chimp habitats to expand its total population 反而把它当作她的主张。
questions.quote: "Sometimes in the rush to conserve the species, I think we forget about the individuals," says Cat Hobaiter, a professor at the University of St. Andrews. "Each population, each community, even each generation of chimps is unique. An event might only have a small impact on the total population of chimps, but it may wipe out an entire community—an entire culture. No matter what we do to restore habitat or support population growth, we may never be able to restore that culture."

options.text: Try to understand our sister species' behavior in the wild.
Make efforts to preserve each individual chimp community.
Study the unique characteristics of each generation of chimps.
Endeavor to restore chimp habitats to expand its total population.

questions.prompt: What does the author suggest conservationists do?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者建议保护主义者做什么?
A) 完全聚焦于基于文化的实体而非基于遗传的实体。
B) 更加重视动物传统而非它们的物理保护。
C) 以一种新颖而全面的方式保护动物物种。
D) 在物种消失之前探索它们的文化。
**判型** What does the author suggest conservationists do? 询问作者明示建议，原文末段有直白的论断句，是细节题而非主旨题。
**拆句** 主干 What does the author suggest + 宾语从句 conservationists do（do 后省略 do 的宾语，由 What 提到句首充当）；suggest 后省略 that 与 should，是英式建议句的常见省略形式。
**定位** 显然，保育工作者需要以一种全新的方式去思考物种保育——既要保护动物的身体与基因，也要保护它们的传统。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反原文是 traditions as well as bodies and genes（“而且也要”），强调兼顾；Focus entirely on culturally-based entities rather than genetically-based ones 用entirely 与 rather than 把作者立场改为“只保文化、不保基因”，方向反了。
B) 过度推断原文用 as well as 表并列、不分主次；Place more stress on animal traditions than on their physical conservation 用 more…than 给传统加权，引入原文没有的优先级判断。
C) ✓ 正确saving species in a completely new way ↔Conserve animal species in a novel and all-round way by preserving animal traditions as well as bodies and genes↔Conserve animal species in a novel and all-round way预判“以全新方式且兼顾两面”后，四项中只有 Conserve animal species in a novel and all-round way 同时具备“novel”（新）与“all-round”（兼顾），锁定 C。
D) 答非所问原文末段建议是“以全新方式保育”，不是“去探索文化”；Explore the cultures of species before they vanish 把 Whiten 第 5 段的感叹与作者建议混为一谈。
questions.quote: Obviously, conservationists need to think about saving species in a completely new way—by preserving animal traditions as well as bodies and genes.

options.text: Focus entirely on culturally-based entities rather than genetically-based ones.
Place more stress on animal traditions than on their physical conservation.
Conserve animal species in a novel and all-round way.
Explore the cultures of species before they vanish.

title: Why does social media trigger feelings of loneliness…

sentences.text: Why does social media trigger feelings of loneliness and inadequacy?

Because instead of being real life, it is, for the most part, impression management, a way of marketing yourself, carefully choosing and filtering the pictures and words to put your best face forward.

passage.translation: 为什么社交媒体会引发孤独感和不足感?因为社交媒体在很大程度上并非真实生活,而是印象管理,是一种自我营销的方式,通过精心选择和过滤图片与文字来展现最好的一面。

sentences.text: Online "friends" made through social media do not follow the normal psychological progression of an interpersonal relationship.
You share neither physical time nor emotional conversations over the Internet.
You simply communicate photographs and catchy posts to a diverse group of people whom you have "friended" or "followed" based on an accidental interaction.
This is not to say that your social media friends can't be real friends.
They absolutely can, but the two are not synonymous.
Generally speaking, there are no unfiltered comments or casually taken photos on our social media pages.
And, rightfully so, because it wouldn't feel safe to be completely authentic and vulnerable with some of our "friends" whom we don't actually know or with whom trust has yet to be built.

passage.translation: 通过社交媒体结交的线上"朋友"并不遵循人际关系的正常心理发展过程。你们既不共享实际相处的时间,也不在互联网上进行情感交流。你只是向一群多样化的人传播照片和吸引眼球的帖子,而这些人是你基于偶然互动而"加为好友"或"关注"的。这并不是说你的社交媒体朋友不能成为真正的朋友。他们完全可以,但两者并不等同。一般来说,我们的社交媒体页面上不会有未经过滤的评论或随意拍摄的照片。这是理所当然的,因为对我们某些实际上并不认识或尚未建立信任关系的"朋友"完全真实和展露脆弱并不会让人感到安全。

sentences.text: Social media can certainly be an escape from the daily grind, but we must be cautioned against the negative effects, such as addiction, on a person's overall psychological well-being.

passage.translation: 社交媒体当然可以成为逃离日常琐事的方式,但我们必须警惕其对个人整体心理健康的负面影响,比如成瘾。

sentences.text: As humans, we yearn for social connection.
Scrolling(滚动) through pages of pictures and comments, however, does not provide the same degree of fulfillment as face-to-face interactions do.
Also, we tend to idealize others' lives and compare our downfalls to their greatest accomplishments, ending in feelings of loneliness and inadequacy.

passage.translation: 作为人类,我们渴望社交联系。然而,翻阅一页页的图片和评论并不能提供与面对面互动同等程度的满足感。而且,我们往往会理想化他人的生活,将我们的失意与他们最大的成就相比较,最终产生孤独感和不足感。

sentences.text: Social media can lead people on the unhealthy quest for perfection.
Some people begin to attend certain events or travel to different places so that they can snap that "perfect" photo.
They begin to seek validation through the number of people who "like" their posts.
In order for it to play a psychologically healthy role in your social life, social media should supplement an already healthy social network.

Pictures and posts should be byproducts of life's treasured moments and fun times, not the planned and calculated image that one is putting out into cyberspace in an attempt to fill insecurities or unmet needs.

passage.translation: 社交媒体会引导人们进行不健康的完美追求。有些人开始参加某些活动或到不同地方旅行,以便拍摄那张"完美"的照片。他们开始通过"点赞"帖子的人数来寻求认可。为了让社交媒体在你的社交生活中发挥心理健康的作用,它应该是对已经健康的社交网络的补充。图片和帖子应该是生活中珍贵时刻和快乐时光的副产品,而不是为了填补不安全感或未满足的需求而向网络空间投放的经过计划和精心设计的形象。

sentences.text: Ultimately, social media has increased our ability to connect with various types of people all over the globe.
It has opened doors for businesses and allowed us to stay connected to people whom we may not otherwise get to follow.
However, social media should feel like a fun experience, not one that contributes to negative thoughts and feelings.

If the latter is the case, increasing face-to-face time with trusted friends, and minimizing time scrolling online, will prove to be a reminder that your social network is much more rewarding than any "like," "follow" or "share" can be.

passage.translation: 最终,社交媒体增强了我们与全球各类人群联系的能力。它为企业打开了大门,让我们能够与那些原本可能无法关注的人保持联系。然而,社交媒体应该是一种有趣的体验,而不是助长消极想法和情绪的体验。如果是后者,增加与值得信赖的朋友面对面相处的时间,减少在线翻阅的时间,将会提醒你,你的社交网络比任何"点赞"、"关注"或"分享"都更有价值。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What does the author imply social media may do to our life?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （推断题）
**题目译文**
作者暗示社交媒体可能对我们的生活产生什么影响？
A) 它可能促进我们的人际关系。
B) 它可能过滤我们对他人的负面印象。
C) 它可能使我们感到孤立和无能。
D) 它可能使我们变得脆弱且不真实。
**判型** What does the author imply social media may do to our life 用 imply 提问,要求从原文已有陈述向前迈一步得出结论。
**拆句** What does the author imply social media may do to our life 是嵌套疑问:主干是 What does the author imply,后面省略了 that 的从句 (that) social media may do to our life,问的是"作者暗示社交媒体可能对我们生活做什么",结构平铺,无陷阱。
**定位** 社交媒体为何会触发孤独感与不胜任感?因为它在很大程度上并不是真实生活,而是一种印象管理,一种自我营销的方式——刻意挑选并过滤图片和文字,以便把自己最好的一面端出来。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反facilitate our interpersonal relationships 说社媒"促进"人际关系,而首段把社媒定性为impression management,后文一直在警示其负面后果,方向反了。
B) 偷换概念filter our negative impressions of others 把原文"过滤自己呈现给别人的图文"偷换成"过滤我们对别人的负面印象",filter 的宾语完全错位。
C) ✓ 正确feelings of loneliness ↔ feel isolated inadequacy ↔ incompetent预判出的"孤立感+自觉不如人"两点恰好被 feel isolated and incompetent 一对一覆盖,无新增、无遗漏,故锁 C。
D) 偷换概念render us vulnerable and inauthentic 把原文段二里描述"对网友坦诚会感到不安全/不真实"的状态硬安到"社交媒体对我们生活做了什么"上,主语接受方错配,且 vulnerable 与inauthentic 在原文是被规避的状态,不是社媒造成的结果。
questions.quote: Why does social media trigger feelings of loneliness and inadequacy? Because instead of being real life, it is, for the most part, impression management, a way of marketing yourself, carefully choosing and filtering the pictures and words to put your best face forward.

options.text: It may facilitate our interpersonal relationships.
It may filter our negative impressions of others.
It may make us feel isolated and incompetent.
It may render us vulnerable and inauthentic.

questions.prompt: Why do people post comments selectively on social media?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
人们为什么在社交媒体上有选择地发布评论？
A) 他们认为并非所有网友都值得信任。
B) 他们想避免冒犯任何受众。
C) 他们不想失去关注者。
D) 他们渴望提升自己的人气。
**判型** Why do people post comments selectively on social media 问的是文中已陈述现象的具体原因,定位句一找就有,属细节题不是推断题。
**拆句** Why do people post comments selectively on social media 主干 people post comments,selectively 作方式状语,Why 引导特殊疑问,结构平铺,无陷阱。
**定位** 而且这样做有其道理,因为对那些我们其实并不真正了解、或彼此尚未建立信任的"朋友",完全坦诚、毫无防备地暴露自己,会让人觉得不安全。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确friends whom we don't actually know or with whom trust has yet to be built ↔do not find all their online friends trustworthy it wouldn't feel safe to be completely authentic and vulnerable ↔do not find all their online friends trustworthy预判出的"对没建立信任的网友不敢全坦白"被 They do not find all their online friends trustworthy 同义浓缩,故锁 A。
B) 无中生有avoid offending any of their audience 提到"避免冒犯任何受众",原文从未涉及"冒犯"这一动机,作者只谈"不安全/不值得坦诚",未谈"怕惹到人"。
C) 无中生有do not want to lose their followers 把动机说成"怕掉粉",原文谈的是信任与安全,从未提及 followers 这一概念,该选项的概念在文中无据。
D) 与原文相反eager to boost their popularity 把动机定为"急于提升人气",而原文恰恰是因为缺乏信任、感到不安才有所保留,谈的是防御性动机,而非进取性动机,方向反了。
questions.quote: And, rightfully so, because it wouldn't feel safe to be completely authentic and vulnerable with some of our "friends" whom we don't actually know or with whom trust has yet to be built.

options.text: They do not find all their online friends trustworthy.
They want to avoid offending any of their audience.
They do not want to lose their followers.
They are eager to boost their popularity.

questions.prompt: What are humans inclined to do according to the passage?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
根据文章，人类倾向于做什么？
A) 夸大自己的人生成就。
B) 不惜代价追求完美。
C) 美化他人的生活。
D) 从他人的失败中吸取教训。
**判型** according to the passage 明确指向原文已有陈述,不要求推断,典型细节题问法。
**拆句** What are humans inclined to do according to the passage 主干 humans are inclined to do what,被动结构 be inclined to do 等于 tend to do,according to the passage 是来源状语,无陷阱。
**定位** 此外,我们倾向于把别人的生活理想化,把自己的低谷与别人最辉煌的成就相比,结果陷入孤独感与不胜任感。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 张冠李戴Exaggerate their life's accomplishments 把"夸大成就"归到 humans 身上,但原文their greatest accomplishments 的 their 指的是"别人(他人)的",不是"我们的";选项偷换了主语。
B) 答非所问Strive for perfection regardless of the cost 说的是第 5 段"unhealthy quest for perfection"那条线,虽然原文确有,但回答的是"社交媒体把人推向什么",而非题干所问的"humans 倾向于做什么"。
C) ✓ 正确idealize others' lives ↔ Paint a rosy picture of other people's lives others' lives ↔ other people's lives预判的"把别人生活想象得太美"恰被 Paint a rosy picture of other people's lives 一对一覆盖,故锁 C。
D) 与原文相反Learn lessons from other people's downfalls 说"从别人的低谷中吸取教训",原文恰相反:是把自己的低谷与别人的高光相比,downfalls 的归属和功能都被翻转。
questions.quote: Also, we tend to idealize others' lives and compare our downfalls to their greatest accomplishments, ending in feelings of loneliness and inadequacy.

options.text: Exaggerate their life's accomplishments.
Strive for perfection regardless of the cost.
Paint a rosy picture of other people's lives.
Learn lessons from other people's downfalls.

questions.prompt: What is the author's view of pictures and posts on social media?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者如何看待社交媒体上的图片和帖子？
A) 它们应该记录人们生活中值得纪念的时刻。
B) 它们应该经过精心编辑以呈现最佳形象。
C) 它们应该以满足个人安全需求的方式展示。
D) 它们应该使人们远离不健康的完美追求。
**判型** What is the author's view of pictures and posts on social media 作者已经在文中以should 句明示自己的看法,属细节题不是态度题。
**拆句** What is the author's view of pictures and posts on social media 主干 What is the author's view,of pictures and posts 限定 view,on social media 限定 pictures and posts,层层套定状语,但理解上无歧义。
**定位** 照片和发文应当是生活中那些值得珍藏的时刻与欢乐时光的副产品,而不是为了填补不安全感或未被满足的需求,而精心策划、刻意计算后投放到网络空间的人设形象。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确byproducts of life's treasured moments and fun times ↔record the memorable moments in people's lives life's treasured moments and fun times ↔ the memorable moments in people's lives预判的"自然记录生活美好瞬间"被 record the memorable moments in people's lives一对一覆盖,故锁 A。
B) 与原文相反carefully edited so as to present the best image 正是作者要批驳的"经营人设"做法,作者用 not the planned and calculated image 明确否定,选项却把它当成应当之事,立场反了。
C) 偷换概念in a way that meets one's security needs 用了原文 insecurities 的对面词 security needs,把作者批评的"用社媒填补 insecurities"偷换为"应当满足安全需求",借同根词制造伪等值。
D) 答非所问keep people from the unhealthy quest for perfection 是作者对社交媒体整体使用方式的告诫,而非作者对 pictures and posts 本身的看法,答的不是本题所问。
questions.quote: Pictures and posts should be byproducts of life's treasured moments and fun times, not the planned and calculated image that one is putting out into cyberspace in an attempt to fill insecurities or unmet needs.

options.text: They should record the memorable moments in people's lives.
They should be carefully edited so as to present the best image.
