**辨邻**
J J 段虽也讲 Twenge 团队与 screen time，但讲的是“结论 + 新研究比以往更进一步”，没有“明确声明不在证因果”的立场转换。The researchers conclude that electronic communication was the only adolescent activity that increased
questions.quote: This time around, Twenge and her team make a point of saying that they are not trying to establish causes as such, but that they are assessing the plausibility of potential causes.

questions.prompt: In the last few decades of the 20th century, living standards went up and economic depressions were largely averted in the US.
questions.explanation:
**答案** B 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
在20世纪最后几十年里,美国的生活水平提高了,经济萧条在很大程度上得以避免。
**锚点** 强锚点：last few decades of the 20th century + economic depressions averted
**定位** 这反映了一个事实：这些数十年里，整体生活水平不断上升，并避开了像全面战争或经济剥夺这样的大规模社会创伤。
**改写** In the last few decades of the 20th century ↔ from the 1960s into the early 2000s 20 世纪最后几十年 ↔ 1960s 起的时段living standards went up ↔ a climb in general standards of living go up ↔ climb 同义；动词 vs. 名词化economic depressions were largely averted ↔avoidance of mass societal traumas like full-scale war or economic deprivation averted ↔ avoidance；economic depressions ↔ economic deprivation
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
I 题干要的是“上升 + 萧条被避开”的乐观叙事，I 段反而是“大衰退发生 + 其影响是否到福祉”，时段不在 20 世纪，立意也是负面事件而非正面避开，差异显著。the impact of the great recession of 2007-2009
questions.quote: It reflected the fact that these decades saw a climb in general standards of living and avoidance of mass societal traumas like full-scale war or economic deprivation.

questions.prompt: Contrary to popular belief, doing homework might add to students' wellbeing.
questions.explanation:
**答案** E 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
与普遍看法相反,做作业可能会增加学生的幸福感。
**锚点** 强锚点：doing homework + 反直觉
**定位** （这最后一项发现似乎与另一个流行假说相矛盾——那个假说认为，正是给学生布置作业的重负在引发所有问题。）
**改写** Contrary to popular belief ↔ would appear to contradict another popular hypothesis contrary to popular belief ↔ contradict popular hypothesis 同义结构doing homework might add to students' wellbeing ↔less time doing homework correlated with lower wellbeing反向推理：少做作业相关于低福祉 = 做作业利好福祉popular belief ↔it is our burdening of students with assignments that is causing all the problems通俗看法的具体内容即“作业过重 = 万恶之源”
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
F F 段与题干都涉及福祉，但讨论的影响因素是屏幕时间而非作业，不能命中要求homework 的题。digital devices—a couple of hours a week—had the highest wellbeing
questions.quote: (This last finding would appear to contradict another popular hypothesis that it is our burdening of students with assignments that is causing all the problems.)

questions.prompt: The author believes the researchers' new study has gone a step further regarding the impact of screen time on wellbeing.
questions.explanation:
**答案** J 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
作者认为研究人员的这项新研究在屏幕时间对幸福感的影响方面更进了一步。
**锚点** 强锚点：author believes + gone a step further
**定位** 但这项新研究确实比以往的研究更进一步，并提示屏幕时间仍应被视为青少年发展繁荣的潜在障碍。
**改写** The author believes ↔I suspect that some experts in the field will be keen to address alternative explanations原文用 I suspect 标明作者第一人称视角has gone a step further regarding the impact of screen time on wellbeing ↔the new work does go further than previous research and suggests that screen time should still be considered a potential barrier to young people's flourishing gone a step further ↔ go further than previous research；screen time on wellbeing ↔screen time as barrier to flourishing
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
D D 段主语是 Twenge and her team（研究者），J 段才出现 I suspect / new work does go further 这种作者主语；题干要的是后者。Twenge and her team make a point of saying that they are not trying to establish causes as such
questions.quote: But the new work does go further than previous research and suggests that screen time should still be considered a potential barrier to young people's flourishing.

questions.prompt: The researchers found that extended screen time makes young people less happy.
questions.explanation:
**答案** F 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
研究人员发现,过长的屏幕时间使年轻人不那么快乐。
**锚点** 强锚点：extended screen time + less happy
**定位** 然而，更高剂量的屏幕时间明显与更低的快乐感相关。
**改写** extended screen time ↔ higher doses of screen time extended ↔ higher doses 同义makes young people less happy ↔ were clearly associated with lower happiness less happy ↔ lower happiness 同义；makes ↔ associated with 强弱差异需注意less happy ↔Those spending 10-19 hours per week on their devices were 41 percent more likely to be unhappy百分比数据支撑“剂量 ↔ 不快乐”的断言
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
G G 段粒度是“年份层面”的同步追踪，F 段才是“个体层面”的剂量-不开心关系。题干extended screen time makes young people less happy 描述的是个体剂量效应，归属 F 段。wellbeing was indeed lowest in years where adolescents spent more time online J J 段给的是“电子通讯增加 + 福祉下降”的同步关系，题干则在问“剂量延长 → 不开心”这种个体层面剂量效应，最匹配仍是 F 段。electronic communication was the only adolescent activity that increased at the same time psychological wellbeing declined
questions.quote: However, higher doses of screen time were clearly associated with lower happiness.

questions.prompt: Data reveals that economic inequality rather than family income might affect people's wellbeing.
questions.explanation:
**答案** I 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
数据显示,经济不平等而非家庭收入可能影响人们的幸福感。
**锚点** 强锚点：economic inequality + family income 对比
**定位** 他们发现了一些证据：像收入不平等这样的粗略指标与福祉变化相关，但更直接影响家庭的经济指标，如家庭收入与失业率，却与福祉没有关系。
**改写** economic inequality ↔ income inequality economic inequality ↔ income inequality 同义rather than family income ↔family income and unemployment rates ... had no relationship with wellbeing rather than ↔ 原文“前者相关、后者无关”对比might affect people's wellbeing ↔ correlated with changes in wellbeing might affect ↔ correlated with 弱化等值
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
B B 段虽提及经济议题，但缺失题干要求的“economic inequality vs. family income”的对比要素，故仅话题相邻。avoidance of mass societal traumas like full-scale war or economic deprivation
questions.quote: They found some evidence that some crude measures, like income inequality, correlated with changes in wellbeing, but economic measures with a more direct impact, like family income and unemployment rates (which put families into difficulties), had no relationship with wellbeing.

questions.prompt: Too much screen time is widely believed to be the cause of unhappiness among today's young people.
questions.explanation:
**答案** A 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
过多的屏幕时间被广泛认为是当今年轻人不快乐的原因。
**锚点** 强锚点：widely believed to be the cause + 通俗看法
**定位** 并且，在一些专家和大众媒体中，最流行的解释之一是：过度的“屏幕时间”是罪魁祸首。
**改写** Too much screen time ↔ excessive "screen time" too much ↔ excessive 同义widely believed to be the cause↔one of the most popular explanations, among some experts and the popular media, is that excessive "screen time" is to blame widely believed ↔ popular explanations / is to blame ↔ cause unhappiness among today's young people ↔ all is not well for our youth all is not well ↔ unhappiness 婉转表达
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
J 题干 widely believed 指公众/媒体的流行看法，源自开篇引出议题的 A 段；J 段是末尾研究者结论，性质不同。screen time should still be considered a potential barrier to young people's flourishing
questions.quote: And one of the most popular explanations, among some experts and the popular media, is that excessive "screen time" is to blame.

title: Rising temperatures and overfishing in the pristine(未受污染的) waters…

sentences.text: Rising temperatures and overfishing in the pristine(未受污染的) waters around the Antarctic could see king penguin populations pushed to the brink of extinction by the end of the century, according to a new study.

The study's report states that as global warming transforms the environment in the world's last great wilderness, 70 percent of king penguins could either disappear or be forced to find new breeding grounds.

passage.translation: 根据一项新研究，南极洲周围未受污染水域的气温上升和过度捕捞可能会使帝企鹅种群在本世纪末被推到灭绝的边缘。该研究报告指出，随着全球变暖改变世界上最后一片大荒原的环境,70%的帝企鹅可能会消失或被迫寻找新的繁殖地。

sentences.text: Co-author Celine Le Bohec, from the University of Strasbourg in France, warned: "If there are no actions aimed at halting or controlling global warming, and the pace of the current human-induced changes such as climate change and overfishing stays the same, the species may soon disappear."
The findings come amid growing concern over the future of the Antarctic.

Earlier this month a separate study found that a combination of climate change and industrial fishing is threatening the krill(磷虾) population in Antarctic waters, with a potentially disastrous impact on whales, seals and penguins.
But today's report is the starkest warning yet of the potentially devastating impact of climate change and human exploitation on the Antarctic's delicate ecosystems.

passage.translation: 来自法国斯特拉斯堡大学的合著者Celine Le Bohec警告说:"如果没有旨在遏制或控制全球变暖的行动,并且当前人类引起的变化(如气候变化和过度捕捞)的速度保持不变,该物种可能很快就会消失。"这些发现是在人们对南极洲未来日益担忧的情况下得出的。本月早些时候,另一项独立研究发现,气候变化和工业捕捞的结合正在威胁南极水域的磷虾种群,这可能对鲸鱼、海豹和企鹅产生灾难性影响。但今天的报告是迄今为止对气候变化和人类开发对南极脆弱生态系统潜在破坏性影响的最严厉警告。

sentences.text: Le Bohec said: "Unless current greenhouse gas emissions drop, 70 percent of king penguins—1.1 million breeding pairs—will be forced to relocate their breeding grounds, or face extinction by 2100."
King penguins are the second-largest type of penguin and only breed on specific isolated islands in the Southern Ocean where there is no ice cover and easy access to the sea.
As the ocean warms, a body of water called the Antarctic Polar Front—an upward movement of nutrient-rich sea that supports a huge abundance of marine life—is being pushed further south.
This means that king penguins, which feed on fish and krill in this body of water, have to travel further to their feeding grounds, leaving their hungry chicks for longer.
And as the distance between their breeding grounds and their food grows, entire colonies could be wiped out.

passage.translation: Le Bohec说:"除非当前的温室气体排放量下降,否则70%的帝企鹅——110万对繁殖对——将被迫迁移其繁殖地,或者在2100年前面临灭绝。"帝企鹅是第二大企鹅种类,只在南大洋的特定孤立岛屿上繁殖,这些岛屿没有冰层覆盖且容易进入海洋。随着海洋变暖,一片被称为南极极锋的水体——一种支撑着大量海洋生物的富含营养物质的海水上升运动——正被推向更南方。这意味着以这片水域中的鱼类和磷虾为食的帝企鹅必须长途跋涉到它们的觅食地,使它们饥饿的雏鸟等待更长时间。随着繁殖地和食物之间的距离增加,整个种群可能被消灭。

sentences.text: Le Bohec said: "The plight of the king penguin should serve as a warning about the future of the entire marine environment in the Antarctic.
Penguins, like other seabirds and marine mammals, occupy higher levels in the food chain and they are what we call bio-indicators of their ecosystems."
Penguins are sensitive indicators of changes in marine ecosystems.
As such, they are key species for understanding and predicting impacts of global change on Antarctic and sub-Antarctic marine ecosystems.
The report found that although some king penguins may be able to relocate to new breeding grounds closer to their retreating food source, suitable new habitats would be scarce.
Only a handful of islands in the Southern Ocean are suitable for sustaining large breeding colonies.

passage.translation: Le Bohec说:"帝企鹅的困境应该成为对南极整个海洋环境未来的警告。企鹅,像其他海鸟和海洋哺乳动物一样,占据食物链的较高层级,它们是我们所说的生态系统的生物指示物。"企鹅是海洋生态系统变化的敏感指标。因此,它们是理解和预测全球变化对南极和亚南极海洋生态系统影响的关键物种。报告发现,尽管一些帝企鹅可能能够迁移到更靠近其后退的食物来源的新繁殖地,但合适的新栖息地将会稀缺。南大洋只有少数几个岛屿适合维持大型繁殖群落。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What will happen by 2100, according to a new study?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
根据一项新研究,到2100年将会发生什么?
A) 南极的帝企鹅将濒临灭绝。
B) 南极周围的海水将上升到更高的水平。
C) 融化的冰盖将摧毁南极广袤的荒原。
D) 南极周围的原始水域将永远消失。
**判型** What will happen by 2100 是对特定时间点将发生事件的客观询问，没有 infer、suggest、imply 等推断信号词。
**拆句** What will happen by 2100, according to a new study? 主干是 What will happen，by 2100 是时间状语，according to a new study 是来源状语，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 据一项新研究，南极未受污染水域的气温上升与过度捕捞，可能使帝企鹅种群在本世纪末濒临灭绝。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确king penguin populations pushed to the brink of extinction ↔King penguins in the Antarctic will be on the verge of dying out.预判要的「濒临灭绝」与 on the verge of dying out 形成短语级的等值同义替换，且时间状语 by 2100 与原文一致。
B) 无中生有Sea water will rise to a much higher level around the Antarctic. 讲的是海平面上升，原文只说 Rising temperatures（气温上升），没说海平面上升。
C) 偷换概念The melting ice cover will destroy the great Antarctic wilderness. 说南极荒野将被冰盖融化摧毁。原文虽提到 world's last great wilderness，但说的是企鹅可能灭绝，而非荒野被毁；melting ice cover 也未在文中作为 2100 年的预测出现。
D) 与原文相反The pristine waters around the Antarctic will disappear forever. 说南极纯净水域将永远消失。原文 pristine\(未受污染的\) waters around the Antarctic 只是被借来限定位置，根本没说这片水域会消失，反而是研究警告水域里的生物会消失。
questions.quote: Rising temperatures and overfishing in the pristine(未受污染的) waters around the Antarctic could see king penguin populations pushed to the brink of extinction by the end of the century, according to a new study.

options.text: King penguins in the Antarctic will be on the verge of dying out.
Sea water will rise to a much higher level around the Antarctic.
The melting ice cover will destroy the great Antarctic wilderness.
The pristine waters around the Antarctic will disappear forever.

questions.prompt: What do we learn from the findings of a separate study?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
我们从另一项研究的发现中了解到什么?
A) 磷虾数量减少和气温上升可能迫使南极鲸类迁徙。
B) 近年来人类活动加速了南极地区的气候变化。
C) 工业捕捞和气候变化可能对某些南极物种是致命的。
D) 南极的磷虾捕捞加剧了原始水域的污染。
**判型** What do we learn from the findings of a separate study? 问的是另一项研究的具体结论，客观转述即可。
**拆句** What do we learn from the findings of a separate study? 主干 What do we learn，from the findings of a separate study 整体作介词短语状语，无复杂从句、无否定，无陷阱。
**定位** 本月早些时候另一项独立研究发现，气候变化和工业捕捞的共同作用正威胁着南极水域的磷虾种群，可能对鲸、海豹和企鹅造成灾难性影响。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 过度推断Shrinking krill population and rising temperatures could force Antarctic whales to migrate. 把鲸迁徙写成结论，但原文只说对鲸有 disastrous impact，并未说鲸会迁徙。
B) 答非所问Human activities have accelerated climate change in the Antarctic region in recent years. 说人类活动加速了气候变化，是另一个层面的话题，原 separate study的结论不是这个。
C) ✓ 正确a combination of climate change and industrial fishing ↔Industrial fishing and climate change with a potentially disastrous impact on whales, seals and penguins ↔could be fatal to certain Antarctic species「合力」和「灾难性影响」两个核心节点均被 C 项以同义替换形式覆盖，且范围词certain 与原文 whales, seals and penguins 的有限枚举一致。
D) 无中生有Krill fishing in the Antarctic has worsened the pollution of the pristine waters. 说磷虾捕捞恶化了水污染，原文从未谈水域被污染，只是用 pristine 形容尚未污染。
questions.quote: Earlier this month a separate study found that a combination of climate change and industrial fishing is threatening the krill(磷虾) population in Antarctic waters, with a potentially disastrous impact on whales, seals and penguins.

options.text: Shrinking krill population and rising temperatures could force Antarctic whales to migrate.
Human activities have accelerated climate change in the Antarctic region in recent years.
Industrial fishing and climate change could be fatal to certain Antarctic species.
Krill fishing in the Antarctic has worsened the pollution of the pristine waters.

questions.prompt: What does the passage say about king penguins?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
文章关于帝企鹅说了什么?
A) 它们将成为第二大灭绝鸟类物种。
B) 它们中的许多将不得不迁徙到南大洋的孤立岛屿。
C) 它们主要以南极极锋的几种磷虾为食。
D) 它们中的大多数未来可能不得不寻找新的繁殖地。
**判型** What does the passage say about king penguins? 问的是「文章直接说了什么」，不是infer 也不是 main idea，属于针对核心对象的客观信息题。
**拆句** What does the passage say about king penguins? 主干 What does the passage say，about king penguins 介宾短语作 say 的宾语补足说明，无从句无否定，无陷阱。
**定位** 除非当前温室气体排放下降，否则 70\% 的帝企鹅——110 万对繁殖伴侣——将被迫迁移繁殖地，或在 2100 年面临灭绝。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念They will turn out to be the second-largest species of birds to become extinct. 把原文 King penguins are the second-largest type of penguin（第二大企鹅种类）偷换成「第二大将灭绝的鸟类」。
B) 与原文相反Many of them will have to migrate to isolated islands in the Southern Ocean. 说企鹅将迁往孤立岛屿，可原文 only breed on specific isolated islands in the Southern Ocean 是说它们本来就只在这些岛上繁殖，不是迁过去。
C) 以偏概全They feed primarily on only a few kinds of krill in the Antarctic Polar Front. 说企鹅主要只吃几种磷虾，原文 king penguins, which feed on fish and krill in this body of water 明明是鱼和磷虾两类，且没说限定几种。
D) ✓ 正确70 percent of king penguins ↔ The majority of them will be forced to relocate their breeding grounds ↔may have to find new breeding grounds in the future数量节点（70\% ↔ majority）和动作节点（被迫迁繁殖地 ↔ 找新繁殖地）双双等值，锁定 D。
questions.quote: Unless current greenhouse gas emissions drop, 70 percent of king penguins—1.1 million breeding pairs—will be forced to relocate their breeding grounds, or face extinction by 2100.

options.text: They will turn out to be the second-largest species of birds to become extinct.
Many of them will have to migrate to isolated islands in the Southern Ocean.
They feed primarily on only a few kinds of krill in the Antarctic Polar Front.
The majority of them may have to find new breeding grounds in the future.

questions.prompt: What happens when sea levels rise in the Antarctic?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
当南极海平面上升时会发生什么?
A) 许多帝企鹅幼鸟无法及时获得食物。
B) 许多帝企鹅可能无法再以磷虾为食。
C) 鲸类将侵入帝企鹅的繁殖地。
D) 鲸类将不得不长途跋涉寻找食物。
**判型** What happens when sea levels rise in the Antarctic? 问的是某条件发生时的直接客观后果，不涉及推断或态度。
**拆句** What happens when sea levels rise in the Antarctic? 主干 What happens，when sea levels rise in the Antarctic 是 when 引导的时间/条件状语从句，结构清晰。注意 sea levels rise 是题干的转述，原文真正描述的是「ocean warms（海洋升温）」，需要按因果链而非字面去匹配。
**定位** 随着海洋升温，名为南极极锋的水体——一股富含营养的海水上涌、支撑着大量海洋生物——正在被推向更南方。这意味着以这片水域中的鱼和磷虾为食的帝企鹅必须前往更远处觅食，使饥饿的幼鸟被独留更长时间。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确leaving their hungry chicks for longer ↔ Many baby king penguins can't have food in time.预判要的「幼鸟挨饿」与 can't have food in time 完全等值；其余选项都偏离这条因果链的末端。
B) 过度推断Many king penguins could no longer live on krill. 说企鹅再也不能靠磷虾为生，但原文只说他们要跑更远去吃，不是再也吃不到。
C) 无中生有Whales will invade king penguins' breeding grounds. 说鲸入侵企鹅繁殖地，全文未提此事。
D) 张冠李戴Whales will have to travel long distances to find food. 描述了鲸要长途觅食，但原文长途觅食的是 king penguins 而不是鲸。
questions.quote: As the ocean warms, a body of water called the Antarctic Polar Front—an upward movement of nutrient-rich sea that supports a huge abundance of marine life—is being pushed further south. This means that king penguins, which feed on fish and krill in this body of water, have to travel further to their feeding grounds, leaving their hungry chicks for longer.

options.text: Many baby king penguins can't have food in time.
Many king penguins could no longer live on krill.
Whales will invade king penguins' breeding grounds.
Whales will have to travel long distances to find food.

questions.prompt: What do we learn about the Southern Ocean?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
我们对南大洋了解到什么?
A) 那里的帝企鹅不愿离开去新的繁殖地。
B) 保护南大洋是南极物种可持续繁衍的关键。
C) 它最有可能成为帝企鹅等物种的最终避难所。
D) 只有少数岛屿可以作为帝企鹅的大型繁殖地。
**判型** What do we learn about the Southern Ocean? 问的是关于南大洋的客观信息，无推断/态度信号词。
**拆句** What do we learn about the Southern Ocean? 主干 What do we learn，about the Southern Ocean 介宾短语限定范围，无从句无否定，无陷阱。
**定位** 南大洋只有少数岛屿适合维持大规模的繁殖群落。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有The king penguins there are reluctant to leave for new breeding grounds. 说企鹅不愿离开，原文从未描述企鹅的意愿，只说迁徙是「被迫」。
B) 过度推断Its conservation is key to the sustainable propagation of Antarctic species. 说南大洋的保护对南极物种可持续繁衍至关重要。原文只说企鹅是 bio-indicators 而未谈「南大洋保护是关键」。
C) 与原文相反It is most likely to become the ultimate retreat for species like the king penguin.说南大洋很可能成为终极避难所，原文反而说「合适的新栖息地稀缺」，方向与之相悖。
D) ✓ 正确Only a handful of islands in the Southern Ocean↔ Only a few of its islands are suitable for sustaining large breeding colonies↔can serve as huge breeding grounds for king penguins量的限定（only a handful ↔ only a few）与功能描述（suitable for sustaining ↔can serve as）均有等值落地，锁定 D。
questions.quote: Only a handful of islands in the Southern Ocean are suitable for sustaining large breeding colonies.

options.text: The king penguins there are reluctant to leave for new breeding grounds.
Its conservation is key to the sustainable propagation of Antarctic species.
It is most likely to become the ultimate retreat for species like the king penguin.
Only a few of its islands can serve as huge breeding grounds for king penguins.

title: Schools are not just a microcosm of society;…

sentences.text: Schools are not just a microcosm of society; they mediate it too.
The best seek to alleviate the external pressures on their pupils while equipping them better to understand and handle the world outside—at once sheltering them and broadening their horizons.
This is ambitious in any circumstances, and in a divided and unequal society the two ideals can clash outright.

passage.translation: 学校不仅是社会的缩影，它们也起着调节作用。最好的学校在让学生更好地理解和应对外部世界的同时，努力减轻他们所承受的外部压力——既为他们提供庇护,又拓宽他们的视野。这在任何情况下都是雄心勃勃的目标,而在一个分裂和不平等的社会中,这两个理想可能会发生直接冲突。

sentences.text: Trips that many adults would consider the adventure of a lifetime—treks in Borneo, a sports tour to Barbados—appear to have become almost routine at some state schools.
Parents are being asked for thousands of pounds.
Though schools cannot profit from these trips, the companies that arrange them do.
Meanwhile, pupils arrive at school hungry because their families can't afford breakfast.
The Child Poverty Action Group says nine out of 30 in every classroom fall below the poverty line.
The discrepancy is startlingly apparent.
Introducing a fundraising requirement for students does not help, as better-off children can tap up richer aunts and neighbours.

passage.translation: 许多成年人会认为是一生冒险经历的旅行——在Borneo的徒步旅行、去Barbados的体育巡游——似乎已经在一些公立学校变得几乎司空见惯。家长们被要求支付数千英镑。尽管学校不能从这些旅行中获利,但安排这些旅行的公司却能获利。与此同时,学生们饿着肚子来到学校,因为他们的家庭负担不起早餐。儿童贫困行动组织表示,每个教室30名学生中有9名生活在贫困线以下。这种差异极其明显。引入学生筹款要求并无帮助,因为富裕家庭的孩子可以向更有钱的姑姨和邻居求助。

sentences.text: Probing the rock pools of a local beach or practising French on a language exchange can fire children's passions, boost their skills and open their eyes to life's possibilities.
Educational outings help bright but disadvantaged students to get better scores in A-level tests.
In this globalised age, there is a good case for international travel, and some parents say they can manage the cost of a school trip abroad more easily than a family holiday.

Even in the face of immense and mounting financial pressures, some schools have shown remarkable determination and ingenuity in ensuring that all their pupils are able to take up opportunities that may be truly life-changing.
They should be applauded.
Methods such as whole-school fundraising, with the proceeds pooled, can help to extend opportunities and fuel community spirit.

passage.translation: 探索当地海滩的岩石池或在语言交流中练习法语可以激发孩子们的热情,提升他们的技能,并让他们看到生活的各种可能性。教育性出游能帮助聪明但处境不利的学生在A-level考试中取得更好的成绩。在这个全球化时代,国际旅行有充分的理由,一些家长表示,他们负担学校海外旅行的费用比负担家庭度假更容易。即使面临巨大且不断增加的财政压力,一些学校仍表现出非凡的决心和独创性,确保所有学生都能把握可能真正改变人生的机会。它们应该得到赞扬。诸如全校筹款并将收益汇集起来的方法,可以帮助扩大机会并激发社区精神。

sentences.text: But £3,000 trips cannot be justified when the average income for families with children is just over £30,000.
Such initiatives close doors for many pupils.
Some parents pull their children out of school because of expensive field trips.
Even parents who can see that a trip is little more than a party or celebration may well feel guilt that their child is left behind.

passage.translation: 但当有孩子家庭的平均收入仅略高于3万英镑时,3000英镑的旅行就无法被证明是合理的。这类举措为许多学生关上了大门。一些家长因为昂贵的实地考察而让孩子退学。即使是那些能看出某次旅行不过是聚会或庆祝活动的家长,也很可能会因为自己的孩子被落下而感到内疚。

sentences.text: The Department for Education's guidance says schools can charge only for board and lodging if the trip is part of the syllabus, and that students receiving government aid are exempt from these costs.
However, many schools seem to ignore the advice; and it does not cover the kind of glamorous, exotic trips, which are becoming increasingly common.
Schools cannot be expected to bring together communities single-handed.
But the least we should expect is that they do not foster divisions and exclude those who are already disadvantaged.

passage.translation: 教育部的指导意见指出,如果旅行是教学大纲的一部分,学校只能收取食宿费,而且接受政府资助的学生可免除这些费用。然而,许多学校似乎无视这一建议;而且该建议也不涵盖那种正变得越来越常见的奢华异国旅行。不能指望学校单枪匹马地将社区团结起来。但我们至少应该期望它们不要助长分裂,不要排斥那些已经处于不利地位的人。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What does the author say best schools should do?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者认为最好的学校应该做什么?
A) 让学生做好准备去挑战和改变这个分裂不平等的社会。
B) 保护学生免受社会压力,使他们能够面对世界。
C) 激励学生发展他们的身体能力和智力能力。
D) 鼓励学生树立雄心壮志,并帮助他们实现目标。
**判型** 题干 What does the author say best schools should do? 指向作者对某一具体对象（best schools）的明确表述，要找的是原文中可被定位句直接覆盖的客观信息。
**拆句** 主干 What does the author say best schools should do? 是嵌套宾语从句：主句 What does the author say，宾语从句 best schools should do；理解时把它读作「作者说 best schools 该做什么」即可，无陷阱。
**定位** 最好的学校力求缓解学生面临的外部压力，同时让他们更好地理解和应对外部世界——既庇护他们，又拓宽他们的视野。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有选项把作者所说的「理解和应对外部世界」夸大为 challenge and change the divided unequal society，文中只在末段说 Schools cannot be expected to bring together communities single-handed，明确否定学校独力变革社会。
B) ✓ 正确alleviate the external pressures on their pupils ↔ Protect students from social pressures equipping them better to understand and handle the world outside ↔enable them to face the world预判中「替学生挡压力」对应 Protect students from social pressures，「让他们应对外部世界」对应 enable them to face the world，B 项是定位句的完整同义改写。
C) 无中生有原文从未提及 physical as well as intellectual abilities 这一维度，作者讲的是减压 +应对世界，不是体能与智力的双轨培养。
D) 偷换概念首段 ambitious 是描述「做这件事很有抱负」的修饰，而 D 项把它改写成 Encourage students to be ambitious——把对学校行为的形容词搬给学生，主语和指向都被偷换。
questions.quote: The best seek to alleviate the external pressures on their pupils while equipping them better to understand and handle the world outside—at once sheltering them and broadening their horizons.

options.text: Prepare students to both challenge and change the divided unequal society.
Protect students from social pressures and enable them to face the world.
Motivate students to develop their physical as well as intellectual abilities.
Encourage students to be ambitious and help them to achieve their goals.

questions.prompt: What does the author think about school field trips?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者对学校实地考察活动有什么看法?
A) 这些活动使来自不同背景的学生能够相互交流。
B) 这些活动扩大了特权学生和弱势学生之间的差距。
C) 这些活动给弱势学生提供了一个看世界的机会。
D) 这些活动只对那些有富裕亲戚和邻居的学生有益。
**判型** 题干 What does the author think about school field trips? 问的是作者明确表达的看法，原文应有直接评价句可定位。
**拆句** 结构简单：主句 What does the author think，介词 about 引出对象 school field trips；理解为「作者对校外考察怎么看」即可，无陷阱。
**定位** 与此同时，有些学生因家里供不起早餐而饿着肚子来上学。儿童贫困行动小组称每 30 名学生中有 9 名生活在贫困线以下。这种落差触目惊心。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反原文强调 trips 在富裕与贫困学生间制造割裂，A 项却说 enable students from different backgrounds to mix with each other，把「加剧分化」反说成「促进交融」。
B) ✓ 正确The discrepancy is startlingly apparent ↔widen the gap between privileged and disadvantaged students better-off children can tap up richer aunts and neighbours ↔privileged and disadvantaged students预判中的「放大贫富差距」完全对应 widen the gap between privileged and disadvantaged students；其余三项都漏掉了作者明确表达的「扩大差距」这一核心负面态度。
C) 与原文相反原文明确指出贫困家庭支付不起 Parents are being asked for thousands of pounds，trips 反而把贫困学生挡在门外；C 项却说 give the disadvantaged students a chance to see the world。
D) 以偏概全原文 better-off children can tap up richer aunts and neighbours 只是举出筹款机制为何失灵的一个细节，D 项却把它推广为 trips 整体 only benefit students with rich relatives and neighbours。
questions.quote: Meanwhile, pupils arrive at school hungry because their families can't afford breakfast. The Child Poverty Action Group says nine out of 30 in every classroom fall below the poverty line. The discrepancy is startlingly apparent.

options.text: They enable students from different backgrounds to mix with each other.
They widen the gap between privileged and disadvantaged students.
They give the disadvantaged students a chance to see the world.
They only benefit students with rich relatives and neighbours.

questions.prompt: What does the author suggest can help build community spirit?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者认为什么可以帮助建立社区精神?
A) 旨在改善社区服务的活动。
B) 有助于激发学生创造力的活动。
C) 需要相互理解的活动。
D) 涉及校园内所有学生的活动。
**判型** 题干 What does the author suggest can help build community spirit? 询问的是作者提出的具体手段，原文应有「某做法→促成 community spirit」的直接陈述。
**拆句** What 既作主句宾语又作 build 的逻辑宾语；宾语从句 What does the author suggest can help build community spirit? 读作「作者建议什么能帮助构建社区精神」即可，无陷阱。
**定位** 诸如全校共同筹款、所得款项集中调配等做法，有助于扩大机会、并激发社区凝聚力。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念原文做法是 whole-school fundraising——校内为校内学生筹款，A 项把它换成Events aiming to improve community services——为社区服务，对象/目的全错。
B) 偷换概念原文 ingenuity 是形容学校自身的应对智慧 remarkable determination and ingenuity，B 项把它移到学生身上 fuel students' ingenuity，主语偷换且与凝聚力议题无关。
C) 无中生有原文未提及「相互理解」，作者只讲全校共担费用的筹款机制；require mutual understanding 是凭常识脑补出的成分。
D) ✓ 正确whole-school fundraising ↔ Activities involving all students on campus with the proceeds pooled ↔ Activities involving all students on campus预判强调的「全校共同参与」在四个选项中仅 Activities involving all students on campus 用 all students 抓住了 whole-school 的核心范围语义。
questions.quote: Methods such as whole-school fundraising, with the proceeds pooled, can help to extend opportunities and fuel community spirit.

options.text: Events aiming to improve community services.
Activities that help to fuel students' ingenuity.
Events that require mutual understanding.
Activities involving all students on campus.

questions.prompt: What do we learn about low-income parents regarding school field trips?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
关于学校实地考察活动,我们对低收入家长了解到什么?
A) 他们希望孩子参加,尽管他们看不到多少益处。
B) 他们不希望孩子参加,但发现很难阻止他们去。
C) 尽管费用高昂,他们也不想让孩子错过任何开阔眼界的机会。
D) 他们希望孩子体验冒险,但不想让他们冒风险。
**判型** 题干 What do we learn about low-income parents regarding school field trips? 问的是关于低收入家长的可被原文直接陈述的客观情况。
**拆句** 主干为 What do we learn about low-income parents，介词短语 regarding school field trips 限定话题范围；读作「关于低收入家长在校外考察这事上我们知道什么」即可，无陷阱。
**定位** 即便那些清楚某次行程不过是聚会或庆祝活动的家长，也很可能因为孩子被落下而感到愧疚。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确a trip is little more than a party or celebration↔ they don't see much benefit may well feel guilt that their child is left behind↔ want their children to participate want their children to participate even though they don't see much benefit 中even though 直接呼应原文 Even；两块语义「想让孩子参加 + 看不到太多益处」刚好同时落在定位句两端。
B) 与原文相反原文家长是「希望孩子参加但有愧」，B 项却说 don't want their kids to participate but find it hard to keep them from going，把家长意愿反过来。
C) 张冠李戴原文中真心相信 trip 能开拓眼界的是作者自己 Probing the rock pools of a local beach…can fire children's passions, boost their skills and open their eyes to life's possibilities，第四段的家长则是 can see that a trip is little more than a party or celebration；C 项却把「渴望孩子开拓眼界」的态度强加给低收入家长。
D) 无中生有原文没有任何关于 they don't want them to run risks 的内容，「风险/安全」是从adventure 一词常识联想出来的，作者完全未提。
questions.quote: Even parents who can see that a trip is little more than a party or celebration may well feel guilt that their child is left behind.

options.text: They want their children to participate even though they don't see much benefit.
They don't want their kids to participate but find it hard to keep them from going.
They don't want their kids to miss any chance to broaden their horizons despite the cost.
They want their children to experience adventures but they don't want them to run risks.

questions.prompt: What is the author's expectation of schools?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者对学校有什么期望?
A) 用创造力把一个社区凝聚在一起。
B) 解决社会中现存的差异。
C) 避免在学生之间制造新的差距。
D) 给予贫困学生优惠待遇。
**判型** 题干 What is the author's expectation of schools? 问的是作者表态性的具体期待，可由文末作者直接陈述句定位。
**拆句** 主干 What is the author's expectation of schools，of schools 是对象状语；读作「作者对学校的期待是什么」即可，无陷阱。
**定位** 我们不能指望学校独力把不同社群凝聚起来。但我们至少该期待的是：学校不要去制造分裂、不要去把那些本已处于弱势的学生排除在外。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反原文恰恰说 Schools cannot be expected to bring together communities single- handed，A 项却把它说成期待 Bringing a community together with ingenuity。
B) 过度推断作者只要求学校不要制造新分裂，并未要求他们 Resolving the existing discrepancies in society——解决既有社会差距已超出作者明确表态。
C) ✓ 正确they do not foster divisions↔Avoiding creating new gaps among students exclude those who are already disadvantaged↔ new gaps among students预判强调的「避免制造新差距、排斥弱势」在选项中仅 Avoiding creating new gaps among students 以 Avoiding 显式保留了 do not 这一否定底线。
D) 无中生有原文未要求学校对贫困生 Giving poor students preferential treatment，只要求不要排斥；preferential 这一额外优待是作者未提的成分。
questions.quote: Schools cannot be expected to bring together communities single-handed. But the least we should expect is that they do not foster divisions and exclude those who are already disadvantaged.

options.text: Bringing a community together with ingenuity.
Resolving the existing discrepancies in society.
Avoiding creating new gaps among students.
Giving poor students preferential treatment.

title: The number of devices you can talk to…

sentences.text: The number of devices you can talk to is multiplying—first it was your phone, then your car, and now you can tell your kitchen appliance what to do.
But even without gadgets that understand our spoken commands, research suggests that, as bizarre as it sounds, under certain (26)____ , people regularly ascribe human traits to everyday objects.

passage.translation: 你可以与之交谈的设备数量正在成倍增加——首先是你的手机,然后是你的汽车,现在你可以告诉你的厨房电器该做什么。但即使没有能理解我们口头指令的小工具,研究表明,尽管听起来很奇怪,在某些情况下,人们经常将人类特征赋予日常物品。

sentences.text: Sometimes we see things as human because we are (27)____ .
In one experiment, people who reported feeling isolated were more likely than others to attribute (28)____ to various gadgets.
In turn, feeling close to objects can (29)____ loneliness.

When college students were reminded of a time they had been (30)____ in a social setting they compensated by exaggerating their number of friends—unless they were first given tasks that caused them to interact with their phone as if it had human qualities.
The phone (31)____ stood in for real friends.

passage.translation: 有时我们将事物视为人类是因为我们感到孤独。在一项实验中,报告感到孤立的人比其他人更有可能将意识归因于各种小工具。反过来,与物品的亲近感可以缓解孤独感。当大学生被提醒起他们曾在社交场合中被排斥的经历时,他们会通过夸大自己的朋友数量来进行补偿——除非他们先完成了导致他们像对待具有人类品质的事物那样与手机互动的任务。手机显然替代了真正的朋友。

sentences.text: At other times, we personify products in an effort to understand them.
One study found that three in four respondents yelled at their computer.
Further, the more their computer gave them problems, the more likely the respondents were to report that it had its own "beliefs and (32)____ ".

passage.translation: 在其他时候,我们赋予产品人格是为了理解它们。一项研究发现,四分之三的受访者对着他们的电脑大喊大叫。此外,他们的电脑给他们带来的问题越多,受访者就越有可能报告说它有自己的"信念和欲望"。

sentences.text: So how do people assign traits to an object?
In part, we rely on looks.
On humans, wide faces are(33)____ with dominance.
Similarly, people rated cars, clocks and watches with wide faces as more dominant-looking than narrow-faced ones, and preferred them—especially in (34)____ situations.
An analysis of car sales in Germany found that cars with grilles(护栅) that were upturned like smiles sold best.
The purchasers saw this (35)____ as increasing a car's friendliness.

passage.translation: 那么人们如何将特征赋予物体?在某种程度上,我们依赖外观。在人类身上,宽脸与支配力相关。同样,人们认为具有宽脸的汽车、钟表和手表比窄脸的看起来更具支配力,并且更喜欢它们——尤其是在竞争环境中。对德国汽车销售的分析发现,带有像微笑一样向上翘起的护栅的汽车销售最好。购买者认为这一特征增加了汽车的友好性。

groups.instructions: In this section, there is a passage with ten blanks. You are required to select one word for each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage. Read the passage through carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not use any of the words in the bank more than once.
groups.content:
The number of devices you can talk to is multiplying—first it was your phone, then your car, and now you can tell your kitchen appliance what to do. But even without gadgets that understand our spoken commands, research suggests that, as bizarre as it sounds, under certain {{26}} , people regularly ascribe human traits to everyday objects.

Sometimes we see things as human because we are {{27}} . In one experiment, people who reported feeling isolated were more likely than others to attribute {{28}} to various gadgets. In turn, feeling close to objects can {{29}} loneliness. When college students were reminded of a time they had been {{30}} in a social setting they compensated by exaggerating their number of friends—unless they were first given tasks that caused them to interact with their phone as if it had human qualities. The phone {{31}} stood in for real friends.

At other times, we personify products in an effort to understand them. One study found that three in four respondents yelled at their computer. Further, the more their computer gave them problems, the more likely the respondents were to report that it had its own "beliefs and {{32}} ".

So how do people assign traits to an object? In part, we rely on looks. On humans, wide faces are{{33}} with dominance. Similarly, people rated cars, clocks and watches with wide faces as more dominant-looking than narrow-faced ones, and preferred them—especially in {{34}} situations. An analysis of car sales in Germany found that cars with grilles(护栅) that were upturned like smiles sold best. The purchasers saw this {{35}} as increasing a car's friendliness.

options.text: alleviate
desires
apparently
excluded
arrogant
feature
associated
lonely
circumstances
separate
competitive
spectacularly
conceded
warrant
consciousness

questions.explanation:
**答案** E) circumstances 名词
**词性槽** 介词 under + 形容词 certain 后必为名词
**依据** under certain circumstances 是固定搭配under certain circumstances（在某些情况下）是英语里高频固定短语，六级阅读 / 写作里几乎是模板词。语义上也最贴：整段在说"在某些条件下，人们会拟人化日常物品"。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
H) consciousness 意识不与 under certain 共现consciousness（意识）不能跟 under certain 形成自然短语；而且它在 32 题描述电脑"有自己的信念和欲望 / 意识"那种语境里更对位（实际 32 题填 desires）。
I) desires 搭配不成立、且后文有更对位的空under certain desires 不是英语习惯说法。desires 在 32 题与 beliefs and ___ 构成"信念和欲望"才是它真正的位置。
K) feature feature 单数不接 under certain feature 表"特征"，搭配是 a feature of，不与 under certain 同现；而且单数形式形态上也不像。它在 35 题 saw this ___ 才是合身的位置。

questions.explanation:
**答案** L) lonely 形容词
**词性槽** be 动词后接表语，要形容词
**依据** 下一句"isolated 的人更易拟人化"是同义印证紧跟的下一句给出了实验佐证：people who reported feeling isolated were more likely than others to attribute __(28)__ to various gadgets。isolated（被孤立的）正是 lonely的近义改写——六级常见的同义替换信号，直接锁定 L。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
C) arrogant 语义与下文实验对不上arrogant 是"傲慢"，与第 2 段的孤独 / 隔绝主题毫无衔接，更不能解释为何要把物当人。
F) competitive 好胜与拟人化无逻辑链好胜与"把物品看成人"没有任何因果关系，下文也未提竞争语境；后面第 4 段的 competitive situations 才是它真正归宿。
M) separate 搭配怪异、词义不对人separate 通常修饰物或空间上的"分开"，we are separate 既不像地道英语，也无法解释下句的 isolated。

questions.explanation:
**答案** H) consciousness 名词
**词性槽** 动词 attribute 后接宾语，要名词
**依据** 把"意识"归给小工具正是拟人化通篇主旨是 people regularly ascribe human traits to everyday objects——人把人类特有的属性赋给物品。最具有"人类专属"意味的就是 consciousness（意识）。把"意识"归给gadgets 正是"赋人类属性"的典型表现。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
I) desiresdesires 已被 32 题预留desires 也能与拟人化挂钩，但 32 题 beliefs and __(32)__ 是它最贴的位置（与 beliefs 并列），不能两处都填。本题先做的话也通，但等做到 32 题就会发现 desires 走不掉、只能回头改 28 题——这种回炒成本提示我们 28 题应该让位给 H。
K) feature feature 不属"人类专属"属性feature 是中性词"特征"，物品本身也有特征，谈不上"把它归给小工具"的拟人化意味，与主旨脱节。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 I) —— desires 与 consciousness 都能填"拟人化属性"，容易选错。to attribute __(28)__ to various gadgets 这一空，desires（欲望）和 consciousness（意识）都是"人类专属属性"，词性也都对。考生若按题号顺序硬填，很容易先把 desires用在 28 题，结果到 32 题 beliefs and __(32)__ 时发现 desires 已用、被迫错选。防坑方法：通读全文后留意"对应程度更高"的空——beliefs and ___ 的并列对称硬框架明显比attribute ___ to gadgets 的宽泛宾语位更强约束，desires 应优先服务 32 题。

questions.explanation:
**答案** A) alleviate 动词
**词性槽** 情态动词 can 后接动词原形
**依据** alleviate loneliness 是高频搭配，语义贴段意alleviate 是"减轻、缓解"的正式表达，常与痛苦 / 孤独 / 压力等抽象不适搭配。整句"与物品建立亲近感能 ___ 孤独"，下文又用"手机替代真实朋友"的实验佐证孤独被缓解了——所以本空填"减轻"。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
O) warrant warrant loneliness 逻辑相反warrant 意为"使……变得有必要 / 值得"，warrant loneliness 等于"让孤独有必要"——和段落"亲近物品能补偿孤独"的逻辑完全相反，正话反说就是六级常见陷阱。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 O) —— warrant 与 alleviate 都能填 can ___ loneliness 的动词槽，但方向相反。can __(29)__ loneliness 这一空，词性筛完后留下 warrant 和 alleviate两个动词原形，看上去都通。但 warrant loneliness 是"让孤独变得有必要"，与段落"亲近物品能补偿孤独"的方向相反——正话反说是六级最毒的陷阱。防坑方法：动词空选完必须再校验一次段意方向，问自己"这是加重还是减轻？"

questions.explanation:
**答案** J) excluded 动词
**词性槽** had been ___ 是被动过去完成的过去分词位
**依据** 上下文是"被社交排斥"才需补偿整句后文是 they compensated by exaggerating their number of friends——之所以要靠夸大朋友数来补偿，前提一定是"被排斥"。excluded（被排除、被排斥）正好接上这个心理逻辑链；而且与本段开头的 lonely / isolated 一脉相承，都是"孤独 / 排斥"主题词。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
D) associatedassociated 不与社交排斥语境共现associated 后一般接 with，单独说 "had been associated in a social setting" 既不符合搭配也无法解释为何要"夸大朋友数补偿"。它真正归宿在第 4 段的 are associated with dominance。
G) conceded concede 词义对不上concede 是"承认 / 让步"，被动 "had been conceded" 意思扭曲，与"在社交场合被怎样"完全脱节。

questions.explanation:
**答案** B) apparently 副词
**词性槽** 主语和谓语动词之间作状语，要副词
**依据** apparently = "看上去 / 据观察"，与实验结论的语气吻合整段在转述心理学实验：手机被发现替代了真实朋友。这是研究者基于行为现象做的推断式结论，用 apparently（显然 / 据看上去）作语气标记最贴。整句"手机似乎替代了真实朋友"是科普文常见的谨慎陈述。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
N) spectacularly程度过强、与谨慎语气冲突spectacularly"惊人地、引人注目地"是程度极强的副词，与心理实验"谨慎陈述发现"的语气冲突；六级文本里科研结论几乎不用这种夸张副词修饰。

questions.explanation:
**答案** I) desires 名词
**词性槽** and 并列 beliefs，必须同为名词复数
**依据** beliefs and desires 是哲学 / 心理学高频搭配beliefs and desires（信念与欲望）是描述"心智状态"的经典并列。电脑被赋予"信念和欲望"，正是用拟人化语言去解释"它为什么老给我使坏"的心理。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
K) feature 单复数与并列对称都不合feature 是单数名词，与复数 beliefs 并列既不对称，也丢了"人类心智专属"的意味。

questions.explanation:
**答案** D) associated 动词
**词性槽** are ___ with 是被动结构
**依据** be associated with 是固定搭配be associated with（与……相关联）是六级阅读高频被动短语。语义上"宽脸与支配性相关联"符合段落"靠外观推断人格"的论点，是科普文里描述相关关系的标准说法。

**答案** F) competitive 形容词
**词性槽** in ___ situations，形容词修饰名词
**依据** 宽脸代表支配感，在竞争场合更被偏爱前句已说 On humans, wide faces are __(33)__ with dominance——宽脸与支配性 / 强势挂钩。强势特征自然在"竞争性"场合更受偏爱：competitive situations（竞争场合）。这是常识 + 段落逻辑的双重锁定。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
C) arrogant arrogant 修饰人不修饰场合arrogant situations 不是英语习惯说法，arrogant 一般描述人的态度，不修饰"情境"。
M) separate separate situations 语义脱节separate situations"分开的情境"既无搭配先例，也与"宽脸 = 支配性 = 在某种场合更被偏爱"的因果链对不上。

questions.explanation:
**答案** K) feature 名词
**词性槽** this + 空作宾语，要单数名词
**依据** feature 正是回指"上扬护栅"这一外观特征前句 cars with grilles\(护栅\) that were upturned like smiles sold best 提到的"微笑式上扬护栅"是一种外观特征。本句 this ___ 自然指代它，用 feature（特征）回指最贴切，且和段落主题"靠外观赋予物品人格"相合。

title: Industrial fishing for krill(磷虾) in the unspoilt waters…

sentences.text: Industrial fishing for krill(磷虾) in the unspoilt waters around Antarctica is threatening the future of one of the world's last great wildernesses, according to a new report.

passage.translation: 据一份新报告称，在南极洲周围未受污染的水域进行磷虾工业捕捞正威胁着世界上仅存的最后一片伟大荒野之一的未来。

sentences.text: The study by Greenpeace analysed the movements of krill fishing vessels in the region and found they were increasingly operating "in the immediate vicinity of penguin colonies and whale-feeding grounds".
It also highlights incidents of fishing boats being involved in groundings, oil spills and accidents, which posed a serious threat to the Antarctic ecosystem.

passage.translation: 绿色和平组织的这项研究分析了该地区磷虾捕捞船只的活动，发现它们越来越多地"在企鹅栖息地和鲸鱼觅食地的紧邻区域"作业。报告还强调了渔船涉及搁浅、漏油和事故的事件，这些对南极生态系统构成了严重威胁。

sentences.text: The report, published on Tuesday, comes amid growing concern about the impact of fishing and climate change on the Antarctic.

A global campaign has been launched to create a network of ocean sanctuaries to protect the seas in the region and Greenpeace is calling for an immediate halt to fishing in areas being considered for sanctuary status.

passage.translation: 这份于周二发布的报告正值人们对捕捞和气候变化对南极影响的担忧日益加剧之际。一项全球运动已经启动，旨在建立海洋保护区网络以保护该地区的海域,绿色和平组织呼吁立即停止在正被考虑列为保护区的区域进行捕捞。

sentences.text: Frida Bengtsson from Greenpeace's Protect the Antarctic campaign said: "If the krill industry wants to show it's a responsible player, then it should be voluntarily getting out of any area which is being proposed as an ocean sanctuary, and should instead be backing the protection of these huge tracts of the Antarctic."

passage.translation: 来自绿色和平组织"保护南极"运动的Frida Bengtsson说："如果磷虾产业想要展示它是一个负责任的参与者,那么它就应该自愿退出任何被提议为海洋保护区的区域,并应转而支持对南极这些广阔区域的保护。"

sentences.text: A global campaign has been launched to turn a huge tract of Antarctic seas into ocean sanctuaries protecting wildlife and banning not just krill fishing, but all fishing.

One was created in the Ross Sea in 2016, another reserve is being proposed in a vast area of the Weddell Sea, and a third sanctuary is under consideration in the area west of the Antarctic Peninsula—a key krill fishing area.

passage.translation: 一项全球运动已经启动,旨在将南极海域的一大片区域变为海洋保护区,以保护野生动物并禁止不仅是磷虾捕捞,而是所有捕捞活动。2016年在罗斯海建立了一个保护区,另一个保护区正在威德尔海的广阔区域被提议建立,第三个保护区正在南极半岛西部区域——一个关键的磷虾捕捞区——被考虑之中。

sentences.text: The Commission for the Conservation of Antarctic Marine Living Resources (CCAMLR) manages the seas around Antarctica.
It will decide on the Weddell Sea sanctuary proposal at a conference in Australia in October, although a decision on the peninsula sanctuary is not expected until later.

passage.translation: 南极海洋生物资源养护委员会(CCAMLR)管理南极洲周围的海域。该委员会将在10月于澳大利亚举行的会议上就威德尔海保护区提案做出决定,尽管对半岛保护区的决定预计要到更晚些时候。

sentences.text: Keith Reid, a science manager at CCAMLR, said that the organisation sought "a balance between protection, conservation and sustainable fishing in the Southern Ocean."
He said although more fishing was taking place nearer penguin colonies it was often happening later in the season when these colonies were empty.

passage.translation: CCAMLR的科学经理Keith Reid说,该组织寻求"在南大洋的保护、养护和可持续捕捞之间取得平衡"。他说,尽管更多的捕捞活动发生在更靠近企鹅栖息地的地方,但这通常发生在这些栖息地已经空无一物的季节后期。

sentences.text: "The creation of a system of marine protected areas is a key part of ongoing scientific and policy discussions in CCAMLR," he added.

"Our long-term operation in the region depends on a healthy and thriving Antarctic marine ecosystem, which is why we have always had an open dialogue with the environmental non-governmental organisations.
We strongly intend to continue this dialogue, including talks with Greenpeace, to discuss improvements based on the latest scientific data.
We are not the ones to decide on the establishment of marine protected areas, but we hope to contribute positively with our knowledge and experience."

passage.translation: "建立海洋保护区系统是CCAMLR正在进行的科学和政策讨论的关键部分,"他补充道。"我们在该地区的长期运作依赖于一个健康和繁荣的南极海洋生态系统,这就是为什么我们一直与环境非政府组织保持开放对话。我们强烈打算继续这种对话,包括与绿色和平组织的会谈,以基于最新科学数据讨论改进措施。我们不是决定建立海洋保护区的人,但我们希望用我们的知识和经验做出积极贡献。"

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What does Greenpeace's study find about krill fishing?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
绿色和平组织的研究发现了磷虾捕捞的什么问题?
A) 它导致大量企鹅和鲸鱼迁徙。
B) 它剥夺了企鹅和鲸鱼的栖息地。
C) 它的作业距离企鹅和鲸鱼的栖息地过近。
D) 它对南极洲周围的野生动物构成了前所未有的威胁。
**判型** What does Greenpeace's study find about krill fishing? 直接问"研究发现什么"，指向原文中可直接抽取的事实陈述。
**拆句** What does Greenpeace's study find about krill fishing? 是标准 wh-疑问句，主语Greenpeace's study、谓语 find、介词短语 about krill fishing 限定范围；结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** Greenpeace 的研究分析了该地区磷虾船的航行轨迹，发现它们越来越多地在"紧邻企鹅栖息地和鲸鱼觅食区"的水域作业。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有caused a great many penguins and whales to migrate 中"造成大量企鹅鲸鱼迁徙"在原文找不到对应——P2 只说船在栖息地附近作业，未说动物迁徙。
B) 过度推断depriving penguins and whales of their habitats 中 deprive...of 表"剥夺"，比原文"在附近作业"严重得多；原文未说磷虾产业"夺走"栖息地。
C) ✓ 正确in the immediate vicinity of penguin colonies and whale-feeding grounds ↔too close to the habitats of penguins and whales they were increasingly operating ↔ It was carried out C 把"紧邻栖息地"重写为"太靠近栖息地"，与预判完全吻合，是定位句的客观转述。
D) 范围程度偷改posed an unprecedented threat 中 unprecedented（前所未有的）是程度副词性夸张；原文 posed a serious threat 只说"严重威胁"，未说"前所未有"。
questions.quote: The study by Greenpeace analysed the movements of krill fishing vessels in the region and found they were increasingly operating "in the immediate vicinity of penguin colonies and whale-feeding grounds".

options.text: It caused a great many penguins and whales to migrate.
It was depriving penguins and whales of their habitats.
It was carried out too close to the habitats of penguins and whales.
It posed an unprecedented threat to the wildlife around Antarctica.

questions.prompt: For what purpose has a global campaign been launched?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
发起全球运动的目的是什么?
A) 减少气候变化对南极洲的影响。
B) 在南极地区建立保护区。
C) 规范南极海域的磷虾捕捞作业。
D) 宣传对磷虾捕捞影响的关切。
**判型** For what purpose has a global campaign been launched? 问的是已发生事件的具体目的，对应原文中一句可抽取的陈述。
**拆句** For what purpose has a global campaign been launched? 是现在完成时被动语态疑问句，by 主语被省略；只需聚焦目的状语"For what purpose"，结构无陷阱。
**定位** 已发起一项全球运动，旨在建立一个海洋保护区网络以保护该地区的海域；Greenpeace 呼吁立即停止在被考虑列为保护区的海域进行捕捞。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念To reduce the impact of climate change on Antarctica 把原文 growing concern about the impact of fishing and climate change 中"气候变化"这一背景诱因当成运动目的——但运动目的是建保护区，不是直接降低气候变化影响。
B) ✓ 正确to create a network of ocean sanctuaries ↔To establish conservation areas in the Antarctic region the seas in the region ↔ in the Antarctic region B 把"建立海洋保护区网络"压缩为"建立南极地区的保护区"，与预判完全吻合。
C) 以偏概全To regulate krill fishing operations 中 regulate（监管/规范）的力度远不及原文 an immediate halt to fishing（立即停止）；且原文是 all fishing，不仅磷虾。
D) 偷换概念To publicise the concern about the impact of krill fishing 把原文 amid growing concern 这一背景描述误读成运动目的——运动是因这种担忧而生，不是为传播担忧而生。
questions.quote: A global campaign has been launched to create a network of ocean sanctuaries to protect the seas in the region and Greenpeace is calling for an immediate halt to fishing in areas being considered for sanctuary status.

options.text: To reduce the impact of climate change on Antarctica.
To establish conservation areas in the Antarctic region.
To regulate krill fishing operations in the Antarctic seas.
To publicise the concern about the impact of krill fishing.

questions.prompt: What is Greenpeace's recommendation to the krill industry?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
绿色和平组织对磷虾产业有什么建议?
A) 选择在建议的保护区以外作业。
B) 自愿保护南极的濒危物种。
C) 在整个繁殖季节避免进行磷虾捕捞。
D) 通过领导全球运动来展现其责任感。
**判型** What is Greenpeace's recommendation to the krill industry? 问的是建议"是什么"，原文有 Greenpeace 发言人的直接引语可抽取。
**拆句** What is Greenpeace's recommendation to the krill industry? 是简单 wh-疑问句，介词短语 to the krill industry 限定建议方向；无陷阱。
**定位** 如果磷虾产业想表明自己是负责任的一方，那么它就应该自愿撤出任何被提议为海洋保护区的海域，转而支持对这些南极广阔海域的保护。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确voluntarily getting out of any area which is being proposed as an ocean sanctuary ↔Opting to operate away from the suggested conservation areas an ocean sanctuary ↔ the suggested conservation areas A 把"自愿撤出拟议保护区"重写为"选择远离拟议保护区作业"，与预判完全吻合。
B) 偷换概念Volunteering to protect the endangered species in the Antarctic 中"保护濒危物种"在原文找不到——原文建议是"撤出"，不是"保护物种"；而且"endangered species"也未出现在原文。
C) 张冠李戴Refraining from krill fishing throughout the breeding season"在整个繁殖季节禁渔"在 P4 找不到对应；"季节限制"是 P7 CCAMLR 的说法，与 Greenpeace 的建议张冠李戴。
D) 过度推断Showing its sense of responsibility by leading the global campaign 把原文 wants to show it's a responsible player 这一假设条件夸大为"通过领导全球运动"——原文从未让磷虾产业"主导"运动。
questions.quote: If the krill industry wants to show it's a responsible player, then it should be voluntarily getting out of any area which is being proposed as an ocean sanctuary, and should instead be backing the protection of these huge tracts of the Antarctic.

options.text: Opting to operate away from the suggested conservation areas.
Volunteering to protect the endangered species in the Antarctic.
Refraining from krill fishing throughout the breeding season.
Showing its sense of responsibility by leading the global campaign.

questions.prompt: What did CCAMLR aim to do according to its science manager?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
根据CCAMLR科学管理者的说法,该组织旨在做什么?
A) 提高公众对南极物种脆弱性的认识。
B) 禁止南大洋的所有商业捕捞作业。
C) 使企鹅聚居地免受一切捕捞干扰。
D) 在不破坏南极生态系统的前提下维持捕捞活动。
**判型** What did CCAMLR aim to do according to its science manager? 问 CCAMLR 的目标，且明确言论来源，是典型细节题。
**拆句** What did CCAMLR aim to do according to its science manager? 是带宾语从句感的wh-疑问句；aim to do 表目标，according to 限定信息来源，结构无陷阱。
**定位** CCAMLR 的科学经理 Keith Reid 说，该组织寻求"在南大洋的保护、养护与可持续捕捞之间的平衡"。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有Raise public awareness of the vulnerability of Antarctic species 中"提升公众对南极物种脆弱性的认识"在原文找不到——CCAMLR 的科学经理未提"科普"目标。
B) 与原文相反Ban all commercial fishing operations in the Southern Ocean 主张"禁止所有商业捕捞"，与 sustainable fishing in the Southern Ocean（可持续捕捞）正话反说——CCAMLR 是支持可持续捕捞，不是全面禁渔。
C) 过度推断Keep the penguin colonies from all fishing interference 中"避免所有捕捞干扰企鹅"在原文是季节性事实 more fishing was taking place nearer penguin colonies it was often happening later in the season when these colonies were empty，而非CCAMLR 的目标；且"all fishing interference"是绝对化夸大。
D) ✓ 正确a balance between protection, conservation and sustainable fishing ↔Sustain fishing without damaging the Antarctic ecosystem protection, conservation ↔ without damaging the Antarctic ecosystem sustainable fishing ↔ Sustain fishing D 把"保护-养护-可持续捕捞之间的平衡"重写为"在不破坏生态前提下维持捕捞"，与预判完全吻合。
questions.quote: Keith Reid, a science manager at CCAMLR, said that the organisation sought "a balance between protection, conservation and sustainable fishing in the Southern Ocean."

options.text: Raise public awareness of the vulnerability of Antarctic species.
Ban all commercial fishing operations in the Southern Ocean.
Keep the penguin colonies from all fishing interference.
Sustain fishing without damaging the Antarctic ecosystem.

questions.prompt: How does CCAMLR define its role in the conservation of the Antarctic environment?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
CCAMLR如何定义其在南极环境保护中的角色?
A) 政策讨论中的协调者。
B) 大数据分析方面的权威机构。
C) 所需专业知识的提供者。
D) 海洋保护区的发起者。
**判型** How does CCAMLR define its role in the conservation of the Antarctic environment?问"如何定义"，回到原文 CCAMLR 的自我表态句即可抽取。
**拆句** How does CCAMLR define its role in the conservation of the Antarctic environment?是 how-疑问句，主语 CCAMLR、谓语 define、宾语 its role，介词短语 in the conservation... 限定角色场景；无陷阱。
**定位** 我们不是决定设立海洋保护区的人，但我们希望以我们的知识与经验作出正面贡献。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 过度推断A coordinator in policy discussions 中"政策讨论中的协调者"是无中生有——原文只说 CCAMLR 与 NGO 有 open dialogue 与 talks，未自我定位为"协调者"。
B) 偷换概念An authority on big data analysis 中"大数据分析权威"在原文找不到——原文只提latest scientific data，没说 CCAMLR 是大数据权威。
C) ✓ 正确contribute positively with our knowledge and experience ↔A provider of the needed expertise We are not the ones to decide on the establishment of marine protected areas ↔A provider of the needed expertise C 用"提供专业知识者"准确浓缩了 but 后的自我表态，且与 but 前的"非决策者"立场一致——完美匹配预判。
D) 与原文相反An initiator of marine sanctuaries 中"海洋保护区的发起者"直接与原文 We are not the ones to decide on the establishment of marine protected areas 相悖——CCAMLR 自陈不是决策者，更不是发起者。
questions.quote: We are not the ones to decide on the establishment of marine protected areas, but we hope to contribute positively with our knowledge and experience.

options.text: A coordinator in policy discussions.
An authority on big data analysis.
A provider of the needed expertise.
An initiator of marine sanctuaries.

title: Last year, a child was born at a…

sentences.text: Last year, a child was born at a hospital in the UK with her heart outside her body.
Few babies survive this rare condition, and those who do must endure numerous operations and are likely to have complex needs.
When her mother was interviewed, three weeks after her daughter's birth, she was asked if she was prepared for what might be a daunting(令人生畏的) task caring for her.
She answered without hesitation that, as far as she was concerned, this would be a "privilege".

passage.translation: 去年，英国一家医院诞生了一名心脏长在体外的婴儿。很少有婴儿能在这种罕见病症中存活，而那些幸存下来的婴儿必须承受无数次手术，并可能有复杂的需求。当她的母亲在女儿出生三周后接受采访时，被问及是否为照顾女儿这一可能令人生畏的任务做好了准备。她毫不犹豫地回答说，就她而言，这将是一种"荣幸"。

sentences.text: Rarely has there been a better example of the power of attitude, one of our most powerful psychological tools.
Our attitudes allow us to turn mistakes into opportunities, and loss into the chance for new beginnings.
An attitude is a settled way of thinking, feeling and/or behaving towards particular objects, people, events or ideologies.
We use our attitudes to filter, interpret and react to the world around us.
You weren't born with attitudes; rather they are all learned, and this happens in a number of ways.

passage.translation: 很少有比这更好的例子能说明态度的力量，它是我们最强大的心理工具之一。我们的态度使我们能够将错误转化为机遇，将损失转化为新开端的契机。态度是对特定对象、人物、事件或意识形态的一种固定的思考、感受和/或行为方式。我们用我们的态度来过滤、解读和回应周围的世界。你并非生来就有态度；相反，态度都是后天习得的,这通过多种方式发生。

sentences.text: The most powerful influences occur during early childhood and include both what happened to you directly, and what those around you did and said in your presence.

As you acquire a distinctive identity your attitudes are further refined by the behavior of those with whom you identify—your family, those of your gender and culture, and the people you admire, even though you may not know them personally.
Friendships and other important relationships become increasingly important, particularly during adolescence.

About that same time and throughout adulthood, the information you receive, especially when ideas are repeated in association with goals and achievements you find attractive, also refines your attitudes.

passage.translation: 最强大的影响发生在童年早期，包括直接发生在你身上的事情，以及你周围的人在你面前的言行。随着你获得独特的身份认同，你的态度会进一步被那些你认同的人的行为所塑造——你的家人、你的性别和文化群体中的人，以及你崇拜的人，即使你可能并不亲自认识他们。友谊和其他重要关系变得越来越重要，尤其是在青春期。大约在同一时期以及整个成年期，你接收到的信息，特别是当想法与你认为有吸引力的目标和成就联系在一起反复出现时，也会完善你的态度。

sentences.text: Many people assume that our attitudes are internally consistent, that is, the way you think and feel about someone or something predicts your behavior towards them.
However, many studies have found that feelings and thoughts don't necessarily predict behavior.
In general, your attitudes will be internally consistent only when the behavior is easy, and when those around you hold similar beliefs.

That's why, for example, many say they believe in the benefits of recycling or exercise, but don't behave in line with their views, because it takes awareness, effort and courage to go beyond merely stating that you believe something is a good idea.

passage.translation: 许多人认为我们的态度在内部是一致的，也就是说，你对某人或某事的想法和感受能够预测你对他们的行为。然而，许多研究发现感受和想法并不一定能预测行为。一般来说，只有当行为容易做到，并且你周围的人持有相似的信念时，你的态度才会在内部保持一致。这就是为什么，例如，许多人说他们相信回收利用或锻炼的好处，但却没有按照自己的观点行事，因为超越仅仅声称你相信某事是个好主意需要意识、努力和勇气。

sentences.text: One of the most effective ways to change an attitude is to start behaving as if you already feel and think the way you'd prefer to.
Take some time to reflect on your attitudes, to think about what you believe and why.
Is there anything you consider a burden rather than a privilege?
If so, start behaving—right now—as if the latter is the case.

passage.translation: 改变态度最有效的方法之一是开始表现得好像你已经以你希望的方式去感受和思考。花些时间反思你的态度，思考你相信什么以及为什么相信。有什么事情是你认为是负担而非荣幸的吗？如果有，从现在开始就表现得好像后者才是事实。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What do we learn from the passage about attitude?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
从文章中我们了解到关于态度的什么信息?
A) 它塑造我们的信念和意识形态。
B) 它改善我们的心理健康。
C) 它决定我们如何回应周围的环境。
D) 它改变我们思考、感受以及彼此互动的方式。
**判型** What do we learn from the passage about attitude 问的是 attitude 这一概念的本质特征，需要在原文找一句对 attitude 功能的定义句去对答案，本质仍是细节定位，而非全篇主旨。
**拆句** What do we learn from the passage about attitude 是疑问句结构：主语 we、谓语learn、from the passage 表来源、about attitude 表对象，无倒装无否定，直白提问对attitude 的认识。
**定位** 我们用我们的态度去过滤、解读并对周围的世界作出反应。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念It shapes our beliefs and ideologies. 把 attitude 说成“塑造我们的信念和意识形态”，但原文是 attitudes…towards particular objects, people, events or ideologies，ideologies 是 attitude 的对象，不是 attitude 塑造的产物。
B) 无中生有It improves our psychological wellbeing. 中的 psychological wellbeing 在 P2 没有对应表述，原文只说 attitude 是 one of our most powerful psychological tools，强调“工具”不是“增进健康”。
C) ✓ 正确react to the world around us ↔ respond to our immediate environment We use our attitudes to filter, interpret and react ↔ It determines how we respond It determines how we respond to our immediate environment 与定位句 We use our attitudes to filter, interpret and react to the world around us. 在“施动者—动作—对象”三层均一一对应，是同义改写。
D) 偷换概念It changes the way we think, feel and interact with one another. 把原文 react to the world around us 改写成“与彼此互动”，并加了 changes（改变）这一动词，与原文“使用 attitudes 去 react”不一致。
questions.quote: We use our attitudes to filter, interpret and react to the world around us.

options.text: It shapes our beliefs and ideologies.
It improves our psychological wellbeing.
It determines how we respond to our immediate environment.
It changes the way we think, feel and interact with one another.

questions.prompt: What can contribute to the refinement of one's attitude, according to the passage?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
根据文章,什么能够促进一个人态度的改善?
A) 他们偶像的行为。
B) 他们的教育水平。
C) 他们与异性的接触。
D) 他们与不同文化的互动。
**判型** What can contribute to the refinement of one's attitude 问的是“致使”项，是对原文列举式因果句的细节查找。
**拆句** What can contribute to the refinement of one's attitude, according to the passage主语 What、谓语 can contribute to、宾语 refinement of one's attitude；according to the passage 是范围状语；句首特殊疑问句无倒装陷阱。
**定位** 当你逐渐获得独立的身份认同，你的态度会被你所认同的那些人——你的家人、与你同性别同文化的人、以及你所敬仰的人（即便你并不与他们相识）——的行为进一步精炼。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确the people you admire ↔ Their idols' behaviors.破折号列举中明确含 the people you admire，Their idols' behaviors. 正是它的名词化同义改写，符合预判。
B) 无中生有Their educational level. 中的 educational level 在 P3 没有任何对应表述，全段只谈身份、性别文化、敬仰者和信息重复。
C) 与原文相反Their contact with the opposite gender. 与原文 those of your gender and culture方向相反——原文强调的是与“同性别同文化”的认同者，C 却换成 opposite gender。
D) 与原文相反Their interaction with different cultures. 与原文 those of your gender and culture也方向相反——原文是“同文化者”，D 是“与不同文化互动”。
questions.quote: As you acquire a distinctive identity your attitudes are further refined by the behavior of those with whom you identify—your family, those of your gender and culture, and the people you admire, even though you may not know them personally.

options.text: Their idols' behaviors.
Their educational level.
Their contact with the opposite gender.
Their interaction with different cultures.

questions.prompt: What do many studies find about people's feelings and thoughts?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
许多研究发现人们的感受和想法有什么特点?
A) 它们可能无法预示一个人将如何行事。
B) 它们在某种程度上与一个人的心态相一致。
C) 它们可能无法在人际关系中表现出来。
D) 无论如何它们都与一个人的行为相符。
**判型** What do many studies find 是查找原文对“many studies 的发现”这一明确事实的陈述。
**拆句** What do many studies find about people's feelings and thoughts 标准 wh-疑问句：助动词 do 提到主语前，主语 many studies、谓语 find、about 短语作宾语补足；结构平直无陷阱。
**定位** 然而，许多研究发现，感受和想法未必能预示行为。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确don't necessarily predict behavior ↔ may not suggest how a person is going to behave They may not suggest how a person is going to behave. 以 They=feelings and thoughts 为主语，把 don't necessarily predict behavior 一字不漏地等值改写，符合预判。
B) 与原文相反They are in a way consistent with a person's mentality. 说感受/想法与“心智”在某种程度上一致，但原文 many studies have found that feelings and thoughts don't necessarily predict behavior 强调的是与“行为”未必一致，B 既偷换对象又调转方向。
C) 偷换概念They may not find expression in interpersonal relations. 把原文 behavior 偷换为interpersonal relations（人际关系），属于话题外延的偷换。
D) 与原文相反They are in line with a person's behavior no matter what. 用 no matter what 说“无论如何都一致”，与原文 don't necessarily predict behavior 完全相反。
questions.quote: However, many studies have found that feelings and thoughts don't necessarily predict behavior.

options.text: They may not suggest how a person is going to behave.
They are in a way consistent with a person's mentality.
They may not find expression in interpersonal relations.
They are in line with a person's behavior no matter what.

questions.prompt: How come many people don't do what they believe is good?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
为什么许多人不去做他们认为好的事情?
A) 他们没有时间。
B) 他们不知道如何做。
C) 他们很虚伪。
D) 他们缺乏意志力。
**判型** How come many people don't do what they believe is good 是“why”的口语化变体，仍是对原文因果句的细节查找。
**拆句** How come many people don't do what they believe is good 中 How come 后接陈述语序的从句 many people don't do what they believe is good；what 引导宾语从句作do 的宾语，结构虽嵌套但语义直接。
**定位** 这就是为什么，比如说，很多人嘴上说他们相信回收或运动的好处，却没有按自己的想法去做——因为要超越仅仅“嘴上说自己相信某事是好主意”这一步，需要觉察、努力和勇气。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有They can't afford the time. 把原因归为没时间，但 because it takes awareness, effort and courage 三个名词中均不含时间因素。
B) 偷换概念They have no idea how to. 把原因归为“不知道怎么做”，但原文 because it takes awareness, effort and courage 强调的是意志品质，而不是方法/知识。
C) 过度推断They are hypocritical. 把“嘴上说相信但不做”推断为伪善，但原文只说需要awareness/effort/courage 才能落实，并未对人格作伪善评价。
D) ✓ 正确it takes awareness, effort and courage to go beyond merely stating that you believe something is a good idea↔ They lack willpower. They lack willpower. 把原文 awareness, effort and courage 三种并列意志品质归并为上位词 willpower，并以 lack 表达“需要却没有”，是同义改写。
questions.quote: That's why, for example, many say they believe in the benefits of recycling or exercise, but don't behave in line with their views, because it takes awareness, effort and courage to go beyond merely stating that you believe something is a good idea.

options.text: They can't afford the time.
They have no idea how to.
They are hypocritical.
They lack willpower.

questions.prompt: What is proposed as a strategy to change attitude?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
提出了什么策略来改变态度?
A) 改变需要立即关注的事情。
B) 开始以体现自身愿望的方式行动。
C) 在一段时间内逐步调整自己的行为。
D) 考虑减轻心理负担的方法。
**判型** What is proposed as a strategy to change attitude 问“被提出的策略是什么”，是对末段明示策略句的细节查找。
**拆句** What is proposed as a strategy to change attitude 是被动语态特殊疑问句：What 作主语、is proposed 是被动谓语、as a strategy to change attitude 是方式状语；考生要意识到“被提出的东西＝作者推荐的策略”。
**定位** 改变态度最有效的方法之一，是从现在开始就按你希望自己已经持有的感受和想法去行动。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有Changing things that require one's immediate attention. 把策略说成“去改变那些需要立即关注的事”，但 P5 没有 immediate attention 这一概念，反而强调按理想状态行动。
B) ✓ 正确start behaving as if you already feel and think the way you'd prefer to↔Starting to act in a way that embodies one's aspirations. as if you already feel and think the way you'd prefer to↔in a way that embodies one's aspirations Starting to act in a way that embodies one's aspirations. 与 One of the most effective ways to change an attitude is to start behaving as if you already feel and think the way you'd prefer to. 在动作（start behaving=Starting to act）、方式（as if…the way you'd prefer to=in a way that embodies one's aspirations）两层逐对对应，是同义改写。
C) 与原文相反Adjusting one's behavior gradually over a period of time. 用 gradually over a period of time 表“逐步”，但原文 start behaving—right now 强调“现在就开始”，方向与节奏均相反。
D) 偷换概念Considering ways of reducing one's psychological burdens. 把策略说成“减轻心理负担”，但 Is there anything you consider a burden rather than a privilege? If so, start behaving—right now—as if the latter is the case. 不是要“减轻 burden”，而是要按 privilege 的视角去行动。
questions.quote: One of the most effective ways to change an attitude is to start behaving as if you already feel and think the way you'd prefer to.

options.text: Changing things that require one's immediate attention.
Starting to act in a way that embodies one's aspirations.
Adjusting one's behavior gradually over a period of time.
Considering ways of reducing one's psychological burdens.

title: The persistent haze over many of our cities…

sentences.text: The persistent haze over many of our cities is a reminder of the polluted air that we breathe.

Over 80% of the world's urban population is breathing air that fails to meet World Health Organisation guidelines, and an estimated 4.5 million people died (26)____ from outdoor air pollution in 2015.

passage.translation: 许多城市上空持续的雾霾提醒着我们所呼吸的空气受到了污染。全球超过80%的城市人口呼吸的空气未能达到世界卫生组织的标准,2015年估计有450万人因室外空气污染而过早死亡。

sentences.text: Globally, urban populations are expected to double in the next 40 years, and an extra 2 billion people will need new places to live, as well as services and ways to move around their cities.
What is more important, the decisions that we make now about the design of our cities will (27)____ the everyday lives and health of the coming generations.
So what would a smog-free, or at least low- pollution, city be like?

passage.translation: 在全球范围内,城市人口预计将在未来40年内翻倍,额外的20亿人将需要新的居住场所,以及服务设施和在城市中出行的方式。更重要的是,我们现在关于城市设计所做的决策将决定未来几代人的日常生活和健康。那么,一个无雾霾或至少低污染的城市会是什么样子呢?

sentences.text: Traffic has become (28)____ with air pollution, and many countries intend to ban the sale of petrol and diesel cars in the next two decades.
But simply (29)____ to electric cars will not mean pollution- free cities.
The level of emissions they cause will depend on how the electricity to run them is(30)____ , while brakes, tyres and roads all create tiny airborne (31)____ as they wear out.

passage.translation: 交通已经成为空气污染的代名词,许多国家打算在未来二十年内禁止销售汽油和柴油汽车。但仅仅转向电动汽车并不意味着城市就没有污染。它们造成的排放水平将取决于驱动它们的电力是如何产生的,而刹车、轮胎和道路在磨损时都会产生微小的空气悬浮颗粒。

sentences.text: Across the developed world, car use is in decline as more people move to city centres, while young people especially are (32)____ for other means of travel.

Researchers are already asking if motor vehicle use has reached its (33)____ and will decline, but transport planners have yet to catch up with this (34)____ , instead of laying new roads to tackle traffic jams.
As users of London's orbital M25 motorway will know, new roads rapidly fill with more traffic.
In the US, studies have shown that doubling the size of a road can (35)____ double the traffic, taking us back to the starting point.

passage.translation: 在发达国家,随着越来越多的人迁往市中心,汽车使用正在减少,而年轻人尤其选择其他出行方式。研究人员已经在问机动车使用是否已达到峰值并将下降,但交通规划者尚未跟上这一趋势,反而在铺设新道路以应对交通拥堵。正如伦敦环形M25高速公路的使用者所知,新道路很快就会被更多的交通流量填满。在美国,研究表明将道路规模扩大一倍可能只是使交通流量翻倍,让我们回到起点。

groups.instructions: In this section, there is a passage with ten blanks. You are required to select one word for each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage. Read the passage through carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not use any of the words in the bank more than once.
groups.content:
The persistent haze over many of our cities is a reminder of the polluted air that we breathe. Over 80% of the world's urban population is breathing air that fails to meet World Health Organisation guidelines, and an estimated 4.5 million people died {{26}} from outdoor air pollution in 2015.

Globally, urban populations are expected to double in the next 40 years, and an extra 2 billion people will need new places to live, as well as services and ways to move around their cities. What is more important, the decisions that we make now about the design of our cities will {{27}} the everyday lives and health of the coming generations. So what would a smog-free, or at least low- pollution, city be like?

Traffic has become {{28}} with air pollution, and many countries intend to ban the sale of petrol and diesel cars in the next two decades. But simply {{29}} to electric cars will not mean pollution- free cities. The level of emissions they cause will depend on how the electricity to run them is{{30}} , while brakes, tyres and roads all create tiny airborne {{31}} as they wear out.

Across the developed world, car use is in decline as more people move to city centres, while young people especially are {{32}} for other means of travel. Researchers are already asking if motor vehicle use has reached its {{33}} and will decline, but transport planners have yet to catch up with this {{34}} , instead of laying new roads to tackle traffic jams. As users of London's orbital M25 motorway will know, new roads rapidly fill with more traffic. In the US, studies have shown that doubling the size of a road can {{35}} double the traffic, taking us back to the starting point.

options.text: alternate
particles
crown
peak
determine
prematurely
generated
simply
locating
switching
merged
synonymous
miniatures
trend
