questions.explanation:
**答案** H 段（弱锚点）
**题目译文**
成功结合线上和线下业务模式的公司可能会成为传统零售商的一大威胁。
**锚点** 成功融合线上线下者成传统零售的隐忧
**定位** 更不用说像 Bonobos 这样大量富有创意的新零售商，正以创造性的方式融合线上线下购物体验。
**改写** Companies that successfully combine online and offline business models ↔Apple's massively successful brick-and-mortar-and-glass retail stores成功融合两端的公司a big concern for traditional retailers ↔what should keep old-fashioned retailers awake at night夜不能寐 ↔ 担忧
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
G G 只表达 Creative retailers are using the new technologies to innovate just about everything stores do——"创新方式"，没有"威胁传统零售商"的语义；与题干a big concern for traditional retailers 不对应。Creative retailers are using the new technologies to innovate just about everything stores do from managing inventory, to marketing, to getting paid L L 的主语是 large retailers——他们是被冲击的传统零售商；与 Q41 的主语"成功融合线上线下者（威胁源）"主体不一致，仅因都谈"线上 + 传统零售"而易诱人。the main thing many large retailers have done in response to all this is to open online stores
questions.quote: Not to mention the large number of creative new retailers, like Bonobos, that are blending online and offline experiences in creative ways.

questions.prompt: Brick and mortar retailers' faith in their business was strengthened when the dot com bubble burst.
questions.explanation:
**答案** F 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
当互联网泡沫破裂时,实体零售商对其业务的信心得到了增强。
**锚点** 互联网泡沫破灭 + 实体信心增强
**定位** 互联网泡沫破灭打脸了那一类预言；之后数年里，随着普查局不断报告网售疲软，传统零售商对未来的信心愈发增强。
**改写** Brick and mortar retailers ↔ conventional retailers Brick and mortar ↔ conventional faith in their business was strengthened ↔conventional retailers' confidence in the future increased faith ↔ confidence + strengthened ↔ increased the dot com bubble burst ↔ The dot-com bust bubble burst 的名词化
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
A A 是"实体衰退"的当下图景（Retail profits are falling sharply），既不在泡沫破灭后这个时段、也不是"信心增强"，与题干所述事件无关。Retail profits are falling sharply. Stores are closing
questions.quote: The dot-com bust discredited most predictions of that sort and in the years that followed, conventional retailers' confidence in the future increased as Census continued to report weak online sales.

questions.prompt: Despite the tremendous challenges from online retailing, traditional retailing will be here to stay for quite some time.
questions.explanation:
**答案** O 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
尽管面临来自在线零售的巨大挑战,传统零售业在相当长的一段时间内仍将继续存在。
**锚点** 传统零售短期内不会消失
**定位** 尽管乱局重重，实体店在可预见的时间内不会消失。
**改写** Despite the tremendous challenges from online retailing ↔ Despite the turmoil让步连词 + 概括上位traditional retailing will be here to stay for quite some time ↔brick and mortar won't disappear any time soon肯定式 = 否定式的同义改写
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
C brick and mortar sales accounted for 92.3 percent of retail sales in the first quarter of 2016 只是当下的份额事实，没有任何"未来会怎样"的判断，与 Q43 的未来时刻判断不对应。brick and mortar sales accounted for 92.3 percent of retail sales in the first quarter of 2016 D the Census data suggest that physical retail is thriving 是"当下繁荣"，不是"未来仍在"；与题干 will be here to stay for quite some time 时态不一致。the Census data suggest that physical retail is thriving
questions.quote: Despite the turmoil, brick and mortar won't disappear any time soon.

questions.prompt: With the rise of online commerce, physical retail stores are likely to suffer the same fate as the yellow pages.
questions.explanation:
**答案** A 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
随着在线商务的兴起,实体零售店可能会遭遇与黄页相同的命运。
**锚点** 黄页式衰亡的比喻
**定位** 实体店看起来正走上黄页的老路（即被时代淘汰）。
**改写** With the rise of online commerce ↔The internet is apparently taking down yet another industry线上崛起的背景physical retail stores are likely to suffer the same fate as the yellow pages ↔Brick and mortar stores(实体店) seem to be going the way of the yellow pages同一习语的同义改写
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
O brick and mortar won't disappear any time soon 与题干 suffer the same fate as the yellow pages 是相反判断（一个说不会消失、一个说会被淘汰）；不可对应。brick and mortar won't disappear any time soon
questions.quote: Brick and mortar stores(实体店) seem to be going the way of the yellow pages.

questions.prompt: The wide use of smartphones has made it more complex for traditional retailers to reinvent their business.
questions.explanation:
**答案** K 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
智能手机的广泛使用使得传统零售商重塑其业务变得更加复杂。
**锚点** 智能手机普及让传统零售再造更复杂
**定位** 智能手机的兴起最近又给零售业的再造过程增加了一层新的复杂性。
**改写** The wide use of smartphones ↔ The rise of the mobile phone smartphones ↔ mobile phone + wide use ↔ rise made it more complex for traditional retailers to reinvent their business↔added a new level of complexity to the process of retail reinvention动词式 ↔ 名词化
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
G G 谈的是 a growing array of internet-connected tools——所有联网工具的总和，并没有像 K 那样专门指向 mobile phone 这一具体设备及其带来的"复杂度增加"。a growing array of internet-connected tools to change how they search, shop, and buy J People can shop more efficiently online 谈的是"线上更高效 → 人流降"，没有smartphones 这一具体工具，也没有 more complex 这一评价——两点都不对应。People can shop more efficiently online and therefore don't need to go to as many stores
questions.quote: The rise of the mobile phone has recently added a new level of complexity to the process of retail reinvention.

title: In a few decades, artificial intelligence (AI) will…

sentences.text: In a few decades, artificial intelligence (AI) will surpass many of the abilities that we believe make us special.
This is a grand challenge for our age and it may require an "irrational" response.

passage.translation: 再过几十年，人工智能（AI）将在许多我们认为使我们与众不同的能力上超越我们。这是我们这个时代的重大挑战，可能需要一种"非理性"的应对方式。

sentences.text: One of the most significant pieces of news from the US in early 2017 was the efforts of Google to make autonomous driving a reality.
According to a report, Google's self-driving cars clocked 1,023,330 km, and required human intervention 124 times.
That is one intervention about every 8,047 km of autonomous driving.
But even more impressive is the progress in just a single year: human interventions fell from 0.8 times per thousand miles to 0.2, a 400% improvement.
With such progress, Google's cars will easily surpass my own driving ability later this year.

passage.translation: 2017年初来自美国的最重要新闻之一是Google努力使自动驾驶成为现实。根据一份报告，Google的自动驾驶汽车行驶了1,023,330公里，需要人工干预124次。也就是说，每行驶约8,047公里的自动驾驶需要一次人工干预。但更令人印象深刻的是仅仅一年内取得的进步：人工干预从每千英里0.8次降至0.2次，提高了400%。有了这样的进步，Google的汽车将在今年晚些时候轻松超越我自己的驾驶能力。

sentences.text: Driving once seemed to be a very human skill.
But we said that about chess, too.
Then a computer beat the human world champion, repeatedly.
The board game Go(围棋) took over from chess as a new test for human thinking in 2016, when a computer beat one of the world's leading professional Go players.
With computers conquering what used to be deeply human tasks, what will it mean in the future to be human?
I worry about my six-year-old son.
What will his place be in a world where machines beat us in one area after another?
He'll never calculate faster, never drive better, or even fly more safely.
Actually, it all comes down to a fairly simple question: What's so special about us?
It can't be skills like arithmetic, which machines already excel in.
So far, machines have a pretty hard time emulating creativity, arbitrary enough not to be predicted by a computer, and yet more than simple randomness.

passage.translation: 驾驶曾经似乎是一项非常人性化的技能。但我们对国际象棋也这样说过。然后计算机反复击败了人类世界冠军。2016年，围棋取代国际象棋成为测试人类思维的新项目，当时一台计算机击败了世界顶尖职业围棋选手之一。随着计算机征服曾经是典型人类任务的领域，在未来成为人类意味着什么？我为我六岁的儿子担心。在一个机器在一个又一个领域击败我们的世界里，他的位置在哪里？他永远不会计算得更快，永远不会驾驶得更好，甚至不会飞行得更安全。实际上，这一切归结为一个相当简单的问题：我们有什么特别之处？不可能是像算术这样的技能，机器已经在这方面表现出色。到目前为止，机器在模仿创造力方面相当困难，创造力足够任意以至于无法被计算机预测，但又不仅仅是简单的随机性。

sentences.text: Perhaps, if we continue to improve information-processing machines, we'll soon have helpful rational assistants.
So we must aim to complement the rationality of the machine, rather than to compete with it.
If I'm right, we should foster a creative spirit because a dose of illogical creativity will complement the rationality of the machine.
Unfortunately, however, our education system has not caught up to the approaching reality.
Indeed, our schools and universities are structured to mould pupils to be mostly obedient servants of rationality, and to develop outdated skills in interacting with outdated machines.
We need to help our children learn how to best work with smart computers to improve human decision-making.
But most of all we need to keep the long-term perspective in mind: that even if computers will outsmart us, we can still be the most creative.
Because if we aren't, we won't be providing much value in future ecosystems, and that may put in question the foundation for our existence.

passage.translation: 也许，如果我们继续改进信息处理机器，我们很快就会拥有有用的理性助手。因此，我们必须致力于补充机器的理性，而不是与之竞争。如果我是对的，我们应该培养创造性精神，因为一剂不合逻辑的创造力将补充机器的理性。然而不幸的是，我们的教育系统还没有跟上即将到来的现实。事实上，我们的学校和大学的结构是将学生塑造成理性的顺从仆人，并培养与过时机器互动的过时技能。我们需要帮助我们的孩子学习如何最好地与智能计算机合作以改善人类决策。但最重要的是，我们需要牢记长远视角：即使计算机会比我们更聪明，我们仍然可以是最有创造力的。因为如果我们不是，我们就不会在未来的生态系统中提供太多价值，这可能会质疑我们存在的基础。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What is the author's greatest concern about the use of AI?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者对人工智能的使用最担心的是什么?
A) 计算机正在执行大量创造性任务。
B) 许多能力将不再是人类独有的。
C) 计算机可能会变得比人类更理性。
D) 许多人类技能正在迅速过时。
**判型** What is the author's greatest concern about the use of AI? 问的是作者最担心的具体一件事，对应原文某处明示，不需多步推理。
**拆句** What is the author's greatest concern about the use of AI? 主干 What is the author's concern，about the use of AI 介词短语作 concern 的限定语；greatest 形容词最高级修饰 concern，强调”最”——只能选一个最大担忧。
**定位** 我担忧我六岁的儿子。在一个机器在一个又一个领域击败我们的世界里，他的位置何在？他永远不会算得更快，永远不会开得更好，甚至飞得更安全。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反Computers are performing lots of creative tasks 称计算机正在完成大量创造性任务，与 machines have a pretty hard time emulating creativity 直接相反——原文恰恰强调机器在创造性上做得很差。
B) ✓ 正确artificial intelligence (AI) will surpass many of the abilities that we believe make us special↔Many abilities will cease to be unique to human beings What will his place be in a world where machines beat us in one area after another?↔Many abilities will cease to be unique to human beings预判”人类独特能力将不再独特”，Many abilities will cease to be unique to human beings 是该预判的标准转述，主语 abilities 与谓语 cease to be unique 与原文surpass/beat us 完全等值。
C) 无中生有Computers may become more rational than humans 谈”计算机比人更理性”这一比较，原文 we must aim to complement the rationality of the machine 只承认机器理性、号召人去补足它，从未做”比人更理性”的比较，更没把它说成作者担忧点。
D) 答非所问Many human skills are fast becoming outdated 取自 to develop outdated skills in interacting with outdated machines，原文 outdated 用于批评教育体系仍训练过时技能，并非作者最大担忧；最大担忧是独特性丧失，不是技能过时。
questions.quote: I worry about my six-year-old son. What will his place be in a world where machines beat us in one area after another? He'll never calculate faster, never drive better, or even fly more safely.

options.text: Computers are performing lots of creative tasks.
Many abilities will cease to be unique to human beings.
Computers may become more rational than humans.
Many human skills are fast becoming outdated.

questions.prompt: What impresses the author most in the field of AI?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
在人工智能领域最令作者印象深刻的是什么?
A) Google的实验性无人驾驶汽车几乎不需要人工干预。
B) Google的汽车仅用一年时间就超越了他的驾驶能力。
C) Google在短时间内在自动驾驶方面取得了巨大进步。
D) Google已成为自动驾驶领域的世界领先者。
**判型** What impresses the author most in the field of AI? 问作者最印象深的具体一件事，原文应有明示的”最”标记词。
**拆句** What impresses the author most in the field of AI? 主干 What impresses the author，most 副词修饰动词 impresses，强调最高程度；in the field of AI 介词短语限定范围。
**定位** 但更令人印象深刻的是仅仅一年内的进步：人为干预从每千英里 0.8 次降到 0.2 次，进步达 400%。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 答非所问Google's experimental driverless cars require little human intervention 描述的是required human intervention 124 times. That is one intervention about every 8,047 km 的事实，原文确有，但作者并未用 most impressive 评价它——most impressive 留给了”一年内的进步幅度”。
B) 偷换概念Google's cars have surpassed his driving ability in just a single year 把”一年内有400% 进步”偷换为”一年内已超过作者驾驶水平”，但原文 Google's cars will easily surpass my own driving ability later this year 用的是将来时 will...later this year——尚未超越，且不是 most impressive 的对象。
C) ✓ 正确even more impressive is the progress in just a single year ↔Google has made huge progress in autonomous driving in a short time human interventions fell from 0.8 times per thousand miles to 0.2, a 400% improvement ↔Google has made huge progress in autonomous driving in a short time预判”短时间内取得巨大进步”，Google has made huge progress in autonomous driving in a short time 双双匹配 huge=400% improvement、in a short time=in just a single year，完整覆盖。
D) 无中生有Google has become a world leader in the field of autonomous driving 给谷歌贴”世界领导者”标签，原文从未做这种排位评价，仅给出谷歌自身的进度数据。
questions.quote: But even more impressive is the progress in just a single year: human interventions fell from 0.8 times per thousand miles to 0.2, a 400% improvement.

options.text: Google's experimental driverless cars require little human intervention.
Google's cars have surpassed his driving ability in just a single year.
Google has made huge progress in autonomous driving in a short time.
Google has become a world leader in the field of autonomous driving.

questions.prompt: What do we learn from the passage about creativity?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
从文章中我们对创造力了解到什么?
A) 它是理性的。
B) 它是可预测的。
C) 它是人类特有的。
D) 它尚未被人工智能模仿。
**判型** What do we learn from the passage about creativity? 是问原文对 creativity 这一概念描述了什么，答案需直接对应原文表述。
**拆句** What do we learn from the passage about creativity? 主干 What do we learn；from the passage 状语指明信息来源；about creativity 介词短语限定信息话题。
**定位** 迄今为止，机器很难模拟创造力——创造力足够任意以致于无法被计算机预测，但又不只是简单的随机。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反It is rational 说创造力是理性的，但原文 a dose of illogical creativity will complement the rationality of the machine 用 illogical 形容 creativity，并把它与rationality 对立——创造力恰恰是非理性。
B) 与原文相反It is predictable 称创造力可预测，原文 arbitrary enough not to be predicted by a computer 明示创造力”任意到不能被预测”——选项直接翻转。
C) 过度推断It is human specific 把创造力升级为”人类专属”，原文只说”机器目前难以模拟创造力”，并未排除其它生物或未来机器也可能有，”专属”是越过原文的强判断。
D) ✓ 正确machines have a pretty hard time emulating creativity ↔ It is yet to be emulated by AI预判”机器尚未能模拟创造力”，It is yet to be emulated by AI 主谓结构与原文完全等值；yet to be 表”尚未发生”，对应原文 have a hard time + So far 的语义。
questions.quote: So far, machines have a pretty hard time emulating creativity, arbitrary enough not to be predicted by a computer, and yet more than simple randomness.

options.text: It is rational.
It is predictable.
It is human specific.
It is yet to be emulated by AI.

questions.prompt: What should schools help children do in the era of AI?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
在人工智能时代,学校应该帮助孩子们做什么?
A) 培养原创性思维。
B) 学会独立工作。
C) 与智能机器竞争。
D) 理解人工智能如何运作。
**判型** What should schools help children do in the era of AI? 问学校应做什么，原文必有should/need to/must 的建议句直接对应。
**拆句** What should schools help children do in the era of AI? 主干 What should schools help children do；help children do 为”help sb. do”的省略 to 不定式结构；in the era of AI 状语限定时代背景。
**定位** 如果我说得对，我们应当培育一种创造性精神，因为一剂非逻辑的创造力将补足机器的理性。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确we should foster a creative spirit ↔ Cultivate original thinking we can still be the most creative ↔ Cultivate original thinking预判”培育创造性精神”，Cultivate original thinking 在动词（cultivate=foster）与名词短语（original thinking=creative spirit）两层做同义替换，是标准答案。
B) 无中生有Learn to work independently 提”独立工作”，原文从未提及；恰相反，原文 learn how to best work with smart computers 强调与机器协作，而非独立。
C) 与原文相反Compete with smart machines 说与机器竞争，原文 we must aim to complement the rationality of the machine, rather than to compete with it 明确反对竞争、主张互补——选项直接翻转主张。
D) 偷换概念Understand how AI works 说理解 AI 的工作原理，原文谈的是”如何与智能计算机协作以改善决策”，并非”理解 AI 工作原理”——它是相邻语境的概念嫁接，非作者主张。
questions.quote: If I'm right, we should foster a creative spirit because a dose of illogical creativity will complement the rationality of the machine.

options.text: Cultivate original thinking.
Learn to work independently.
Compete with smart machines.
Understand how AI works.

questions.prompt: How can we humans justify our future existence?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
我们人类如何证明我们未来存在的正当性?
A) 通过不断地在智力上胜过计算机。
B) 通过采取长远的视角。
C) 通过理性地与人工智能妥协。
D) 通过用我们的创造力提供价值。
**判型** How can we humans justify our future existence? 问”如何”，对应原文某句给出的具体路径，可逐字落地。
**拆句** How can we humans justify our future existence? 主干 How can we justify our existence；humans 与 we 是同位语，强调”我们人类”；future 形容词修饰 existence。
**定位** 因为如果我们不是（最有创造力的），我们将无法在未来的生态中提供太多价值，而这可能会让我们存在的根基受到质疑。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反By constantly outsmarting computers 称要”持续比计算机更聪明”，原文 even if computers will outsmart us 已让步承认 computers will outsmart us（计算机将更聪明），人类靠的是创造力而非更聪明——选项直接反转。
B) 答非所问By adopting a long-term perspective 取自 we need to keep the long-term perspective in mind，原文是”在心中保持长远视角”作为提醒方式，并非作者给出的”为存在正名”的根本手段——根本手段是创造力。
C) 无中生有By rationally compromising with AI 称”与 AI 理性妥协”，原文从未出现 compromise或同义词，原文主张是”互补”（complement），不是妥协。
D) ✓ 正确if we aren't, we won't be providing much value in future ecosystems↔By providing value with our creativity even if computers will outsmart us, we can still be the most creative↔By providing value with our creativity预判”靠创造力提供价值”，By providing value with our creativity 双双匹配 creativity（手段）与 providing value（目的），且 by 短语正是 how 题的标准回答形式。
questions.quote: Because if we aren't, we won't be providing much value in future ecosystems, and that may put in question the foundation for our existence.

options.text: By constantly outsmarting computers.
By adopting a long-term perspective.
By rationally compromising with AI.
By providing value with our creativity.

title: When I re-entered the full-time workforce a few…

sentences.text: When I re-entered the full-time workforce a few years ago after a decade of solitary self- employment, there was one thing I was looking forward to the most: the opportunity to have work friends once again.
It wasn't until I entered the corporate world that I realized, for me at least, being friends with colleagues didn't emerge as a priority at all.
This is surprising when you consider the prevailing emphasis by scholars and trainers and managers on the importance of cultivating close interpersonal relationships at work.

So much research has explored the way in which collegial(同事的) ties can help overcome a range of workplace issues affecting productivity and the quality of work output such as team-based conflict, jealousy, undermining, anger, and more.

passage.translation: 几年前,当我在十年的独自创业之后重新进入全职工作时,我最期待的一件事就是:有机会再次拥有工作中的朋友。直到我进入企业界,我才意识到,至少对我而言,与同事成为朋友根本没有成为优先事项。考虑到学者、培训师和管理者普遍强调在工作中培养亲密人际关系的重要性,这是令人惊讶的。大量研究探索了同事关系如何帮助克服影响生产力和工作成果质量的一系列职场问题,如团队冲突、嫉妒、破坏、愤怒等。

sentences.text: Perhaps my expectations of lunches, water-cooler gossip and caring, deep-and-meaningful conversations were a legacy of the last time I was in that kind of office environment.
Whereas now, as I near the end of my fourth decade, I realize work can be fully functional and entirely fulfilling without needing to be best mates with the people sitting next to you.

passage.translation: 也许我对午餐、茶水间闲聊以及关怀、深刻而有意义的对话的期待,是我上次处于那种办公环境时留下的遗产。而现在,当我接近四十岁的尾声时,我意识到工作可以完全正常运转并完全令人满足,而不需要与坐在你旁边的人成为最好的朋友。

sentences.text: In an academic analysis just published in the profoundly-respected Journal of Management, researchers have looked at the concept of "indifferent relationships".
It's a simple term that encapsulates(概括) the fact that relationships at work can reasonably be non-intimate, inconsequential, unimportant and even, dare I say it, disposable or substitutable.

passage.translation: 在刚刚发表于备受尊敬的《管理学杂志》的一篇学术分析中,研究人员研究了"冷淡关系"的概念。这是一个简单的术语,概括了这样一个事实:工作中的关系可以合理地是非亲密的、无关紧要的、不重要的,甚至,我敢说,是可抛弃或可替代的。

sentences.text: Indifferent relationships are neither positive nor negative.
The limited research conducted thus far indicates they're especially dominant among those who value independence over cooperation, and harmony over confrontation.
Indifference is also the preferred option among those who are socially lazy.
Maintaining relationships over the long term takes effort.
For some of us, too much effort.

passage.translation: 冷淡关系既不是积极的也不是消极的。迄今为止进行的有限研究表明,这种关系在那些重视独立胜过合作、重视和谐胜过对抗的人中尤其占主导地位。冷淡也是那些在社交上懒惰的人的首选。长期维持关系需要努力。对我们中的一些人来说,这需要太多努力。

sentences.text: As noted above, indifferent relationships may not always be the most helpful approach in resolving some of the issues that pop up at work.
But there are nonetheless several empirically proven benefits.
One of those is efficiency.
Less time chatting and socializing means more time working and churning(产出).

passage.translation: 如上所述,冷淡关系可能并不总是解决工作中出现的一些问题的最有帮助的方法。但仍然有几个经过实证证明的好处。其中之一是效率。更少的闲聊和社交意味着更多的时间工作和产出。

sentences.text: The other is self-esteem.
As human beings, we're primed to compare ourselves to each other in what is an anxiety-inducing phenomenon.
Apparently, we look down on acquaintances more so than friends.
Since the former is most common among those inclined towards indifferent relationships, their predominance can bolster individuals' sense of self-worth.

passage.translation: 另一个是自尊。作为人类,我们倾向于在一种引发焦虑的现象中将自己与他人进行比较。显然,我们轻视熟人多于轻视朋友。由于前者在倾向于冷淡关系的人中最为常见,它们的主导地位可以增强个人的自我价值感。

sentences.text: Ego aside, a third advantage is that the emotional neutrality of indifferent relationships has been found to enhance critical evaluation, to strengthen one's focus on task resolution, and to gain greater access to valuable information.
None of that might be as fun as after-work socializing but, hey, I'll take it anyway.

passage.translation: 撇开自我不谈,第三个优势是,已经发现冷淡关系的情感中立性能够增强批判性评估,加强对任务解决的专注,并获得更多有价值信息的渠道。这些可能都不如下班后的社交活动有趣,但是,嘿,无论如何我都会接受。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What did the author realize when he re-entered the corporate world?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
当作者重新进入企业界工作时,他意识到了什么?
A) 与同事交新朋友并不像他预期的那么容易。
B) 培养积极的人际关系帮助他驱散了孤独感。
C) 在企业界工作比自主创业需要更多的人际交往技巧。
D) 与同事建立亲密关系并不像他预期的那么重要。
**判型** What did the author realize 是对作者具体所”想到”内容的直接发问，没有 infer、imply之类的推断信号，答案应在原文里有近乎对应的句子。
**拆句** Q46 是标准 wh-疑问句：主语 the author、谓语 realize，when 引导时间状语从句 when he re-entered the corporate world。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 直到我重回公司职场我才意识到，至少对我而言，和同事做朋友这件事根本算不上什么优先项。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念Making new friends with his workmates was not as easy as he had anticipated 说的是”交朋友没那么容易”，原文 didn't emerge as a priority at all 说的是”根本不是优先项 = 不重要”；“难易”和”重要不重要”是两码事，属于偷换概念。
B) 与原文相反Cultivating positive interpersonal relationships helped him expel solitary feelings表态是”积极关系帮他赶走了孤独”，与原文”作者发现其实没那么重要、连期待都落空了”的语义方向相反；且原文从未说同事关系帮他驱散孤独。
C) 无中生有Working in the corporate world requires more interpersonal skills than self- employment 把公司职场与自雇放在”人际技能要求”上做比较，原文只说作者”再次进入公司发现交朋友不重要”，从未把两种工作模式的人际技能要求拿来比较。
D) ✓ 正确being friends with colleagues didn't emerge as a priority at all ↔Building close relationships with his colleagues was not as important as he had expected. there was one thing I was looking forward to the most ↔ as he had expected预判说”和同事做朋友不像他原以为的那样重要”，D 把”和同事做朋友”改写为 Building close relationships with his colleagues，把”不重要”改写为 was not as important as he had expected，两端语义完全对应。
questions.quote: It wasn't until I entered the corporate world that I realized, for me at least, being friends with colleagues didn't emerge as a priority at all.

options.text: Making new friends with his workmates was not as easy as he had anticipated.
Cultivating positive interpersonal relationships helped him expel solitary feelings.
Working in the corporate world requires more interpersonal skills than self-employment.
Building close relationships with his colleagues was not as important as he had expected.

questions.prompt: What do we learn from many studies about collegial relationships?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
从许多研究中我们对同事关系了解到什么?
A) 不和谐的关系对生产力有不利影响。
B) 和谐的关系是许多公司致力于培养的。
C) 亲密的同事关系对产品质量几乎没有什么贡献。
D) 工作场所中的冲突关系几乎无处不在。
**判型** What do we learn from many studies 询问已有研究的具体发现，是对客观信息的复述，归入细节题。
**拆句** Q47 主干 What do we learn，from 引导信息来源 from many studies，about 引导话题about collegial relationships。无从句、无否定，无理解陷阱。
**定位** 大量研究已经探究了同事间的关系如何帮助化解一系列影响生产率与工作产出质量的职场问题，比如团队冲突、嫉妒、暗中拆台、愤怒等等。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确collegial(同事的) ties can help overcome a range of workplace issues affecting productivity and the quality of work output such as team-based conflict, jealousy, undermining, anger, and more↔ Inharmonious relationships have an adverse effect on productivity. team-based conflict, jealousy, undermining, anger ↔ Inharmonious relationships预判说”和谐关系能化解影响生产率的问题”，等价于”关系不和谐就会损害生产率”，正与 Inharmonious relationships have an adverse effect on productivity 在逻辑上对应。
B) 偷换概念Harmonious relationships are what many companies aim to cultivate 谈的是”公司想培育”，原文谈的是”研究探究关系如何化解职场问题”；研究发现 ≠ 公司目标，属于偷换概念。
C) 与原文相反Close collegial relationships contribute very little to product quality 说”对产品质量贡献很小”，原文 can help overcome a range of workplace issues affecting productivity and the quality of work output 说的是”能帮助克服影响产出质量的问题”，恰好相反。
D) 过度推断Conflicting relationships in the workplace exist almost everywhere 把原文里仅作为”被研究的负面问题之一”提到的 conflict 放大成”在职场几乎到处存在”的全称断言，超出原文范围。
questions.quote: So much research has explored the way in which collegial(同事的) ties can help overcome a range of workplace issues affecting productivity and the quality of work output such as team- based conflict, jealousy, undermining, anger, and more.

options.text: Inharmonious relationships have an adverse effect on productivity.
Harmonious relationships are what many companies aim to cultivate.
Close collegial relationships contribute very little to product quality.
Conflicting relationships in the workplace exist almost everywhere.

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about relationships at work from an academic analysis?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （推断题）
**题目译文**
从一项学术分析中可以推断出工作中的关系有什么特点?
A) 它们应该被培养。
B) 它们实际上无关紧要。
C) 它们对企业文化至关重要。
D) 它们应该保持适度亲密。
**判型** What can be inferred 直接给出 infer 字样，按规则归为推断题，需要从定位句做一步合理延伸。
**拆句** Q48 主干 What can be inferred about relationships at work，from 引出依据 from an academic analysis。被动 can be inferred 等于 we can infer，理解上无陷阱。
**定位** 这是个简单的术语，它概括了一个事实：职场关系完全可以是非亲密的、无足轻重的、不重要的，甚至——我冒昧地说——可有可无、可被替代。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反They should be cultivated 表达”应当被培育”，与原文该学术分析对职场关系”非亲密、不重要、可替代”的去价值化描述方向相反。
B) ✓ 正确non-intimate, inconsequential, unimportant and even, dare I say it, disposable or substitutable ↔They are virtually irrelevant.预判”职场关系无关紧要”，They are virtually irrelevant 用 virtually irrelevant 概括五个形容词的共同语义场，正是这一步推断的最佳落点。
C) 无中生有They are vital to corporate culture 谈”对企业文化至关重要”，但原文该学术分析既未提 corporate culture，也未把职场关系定性为 vital，且与 unimportant 直接矛盾。
D) 偷换概念They should be reasonably intimate 主张”应该相当亲密”，与原文 can reasonably be non-intimate 中 reasonably 修饰 non-intimate（合理地非亲密）相反；干扰项保留了原文的 reasonably 这个词，但把 non-intimate 偷成了 intimate。
questions.quote: It's a simple term that encapsulates(概括) the fact that relationships at work can reasonably be non-intimate, inconsequential, unimportant and even, dare I say it, disposable or substitutable.

options.text: They should be cultivated.
They are virtually irrelevant.
They are vital to corporate culture.
They should be reasonably intimate.

questions.prompt: What does the author say about people who are socially lazy?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者对社交懒惰的人有什么看法?
A) 他们在参与社交互动时感到不舒服。
B) 他们经常发现自己与同事发生对抗。
C) 他们不愿意为维持工作场所关系而付出努力。
D) 他们在处理人际问题时缺乏基本的沟通技巧。
**判型** What does the author say about people who are socially lazy 直接问作者对某群体的具体说法，是对原文一句话的同义复述，归入细节题。
**拆句** Q49 主干 What does the author say about people，who are socially lazy 是限定people 的定语从句。结构清晰、无否定，无理解陷阱。
**定位** 对那些”社交懒人”来说，冷漠（无关紧要型关系）也是首选。维系长期关系需要付出努力——而对我们中的一些人而言，付出得太多了。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有They feel Uncomfortable when engaging in social interactions 谈”社交时感到不适”，原文只提到”社交懒人”嫌维系关系费力，从未谈他们参与社交时的心理感受。
B) 张冠李戴They often find themselves in confrontation with their colleagues 把”冲突”赋给”社交懒人”，但原文 harmony over confrontation 是描述”看重独立、追求和谐”的人偏好冷漠关系，与”社交懒人”是并列的两类，把另一群体的属性套到当前题问的群体头上。
C) ✓ 正确Maintaining relationships over the long term takes effort. For some of us, too much effort. ↔They are Unwilling to make efforts to maintain Workplace relationships. Indifference is also the preferred option among those who are socially lazy ↔ They预判”嫌维护关系太费力”，Unwilling to make efforts to maintain Workplace relationships 把”嫌费力”明示为”不愿付出努力维护职场关系”，正是预判的同义改写。
D) 无中生有They lack basic communication skills in dealing with interpersonal issues 谈”缺乏基本沟通技能”，原文从未评价”社交懒人”的沟通能力，只说他们”嫌费力”。
questions.quote: Indifference is also the preferred option among those who are socially lazy. Maintaining relationships over the long term takes effort. For some of us, too much effort.

options.text: They feel Uncomfortable when engaging in social interactions.
They often find themselves in confrontation with their colleagues.
They are Unwilling to make efforts to maintain Workplace relationships.
They lack basic communication skills in dealing with interpersonal issues.

questions.prompt: What is one of the benefits of indifferent relationships?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
冷淡关系的好处之一是什么?
A) 它们在工作中提供乐趣。
B) 它们有助于控制情绪。
C) 它们有助于解决分歧。
D) 它们提高工作效率。
**判型** What is one of the benefits of indifferent relationships 是对原文已列出的好处之一的直接发问，无推断信号，归入细节题。
**拆句** Q50 主干 What is one of the benefits，of indifferent relationships 是限定 benefits 的介词短语。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 其中一项是效率。少花时间闲聊和社交就意味着更多时间用在工作和产出上。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反They provide fun at work 说”提供工作乐趣”，原文 None of that might be as fun as after-work socializing 明示”无关紧要型关系的这些好处可能并不如下班后社交那么有趣”，与”提供乐趣”方向相反。
B) 偷换概念They help control emotions 说”帮助控制情绪”，原文 the emotional neutrality of indifferent relationships 说的是”无关紧要型关系本身在情感上是中性的”——是结果而非手段，且没有”控制情绪”的意思。
C) 与原文相反They help resolve differences 说”帮助化解分歧”，原文 As noted above, indifferent relationships may not always be the most helpful approach in resolving some of the issues that pop up at work 恰好提示”无关紧要型关系并不总是解决问题的最好方式”——化解问题不是它的好处。
D) ✓ 正确One of those is efficiency. Less time chatting and socializing means more time working and churning(产出).↔ They improve Work efficiency.预判”提升工作效率”，They improve Work efficiency 把这一好处直陈出来，与定位句一一对应，是首段并列项里最显眼的一条。
questions.quote: One of those is efficiency. Less time chatting and socializing means more time working and churning(产出).

options.text: They provide fun at work.
They help control emotions.
They help resolve differences.
They improve Work efficiency.

title: Steel is valued for its reliability, but not…

sentences.text: Steel is valued for its reliability, but not when it gets cold.
Most forms of steel (26)____ become brittle(脆的) at temperatures below about -25℃ unless they are mixed with other metals.
Now, though, a novel type of steel has been developed that resists (27)____ at much lower temperatures, while retaining its strength and toughness—without the need for expensive (28)____ .

passage.translation: 钢因其可靠性而受到重视，但在寒冷环境中却并非如此。大多数形式的钢在温度低于约零下25摄氏度时会突然变脆，除非与其他金属混合。然而，现在已经开发出一种新型钢，能够在低得多的温度下抵抗断裂，同时保持其强度和韧性——而且无需昂贵的添加剂。

sentences.text: Steel's fragility at low temperatures first became a major concern during the Second World War.

After German U-boats torpedoed(用⻥雷攻击) numerous British ships, a 2700-strong fleet of cheap-and- cheerful "Liberty ships" was introduced to replace the lost vessels, providing a lifeline for the (29)____British.
But the steel shells of hundreds of the ships (30)____ in the icy North Atlantic, and 12 broke in half and sank.

passage.translation: 钢在低温下的脆性在第二次世界大战期间首次成为重大问题。在德国U型潜艇用鱼雷攻击了大量英国船只后，引入了一支由2700艘廉价且简易的'自由轮'组成的船队来替代损失的船只，为被围困的英国提供了生命线。但数百艘船的钢制船体在冰冷的北大西洋中开裂，其中12艘断成两半并沉没。

sentences.text: Brittleness remains a problem when building steel structures in cold conditions, such as oil rigs in the Arctic.
So scientists have (31)____ to find a solution by mixing it with expensive metals such as nickel.

passage.translation: 在寒冷条件下建造钢结构时，脆性仍然是一个问题，例如北极的石油钻井平台。因此科学家们努力通过将钢与镍等昂贵金属混合来寻找解决方案。

sentences.text: Yuuji Kimura and colleagues in Japan tried a more physical (32)____ .
Rather than adding other metals, they developed a complex mechanical process involving repeated heating and very severe mechanical deformation, known as temp forming.

passage.translation: 日本的Yuuji Kimura及其同事尝试了一种更加物理性的方法。他们没有添加其他金属，而是开发了一种复杂的机械工艺，涉及反复加热和极其严重的机械变形，称为温度成型。

sentences.text: The resulting steel appears to achieve a combination of strength and toughness that is (33)____ to that of modern steels that are very rich in alloy content and, therefore, very expensive.

passage.translation: 所得到的钢似乎实现了强度和韧性的结合，可与合金含量非常高因而非常昂贵的现代钢相媲美。

sentences.text: Kimura's team intends to use its tempformed steel to make ultra-high strength parts, such as bolts.
They hope to reduce both the number of (34)____ needed in a construction job and their weight—by replacing solid supports with (35)____ tubes, for example.
This could reduce the amount of steel needed to make everything from automobiles to buildings and bridges.

passage.translation: Kimura的团队打算使用其温度成型钢来制造超高强度零件，例如螺栓。他们希望减少建筑工程所需的零部件数量及其重量——例如通过用空心管替代实心支撑。这可以减少制造从汽车到建筑物和桥梁的所有物品所需的钢材用量。

Read the passage through carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not use any of the words in the bank more than once.
groups.content:
Steel is valued for its reliability, but not when it gets cold. Most forms of steel {{26}} become brittle(脆的) at temperatures below about -25℃ unless they are mixed with other metals. Now, though, a novel type of steel has been developed that resists {{27}} at much lower temperatures, while retaining its strength and toughness—without the need for expensive {{28}} .

Steel's fragility at low temperatures first became a major concern during the Second World War. After German U-boats torpedoed(用⻥雷攻击) numerous British ships, a 2700-strong fleet of cheap-and- cheerful "Liberty ships" was introduced to replace the lost vessels, providing a lifeline for the {{29}}British. But the steel shells of hundreds of the ships {{30}} in the icy North Atlantic, and 12 broke in half and sank.

Brittleness remains a problem when building steel structures in cold conditions, such as oil rigs in the Arctic. So scientists have {{31}} to find a solution by mixing it with expensive metals such as nickel.

Yuuji Kimura and colleagues in Japan tried a more physical {{32}} . Rather than adding other metals, they developed a complex mechanical process involving repeated heating and very severe mechanical deformation, known as temp forming.

The resulting steel appears to achieve a combination of strength and toughness that is {{33}} to that of modern steels that are very rich in alloy content and, therefore, very expensive.

Kimura's team intends to use its tempformed steel to make ultra-high strength parts, such as bolts. They hope to reduce both the number of {{34}} needed in a construction job and their weight—by replacing solid supports with {{35}} tubes, for example. This could reduce the amount of steel needed to make everything from automobiles to buildings and bridges.

cracked

questions.explanation:
**答案** A) abruptly 副词
**词性槽** 实义动词前 / 助动词后修饰位
**依据** 钢在 -25℃ 以下"突然"变脆，与温度阈值语义吻合Most forms of steel __(26)__ become brittle(脆的) at temperatures below about-25℃：温度跨过一个临界点就发生状态突变，abruptly become brittle = 突然变脆，正贴临界温度的语义；同时也铺垫了后文"低温脆性问题严重"的迫切性。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
D) ardently ardently 是"热切地"，修饰人之情感ardently 多与 love、support、admire 等表态度的动词搭配，主语通常是人；用它修饰"钢变脆"语义荒诞、感情色彩也完全错位。

questions.explanation:
**答案** J) fractures 名词
**词性槽** 动词 resists 后需名词宾语
**依据** 与首句"低温变脆"承接，正是要抵抗的"断裂"首句已说 Most forms of steel __(26)__ become brittle(脆的) at temperatures below about -25℃，brittle 的结果即断裂；新钢 resists __(27)__ at much lower temperatures抵抗的就是 fractures（断裂），上下衔接自然。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
H) components components 是"部件"，钢不会"抵抗部件" resist components 在语义上不成立；且 components 之归宿在第 34 空，作"建筑所需的部件数"。

questions.explanation:
**答案** B) additives 名词
**词性槽** 形容词 expensive 后缺名词宾语
**依据** 呼应上文"加金属来抗脆"的添加物语义上文 Most forms of steel __(26)__ become brittle(脆的) at temperatures below about-25℃ unless they are mixed with other metals. 已点明传统做法是加其他金属来抗脆，新钢则"不用昂贵的添加物"也能抗脆，additives 正是"添加进去的东西"，与 mixed with other metals 形成同义对应。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
H) components components 指"组成部件"而非"添加物" components 常用于机器 / 结构的"零件、组件"，与"为抗脆而往钢里加入的物质"语义错位；且components 真正用武之地在 They hope to reduce both the number of __(34)__ needed in a construction job。
J) fractures fractures 是"裂纹"，与"昂贵的"搭不上fractures = 断裂 / 裂纹，是钢要避免的结果而不是"昂贵的、被需要的东西"，逻辑反；它另有归宿——填到第 27 空的 "resists __" 后面。

questions.explanation:
**答案** E) besieged 形容词
**词性槽** the + ___ + British 前作定语
**依据** 上文"被 U 艇袭击"正是"被围困"的同义改写After German U-boats torpedoed(用鱼雷攻击) numerous British ships, a 2700-strong fleet of cheap-and-cheerful "Liberty ships" was introduced to replace the lost vessels, providing a lifeline for the __(29)__ British. 给出"船只被鱼雷击沉、急需救命船"，besieged British = 处境艰难、被围困的英国人，与 lifeline（救命线）形成因果。

**答案** I) cracked 动词
**词性槽** but 后从句需谓语动词
**依据** 钢壳在冰海里"开裂"，与紧接的 broke in half 顺承But the steel shells of hundreds of the ships __(30)__ in the icy North Atlantic, and 12 broke in half and sank.：先开裂、后断成两半并沉没，cracked → broke → sank 是程度递进。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
N) strived strived 主语应是人，钢壳不会"努力" strive = 努力奋斗，主语通常为人或群体，不能用于无生命的 steel shells；且与后面的broke、sank 在语义上完全不连贯。它将在第 31 空大显身手。

questions.explanation:
**答案** N) strived 动词
**词性槽** have ___ 现在完成时缺过去分词
**依据** strive to do = 努力做某事，固定搭配So scientists have strived to find a solution by mixing it with expensive metals such as nickel.："科学家一直努力通过加昂贵金属（如镍）来找解决办法"，正是 strive to do 的标准用法，且与上句"低温脆裂仍是问题"形成因果。

**答案** C) approach 名词
**词性槽** 形容词 physical 后缺名词中心词
**依据** 下句"a complex mechanical process"复指本词，即"方法"紧接的 Rather than adding other metals, they developed a complex mechanical process involving repeated heating and very severe mechanical deformation, known as temp forming. 是对前句"more physical ___"的同位展开，说明这是"一种物理性的方法/ 路子"，approach（方法 / 途径）正合。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
F) channel channel 偏"渠道 / 海峡"，不与 physical 搭配channel 常指传播 / 沟通的渠道或地理上的海峡，与"物理性的解决路子"不搭；try a physical channel 更不是固定表达。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 F) —— a physical channel 似通实错。考生可能误填 channel，因为 a more physical channel（更物理的渠道）字面读得过去；但后句 a complex mechanical process involving repeated heating and very severe mechanical deformation, known as temp forming. 是"方法 / 路子"的同位解释，必须用 approach。防坑：读完空后再读一句"是不是对前句的同义重申"。

questions.explanation:
**答案** G) comparable 形容词
**词性槽** be 动词 is 后需表语形容词
**依据** 新钢的强度韧性"比得上"昂贵合金钢，是全文卖点下句 that of modern steels that are very rich in alloy content and, therefore, very expensive. 明确对照对象是"含合金多、非常昂贵"的现代钢，本文亮点正是新工艺钢"性能可与之比肩"，comparable to 即"与…相当"。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
L) relevant relevant 只是"相关"，落不下"性能相当"的强对比relevant to = "与…相关"，说"新钢的强度韧性与昂贵合金钢相关"既不构成有意义的比较，也削弱了作者强调的"以更低成本达到同等性能"的卖点。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 L) —— be relevant to 误当成 be comparable to。两词都能与 to搭配，且 relevant 更眼熟，考生易凭眼熟选 L。防坑：a combination of strength and toughness that is __(33)__ to that of modern steels that are very rich in alloy content and, therefore, very expensive. 的结构是性能间的"比较"而非"相关"，看到 that of ... 的对照结构就要用 comparable。

questions.explanation:
**答案** H) components 名词
**词性槽** the number of 后接可数名词复数
**依据** 建筑"部件数"是被减少的对象上文 make ultra-high strength parts, such as bolts. 已铺垫"用作部件"，空处 reduce both the number of __(34)__ needed in a construction job and their weight 就是减少建筑中部件的数量与重量，components 完美对接 parts。

**答案** K) hollow 形容词
**词性槽** 名词 tubes 前缺定语形容词
**依据** solid 实心 ↔ hollow 空心，反义对照天然replacing solid supports with __(35)__ tubes 形成"以…管代替实心支撑"的替换关系；要在重量上更轻、对应上文 reduce their weight，自然要用 hollow（空心的）管子，与solid 形成反义对照。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
E) besieged besieged 形容"被围困"，与钢管不搭besieged 主语应是人 / 城市 / 国家（被围攻）；用来修饰工程用钢管语义错配，且与减重逻辑无关。
O) violent violent tubes 语义荒诞violent = 暴力的 / 猛烈的，与无生命的支撑钢管搭不上，也无法解释"为何能替代实心支撑、减轻重量"。

title: Officials at the White House announced a new…

sentences.text: Officials at the White House announced a new space policy focused on managing the increasing number of satellites that companies and governments are launching into space.
Space Policy Directive-3 lays out general guidelines for the United States to mitigate(缓解) the effects of space debris and track and manage traffic in space.

passage.translation: 白宫官员宣布了一项新的太空政策,重点关注管理企业和政府正在向太空发射的日益增多的卫星。第三号太空政策指令为美国减缓太空碎片的影响以及跟踪和管理太空交通制定了总体指导方针。

sentences.text: This policy sets the stage for the Department of Commerce to take over the management of traffic in space.
The department will make sure that newly launched satellites don't use radio frequencies that would interfere with existing satellites, and schedule when such new satellites can be launched.
This only applies to American space activities, but the hope is that it will help standardize a set of norms in the dawning commercial spaceflight industry throughout the world.

passage.translation: 该政策为商务部接管太空交通管理奠定了基础。该部门将确保新发射的卫星不使用会干扰现有卫星的无线电频率,并安排此类新卫星的发射时间。这仅适用于美国的太空活动,但希望它将有助于在全球新兴的商业航天产业中标准化一套规范。

sentences.text: Space, especially the space directly around our planet, is getting more crowded as more governments and companies launch satellites.
One impetus for the policy is that companies are already starting to build massive constellations(星座), comprising hundreds or thousands of satellites with many moving parts among them.
With so much stuff in space, and a limited area around our planet, the government wants to reduce the chances of a collision.
Two or more satellites slamming into each other could create many more out-of-control bits that would pose even more hazards to the growing collection of satellites in space.

passage.translation: 随着更多政府和企业发射卫星,太空,尤其是我们星球周围的太空,变得越来越拥挤。该政策的一个推动力是企业已经开始建造大规模星座,由数百或数千颗卫星组成,其中有许多运动部件。由于太空中有如此多的物体,而我们星球周围的区域有限,政府希望降低碰撞的可能性。两颗或更多卫星相互撞击可能会产生更多失控的碎片,对太空中日益增多的卫星构成更大的危险。

sentences.text: And it's not like this hasn't happened before.
In 2009 an old Russian craft slammed into a communications satellite, creating a cloud of hundreds of pieces of debris and putting other hardware at risk.

Journalist Sarah Scoles reports that NASA currently tracks about 24,000 objects in space, and in 2016 the Air Force had to issue 3,995,874 warnings to satellite owners alerting them to a potential nearby threat from another satellite or bit of debris.

passage.translation: 而且这种情况以前也发生过。2009年,一艘俄罗斯旧飞行器撞上了一颗通信卫星,产生了数百块碎片云,使其他硬件面临风险。记者Sarah Scoles报道称,NASA目前跟踪太空中约24000个物体,2016年空军不得不向卫星所有者发出3995874次警告,提醒他们注意来自另一颗卫星或碎片的潜在附近威胁。

sentences.text: That's why this new policy also includes directions to update the current U.S.

Government Orbital Debris Mitigation Standard Practices, which already require any entity that launches a satellite or spacecraft to vigorously analyze the likelihood that any of their actions, from an unexpected failure or normal operations, will create more space debris.
It includes accounting for any piece of debris they plan to release over 5mm that might stay in orbit for 25 years or more.
It might seem surprising to think about an item staying in space for that long, but the oldest satellite still in orbit—Vanguard 1—turned 60 in 2018.

passage.translation: 这就是为什么这项新政策还包括更新现行美国政府轨道碎片减缓标准实践的指示,该实践已经要求任何发射卫星或航天器的实体严格分析其任何行动(从意外故障到正常操作)产生更多太空碎片的可能性。它包括对他们计划释放的任何可能在轨道上停留25年或更长时间的超过5毫米的碎片进行核算。想到一个物体在太空中停留如此长的时间似乎令人惊讶,但仍在轨道上的最古老卫星Vanguard 1号在2018年迎来了60岁生日。

sentences.text: Agencies and companies throughout the world are working on developing technology that would dispose of or capture space debris before it causes serious damage.
But for now, the U.S. government is more focused on preventing new debris from forming than taking the trash out of orbit.

passage.translation: 世界各地的机构和企业正在努力开发能够在太空碎片造成严重损害之前处理或捕获它的技术。但目前,美国政府更专注于防止新碎片的形成,而不是清理轨道上的垃圾。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the new U.S. space policy?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
美国新太空政策的目的是什么?
A) 为太空探索制定总体指导方针。
B) 鼓励企业参与太空项目。
C) 最大限度地利用太空中的卫星。
D) 改善太空交通状况。
**判型** What is the purpose of the new U.S. space policy? 是对原文已明示信息的直接提问，没有 infer／suggest 等推断信号。
**拆句** 标准 What is the purpose of X？ 句式，主语 the new U.S. space policy，无从句、无否定，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 《第三号空间政策指令》为美国列出大致指南，以缓解太空碎片的影响并追踪、管理太空中的交通。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念To lay out general guidelines for space exploration. 把原文的 traffic in space 偷换成 space exploration，「探索」是与「交通管理」截然不同的活动。
B) 无中生有To encourage companies to join in space programs. 在原文找不到任何「鼓励公司加入」的表述，最接近的 companies are already starting to build massive constellations 只说明现状，不是政策目的。
C) 过度推断To make the best use of satellites in space. 中 make the best use of 远超出原文track and manage traffic in space 的「追踪＋管理」语义，且话题对象从「交通」被换成「卫星」。
D) ✓ 正确track and manage traffic in space ↔ improve traffic conditions in space预判要求落在「碎片」或「交通」两个语义里，四个选项中只有 To improve traffic conditions in space. 命中「交通」且与 track and manage traffic in space 等值，锁定 D。
questions.quote: Space Policy Directive-3 lays out general guidelines for the United States to mitigate(缓解) the effects of space debris and track and manage traffic in space.

options.text: To lay out general guidelines for space exploration.
To encourage companies to join in space programs.
To make the best use of satellites in space.
To improve traffic conditions in space.

questions.prompt: What is the Department of Commerce expected to do under the new policy?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
根据新政策,商务部预期将做什么?
A) 减少太空碎片。
B) 监测卫星运行。
C) 监管新卫星的发射。
D) 更新卫星通信技术。
**判型** What is the Department of Commerce expected to do under the new policy? 在原文里有明确职责描述。
**拆句** What is X expected to do under Y？ 主干清晰，under 引导条件限定，无难点；结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 这项政策为商务部接管太空交通管理铺平道路。该部门将确保新发射的卫星不会使用会与已有卫星互相干扰的无线电频率，并安排此类新卫星的发射时间。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 张冠李戴Reduce debris in space. 出现在 to mitigate(缓解) the effects of space debris 和preventing new debris from forming 处，是政策总目标，不是 Department of Commerce 这一具体机构的职责。
B) 偷换概念原文 make sure that newly launched satellites don't use radio frequencies 只管发射前的频率分配，不是 Monitor satellite operations. 这种针对在轨运行的持续监控。
C) ✓ 正确schedule when such new satellites can be launched ↔Regulate the launching of new satellites. make sure that newly launched satellites don't use radio frequencies that would interfere with existing satellites↔ Regulate the launching of new satellites.预判要求覆盖「频率＋时间」这两项发射环节的管控，Regulate the launching of new satellites. 用一个上位动词同时统摄，恰是定位句的语义合集。
D) 无中生有Update satellite communications technology. 中「更新通信技术」在原文无任何依据，最接近的 radio frequencies 仅指频率分配，并不是更新技术。
questions.quote: This policy sets the stage for the Department of Commerce to take over the management of traffic in space. The department will make sure that newly launched satellites don't use radio frequencies that would interfere with existing satellites, and schedule when such new satellites can be launched.

options.text: Reduce debris in space.
Monitor satellite operations.
Regulate the launching of new satellites.
Update satellite communications technology.

questions.prompt: What does the U.S. government hope to do with the new space policy?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
美国政府希望通过新太空政策实现什么?
A) 为太空飞行行业设定国际标准。
B) 通过制定一套规范来垄断太空产业。
C) 促进全世界的商业太空飞行。
D) 促进太空探索领域的国际合作。
**判型** What does the U.S. government hope to do with the new space policy? 在原文中有the hope is that … 的明示表述。
**拆句** What does X hope to do with Y？ 主干简单，with 表「借助／凭借」。无否定、无比较，无陷阱。
**定位** 这只适用于美国本土的太空活动，但希望此举有助于在新兴的全球商业航天产业中标准化一套规范。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确standardize a set of norms in the dawning commercial spaceflight industry throughout the world↔ Set international standards for the space flight industry.预判要求「全球范围、统一标准、航天产业」三要素同时落实，Set international standards for the space flight industry. 三点全中。
B) 与原文相反Monopolize space industry by developing a set of norms. 把「标准化」扭曲为Monopolize 的「垄断」，原文 standardize a set of norms 是建立通用规范，与「独占」是反义。
C) 偷换概念原文希望的是 standardize a set of norms，而不是 Facilitate commercial space flights throughout the world. 的「便利商业飞行」；后者是「统一规范」可能带来的间接效果，被偷换为政策的直接目的。
D) 无中生有Promote international collaboration in space exploration. 把话题从 commercial spaceflight industry 偷换成 space exploration，并增加了 collaboration 这一原文未提的内容。
questions.quote: This only applies to American space activities, but the hope is that it will help standardize a set of norms in the dawning commercial spaceflight industry throughout the world.

options.text: Set international standards for the space flight industry.
Monopolize space industry by developing a set of norms.
Facilitate commercial space flights throughout the world.
Promote international collaboration in space exploration.

questions.prompt: What is a space vehicle launching entity required to do according to the current U.S. Government Orbital Debris Mitigation Standard Practices?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
根据现行美国政府轨道碎片减缓标准实践,太空飞行器发射实体需要做什么?
A) 估算其碎片将在太空停留多长时间。
B) 随时说明其释放到太空中的碎片。
C) 提供管理其产生的太空碎片的详细计划。
D) 对任何可能增加太空碎片的情况进行彻底分析。
**判型** What is a space vehicle launching entity required to do …? 问的是法规明文规定，原文有逐字依据。
**拆句** 主干 What is a space vehicle launching entity required to do？ 后接 according to …状语限定来源；动词 required 被动语态隐藏施事者，但不影响理解，无陷阱。
**定位** 这就是为何这项新政策还包含更新现行《美国政府轨道碎片缓解标准做法》的指示。该做法已经要求任何发射卫星或航天器的实体严格分析其各种行为——无论是意外故障还是正常操作——产生更多太空碎片的可能性。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 以偏概全Give an estimate of how long its debris will stay in space. 把原文 any piece of debris they plan to release over 5mm that might stay in orbit for 25 years or more 这一附加规定截取出来当主要义务；原文里停留时间只是判断要不要核算的门槛，发射方被要求的是分析创造碎片的可能性。
B) 偷换概念Account for the debris it has released into space at any time. 中现在完成时 has released 指向已发生的事实，而原文 vigorously analyze the likelihood that any of their actions, from an unexpected failure or normal operations, will create more space debris 是面向未来的可能性分析。
C) 偷换概念Provide a detailed plan for managing the space debris it creates. 把「分析产生新碎片的可能性」扭曲为「为已产生的碎片做管理方案」，是 dispose of or capture space debris 那种事后处置的语义，而非 vigorously analyze the likelihood。
D) ✓ 正确vigorously analyze the likelihood that any of their actions, from an unexpected failure or normal operations, will create more space debris↔ Make a thorough analysis of any possible addition to space debris. the likelihood that any of their actions, from an unexpected failure or normal operations, will create more space debris↔ any possible addition to space debris预判要求三要素同时命中，Make a thorough analysis of any possible addition to space debris. 一一对应——thorough ↔ vigorously，analysis ↔ analyze，possible addition ↔ the likelihood that any of their actions。
questions.quote: That's why this new policy also includes directions to update the current U.S. Government Orbital Debris Mitigation Standard Practices, which already require any entity that launches a satellite or spacecraft to vigorously analyze the likelihood that any of their actions, from an unexpected failure or normal operations, will create more space debris.

options.text: Give an estimate of how long its debris will stay in space.
Account for the debris it has released into space at any time.
Provide a detailed plan for managing the space debris it creates.
Make a thorough analysis of any possible addition to space debris.

questions.prompt: What are space agencies and companies aiming to do at present?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
目前太空机构和公司的目标是做什么?
A) 在使用过的太空飞行器变成碎片之前对其进行回收利用。
B) 开发解决太空碎片问题的技术。
C) 限制进入太空的碎片数量。
D) 密切合作以回收太空碎片。
**判型** What are space agencies and companies aiming to do at present? 问当下正在做的事，原文有明示。
**拆句** 主干 What are X aiming to do？ 加状语 at present 限定时间。aim to ＋ V 是固定结构，表「目标在于做某事」；结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 全球各机构和公司正在致力于研发能在太空碎片造成严重损害之前对其进行处理或捕获的技术。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有Recycle used space vehicles before they turn into debris. 中 Recycle used space vehicles 与 before they turn into debris 在原文都找不到；原文 dispose of or capture space debris 处理的是已经是碎片的对象，不是回收尚未成为碎片的航天器。
B) ✓ 正确developing technology that would dispose of or capture space debris↔Develop technology to address the space debris problem.预判要求「技术 ＋ 处理或捕获碎片」两要素同时命中，Develop technology to address the space debris problem. 在动名词→不定式、上位动词替换两个层面均与原文等值。
C) 张冠李戴Limit the amount of debris entering space. 对应的是末段次句 the U.S. government is more focused on preventing new debris from forming——这是政府的重心，主语是政府，不是题干所问的 Agencies and companies throughout the world。
D) 无中生有Cooperate closely to retrieve space debris. 中 Cooperate closely 在原文无任何依据，retrieve space debris 把 dispose of or capture space debris 这两个动词偷换为单一的 retrieve，并增加了合作意涵。
questions.quote: Agencies and companies throughout the world are working on developing technology that would dispose of or capture space debris before it causes serious damage.

title: Effective Friday, Screen Actors Guild-American Federation of Television…

sentences.text: Effective Friday, Screen Actors Guild-American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (SAG-AFTRA) has declared a strike against 11 video game publishers over games that went into production after Feb. 17, 2015.
The companies include some of the heavyweights of the industry, like Electronic Arts Productions, Insomniac Games, Activision and Disney.

passage.translation: 自周五起,美国演员工会-美国电视广播艺人联合会(SAG-AFTRA)宣布对11家电子游戏发行商进行罢工,涉及2015年2月17日之后投入制作的游戏。这些公司包括该行业的一些重量级企业,如Electronic Arts Productions、Insomniac Games、Activision和Disney。

sentences.text: The strike comes in light of an unsuccessful 19 months of negotiations after the existing labor contract known as the Interactive Media Agreement expired in late 2014.
Overall, the strike is an effort to provide more secondary compensation along with other concerns, such as transparency upon hiring talent and on-set(制作中) safety precautions.

passage.translation: 此次罢工是在长达19个月的谈判未果后发生的,此前被称为《互动媒体协议》的现行劳动合同已于2014年底到期。总体而言,此次罢工旨在争取更多的二次报酬以及其他诉求,例如雇用人才时的透明度和制作中的安全防范措施。

sentences.text: The video gaming industry has ballooned in recent years.
The Los Angeles Times reports that the industry is in the midst of an intense increase in cash flow.
In 2015, gaming produced $23.5 billion in domestic revenue.

passage.translation: 电子游戏行业近年来迅速膨胀。据《洛杉矶时报》报道,该行业正处于现金流大幅增长之中。2015年,游戏行业在国内创造了235亿美元的收入。

sentences.text: But SAG-AFTRA says voice actors don't receive residuals(追加酬金) for their gaming work.
Instead, they receive a fixed rate, which is typically about $825 for a standard four-hour vocal session.

So the voice actors are pushing for the idea of secondary compensation—a performance bonus every time a game sells 2 million copies or downloads, or reaches 2 million subscribers, with a cap at 8 million.

passage.translation: 但SAG-AFTRA表示,配音演员并未因其游戏工作获得追加酬金。相反,他们获得的是固定费率,标准的四小时配音工作通常约为825美元。因此配音演员正在推动二次报酬的理念——每当游戏销售或下载量达到200万份,或订阅用户达到200万时获得一次绩效奖金,上限为800万。

sentences.text: "It's a very small number of games that would trigger this secondary compensation issue," said voice actor Crispin Freeman, who's a member of the union's negotiating committee.
"This is an important aspect of what it means to be a freelance(从事自由职业的) performer, who isn't regularly employed every single day working on projects."

passage.translation: 工会谈判委员会成员、配音演员Crispin Freeman说:"能够触发这一二次报酬问题的游戏数量非常少。这是作为一名从事自由职业的表演者所意味的重要方面,他们并非每天都在项目中定期受雇工作。"

sentences.text: Another major complaint from the actors is the secrecy of the industry.

"I can't imagine if there's any other acting job in the world where you don't know what show you're in, when you're hired," says voice actor Keythe Farley, who chairs the SAG-AFTRA negotiating committee.

passage.translation: 演员们的另一个主要抱怨是行业的保密性。配音演员、SAG-AFTRA谈判委员会主席Keythe Farley说:"我无法想象世界上还有其他任何表演工作,在你被雇用时却不知道自己在演什么节目。"

sentences.text: "And yet that happens every day in the video game world," Farley told reporters during a press conference Friday.
"I was a main character in Fallout 4, a character by the name of Kellogg, and I never knew that I was doing vocal recording for that game throughout the year and a half."

passage.translation: Farley在周五的新闻发布会上告诉记者:"然而这种情况每天都在电子游戏世界中发生。我在《辐射4》中是一个主要角色,名叫Kellogg,但在整整一年半的时间里,我从不知道自己是在为那款游戏进行配音录制。"

sentences.text: Scott Witlin, the lawyer representing the video game companies, says voice actors "represent less than one tenth of 1 percent of the work that goes into making a video game."

So "even though they're the top craftsmen in their field," Witlin says, "if we pay them under a vastly different system than the people who do the 99.9 percent of the work, that's going to create far more problems for the video game companies."

passage.translation: 代表电子游戏公司的律师Scott Witlin表示,配音演员"所代表的工作量不到制作一款电子游戏所需工作量的千分之一"。因此Witlin说,"即使他们是各自领域顶尖的工匠,如果我们按照与完成99.9%工作的人员截然不同的制度向他们支付报酬,那将给电子游戏公司带来更多问题。"

questions.prompt: Why did SAG-AFTRA declare a strike against some video game publishers?
questions.explanation:

**题目译文**
SAG-AFTRA为何宣布对一些电子游戏发行商进行罢工?
A) 他们之间的劳动合同遭到了违反。
B) 其重新谈判合同的请求遭到了拒绝。
C) 它在19个月的谈判中反复受到欺骗。
D) 他们之间的谈判已经破裂。
**判型** Why did SAG-AFTRA declare a strike against some video game publishers? 直接索取一个具体的事实性原因，不要求推断。
**拆句** 题干主干为 Why did SAG-AFTRA declare a strike against some video game publishers，一般疑问 + 介词短语限定罢工对象，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 此次罢工源于一场为期 19 个月、未能成功的谈判——此前被称为《互动媒体协议》的现行劳动合同已于 2014 年末到期。
questions.tip:
**选项**

B) 偷换概念原文呈现的是 19 个月谈判失败，而非一方发起重谈被另一方拒绝；Its appeal to renegotiate the contract had been rejected 把"谈崩"偷换为"提议被拒"。
C) 无中生有原文只指出谈判 unsuccessful，并未指控对方 cheating；It had been cheated repeatedly 既加重态度也添加事实。
D) ✓ 正确an unsuccessful 19 months of negotiations ↔The negotiations between them had broken down预判要求的"谈了 19 个月没谈拢"与 The negotiations between them had broken down 字面对应——broken down 是 unsuccessful 的标准同义替换。
questions.quote: The strike comes in light of an unsuccessful 19 months of negotiations after the existing labor contract known as the Interactive Media Agreement expired in late 2014.

options.text: The labor contract between them had been violated.

title: The dream of personalised flight is still vivid…

sentences.text: The dream of personalised flight is still vivid in the minds of many inventors, some developing cycle-powered craft, others (26)____ money into jetpacks(喷气⻜行背包).

passage.translation: 个性化飞行的梦想在许多发明家的脑海中依然清晰，一些人在开发脚踏动力飞行器,另一些人则在喷气飞行背包上投入大量资金。然而,飞行汽车始终是个人交通自由的终极象征。

sentences.text: Several companies around the world have produced (28)____ that can drive on roads and fly.

sentences.text: But all these concepts are massively expensive, require safety certification standards for road and air, need (30)____ controls, involve complex folding wings and propellers, and have to be flown from air-strips.
So they are likely to remain rich people's playthings rather than practical transport solutions for the masses.

passage.translation: 但所有这些概念都极其昂贵,需要道路和空中的安全认证标准,需要双重控制系统,涉及复杂的折叠机翼和螺旋桨,并且必须从飞机跑道起飞。因此它们很可能仍然是富人的玩物,而不是大众的实用交通解决方案。

sentences.text: "A car that takes off from some London street and lands in another (31)____ street is unlikely to happen," says Prof.
Gray, a leading aeronautical engineer.

passage.translation: 领先的航空工程师Gray教授说:"一辆从伦敦某条街道起飞并降落在另一条随机街道的汽车不太可能实现。空中出租车的可能性要大得多。"但这不会阻止发明家们构想新的飞行方式,并试图说服投资者支持他们有时异想天开的计划。

sentences.text: Civilian aviation is being disrupted, not by the age-old desires for speed, romanticism and (33)____, but by the pressing need to respond to a changing climate.
New electric engines coupled with artificial intelligence and (34)____ systems will contribute to a more efficient, integrated transport system that is less polluting and less noisy.
That may sound simple, but as Prof.
Gray says, "When I travel somewhere I like this notion that when I finish my journey I feel better than when I started it.
That's completely at(35)____ with how I feel today."
Now that would be progress.

passage.translation: 民用航空正在被颠覆,不是因为对速度、浪漫主义和魅力的古老渴望,而是因为应对气候变化的迫切需要。新型电动发动机与人工智能和自主系统相结合,将有助于建立一个更高效、更完善的交通系统,污染更少、噪音更小。这听起来可能很简单,但正如Gray教授所说:"当我去某个地方旅行时,我喜欢这样一个概念,即当我结束旅程时,我的感觉比开始时更好。这与我今天的感受完全相反。"那才是真正的进步。

groups.instructions: In this section, there is a passage with ten blanks. You are required to select one word for each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage. Read the passage through carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not use any of the words in the bank more than once.
groups.content:
The dream of personalised flight is still vivid in the minds of many inventors, some developing cycle-powered craft, others {{26}} money into jetpacks(喷气⻜行背包). However, the flying car has always remained the {{27}} symbol of personal transport freedom.

Several companies around the world have produced {{28}} that can drive on roads and fly. Airbus has a futuristic modular(组件式的) concept involving a passenger capsule that can be {{29}}from the road-going chassis(底盘) and picked up by a helicopter-type machine.

But all these concepts are massively expensive, require safety certification standards for road and air, need {{30}} controls, involve complex folding wings and propellers, and have to be flown from air-strips. So they are likely to remain rich people's playthings rather than practical transport solutions for the masses.

"A car that takes off from some London street and lands in another {{31}} street is unlikely to happen," says Prof. Gray, a leading aeronautical engineer. "Sky taxis are much more likely." But that won't stop inventors from dreaming up new ways to fly and trying to persuade investors to back their sometimes {{32}} schemes.

Civilian aviation is being disrupted, not by the age-old desires for speed, romanticism and {{33}}, but by the pressing need to respond to a changing climate. New electric engines coupled with artificial intelligence and {{34}} systems will contribute to a more efficient, integrated transport system that is less polluting and less noisy. That may sound simple, but as Prof. Gray says, "When I travel somewhere I like this notion that when I finish my journey I feel better than when I started it. That's completely at{{35}} with how I feel today." Now that would be progress.

options.text: autonomous
pouring
detached
prototypes
dual
random
glamour
repressing
imminent
