title: The Price of Oil and the Price of Carbon

passage.label: A

sentences.text: Fossil fuel prices are likely to stay "low for long".
Notwithstanding important recent progress in developing renewable fuel sources, low fossil fuel prices could discourage further innovation in, and adoption of, cleaner energy technologies.
The result would be higher emissions of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases.

passage.translation: 化石燃料价格可能会"长期保持低位"。尽管近期在开发可再生燃料来源方面取得了重要进展,但化石燃料价格走低可能会阻碍更清洁能源技术的进一步创新和采用。其结果将是二氧化碳和其他温室气体排放量增加。

passage.label: B

sentences.text: Policymakers should not allow low energy prices to derail the clean energy transition.
Action to restore appropriate price incentives, notably through corrective carbon pricing, is urgently needed to lower the risk of irreversible and potentially devastating effects of climate change.
That approach also offers fiscal benefits.

passage.translation: 政策制定者不应让低能源价格破坏清洁能源转型。迫切需要采取行动恢复适当的价格激励,特别是通过纠正性碳定价,以降低气候变化不可逆转且可能具有毁灭性影响的风险。这一方法还能带来财政收益。

passage.label: C

sentences.text: Oil prices have dropped by over 60% since June 2014.
A commonly held view in the oil industry is that "the best cure for low oil prices is low oil prices".

The reasoning behind this saying is that low oil prices discourage investment in new production capacity, eventually shifting the oil supply curve backward and bringing prices back up as existing oil fields—which can be tapped at relatively low marginal cost—are depleted.
In fact, in line with past experience, capital expenditure in the oil sector has dropped sharply in many producing countries, including the United States.
The dynamic adjustment to low oil prices may, however, be different this time around.

passage.translation: 自2014年6月以来,石油价格已下跌超过60%。石油行业普遍持有的观点是"低油价的最佳解药就是低油价"。这句话背后的逻辑是,低油价会抑制新生产能力的投资,最终使石油供应曲线向后移动,并在现有油田——这些油田可以以相对较低的边际成本开采——枯竭时使价格回升。事实上,与过去的经验一致,包括美国在内的许多产油国的石油行业资本支出已大幅下降。然而,这一次对低油价的动态调整可能有所不同。

passage.label: D

sentences.text: Oil prices are expected to remain lower for longer.
The advent of new technologies has added about 4.2 million barrels per day to the crude oil market, contributing to a global over-supply.

In addition, other factors are putting downward pressure on oil prices: change in the strategic behavior of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries, the projected increase in Iranian exports, the scaling- down of global demand (especially from emerging markets), the long-term drop in petroleum consumption in the United States, and some displacement of oil by substitutes.
These likely persistent forces, like the growth of shale(⻚岩) oil, point to a "low for long" scenario.
Futures markets, which show only a modest recovery of prices to around $60 a barrel by 2019, support this view.

passage.translation: 石油价格预计将在更长时间内保持较低水平。新技术的出现已为原油市场增加了约420万桶/日的产量,导致全球供应过剩。此外,其他因素也在给油价带来下行压力:石油输出国组织战略行为的变化、伊朗出口预计增加、全球需求(尤其是来自新兴市场的需求)缩减、美国石油消费的长期下降,以及一些替代品对石油的替代。这些可能持续存在的力量,如页岩油的增长,指向"长期低位"的情景。期货市场显示到2019年价格仅温和回升至每桶约60美元,这支持了这一观点。

passage.label: E

sentences.text: Natural gas and coal—also fossil fuels—have similarly seen price declines that look to be long-lived.
Coal and natural gas are mainly used for electricity generation, whereas oil is used mostly to power transportation, yet the prices of all these energy sources are linked.
The North American shale gas boom has resulted in record low prices there.

The recent discovery of the giant Zohr gas field off the Egyptian coast will eventually have impact on pricing in the Mediterranean region and Europe, and there is significant development potential in many other places, notably Argentina.
Coal prices also are low, owing to over-supply and the scaling-down of demand, especially from China, which burns half of the world's coal.

passage.translation: 天然气和煤炭——同样是化石燃料——也经历了看似长期的价格下跌。煤炭和天然气主要用于发电,而石油主要用于驱动交通运输,但所有这些能源的价格都是相互关联的。北美页岩气繁荣导致那里的价格创下历史新低。最近在埃及海岸发现的巨型Zohr天然气田最终将对地中海地区和欧洲的定价产生影响,许多其他地方也具有巨大的开发潜力,尤其是阿根廷。由于供应过剩和需求缩减,煤炭价格也处于低位,尤其是来自中国的需求,中国燃烧了全球一半的煤炭。

passage.label: F

sentences.text: Technological innovations have unleashed the power of renewables such as wind, hydro, solar, and geothermal(地热).
Even Africa and the Middle East, home to economies that are heavily dependent on fossil fuel exports, have enormous potential to develop renewables.
For example, the United Arab Emirates has endorsed an ambitious target to draw 24% of its primary energy consumption from renewable sources by 2021.

passage.translation: 技术创新释放了风能、水能、太阳能和地热能等可再生能源的潜力。即使是非洲和中东——这些严重依赖化石燃料出口的经济体所在地——也拥有开发可再生能源的巨大潜力。例如,阿联酋已制定了一个雄心勃勃的目标,即到2021年从可再生能源中获取其一次能源消费的24%。

passage.label: G

sentences.text: Progress in the development of renewables could be fragile, however, if fossil fuel prices remain low for long.
Renewables account for only a small share of global primary energy consumption, which is still dominated by fossil fuels—30% each for coal and oil, 25% for natural gas.
But renewable energy will have to displace fossil fuels to a much greater extent in the future to avoid unacceptable climate risks.

passage.translation: 然而,如果化石燃料价格长期保持低位,可再生能源发展的进展可能会很脆弱。可再生能源仅占全球一次能源消费的一小部分,化石燃料仍占主导地位——煤炭和石油各占30%,天然气占25%。但为了避免不可接受的气候风险,可再生能源未来必须在更大程度上取代化石燃料。

passage.label: H

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the current low prices for oil, gas, and coal may provide little incentive for research to find even cheaper substitutes for those fuels.
There is strong evidence that both innovation and adoption of cleaner technology are strongly encouraged by higher fossil fuel prices.
The same is true for new technologies for alleviating fossil fuel emissions.

passage.translation: 不幸的是,当前石油、天然气和煤炭的低价格可能无法为寻找这些燃料更便宜替代品的研究提供足够的激励。有强有力的证据表明,更高的化石燃料价格会极大地促进清洁技术的创新和采用。对于缓解化石燃料排放的新技术来说也是如此。

passage.label: I

sentences.text: The current low fossil fuel price environment will thus certainly delay the energy transition from fossil fuel to clean energy sources.

Unless renewables become cheap enough that substantial carbon deposits are left underground for a very long time, if not forever, the planet will likely be exposed to potentially catastrophic climate risks.

passage.translation: 因此,当前的低化石燃料价格环境肯定会推迟从化石燃料向清洁能源的能源转型。除非可再生能源变得足够便宜,以至于大量碳矿藏被长期甚至永远留在地下,否则地球可能会面临潜在的灾难性气候风险。

passage.label: J

sentences.text: Some climate impacts may already be discernible.

For example, the United Nations Children's Fund estimates that some 11 million children in Africa face hunger, disease, and water shortages as a result of the strongest El Nino(厄尔尼诺) weather phenomenon in decades.
Many scientists believe that El Nino events, caused by warming in the Pacific, are becoming more intense as a result of climate change.

passage.translation: 一些气候影响可能已经可以辨别。例如,联合国儿童基金会估计,由于数十年来最强的厄尔尼诺天气现象,非洲约1100万儿童面临饥饿、疾病和缺水问题。许多科学家认为,由太平洋变暖引起的厄尔尼诺事件正因气候变化而变得更加强烈。

passage.label: K

sentences.text: Nations from around the world have gathered in Paris for the United Nations Climate Change Conference, COP 21, with the goal of a universal and potentially legally-binding agreement on reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
We need very broad participation to fully address the global tragedy that results when countries fail to take into account the negative impact of their carbon emissions on the rest of the world.
Moreover, non-participation by nations, if sufficiently widespread, can undermine the political will of participating countries to act.

passage.translation: 来自世界各地的国家已在巴黎召开联合国气候变化大会COP 21,目标是就减少温室气体排放达成一项普遍且可能具有法律约束力的协议。我们需要非常广泛的参与,以充分解决当各国未能考虑其碳排放对世界其他地区的负面影响时所导致的全球性悲剧。此外,如果不参与的国家足够多,可能会削弱参与国采取行动的政治意愿。

passage.label: L

sentences.text: The nations participating at COP 21 are focusing on quantitative emissions-reduction commitments.
Economic reasoning shows that the least expensive way for each country is to put a price on carbon emissions.
The reason is that when carbon is priced, those emissions reductions that are least costly to implement will happen first.

The International Monetary Fund calculates that countries can generate substantial fiscal revenues by eliminating fossil fuel subsidies and levying carbon charges that capture the domestic damage caused by emissions.
A tax on upstream carbon sources is one easy way to put a price on carbon emissions, although some countries may wish to use other methods, such as emissions trading schemes.
In order to maximize global welfare, every country's carbon pricing should reflect not only the purely domestic damage from emissions, but also the damage to foreign countries.

passage.translation: 参加COP 21的国家正专注于量化减排承诺。经济推理表明,对每个国家来说,最便宜的方式是对碳排放定价。原因是,当碳被定价时,那些实施成本最低的减排措施将首先发生。国际货币基金组织计算,各国可以通过取消化石燃料补贴并征收碳费来获得可观的财政收入,这些碳费可以弥补排放造成的国内损害。对上游碳源征税是为碳排放定价的一种简便方法,尽管一些国家可能希望使用其他方法,如排放交易计划。为了最大化全球福利,每个国家的碳定价不仅应反映排放造成的纯粹国内损害,还应反映对外国的损害。

passage.label: M

sentences.text: Setting the right carbon price will therefore efficiently align the costs paid by carbon users with the true social opportunity cost of using carbon.

By raising relative demand for clean energy sources, a carbon price would also help align the market return to clean-energy innovation with its social return, spurring the refinement of existing technologies and the development of new ones.
And it would raise the demand for technologies such as carbon capture and storage, spurring their further development.
If not corrected by the appropriate carbon price, low fossil fuel prices are not accurately signaling to markets the true social profitability of clean energy.

While alternative estimates of the damage from carbon emissions differ, and it's especially hard to reckon the likely costs of possible catastrophic climate events, most estimates suggest substantial negative effects.

passage.translation: 因此,设定正确的碳价格将有效地使碳使用者支付的成本与使用碳的真实社会机会成本保持一致。通过提高对清洁能源的相对需求,碳价格还将有助于使清洁能源创新的市场回报与其社会回报保持一致,从而刺激现有技术的改进和新技术的开发。它还将提高对碳捕获和储存等技术的需求,推动其进一步发展。如果不通过适当的碳价格加以纠正,低化石燃料价格就无法向市场准确地传递清洁能源真实社会盈利能力的信号。虽然对碳排放损害的不同估计有所不同,特别是很难估算可能的灾难性气候事件的可能成本,但大多数估计都表明存在重大的负面影响。

passage.label: N

sentences.text: Direct subsidies to research and development have been adopted by some governments but are a poor substitute for a carbon price: they do only part of the job, leaving in place market incentives to over- use fossil fuels and thereby add to the stock of atmospheric greenhouse gases without regard to the collateral(附带的) costs.

passage.translation: 一些政府已采用对研究和开发的直接补贴,但这是碳价格的拙劣替代品:它们只完成了部分工作,却让过度使用化石燃料的市场激励机制继续存在,从而在不考虑附带成本的情况下增加大气温室气体的存量。

passage.label: O

sentences.text: The hope is that the success of COP 21 opens the door to future international agreement on carbon prices.
Agreement on an international carbon-price floor would be a good starting point in that process.
Failure to address comprehensively the problem of greenhouse gas emissions, however, exposes all generations, present and future, to incalculable risks.

passage.translation: 希望COP 21的成功为未来关于碳价格的国际协议打开大门。就国际碳价格下限达成协议将是这一进程的良好起点。然而,未能全面解决温室气体排放问题,将使所有世代,无论现在还是未来,都面临无法估量的风险。

groups.instructions: In this section, you are going to read a passage with ten statements attached to it. Each statement contains information given in one of the paragraphs. Identify the paragraph from which the information is derived. You may choose a paragraph more than once. Each paragraph is marked with a letter. Answer the questions by marking the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2.

questions.prompt: A number of factors are driving down the global oil prices not just for now but in the foreseeable future.
questions.explanation:
**答案** D 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
许多因素正在推动全球油价下跌,不仅是现在,而且在可预见的未来也是如此。
**锚点** 多重因素＋未来油价持续走低
**定位** 预计油价将在更长时间内保持更低。新技术的出现每天给原油市场新增约 420 万桶，导致全球供过于求。此外，还有多种因素继续压低油价：欧佩克战略行为的改变、伊朗出口的预期增长、全球需求的缩减（尤其是来自新兴市场）、美国石油消费的长期下降，以及替代品对石油的部分挤占。
**改写** A number of factors are driving down the global oil prices ↔other factors are putting downward pressure on oil prices并列因素＋向下方向的同义替换not just for now but in the foreseeable future ↔Oil prices are expected to remain lower for longer时间长度的同义改写
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
C Oil prices have dropped by over 60% since June 2014 只讲了跌幅事实，没有 A number of factors 与 foreseeable future 同时落地的并列因素清单。Oil prices have dropped by over 60% since June 2014 E Natural gas and coal—also fossil fuels—have similarly seen price declines that look to be long-lived 锁定的是 gas/coal，而非 global oil prices。Natural gas and coal—also fossil fuels—have similarly seen price declines that look to be long-lived
questions.quote: Oil prices are expected to remain lower for longer. The advent of new technologies has added about 4.2 million barrels per day to the crude oil market, contributing to a global over-supply. In addition, other factors are putting downward pressure on oil prices: change in the strategic behavior of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries, the projected increase in Iranian exports, the scaling-down of global demand (especially from emerging markets), the long-term drop in petroleum consumption in the United States, and some displacement of oil by substitutes.

questions.prompt: Pricing carbon proves the most economical way to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
questions.explanation:
**答案** L 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
碳定价被证明是减少温室气体排放最经济的方式。
**锚点** 碳定价＝最经济的减排方式
**定位** 经济学推理表明，对每个国家而言，最便宜的方式就是给碳排放定价。
**改写** Pricing carbon ↔ put a price on carbon emissions动名词与动词短语的句式转换the most economical way to reduce greenhouse gas emissions ↔the least expensive way for each country is to put a price on carbon emissions正反向最高级同义
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
M Setting the right carbon price will therefore efficiently align the costs paid by carbon users with the true social opportunity cost of using carbon 只在论证 价格对齐机制，没有把碳定价说成 最便宜的减排路径。Setting the right carbon price will therefore efficiently align the costs paid by carbon users with the true social opportunity cost of using carbon N Direct subsidies to research and development have been adopted by some governments but are a poor substitute for a carbon price 是从反面贬低补贴，没有正面给出最高级判断。Direct subsidies to research and development have been adopted by some governments but are a poor substitute for a carbon price
questions.quote: Economic reasoning shows that the least expensive way for each country is to put a price on carbon emissions.

questions.prompt: It is estimated that extreme weather conditions have endangered the lives of millions of African children.
questions.explanation:
**答案** J 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
据估计,极端天气条件已经危及数百万非洲儿童的生命。
**锚点** 极端天气危及数百万非洲儿童
**定位** 例如，联合国儿童基金会估计，约 1100 万非洲儿童因数十年来最强的厄尔尼诺天气现象而面临饥饿、疾病与缺水。
**改写** extreme weather conditions ↔ the strongest El Nino weather phenomenon in decades具体气候事件 → 上位概括millions of African children ↔ 11 million children in Africa具体数字 → 量级上位endangered the lives of ↔ face hunger, disease, and water shortages结果聚合的同义
questions.quote: For example, the United Nations Children's Fund estimates that some 11 million children in Africa face hunger, disease, and water shortages as a result of the strongest El Nino weather phenomenon in decades.

questions.prompt: The prices of coal are low as a result of over-supply and decreasing demand.
questions.explanation:
**答案** E 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
由于供应过剩和需求下降,煤炭价格处于低位。
**锚点** 煤价因供过于求与需求下降而低
**定位** 煤炭价格同样很低，其原因是供过于求与需求下降，尤其是来自中国的需求下降，中国消耗了全世界一半的煤炭。
**改写** The prices of coal are low ↔ Coal prices also are low主语换序＋同义over-supply and decreasing demand ↔ over-supply and the scaling-down of demand近义短语逐字对位
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
D contributing to a global over-supply 与 the scaling-down of global demand (especially from emerging markets) 都讲油，没讲煤。contributing to a global over-supply
questions.quote: Coal prices also are low, owing to over-supply and the scaling-down of demand, especially from China, which burns half of the world's coal.

questions.prompt: Higher fossil fuel prices prove to be conducive to innovation and application of cleaner technology.
questions.explanation:
**答案** H 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
较高的化石燃料价格被证明有利于更清洁技术的创新和应用。
**锚点** 高化石燃料价格利于清洁技术创新与应用
**定位** 有强力证据表明，更高的化石燃料价格能够有力地推动清洁技术的创新与采用。
**改写** Higher fossil fuel prices ↔ higher fossil fuel prices几乎逐字一致conducive to innovation and application of cleaner technology ↔both innovation and adoption of cleaner technology are strongly encouraged近义动词＋被动主动转换
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
A low fossil fuel prices could discourage further innovation in, and adoption of, cleaner energy technologies 的因（low prices）与果（discourage）都与陈述句相反。low fossil fuel prices could discourage further innovation in, and adoption of, cleaner energy technologies
questions.quote: There is strong evidence that both innovation and adoption of cleaner technology are strongly encouraged by higher fossil fuel prices.

questions.prompt: If fossil fuel prices remain low for a long time, it may lead to higher emissions of greenhouse gases.
questions.explanation:
**答案** A 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
如果化石燃料价格长期保持低位,可能会导致温室气体排放量增加。
**锚点** 化石燃料长期低价 → 温室气体排放升高
**定位** 尽管可再生能源近年来取得了重要进展，但低化石燃料价格可能阻碍清洁能源技术的进一步创新与采用。其结果将是二氧化碳和其他温室气体的排放升高。
**改写** fossil fuel prices remain low for a long time ↔ Fossil fuel prices are likely to stay low for long时间长度的同义it may lead to higher emissions of greenhouse gases ↔The result would be higher emissions of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases因果连接词的同义＋上位概括
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
H both innovation and adoption of cleaner technology are strongly encouraged by higher fossil fuel prices 只立论于 higher prices，没有把 低价持续 → 高排放 这条结论说出。both innovation and adoption of cleaner technology are strongly encouraged by higher fossil fuel prices I The current low fossil fuel price environment will thus certainly delay the energy transition from fossil fuel to clean energy sources 的结论是 延迟转型，与陈述句的 排放升高 不对位。The current low fossil fuel price environment will thus certainly delay the energy transition from fossil fuel to clean energy sources
questions.quote: Notwithstanding important recent progress in developing renewable fuel sources, low fossil fuel prices could discourage further innovation in, and adoption of, cleaner energy technologies. The result would be higher emissions of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases.

questions.prompt: Fossil fuels remain the major source of primary energy consumption in today's world.
questions.explanation:
**答案** G 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
化石燃料仍然是当今世界一次能源消费的主要来源。
**锚点** 化石燃料仍是一次能源消费主源
**定位** 可再生能源仅占全球一次能源消费的小部分，化石燃料仍然主导整个消费结构——煤炭与石油各占 30%，天然气占 25%。
**改写** Fossil fuels remain the major source of primary energy consumption ↔Renewables account for only a small share of global primary energy consumption, which is still dominated by fossil fuels支配关系同义＋正反语义互补in today's world ↔ 30% each for coal and oil, 25% for natural gas当下数据佐证 现今 这一时间限定
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
E Natural gas and coal—also fossil fuels—have similarly seen price declines that look to be long-lived 关注 价格走低，没说 化石燃料占一次能源消费多少比例。Natural gas and coal—also fossil fuels—have similarly seen price declines that look to be long-lived
questions.quote: Renewables account for only a small share of global primary energy consumption, which is still dominated by fossil fuels—30% each for coal and oil, 25% for natural gas.

questions.prompt: Even major fossil exporting countries have great potential to develop renewable energies.
questions.explanation:
**答案** F 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
即使是主要的化石燃料出口国也拥有发展可再生能源的巨大潜力。
**锚点** 化石燃料出口大国也有可再生潜力
**定位** 甚至非洲与中东这些严重依赖化石燃料出口的经济体所在地区，也拥有发展可再生能源的巨大潜力。
**改写** Even major fossil exporting countries ↔Even Africa and the Middle East, home to economies that are heavily dependent on fossil fuel exports让步词同义＋具体地区上位have great potential to develop renewable energies ↔have enormous potential to develop renewables形容词近义＋同词对位
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
B Policymakers should not allow low energy prices to derail the clean energy transition 焦点在 政策，没讲 fossil exporting countries 的 renewable potential。Policymakers should not allow low energy prices to derail the clean energy transition
questions.quote: Even Africa and the Middle East, home to economies that are heavily dependent on fossil fuel exports, have enormous potential to develop renewables.

questions.prompt: Greenhouse gas emissions, if not properly dealt with, will pose endless risks for mankind.
questions.explanation:
**答案** O 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
温室气体排放如果不妥善处理,将给人类带来无尽的风险。
**锚点** 温室气体未妥善处理 → 人类无尽风险
**定位** 然而，若不能全面应对温室气体排放问题，将让现在与未来的所有世代都面临不可估量的风险。
**改写** if not properly dealt with ↔Failure to address comprehensively the problem of greenhouse gas emissions条件结构与名词化条件互译endless risks for mankind ↔ exposes all generations, present and future, to incalculable risks无尽 与 不可估量／所有世代 的同义
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
I Unless renewables become cheap enough that substantial carbon deposits are left underground for a very long time, if not forever, the planet will likely be exposed to potentially catastrophic climate risks 的条件是 可再生不够便宜，与陈述句 温室气体未妥善处理 的条件不直接对位。Unless renewables become cheap enough that substantial carbon deposits are left underground for a very long time, if not forever, the planet will likely be exposed to potentially catastrophic climate risks B irreversible and potentially devastating effects of climate change 出现在 政策呼吁 的语境里，没有 暴露所有世代于不可估量的风险 这一全人类范围断言。irreversible and potentially devastating effects of climate change
questions.quote: Failure to address comprehensively the problem of greenhouse gas emissions, however, exposes all generations, present and future, to incalculable risks.

questions.prompt: It is urgent for governments to increase the cost of using fossil fuels to an appropriate level to lessen the catastrophic effects of climate change.
questions.explanation:
**答案** B 段（弱锚点）
**题目译文**
政府迫切需要将使用化石燃料的成本提高到适当水平,以减轻气候变化的灾难性影响。
**锚点** 政府须紧迫提高化石燃料使用成本以减轻气候灾难
**定位** 亟需采取行动恢复合适的价格激励，尤其要通过纠正性的碳定价来降低气候变化不可逆且可能造成毁灭性影响的风险。
**改写** It is urgent for governments ↔ is urgently needed紧迫性程度词同义increase the cost of using fossil fuels to an appropriate level ↔Action to restore appropriate price incentives, notably through corrective carbon pricing动作目标的同义概括lessen the catastrophic effects of climate change ↔lower the risk of irreversible and potentially devastating effects of climate change动词同义＋形容词同义
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
L Economic reasoning shows that the least expensive way for each country is to put a price on carbon emissions 在论证 最便宜的减排路径，没有 urgent /urgently needed 这层紧迫呼吁。Economic reasoning shows that the least expensive way for each country is to put a price on carbon emissions M Setting the right carbon price will therefore efficiently align the costs paid by carbon users with the true social opportunity cost of using carbon 阐述机制对齐，未喊出 紧迫呼吁 与 减轻气候灾难 的成对结论。Setting the right carbon price will therefore efficiently align the costs paid by carbon users with the true social opportunity cost of using carbon
questions.quote: Action to restore appropriate price incentives, notably through corrective carbon pricing, is urgently needed to lower the risk of irreversible and potentially devastating effects of climate change.

title: Beginning in the late sixteenth century, it became…

sentences.text: Beginning in the late sixteenth century, it became fashionable for young aristocrats to visit Paris, Venice, Florence, and above all, Rome, as the culmination(终极) of their classical education.
Thus was born the idea of the Grand Tour, a practice which introduced Englishmen, Germans, Scandinavians, and also Americans to the art and culture of France and Italy for the next 300 years.
Travel was arduous and costly throughout the period, possible only for a privileged class—the same that produced gentlemen scientists, authors, antique experts, and patrons of the arts.

passage.translation: 从十六世纪晚期开始，年轻贵族访问巴黎、威尼斯、佛罗伦萨，尤其是罗马，作为其古典教育的终极体验，成为一种时尚。由此诞生了大旅行的概念，这一实践在接下来的300年里将英国人、德国人、斯堪的纳维亚人以及美国人引向法国和意大利的艺术与文化。在整个时期，旅行既艰苦又昂贵，只有特权阶层才有可能进行——正是这个阶层产生了绅士科学家、作家、古董专家和艺术赞助人。

sentences.text: The Grand Tourist was typically a young man with a thorough grounding in Greek and Latin literature as well as some leisure time, some means, and some interest in art.

The German traveler Johann Winckelmann pioneered the field of art history with his comprehensive study of Greek and Roman sculpture; he was portrayed by his friend Anton Raphael Mengs at the beginning of his long residence in Rome.

Most Grand Tourists, however, stayed for briefer periods and set out with less scholarly intentions, accompanied by a teacher or guardian, and expected to return home with souvenirs of their travels as well as an understanding of art and architecture formed by exposure to great masterpieces.

passage.translation: 大旅行者通常是一位在希腊和拉丁文学方面有深厚基础的年轻男子,同时拥有一些闲暇时间、一些财力以及对艺术的某种兴趣。德国旅行者Johann Winckelmann以其对希腊和罗马雕塑的综合研究开创了艺术史领域;他在罗马长期居住之初由其朋友Anton Raphael Mengs为其画像。然而,大多数大旅行者停留的时间较短,出发时的学术意图也较少,由教师或监护人陪同,并期望带着旅行纪念品以及通过接触伟大杰作而形成的对艺术和建筑的理解返回家乡。

sentences.text: London was a frequent starting point for Grand Tourists, and Paris a compulsory destination; many traveled to the Netherlands, some to Switzerland and Germany, and a very few adventurers to Spain, Greece, or Turkey.
The essential place to visit, however, was Italy.

The British traveler Charles Thompson spoke for many Grand Tourists when in 1744 he described himself as "being impatiently desirous of viewing a country so famous in history, a country which once gave laws to the world, and which is at present the greatest school of music and painting, contains the noblest productions of sculpture and architecture, and is filled with cabinets of rarities, and collections of all kinds of historical relics".
Within Italy, the great focus was Rome, whose ancient ruins and more recent achievements were shown to every Grand Tourist.
Panini's Ancient Rome and Modern Rome represent the sights most prized, including celebrated Greco-Roman statues and views of famous ruins, fountains, and churches.

Since there were few museums anywhere in Europe before the close of the eighteenth century, Grand Tourists often saw paintings and sculptures by gaining admission to private collections, and many were eager to acquire examples of Greco-Roman and Italian art for their own collections.

In England, where architecture was increasingly seen as an aristocratic pursuit, noblemen often applied what they learned from the villas of Palladio in the Veneto and the evocative(唤起回忆的) ruins of Rome to their own country houses and gardens.

passage.translation: 伦敦是大旅行者的常见出发点,巴黎是必到之处;许多人前往荷兰,一些人前往瑞士和德国,极少数冒险者前往西班牙、希腊或土耳其。然而,必去之地是意大利。英国旅行者Charles Thompson在1744年描述自己"迫不及待地渴望参观一个在历史上如此著名的国家,一个曾经为世界制定法律的国家,一个目前是音乐和绘画最伟大学府的国家,包含雕塑和建筑最高贵的作品,并充满珍品陈列室和各种历史遗物收藏",这代表了许多大旅行者的心声。在意大利境内,重点是罗马,其古代遗迹和较近期的成就会向每一位大旅行者展示。Panini的《古代罗马》和《现代罗马》代表了最受珍视的景观,包括著名的希腊罗马雕像以及著名废墟、喷泉和教堂的景观。由于十八世纪末之前欧洲各地几乎没有博物馆,大旅行者常常通过获准进入私人收藏来观赏绘画和雕塑,许多人渴望为自己的收藏获得希腊罗马和意大利艺术的范例。在英国,建筑日益被视为贵族的追求,贵族们常常将他们从Veneto地区Palladio的别墅和罗马引人回忆的废墟中学到的东西应用到自己的乡间宅邸和花园中。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What is said about the Grand Tour?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
关于大游学有何说法?
A) 它在当时的年轻人中很流行。
B) 普通人负担不起。
C) 它造就了一些著名的欧洲艺术家。
D) 它成为大学教育的必修部分。
**判型** What is said about the Grand Tour 直接问关于这件事的某个陈述，是对原文细节的事实性核对，不要求归纳整篇也不要求推断。
**拆句** What is said about the Grand Tour? 是 What 引导的一般疑问句，谓语用被动 is said，主语是疑问词 What。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 整个时期，旅行都既艰辛又昂贵，只有特权阶层才负担得起——也正是这一阶层产生了绅士科学家、作家、古董鉴赏家和艺术赞助人。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念It was fashionable among young people of the time 把原文的 young aristocrats（年轻贵族）偷偷换成 young people（年轻人）。原文限定是年轻贵族这个特权小群体，并未说在所有年轻人中流行。
B) ✓ 正确possible only for a privileged class↔unaffordable for ordinary people预判是「只有少数人去得起」，B 选项 unaffordable for ordinary people 正是这句话从「少数人可以」翻成「多数人不可以」的对称否定，与定位句严丝合缝。
C) 无中生有It produced some famous European artists 说 Grand Tour 培养出了著名艺术家。原文 the same that produced gentlemen scientists, authors, antique experts, and patrons of the arts 说的是「特权阶层」产生了这些人，且这些人是科学家、作家、古董专家、艺术赞助人，不是 artists；而且产生主语是「阶层」，不是 Grand Tour本身。
D) 偷换概念It made a compulsory part of college education 用 college education 替换原文的classical education。前者指大学教育，后者指对古希腊罗马经典的学习；而且原文用的是 fashionable（流行的），不是 compulsory（必修的）。
questions.quote: Travel was arduous and costly throughout the period, possible only for a privileged class—the same that produced gentlemen scientists, authors, antique experts, and patrons of the arts.

options.text: It was fashionable among young people of the time.
It was unaffordable for ordinary people.
It produced some famous European artists.
It made a compulsory part of college education.

questions.prompt: What did Grand Tourists have in common?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
大游学旅行者有什么共同点?
A) 他们有丰富的地理知识。
B) 他们勇敢且富有冒险精神。
C) 他们精通文学并对艺术感兴趣。
D) 他们有足够的旅行和户外生活经验。
**判型** What did Grand Tourists have in common 问的是一个客观共性事实，仍属于「原文写了就有、没写就没」的细节核对。
**拆句** What did Grand Tourists have in common? 一般疑问句，have in common 是固定搭配have something in common（有共同点）的中间挖空形式。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** Grand Tourist 通常是一位对希腊和拉丁文学有透彻基础、并有一定闲暇时间、一定经济能力以及对艺术抱有兴趣的年轻人。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有They had much geographic knowledge（具备丰富的地理知识）在原文中找不到对应——原文给的是古典文学、闲、钱、艺术兴趣，未提地理知识。
B) 以偏概全They were courageous and venturesome（勇敢而富冒险精神）只对应第 3 段提到的a very few adventurers to Spain, Greece, or Turkey，即极少数冒险家，而不是Grand Tourist 群体的共性。
C) ✓ 正确a thorough grounding in Greek and Latin literature ↔ versed in literature some interest in art↔ interested in art预判要求同时覆盖「古典文学功底 + 艺术兴趣」，C 项 versed in literature and interested in art 两段并列恰好对应两点，无遗漏。
D) 无中生有They had enough travel and outdoor-life experience（有充分的旅行和户外经验）原文没说。原文只在第 1 段说 Travel was arduous and costly——旅行艰难，反而暗示他们从未做过这类艰苦旅行。
questions.quote: The Grand Tourist was typically a young man with a thorough grounding in Greek and Latin literature as well as some leisure time, some means, and some interest in art.

options.text: They had much geographic knowledge.
They were courageous and venturesome.
They were versed in literature and interested in art.
They had enough travel and outdoor-life experience.

questions.prompt: How did Grand Tourists benefit from their travel?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
大游学旅行者如何从旅行中受益?
A) 他们从世界上最伟大的杰作中找到了灵感。
B) 他们对早期人类文明有了更好的了解。
C) 他们对现代艺术形式的起源产生了兴趣。
D) 他们获得了一些古典艺术和建筑方面的知识。
**判型** How did Grand Tourists benefit from their travel 问的是一个客观事实——旅行带给他们什么收获，是细节核对题。
**拆句** How did Grand Tourists benefit from their travel? How 引导的一般疑问句，benefit from 是固定搭配（从…中获益）。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 然而大多数 Grand Tourists 停留时间较短、出发时学术目的也较弱，由一位教师或监护人陪同，并预期带着旅行纪念品以及通过接触杰作而形成的对艺术与建筑的理解回到家中。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 过度推断They found inspiration in the world's greatest masterpieces（从最伟大的杰作中找到灵感）原文只说 exposure to great masterpieces（接触杰作），并未说找到了灵感；找到灵感是创作者的反应，原文是观众式的学习。
B) 偷换概念They got a better understanding of early human civilization（对早期人类文明有了更好理解）原文谈的是 art and architecture，特别是古希腊罗马的艺术与建筑，不是泛泛的「早期人类文明」。early human civilization 通常指史前或更广义的远古文明。
C) 与原文相反They developed an interest in the origin of Modern art forms（对现代艺术形式的起源产生兴趣）原文谈的全部是 classical/Greco-Roman 古典艺术，与「现代艺术」在时代上正好相反，且未提「起源研究」。
D) ✓ 正确an understanding of art and architecture formed by exposure to great masterpieces ↔They gained some knowledge of classical art and architecture as the culmination of their classical education ↔ classical art and architecture预判要求「获得艺术与建筑的认识」，D They gained some knowledge of classical art and architecture 三个语义点完整覆盖：gained = formed/return with、knowledge = understanding、art and architecture 原词，命中度最高。
questions.quote: Most Grand Tourists, however, stayed for briefer periods and set out with less scholarly intentions, accompanied by a teacher or guardian, and expected to return home with souvenirs of their travels as well as an understanding of art and architecture formed by exposure to great masterpieces.

options.text: They found inspiration in the world's greatest masterpieces.
They got a better understanding of early human civilization.
They developed an interest in the origin of Modern art forms.
They gained some knowledge of classical art and architecture.

questions.prompt: Why did many Grand Tourists visit the private collections?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
为什么许多大游学旅行者参观私人收藏?
A) 他们可以在那里购买独特的纪念品带回家。
B) 19世纪以前欧洲几乎没有任何博物馆。
C) 他们发现那里的古董更有价值。
D) 私人收藏的种类更多。
**判型** Why did many Grand Tourists visit the private collections 问的是一个具体原因，原文应有 since/because 之类的因果句，是细节题而非推断题。
**拆句** Why did many Grand Tourists visit the private collections? Why 引导的一般疑问句，visit 是谓语动词。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 由于 18 世纪末以前整个欧洲几乎没有什么博物馆，Grand Tourists 往往通过取得进入私人收藏的许可来看画作与雕塑，许多人还急切地希望为自己的收藏获取希腊罗马和意大利艺术的样本。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 答非所问They could buy unique souvenirs there to take back home（他们可以在那里买独特的纪念品带回家）原文说的是 gaining admission to private collections（取得参观许可），并非购物；纪念品 souvenirs 是第 2 段的话题，与「为何参观私人收藏」无关。
B) ✓ 正确there were few museums anywhere in Europe before the close of the eighteenth century ↔Europe hardly had any museums before the 19th century预判「当时几乎没博物馆」与 B Europe hardly had any museums before the 19th century 一一对应，连时间表达都完成了 the close of the eighteenth century → the 19th century 的对称转换。
C) 无中生有They found the antiques there more valuable（他们发现那里的古董更有价值）原文没有比较——既未说私人收藏比哪里的更有价值，也没有 valuable 这种判断。
D) 无中生有Private collections were of greater variety（私人收藏种类更丰富）原文未提「种类多」或与其他来源做对比；原文只说很多人「急于为自己的收藏获取样本」，与「种类更多」无关。
questions.quote: Since there were few museums anywhere in Europe before the close of the eighteenth century, Grand Tourists often saw paintings and sculptures by gaining admission to private collections, and many were eager to acquire examples of Greco-Roman and Italian art for their own collections.

options.text: They could buy unique souvenirs there to take back home.
Europe hardly had any museums before the 19th century.
They found the antiques there more valuable.
Private collections were of greater variety.

questions.prompt: How did the Grand Tour influence the architecture in England?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
大游学如何影响英国的建筑?
A) 出现了越来越多的罗马风格建筑。
B) 许多贵族开始搬入罗马风格的别墅。
C) 贵族的乡村住宅都有罗马风格的花园。
D) 意大利建筑师被雇来设计房屋和花园。
**判型** How did the Grand Tour influence the architecture in England 问的是一个原文已写出的具体影响，仍走细节核对，不是要归纳全篇主旨。
**拆句** How did the Grand Tour influence the architecture in England? How 引导的一般疑问句，influence 是谓语，the architecture in England 是宾语，in England 修饰architecture。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 在英格兰，建筑越来越被视为贵族的爱好，贵族们常常把他们从威尼托地区帕拉第奥别墅以及罗马富于唤起力的废墟中学到的东西，运用到自己的乡间住宅和花园之中。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确noblemen often applied what they learned from the villas of Palladio in the Veneto and the evocative ruins of Rome to their own country houses and gardens↔ There appeared more and more Roman-style buildings the villas of Palladio in the Veneto and the evocative ruins of Rome↔Roman-style原文写「贵族把学到的罗马风格用到自家房子」，A There appeared more and more Roman-style buildings 是从结果角度对这件事的客观转述，对应得严丝合缝。
B) 偷换概念Many aristocrats began to move into Roman-style villas（许多贵族开始搬进罗马风格的别墅）原文是把「从别墅中学到的」风格应用到自家英国住宅上，不是搬进意大利的别墅；move into 这一行为原文未提。
C) 以偏概全Aristocrats' country houses all had Roman-style gardens（贵族的乡间住宅都有罗马风格的花园）原文用 often applied（经常应用），是高频但非全部；选项 all 把高频升级成绝对全部，范围被偷偷放大。
D) 无中生有Italian architects were hired to design houses and gardens（意大利建筑师被雇来设计房子和花园）原文说的是 noblemen 自己应用所学，未提雇佣意大利建筑师；hire这一动作整体属于杜撰。
questions.quote: In England, where architecture was increasingly seen as an aristocratic pursuit, noblemen often applied what they learned from the villas of Palladio in the Veneto and the evocative ruins of Rome to their own country houses and gardens.

options.text: There appeared more and more Roman-style buildings.
Many aristocrats began to move into Roman-style villas.
Aristocrats' country houses all had Roman-style gardens.
Italian architects were hired to design houses and gardens.

title: Tennessee's technical and community colleges will not outsource(外包)…

sentences.text: Tennessee's technical and community colleges will not outsource(外包) management of their facilities to a private company, a decision one leader said was bolstered by an analysis of spending at each campus.

passage.translation: 田纳西州的技术学院和社区学院将不会把其设施管理外包给私营公司,一位领导表示,这一决定得到了对各校区支出分析的支持。

sentences.text: In an email sent Monday to college presidents in the Tennessee Board of Regents system, outgoing Chancellor John Morgan said an internal analysis showed that each campus' spending on facilities management fell well below the industry standards identified by the state.

Morgan said those findings—which included data from the system's 13 community colleges, 27 technical colleges and six universities—were part of the decision not to move forward with Governor Bill Haslam's proposal to privatize management of state buildings in an effort to save money.

passage.translation: 在周一发给田纳西州董事会系统各学院院长的一封电子邮件中,即将离任的校长John Morgan表示,一项内部分析显示,各校区在设施管理方面的支出远低于该州确定的行业标准。Morgan表示,这些调查结果——包括来自该系统13所社区学院、27所技术学院和6所大学的数据——是决定不推进州长Bill Haslam提出的将州立建筑管理私有化以节省资金的提案的部分原因。

sentences.text: "While these numbers are still being validated by the state, we feel any adjustments they might suggest will be immaterial," Morgan wrote to the presidents.
"System institutions are operating very efficiently based on this analysis, raising the question of the value of pursuing a broad scale outsourcing initiative."

passage.translation: Morgan在给各院长的信中写道:"虽然这些数字仍在接受州政府的验证,但我们认为他们可能提出的任何调整都将是无关紧要的。根据这项分析,系统内各机构的运营效率非常高,这引发了一个问题,即追求大规模外包举措的价值何在。"

sentences.text: Workers' advocates have criticized Haslam's plan, saying it would mean some campus workers would lose their jobs or benefits.
Haslam has said colleges would be free to opt in or out of the outsourcing plan, which has not been finalized.

passage.translation: 工人权益倡导者批评了Haslam的计划,称这将意味着一些校园工作人员会失去工作或福利。Haslam表示,各学院可以自由选择加入或退出尚未最终确定的外包计划。

sentences.text: Morgan notified the Haslam administration of his decision to opt out in a letter sent last week.
That letter, which includes several concerns Morgan has with the plan, was originally obtained by The Commercial Appeal in Memphis.

passage.translation: Morgan在上周发出的一封信中向Haslam政府通报了他选择退出的决定。这封信包含了Morgan对该计划的几点担忧,最初由孟菲斯的The Commercial Appeal获得。

sentences.text: In an email statement from the state's Office of Customer Focused Government, which is examining the possibility of outsourcing, spokeswoman Michelle R.
Martin said officials were still working to analyze the data from the Board of Regents.

Data on management expenses at the college system and in other state departments will be part of a "business justification" the state will use as officials deliberate the specifics of an outsourcing plan.

passage.translation: 在该州客户导向型政府办公室发表的一份电子邮件声明中,该办公室正在研究外包的可能性,女发言人Michelle R. Martin表示,官员们仍在努力分析来自董事会的数据。学院系统和其他州政府部门的管理费用数据将成为该州"业务论证"的一部分,官员们将利用这些论证来审议外包计划的具体细节。

sentences.text: "The state's facilities management project team is still in the process of developing its business justification and expects to have that completed and available to the public at the end of February," Martin said.
"At this time there is nothing to take action on since the analysis has yet to be completed."

passage.translation: Martin说:"该州的设施管理项目团队仍在制定其业务论证,预计将在2月底完成并向公众公布。目前由于分析尚未完成,没有需要采取行动的事项。"

sentences.text: Morgan's comments on outsourcing mark the second time this month that he has come out against one of Haslam's plans for higher education in Tennessee.

Morgan said last week that he would retire at the end of January because of the governor's proposal to split off six universities of the Board of Regents system and create separate governing boards for each of them.
In his resignation letter, Morgan called the reorganization "unworkable".

passage.translation: Morgan关于外包的评论标志着他本月第二次公开反对Haslam为田纳西州高等教育制定的计划之一。Morgan上周表示,由于州长提出将董事会系统的六所大学分离出来,并为每所大学建立独立的管理委员会,他将于1月底退休。在辞职信中,Morgan称这次重组"不可行"。

questions.prompt: What do we learn about the decision of technical and community colleges in Tennessee?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
关于田纳西州技术学院和社区学院的决定,我们了解到什么?
A) 该决定得到了校园支出分析的支持。
B) 该决定已被州长断然拒绝。
C) 该决定忽视了教职工的诉求。
D) 该决定将改善这些院校的财务状况。
**判型** What do we learn about the decision of technical and community colleges in Tennessee? 问的是关于这个决定我们从文中得知什么，是对原文事实的客观转述，不带infer / imply。
**拆句** What do we learn about the decision of technical and community colleges in Tennessee? 是一个直接特殊疑问句，about 后面带一个长名词短语，里面 of technical and community colleges in Tennessee 是 the decision 的两层后置修饰（of 短语 + in短语）；结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 田纳西州的技术学院与社区学院不会把它们的设施管理外包给私营公司，一位领导者说这一决定有 "对各校园开支的一份分析" 作支撑。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确a decision one leader said was bolstered by an analysis of spending at each campus ↔It is backed by a campus spending analysis.选项 It is backed by a campus spending analysis. 把 bolster 换成 back，把 of 短语压成复合名词，语义和预判 "决定有开支分析作支撑" 一一对应。
B) 看清谁拒绝了谁It has been flatly rejected by the governor. 的 rejected by the governor 与Governor Bill Haslam's proposal to privatize management of state buildings 中州长 "提出外包" 的事实相反——是 Morgan 不接受州长的方案，不是州长否决学院的决定。
C) 无中生有It has neglected their faculty's demands. 中 faculty's demands（教师诉求）在原文没有任何对应：文中提到的是 Workers' advocates（工人权益倡导者），并非 faculty（教师），也未出现 demands 这一指控。
D) 过度推断It will improve their financial situation. 把改善财务状况说成学院决定的结果；原文里in an effort to save money 是州长想 "为州里省钱" 才提出外包的动机，并未说不外包能改善学院财务。
questions.quote: Tennessee's technical and community colleges will not outsource(外包) management of their facilities to a private company, a decision one leader said was bolstered by an analysis of spending at each campus.

options.text: It is backed by a campus spending analysis.
It has been flatly rejected by the governor.
It has neglected their faculty's demands.
It will improve their financial situation.

questions.prompt: What does the campus spending analysis reveal?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
校园支出分析揭示了什么?
A) 私营企业在校园管理中发挥着重要作用。
B) 由学院进行设施管理更具成本效益。
C) 近年来设施管理已有很大改善。
D) 学院对自身财务事务拥有完全的控制权。
**判型** What does the campus spending analysis reveal? 问的是分析揭示了什么客观事实，仍属对原文结论句的转述。
**拆句** What does the campus spending analysis reveal? 是 What 作宾语前置的特殊疑问句，主语是 the campus spending analysis，谓语 reveal；结构清晰，无陷阱。
**定位** 即将离任的校长 John Morgan 说，一份内部分析显示，每一所校园在设施管理上的开支都远低于该州认定的行业标准。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反Private companies play a big role in campus management. 与原文方向直接相反——分析得出的结论恰恰是 "不需要外包给私企"，raising the question of the value of pursuing a broad scale outsourcing initiative 是在反问外包的必要性。
B) ✓ 正确each campus' spending on facilities management fell well below the industry standards ↔Facilities management by colleges is more cost-effective. "开支低于业内标准 + 学院自己在管" 两段信息合起来就是 "由学院来管反而更省钱"，与选项 Facilities management by colleges is more cost-effective. 完全等值。
C) 无中生有Facilities management has greatly improved in recent years. 中 in recent years 的时间纵向比较，全文没有任何依据；原文只做 "当前校园开支 vs 当前业内标准" 的横向比较，未涉及历史改进。
D) 以偏概全Colleges exercise full control over their own financial affairs. 中 full control over financial affairs 的全权说法在原文没依据；原文只谈一笔具体开支（设施管理）低于业内标准，并未谈学院整体财权的归属。
questions.quote: outgoing Chancellor John Morgan said an internal analysis showed that each campus' spending on facilities management fell well below the industry standards identified by the state.

options.text: Private companies play a big role in campus management.
Facilities management by colleges is more cost-effective.
Facilities management has greatly improved in recent years.
Colleges exercise full control over their own financial affairs.

questions.prompt: Workers' supporters argue that Bill Haslam's proposal would _________.
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
工人支持者认为Bill Haslam的提案将_________。
A) 剥夺学院管理其设施的权利
B) 使工人履行职责的积极性降低
C) 导致一些校园工人失业
D) 导致校园设施私有化
**判型** Workers' supporters argue that Bill Haslam's proposal would _________. 留空让你补出Workers' supporters 的论点内容，即原文对应论点的同义转述。
**拆句** Workers' supporters argue that Bill Haslam's proposal would _________. 是一个简单复合句：主句主语 Workers' supporters，谓语 argue；that 引导宾语从句，从句里 Bill Haslam's proposal 作主语、would 后接选项补出的动词原形；结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 工人权益倡导者批评 Haslam 的方案，称这会意味着一些校园工人失去工作或福利。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反deprive colleges of the right to manage their facilities 把后果说成 "剥夺学院自管权"，原文 Haslam has said colleges would be free to opt in or out of the outsourcing plan 反而强调学校可自由进出。
B) 偷换概念make workers less motivated in performing duties 提到 "工作积极性下降"，原文从未谈及 motivation 维度；倡导者担心的是 "失业 / 失福利" 这种实体损失，不是士气。
C) ✓ 正确some campus workers would lose their jobs or benefits ↔render a number of campus workers jobless原文给的是 "丢工作 OR 丢福利" 两个并列后果，选项 render a number of campus workers jobless 命中其中 "丢工作" 这一支；六级选 "原文也直说过" 的那一项，没毛病。
D) 答非所问lead to the privatization of campus facilities 把 "私有化校园设施" 说成倡导者批评的后果；但 privatize 本来就是 Haslam 计划本身（Governor Bill Haslam's proposal to privatize management of state buildings），不是倡导者另外担心的后果。
questions.quote: Workers' advocates have criticized Haslam's plan, saying it would mean some campus workers would lose their jobs or benefits.

options.text: deprive colleges of the right to manage their facilities
make workers less motivated in performing duties
render a number of campus workers jobless
lead to the privatization of campus facilities

questions.prompt: What do we learn from the state spokeswoman's response to John Morgan's decision?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
从州政府女发言人对John Morgan决定的回应中我们了解到什么?
A) 外包计划尚未最终确定。
B) 外包计划将会实施。
C) 州政府官员对外包计划充满信心。
D) 学院支出分析证明外包计划是合理的。
**判型** What do we learn from the state spokeswoman's response to John Morgan's decision? 问的是发言人回应中我们读到了什么客观事实，仍是原文转述。
**拆句** What do we learn from the state spokeswoman's response to John Morgan's decision? 是特殊疑问句，from 引出短语作状语，里面 the state spokeswoman's response 是核心名词，后跟 to John Morgan's decision 的介词短语作后置修饰，限定是"对谁的决定的回应"；结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 州里负责设施管理项目的团队仍在制定其业务可行性报告，预计 2 月底完成并对外公开。眼下没有可执行的事项，因为分析还没完成。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确The state's facilities management project team is still in the process of developing its business justification↔ The outsourcing plan is not yet finalized. Haslam has said colleges would be free to opt in or out of the outsourcing plan, which has not been finalized.↔ The outsourcing plan is not yet finalized.发言人原话强调 "仍在制定 / 没东西可执行"，与第 4 段 which has not been finalized完全合拍，对应选项 The outsourcing plan is not yet finalized.。
B) 过度推断The outsourcing plan will be implemented. 把 "将会实施" 当作发言人态度，原文反而是 At this time there is nothing to take action on——现在无可执行，并未承诺一定实施。
C) 无中生有The state officials are confident about the outsourcing plan. 用 confident 强加情绪色彩，原文发言人通篇是 "还在做、还没定" 的中性陈述，未现任何信心表态。
D) 与原文相反The college spending analysis justifies the outsourcing plan. 让学院开支分析去 "证成外包"，与第 2 段 fell well below the industry standards 给出的结论方向相反——分析得出的是 "无需外包"。
questions.quote: The state's facilities management project team is still in the process of developing its business justification and expects to have that completed and available to the public at the end of February. At this time there is nothing to take action on since the analysis has yet to be completed.

options.text: The outsourcing plan is not yet finalized.
The outsourcing plan will be implemented.
The state officials are confident about the outsourcing plan.
The college spending analysis justifies the outsourcing plan.

questions.prompt: Why did John Morgan decide to resign?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
John Morgan为什么决定辞职?
A) 他对田纳西州政府失去了信心。
B) 他在高等教育政策上与州长意见不一致。
C) 他认为州政府的外包提案根本行不通。
D) 他反对州长重建学院董事会系统的计划。
**判型** Why did John Morgan decide to resign? 问的是原因，原文有 because of 显式给出，属对原因句的转述。
**拆句** Why did John Morgan decide to resign? 是 Why 起手的特殊疑问句，结构平铺直叙，decide to resign 是 "动词 + 不定式" 的常规搭配；无陷阱。
**定位** Morgan 上周说他将在 1 月底退休，原因是州长提议把董事会系统下的 6 所大学拆出来，各自成立独立的治理委员会。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 以偏概全He had lost confidence in the Tennessee state government. 把原因从 "反对州长某具体方案" 扩大成 "对州政府整体失去信心"，原文从未谈及他对州政府整体的信任状态。
B) 以偏概全He disagreed with the governor on higher education policies. 中 higher education policies 是复数泛指 "高等教育政策" 整体；原文 Morgan's comments on outsourcing mark the second time this month that he has come out against one of Haslam's plans 只表明 "第二次反对州长其中一项方案"，仍是单一政策维度。
C) 张冠李戴He thought the state's outsourcing proposal was simply unworkable. 把辞职原因说成 "觉得外包方案不可行"，但原文 In his resignation letter, Morgan called the reorganization "unworkable". 中 unworkable 修饰的是 the reorganization（重组）而不是 outsourcing；辞职原因明确是 because of the governor's proposal to split off six universities，即重组，不是外包。
D) ✓ 正确because of the governor's proposal to split off six universities of the Board of Regents system and create separate governing boards for each of them↔ He opposed the governor's plan to reconstruct the college board system.原文交代他辞职的直接原因就是州长这一拆分提案，辞职这个行为本身即 oppose 的最强表达，与选项 He opposed the governor's plan to reconstruct the college board system. 等值。
questions.quote: Morgan said last week that he would retire at the end of January because of the governor's proposal to split off six universities of the Board of Regents system and create separate governing boards for each of them.

He disagreed with the governor on higher education policies.
He thought the state's outsourcing proposal was simply unworkable.

title: Let's all stop judging people who talk to…

sentences.text: Let's all stop judging people who talk to themselves.
New research says that those who can't seem to keep their inner monologues(独白) in are actually more likely to stay on task, remain (26)____ better and show improved perception capabilities.
Not bad, really, for some extra muttering.

passage.translation: 让我们都别再评判那些自言自语的人了。新研究表明,那些似乎无法将内心独白憋在心里的人实际上更有可能专注于任务,保持更好的注意力,并表现出更强的感知能力。对于一些额外的喃喃自语来说,这真的还不错。

sentences.text: According to a series of experiments published in the Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology by professors Gary Lupyan and Daniel Swignley, the act of using verbal clues to (27)____ mental pictures helps people function quicker.

passage.translation: 根据Gary Lupyan和Daniel Swignley两位教授在《实验心理学季刊》上发表的一系列实验,使用语言线索来触发心理图像的行为能帮助人们更快地运作。

sentences.text: In one experiment, they showed pictures of various objects to twenty (28)____ and asked them to find just one of those, a banana.
Half were (29)____ to repeat out loud what they were looking for and the other half kept their lips (30)____ .
Those who talked to themselves found the banana slightly faster than those who didn't, the researchers say.

In other experiments, Lupyan and Swignley found that(31)____ the name of a common product when on the hunt for it helped quicken someone's pace, but talking about uncommon items showed no advantage and slowed you down.

passage.translation: 在一项实验中,他们向二十名志愿者展示了各种物品的图片,并要求他们只找出其中一个——一根香蕉。一半人被要求大声重复他们要找的东西,另一半人则保持沉默。研究人员说,那些自言自语的人比那些不说话的人稍快地找到了香蕉。在其他实验中,Lupyan和Swignley发现,在寻找常见商品时说出其名称有助于加快某人的速度,但谈论不常见的物品则没有优势,反而会拖慢你的速度。

sentences.text: Common research has long held that talking themselves through a task helps children learn, although doing so when you've (32)____ matured is not a great sign of (33)____ .

The two professors hope to refute that idea, (34)____ that just as when kids walk themselves through a process, adults can benefit from using language not just to communicate, but also to help "augment thinking".

passage.translation: 常见的研究长期以来认为,通过自言自语来完成任务有助于儿童学习,尽管当你显然已经成熟时这样做并不是聪明的好迹象。这两位教授希望反驳这一观点,声称就像孩子们引导自己完成一个过程一样,成年人也可以从使用语言中受益,不仅是为了交流,还可以帮助'增强思维'。

sentences.text: Of course, you are still encouraged to keep the talking at library tones and, whatever you do, keep the information you share simple, like a grocery list.
At any (35)____ , there's still such a thing as too much information.

passage.translation: 当然,我们仍然鼓励你把说话保持在图书馆的音量,而且无论你做什么,都要让你分享的信息保持简单,比如购物清单。无论音量如何,信息过多仍然是个问题。

groups.instructions: In this section, there is a passage with ten blanks. You are required to select one word for each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage. Read the passage through carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not use any of the words in the bank more than once.
groups.content:
Let's all stop judging people who talk to themselves. New research says that those who can't seem to keep their inner monologues(独白) in are actually more likely to stay on task, remain {{26}} better and show improved perception capabilities. Not bad, really, for some extra muttering.

According to a series of experiments published in the Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology by professors Gary Lupyan and Daniel Swignley, the act of using verbal clues to {{27}} mental pictures helps people function quicker.

In one experiment, they showed pictures of various objects to twenty {{28}} and asked them to find just one of those, a banana. Half were {{29}} to repeat out loud what they were looking for and the other half kept their lips {{30}} . Those who talked to themselves found the banana slightly faster than those who didn't, the researchers say. In other experiments, Lupyan and Swignley found that{{31}} the name of a common product when on the hunt for it helped quicken someone's pace, but talking about uncommon items showed no advantage and slowed you down.

Common research has long held that talking themselves through a task helps children learn, although doing so when you've {{32}} matured is not a great sign of {{33}} . The two professors hope to refute that idea, {{34}} that just as when kids walk themselves through a process, adults can benefit from using language not just to communicate, but also to help "augment thinking".

Of course, you are still encouraged to keep the talking at library tones and, whatever you do, keep the information you share simple, like a grocery list. At any {{35}} , there's still such a thing as too much information.

options.text: apparently
obscurely
arrogance
sealed
brilliance
spectators
claiming
trigger
dedicated
uttering
focused
volume
incur
volunteers
instructed

questions.explanation:
**答案** F) focused 形容词
**词性槽** remain + 空，空作表语
**依据** stay focused 是固定表达focused 与前文 stay on task（保持专心于任务）并列，stay on task / remain focused是英语里描述“专注”的常见连用；且 focused 强调“注意力集中”，与后文 show improved perception capabilities（感知能力提升）的逻辑链一致。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
E) dedicated dedicated 偏“长期投入/奉献”，不指即时注意力dedicated 多指“对事业/工作长期投入、奉献”，常用 dedicated to sth.；而本句讨论的是自言自语者“当下任务中”的专注状态，与“奉献”含义不匹配；且 remain dedicated 通常需要后跟 to+ 对象，本句没有。

questions.explanation:
**答案** L) trigger 动词
**词性槽** to 后接动词原形
**依据** trigger mental pictures = 触发心理图像trigger 是“激发/触发”，正面或中性色彩，可与 mental pictures 搭配表“调出脑海中的图像”；与全文“说出关键词加速大脑反应”的主旨一致：用语言线索去“触发”大脑里的图片，加快搜索。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
G) incur incur 多接负面后果，感情色彩与文意冲突incur 常接 loss、debt、anger、cost 等负面结果，意为“招致（不好的事）”；而 mental pictures 是中性/积极的认知产物，且本句在说自言自语的**正面**效果，感情色彩与 incur反向。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 G) —— 感情色彩反向最易误选。incur 词性、句法位都对得上 to__(27)__ mental pictures；考生若不熟悉“incur 多接负面后果”的搭配色彩，极易当作“引起”就填进去。防坑一句话：incur 接坏事，trigger 接反应。

questions.explanation:
**答案** O) volunteers 名词
**词性槽** 数词 twenty 后必跟可数名词复数
**依据** 心理学实验里被试称作 volunteers原文 In one experiment, they showed pictures of various objects to twenty __(28)__and asked them to find just one of those, a banana 描述的是实验场景，被试是**自愿参加实验的人**，对应 volunteers；而且第二段已铺垫 a series of experiments，符合“招募志愿者做实验”的常见表达。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
K) spectators 观众用于赛事/演出，不用于实验被试spectators 指体育比赛、表演的“观众”，是被动观看，不参与任务；而本句要求 asked them to find just one of those, a banana，被试要主动搜索香蕉，是实验参与者而非旁观者，词义指向不符。

questions.explanation:
**答案** H) instructed 动词
**词性槽** be 动词后 + to 不定式 → 过去分词作被动
**依据** instruct sb. to do 是固定搭配instructed 表“被指示/被要求做某事”，搭配“be instructed to do”是最常用结构。原文 Half were instructed to repeat out loud what they were looking for and the other half kept their lips __(30)__ 表明实验员让一半志愿者出声重复，正是被指示的动作。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
E) dedicated 搭配是 dedicated to 而非 dedicated to do dedicated 表“致力于”，固定搭配是 be dedicated to + 名词/动名词（to 是介词），而本句 to repeat 是不定式；且“被致力于重复”逻辑不通，不符合实验员“下指令”的语境。

questions.explanation:
**答案** J) sealed 形容词
**词性槽** keep + 宾语 + 空，空作宾补
**依据** sealed lips = 紧闭双唇另一半被试不出声，即“双唇紧闭”，sealed 与上一句 Half were instructed to repeat out loud 形成“出声 vs 不出声”的鲜明对照，逻辑链清晰。

**答案** M) uttering 动词
**词性槽** found that 引导的主语缺空，need 动名词
**依据** uttering the name = 说出名字uttering 意为“说出（一个声音/词）”，与上下文“talked to themselves”“repeat out loud”一脉相承——本段全在讲“出声说”能加速任务；utter the name of a product 即“说出某商品的名字”，与“when on the hunt for it 找东西时”逻辑顺畅。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
D) claiming claim 偏“主张/索取”，不指简单说出名字claiming 意为“宣称/主张/索取”，常接观点或权利（claim that …/claim a prize），用 claim the name of a product 不符合英语习惯；且全段讨论的是“出声重复名字”的发音动作，不是“主张商品名”的言论行为。

questions.explanation:
**答案** A) apparently 副词
**词性槽** 助动词 've 与过去分词 matured 之间 → 副词
**依据** apparently 修饰整句表“显然”apparently “显然地/看上去”，修饰 you've matured，表“你显然已经成熟了”——作者用这一带轻微反讽语气的副词，引出下句“成年人再自言自语就被认为不聪明”的世俗偏见，与第四段后半文要 refute that idea 形成铺垫。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
I) obscurely obscurely 偏“晦涩地”，与 matured 搭配语义违和obscurely 意为“含糊地/不为人知地”，常修饰表达或处境（如 obscurely worded），不修饰mature 这种描述“个人成长状态”的动词；“晦涩地成熟”逻辑不通。

questions.explanation:
**答案** C) brilliance 名词
**词性槽** of 后接名词作介词宾语
**依据** not a great sign of brilliance = 不是聪明的标志brilliance “聪颖”是世俗偏见里“成熟成年人应当展现”的特质；原句意在转述偏见——“成年人还自言自语，看起来不是聪明的表现”。与后文 The two professors hope to refute that idea 中两教授要反驳的“成年人自言自语 = 不聪明”的观念严丝合缝。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
B) arrogance arrogance 偏“傲慢”，与上下文“聪明/不聪明”话题反向arrogance “傲慢”是负面性格特质；本句要表达的是“不是聪明（智力）的标志”而非“不是傲慢（性格）的标志”，且“自言自语 → 不傲慢”的逻辑与全文“是否聪明”的讨论完全错位。

questions.explanation:
**答案** D) claiming 动词
**词性槽** 句末逗号后 + 空 + that 从句，分词作伴随状语
**依据** claim that … = 主张某观点claiming 表“主张/宣称”，能接 that 从句，恰好引出两位教授“想反驳的对立观点”的具体内容：adults can benefit from using language not just to communicate, but also to help "augment thinking"。

**答案** N) volume 名词
**词性槽** At any + 空 → 固定搭配里的名词
**依据** at any volume 承接上文 library tones volume “音量”与本段开篇 keep the talking at library tones（用图书馆里的低音量）紧密呼应——作者从“说话音量”过渡到“无论以何种音量”都要注意信息别太多。注：虽然惯用语是 at any rate，但本段以 volume 收束，正是利用“音量”这一关键词把段落语境串起来的写作选择，rate 也不在词库中。
questions.tip:
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 B) —— 孤立看习语 at any rate 易走偏。考生若死记 at any rate是“无论如何”却发现 rate 不在词库，可能慌乱去试 arrogance 等抽象名词；防坑一句话：词库里不放 rate，就回段首找关键词——本段 library tones 直接锁 volume。

title: Massive rubbish dumps and sprawling landfills constitute one…

sentences.text: Massive rubbish dumps and sprawling landfills constitute one of the more uncomfortable impacts that humans have on wildlife.
They have led some birds to give up on migration.
Instead of flying thousands of miles in search of food, they make the waste sites their winter feeding grounds.

passage.translation: 大规模的垃圾堆和不断扩张的垃圾填埋场构成了人类对野生动物造成的较为令人不安的影响之一。它们导致一些鸟类放弃了迁徙。这些鸟类不再飞行数千英里寻找食物,而是将废弃场所作为它们的冬季觅食地。

sentences.text: Researchers in Germany used miniature GPS tags to track the migrations of 70 white storks(鹳) from different sites across Europe and Asia during the first five months of their lives.

While many birds travelled along well-known routes to warmer climates, others stopped short and spent the winter on landfills, feeding on food waste, and the multitudes of insects that thrive on the dumps.

passage.translation: 德国的研究人员使用微型GPS标签追踪了来自欧洲和亚洲不同地点的70只白鹳在其生命最初五个月的迁徙情况。虽然许多鸟类沿着众所周知的路线飞往温暖的气候区,但其他鸟类中途停留,在垃圾填埋场过冬,以食物垃圾和在垃圾堆上大量繁殖的昆虫为食。

sentences.text: In the short-term, the birds seem to benefit from overwintering(过冬) on rubbish dumps.

Andrea Flack of the Max Planck Institute found that birds following traditional migration routes were more likely to die than German storks that flew only as far as northern Morocco, and spent the winter there on rubbish dumps.
"For the birds it's a very convenient way to get food.
There are huge clusters of organic waste they can feed on," said Flack.
The meals are not particularly appetising, or even safe.
Much of the waste is discarded rotten meat, mixed in with other human debris such as plastic bags and old toys.

passage.translation: 短期来看,鸟类似乎从在垃圾场过冬中受益。Max Planck研究所的Andrea Flack发现,遵循传统迁徙路线的鸟类比仅飞到摩洛哥北部并在那里的垃圾场过冬的德国白鹳更有可能死亡。Flack说:"对鸟类来说,这是一种非常便利的获取食物的方式。那里有大量的有机废物可供它们觅食。"然而这些食物并不特别美味,甚至不安全。大部分废物是被丢弃的腐烂肉类,混杂着塑料袋和旧玩具等其他人类垃圾。

sentences.text: "It's very risky.
The birds can easily eat pieces of plastic or rubber bands and they can die," said Flack.
"And we don't know about the long-term consequences.
They might eat something toxic and damage their health.
We cannot estimate that yet."

passage.translation: Flack说:"这非常危险。鸟类很容易吃到塑料碎片或橡皮筋,它们可能会因此死亡。而且我们不知道长期后果。它们可能吃到有毒物质并损害健康。我们目前还无法估计。"

sentences.text: The scientists tracked white storks from different colonies in Europe and Africa.
The Russian, Greek and Polish storks flew as far as South Africa, while those from Spain, Tunisia and Germany flew only as far as the Sahel.

passage.translation: 科学家们追踪了来自欧洲和非洲不同栖息地的白鹳。来自俄罗斯、希腊和波兰的白鹳飞到了南非,而来自西班牙、突尼斯和德国的白鹳只飞到了萨赫勒地区。

sentences.text: Landfill sites on the Iberian peninsula have long attracted local white storks, but all of the Spanish birds tagged in the study flew across the Sahara desert to the western Sahel.

Writing in the journal, the scientists describe how the storks from Germany were clearly affected by the presence of waste sites, with four out of six birds that survived for at least five months overwintering on rubbish dumps in northern Morocco, instead of migrating to the Sahel.

passage.translation: 伊比利亚半岛上的垃圾填埋场长期以来一直吸引着当地的白鹳,但研究中标记的所有西班牙鸟类都飞越了撒哈拉沙漠前往西萨赫勒地区。科学家们在该期刊上撰文描述了来自德国的白鹳明显受到废弃场所存在的影响,在存活至少五个月的六只鸟类中,有四只在摩洛哥北部的垃圾场过冬,而不是迁徙到萨赫勒地区。

sentences.text: Flack said it was too early to know whether the benefits of plentiful food outweighed the risks of feeding on landfills.
But that's not the only uncertainty.
Migrating birds affect ecosystems both at home and at their winter destinations, and disrupting the traditional routes could have unexpected side effects.
White storks feed on locusts(蝗虫) and other insects that can become pests if their numbers get out of hand.
"They provide a useful service," said Flack.

passage.translation: Flack表示,现在判断充足食物的好处是否超过在垃圾填埋场觅食的风险还为时过早。但这不是唯一的不确定性。迁徙鸟类在家园和冬季目的地都会影响生态系统,打乱传统路线可能会产生意想不到的副作用。白鹳以蝗虫和其他昆虫为食,如果这些昆虫的数量失控,它们可能会成为害虫。Flack说:"它们提供了有用的服务。"

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What is the impact of rubbish dumps on wildlife?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
垃圾场对野生动物有什么影响?
A) 它们迫使白鹳寻找更安全的越冬栖息地。
B) 它们严重污染了鸟类过冬的地方。
C) 它们加速了某些有害昆虫的繁殖。
D) 它们改变了某些鸟类先前的迁徙习性。
**判型** What is the impact of rubbish dumps on wildlife?问的是一个具体客观事实——X对Y产生了什么影响，不带infer／suggest／imply类信号词。
**拆句** 主干是What is the impact of rubbish dumps on wildlife?——What作表语提问，主语是the impact，of rubbish dumps是impact的修饰（影响的发出者），on wildlife是impact的指向对象（影响的承受者）。句子平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 巨大的垃圾堆和肆意扩张的填埋场，是人类对野生动物造成的较为令人不安的影响之一。它们已经导致一些鸟类放弃迁徙。这些鸟不再飞越数千英里去寻找食物，而是把垃圾场当成它们的越冬觅食地。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反They have forced white storks to search for safer winter shelters.说鸟去寻找「更安全的」避寒处，但原文明说鸟把垃圾场当作winter feeding grounds，且垃圾场被Flack描述为very risky，恰恰不安全，与原文相反。
B) 无中生有They have seriously polluted the places where birds spend winter.说垃圾场严重污染了鸟的越冬地，但原文谈的是「垃圾场本身成了越冬地」，并未说垃圾场污染了「鸟原本的越冬地」，无对应。
C) 张冠李戴They have accelerated the reproduction of some harmful insects.说垃圾场加速了害虫繁殖，但White storks feed on locusts and other insects that can become pests的主语是white storks以蝗虫等为食，谈的是鸟为生态服务的作用；「加速繁殖」既未提，主语也错位。
D) ✓ 正确led some birds to give up on migration ↔changed the previous migration habits of certain birds预判要的是「让鸟不再迁徙」，changed the previous migration habits of certain birds正是这层意思的上位表述（「放弃」是「改变」的子集），且无其他选项触及「迁徙习惯」。
questions.quote: Massive rubbish dumps and sprawling landfills constitute one of the more uncomfortable impacts that humans have on wildlife. They have led some birds to give up on migration. Instead of flying thousands of miles in search of food, they make the waste sites their winter feeding grounds.

options.text: They have forced white storks to search for safer winter shelters.
They have seriously polluted the places where birds spend winter.
They have accelerated the reproduction of some harmful insects.
They have changed the previous migration habits of certain birds.

questions.prompt: What do we learn about birds following the traditional migration routes?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
关于遵循传统迁徙路线的鸟类,我们了解到什么?
A) 它们能够以加快的速度繁殖。
B) 它们能够更好地熬过冬天。
C) 它们帮助人类消灭有害昆虫。
D) 它们更有可能面临死亡风险。
**判型** What do we learn about birds following the traditional migration routes?问的是关于某类鸟的客观陈述，是细节复现题。
**拆句** 主干What do we learn about birds，following the traditional migration routes是现在分词短语作birds的后置定语，限定「哪类鸟」——是「走传统迁徙路线的」那一类，与「停在垃圾场过冬」的那一类对比。
**定位** Max Planck研究所的Andrea Flack发现，遵循传统迁徙路线的鸟比那些只飞到摩洛哥北部并在那里垃圾场过冬的德国白鹳更容易死亡。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有They can multiply at an accelerating rate.说传统路线鸟「加速繁殖」，但原文从未涉及任何鸟的繁殖率，全段在谈「存活率」。
B) 与原文相反They can better pull through the winter.说传统路线鸟「更能熬过冬天」，但原文明说他们were more likely to die——死亡率更高即更难熬过冬天，方向反了。
C) 张冠李戴They help humans kill harmful insects.说「帮人类杀害虫」，原文White storks feed on locusts and other insects that can become pests谈的确是白鹳吃害虫的生态作用，但这一作用属于全体白鹳的物种属性，并非特指「走传统路线的鸟」，与Q52题干主语错配。
D) ✓ 正确more likely to die ↔ more likely to be at risk of dying预判要的是「更容易死」，D项把die包装成be at risk of dying，比较方向（more likely）与对象（traditional路线的鸟）都对得上，是唯一保留比较方向且语义一致的选项。
questions.quote: Andrea Flack of the Max Planck Institute found that birds following traditional migration routes were more likely to die than German storks that flew only as far as northern Morocco, and spent the winter there on rubbish dumps.

options.text: They can multiply at an accelerating rate.
They can better pull through the winter.
They help humans kill harmful insects.
They are more likely to be at risk of dying.

questions.prompt: What does Andrea Flack say about the birds overwintering on rubbish dumps?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
Andrea Flack对在垃圾场越冬的鸟类有何评论?
A) 它们最终可能会永久留在那里。
B) 它们可能会吃到有害的东西。
C) 它们可能会形成新的觅食习性。
D) 它们可能难以获得充足的食物。
**判型** What does Andrea Flack say about the birds overwintering on rubbish dumps?问某人对某事的具体说法，是引语细节题。
**拆句** 主干What does Andrea Flack say，about the birds是say的宾语介短，overwintering on rubbish dumps是现在分词后置定语修饰birds——指「在垃圾场过冬的那群鸟」，与传统路线鸟相区分。
**定位** 「风险很大。鸟很容易吃下塑料碎片或橡皮筋，然后死掉。」Flack说。「而且我们不知道长期后果。它们可能吃下有毒物质而损害健康。我们目前还无法估算这一点。」
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 过度推断They may end up staying there permanently.说鸟可能「永久留在垃圾场」，但原文只谈「在垃圾场过冬」（over wintering），是季节性行为，未提任何「永久」信号。
B) ✓ 正确They might eat something toxic and damage their health. ↔They may eat something harmful.预判要的是「可能吃到有害物」，They may eat something harmful.逐词对应原文might eat something toxic，是教科书式的「情态等值+毒→害上位化」组合改写。
C) 无中生有They may evolve new feeding habits.说鸟「可能进化出新的觅食习惯」，evolve／new feeding habits在原文找不到对应；Flack的话题是健康风险，不是觅食习惯演化。
D) 与原文相反They may have trouble getting adequate food.说鸟「可能难以获得足够食物」，但原文For the birds it's a very convenient way to get food. There are huge clusters of organic waste they can feed on明说食物又多又方便，与「难以获得」完全相反。
questions.quote: "It's very risky. The birds can easily eat pieces of plastic or rubber bands and they can die," said Flack. "And we don't know about the long-term consequences. They might eat something toxic and damage their health. We cannot estimate that yet."

options.text: They may end up staying there permanently.
They may eat something harmful.
They may evolve new feeding habits.
They may have trouble getting adequate food.

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about the Spanish birds tagged in the study?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （推断题）
**题目译文**
关于研究中标记的西班牙鸟类可以推断出什么?
A) 它们逐渐失去了冬季迁徙的习性。
B) 它们更喜欢远方的垃圾场而非本地的垃圾场。
C) 它们不会被迁徙路线上的垃圾场所吸引。
D) 它们在摩洛哥的垃圾场与来自德国的白鹳会合。
**判型** What can be inferred about the Spanish birds tagged in the study?含be inferred信号词，明确要求做一步推理而非直接复述。
**拆句** 主干What can be inferred about the Spanish birds，tagged in the study是过去分词作Spanish birds的后置定语（被研究标记的那群西班牙鸟），限定研究范围内的样本，不是泛指所有西班牙鸟。
**定位** 伊比利亚半岛上的垃圾填埋场长期以来一直吸引着当地的白鹳，但研究中被标记的所有西班牙鸟都飞越撒哈拉沙漠到了西非Sahel。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 过度推断They gradually lose the habit of migrating in winter.说西班牙鸟「逐渐丧失迁徙习惯」，但原文恰恰相反——这批鸟「飞越撒哈拉」完成了远距离迁徙，证明迁徙习惯保留得好好的，是过推+反向。
B) 过度推断They prefer rubbish dumps far away to those at home.说鸟「偏好远处的垃圾场胜过本地的」，但原文未说这批鸟去Sahel是为了「那里的垃圾场」，他们去的是Sahel（越冬地）而非Sahel的垃圾场；同时prefer...to...是主动偏好，原文无主观偏好证据。
C) ✓ 正确all of the Spanish birds tagged in the study flew across the Sahara desert to the western Sahel ↔They are not attracted to the rubbish dumps on their migration routes.预判要的是「宁可远飞也不停本地垃圾场」，not attracted to the rubbish dumps on their migration routes正是把「飞越而过」明示为「未被吸引」，是这一步推断的精准表达。
D) 与原文相反They join the storks from Germany on rubbish dumps in Morocco.说西班牙鸟「在摩洛哥垃圾场与德国鸟会合」，但原文明说西班牙鸟flew across the Sahara desert to the western Sahel——他们飞过了撒哈拉到Sahel，根本没停在摩洛哥；摩洛哥垃圾场停的是德国鸟。
questions.quote: Landfill sites on the Iberian peninsula have long attracted local white storks, but all of the Spanish birds tagged in the study flew across the Sahara desert to the western Sahel.

options.text: They gradually lose the habit of migrating in winter.
They prefer rubbish dumps far away to those at home.
They are not attracted to the rubbish dumps on their migration routes.
They join the storks from Germany on rubbish dumps in Morocco.

questions.prompt: What is scientists' other concern about white storks feeding on landfills?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
科学家对白鹳在垃圾填埋场觅食还有什么其他担忧?
A) 对生态系统的潜在危害。
B) 白鹳物种的基因变化。
C) 流行病向其栖息地的传播。
D) 对生物多样性的破坏性影响。
**判型** What is scientists' other concern问的是科学家的「另一个」具体担忧，是要找原文明示的客观陈述。
**拆句** 主干What is scientists' other concern about white storks feeding on landfills?——other修饰concern暗示「除前文已提之外」，about white storks feeding on landfills是concern的内容介短，feeding on landfills是现在分词作后置定语修饰storks。
**定位** 但这不是唯一的不确定性。迁徙鸟同时影响起点和越冬地的生态系统，而扰乱传统迁徙路线可能带来意想不到的副作用。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确Migrating birds affect ecosystems both at home and at their winter destinations, and disrupting the traditional routes could have unexpected side effects.↔ The potential harm to the ecosystem.预判要的是「对生态系统的潜在影响」，A项把affect ecosystems（动词短语）+could have side effects（情态+负面后果）合并为harm to the ecosystem+potential（名词+形容词），是双重包装但完全等值。
B) 无中生有The genetic change in the stork species.说「鹳物种的基因变化」，但原文从未涉及genetic／基因层面的描述，只谈行为（迁徙改变）与生态影响。

title: We live today indebted to McCardell, Cashin, Hawes,…

sentences.text: We live today indebted to McCardell, Cashin, Hawes, Wilkins, and Maxwell, and other women who liberated American fashion from the confines of Parisian design.
Independence came in tying, wrapping, storing, harmonizing, and rationalizing that wardrobe.

These designers established the modern dress code, letting playsuits and other active wear outfits suffice for casual clothing, allowing pants to enter the wardrobe, and prizing rationalism and versatility in dress, in contradiction to dressing for an occasion or allotment of the day.
Fashion in America was logical and answerable to the will of the women who wore it.
Implicitly or explicitly, American fashion addressed a democracy, whereas traditional Paris-based fashion was prescriptive and imposed on women, willing or not.

passage.translation: 我们今天的生活受益于McCardell、Cashin、Hawes、Wilkins、Maxwell以及其他将美国时尚从巴黎设计的束缚中解放出来的女性。独立性体现在衣橱的系结、包裹、储存、协调和合理化上。这些设计师确立了现代着装规范，让运动装和其他运动休闲服装足以应对日常穿着,允许裤装进入衣橱,并在着装中推崇理性主义和多功能性,这与为特定场合或一天中特定时段着装的做法相矛盾。美国时尚是合乎逻辑的,并且回应穿着它的女性的意愿。无论是隐含还是明确,美国时尚面向的是民主,而传统的以巴黎为基础的时尚则是规定性的,强加于女性身上,无论她们愿意与否。

sentences.text: In an earlier time, American fashion had also followed the dictates of Paris, or even copied and pirated specific French designs.
Designer sportswear was not modeled on that of Europe, as "modern art" would later be; it was genuinely invented and developed in America.
Its designers were not high-end with supplementary lines.
The design objective and the business commitment were to sportswear, and the distinctive traits were problem-solving ingenuity and realistic lifestyle applications.
Ease of care was most important: summer dresses and outfits, in particular, were chiefly cotton, readily capable of being washed and pressed at home.
Closings were simple, practical, and accessible, as the modern woman depended on no personal maid to dress her.
American designers prized resourcefulness and the freedom of women who wore the clothing.

passage.translation: 在更早的时期,美国时尚也曾遵循巴黎的指令,甚至复制和盗版具体的法国设计。设计师运动装并非像后来的"现代艺术"那样以欧洲为范本;它是在美国真正发明和发展起来的。它的设计师们并非拥有附属产品线的高端品牌。设计目标和商业承诺都是针对运动装的,其显著特征是解决问题的独创性和现实的生活方式应用。易于打理是最重要的:夏季连衣裙和套装尤其主要采用棉质面料,能够方便地在家中洗涤和熨烫。衣服的开合简单、实用且易于操作,因为现代女性不依赖私人女仆来为她穿衣。美国设计师重视足智多谋以及穿着这些服装的女性的自由。

sentences.text: Many have argued that the women designers of this time were able to project their own clothing values into a new style.
Of course, much of this argument in the 1930s-40s was advanced because there was little or no experience in justifying apparel(服装) on the basis of utility.
If Paris was cast aside, the tradition of beauty was also to some degree slighted.
Designer sportswear would have to be verified by a standard other than that of pure beauty; the emulation of a designer's life in designer sportswear was a crude version of this relationship.
The consumer was ultimately to be mentioned as well, especially by the likes of Dorothy Shaver, who could point to the sales figures at Lord & Taylor.

passage.translation: 许多人认为,这一时期的女性设计师能够将她们自己的服装价值观投射到一种新风格中。当然,在20世纪30至40年代,这一论点的提出在很大程度上是因为在以实用性为基础来证明服装的合理性方面几乎没有或根本没有经验。如果巴黎被抛弃,美的传统在某种程度上也受到了轻视。设计师运动装必须通过纯粹美之外的标准来验证;在设计师运动装中对设计师生活的仿效是这种关系的粗糙版本。消费者最终也要被提及,尤其是像Dorothy Shaver这样的人,她可以指出Lord & Taylor的销售数字。

sentences.text: Could utility alone justify the new ideas of the American designers?
Fashion is often regarded as a pursuit of beauty, and some cherished fashion's trivial relationship to the fine arts.
What the designers of the American sportswear proved was that fashion is a genuine design art, answering to the demanding needs of service.
Of course these practical, insightful designers have determined the course of late twentieth-century fashion.
They were the pioneers of gender equity, in their useful, adaptable clothing, which was both made for the masses and capable of self-expression.

passage.translation: 单凭实用性就能证明美国设计师的新理念是合理的吗?时尚通常被视为对美的追求,一些人珍视时尚与美术之间微不足道的关系。美国运动装设计师们所证明的是,时尚是一门真正的设计艺术,回应服务的严苛需求。当然,这些务实而富有洞察力的设计师决定了20世纪后期时尚的走向。她们是性别平等的先驱,她们实用、适应性强的服装既为大众制造,又能够实现自我表达。

title: Half of your brain stays alert and prepared…

sentences.text: Half of your brain stays alert and prepared for danger when you sleep in a new place, a study has revealed.
This phenomenon is often (26)____ to as the "first-night-effect".
Researchers from Brown University found that a network in the left hemisphere of the brain "remained more active" than the network in the right side of the brain.
Playing sounds into the right ears (stimulating the left hemisphere) of (27)____ was more likely to wake them up than if the noises were played into their left ear.

passage.translation: 一项研究显示，当你在一个新地方睡觉时，你的半个大脑会保持警觉并为危险做好准备。这种现象通常被称为"第一夜效应"。Brown University的研究人员发现，大脑左半球的一个网络比右半球的网络"保持更活跃"。向志愿者的右耳播放声音（刺激左半球）比向他们的左耳播放噪音更有可能唤醒他们。

sentences.text: It was (28)____ observed that the left side of the brain was more active during deep sleep.
When the researchers repeated the laboratory experiment on the second and third nights they found the left hemisphere could not be stimulated in the same way during deep sleep.
The researchers explained that the study demonstrated when we are in a (29)____ environment the brain partly remains alert so that humans can defend themselves against any (30)____ danger.

passage.translation: 研究人员特别观察到，在深度睡眠期间，大脑左侧更加活跃。当研究人员在第二晚和第三晚重复实验室实验时，他们发现在深度睡眠期间左半球无法以同样的方式被刺激。研究人员解释说，该研究表明当我们处于一个陌生环境中时，大脑会部分保持警觉，以便人类能够保护自己免受任何潜在危险。

sentences.text: The researchers believe this is the first time that the "first-night-effect" of different brain states has been (31)____ in humans.
It isn't, however, the first time it has ever been seen.
Some animal (32)____also display this phenomenon.
For example, dolphins, as well as other (33)____ animals, shut down one hemisphere of the brain when they go to sleep.
A previous study noted that dolphins always (34)____control their breathing.
Without keeping the brain active while sleeping, they would probably drown.
But, as the human study suggests, another reason for dolphins keeping their eyes open during sleep is that they can look out for (35)____ while asleep.
It also keeps their physiological processes working.

passage.translation: 研究人员认为这是首次在人类身上识别出不同大脑状态的"第一夜效应"。然而，这并不是第一次观察到这种现象。一些动物物种也表现出这种现象。例如，海豚以及其他海洋动物在入睡时会关闭大脑的一个半球。先前的一项研究指出，海豚总是有意识地控制它们的呼吸。如果在睡眠时不保持大脑活跃，它们可能会溺水。但是，正如人类研究表明的那样，海豚在睡眠时睁着眼睛的另一个原因是它们可以在睡觉时警惕捕食者。这也使它们的生理过程保持运作。

Read the passage through carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. groups.content:
Half of your brain stays alert and prepared for danger when you sleep in a new place, a study has revealed. This phenomenon is often {{26}} to as the "first-night-effect". Researchers from Brown University found that a network in the left hemisphere of the brain "remained more active" than the network in the right side of the brain. Playing sounds into the right ears (stimulating the left hemisphere) of {{27}} was more likely to wake them up than if the noises were played into their left ear.

It was {{28}} observed that the left side of the brain was more active during deep sleep. When the researchers repeated the laboratory experiment on the second and third nights they found the left hemisphere could not be stimulated in the same way during deep sleep. The researchers explained that the study demonstrated when we are in a {{29}} environment the brain partly remains alert so that humans can defend themselves against any {{30}} danger.

The researchers believe this is the first time that the "first-night-effect" of different brain states has been {{31}} in humans. It isn't, however, the first time it has ever been seen. Some animal {{32}}also display this phenomenon. For example, dolphins, as well as other {{33}} animals, shut down one hemisphere of the brain when they go to sleep. A previous study noted that dolphins always {{34}}control their breathing. Without keeping the brain active while sleeping, they would probably drown. But, as the human study suggests, another reason for dolphins keeping their eyes open during sleep is that they can look out for {{35}} while asleep. It also keeps their physiological processes working.
