questions.quote: Although more than a third have an object in their rooms they would like to keep secret from their parents, rarely is it anything more alarming than a diary or off-color(低俗的) book or CD.

questions.prompt: It is beneficial to encourage young people to explore the broader world and get ready to make it a better place.
questions.explanation:
**答案** L 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
鼓励年轻人探索更广阔的世界并准备好让它变得更美好是有益的。
**锚点** 鼓励青年探索世界 + 让世界更好
**定位** 鼓励他们走出眼下经验、去探索更广阔的世界，并为自己塑造世界的那一天做好准备——我们将受益匪浅。
**改写** It is beneficial ↔ We have everything to gain by受益匪浅 ↔ 有益encourage young people to explore the broader world ↔encouraging them to explore the world beyond their immediate experience广阔的世界 ↔ 眼前经验之外的世界get ready to make it a better place ↔ prepare themselves for their turn at shaping that world为更好地塑造 ↔ 让它更好
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
K K 段说 there is also a place in a young life for noble purposes，是 该有 的立论；题干 It is beneficial to encourage ... 是 鼓励有益 的呼吁，与 L 段对位。there is also a place in a young life for noble purposes
questions.quote: We have everything to gain by encouraging them to explore the world beyond their immediate experience and to prepare themselves for their turn at shaping that world.

questions.prompt: Many teenagers now offer to render service to the needy.
questions.explanation:
**答案** E 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
现在许多青少年主动为有需要的人提供服务。
**锚点** 为弱势 / 有需要的人服务
**定位** 他们中很多人自愿参与服务弱势群体的社区志愿活动。
**改写** offer to render service ↔ volunteer for community service主动提供服务 ↔ 自愿做社区服务the needy ↔ disadvantaged people the + 形容词 = 一类人
questions.quote: Many of them volunteer for community service with disadvantaged people.

questions.prompt: Interviews with students find many of them are only concerned about personal matters.
questions.explanation:
**答案** J 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
对学生的访谈发现他们中的许多人只关心个人事务。
**锚点** 访谈中学生只关心个人事务
**定位** 被问到想改变世界中的什么时，学生们只提到了个人层面的事，比如放慢生活节奏、交到好朋友、变得更有精神追求、变得更物质成功或更不物质化（视个人价值观而定），以及更尊重地球、动物和他人。
**改写** Interviews with students ↔ In our interviews介词短语 ↔ 名词化主语many of them are only concerned about personal matters ↔the students mentioned only personal concerns concerned about ↔ personal concerns 名词化变体
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
H H 段说 in follow-up interviews with a few of the teenagers, we found ... little interest in civic life，落脚是 缺乏公共兴趣，没有 学生只提个人事务 的集中呈现，故不是源头段。in follow-up interviews with a few of the teenagers, we found lots of insight, positive feeling and inspirational thinking
questions.quote: Asked what they would like to change in the world, the students mentioned only personal concerns such as slowing down the pace of life, gaining good friends, becoming more spiritual, becoming either more materially successful or less materially oriented (depending on the student's values), and being more respectful of the Earth, animals and other people.

title: Can Societies be rich and green?

passage.label: A

sentences.text: "If our economies are to flourish, if global poverty is to be eliminated and if the well-being of the world's people is to be enhanced—not just in this generation but in succeeding generations—we must make sure we take care of the natural environment and resources on which our economic activity depends."

That statement comes not, as you might imagine, from a stereotypical tree-hugging, save- the-world greenie(环保主义者), but from Gordon Brown, a politician with a reputation for rigour, thoroughness and above all, caution.

passage.translation: "如果我们的经济要繁荣发展,如果全球贫困要被消除,如果世界人民的福祉要得到提升——不仅是这一代人,还包括后代——我们必须确保善待我们经济活动所依赖的自然环境和资源。"这番话并非如你所想,出自一位刻板印象中拥抱树木、拯救世界的环保主义者,而是来自Gordon Brown,一位以严谨、周密,尤其是谨慎著称的政治家。

passage.label: B

sentences.text: A surprising thing for the man who runs one of the world's most powerful economies to say?
Perhaps; though in the run-up to the five-year review of the millennium(千年的) Goals, he is far from alone.

The roots of his speech, given in March at the roundtable meeting of environment and energy ministers from the G20 group of nations, stretch back to 1972, and the United Nations Conference on the Human Environment in Stockholm.

passage.translation: 对于管理着世界上最强大经济体之一的人来说,这是一番令人惊讶的话?或许吧;尽管在千年发展目标五年审查前夕,他远非孤例。他在三月份G20国家环境与能源部长圆桌会议上发表的这番讲话,其根源可以追溯到1972年,追溯到在斯德哥尔摩召开的联合国人类环境会议。

passage.label: C

sentences.text: "The protection and improvement of the human environment is a major issue which affects the well- being of peoples and economic development throughout the world," read the final declaration from this gathering, the first of a sequence which would lead to the Rio de Janeiro Earth Summit in 1992 and the World Development Summit in Johannesburg three years ago.

passage.translation: "保护和改善人类环境是一个重大问题,它影响着全世界人民的福祉和经济发展,"这次会议的最终宣言如此写道,这是一系列会议中的第一次,这些会议随后催生了1992年的里约热内卢地球峰会和三年前的约翰内斯堡世界发展峰会。

passage.label: D

sentences.text: Hunt through the reports prepared by UN agencies and development groups—many for conferences such as this year's Millennium Goals review—and you will find that the linkage between environmental protection and economic progress is a common thread.

passage.translation: 翻阅联合国机构和发展组织准备的报告——其中许多是为今年的千年发展目标审查等会议准备的——你会发现,环境保护与经济进步之间的联系是一条贯穿始终的主线。

passage.label: E

sentences.text: Managing ecosystems sustainably is more profitable than exploiting them, according to the Millennium Ecosystem Assessment.
But finding hard evidence to support the thesis is not so easy.
Thoughts turn first to some sort of global statistic, some indicator which would rate the wealth of nations in both economic and environmental terms and show a relationship between the two.

passage.translation: 根据千年生态系统评估报告,可持续地管理生态系统比开发利用它们更有利可图。但要找到支持这一论点的确凿证据并不容易。人们首先想到的是某种全球性统计数据,某个既能衡量各国经济财富又能衡量环境状况的指标,并显示两者之间的关系。

passage.label: F

sentences.text: If such an indicator exists, it is well hidden.

And on reflection, this is not surprising; the single word "environment" has so many dimensions, and there are so many other factors affecting wealth—such as the oil deposits—that teasing out a simple economy-environment relationship would be almost impossible.

passage.translation: 如果这样的指标存在,它也被深藏不露。仔细想来,这并不奇怪;"环境"这个词本身就有如此多的维度,而且还有许多其他因素影响着财富——比如石油储量——因此要梳理出一种简单的经济-环境关系几乎是不可能的。

passage.label: G

sentences.text: The Millennium Ecosystem Assessment, a vast four-year global study which reported its initial conclusions earlier this year, found reasons to believe that managing ecosystems sustainably—working with nature rather than against it—might be less profitable in the short term, but certainly brings long-term rewards.

passage.translation: 千年生态系统评估是一项历时四年的大型全球研究,今年早些时候发布了初步结论,研究发现有理由相信,可持续地管理生态系统——与自然合作而非对抗——在短期内可能利润较低,但从长远来看必然会带来回报。

passage.label: H

sentences.text: And the World Resources Institute (WRI) in its World Resources 2005 report, issued at the end of August, produced several such examples from Africa and Asia; it also demonstrated that environmental degradation affects the poor more than the rich, as poorer people derive a much higher proportion of their income directly from the natural resources around them.

passage.translation: 世界资源研究所在八月底发布的《2005年世界资源报告》中,提供了来自非洲和亚洲的若干此类实例;报告还证明,环境退化对穷人的影响大于富人,因为较贫困的人从周围自然资源中直接获得的收入比例要高得多。

passage.label: I

sentences.text: But there are also many examples of growing wealth by trashing the environment, in rich and poor parts of the world alike, whether through unregulated mineral extraction, drastic water use for agriculture, slash-and-burn farming, or fossil-fuel-guzzling(大量消耗) transport.
Of course, such growth may not persist in the long term—which is what Mr.
Brown and the Stockholm declaration were both attempting to point out.
Perhaps the best example of boom growth and bust decline is the Grand Banks fishery.
For almost five centuries a very large supply of cod(鳕⻥) provided abundant raw material for an industry which at its peak employed about 40,000 people, sustaining entire communities in Newfoundland.
Then, abruptly, the cod population collapsed.
There were no longer enough fish in the sea for the stock to maintain itself, let alone an industry.
More than a decade later, there was no sign of the ecosystem re-building itself.
It had, apparently, been fished out of existence; and the once mighty Newfoundland fleet now gropes about frantically for crab on the sea floor.

passage.translation: 但同样也有许多通过破坏环境来增加财富的例子,在世界各地的富裕和贫困地区都是如此,无论是通过不受管制的矿产开采、农业用水的大量消耗、刀耕火种式农业,还是大量消耗化石燃料的交通运输。当然,这种增长可能无法长期持续——这正是Brown先生和斯德哥尔摩宣言都试图指出的。也许繁荣增长和衰退崩溃的最佳例证就是大浅滩渔场。近五个世纪以来,大量的鳕鱼供应为一个行业提供了丰富的原材料,该行业在鼎盛时期雇用了约4万人,维持着纽芬兰的整个社区。然后,鳕鱼种群突然崩溃。海里不再有足够的鱼来维持种群本身,更不用说支撑一个行业了。十多年后,仍看不到生态系统重建的迹象。显然,它已被捕捞到灭绝;曾经强大的纽芬兰船队现在在海底疯狂地摸索着捕捞螃蟹。

passage.label: J

sentences.text: There is a view that modern humans are inevitably sowing the seed of a global Grand Banks-style disaster.
The idea is that we are taking more out of what you might call the planet's environmental bank balance than it can sustain; we are living beyond our ecological means.

One recent study attempted to calculate the extent of this "ecological overshoot of the human economy", and found that we are using 1.2 Earth's-worth of environmental goods and services—the implication being that at some point the debt will be called in, and all those services—the things which the planet does for us for free—will grind to a halt.

passage.translation: 有一种观点认为,现代人类不可避免地在播下一场全球性大浅滩式灾难的种子。这个想法是,我们从可以称之为地球环境银行账户中提取的东西超过了它所能承受的;我们的生活超出了生态承载能力。最近一项研究试图计算这种"人类经济的生态超载"程度,发现我们正在使用相当于1.2个地球的环境产品和服务——这意味着在某个时候债务将被催讨,而所有那些服务——地球免费为我们做的事情——将会停止运转。

passage.label: K

sentences.text: Whether this is right, and if so where and when the ecological axe will fall, is hard to determine with any precision—which is why governments and financial institutions are only beginning to bring such risks into their economic calculations.

It is also the reason why development agencies are not united in their view of environmental issues; while some, like the WRI, maintain that environmental progress needs to go hand-in-hand with economic development, others argue that the priority is to build a thriving economy, and then use the wealth created to tackle environmental degradation.

passage.translation: 这种说法是否正确,如果正确的话,生态危机将在何时何地降临,很难精确判断——这就是为什么各国政府和金融机构才刚刚开始将这类风险纳入其经济计算。这也是发展机构在环境问题上观点不一致的原因;一些机构,如世界资源研究所,坚持认为环境进步需要与经济发展齐头并进,而另一些机构则认为,首要任务是建立繁荣的经济,然后利用创造的财富来应对环境退化。

passage.label: L

sentences.text: This view assumes that rich societies will invest in environmental care.
But is this right?
Do things get better or worse as we get richer?
Here the Stockholm declaration is ambiguous.
"In the developing countries," it says, "most of the environmental problems are caused by under- development," So it is saying that economic development should make for a cleaner world?
Not necessarily.
"In the industrialised countries, environmental problems are generally related to industrialisation and technological development," it continues.
In other words, poor and rich both over-exploit the natural world, but for different reasons.
It's simply not true that economic growth will surely make our world cleaner.

passage.translation: 这种观点假设富裕社会会投资于环境保护。但这是对的吗?随着我们变得更富裕,情况是变好还是变坏?在这一点上,斯德哥尔摩宣言的表述含糊不清。它说:"在发展中国家,大多数环境问题是由欠发达造成的。"那么它是在说经济发展应该带来一个更清洁的世界吗?未必。它继续说道:"在工业化国家,环境问题通常与工业化和技术发展有关。"换句话说,穷国和富国都过度开发自然世界,但原因不同。经济增长必然会使我们的世界更清洁,这种说法根本不正确。

passage.label: M

sentences.text: Clearly, richer societies are able to provide environmental improvements which lie well beyond the reach of poorer communities.
Citizens of wealthy nations demand national parks, clean rivers, clean air and poison-free food.
They also, however, use far more natural resources—fuel, water (all those baths and golf courses) and building materials.

passage.translation: 显然,富裕社会能够提供远超贫困社区能力范围的环境改善。富裕国家的公民要求有国家公园、清洁的河流、清洁的空气和无毒的食物。然而,他们也使用多得多的自然资源——燃料、水(所有那些浴缸和高尔夫球场)和建筑材料。

passage.label: N

sentences.text: A case can be made that rich nations export environmental problems, the most graphic example being climate change.
As a country's wealth grows, so do its greenhouse gas emissions.
The figures available will not be completely accurate.

Measuring emissions is not a precise science, particularly when it comes to issues surrounding land use; not all nations have released up-to-date data, and in any case, emissions from some sectors such as aviation are not included in national statistics.
But the data is exact enough for a clear trend to be easily discernible.
As countries become richer, they produce more greenhouse gases; and the impact of those gases will fall primarily in poor parts of the world.

passage.translation: 可以认为富裕国家输出环境问题,最典型的例子就是气候变化。随着一个国家财富的增长,其温室气体排放也随之增长。现有数据不会完全准确。测量排放不是一门精确的科学,特别是涉及土地使用问题时;并非所有国家都发布了最新数据,而且无论如何,航空等某些部门的排放并未包含在国家统计数据中。但数据足够精确,足以清楚地辨别出一个明显的趋势。随着国家变得更富裕,它们产生更多的温室气体;而这些气体的影响将主要落在世界贫困地区。

passage.label: O

sentences.text: Wealth is not, of course, the only factor involved.
The average Norwegian is better off than the average US citizen, but contributes about half as much to climate change.
But could Norway keep its standard of living and yet cut its emissions to Moroccan or even Ethiopian levels?

That question, repeated across a dozen environmental issues and across our diverse planet, is what will ultimately determine whether the human race is living beyond its ecological means as it pursues economic revival.

passage.translation: 当然,财富并不是唯一的相关因素。挪威人平均比美国公民富裕,但对气候变化的贡献约为后者的一半。但挪威能否在保持生活水平的同时,将排放量降低到摩洛哥甚至埃塞俄比亚的水平?这个问题,在十几个环境问题上、在我们这个多样化的星球上重复出现,最终将决定人类在追求经济复兴时,其生活方式是否超出了生态承载能力。

groups.instructions: In this section, you are going to read a passage with ten statements attached to it. Each statement contains information given in one of the paragraphs. Identify the paragraph from which the information is derived. You may choose a paragraph more than once. Each paragraph is marked with a letter. Answer the questions by marking the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2.

questions.prompt: Examples show that both rich and poor countries exploited the environment for economic progress.
questions.explanation:
**答案** I 段（弱锚点）
**题目译文**
事例表明,富国和穷国都为经济发展而开发利用了环境。
**锚点** 富国穷国都为发展破坏环境
**定位** 但是也有很多例子表明，无论是世界的富裕地区还是贫穷地区，都存在着通过破坏环境来获取财富增长的现象，这些做法包括无序的矿产开采、农业上的大量耗水、刀耕火种式的农业，以及大量消耗化石燃料的交通方式。
**改写** both rich and poor countries ↔ in rich and poor parts of the world alike并列结构同义改写exploited the environment for economic progress ↔growing wealth by trashing the environment动词同义加手段目的互换
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
L L 段虽然区分了穷国与富国的环境问题成因——In the developing countries, most of the environmental problems are caused by under-development 与 In the industrialised countries, environmental problems are generally related to industrialisation and technological development——但它讨论的是穷富各自因何而污染，并没有给出为了经济进步而破坏环境的具体例子，与题干 Examples show that 的举例语义不符。In the developing countries, most of the environmental problems are caused by under-development
questions.quote: But there are also many examples of growing wealth by trashing the environment, in rich and poor parts of the world alike, whether through unregulated mineral extraction, drastic water use for agriculture, slash-and-burn farming, or fossil-fuel-guzzling transport.

questions.prompt: Environmental protection and improvement benefit people all over the world.
questions.explanation:
**答案** C 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
环境保护和改善使全世界人民受益。
**锚点** 环境保护惠及全世界人民
**定位** 斯德哥尔摩这次会议的最终宣言写道：保护与改善人类环境是一项重大议题，它关系到全世界人民的福祉和经济发展。这次会议是此后一系列峰会的起点，其后又有 1992 年的里约地球峰会和三年前在约翰内斯堡举行的世界发展峰会。
**改写** Environmental protection and improvement ↔The protection and improvement of the human environment近乎原样复现benefit people all over the world ↔ affects the well-being of peoples ... throughout the world动词与范围短语同义概括
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
A A 段虽然也讲到环境与资源关系到福祉与经济发展 we must make sure we take care of the natural environment and resources on which our economic activity depends，但这段话是出自 Gordon Brown 的发言，并不是会议宣言惠及全世界人民的口吻，与题干 Environmental protection and improvement benefit people all over the world 的宣言主张基调不一致。we must make sure we take care of the natural environment and resources on which our economic activity depends
questions.quote: The protection and improvement of the human environment is a major issue which affects the well-being of peoples and economic development throughout the world, read the final declaration from this gathering, the first of a sequence which would lead to the Rio de Janeiro Earth Summit in 1992 and the World Development Summit in Johannesburg three years ago.

questions.prompt: It is not necessarily true that economic growth will make our world cleaner.
questions.explanation:
**答案** L 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
经济增长必然会使我们的世界更清洁,这一说法未必正确。
**锚点** 经济增长未必让世界更干净
**定位** 经济增长一定会让我们的世界变得更干净，这种说法根本就不成立。
**改写** It is not necessarily true that economic growth will make our world cleaner ↔It's simply not true that economic growth will surely make our world cleaner否定判断加原句词面对位
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
M M 段陈述富国能提供更多环境改善 national parks, clean rivers, clean air and poison-free food，但也消耗更多自然资源 far more natural resources—fuel, water (all those baths and golf courses) and building materials。这是为未必更干净这一判断的事实佐证，但题干所断言的判断本身出自 L 段。They also, however, use far more natural resources—fuel, water (all those baths and golf courses) and building materials
questions.quote: It's simply not true that economic growth will surely make our world cleaner.

questions.prompt: The common theme of the UN reports is the relation between environmental protection and economic growth.
questions.explanation:
**答案** D 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
联合国报告的共同主题是环境保护与经济增长之间的关系。
**锚点** UN 报告的共同主题
**定位** 如果你翻阅由联合国机构和发展类组织准备的各种报告——其中许多是为今年的千年目标审议会议所准备的——你会发现：环境保护与经济进步之间的关联，是一条贯穿其中的共同主线。
**改写** The common theme of the UN reports ↔reports prepared by UN agencies and development groups简称对全称common theme ↔ a common thread比喻同义改写the relation between environmental protection and economic growth ↔the linkage between environmental protection and economic progress同义词替换
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
B B 段确实涉及国际层面 the United Nations Conference on the Human Environment in Stockholm，但它讨论的是布朗发言的国际背景与历史源头，并未出现 UN 报告这一对象，更没有概括它们的共同主题，与题干 The common theme of the UN reports 不一致。the United Nations Conference on the Human Environment in Stockholm
questions.quote: Hunt through the reports prepared by UN agencies and development groups—many for conferences such as this year's Millennium Goals review—and you will find that the linkage between environmental protection and economic progress is a common thread.

questions.prompt: Development agencies disagree regarding how to tackle environment issues while ensuring economic progress.
questions.explanation:
**答案** K 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
在确保经济发展的同时如何应对环境问题,发展机构对此存在分歧。
**锚点** 发展机构内部立场分歧
**定位** 这也是为什么发展类机构在环境议题上立场并不统一的原因：一些机构（如世界资源研究所）主张环境进步必须与经济发展齐头并进；另一些机构则认为，优先要务是先建立繁荣经济，再用所创造的财富去治理环境退化。
**改写** Development agencies disagree ↔development agencies are not united in their view of environmental issues否定短语等价how to tackle environment issues while ensuring economic progress ↔environmental progress needs to go hand-in-hand with economic development句式重构表同一议题
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
L L 段虽然也用对比结构 In the developing countries, most of the environmental problems are caused by under-development 与 In the industrialised countries, environmental problems are generally related to industrialisation and technological development，但它对比的是穷国与富国的环境问题成因，不是发展机构之间的策略分歧，与题干 Development agencies disagree 的对象不符。In the developing countries, most of the environmental problems are caused by under-development
questions.quote: It is also the reason why development agencies are not united in their view of environmental issues; while some, like the WRI, maintain that environmental progress needs to go hand-in- hand with economic development, others argue that the priority is to build a thriving economy, and then use the wealth created to tackle environmental degradation.

questions.prompt: It is difficult to find solid evidence to prove environmental friendliness generates more profits than exploiting the natural environment.
questions.explanation:
**答案** E 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
很难找到确凿证据证明环境友好型发展比开发利用自然环境能产生更多利润。
**锚点** 难以找到硬证据
**定位** 根据千年生态系统评估的研究，可持续地管理生态系统比剥削式开发更有利可图。但是，要找到能支持这一论断的硬证据并不容易。
**改写** difficult to find solid evidence ↔ finding hard evidence to support the thesis is not so easy同义形容词加句式互换environmental friendliness generates more profits than exploiting the natural environment ↔Managing ecosystems sustainably is more profitable than exploiting them概念上位概括
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
G G 段虽然也涉及千年生态系统评估并讨论可持续管理，但它讨论的是结论本身 might be less profitable in the short term, but certainly brings long-term rewards——可持续管理在长期带来回报，与题干 difficult to find solid evidence 所强调的取证困难语义不一致。might be less profitable in the short term, but certainly brings long-term rewards F F 段顺着 E 段的话题接续讨论 If such an indicator exists, it is well hidden 和teasing out a simple economy-environment relationship would be almost impossible，但它讨论的是那个理想化的全球指标几乎不可能得到，不是难以找到支持环境友好更赚论点的硬证据这一主张本身，题干 Q41 的源头判断仍在 E 段。If such an indicator exists, it is well hidden
questions.quote: Managing ecosystems sustainably is more profitable than exploiting them, according to the Millennium Ecosystem Assessment. But finding hard evidence to support the thesis is not so easy.

questions.prompt: Sustainable management of ecosystems will prove rewarding in the long run.
questions.explanation:
**答案** G 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
对生态系统的可持续管理从长远来看将会带来回报。
**锚点** 可持续管理长期有回报
**定位** 千年生态系统评估是一项历时四年的庞大全球研究，其初步结论已于今年早些时候发布。研究找到理由相信：可持续地管理生态系统——与自然合作而非对抗——短期内利润可能较低，但长期一定会带来回报。
**改写** Sustainable management of ecosystems ↔ managing ecosystems sustainably名词化与动副结构互换will prove rewarding in the long run ↔ certainly brings long-term rewards同源词族加短语同义
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
E E 段虽然也提到 Managing ecosystems sustainably is more profitable than exploiting them，但它的重点是很难找到硬证据，没有展开短期不赚长期有回报这一时间维度，与题干 in the long run 不直接对应。Managing ecosystems sustainably is more profitable than exploiting them, according to the Millennium Ecosystem Assessment H H 段虽然给出生态与经济关系的具体案例，但侧重点在 environmental degradation affects the poor more than the rich，谈的是环境退化对穷人冲击更大，不是可持续管理长期有回报这一论断本身。environmental degradation affects the poor more than the rich, as poorer people derive a much higher proportion of their income directly from the natural resources around them
questions.quote: The Millennium Ecosystem Assessment, a vast four-year global study which reported its initial conclusions earlier this year, found reasons to believe that managing ecosystems sustainably—working with nature rather than against it—might be less profitable in the short term, but certainly brings long-term rewards.

questions.prompt: A politician noted for being cautious asserts that sustainable human development depends on the natural environment.
questions.explanation:
**答案** A 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
一位以谨慎著称的政治家断言,人类的可持续发展依赖于自然环境。
**锚点** 审慎政治家断言可持续发展依赖自然环境
**定位** 如果我们的经济要繁荣，如果要消除全球贫困，如果世界人民的福祉要得到提升——不仅是这一代人，也包括后代——我们就必须确保我们照护好自然环境与资源，因为我们的经济活动依赖于它们。这段话并不像你想象的那样出自典型的、抱树式拯救世界的环保人士，而是出自戈登·布朗——一位以严谨、彻底、尤其以谨慎著称的政治家。
**改写** A politician noted for being cautious ↔a politician with a reputation for rigour, thoroughness and above all, caution同源词族加短语同义sustainable human development depends on the natural environment ↔we must make sure we take care of the natural environment and resources on which our economic activity depends概念上位概括
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
B B 段也涉及布朗发言，但内容是讲发言的国际背景与历史源头 in the run-up to the five-year review of the millennium(千年的) Goals 与 The roots of his speech ... stretch back to 1972，并未承载可持续发展依赖自然环境这一断言本身，与题干asserts that sustainable human development depends on the natural environment 的内容定位不符。The roots of his speech, given in March at the roundtable meeting of environment and energy ministers from the G20 group of nations, stretch back to 1972
questions.quote: If our economies are to flourish, if global poverty is to be eliminated and if the well-being of the world's people is to be enhanced—not just in this generation but in succeeding generations—we must make sure we take care of the natural environment and resources on which our economic activity depends. That statement comes not, as you might imagine, from a stereotypical tree-hugging, save-the-world greenie, but from Gordon Brown, a politician with a reputation for rigour, thoroughness and above all, caution.

questions.prompt: Poor countries will have to bear the cost for rich nations' economic development.
questions.explanation:
**答案** N 段（弱锚点）
**题目译文**
穷国将不得不为富国的经济发展承担代价。
**锚点** 穷国为富国发展买单
**定位** 随着国家变得更富裕，它们排放的温室气体也更多；而这些气体造成的影响，将主要落在世界上较为贫穷的地区。
**改写** rich nations' economic development ↔As countries become richer, they produce more greenhouse gases因果同位Poor countries will have to bear the cost ↔the impact of those gases will fall primarily in poor parts of the world比喻动词加范围词同义
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
H H 段虽然也得出环境退化对穷人冲击更大 environmental degradation affects the poor more than the rich，但它给出的理由是 poorer people derive a much higher proportion of their income directly from the natural resources around them——穷人对自然资源依赖更高、所以更易受冲击，并未把这种冲击归因于富国的经济发展，与题干 bear the cost for rich nations' economic development 的归因方向不同。poorer people derive a much higher proportion of their income directly from the natural resources around them O O 段虽然也涉及国家间财富与排放关系，并以挪威与美国对比 The average Norwegian is better off than the average US citizen, but contributes about half as much to climate change，但它只在富国之间作比较，讨论财富是否唯一变量，并未明示穷国承担富国代价，与题干 Q44 的承担关系不符。The average Norwegian is better off than the average US citizen, but contributes about half as much to climate change
questions.quote: As countries become richer, they produce more greenhouse gases; and the impact of those gases will fall primarily in poor parts of the world.

questions.prompt: One recent study warns us of the danger of the exhaustion of natural resources on Earth.
questions.explanation:
**答案** J 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
最近一项研究警告我们地球自然资源枯竭的危险。
**锚点** 最近一项研究警示资源耗尽
**定位** 最近的一项研究试图量化这种人类经济的生态透支程度，发现我们正在消耗 1.2 个地球的环境产品与服务——其含义是：在某个时间点这笔生态债务将被讨回，地球免费为我们提供的所有服务都将停摆。
**改写** One recent study↔ One recent study原样复现warns us of the danger of the exhaustion of natural resources on Earth↔we are using 1.2 Earth's-worth of environmental goods and services比喻还原与上位概括
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
I I 段虽然也涉及资源耗尽，并以 the Grand Banks fishery 与 cod(鳕鱼) 提供生动案例，但它讲的是单一渔业的崩溃，并没有一项最近研究警告全球自然资源耗尽的研究表述，与题干 One recent study 的研究对象不符。Perhaps the best example of boom growth and bust decline is the Grand Banks fishery
questions.quote: One recent study attempted to calculate the extent of this ecological overshoot of the human economy, and found that we are using 1.2 Earth's-worth of environmental goods and services—the implication being that at some point the debt will be called in, and all those services—the things which the planet does for us for free—will grind to a halt.

title: These days, nobody needs to cook.…

sentences.text: These days, nobody needs to cook.
Families graze on high-cholesterol take-aways and microwaved ready-meals.
Cooking is an occasional hobby and a vehicle for celebrity chefs.
Which makes it odd that the kitchen has become the heart of the modern house: what the great hall was to the medieval castle, the kitchen is to the 21st-century home.

passage.translation: 如今,没有人需要做饭。家庭靠高胆固醇的外卖和微波炉加热的即食食品度日。烹饪成了偶尔的爱好和名厨们的表演工具。这使得厨房成为现代住宅的核心这件事显得很奇怪:中世纪城堡的大厅是什么地位,厨房就是21世纪家庭的什么地位。

sentences.text: The money spent on kitchens has risen with their status.
In America the kitchen market is now worth $170 billion, five times the country's film industry.
In the year to August 2007, IKEA, a Swedish furniture chain, sold over one million kitchens worldwide.
The average budget for a "major" kitchen overhaul in 2006, calculates Remodeling magazine, was a staggering $54,000; even a "minor" improvement cost on average $18,000.

passage.translation: 厨房上的花费随着其地位的提升而增加。在美国,厨房市场现在价值1700亿美元,是该国电影产业的五倍。截至2007年8月的一年里,瑞典家具连锁店宜家在全球售出了超过100万套厨房。据《改造》杂志计算,2006年一次"大型"厨房翻新的平均预算高达54000美元;即使是"小型"改造平均也要花费18000美元。

sentences.text: Exclusivity, more familiar in the world of high fashion, has reached the kitchen: Robinson &Cornish, a British manufacturer of custom-made kitchens, offers a Georgian-style one which would cost 145,000-155,000—excluding building, plumbing and electrical work.
Its big selling point is that nobody else will have it: "You won't see this kitchen anywhere else in the world."

passage.translation: 在高级时装界更为常见的排他性已经延伸到了厨房领域:英国定制厨房制造商Robinson & Cornish提供一款乔治亚风格的厨房,售价14.5万至15.5万英镑——不包括建筑、管道和电气工程费用。其最大卖点在于别人不会拥有它:"你不会在世界上任何其他地方看到这款厨房。"

sentences.text: The elevation of the room that once belonged only to the servants to that of design showcase for the modern family tells the story of a century of social change.
Right into the early 20th century, kitchens were smoky, noisy places, generally located underground, or to the back of the house, and as far from living space as possible.
That was as it should be: kitchens were for servants, and the aspiring middle classes wanted nothing to do with them.

passage.translation: 曾经只属于仆人的房间提升为现代家庭设计展示空间,讲述了一个世纪社会变迁的故事。直到20世纪初,厨房还是烟雾缭绕、嘈杂的地方,通常位于地下或房子后面,尽可能远离生活空间。这本该如此:厨房是给仆人用的,而有抱负的中产阶级不想与之有任何关系。

sentences.text: But as the working classes prospered and the servant shortage set in, housekeeping became a matter of interest to the educated classes.
One of the pioneers of a radical new way of thinking about the kitchen was Catharine Esther Beecher, sister of Harriet Beecher Stowe.
In American Woman's Home, published in 1869, the Beecher sisters recommended a scientific approach to household management, designed to enhance the efficiency of a woman's work and promote order.

passage.translation: 但随着工人阶级的繁荣和仆人短缺的出现,家务管理成为受教育阶层感兴趣的事情。对厨房进行激进新思考的先驱之一是Catharine Esther Beecher,她是Harriet Beecher Stowe的姐姐。在1869年出版的《美国妇女之家》中,Beecher姐妹提出了一种科学的家庭管理方法,旨在提高妇女工作的效率并促进秩序。

sentences.text: Many contemporary ideas about kitchen design can be traced back to another American, Christine Frederick, who set about enhancing the efficiency of the housewife.
Her 1919 work, Household Engineering: Scientific Management in the Home, was based on detailed observation of a housewife's daily routine.
She borrowed the principle of efficiency on the factory floor and applied it to domestic tasks on the kitchen floor.

passage.translation: 许多关于厨房设计的当代理念可以追溯到另一位美国人Christine Frederick,她致力于提高家庭主妇的效率。她1919年的作品《家庭工程学:家庭中的科学管理》基于对家庭主妇日常工作的详细观察。她借鉴了工厂车间的效率原则,并将其应用于厨房的家务劳动。

sentences.text: Frederick's central idea, that "stove, sink and kitchen table must be placed in such a relation that useless steps are avoided entirely", inspired the first fully fitted kitchen, designed in the 1920s by Margarete Schütte-Lihotsky.
It was a modernist triumph, and many elements remain central features of today's kitchen.

passage.translation: Frederick的核心理念是"炉灶、水槽和厨房桌子必须以避免一切无用步骤的关系来摆放",这启发了1920年代由Margarete Schütte-Lihotsky设计的第一个全配置厨房。这是现代主义的胜利,其中许多元素仍然是当今厨房的核心特征。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What does the author say about the kitchen of today?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者对当今的厨房有何看法?
A) 这是家庭主妇展示厨艺的地方。
B) 这是家庭招待重要客人的地方。
C) 它已成为现代住宅中有些奇特的存在。
D) 它被视为现代家庭的中心。
**判型** What does the author say about the kitchen of today? 问的是作者就一个具体对象给出的具体说法，可在文本中找到直接对应的句子。
**拆句** 题干结构是 What does the author say about the kitchen of today?——一个标准的特殊疑问句，谓语 say，宾语就是后面的从句问点，无任何陷阱。
**定位** 这就使得这件事显得奇怪：厨房竟然成了现代住宅的核心——厨房之于 21 世纪家庭，正如大厅之于中世纪城堡。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有原文反而说 nobody needs to cook，与 housewives display their cooking skills 完全相反，文中也未提及任何"展示技艺"的功能。
B) 无中生有全文从未把厨房描述为 where the family entertains important guests，作者用的比喻是"家中之心"而非"会客场所"，二者并不等价。
C) 偷换概念原文 Which makes it odd that the kitchen has become the heart of the modern house 中 odd 修饰的是"没人做饭却把厨房当核心"这一反差，而非把厨房本身评价为奇怪之物；It has become something odd in a modern house. 把 odd 的指向从"现象"偷换为"厨房本身"。
D) ✓ 正确the kitchen has become the heart of the modern house ↔It is regarded as the center of a modern home. "厨房 = 现代住宅的核心"与 It is regarded as the center of a modern home. 在词项和句法上几乎一对一对应，可直接锁定。
questions.quote: Which makes it odd that the kitchen has become the heart of the modern house: what the great hall was to the medieval castle, the kitchen is to the 21st-century home.

options.text: It is where housewives display their cooking skills.
It is where the family entertains important guests.
It has become something odd in a modern house.
It is regarded as the center of a modern home.

questions.prompt: Why does the Georgian-style kitchen sell at a very high price?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
为什么乔治亚风格的厨房售价极高?
A) 它被认为具有巨大的艺术价值。
B) 在其他任何地方都找不到复制品。
C) 它由一家著名的英国公司制造。
D) 没有其他制造商能生产出类似的产品。
**判型** Why does the Georgian-style kitchen sell at a very high price? 是 Why 类直接问因果的具体性提问，答案在原文中有句对应。
**拆句** Why does the Georgian-style kitchen sell at a very high price——does 是助动词、主语是 the Georgian-style kitchen、谓语 sell 取"售价为/卖到"的意义，sell at + 价格是固定搭配，无从句、无陷阱。
**定位** 它最大的卖点在于：再没别人会拥有同款——"你在世界上别的任何地方都见不到这款厨房。"
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有原文卖点是"独一无二"而非 tremendous artistic value，文中既未出现 artistic 也未出现任何评价艺术性的措辞。
B) ✓ 正确nobody else will have it ↔ No duplicate is to be found in any other place. You won\'t see this kitchen anywhere else in the world. ↔ in any other place预判得到的"独一无二"被 No duplicate 用否定式同义改写，正是阅读改写的经典手法，直接锁定 B。
C) 偷换概念原文只称 Robinson & Cornish, a British manufacturer of custom-made kitchens，未称其"著名"；高价的原因是"定制独款"而不是"厂家有名"，把"独款"换成"名厂"属偷换。
D) 过度推断原文 nobody else will have it 强调"没人会拥有同款"，是商家承诺的稀缺，而非 No other manufacturer can produce anything like it. 所指的"别家厂没这能力造"，后者是把稀缺性升级为唯一制造能力。
questions.quote: Its big selling point is that nobody else will have it: "You won\'t see this kitchen anywhere else in the world."

options.text: It is believed to have tremendous artistic value.
No duplicate is to be found in any other place.
It is manufactured by a famous British company.
No other manufacturer can produce anything like it.

questions.prompt: What does the change in the status of the kitchen reflect?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
厨房地位的变化反映了什么?
A) 生活条件的改善。
B) 女性地位的提升。
C) 技术进步。
D) 社会变革。
**判型** What does the change in the status of the kitchen reflect? 是对一个具体陈述的指向性提问，答案在原文有明确等价说法。
**拆句** 题干主干是 What does [the change in the status of the kitchen] reflect?——一个标准特殊疑问句，方括号内是嵌套了 of 介宾结构的复杂主语，理解时要把 in 和 of 两层都拆出来："厨房的地位的变化"。
**定位** 这个曾经只属于仆人的房间，如今升格为现代家庭的设计展示空间，这一升格本身讲述着一个世纪以来的社会变迁。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 以偏概全Improved living conditions. 仅是 social change 在物质层面的一个细分项，原文论断指向更宽的社会变迁，不能用一个具体侧面替代整体。
B) 过度推断原文仅说"工人阶级富裕 + 仆人短缺"导致家政进入受教育阶层视野，未直接说厨房地位变化反映 Women\'s elevated status；把"家政成为关注对象"等同于"女性地位提升"是引申过头。
C) 以偏概全原文第 7 段提到的全功能厨房只是社会变迁的一个产物，整段论断指向 social change而非单纯 Technological progress.，技术进步是结果端的一个具体表现而非"被反映"的本体。
D) ✓ 正确a century of social change↔ Social change. tells the story of↔ reflect预判已锁定"反映的对象是社会变迁"，Social change. 是最直接对应的截取式答案。
questions.quote: The elevation of the room that once belonged only to the servants to that of design showcase for the modern family tells the story of a century of social change.

options.text: Improved living conditions.
Women's elevated status.
Technological progress.
Social change.

questions.prompt: What was the Beecher sisters' idea of a kitchen?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
Beecher姐妹对厨房的理念是什么?
A) 一个女性能够更高效工作的地方。
B) 一个可以应用高科技的地方。
C) 一个受过教育的人感兴趣的地方。
D) 一个试验新想法的地方。
**判型** What was the Beecher sisters' idea of a kitchen? 问的是具体人物的具体观点，文本中必有一句直接给出。
**拆句** What was the Beecher sisters\' idea of a kitchen——名词 idea 后接 of 介宾，整体相当于"贝彻姐妹关于厨房的主张是什么"，注意 \'s 表所有格，主语其实是 idea 而不是 sisters。
**定位** 在 1869 年出版的《美国妇女之家》中，贝彻姐妹倡导用科学的方法管理家务，旨在提升女性劳作的效率并促进家中秩序。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确enhance the efficiency of a woman\'s work ↔ where women could work more efficiently scientific approach to household management ↔A place where women could work more efficiently.预判"用科学方法提高效率"中最贴近"厨房应当是怎样的场所"的描述就是"让女性更高效工作的场所"，正与 A 同义。
B) 偷换概念原文用的是 a scientific approach，意指"科学方法/科学化思路"，而非 high technology；19 世纪的家政科学化不等于现代高科技应用，前者强调方法、后者强调器物。
C) 张冠李戴原文 housekeeping became a matter of interest to the educated classes 的主语是housekeeping（家政），主语被偷换为 kitchen；并且"受教育阶层产生兴趣"是社会背景而非贝彻姐妹的主张本身。
D) 无中生有原文只说贝彻姐妹"倡导科学方法"，并未把厨房定位成 to experiment with new ideas；科学方法在文中是被推荐的现成方案，而不是被实验的对象。
questions.quote: In American Woman\'s Home, published in 1869, the Beecher sisters recommended a scientific approach to household management, designed to enhance the efficiency of a woman\'s work and promote order.

options.text: A place where women could work more efficiently.
A place where high technology could be applied.
A place of interest to the educated people.
A place to experiment with new ideas.

questions.prompt: What do we learn about today's kitchen?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
关于当今的厨房我们了解到什么?
A) 它代表了人们日常生活中快速的技术进步。
B) 它的许多核心特征与20世纪20年代的并无不同。
C) 它已被改造得面目全非。
D) 它的许多功能已发生很大变化。
**判型** What do we learn about today\'s kitchen? 问的是关于当下厨房可从文中得到的具体信息，仍走定位—比对路径。
**拆句** 题干是 What do we learn about today\'s kitchen?——主句一目了然，关键在末段那句对今昔的对比，关系到 many elements remain 这种含"保持/延续"语义的动词。
**定位** 那是一次现代主义的胜利，其许多元素至今仍是当今厨房的核心特征。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有原文只说"1920 年代的许多元素仍是今天厨房的核心"，重在"延续"，未涉及 the rapid technological advance；恰恰相反，强调的是没有大变。
B) ✓ 正确many elements remain central features of today\'s kitchen ↔Many of its central features are no different from those of the 1920s. designed in the 1920s by Margarete Schütte-Lihotsky ↔ those of the 1920s预判得到的"延续语义"与 no different from those of the 1920s 的"与那时无差异"是等价表述，可直接选 B。
C) 与原文相反It has been transformed beyond recognition. 表达"已被改变得认不出来"，与原文many elements remain 的"仍然是"语义直接对立。
D) 与原文相反Many of its functions have changed greatly. 强调"功能发生重大改变"，原文聚焦的是 central features"核心特征延续"，前者"功能巨变"与后者"特征不变"在方向上相反。
questions.quote: It was a modernist triumph, and many elements remain central features of today\'s kitchen.

options.text: It represents the rapid technological advance in people's daily life.
Many of its central features are no different from those of the 1920s.
It has been transformed beyond recognition.
Many of its functions have changed greatly.

title: Facing water shortages and escalating fertilizer costs, farmers…

sentences.text: Facing water shortages and escalating fertilizer costs, farmers in developing countries are using raw sewage(下水道污水) to irrigate and fertilize nearly 49 million acres of cropland, according to a new report—and it may not be a bad thing.

passage.translation: 根据一份新报告,面对水资源短缺和不断上涨的化肥成本,发展中国家的农民正在使用未经处理的污水来灌溉和施肥近4900万英亩的农田,而这可能并不是一件坏事。

sentences.text: While the practice carries serious health risks for many, those dangers are outweighed by the social and economic gains for poor urban farmers and consumers who need affordable food.

passage.translation: 虽然这种做法对许多人来说存在严重的健康风险,但对于需要负担得起的食物的贫困城市农民和消费者而言,这些危险被社会和经济收益所抵消。

sentences.text: "There is a large potential for wastewater agriculture to both help and hurt great numbers of urban consumers," said Liqa Raschid-Sally, who led the study.

passage.translation: 领导这项研究的Liqa Raschid-Sally说:"污水农业在帮助和伤害大量城市消费者方面都有很大的潜力。"

sentences.text: The report focused on poor urban areas, where farms in or near cities supply relatively inexpensive food.
Most of these operations draw irrigation water from local rivers or lakes.
Unlike developed cities, however, these areas lack advanced water-treatment facilities, and rivers effectively become sewers(下水道).

passage.translation: 该报告聚焦于贫困城市地区,在这些地区,城市内或城市附近的农场供应相对便宜的食物。这些农业经营大多从当地河流或湖泊抽取灌溉用水。然而,与发达城市不同,这些地区缺乏先进的水处理设施,河流实际上成为了下水道。

sentences.text: When this water is used for agricultural irrigation, farmers risk absorbing disease-causing bacteria, as do consumers who eat the produce raw and unwashed.
Nearly 2.2 million people die each year because of diarrhea-related(与腹泻相关的) diseases, according to WHO statistics.
More than 80% of those cases can be attributed to contact with contaminated water and a lack of proper sanitation.
But Pay Drechsel, an environmental scientist, argues that the social and economic benefits of using untreated human waste to grow food outweigh the health risks.

passage.translation: 当这些水被用于农业灌溉时,农民面临吸收致病细菌的风险,生吃未清洗农产品的消费者也是如此。根据WHO的统计数据,每年有近220万人死于与腹泻相关的疾病。其中80%以上的病例可归因于接触受污染的水和缺乏适当的卫生设施。但环境科学家Pay Drechsel认为,使用未经处理的人类排泄物种植食物所带来的社会和经济效益超过了健康风险。

sentences.text: Those dangers can be addressed with farmer and consumer education, he said, while the free water and nutrients from human waste can help urban farmers in developing countries to escape poverty.

passage.translation: 他说,这些危险可以通过农民和消费者教育来解决,而来自人类排泄物的免费水和营养物质可以帮助发展中国家的城市农民摆脱贫困。

sentences.text: Agriculture is a water-intensive business, accounting for nearly 70% of global fresh water consumption.

passage.translation: 农业是一项用水密集型产业,占全球淡水消费量的近70%。

sentences.text: In poor, dry regions, untreated wastewater is the only viable irrigation source to keep farmers in business.
In some cases, water is so scarce that farmers break open sewage pipes transporting waste to local rivers.

passage.translation: 在贫困干旱地区,未经处理的废水是维持农民生计的唯一可行灌溉水源。在某些情况下,水资源如此稀缺,以至于农民会破坏将废水输送到当地河流的污水管道。

sentences.text: Irrigation is the primary agricultural use of human waste in the developing world.
But frequently untreated human waste harvested from lavatories is delivered to farms and spread as fertilizer.

passage.translation: 灌溉是发展中国家人类排泄物在农业中的主要用途。但从厕所收集的未经处理的人类排泄物也经常被运送到农场并作为肥料撒施。

sentences.text: In most cases, the human waste is used on grain crops, which are eventually cooked, minimizing the risk of transmitting water-borne diseases.
With fertilizer prices jumping nearly 50% per metric ton over the last year in some places, human waste is an attractive, and often necessary, alternative.

passage.translation: 在大多数情况下,人类排泄物被用于谷物作物,这些作物最终会被烹饪,从而最大限度地降低了传播水传播疾病的风险。在某些地方,化肥价格在过去一年中每公吨上涨了近50%,人类排泄物是一种有吸引力且往往是必要的替代品。

sentences.text: In cases where sewage mud is used, expensive chemical fertilizer use can be avoided.
The mud contains the same critical nutrients.

passage.translation: 在使用污水污泥的情况下,可以避免使用昂贵的化学肥料。污泥含有相同的关键营养物质。

sentences.text: "Overly strict standards often fail," James Bartram, a WHO water-health expert, said.
"We need to accept that fact across much of the planet, so waste with little or no treatment will be used in agriculture for good reason."

passage.translation: WHO水与健康专家James Bartram说:"过于严格的标准往往会失败。我们需要接受这样一个事实:在地球上的大部分地区,很少或未经处理的废物将被用于农业,这是有充分理由的。"

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What does the author say about the use of raw sewage for farming?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者对使用未经处理的污水进行农业生产有何看法?
A) 其风险不可高估。
B) 应该完全禁止。
C) 其益处超过了所涉及的危害。
D) 它正在污染数百万英亩的农田。
**判型** What does the author say about the use of raw sewage for farming? 是问作者对一件具体事的看法，在原文有明确表态句可对应，仍属可定位的细节题，而非需要串全文的主旨题。
**拆句** 题干 Q46 是一个标准的 what 引导的特殊疑问句，主干是 what does the author say，介词短语 about the use of raw sewage for farming 限定 say 的对象——把 raw sewage用于 farming 这件事。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 尽管这种做法对许多人构成严重健康风险，但这些危险被贫困城市农民及需要廉价食物的消费者所获得的社会与经济收益所抵消（即收益大于风险）。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反Its risks cannot be overestimated. 是 '风险无论怎么估都不为过、要高度警惕'之意；而原文 those dangers are outweighed 恰恰承认风险但认为被收益盖过，与之相反。
B) 与原文相反It should be forbidden altogether. 是'应一律禁止'，但作者在 P2 明确肯定其综合收益，Overly strict standards often fail 还反对一刀切，禁止说法与全文立场相反。
C) ✓ 正确those dangers are outweighed by the social and economic gains ↔Its benefits outweigh the hazards involved.把 P2 中的被动改成主动，再做两组同义替换，就得到 Its benefits outweigh the hazards involved.，与预判'收益大于风险'完全等价。
D) 偷换概念It is polluting millions of acres of cropland. 把 irrigate and fertilize nearly 49 million acres of cropland 中的'灌溉/施肥'偷换成'polluting'，把使用面积包装成污染面积。
questions.quote: While the practice carries serious health risks for many, those dangers are outweighed by the social and economic gains for poor urban farmers and consumers who need affordable food.

options.text: Its risks cannot be overestimated.
It should be forbidden altogether.
Its benefits outweigh the hazards involved.
It is polluting millions of acres of cropland.

questions.prompt: What is the main problem caused by the use of wastewater for irrigation?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
使用废水灌溉造成的主要问题是什么?
A) 附近的河流和湖泊将逐渐受到污染。
B) 它将使化肥生产商破产。
C) 农民和消费者可能受到有害细菌的影响。
D) 它将使农产品在市场上的竞争力下降。
**判型** What is the main problem caused by 指向一个具体后果，原文必有句子直接描述这个后果，属于可定位的细节题。
**拆句** 题干 Q47 主干为 What is the main problem，过去分词短语 caused by the use of wastewater for irrigation 后置修饰 problem，说明问题的起因是'用污水灌溉'。注意caused by 是被动来源，不是 caused，不要错读成'问题导致灌溉'。
**定位** 当这种水被用于农业灌溉时，农民面临吸收致病细菌的风险，生吃且未清洗农产品的消费者也同样如此。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反原文 rivers effectively become sewers 说明的是河流先被污染才被农民取用；选项Rivers and lakes nearby will gradually become contaminated. 反把'灌溉'当成污染河流的原因，因果反转。
B) 过度推断It will drive producers of chemical fertilizers out of business. 说污水灌溉会把化肥厂挤出市场——原文只有 expensive chemical fertilizer use can be avoided 说可避免使用昂贵化肥，并未提及化肥生产商倒闭。
C) ✓ 正确farmers risk absorbing disease-causing bacteria, as do consumers ↔Farmers and consumers may be affected by harmful bacteria.并列主语 farmers and consumers 对应、disease-causing bacteria 对应 harmful bacteria，预判中'两类人都中招细菌'与 C 完全等价。
D) 无中生有It will make the farm produce less competitive on the market. 说会让农产品市场竞争力下降，原文从未讨论农产品的市场竞争问题。
questions.quote: When this water is used for agricultural irrigation, farmers risk absorbing disease-causing bacteria, as do consumers who eat the produce raw and unwashed.

options.text: Rivers and lakes nearby will gradually become contaminated.
It will drive producers of chemical fertilizers out of business.
Farmers and consumers may be affected by harmful bacteria.
It will make the farm produce less competitive on the market.

questions.prompt: What is environmental scientist Pay Drechsel's attitude towards the use of untreated human waste in agriculture?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （态度题）
**题目译文**
环境科学家Pay Drechsel对在农业中使用未经处理的人类粪便持什么态度?
A) 赞成的。
B) 怀疑的。
C) 漠不关心的。
D) 负责任的。
**判型** What is environmental scientist Pay Drechsel's attitude towards 中 attitude towards是态度题的标志性结构。
**拆句** 题干 Q48 主干是 What is ... attitude，名词短语 environmental scientist Pay Drechsel's是 attitude 的所有格修饰，介词短语 towards the use of untreated human waste in agriculture 指明态度的对象。结构清晰。
**定位** 他说，那些危险可以通过对农民和消费者的教育加以解决，与此同时，来自人类废物的免费水和养分可帮助发展中国家的城市农民摆脱贫困。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确the social and economic benefits of using untreated human waste to grow food outweigh the health risks↔ Favorable. can help urban farmers in developing countries to escape poverty ↔ Favorable. P5 P6 中 Drechsel 的全部话语只出现 benefits、outweigh、help、escape 等正面动词，没有任何 reservation/however 等保留信号，态度收敛为 Favorable.。
B) 无中生有Skeptical. 需要原文出现 doubt/question/uncertain/may not 等怀疑信号，P5 P6 全是正面陈述，无此类信号。
C) 与原文相反Indifferent. 是'漠不关心'，但 Drechsel 主动 argues、积极给出解决方案，绝非旁观者。
D) 答非所问Responsible. 是'负责任'，描述人的品格而非对某事的态度极性；态度题答案应是favorable/critical/neutral 一类'方向词'，responsible 不在态度词谱系内。
questions.quote: Those dangers can be addressed with farmer and consumer education, he said, while the free water and nutrients from human waste can help urban farmers in developing countries to escape poverty.

options.text: Favorable.
Skeptical.
Indifferent.
Responsible.

questions.prompt: What does Pay Dreschsel think of the risks involved in using untreated human waste for farming?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
Pay Drechsel如何看待使用未经处理的人类粪便进行农业生产所涉及的风险?
A) 这些风险在某种程度上被夸大了。
B) 这些风险可以通过教育来解决。
C) 这些风险将通过新技术得到最小化。
D) 这些风险可以通过改善卫生条件来解决。
**判型** What does Pay Dreschsel think of the risks 问的是对一个具体对象（风险）的具体看法，原文有明确句对应，属可定位的细节题。
**拆句** 题干 Q49 主干 What does Pay Dreschsel think of，介词 of 的宾语是 the risks involved in using untreated human waste for farming，其中 involved in 是过去分词短语后置修饰 risks，意为'涉及到……的风险'。结构略长但无歧义。
**定位** 他说，那些危险可以通过对农民和消费者的教育加以解决，与此同时，来自人类废物的免费水和养分可帮助发展中国家的城市农民摆脱贫困。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念They have been somewhat exaggerated. 是说风险被夸大，但 But Pay Drechsel ... argues that the social and economic benefits ... outweigh the health risks 只承认风险存在但收益更大，并未质疑风险描述的真实性。
B) ✓ 正确Those dangers can be addressed with farmer and consumer education ↔They can be dealt with through education. address↔deal with 同义、with↔through 同表方式，再加上代词 Those dangers↔They，三组对应使 B 与定位句几乎逐词等值。
C) 无中生有They will be minimized with new technology. 提到新技术，但 P6 给出的手段是education 而非 technology，原文从无新技术之说。
D) 张冠李戴They can be addressed by improved sanitation. 说靠改善卫生设施解决，lack of proper sanitation 只是把 sanitation 当成致病原因之一，并非 Drechsel 给出的解决手段；他的方案是 education。
questions.quote: Those dangers can be addressed with farmer and consumer education, he said, while the free water and nutrients from human waste can help urban farmers in developing countries to escape poverty.

options.text: They have been somewhat exaggerated.
They can be dealt with through education.
They will be minimized with new technology.
They can be addressed by improved sanitation.

questions.prompt: What do we learn about James Bartram's position on the use of human waste for farming?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
我们从James Bartram关于使用人类粪便进行农业生产的立场中了解到什么?
A) 他赞同Pay Drechsel在这个问题上的观点。
B) 他对Liqa Raschid-Sally的结论提出质疑。
C) 他认为这是摆脱当前粮食危机的唯一出路。
D) 他认为这对于应对全球贫困是不可或缺的。
**判型** Q50 选项 He echoes Pay Drechsel's opinion on the issue. 和 He challenges Liqa Raschid-Sally's conclusion 都涉及与他人的关系，需要把 Bartram 的话与前文人物比对，仍是基于定位句的细节题。
**拆句** 题干 Q50 主干 What do we learn about James Bartram's position，介词短语 on the use of human waste for farming 限定 position 的对象。we learn about 是常见的客观提问句式，等同于'文章告诉我们'。
**定位** "过于严格的标准往往会失败，"世界卫生组织水健康专家詹姆斯·巴特拉姆说，"我们必须接受这样一个事实：在地球的很多地方，几乎不经处理或完全不处理的废物将被合理地用于农业。"
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确waste with little or no treatment will be used in agriculture for good reason↔He echoes Pay Drechsel's opinion on the issue. Overly strict standards often fail↔He echoes Pay Drechsel's opinion on the issue. Drechsel 主张'风险可解、利大于弊、继续使用'，Bartram 主张'严格禁止行不通、可合理使用'，方向上一一对应，echoes 是'附和、应和'的最准确表达。
B) 张冠李戴Liqa Raschid-Sally 给出 large potential ... to both help and hurt 这一中立结论；Bartram 的话并非针对她，且立场也不是反对'有正有负'的结论，谈不上 challenges。

title: The robotics revolution is set to bring humans…

sentences.text: The robotics revolution is set to bring humans face to face with an old fear—man-made creations as smart and capable as we are but without a moral compass.
As robots take on ever more complex roles, the question naturally (26)____ : Who will be responsible when they do something wrong?
Manufacturers?
Users?
Software writers?
The answer depends on the robot.

passage.translation: 机器人革命即将让人类直面一个古老的恐惧——人造的造物像我们一样聪明能干，却没有道德指南针。随着机器人承担越来越复杂的角色，一个问题自然而然地出现了：当它们做错事时，谁将负责？制造商？使用者？软件编写者？答案取决于机器人本身。

sentences.text: Robots already save us time, money and energy.
In the future, they will improve our health care, social welfare and standard of living.

The (27)____ of computational power and engineering advances will (28)____ enable lower-cost in-home care for the disabled, (29)____ use of driverless cars that may reduce drunk- and distracted-driving accidents and countless home and service-industry uses for robots, from street cleaning to food preparation.

passage.translation: 机器人已经为我们节省了时间、金钱和精力。在未来，它们将改善我们的医疗保健、社会福利和生活水平。计算能力和工程技术进步的结合，最终将实现为残疾人提供成本更低的居家护理，广泛使用可能减少酒驾和分心驾驶事故的无人驾驶汽车，以及机器人在家庭和服务行业的无数用途，从街道清洁到食品制备。

sentences.text: But there are (30)____ to be problems.
Robot cars will crash.
A drone(遥控⻜行器) operator will(31)____ someone's privacy.
A robotic lawn mower(割草机) will run over a neighbor's cat.
Juries sympathetic to the (32)____ of machines will punish entrepreneurs with company-crushing (33)____and damages.
What should governments do to protect people while (34)____ space for innovation?

passage.translation: 但问题必然会出现。机器人汽车会发生碰撞。无人机操作员会侵犯他人隐私。机器人割草机会碾过邻居的猫。同情机器受害者的陪审团会用足以摧毁公司的罚款和赔偿来惩罚企业家。政府应该做些什么来保护人们，同时保留创新的空间？

sentences.text: Big, complicated systems on which much public safety depends, like driverless cars, should be built,(35)____ and sold by manufacturers who take responsibility for ensuring safety and are liable for accidents.
Governments should set safety requirements and then let insurers price the risk of the robots based on the manufacturer's driving record, not the passenger's.

passage.translation: 公共安全在很大程度上依赖的大型复杂系统，如无人驾驶汽车，应该由制造商建造、编程和销售，制造商负责确保安全并对事故承担责任。政府应该设定安全要求，然后让保险公司根据制造商的驾驶记录而非乘客的记录来为机器人的风险定价。

groups.instructions: In this section, there is a passage with ten blanks. You are required to select one word for each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage. Read the passage through carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not use any of the words in the bank more than once.
groups.content:
The robotics revolution is set to bring humans face to face with an old fear—man-made creations as smart and capable as we are but without a moral compass. As robots take on ever more complex roles, the question naturally {{26}} : Who will be responsible when they do something wrong? Manufacturers? Users? Software writers? The answer depends on the robot.

Robots already save us time, money and energy. In the future, they will improve our health care, social welfare and standard of living. The {{27}} of computational power and engineering advances will {{28}} enable lower-cost in-home care for the disabled, {{29}} use of driverless cars that may reduce drunk- and distracted-driving accidents and countless home and service-industry uses for robots, from street cleaning to food preparation.

But there are {{30}} to be problems. Robot cars will crash. A drone(遥控⻜行器) operator will{{31}} someone's privacy. A robotic lawn mower(割草机) will run over a neighbor's cat. Juries sympathetic to the {{32}} of machines will punish entrepreneurs with company-crushing {{33}}and damages. What should governments do to protect people while {{34}} space for innovation?

Big, complicated systems on which much public safety depends, like driverless cars, should be built,{{35}} and sold by manufacturers who take responsibility for ensuring safety and are liable for accidents. Governments should set safety requirements and then let insurers price the risk of the robots based on the manufacturer's driving record, not the passenger's.

options.text: arises
manifesting
ascends
penalties
bound
preserving
combination
programmed
definite
proximately
eventually
victims
interfere
widespread
invade

questions.explanation:
**答案** A) arises 动词
**词性槽** the question 作主语，缺谓语动词，单数第三人称一般现在时
**依据** the question arises 是「问题出现」的固定表达the question naturally arises: Who will be responsible when they do something wrong? 中 arises 三单形式恰好匹配 the question 单数主语，「问题自然产生」也直接引出下文那三连问。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
B) ascends ascends 指「上升、登顶」，不与抽象 question 搭配ascend 多用于物理攀升或地位上升(ascend the throne / ascend to power)，「问题上升」不是正常英语表达，且与「自然引出疑问」的语境无关。

questions.explanation:
**答案** D) combination 名词
**词性槽** 定冠词 The 后、of 短语前是名词作主语
**依据** and 把两个力量拼在一起 → 组合of 后是 computational power and engineering advances 两个东西，与「组合」语义天然契合，且单数与 The 一致；它「将带来低成本居家护理」也只有「两股力量的结合」逻辑顺。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
J) penalties复数 penalties 与单数动词 will enable 主谓不一致，且语义反向penalties 是复数(就形态而言句子也能走，但本质偏离句意)；其语义「惩罚」与「带来低成本居家护理」完全冲突，无法主语化这一积极后果。
N) victims「受害者的…」完全不匹配后文积极语义victims 指「受害者」，与「促成无障碍居家护理、无人驾驶」的正面后果不搭，也不与「计算力 + 工程进展」形成自然属格。

questions.explanation:
**答案** F) eventually 副词
**词性槽** 情态动词 will 与实义动词 enable 之间，缺一个修饰动词的副词
**依据** 对应未来时 will，强调技术演进的最终结果句子用 will __(28)__ enable，且整段在展望 In the future, they will improve our health care，「最终能够实现」语义与 eventually(最终) 完美契合。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
M) proximately 词义指「邻近地/直接地」，与「未来终将」的时间感反向proximately 表示「在原因链上直接地」或「在空间/时间上邻近地」，放进 will __(28)__enable 不仅与 will 表达的未来感冲突，还和后文 In the future 的远景描写矛盾。

questions.explanation:
**答案** O) widespread 形容词
**词性槽** 名词 use 前需一个定语形容词
**依据** 「无人驾驶车的普及使用」才能减少酒驾分心事故__(29)__ use of driverless cars that may reduce drunk- and distracted-driving accidents 强调通过「广泛使用」无人车来减少事故，widespread use 是英语固定搭配，正中此意。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
E) definitedefinite use 不是英语习惯搭配，语义也只表「明确的使用」definite 强调「明确的、不可置疑的」，无法解释「为何能减少酒驾事故」——减少事故靠的是规模化普及，不是「明确」。

questions.explanation:
**答案** C) bound 形容词
**词性槽** be 动词与 to do 之间是表语形容词位
**依据** be bound to do 是「必然/注定要…」的固定搭配there are __(30)__ to be problems. 等于 there are bound to be problems，意为「必然会有问题」。下一句立刻列出种种事故 Robot cars will crash. A drone(遥控飞行器) operator will __(31)__ someone's privacy.，印证这种「注定」。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
E) definitedefinite 不与 to do 直接搭配definite 表「明确的」，不存在 be definite to do 的固定结构，且语义「明确会有问题」也不如「注定会有问题」贴合后文的事故罗列。
O) widespread 义为「广泛的」，与 there be…to do 句型不兼容widespread 修饰名词或作表语描述分布范围，不能后接 to do 不定式表「注定要…」；语义也偏离段意。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 E) —— 「definite to be problems」看似也成立，实则无此搭配。考生若不知道 be bound to do 这个固定结构，会被 definite「明确的」诱惑——「明确会有问题」中文听着也通。防坑要点：英语里能进 be ___ to do 的形容词是有限的(bound/likely/sure/about/certain)，definite 不在其中。

questions.explanation:
**答案** H) invade 动词
**词性槽** 助动词 will 后接动词原形，且后跟宾语 someone's privacy
**依据** invade one's privacy 是「侵犯隐私」的固定搭配will __(31)__ someone's privacy 与 invade privacy 完美对应——这是英语高频法律/新闻搭配，对应中文「侵犯隐私」。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
G) interfereinterfere 是不及物动词，必须带 with，不能直接接 someone's privacy interfere 后需 with 才能接宾语(interfere with one's privacy)，原句中没有 with，语法上直接排除；同时 invade privacy 是更地道的搭配。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 G) —— interfere 义近 invade 但不及物。interfere 在中文翻译里也常被译成「干涉、侵犯」，看着和 invade 同义。防坑要点：及物性是动词位的硬约束，没有 with 不能选 interfere；invade privacy 是英语写作高频固定搭配，认死了即可。

questions.explanation:
**答案** N) victims 名词
**词性槽** the ___ of machines 是名词位
**依据** 「机器的受害者」获得陪审团同情Juries sympathetic to the victims of machines——陪审团同情的对象自然是被机器伤害的「受害者」，与下文 punish entrepreneurs 的因果一致。

**答案** J) penalties 名词
**词性槽** with 后、and damages 并列前是名词位
**依据** 「陪审团惩罚企业家」的工具是处罚 + 赔偿Juries sympathetic to the __(32)__ of machines will punish entrepreneurs with company-crushing __(33)__ and damages. 里 punish 提示惩罚手段；penalties(罚款) 与damages(损害赔偿) 是法律语境中典型的双驾马车。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
N) victims victims 是人，无法作「惩罚」的工具/手段with victims and damages 在语义上不成立——受害者不是惩罚企业家的「工具」。同时 N 词更适合留给 32 题「机器的 ___」那个名词位。

questions.explanation:
**答案** K) preserving 动词
**词性槽** while 后缺一个动名词作伴随状语
**依据** 与 protect 形成「保护民众 / 保留创新空间」的并列对照to protect people while __(34)__ space for innovation 是经典的 while 对照结构：前半保护民众、后半保留创新余地。preserve space 是「保留空间」的固定搭配，逻辑顺。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
I) manifesting 义为「显现、表明」，无法和 space 构成「留出空间」语义manifest space 不是固定搭配；且文段在讨论「如何既保护人又给创新留空间」，需要的是「保留」，不是「显现」。

questions.explanation:
**答案** L) programmed 动词
**词性槽** 并列结构 built, ___ and sold 中缺一个过去分词
**依据** 与 built/sold 构成「造 → 编程 → 卖」的完整生产链无人车这类机器人系统在 driverless cars, should be built, __(35)__ and sold by manufacturers 的语境里，先组装、再编程、再出售，programmed 正中产品生命周期叙述。

title: America's education system has become less a ladder…

sentences.text: America's education system has become less a ladder of opportunity than a structure to transmit inequality from one generation to the next.

passage.translation: 美国的教育体系已经不再是一架机会的阶梯,而是成为了一种将不平等从一代传递到下一代的结构。

sentences.text: That's why school reform is so critical.
This is an issue of equality, opportunity and national conscience.
It's not just about education, but about poverty and justice.

passage.translation: 这就是为什么学校改革如此重要。这是一个关乎平等、机会和国家良知的问题。它不仅仅关乎教育,还关乎贫困和公正。

sentences.text: It's true that the main reason inner-city schools do poorly isn't teachers' unions, but poverty.
Southern states without strong teachers' unions have schools at least as awful as those in union states.
Some Chicago teachers seem to think that they shouldn't be held accountable until poverty is solved.
There're steps we can take that would make some difference, and Mayor Rahm Emanuel is trying some of them—yet the union is resisting.

passage.translation: 确实,市中心学校教学质量差的主要原因不是教师工会,而是贫困。那些没有强大教师工会的南部州,其学校至少和工会州的学校一样糟糕。一些芝加哥教师似乎认为,在贫困问题解决之前,他们不应该被追究责任。我们可以采取一些能够产生一定作用的措施,市长Rahm Emanuel正在尝试其中的一些措施——然而工会却在抵制。

sentences.text: I'd be sympathetic if the union focused solely on higher compensation.
Teachers need to be much better paid to attract the best college graduates to the nation's worst schools.
But, instead, the Chicago union seems to be using its political capital primarily to protect weak performers.

passage.translation: 如果工会只专注于提高薪酬,我会表示同情。教师需要获得更高的报酬,以吸引最优秀的大学毕业生到国家最差的学校任教。但是,芝加哥工会似乎主要利用其政治资本来保护表现不佳的教师。

sentences.text: There's solid evidence that there are huge differences in the effectiveness of teachers.
The gold standard study by Harvard and Columbia University scholars found that even in high-poverty schools, teachers consistently had a huge positive or negative impact.

passage.translation: 有确凿证据表明,教师的有效性存在巨大差异。哈佛大学和哥伦比亚大学学者进行的黄金标准研究发现,即使在高贫困学校,教师也始终产生巨大的积极或消极影响。

sentences.text: Get a bottom 1% teacher, and the effect is the same as if a child misses 40% of the school year.
Get a teacher from the top 20%, and it's as if a child has gone to school for an extra month or two.
The study found that strong teachers in the fourth through eighth grades raised the skills of their students in ways that would last for decades.
Just having a strong teacher for one elementary year left pupils a bit less likely to become mothers as teenagers, a bit more likely to go to college and earning more money at age 28.

passage.translation: 遇到最差1%的教师,其效果相当于孩子缺席40%的学年。遇到最优秀20%的教师,则相当于孩子多上了一两个月的学。该研究发现,四年级到八年级的优秀教师以持续数十年的方式提高了学生的技能。仅仅在小学某一年遇到一位优秀教师,就能让学生成为少女妈妈的可能性略微降低,上大学的可能性略微提高,并在28岁时赚更多的钱。

sentences.text: How does one figure out who is a weak teacher?
Yes, that's a challenge.
But researchers are improving systems to measure a teacher's performance throughout the year, and, with three years of data, it's usually possible to tell which teachers are failing.

passage.translation: 如何判断谁是不称职的教师?是的,这是一个挑战。但研究人员正在改进全年衡量教师表现的系统,而且有了三年的数据,通常就能判断出哪些教师不合格。

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the union in Chicago is insisting that teachers who are laid off—often for being ineffective—should get priority in new hiring.
That's an insult to students.

passage.translation: 不幸的是,芝加哥工会坚持认为被解雇的教师——通常是因为不称职——应该在新招聘中获得优先权。这是对学生的侮辱。

sentences.text: Teaching is so important that it should be like other professions, with high pay and good working conditions but few job protections for bottom performers.

passage.translation: 教学如此重要,应该像其他职业一样,有高薪和良好的工作条件,但对表现最差者只提供很少的工作保障。

sentences.text: This isn't a battle between garment workers and greedy bosses.
The central figures in the Chicago schools strike are neither strikers nor managers but 350,000 children.
Protecting the union demand sacrifices those students, in effect turning a blind eye to the injustice in the education system.

passage.translation: 这不是服装工人与贪婪老板之间的战斗。芝加哥学校罢工的核心人物既不是罢工者也不是管理者,而是35万名儿童。保护工会的要求就是牺牲这些学生,实际上是对教育体系中的不公正视而不见。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What do we learn about America's education system?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
关于美国的教育体系我们了解到什么?
A) 它为富人提供了机会的阶梯。
B) 它对消除不平等几乎没有贡献。
C) 它几代人以来基本保持不变。
D) 它培养了一代代有责任感的公民。
**判型** What do we learn about America's education system? 是问"关于美国教育体系我们了解到什么"，要的是原文已说出的事实表述，而不是隐含推断。
**拆句** What do we learn about America's education system? 是标准疑问句，主干 we learn about America's education system，无从句、无否定、无比较，理解上无陷阱。
**定位** 美国的教育体系已不再那么像一架通向机会的阶梯，而更像一座把不平等代代相传的结构。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有原文说教育体系不再是"机会的阶梯"，选项 It provides a ladder of opportunity for the wealthy. 反过来说它"为富人提供机会的阶梯"，无中生有地嫁接了"the wealthy"这一对象。
B) ✓ 正确a structure to transmit inequality from one generation to the next ↔contributes little to the elimination of inequality less a ladder of opportunity than a structure to transmit inequality ↔ contributes little预判要的是"几乎没在消除不平等 / 反而在传递不平等"两层意思；选项 It contributes little to the elimination of inequality. 正好覆盖前一层，是定位句的同义反向改写，因此锁定 B。
C) 与原文相反原文 has become less ... than ... 强调"已经发生了变化"，选项 It has remained basically unchanged for generations. 说"几代未变"，与原文方向完全相反。
D) 无中生有原文通篇批判教育体系，选项 It has brought up generations of responsible citizens.给出正向评价（培养了一代代负责任的公民），属作者立场之反，且原文无任何"培养公民"的提及。
questions.quote: America's education system has become less a ladder of opportunity than a structure to transmit inequality from one generation to the next.

options.text: It provides a ladder of opportunity for the wealthy.
It contributes little to the elimination of inequality.
It has remained basically unchanged for generations.
It has brought up generations of responsible citizens.

questions.prompt: What is chiefly responsible for the undesirable performance of inner-city schools?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
市中心学校表现不佳的主要原因是什么?
A) 不合格的教师。
B) 缺乏财政资源。
C) 不利的学习环境。
D) 潜意识的种族歧视。
**判型** What is chiefly responsible for the undesirable performance of inner-city schools? 是问明确给出的主因事实，原文必然有一句直接的因果断言。
**拆句** 题干主干 What is chiefly responsible for X，be responsible for 意为"对……负责"，引申为"造成……的原因"；undesirable performance 即"差劲的表现"。
**定位** 确实，市中心学校表现糟糕的主要原因不是教师工会，而是贫困。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念原文把工会和教师列为"不是主因"，选项 Unqualified teachers. 把"工会"偷换为"不合格教师"——确实下文有差教师的话题，但作为"主因"原文明确否定。
B) ✓ 正确the main reason inner-city schools do poorly isn't teachers' unions, but poverty ↔Lack of financial resources.预判核心"贫困是主因"对应到选项里只有 Lack of financial resources. 是同义复述，其余选项均未提到资金/贫困。
C) 无中生有选项 Unfavorable learning environment. 谈"不利的学习环境"，原文从头到尾未将"环境"列为差表现的主因。
D) 无中生有选项 Subconscious racial discrimination. 引入了"潜意识种族歧视"这一话题，全文没有任何提及种族的内容。
questions.quote: It's true that the main reason inner-city schools do poorly isn't teachers' unions, but poverty.

options.text: Unqualified teachers.
Lack of financial resources.
Unfavorable learning environment.
Subconscious racial discrimination.

questions.prompt: What does the author think the union should do to win popular support?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者认为工会应该做什么来赢得大众支持?
A) 协助市政府改革学校。
B) 给市中心学校提供建设性建议。
C) 要求提高教师薪酬。
D) 帮助教师改进教学。
**判型** What does the author think the union should do to win popular support? 问作者明确表达的建议，原文有让步条件句直接对应。
**拆句** 题干主干 What does the author think (that) the union should do to win popular support；嵌套宾语从句 + 不定式目的状语 to win popular support（"以赢得民众支持"）。
**定位** 如果工会只聚焦于争取更高薪酬，我是同情（支持）的。教师确需大幅加薪，才能把最优秀的大学毕业生吸引到全国最差的学校。可惜，芝加哥工会似乎正把它的政治资本主要用在保护差表现者上。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反原文 the union is resisting 明确写工会在抵制市长的改革，选项 Assist the city government in reforming schools. 说工会"协助政府改革"，与原文反向。
B) 无中生有选项 Give constructive advice to inner-city schools. 让工会"向市中心学校建言"，原文从未让工会扮演建议者，且作者认为工会该做的是争取薪酬，不是建言。
C) ✓ 正确focused solely on higher compensation ↔ Demand higher pay for teachers. Teachers need to be much better paid ↔ higher pay for teachers预判核心"工会应聚焦于更高薪酬"几乎逐字对应 Demand higher pay for teachers.，锁定 C。
D) 偷换概念选项 Help teachers improve teaching. 让工会"帮助教师提升教学"，原文从未谈及工会负责教学培训；且原文反复点出工会的问题在"保护差表现者"而非"提升教学"。
questions.quote: I'd be sympathetic if the union focused solely on higher compensation. Teachers need to be much better paid to attract the best college graduates to the nation's worst schools. But, instead, the Chicago union seems to be using its political capital primarily to protect weak performers.

options.text: Assist the city government in reforming schools.
Give constructive advice to inner-city schools.
Demand higher pay for teachers.
Help teachers improve teaching.

questions.prompt: What is the finding of the gold standard study by Harvard and Columbia University scholars?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
Harvard和Columbia University学者的黄金标准研究有什么发现?
A) 许多市中心学校的教师不能胜任工作。
B) 很大比例的市中心儿童经常缺课。
C) 许多学生对他们的教师不满意。
D) 学生表现与教师有很大关系。
**判型** What is the finding of the gold standard study 问的是该研究明面写出的结论，属事实复述。
**拆句** 题干主干 What is the finding of the study；介词短语 by Harvard and Columbia University scholars 修饰 study，说明研究执行者，无理解陷阱。
**定位** 这项由哈佛与哥伦比亚大学学者完成的黄金标准研究发现：即便在高贫困学校里，教师始终对学生有巨大的正面或负面影响。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 以偏概全原文只说"教师之间差异巨大、有强有弱"，选项 Many inner-city school teachers are not equal to their jobs. 偷换为"很多教师不胜任"——把双向差异（正面 or 负面）单方面强化为"普遍不胜任"。
B) 偷换概念选项 A large proportion of inner-city children often miss classes. 说"很大比例的市中心学生经常缺课"，原文 as if a child misses 40% of the school year 是"差老师对学生的影响相当于缺课 40%"的比喻，并非真有学生缺课。
C) 无中生有选项 Many students are dissatisfied with their teachers. 谈"学生对老师不满"，原文研究讨论的是教师对学生的客观影响，从未涉及学生主观满意度。
D) ✓ 正确teachers consistently had a huge positive or negative impact ↔Student performance has a lot to do with teachers. strong teachers in the fourth through eighth grades raised the skills of their students in ways that would last for decades↔ Student performance has a lot to do with teachers.预判核心"教师差异对学生有巨大影响"对应 Student performance has a lot to do with teachers.——这是因果方向相同、主宾互换的同义改写，锁定 D。
questions.quote: The gold standard study by Harvard and Columbia University scholars found that even in high-poverty schools, teachers consistently had a huge positive or negative impact.

options.text: Many inner-city school teachers are not equal to their jobs.
A large proportion of inner-city children often miss classes.
Many students are dissatisfied with their teachers.
Student performance has a lot to do with teachers.

questions.prompt: Why does the author say the Chicago union's demand is an insult to students?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
为什么作者说芝加哥工会的要求是对学生的侮辱?
A) 它以牺牲学生为代价保护不称职的教师。
B) 它低估了学生区分好教师和差教师的能力。
C) 它使学生感到自己在很多方面受到歧视。
D) 它完全忽视了学生在学习过程中的主动性。
**判型** Why does the author say the Chicago union's demand is an insult to students? 问的是作者已说出"insult"的直接理由，原文必有同段相邻的因果支撑。
**拆句** 题干主干 Why does the author say [the Chicago union's demand is an insult to students]；say 的宾语是一个完整从句，意思是"芝加哥工会的诉求是对学生的侮辱"。
**定位** 可惜，芝加哥工会坚持要求：被解雇的教师（这些教师常常是因为表现差才被解雇）在新一轮招聘中应享有优先权。这是对学生的侮辱。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确teachers who are laid off—often for being ineffective—should get priority in new hiring↔It protects incompetent teachers at the expense of students. to protect weak performers↔ It protects incompetent teachers预判要的两层意思——"保护差教师"+ "牺牲学生" ——只有 It protects incompetent teachers at the expense of students. 完整命中，锁定 A。
B) 无中生有选项 It underestimates students' ability to tell good teachers from poor ones.谈"低估学生分辨好坏老师的能力"，原文从未谈及学生的分辨力。
C) 无中生有选项 It makes students feel that they are discriminated against in many ways. 引入"歧视"话题，全文未提任何歧视议题。
D) 无中生有选项 It totally ignores students' initiative in the learning process. 谈"完全忽视学生在学习过程中的主动性"，原文未涉及学生主动性话题。
questions.quote: Unfortunately, the union in Chicago is insisting that teachers who are laid off—often for being ineffective—should get priority in new hiring. That's an insult to students.

options.text: It protects incompetent teachers at the expense of students.
It underestimates students' ability to tell good teachers from poor ones.
It makes students feel that they are discriminated against in many ways.
It totally ignores students' initiative in the learning process.

title: Manufacturers of products that claim to be environmentally…

sentences.text: Manufacturers of products that claim to be environmentally friendly will face tighter rules on how they are advertised to consumers under changes proposed by the Federal Trade Commission.

passage.translation: 根据联邦贸易委员会提出的修订方案,声称环保的产品制造商在向消费者进行广告宣传时将面临更严格的规定。

sentences.text: The commission's revised "Green Guides" warn marketers against using labels that make broad claims, like "eco-friendly".
Marketers must qualify their claims on the product packaging and limit them to a specific benefit, such as how much of the product is recycled.

passage.translation: 该委员会修订的《绿色指南》警告营销人员不要使用"环保"等做出宽泛声明的标签。营销人员必须在产品包装上对其声明进行限定,并将其限制在具体的益处上,例如产品中有多少成分是回收的。

sentences.text: "This is really about trying to cut through the confusion that consumers have when they are buying a product and that businesses have when they are selling a product," said Jon Leibowitz, chairman of the commission.

passage.translation: 该委员会主席Jon Leibowitz说:"这实际上是为了消除消费者在购买产品时以及企业在销售产品时所面临的困惑。"

sentences.text: The revisions come at a time when green marketing is on the rise.
According to a new study, the number of advertisements with green messages in mainstream magazines has risen since 1987, and peaked in 2008 at 10.4%.
In 2009, the number dropped to 9%.

passage.translation: 这些修订是在绿色营销兴起之际提出的。根据一项新研究,主流杂志中带有绿色信息的广告数量自1987年以来有所上升,并在2008年达到10.4%的峰值。2009年,这一数字降至9%。

sentences.text: But while the number of advertisements may have dipped, there has been a rapid spread of eco- labeling.
There are both good and bad players in the eco-labeling game.

passage.translation: 但是,虽然广告数量可能有所下降,生态标签却迅速蔓延。在生态标签游戏中既有好的参与者也有坏的参与者。

sentences.text: In the last five years or so, there has been an explosion of green claims and environmental claims.
It is clear that consumers don't always know what they are getting.

passage.translation: 在过去五年左右的时间里,绿色声明和环境声明出现了爆炸式增长。显然,消费者并不总是知道他们得到的是什么。

sentences.text: A handful of lawsuits have been filed in recent years against companies accused of using misleading environmental labels.
In 2008 and 2009, class-action lawsuits(集体诉讼) were filed against SC Johnson for using "Greenlist" labels on its cleaning products.
The lawsuits said that the label was misleading because it gave the impression that the products had been certified by a third party when the certification was the company's own.

passage.translation: 近年来,已有少数针对被指控使用误导性环境标签的公司提起的诉讼。2008年和2009年,针对SC Johnson在其清洁产品上使用"Greenlist"标签提起了集体诉讼。诉讼称该标签具有误导性,因为它给人的印象是产品已经过第三方认证,而实际上认证是该公司自己做的。

sentences.text: "We are very proud of our accomplishments under the Greenlist system and we believe that we will prevail in these cases," Christopher Beard, director of public affairs for SC Johnson, said, while acknowledging that "this has been an area that is difficult to navigate."

passage.translation: SC Johnson公共事务总监Christopher Beard说:"我们为Greenlist系统下取得的成就感到非常自豪,我们相信我们将在这些案件中获胜。"同时他也承认"这一直是一个难以驾驭的领域"。

sentences.text: Companies have also taken it upon themselves to contest each other's green claims.

passage.translation: 各公司也主动对彼此的绿色声明提出质疑。

sentences.text: David Mallen, associate director of the Council of Better Business Bureau, said in the last two years the organization had seen an increase in the number of claims companies were bringing against each other for false or misleading environmental product claims.

passage.translation: 商业改进局理事会副主任David Mallen表示,在过去两年中,该组织看到公司因虚假或误导性环境产品声明而相互提起诉讼的数量有所增加。

sentences.text: "About once a week, I have a client that will bring up a new certification I've never even heard of and I'm in this industry," said Kevin Wilhelm, chief executive officer of Sustainable Business Consulting.
"It's kind of a Wild West, anybody can claim themselves to be green."
Mr.
Wilhelm said the excess of labels made it difficult for businesses and consumers to know which labels they should pay attention to.

passage.translation: Sustainable Business Consulting首席执行官Kevin Wilhelm说:"大约每周一次,我会有一个客户提出一个我从未听说过的新认证,而我就在这个行业里。""这有点像狂野西部,任何人都可以声称自己是绿色的。"Wilhelm先生表示,过多的标签使得企业和消费者难以知道应该关注哪些标签。

questions.prompt: What do the revised "Green Guides" require businesses to do?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
修订后的《绿色指南》要求企业做什么?
A) 尽可能多地生产绿色产品。
B) 标明其产品是否可回收。
C) 具体说明其产品在哪些方面是绿色的。
D) 在其所有产品上贴绿色标签。
**判型** What do the revised "Green Guides" require businesses to do? 直接问规则要求做什么，答案应是原文规定句的客观转述。
**拆句** 主干 What do the revised "Green Guides" require businesses to do，疑问代词 What作 do 的宾语；revised 作前置定语修饰 Green Guides，businesses 是 require 的宾语，to do 为不定式作宾语补足语。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
**定位** 营销者必须在产品包装上对其宣称加以限定，并将其约束在某一具体益处上，例如产品中有多少比例是循环再造的。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有Manufacture as many green products as possible 把对"宣传方式"的规定偷换为对"生产数量"的要求，原文从未提及。
B) 以偏概全原文 such as how much of the product is recycled 用 such as 把"可回收"作举例，Indicate whether their products are recyclable 却把这一例子当作唯一要求。
C) ✓ 正确limit them to a specific benefit, such as how much of the product is recycled ↔Specify in what way their products are green qualify their claims ↔ Specify C 项把"加以限定"和"指明具体益处"两层语义合并为一句"specify in what way their products are green"，与预判完全吻合。
D) 与原文相反原文 warn marketers against using labels that make broad claims 是"警告别乱贴宽泛标签"，Attach green labels to all of their products 反过来要求"全部贴绿标"。
questions.quote: Marketers must qualify their claims on the product packaging and limit them to a specific benefit, such as how much of the product is recycled.

questions.prompt: What was SC Johnson accused of in the class-action lawsuits?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
在集体诉讼中SC Johnson被指控什么?
A) 它给消费者造成其所有产品都是真正绿色产品的印象。
B) 它授权第三方将其产品标注为环保产品。
C) 它误导消费者相信其产品已经过第三方认证。
D) 它销售的清洁产品未被列入官方"绿色清单"。
**判型** What was SC Johnson accused of in the class-action lawsuits? 直接问被指控的具体内容，对应原文叙述句。
**拆句** 主干 What was SC Johnson accused of，被动语态：SC Johnson 是受动者；in the class-action lawsuits 作时间/事件状语，限定指控发生的场合。注意 accused of 后接的是"指控的内容"，原文对应表达可能是 misleading/gave the impression that…，需识别这一对应。
**定位** 诉讼指控该标签具有误导性，因为它给人留下产品已经过第三方认证的印象，而实际上该认证是公司自身做出的。
questions.tip:

A) 偷换概念It gave consumers the impression that all its products were truly green 把指控重点从"经第三方认证"偷换为"产品全都真正环保"，且 all 与 truly 在原文均无对应。
B) 与原文相反It gave a third party the authority to label its products as environmentally friendly 说"授权第三方贴标"，正是原文否认的——原文为 the certification was the company's own，反向陈述。
C) ✓ 正确the label was misleading ↔ It misled consumers gave the impression that the products had been certified by a third party ↔to believe that its products had been certified by a third party C 项把"标签误导"与"让人以为经第三方认证"两层语义合并，并与定位句一一对应，与预判吻合。
D) 无中生有It sold cleaning products that were not included in the official "Greenlist" 编造"卖了不在官方 Greenlist 里的清洁产品"，原文从未提及。原文 Greenlist 也并非"官方"清单，而是公司自有。

questions.prompt: How did Christopher Beard defend his company's labeling practice?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
Christopher Beard如何为其公司的标签做法辩护?
A) 关于绿色标签没有明确的指导方针。
B) 他公司的产品已经得到公众的好评。
C) 这符合市场上流行的做法。
D) 没有法律要求第三方参与认证。
**判型** How did Christopher Beard defend his company's labeling practice? 问的是"用何种说法辩护"，答案在原话里。
**拆句** How 作方式状语，主干 did Christopher Beard defend his company's labeling practice。注意 his company's labeling practice 是"公司的标签做法"——即 Greenlist 的标注行为；考生若误读为"产品"会偏。
**定位** "我们对 Greenlist 体系下取得的成就深感自豪，并且相信会在这些案件中胜诉。"SC Johnson 公共事务总监 Christopher Beard 这样说，同时也承认"这一直是一个难以把握的领域"。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确this has been an area that is difficult to navigate ↔There were no clear guidelines concerning green labeling A 项把"难以把握"具象化为"没有明确指引"，正是 Beard 用以为公司开脱的核心辩护点。
B) 答非所问His company's products had been well received by the public 谈"产品受欢迎"，原文未提及；Beard 提的是"自豪于 Greenlist 体系下的成就"，并非"公众反响好"。
C) 无中生有It was in conformity to the prevailing practice in the market 说"符合行业普遍做法"，原文中 Beard 从未做过"大家都这么干"的辩解。
D) 无中生有No law required the involvement of a third party in certification 称"法律没要求第三方介入"，原文未提任何法律层面的辩护。
questions.quote: "We are very proud of our accomplishments under the Greenlist system and we believe that we will prevail in these cases," Christopher Beard, director of public affairs for SC Johnson, said, while acknowledging that "this has been an area that is difficult to navigate."

sentences.text: This description of roller-skating (28)____ the three components of an attitude: affect, cognition, and behavior.

These feelings (29)____ the affective or emotional component; they are an important ingredient in attitudes.

passage.translation: 这段关于轮滑的描述阐释了态度的三个组成部分：情感、认知和行为。你热爱这项活动；它非常有趣。这些感受突显了情感或情绪成分；它们是态度中的重要组成部分。我们对对象所拥有的知识构成了态度的认知成分。你了解这项活动能带来的健康益处。最后,态度具有行为成分。我们的态度促使我们走到户外去享受轮滑。
