questions.explanation:
**答案** O) surprisingly 副词
**词性槽** 形容词 little 前缺修饰语，填副词
**依据** 呼应 However 的转折与意外感However, there has been __(26)__ little research on the influence of leisure activities：However 表明"家庭对工作影响研究很多，却出人意料地少有关于休闲的研究"——surprisingly（令人惊讶地）正强调这种"本该有却很少"的反差。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
C) casually 语义不搭（随意地）casually"随意地"修饰人做事的方式，casually little research 讲不通——研究数量"少"与"随意"无关，逻辑不成立。

questions.explanation:
**答案** N) shaped 动词
**词性槽** 从句主语后缺谓语动词
**依据** 对应全文核心动词"影响/塑造" to look at how the time spent on their hobbies __(27)__ their work life呼应开篇 how family life can affect productivity——研究的正是爱好时间如何"影响、塑造"工作生活。shape（塑造、影响）与 affect 同义，是本句最贴的谓语动词。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
M) scratch 词义不搭scratch"抓挠"，scratch their work life 语义荒谬，与"研究爱好如何影响工作"无关，纯靠词性蒙的人最易在此掉坑。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 M) —— 纯靠词性蒙易撞上 scratch。第 27 空 how the time spent on their hobbies __(27)__ their work life需及物动词，若不读懂"研究爱好如何影响工作"的语境、只凭"是个动词"乱填，scratch 这种词性也对的词最易误选；实则 scratch their work life 语义荒谬。防坑：动词空选定前务必把动宾连读一遍，看搭配是否成话。

questions.explanation:
**答案** I) normal 形容词
**词性槽** than 后跟比较基准，此处填名词化形容词
**依据** than normal="比平常更久" participants spent longer than __(28)__：longer than normal 是地道说法，意为"花的时间比平常（正常水平）更长"，normal 正好充当"平常"这个比较基准，与下文"花更久会增强工作信心"衔接。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
K) relative被 longer 诱导但不成基准relative"相对的/亲戚"，句中有比较级 longer 易让人误以为"相对"很搭，但 longer than relative 既不表常态也不成搭配，无法作"比平常更久"的基准。
J) prevalent 义为"普遍的"，不搭prevalent"普遍流行的"，longer than prevalent 讲不通，与时间长短的比较基准无关。
L) removed 义为"远离的"，留给 35 空removed"远离的"用于 far removed from，longer than removed 不通；它是第 35 空的答案。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 K) —— relative 被比较级 longer 诱导。第 28 空 spent longer than __(28)__有比较级 longer，relative（相对的）让人误以为"相对而言"很搭，词性也是形容词；但 longer than 后需要的是"常态"基准 normal，longer than relative 根本不成话。防坑：than 后填"和什么比"的基准，认准 normal/usual。

questions.explanation:
**答案** B) case 名词
**词性槽** the + ___ 作 was 的表语，缺名词
**依据** the case="实情如此"固定表达But this was only the __(29)__ when…：this was only the case when… 意为"只有在…时才是这种情况"，the case 是地道固定搭配，承接上句"花更久会增强信心"并加上限定条件。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
E) estate 词义离题estate"房地产"，the estate 与本句"这只在…时成立"的逻辑毫无关系。
G) faculty 义偏不搭faculty"教员/才能"，this was the faculty 不成话，无法表"情况如此"。

questions.explanation:
**答案** C) casually 副词
**词性槽** 句末修饰 did it 的方式状语
**依据** 与 only 呼应"只是随便做做" hobby was similar to their work but they only did it __(30)__与前半句 a serious hobby（认真的爱好）对照：but they only（只是）暗示这里是"不认真、随便玩玩"，casually（随意地）正好。

**答案** D) efficiency 名词
**词性槽** 形容词 work 后缺名词作宾语中心
**依据** 与 work 搭配且贴合"损耗工作表现"主线decreased their work __(31)__承接上句"爱好既认真又与工作相似时，多花时间反而坏事"。work efficiency（工作效率）是地道搭配，"降低了工作效率"正是这种损耗的体现，与 productivity（生产力）一脉相承。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
B) case 搭配与逻辑都不合case"情况"，decreased their work case 不成搭配，"减少工作情况"逻辑讲不通；case 该留给the case 那种框架（第 29 空）。
E) estate 词义离题（房地产）estate意为房地产、庄园，work estate 不成搭配，更与全文"爱好—工作信心"主题毫无关系，纯属凑数干扰。
G) faculty 义偏且不搭faculty常指大学教员或人的官能/才能，work faculty 不是地道说法，也无法承接"多花时间在爱好上反而减少了什么"的语境，逻辑接不上。

questions.explanation:
**答案** F) exhausted 形容词
**词性槽** be left + ___ 表状态，需形容词
**依据** 承接"耗尽心理资源"前句说维持认真的爱好要 invest significant psychological resources，若爱好与工作要求相同，人就 left __(32)__ and unable to perform well——被掏空、累垮，exhausted（精疲力竭的）与"and 后无法好好工作"因果相承。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
I) normal 义为"正常"，与负面状态相反normal"正常的"，be left normal and unable to perform well 自相矛盾——既正常又无法胜任，逻辑冲突；normal 该留给"比平常"的比较基准（第 28 空）。
J) prevalent 义为"普遍的"，不描述人prevalent"普遍流行的"形容现象，不能形容"人被弄成…的状态"，left prevalent 讲不通。
K) relative义为"相对的"，不搭relative"相对的/亲戚"，be left relative 既不表状态也无意义，与"无法胜任工作"接不上。
L) removed 义为"远离的"，留给 35 空removed"远离的"用于 far removed from，单独 left removed 不表"累垮"这种状态，它是第35 空 far removed from 的答案。

questions.explanation:
**答案** H) interfere 动词
**词性槽** 情态动词 may not 后缺动词原形
**依据** 对应"不会以同样方式妨碍"本句与上句构成转折：上句说相似爱好会把人掏空，But if their hobby is quite different from their career, it may not __(33)__ in the same way——若爱好与工作不同，就"不会以同样方式干扰"工作。interfere（干扰、妨碍）正好顶上这个"不会妨碍"，且 interfere 不及物，正合空后直接接 in the same way（无宾语）。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
A) boost 语义方向反（褒义）boost"提升"是褒义，但 may not 否定 + But 转折要的是"不会造成（负面）干扰"，填 boost成了"不会提升"，与"帮助发展技能"的下文自相矛盾。
M) scratch 词义不搭scratch"抓挠"，may not scratch in the same way 语义荒谬，与"不会以同样方式妨碍工作"无关。
N) shaped 中性"塑造"接不上否定转折shaped"塑造"中性，may not shape in the same way（不会以同样方式塑造）与上句"耗尽资源"的负面对照对不上；这里要的是负面动作的反面（不会干扰）。shaped 是第 27 空的答案。

questions.explanation:
**答案** A) boost 动词
**词性槽** that 引导定语从句缺谓语动词
**依据** 与 confidence 正搭，承"积极作用"语境本句讲不同类型的爱好能 help them develop other knowledge and skills，进而"增强工作中的信心"。boost one's confidence（提升信心）是固定正向搭配，与 help develop 的积极语气一致。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
M) scratch 词义不搭（抓挠）scratch意为抓、挠或"从零开始（from scratch）"，scratch their confidence 不成立，与"增强信心"毫无关系，是形义双重不搭的干扰。

questions.explanation:
**答案** L) removed 形容词
**词性槽** so far ___ from 中作形容词
**依据** far removed from="与…相去甚远"固定搭配Since climbing is so far __(35)__ from their day-to-day work activities：far removed from 是固定搭配，意为"与日常工作活动相去甚远"，呼应下文 they can still recover from the demands of their job——正因差距大才能恢复精力。

title: Female employees consistently pay lower airfares than men…

sentences.text: Female employees consistently pay lower airfares than men do for the same flights because they tend to book earlier.

passage.translation: 女性员工购买相同航班机票时支付的票价始终低于男性,因为她们倾向于更早预订。

sentences.text: We compared the airfare paid by employees in the same position within a company for the same class of travel and used a common statistical technique to account for other factors that might affect differences in airfares.
We found that women paid on average $18 less per ticket than their male colleagues.
Further investigation allowed us to conclude that this gap is largely explained by the fact that women tended to book earlier than men, 1.8 days on average.

passage.translation: 我们比较了公司内相同职位的员工购买同等舱位机票所支付的票价,并使用了一种常见的统计技术来考虑可能影响票价差异的其他因素。我们发现女性平均每张机票比男性同事少支付18美元。进一步调查使我们得以得出结论,这一差距在很大程度上可以用女性倾向于比男性更早预订这一事实来解释,平均提前1.8天。

sentences.text: We wanted to determine what was causing these gender differences in booking business trips so we tested a variety of possible explanations, such as women choosing to plan ahead or male frequent travelers being inclined to book late.

None of these explained away the gender gap, so we applied data collected from surveys that express consumer preferences that play a central role in economic decisions, such as patience and risk avoidance.

passage.translation: 我们想要确定是什么导致了预订商务旅行中的这些性别差异,因此我们测试了各种可能的解释,例如女性选择提前计划或男性常旅客倾向于晚订。这些都不能消除性别差距,因此我们应用了从调查中收集的数据,这些调查表达了在经济决策中起核心作用的消费者偏好,例如耐心和风险规避。

sentences.text: We found that only the concept of "negative reciprocity"—in which an employee who feels unfairly treated engages in negative behaviors, such as spending their company's money less carefully—explains these differences.
The surveys showed men tend to exhibit more of these negative behaviors than women.
This isn't to say that all men engage in these behaviors—or that booking relatively late is a sign of abnormal behavior.
It only means that the gender gap disappears when we plug in the negative reciprocity variable.

passage.translation: 我们发现只有"负面互惠"这一概念——即感到受到不公平对待的员工会从事负面行为,例如不那么谨慎地花费公司的钱——能够解释这些差异。调查显示男性比女性更倾向于表现出这些负面行为。这并不是说所有男性都从事这些行为,或者相对较晚预订是异常行为的标志。这只是意味着当我们代入负面互惠变量时,性别差距就消失了。

sentences.text: Prior research on negative reciprocity among workers found that it can result in lower employee motivation, business performance and workplace morale(士气) and culture.

passage.translation: 先前关于员工负面互惠的研究发现,它可能导致员工积极性、业务绩效以及工作场所士气和文化下降。

sentences.text: Our results show another way these negative behaviors can manifest themselves, like in airline bookings, and add to evidence that women are less likely to engage in them.

passage.translation: 我们的研究结果展示了这些负面行为可以表现出来的另一种方式,例如在航空预订中,并增加了女性不太可能从事这些行为的证据。

sentences.text: Companies spend significant sums of money on business travel.
While that $18 difference per ticket may seem small, it adds up.
Our analysis suggests early booking by women can translate into savings of $1 million a year for a large multinational company with 20,000 regular travelers.

passage.translation: 公司在商务旅行上花费大量资金。虽然每张机票18美元的差异可能看起来很小,但积少成多。我们的分析表明,对于一家拥有20000名定期旅行者的大型跨国公司来说,女性的提前预订可以转化为每年100万美元的节省。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What did the author's team conclude about the gender difference in airfares from their further investigation?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者的团队通过进一步调查得出了关于机票价格性别差异的什么结论?
A) 这在很大程度上归因于女性比男性更早预订机票。
B) 这在很大程度上可以用女性选择更便宜的航班来解释。
C) 这主要是由男性员工愿意支付更多费用来解释的。
D) 这是因为女性更关心公司的资金。
**判型** 题干 What did the author's team conclude 问作者团队得出了什么结论，是对文中已陈述事实的提取，不需推断。
**拆句** 主干是 What did the author's team conclude about the gender difference in airfares，特殊疑问句，conclude 后接 about 引出结论的对象；句末 from their further investigation 是状语，交代结论的来源，是关键定位信号，结构平铺、无陷阱。
**定位** 进一步调查使我们得出结论：这一差距很大程度上可由女性比男性订得更早这一事实来解释，平均早 1.8 天。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确this gap is largely explained by the fact that women tended to book earlier than men ↔It is largely attributed to women booking earlier than men选项 largely attributed to women booking earlier than men 与预判“价差主要因女性订得更早”完全吻合，是定位句的同义替换。
B) 无中生有原文将价差归因于订得早，从未说女性“选了更便宜的航班”；women's choosing cheaper flights 是文中没有的新说法。
C) 偷换概念原文成因是订得早晚，并非男性“更愿意多付钱”；male employees' readiness to pay more 把订得晚导致票价高，曲解成男性主动愿意付高价。
D) 张冠李戴“女性更在乎公司的钱”是第 4 段负向回报机制的延伸，不是本题进一步调查的结论；women care more about their company's money 张冠李戴到本题。
questions.quote: Further investigation allowed us to conclude that this gap is largely explained by the fact that women tended to book earlier than men, 1.8 days on average.

options.text: It is largely attributed to women booking earlier than men.
It is largely explained by women's choosing cheaper flights.
It is mainly accounted for by male employees' readiness to pay more.
It is due to the fact that women care more about their company's money.

questions.prompt: What did the researchers want to determine by testing a variety of possible explanations?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
研究人员想通过测试各种可能的解释来确定什么?
A) 是什么使得经常出差的男性晚预订机票。
B) 是什么导致女性在预订商务旅行时提前计划。
C) 是什么促使女性预订更便宜的航班。
D) 是什么造成了机票价格的性别差距。
**判型** 题干 What did the researchers want to determine 问研究者想弄清什么，答案是文中明写的目的，属事实提取。
**拆句** 主干 What did the researchers want to determine，后接介词短语 by testing a variety of possible explanations 作方式状语，by 表手段；理清“通过检验多种解释”是手段、“想弄清什么”才是问点，避免把手段当答案。
**定位** 我们想弄清是什么造成了订商务差旅中的这些性别差异，于是检验了多种可能的解释，比如女性选择提前规划，或男性常旅客倾向于晚订。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 以偏概全What made male frequent travelers book air tickets late 取自文中举例的待检解释male frequent travelers being inclined to book late，是被检验的假设之一，不是研究总目的。
B) 以偏概全What caused women to plan ahead in booking business trips 同样取自待检举例women choosing to plan ahead，是子假设而非研究要弄清的总问题。
C) 无中生有What motivated women to book cheaper flights 中“女性订更便宜的航班”文中从未出现，价差源于订得早而非选便宜航班。
D) ✓ 正确what was causing these gender differences in booking business trips ↔What accounted for the gender gap in airfares What accounted for the gender gap in airfares 正是预判“弄清性别价差成因”的同义表达，锁定该项。
questions.quote: We wanted to determine what was causing these gender differences in booking business trips so we tested a variety of possible explanations, such as women choosing to plan ahead or male frequent travelers being inclined to book late.

options.text: What made male frequent travelers book air tickets late.
What caused women to plan ahead in booking business trips.
What motivated women to book cheaper flights.
What accounted for the gender gap in airfares.

questions.prompt: What happened when the negative reciprocity variable was taken into account?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
当消极互惠变量被考虑在内时发生了什么?
A) 男性和女性都被发现有消极行为。
B) 男性和女性都不认为晚预订是一种不良行为。
C) 机票费用的性别差异不再存在。
D) 性别差距倾向于显著缩小。
**判型** 题干 What happened when the negative reciprocity variable was taken into account问“当变量被纳入后发生了什么”，结果文中明写，属细节。
**拆句** 主干 What happened when ...，when 引导时间状语从句，从句用被动 was taken into account；读懂“当负向回报这一变量被引入分析时”这个条件，结果句即答案。
**定位** 它只是意味着，当我们把负向回报这一变量代入后，性别差距就消失了。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 与原文相反原文称男性比女性更常有此类行为 men tend to exhibit more of these negative behaviors than women，并非“男女都有”；Both men and women were found to engage in negative behaviors 与原文相悖，且非“代入变量后”的结果。
B) 偷换概念原文只说晚订不必然是异常行为 booking relatively late is a sign of abnormal behavior 的免责说明，并非“男女都不视晚订为坏行为”，更不是代入变量后的结果。
C) ✓ 正确the gender gap disappears ↔ The gender difference in airfare expenses no longer existed The gender difference in airfare expenses no longer existed 与预判“性别差距消失”完全对应，锁定该项。
D) 偷换概念原文是差距“消失” the gender gap disappears，The gender gap tended to narrow to a significant degree 说成“显著缩小”，程度被改弱，与原文不符。
questions.quote: It only means that the gender gap disappears when we plug in the negative reciprocity variable.

options.text: Both men and women were found to engage in negative behaviors.
Neither men nor women viewed booking late as a bad behavior.
The gender difference in airfare expenses no longer existed.
The gender gap tended to narrow to a significant degree.

questions.prompt: What did prior research on negative reciprocity among workers find?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
先前关于员工消极互惠的研究发现了什么?
A) 它对工作场所的危害可能比对员工的危害更大。
B) 它加剧了工作场所的男女分化。
C) 它在多个方面被证明是适得其反的。
D) 它可能导致劳资冲突的增加。
**判型** 题干 What did prior research ... find 问先前研究发现了什么，是文中已陈述的内容，属事实提取。
**拆句** 主干 What did prior research on negative reciprocity among workers find，find 是问点动词；among workers 限定研究对象，prior 限定时间，定位时认准“先前的、关于工人的”那项研究。
**定位** 先前关于工人负向回报的研究发现，它会导致员工积极性、业绩、职场士气与文化的下降。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 无中生有原文未比较“对职场”与“对员工”谁伤害更大；do more harm to the workplace than to employees 凭空造出一个原文没有的比较。
B) 张冠李戴“造成职场男女分化”是后文 P6 对本研究结果的引申，不是先前研究的发现；contributes to the male-female divide in the workplace 张冠李戴。
C) ✓ 正确it can result in lower employee motivation, business performance and workplace morale(士气) and culture↔ It proves to be counterproductive in a number of ways counterproductive in a number of ways 正是预判“多方面负面下降”的抽象概括，锁定该项。
D) 无中生有原文后果是积极性、业绩、士气、文化下降，无“劳资冲突加剧”；increasing labor- management conflicts 是文中没有的新后果。
questions.quote: Prior research on negative reciprocity among workers found that it can result in lower employee motivation, business performance and workplace morale(士气) and culture.

options.text: It can do more harm to the workplace than to employees.
It contributes to the male-female divide in the workplace.
It proves to be counterproductive in a number of ways.
It can result in increasing labor-management conflicts.

questions.prompt: What does the author emphasize about their analysis in the last paragraph?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者在最后一段强调了他们分析的什么内容?
A) 它可以帮助公司显著增加节省。
B) 它可以适当地促进公司的业务绩效。
C) 它可以将女性的预订做法转化为男性的行为。
D) 它可以增强大型跨国公司的竞争力。
**判型** 题干 What does the author emphasize about their analysis in the last paragraph 锁定最后一段、问其强调点，答案在段内明写，属细节。
**拆句** 主干 What does the author emphasize about their analysis，emphasize 后 about引出强调对象 their analysis；末尾 in the last paragraph 限定到最后一段，定位即在该段内。
**定位** 我们的分析表明，女性的早订每年可为一家拥有两万名常旅客的大型跨国公司带来一百万美元的节省。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确early booking by women can translate into savings of $1 million a year↔It can help companies increase their savings significantly help companies increase their savings significantly 正是预判“早订为公司省大钱”的概括，锁定该项。
B) 张冠李戴“提升业绩”是第 5 段先前研究提到的 business performance，不是末段分析所强调的内容；contribute to companies' business performance 张冠李戴到本段。
C) 偷换概念原文 translate into 的宾语是 savings（节省），不是“把女性的做法变成男性的行为”；translate women's booking practice into men's behavior 借同一动词曲解原意。
D) 过度推断原文只谈为公司省钱，未涉及“提升竞争力”；enhance large multinational companies' competitiveness 是过度引申出的新结论。
questions.quote: Our analysis suggests early booking by women can translate into savings of $1 million a year for a large multinational company with 20,000 regular travelers.

options.text: It can help companies increase their savings significantly.
It can duly contribute to companies' business performance.
It can translate women's booking practice into men's behavior.
It can enhance large multinational companies' competitiveness.

title: One of my bad habits is saying "busy"…

sentences.text: One of my bad habits is saying "busy" when people ask me how I'm doing.
Sometimes it's because I actually am busy, but other times it's because that's what I think I'm supposed to say.
That's what important people say.
That's what people who get promoted say.
But working long hours doesn't drive better results.
Never taking a vacation won't lead to a promotion.
So why are we so proud to talk about how busy we are all the time?

passage.translation: 我的一个坏习惯是当别人问我过得怎么样时，我会说"很忙"。有时是因为我确实很忙，但其他时候是因为我认为自己应该这么说。重要的人都这么说。获得晋升的人都这么说。但长时间工作并不能带来更好的结果。从不休假也不会带来晋升。那么我们为什么总是如此自豪地谈论自己有多忙呢？

sentences.text: In 2016, researchers from Columbia, Harvard, and Georgetown conducted a study to figure it out.
They found busy people are perceived to be of high status, and interestingly, these status attributions are heavily influenced by our own beliefs about social mobility.
In other words, the more we believe that one has the opportunity for success based on hard work, the more we tend to think that people who skip leisure and work all the time are of higher standing.

passage.translation: 2016年，来自哥伦比亚大学、哈佛大学和乔治城大学的研究人员进行了一项研究来弄清这个问题。他们发现忙碌的人被认为具有高地位，有趣的是，这些地位归因在很大程度上受到我们自己关于社会流动性的信念的影响。换句话说，我们越相信一个人有机会通过努力工作获得成功，我们就越倾向于认为那些放弃休闲并一直工作的人地位更高。

sentences.text: That's why we feel like we have to appear busy, and there's a real perception that if someone is knee-deep in meetings, emails, and stress, then they're probably a big deal.
This culture of busyness is making it hard for employees to find work-life balance.
According to a recent study, one in five highly engaged employees is at risk of burnout(精疲力竭).

passage.translation: 这就是为什么我们觉得必须显得很忙，而且确实存在一种看法，即如果某人深陷于会议、邮件和压力之中，那么他们很可能是个重要人物。这种忙碌文化正使员工难以找到工作与生活的平衡。根据最近的一项研究，五分之一的高度投入的员工面临精疲力竭的风险。

sentences.text: Personally, I'm going to stop saying "busy" when people ask me how I am.
It sounds self- righteous(自以为是的) and sets the wrong tone.
Phrases like "I have limited access to email" and "I'll respond as soon as I get back" sound like you're being held against your will from working as opposed to making the most of your time off.

passage.translation: 就我个人而言，当别人问我过得怎么样时，我不会再说"很忙"了。这听起来自以为是，而且定下了错误的基调。像"我查看邮件的机会有限"和"我一回来就会尽快回复"这样的措辞听起来像是你被迫不能工作，而不是在充分利用你的休息时间。

sentences.text: That's why we recently launched the Out of Office Email Generator, a free tool you can use before your next long weekend or trip.
You can share loud and proud that you won't be checking email until you're back.
Managers need to think twice about emailing their teams on the weekend and talking about how busy they are.
Leaders should take time off themselves and encourage employees to do the same.

passage.translation: 这就是为什么我们最近推出了外出邮件生成器，这是一个免费工具，你可以在下一个长周末或旅行之前使用。你可以大声而自豪地分享你在回来之前不会查看邮件。管理者需要三思而后行，不要在周末给团队发邮件，也不要谈论自己有多忙。领导者应该自己抽时间休息，并鼓励员工也这样做。

groups.instructions: There are 2 passages in this section.Each passage is followed by some questions or unfinished statements.For each of them there are four choices marked A),B),C)and D).You should decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre.

questions.prompt: What is a reason for the author to be in the habit of saying "busy" when asked how he is doing?
questions.explanation:
**答案** A （细节题）
**题目译文**
当被问及近况时,作者习惯性地回答"忙"的一个原因是什么?
A) 他只是效仿成功人士的做法。
B) 他实际上为自己忙碌而感到自豪。
C) 他认为每个人都应该全身心投入工作。
D) 他相信忙碌能确保取得成就。
**判型** 题干 What is a reason for the author to be in the habit 问一个具体可在原文找到的原因，答案直接落在某句话里。
**拆句** 主干是 What is a reason，后接 for 引导的逻辑主语 for the author to be in the habit of saying "busy"，再用 when 状语 when asked how he is doing 限定情境。结构清晰，无陷阱，只需读成“作者在被问近况时爱说忙，原因是什么”。
**定位** 有时是因为我确实忙，但另一些时候是因为那是我以为自己应该说的话。重要人物就这么说，得到晋升的人就这么说。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) ✓ 正确That's what important people say. That's what people who get promoted say ↔follows successful people's example预判“效仿成功者的做法”与 He just follows successful people's example 完全吻合，故锁定此项。
B) 张冠李戴原文末尾反问 why are we so proud to talk about how busy we are 是带反思的反问，并非作者承认自己“为忙而自豪”，选项把反问当作者的真实态度，属张冠李戴。
C) 无中生有原文从未说作者认为“人人都应投身工作”；相反作者反思忙碌文化，everyone should be devoted to work 在文中无任何依据，属无中生有。
D) 与原文相反原文明说 working long hours doesn't drive better results，即忙碌并不保证成就；busyness ensures accomplishments 与原文意思正好相反。
questions.quote: Sometimes it's because I actually am busy, but other times it's because that's what I think I'm supposed to say. That's what important people say. That's what people who get promoted say.

options.text: He just follows successful people's example.
He is actually proud to be fully occupied.
He thinks everyone should be devoted to work.
He believes busyness ensures accomplishments.

questions.prompt: Why do we tend to think that busy people are of high status?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
我们为什么倾向于认为忙碌的人地位高?
A) 我们的地位可归因于我们的社会流动性。
B) 我们坚信努力工作会带来成功。
C) 我们自己的成功机会从来都不容易获得。
D) 我们发现很少有地位高的人有时间休闲。
**判型** 题干 Why do we tend to think that busy people are of high status 问的是原文研究已经给出的解释，属可定位的明确事实。
**拆句** Why do we tend to think that busy people are of high status 中 think 后接 that 宾语从句 busy people are of high status。tend to 是“倾向于”，不是绝对，读时不必纠结，整句即“我们为什么倾向认为忙人地位高”。
**定位** 换句话说，我们越是相信一个人靠努力工作就有成功的机会，就越倾向于认为那些放弃休闲、一直工作的人地位更高。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 偷换概念原文说我们对社会流动的信念影响了地位判断，并非“地位可归因于社会流动”；status can be attributed to our social mobility 把“信念影响判断”偷换成“地位源于流动”，颠倒了关系。
B) ✓ 正确the more we believe that one has the opportunity for success based on hard work ↔We hold the belief that hard work leads to success预判的“努力工作通向成功的信念”与 hold the belief that hard work leads to success逐字对应，故锁定此项。
C) 无中生有原文谈的是“相信有机会成功”，从未说“我们自己的成功机会来之不易”；opportunity for success never comes easily 在文中无依据，属无中生有。
D) 答非所问题问“为何觉得忙人地位高”，few people of high status have time for leisure 是描述高地位者的现象，没回答原因，且原文也未这么说，属答非所问兼无中生有。
questions.quote: In other words, the more we believe that one has the opportunity for success based on hard work, the more we tend to think that people who skip leisure and work all the time are of higher standing.

options.text: Our status can be attributed to our social mobility.
We hold the belief that hard work leads to success.
Our own opportunity for success never comes easily.
We find few people of high status have time for leisure.

questions.prompt: What do we learn about the culture of busyness from a recent study?
questions.explanation:
**答案** D （细节题）
**题目译文**
从最近的一项研究中,我们对忙碌文化了解到什么?
A) 它使员工陷入无休止的会议、邮件和压力之中。
B) 它迫使约20%的员工表现得总是很忙。
C) 它扭曲了许多员工对什么是满意生活的信念。
D) 它对许多忙碌员工的幸福感造成很大伤害。
**判型** 题干 What do we learn about the culture of busyness from a recent study 问一项研究的具体结论，答案在原文摆着。
**拆句** What do we learn about the culture of busyness from a recent study：主干 What do we learn，about 短语限定话题，from 短语点明信息来源。三段修饰平铺，无陷阱。
**定位** 这种忙碌文化正使员工难以找到工作与生活的平衡。根据近期一项研究，每五名高投入员工中就有一名面临精疲力竭的风险。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 张冠李戴meetings, emails and stress 出自上一段对“显得忙的人”的描写 knee-deep in meetings, emails, and stress，并非“近期研究”的结论；题问研究发现什么，此项把别处内容搬来，属张冠李戴。
B) 偷换概念原文 one in five（约20%）指的是“面临精疲力竭风险”的人，compels some 20%of employees to appear always busy 把这20%偷换成“被迫显得忙”，数据所指对象被改。
C) 无中生有原文未提忙碌文化“扭曲了员工对满意生活的认知”；distorts…belief of what a satisfying life is 在文中找不到对应句，属无中生有。
D) ✓ 正确one in five highly engaged employees is at risk of burnout ↔It does much harm to many busy employees' well-being预判“危害员工身心”与 does much harm to many busy employees' well-being 吻合，故锁定此项。
questions.quote: This culture of busyness is making it hard for employees to find work-life balance. According to a recent study, one in five highly engaged employees is at risk of burnout(精疲力竭).

options.text: It places employees in endless meetings, emails and stress.
It compels some 20% of employees to appear always busy.
It distorts many employees' belief of what a satisfying life is.
It does much harm to many busy employees' well-being.

questions.prompt: What do such utterances as "I have limited access to email" sound like according to the author?
questions.explanation:
**答案** C （细节题）
**题目译文**
根据作者的说法,像"我查看邮件的机会有限"这样的话听起来像什么?
A) 某人太忙而无法及时查看所有邮件。
B) 某人反对当前盛行的工作文化。
C) 某人被环境所迫而停止工作。
D) 某人只是在享受他们的休息时间。
**判型** 题干 What do such utterances as … sound like according to the author 问作者认为这类话听起来像什么，答案是原文作者的明确评价。
**拆句** What do such utterances as "I have limited access to email" sound like according to the author：such…as 举例结构，sound like 是“听起来像”。注意 sound like 后省略了表语，正是要补的答案；according to the author 提示以作者原话为准。
**定位** “我邮件查看受限”“我一回来就回复”这类话听起来像是你被违背意愿地拦着不让工作，而不是在充分利用你的休假时光。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 答非所问题问这类话“听起来像”什么（即给人的印象），too busy to check all emails in time描述的是字面情境而非作者说的负面印象；作者的重点是“像被迫”，此项答非所问。
B) 过度推断作者只说这类话“听起来像被迫”、设错了基调，并未说它表示“反对主流工作文化”；opposed to the prevailing work culture 是读者强行拔高，属过度推断。
C) ✓ 正确you're being held against your will from working ↔One is forced by circumstances to stop working预判“被迫无法工作”与 forced by circumstances to stop working 吻合，故锁定此项。
D) 与原文相反原文用 as opposed to 把“被迫不能工作”与“充分享受休假”对立，明说这类话听起来“不是”在享受休假；simply enjoying their time off work 恰是被否定的那一面，正好相反。
questions.quote: Phrases like "I have limited access to email" and "I'll respond as soon as I get back" sound like you're being held against your will from working as opposed to making the most of your time off.

options.text: One is too busy to check all emails in time.
One is opposed to the prevailing work culture.
One is forced by circumstances to stop working.
One is simply enjoying their time off work.

questions.prompt: Why did the author and his colleagues launch the Out of Office Email Generator?
questions.explanation:
**答案** B （细节题）
**题目译文**
作者和他的同事为什么推出"不在办公室邮件生成器"?
A) 使忙碌的员工能够花更少的时间查看邮件。
B) 确保员工和雇主都真正拥有休息时间。
C) 阻止管理者谈论他们的团队通常有多忙。
D) 鼓励雇主和员工都及时回复邮件。
**判型** 题干 Why did the author and his colleagues launch the Out of Office Email Generator 问一个具体动作的目的，答案藏在原文相应段落。
**拆句** Why did the author and his colleagues launch the Out of Office Email Generator：主干 Why did the author and his colleagues launch，宾语是专有工具名。一般疑问语序无陷阱，落脚在“为何推出这个工具”。
**定位** 这就是我们最近推出“Out of Office Email Generator”这款免费工具的原因，你可以在下个长周末或出行前使用它。你可以大方而自豪地宣告，回来之前不会查邮件。管理者需要三思，别在周末给团队发邮件、别炫耀自己多忙。领导者应自己带头休假，并鼓励员工同样如此。
questions.tip:
**选项**
A) 以偏概全“少花时间查邮件”只是手段、且只覆盖员工一方，原文目的是让双方“真正休假”；spend less time checking emails 把整体目的缩成局部手段，属以偏概全。
B) ✓ 正确You can share loud and proud that you won't be checking email until you're back↔To ensure employees as well as employers truly have time off Leaders should take time off themselves and encourage employees to do the same↔employers as well as employees预判“让员工和雇主都真正休假”与 employees as well as employers truly have time off 完整对应、双方都覆盖，故锁定此项。
C) 以偏概全“别谈论团队多忙”只是原文对管理者诸多建议之一 talking about how busy they are，不是推出工具的总目的；stop managers from talking about how busy… 拿一个分支当全部，属以偏概全。
D) 与原文相反原文呼吁休假时“不查/不发邮件”，answer emails promptly（及时回邮件）与原文意图正好相反。
questions.quote: That's why we recently launched the Out of Office Email Generator, a free tool you can use before your next long weekend or trip. You can share loud and proud that you won't be checking email until you're back. Managers need to think twice about emailing their teams on the weekend and talking about how busy they are. Leaders should take time off themselves and encourage employees to do the same.

options.text: To enable busy employees to spend less time checking emails.
To ensure employees as well as employers truly have time off.
To stop managers from talking about how busy their teams usually are.
To encourage both employers and employees to answer emails promptly.

title: Exercising for just 10 minutes a week is…

sentences.text: Exercising for just 10 minutes a week is linked to a longer life, according to a new study published in The British Journal of Sports Medicine.

passage.translation: 根据发表在《英国运动医学杂志》上的一项新研究，每周仅锻炼10分钟就与更长的寿命有关。

sentences.text: Several recent studies have found that even low-intensity exercise, done for a short amount of time, can have a meaningful (26)____ on health.
Still, the idea that exercising for just 10 minutes a week may be enough to increase your lifespan is novel.
It's also somewhat (27)____ , since the federal physical activity guidelines recommend getting at least 75 minutes of vigorous exercise or 150 minutes of (28)____ exercise each week.

passage.translation: 最近的几项研究发现，即使是短时间的低强度运动，也能对健康产生有意义的影响。尽管如此，每周仅锻炼10分钟就足以延长寿命的观点仍然是新颖的。这也有些争议,因为联邦身体活动指南建议每周至少进行75分钟的剧烈运动或150分钟的中等强度运动。

sentences.text: The study was based on data from more than 88,000 U.S. adults who (29)____ in the National Health Interview Survey between 1997 and 2008.

passage.translation: 该研究基于1997年至2008年间参加全国健康访问调查的88000多名美国成年人的数据。

sentences.text: Contrary to some research that has found an (30)____ limit to the amount of exercise that is healthy, the researchers found that there was (31)____ no limit to the longevity(⻓寿) benefits of exercise.
Even the small group of people who got 10 times the amount of exercise recommended by the federal government had a 46% lower (32)____ of death than the least active group.

passage.translation: 与一些发现健康运动量存在上限的研究相反，研究人员发现运动对长寿的益处似乎没有上限。即使是运动量达到联邦政府建议量10倍的一小部分人,其死亡风险也比最不活跃群体低46%。

sentences.text: Still, observational studies like this one cannot prove cause and effect; they can only find (33)____.
The researchers also were not able to (34)____ for certain lifestyle factors that could affect lifespan, including dietary habits and changes in physical activity over time.
Despite these (35)____ , the study's results are yet another indication of the power of physical activity, even in small amounts.

passage.translation: 然而,像这样的观察性研究无法证明因果关系;它们只能发现模式。研究人员也无法对某些可能影响寿命的生活方式因素进行调整,包括饮食习惯和身体活动随时间的变化。尽管存在这些局限性,该研究结果仍然是身体活动力量的又一个证明,即使是少量的运动。

groups.instructions: In this section, there is a passage with ten blanks. You are required to select one word for each blank from a list of choices given in a word bank following the passage. Read the passage through carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not use any of the words in the bank more than once.
groups.content:
Exercising for just 10 minutes a week is linked to a longer life, according to a new study published in The British Journal of Sports Medicine.

Several recent studies have found that even low-intensity exercise, done for a short amount of time, can have a meaningful {{26}} on health. Still, the idea that exercising for just 10 minutes a week may be enough to increase your lifespan is novel. It's also somewhat {{27}} , since the federal physical activity guidelines recommend getting at least 75 minutes of vigorous exercise or 150 minutes of {{28}} exercise each week.

The study was based on data from more than 88,000 U.S. adults who {{29}} in the National Health Interview Survey between 1997 and 2008.

Contrary to some research that has found an {{30}} limit to the amount of exercise that is healthy, the researchers found that there was {{31}} no limit to the longevity(⻓寿) benefits of exercise. Even the small group of people who got 10 times the amount of exercise recommended by the federal government had a 46% lower {{32}} of death than the least active group.

Still, observational studies like this one cannot prove cause and effect; they can only find {{33}}. The researchers also were not able to {{34}} for certain lifestyle factors that could affect lifespan, including dietary habits and changes in physical activity over time. Despite these {{35}} , the study's results are yet another indication of the power of physical activity, even in small amounts.

options.text: adjust
participated
alter
patterns
approximately
populated
controversial
risk
coordinates
seemingly
impact
type
limitations
upper
moderate

questions.explanation:
**答案** F) impact 名词
**词性槽** 形容词 meaningful 后、a 后缺名词
**依据** have an impact on 是固定搭配，意为"对……产生影响" even low-intensity exercise, done for a short amount of time, can have a meaningful__(26)__ on health——have a(n) impact on health 即"对健康有影响"，搭配标准、语义贴切：低强度运动对健康有切实影响，正是本段要点。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
N) type type 不搭 meaningful…on，语义也不通a meaningful type on health（"对健康的一种有意义的类型"）讲不通，type 也不与 on 构成"对……的"含义；这里要表达的是运动对健康的"作用/影响"。

questions.explanation:
**答案** D) controversial 形容词
**词性槽** 系动词 is + somewhat 之后作表语，需形容词
**依据** 因与官方指南冲突，故"有争议" It's also somewhat __(27)__, since the federal physical activity guidelines recommend getting at least 75 minutes of vigorous exercise or 150 minutes of __(28)__ exercise——since 给出理由："10分钟即可"的说法和官方推荐的几十上百分钟相去甚远，自然"有些争议"。controversial 与这层让步/对立逻辑严丝合缝。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
H) moderate moderate 义为"适度的"，与 since 的争议逻辑不合，且它另有归宿moderate 表"中等/适度"，无法解释"because 它和官方指南相左"这层因果；况且 moderate更贴 28 空的 moderate exercise（适度运动）固定搭配，应留给 28 题。

questions.explanation:
**答案** H) moderate 形容词
**词性槽** 名词 exercise 前作定语，需形容词
**依据** 与 vigorous 对照，moderate exercise 即"适度/中等强度运动" at least 75 minutes of vigorous exercise or 150 minutes of __(28)__ exercise——vigorous（剧烈）对应 75 分钟，or 后强度更低的运动要更多时长 150 分钟，正是moderate（中等强度）。moderate exercise 是健康指南里的固定表达，与 vigorous 形成强度对照。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
O) upper upper 不修饰运动强度，且它另有归宿upper 意为"上面的/上限的"，不能说 upper exercise；况且 upper 更贴 30 空的 upper limit（上限）固定搭配，应留给 30 题。这里要的是与 vigorous 对照的强度词。

questions.explanation:
**答案** I) participated 动词
**词性槽** 关系代词 who 后缺谓语，要填动词且用过去式
**依据** participate in 是固定搭配，意为"参与某调查"空后紧跟 in：who __(29)__ in the National Health Interview Survey，participate in 正是"参加（一项调查/活动）"的标准搭配，主语是 88,000 名成年人，语义完全契合"参加了全国健康访谈调查"。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
A) adjust 搭配与语义都不对adjust 意为"调整"，常搭 adjust for/to，不能说"人 adjust in 一项调查"，语义上成年人"调整进调查"也讲不通。
B) alter 义为"改变"，与"参加调查"无关alter 是"改动、改变"，"成年人改变了这项调查"既不合常理也不搭 in，与上下文的研究取样语境冲突。

questions.explanation:
**答案** O) upper 形容词
**词性槽** 名词 limit 前、an 后作定语，需形容词
**依据** upper limit（上限）是固定搭配，呼应"运动量过多是否仍健康" Contrary to some research that has found an __(30)__ limit to the amount of exercise that is healthy——upper limit 即"上限"：有研究认为健康运动量存在一个上限，而本研究发现"几乎没有上限"，前后正成对比，upper limit 搭配地道、逻辑契合。

**答案** M) seemingly 副词
**词性槽** 修饰 no limit 的程度/口吻，需副词
**依据** 对"无上限"这一惊人结论留有余地，"看似"无上限there was __(31)__ no limit to the longevity benefits of exercise——"运动延寿几乎没有上限"是个强结论，作者用 seemingly（看似、貌似）留有余地，既转述发现又不把话说满，符合科普文严谨口吻。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
C) approximately approximately 修饰数字，不修饰"no limit" approximately"大约"通常修饰具体数量（approximately 75 minutes），用来修饰"no limit"这种非数值判断不通顺；这里要的是表"看似"的语气副词，而非约数副词。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 C) —— approximately 词性也对，易与 seemingly 混淆。两者都是副词，there was __(31)__ no limit，考生可能想"approximately no limit（大约没上限）"；但 approximately 只修饰数字，修饰"no limit"这种结论不通。防坑：先问空修饰的是数字还是判断，约数副词只贴数字。

questions.explanation:
**答案** L) risk 名词
**词性槽** 形容词 lower 之后、of death 之前缺名词
**依据** risk of death（死亡风险）是固定搭配，且呼应"延寿"主题had a 46% lower __(32)__ of death——risk of death 即"死亡风险"，运动多的人死亡风险低 46%，正好支撑全文"运动有益寿命"的主旨，搭配与语义双双契合。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
N) type type of death 不合此处逻辑type of death 是"死亡的类型"，无法用"lower"来比较高低，也和"运动延寿、降低死亡可能"的语境对不上；这里要的是可量化升降的"风险"。

questions.explanation:
**答案** J) patterns 名词
**词性槽** 动词 find 后缺宾语，需复数名词
**依据** 与"不能证因果、只能发现关联"形成对照，patterns 即"关联型态" observational studies like this one cannot prove cause and effect; they can only find__(33)__——分号前后是对比：不能证明因果，只能找出"模式/关联"。patterns 正指观察研究能看到的相关规律，与 cause and effect 恰成对照。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
E) coordinates 义为"坐标"，与研究方法语境无关coordinates 多指数学"坐标"，放进"观察研究只能发现什么"的语境毫无意义，与 cause and effect 的对照逻辑也搭不上。

questions.explanation:
**答案** A) adjust 动词
**词性槽** 情态 able to 之后缺动词原形
**依据** adjust for 是研究术语，意为"校正、排除……因素的影响" were not able to __(34)__ for certain lifestyle factors that could affect lifespan——adjust for（在统计中）"对某些因素加以校正/控制"是研究方法的固定说法，承接上文"该研究有局限"：研究者没能排除饮食、运动量变化等干扰因素，逻辑严丝合缝。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
B) alteralter 不搭 for，且语义相反alter 是"改变"，常作及物动词（alter something），不与 for 构成"校正"义；说"研究者没能改变这些因素"不合科研语境，这里要的是"校正/控制"而非"改变"。
**易错**
最具迷惑性的错误词是 B) —— alter 与 adjust 同为"改变"义动词，极易误选。两词都是动词、词义都沾"改动"，考生易凭眼熟选 alter；但本句要的是科研术语 adjust for（校正/排除因素），alter 既不搭 for 又语义偏"改变"。防坑：动词空务必把空后的介词（for）和候选连读，搭不通的立刻淘汰。

questions.explanation:
**答案** G) limitations 名词
**词性槽** 介词 Despite + these 之后缺名词，且要复数
**依据** 承接上文研究的两处不足，these 指代"这些局限"上文刚说研究 cannot prove cause and effect 又 were not able to __(34)__ for certain lifestyle factors，这些都是研究的不足；Despite these limitations（尽管有这些局限）正好回指这两处缺陷，转折后再肯定研究价值，逻辑顺畅。
questions.tip:
**竞争词**
J) patterns 义为"模式"，指代不上前文的"缺陷" patterns 是"模式、规律"，前文讲的是研究做不到什么（局限），不是某种模式；说"尽管有这些模式"与上下文转折逻辑不符。

title: A Club Where Lions Dance and Traditions Take Root

passage.label: A

sentences.text: The first thing you notice in the staircase to the fourth-floor studio on Canal Street in Manhattan, New York, is the measured thumping(嘭嘭声) coming from behind a metal door.
Just beyond the entrance, large lion masks were twisting and turning to the drum-beat.
On a recent Friday evening, the teenagers made their way across the studio floor as they practiced Chinese lion dancing.

passage.translation: 在纽约曼哈顿Canal街通往四楼工作室的楼梯上,你首先注意到的是从一扇金属门后传来的有节奏的嘭嘭声。刚过入口处,巨大的狮头正随着鼓点扭动翻转。在最近的一个周五晚上,这些青少年在工作室地板上穿行,练习中国舞狮。

passage.label: B

sentences.text: "You want to play in a circle," Victor Fong, aged 24, told his students at the New York Chinese Freemasons Athletic Club.
"Take it slow and do it again."

The dance group, made up of 60 members, performs throughout the year but was now preparing for its biggest events, Chinese Lunar New Year celebrations, which will begin on Saturday and conclude on February 15.
Teenagers comprise about half of the group, many of whom began lion dancing at the age of 14.

About 100 current and past members of the dance group—which has been performing since 1956—will be among the 220 groups marching through Chinatown in Manhattan for the 18th Lunar New Year Parade on February 5.

passage.translation: "你们要围成一个圈来表演,"24岁的Victor Fong在纽约中华公所体育会对他的学生们说道。"慢慢来,再做一遍。"这个由60名成员组成的舞狮团全年都有演出,但现在正在为其最大的活动——中国农历新年庆祝活动做准备,庆祝活动将于周六开始并于2月15日结束。青少年约占该团体的一半,其中许多人从14岁就开始舞狮。这个自1956年以来一直在表演的舞狮团约有100名现任和往届成员,将加入2月5日在曼哈顿唐人街游行的220个团体,参加第18届农历新年游行。

passage.label: C

sentences.text: Mr.
Fong has been involved in the organization since he was 15 and began teaching lion dancing three years ago.
But the club also acts as a recreation center and safe haven(庇护所) for teenagers, with video games readily available.
As many as 20 students show up after school.
"The basic requirement for hanging out here is you have to learn how to lion dance," Mr.
Fong said.
While that is not a formal requirement for being a member, everyone finds a way to participate in the Lunar New Year Parade, whether it's by dancing, carrying a flag or beating a drum.

passage.translation: Fong先生从15岁起就参与这个组织,三年前开始教授舞狮。但这个俱乐部也充当着青少年的娱乐中心和庇护所,随时可以玩电子游戏。放学后多达20名学生会来这里。"在这里闲逛的基本要求是你必须学会舞狮,"Fong先生说。虽然这不是成为会员的正式要求,但每个人都会找到参与农历新年游行的方式,无论是通过舞狮、举旗还是打鼓。

passage.label: D

sentences.text: Alvin Chau, aged 26, is an environmental consultant by day and a lion dancer on weekends.
He has been a club member for 10 years and joined because of an interest in lion dance.
"We're a big family," he said, shaking hands with other members as they walked through the door.
"You know everyone."

passage.translation: 26岁的Alvin Chau白天是一名环境顾问,周末则是一名舞狮者。他已经是俱乐部成员10年了,因为对舞狮感兴趣而加入。"我们是一个大家庭,"他说道,当其他成员走进门时与他们握手。"你认识每一个人。"

passage.label: E

sentences.text: It is believed that the lion dance began in the third century.
Stories vary about how lion dancing came to be, but most of them include a monster named Nian who would terrorize a village.
The villagers finally banded together and scared the beast away with firecrackers(爆竹) and drums.
While lions are not native to China, some versions of the story include the villagers creating a monster of their own in the shape of a lion to fight off the beast.

passage.translation: 据信舞狮始于三世纪。关于舞狮如何产生的故事各不相同,但大多数都包含一个名叫年的怪兽,它会恐吓村庄。村民们最终团结起来,用爆竹和鼓声吓跑了这头野兽。虽然狮子并非中国本土动物,但该故事的某些版本包括村民们创造了一个狮子形状的怪兽来击退野兽。

passage.label: F

sentences.text: Today, the dancers travel across Chinatown going from business to business to bring good luck for the coming year.
The new year—according to the Chinese lunar calendar—will begin on Saturday and marks the Year of the Rooster(鸡年), which is thought to be a symbol of positivity.
"It's almost like the dark night is ending and the sun is coming up," said Ya Yung Teng, the digital collections coordinator for the Museum of Chinese in America.
"It's hopeful that we're going to have a new day."
Roosters and chickens are not particularly strong creatures, Ms.
Teng said, but they are numerous.
"In a way," she said, the rooster "stands for 'We the People.'"

passage.translation: 如今,舞狮者穿行于唐人街,挨家挨户为来年带来好运。根据中国农历,新年将于周六开始,标志着鸡年的到来,鸡被认为是积极向上的象征。"这几乎就像黑夜即将结束,太阳正在升起,"美国华人博物馆数字馆藏协调员Ya Yung Teng说。"这让人充满希望,我们将迎来新的一天。"Teng女士说,公鸡和鸡并不是特别强壮的生物,但它们数量众多。"从某种意义上说,"她说,公鸡"代表着'我们人民'。"

passage.label: G

sentences.text: The lion head and tail are operated by two people.
As one person controls the head, a second follows under a train of fabric representing the body.
The dancers move in harmony as they imitate the animal's natural movements in the wild, including the aggressiveness of an attack.
A lion head figure weighs under 10 pounds and sits squarely on the dancer's shoulders.
Inside, the dancer manipulates strings that open and close the lion's eyes, shake its ears and open its mouth to reveal a fire-orange tongue.

passage.translation: 狮头和狮尾由两个人操作。一个人控制狮头,另一个人跟在代表身体的布料下面。舞者和谐地移动,模仿动物在野外的自然动作,包括攻击时的攻击性。一个狮头重量不到10磅,稳稳地架在舞者肩膀上。在里面,舞者操纵绳子来睁闭狮子的眼睛、摇动耳朵并张开嘴巴露出火橙色的舌头。

passage.label: H

sentences.text: "A good lion dancer will imitate a living creature," said Karlin Chan, aged 59, who heads the athletic club's community public relations.
"I started lion dancing when I was a kid," he said.
"Chinatown was much smaller then and it was a celebration with fireworks and firecrackers, which added a lot of flavor and meaning to it."

passage.translation: "一个好的舞狮者会模仿一个活生生的生物,"59岁的Karlin Chan说,他是体育会社区公关负责人。"我小时候就开始舞狮了,"他说。"那时唐人街要小得多,庆祝活动有烟花和爆竹,这为它增添了许多风味和意义。"

passage.label: I

sentences.text: Mr.
Chan buys a new lion head each year when he travels to China.
A head costs about $1,500.
"If you want the good stuff, the quality, you have to see it for yourself," he said.
"I'll inspect the product before we put it in the container and ship it over."
Mr.
Chan, who has been involved with the club for nearly 50 years, said that passing the dance from one generation to the next was vital.
"You need to pass on the traditions and the culture, and this is a part of our culture," he said.
"It's a great way to promote cultural understanding and exchange; we welcome that."

passage.translation: Chan先生每年去中国时都会买一个新狮头。一个狮头大约要1500美元。"如果你想要好东西、高质量的,你必须亲自去看,"他说。"在我们把它装进集装箱运过来之前,我会检查产品。"Chan先生参与俱乐部活动已近50年,他说将舞蹈从一代传给下一代至关重要。"你需要传承传统和文化,而这是我们文化的一部分,"他说。"这是促进文化理解和交流的好方法;我们欢迎这样做。"

passage.label: J

sentences.text: For Sara Pore, aged 17, another club member, lion dance is more than just tradition; it provides a creative outlet.
"Lion dancing started 2,000 years ago—that's incredible," she said.
"But what makes you a competent lion dancer is that there's a sense of imagination involved.
Lion dancing teaches competence in leadership because of this.
You're constantly forced to push yourself past your limit."

passage.translation: 对于另一位俱乐部成员、17岁的Sara Pore来说,舞狮不仅仅是传统;它提供了一个创造性的出口。"舞狮始于2000年前——这太不可思议了,"她说。"但让你成为一名称职的舞狮者的是其中涉及的想象力。舞狮因此教会人们领导能力的胜任力。你被不断迫使突破自己的极限。"

passage.label: K

sentences.text: Back at rehearsal(排练), Just in Le, aged 18, tied a red ribbon around his waist to practice jumping.
The dancers use the ribbons to pull themselves up over their partners' heads.
The room's ceilings are too low to wear the lion heads for jumping practice, so once up on his partner's head, Mr.
Le held out his arms as if in offering.

passage.translation: 回到排练现场,18岁的Justin Le在腰间系上一条红丝带练习跳跃。舞者们用丝带将自己拉过搭档的头顶。房间的天花板太低,无法戴着狮头练习跳跃,所以一旦站到搭档头顶上,Le先生就伸出双臂,仿佛在献礼。

passage.label: L

sentences.text: Mr.
Le comes by the dance as a legacy(传承).
"I was born into it," Mr.
Le said, noting that his uncle and father were club members.
"Growing up, I would always watch my family and see the lion dance, and I slowly grew interested in it."
By the age of 14, he was fully enrolled in the athletic club's lion dance group.
"I value my culture and tradition, being Chinese or Asian-American.
I have a lot of pride in that," he said.
"I want to contribute and give back to the community."

passage.translation: Le先生的舞蹈是一种传承。"我生来就接触它,"Le先生说,并指出他的叔叔和父亲都是俱乐部成员。"在成长过程中,我总是看着我的家人并观看舞狮,我慢慢对它产生了兴趣。"到14岁时,他已经完全加入了体育会的舞狮团。"我珍视我的文化和传统,作为华裔或亚裔美国人。我对此深感自豪,"他说。"我想做出贡献并回馈社区。"

groups.instructions: In this section, you are going to read a passage with ten statements attached to it. Each statement contains information given in one of the paragraphs. Answer the questions by marking the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2.

title: New Formula One Chief Hopes to Grab Americans' Attention

passage.label: A

sentences.text: For the past four decades, the leader of Formula One car racing, one of the biggest annual sporting series in the world, was Bernie Ecclestone, a former motorcycle parts dealer who built it into an international presence essentially on his own.

passage.translation: 在过去四十年里,世界最大年度体育赛事之一的一级方程式赛车运动的领导者是Bernie Ecclestone,一位前摩托车零件经销商,他基本上凭一己之力将其打造成了国际性的存在。

passage.label: B

sentences.text: A skilled backroom operator who speaks without a filter, Ecclestone said often that in his opinion, the sport was at its best when he was allowed to act as "a dictator."

passage.translation: 作为一位不加过滤地直言不讳的幕后运作高手,Ecclestone经常说,在他看来,当他被允许像"独裁者"一样行事时,这项运动处于最佳状态。

passage.label: C

sentences.text: Yet now the dictator is gone.

After an American company, Liberty Media, acquired the Formula One competition recently, Chase Carey—a former executive with Fox Broadcasting Company and DirecTV who by his own admission is not a fierce racing fan—was named to replace Ecclestone and to try to renovate the organization's management, reach and ambition.

passage.translation: 然而现在这位独裁者已经离开了。在美国公司Liberty Media最近收购一级方程式赛事后,Chase Carey——Fox Broadcasting Company和DirecTV的前高管,他自己承认并非狂热的赛车迷——被任命接替Ecclestone,并试图革新该组织的管理、影响力和抱负。

passage.label: D

sentences.text: Among the goals, Carey said in an interview on Tuesday, is one that just about every global sport seems interested in chasing: increasing interest in the United States.
"People have said we're going to'Americanize' it," Carey said.
"And we're not going to do that totally.
But realistically, there are some elements of Americanization that the sport could use."

passage.translation: Carey在周二的采访中表示,目标之一是几乎每项全球性体育运动都感兴趣追求的:提高在美国的关注度。"人们说我们要将它'美国化',"Carey说。"我们不会完全那样做。但实际上,这项运动可以采用美国化的一些元素。"

passage.label: E

sentences.text: While Formula One commands enormous audiences throughout much of the world, many American sports fans know it as that other motorsport, the one that is not Nascar(纳斯卡⻋赛).

Formula One teams race far more technologically advanced vehicles around tracks all over the world—in magnificent events in places like Malaysia, Monaco, Singapore and the United Arab Emirates, and on tradition-rich tracks like Silverstone in England and Monza in Italy too.

passage.translation: 虽然一级方程式在世界大部分地区拥有庞大的观众群,但许多美国体育迷知道它是另一项赛车运动,不是纳斯卡车赛的那一项。一级方程式车队驾驶技术先进得多的赛车在世界各地的赛道上比赛——在马来西亚、摩纳哥、新加坡和阿联酋等地举办壮观的赛事,也在英国Silverstone和意大利Monza等富有传统的赛道上比赛。

passage.label: F

sentences.text: The series has an annual race in Austin, Texas.
But within "a few years," Carey said, he plans to bring another to a destination American city, like New York, Los Angeles, Miami or Las Vegas.

Carey's ambitious plan is two-fold: first, change the business model of Formula One, which he said was a "one-man show" under Ecclestone that had a largely narrow vision when it came to negotiating partnership deals; and second, alter the way fans experience the sport, both in person and remotely, so that connections between the audience and people within the series are easier to make.

passage.translation: 该系列赛事每年在德克萨斯州奥斯汀举办一场比赛。但Carey表示,他计划在"几年内"将另一场比赛带到美国的目的地城市,如纽约、洛杉矶、迈阿密或拉斯维加斯。Carey雄心勃勃的计划分为两方面:首先,改变一级方程式的商业模式,他说在Ecclestone领导下这是一场"个人秀",在谈判合作协议时视野很大程度上较为狭窄;其次,改变车迷体验这项运动的方式,无论是现场还是远程,使观众与赛事中的人之间的联系更容易建立。

passage.label: G

sentences.text: Increased digital access for fans, a more behind-the-scenes experience for broadcast viewers and innovation in areas like virtual reality—what is it like to speed around a track inside a Ferrari?—are among the possibilities.
"The sport has clearly been underserved," Carey said.
"It doesn't do anything digitally.
There's no marketing.
It doesn't tell any stories.
The goal in this is to make the fans connect to the live experience as much as possible, and the tools you have to do that, we're not using at all."

passage.translation: 为车迷增加数字化接入、为转播观众提供更多幕后体验以及在虚拟现实等领域的创新——在法拉利赛车内飞驰赛道是什么感觉?——都是可能性之一。"这项运动显然服务不足,"Carey说。"它在数字化方面什么都不做。没有营销。它不讲述任何故事。这方面的目标是让车迷尽可能多地与现场体验建立联系,而你拥有的工具,我们根本没有使用。"

passage.label: H

sentences.text: The larger question, though, is a familiar one: Is there room for Formula One in the ever-crowded sports landscape of the United States?
Opinions vary, particularly because viewing habits among consumers continue to evolve.

John Bloom, a professor at Shippensburg University who has studied American sports history, said the biggest challenge for any sport trying to increase its presence in the United States was framing itself in a way that had lasting appeal.
"Sports generally become popular in some way because they establish a narrative," Bloom said.

"When I think of motorsports in the U.S., what we all think of is Nascar, and the narrative of Nascar is sort of rural, white, working- class Americans, mostly in the South, connecting with the atmosphere of those races.
That's the narrative.
When I think of the narrative of Formula One, it's a very different kind of audience."

passage.translation: 然而,更大的问题是一个熟悉的问题:在美国日益拥挤的体育格局中,一级方程式还有空间吗?意见各不相同,特别是因为消费者的观看习惯在持续演变。Shippensburg University研究美国体育史的教授John Bloom表示,任何试图增强其在美国存在感的体育运动面临的最大挑战是以一种具有持久吸引力的方式来定位自己。"体育运动之所以能以某种方式变得流行,是因为它们建立了一种叙事,"Bloom说。"当我想到美国的赛车运动时,我们都想到的是纳斯卡车赛,而纳斯卡车赛的叙事是某种乡村的、白人的、工人阶级的美国人,主要在南方,与那些比赛的氛围产生联系。这就是叙事。当我想到一级方程式的叙事时,它是一种非常不同类型的观众。"

passage.label: I

sentences.text: That difference, Carey said, is significant.

While some might immediately link Formula One to Nascar in terms of American growth, Carey said Formula One's brand research had indicated there was very little crossover; rather, Formula One fans generally cite other so-called elite events, like Wimbledon or the Ryder Cup, as competitions they enjoy.
"Other than they're both cars, the Nascar fan base is a very different fan base," Carey said.
"It's a very regional fan base.
Formula One is a global, famous brand of stars.
These are machines that shock and awe you."

passage.translation: Carey说,这种差异是显著的。虽然有些人可能立即将一级方程式与纳斯卡车赛在美国增长方面联系起来,但Carey表示一级方程式的品牌研究表明两者几乎没有交叉;相反,一级方程式车迷通常会提到其他所谓的精英赛事,如温布尔登网球赛或莱德杯,作为他们喜欢的比赛。"除了都是汽车之外,纳斯卡车赛的车迷群体是一个非常不同的车迷群体,"Carey说。"它是一个非常区域性的车迷群体。一级方程式是一个全球性的、由明星组成的著名品牌。这些是让你震撼和敬畏的机器。"

passage.label: J

sentences.text: Carey's background is in deal making and innovation.
At Fox Broadcasting Company, he was a top advisor for years, known for his skill in helping to lead the launch of the company into sports, as well as the start of Fox News Channel.
After going to DirecTV, he positioned the satellite provider as a mainstream option in millions of households.

passage.translation: Carey的背景是交易撮合和创新。在Fox Broadcasting Company,他多年来一直是高级顾问,以帮助领导公司进军体育领域以及启动Fox News Channel的技能而闻名。在去DirecTV之后,他将这家卫星提供商定位为数百万家庭的主流选择。

passage.label: K

sentences.text: Now, after Liberty Media paid $4.4 billion to acquire Formula One, he is charged with making the investment pay off.

"I think they can build Formula One in the U.S.," said Patrick Crakes, an executive at InVivo Media Group who spent 25 years at Fox Broadcasting Company before leaving in 2016 as a senior manager at Fox Sports.
"People don't work on their cars anymore.
They don't want that connection anymore.
It's about technology and pushing the limits.
It's about speed, danger and risk.
And Formula One has that more than any other racing series."

passage.translation: 现在,在Liberty Media支付44亿美元收购一级方程式后,他的任务是让这项投资获得回报。"我认为他们可以在美国建立一级方程式,"InVivo Media Group的高管Patrick Crakes说,他在Fox Broadcasting Company工作了25年,2016年作为Fox Sports的高级经理离职。"人们不再自己修车了。他们不再想要那种联系了。这关乎技术和突破极限。这关乎速度、危险和风险。而一级方程式比任何其他赛车系列都更具备这些。"

passage.label: L

sentences.text: That is what hooked Carey, and he said he thought his experience was not unusual.
He recalled attending Formula One's Monaco race last year and being overwhelmed by the ceremony leading up to the event, the way the race charmed the city for days ahead of the start.
In his mind, it felt like a

passage.translation: Super Bowl(超级碗橄榄球赛).这就是吸引Carey的地方,他说他认为自己的经历并不罕见。他回忆起去年参加一级方程式摩纳哥大奖赛,被赛事前的仪式所震撼,比赛在开始前几天就让整座城市为之着迷的方式。在他看来,这感觉就像超级碗橄榄球赛。

sentences.text: Then, on race day, he watched as the cars rocketed out of a tunnel and went screaming toward a tight turn with the city's harbor and the Mediterranean Sea in the background framing the scene.
He was fascinated.
"You can't help but be awed," he said, "and I think that feeling can be translated to the viewer."

passage.translation: 然后,在比赛日,他看着赛车从隧道中冲出,呼啸着冲向一个急转弯,城市的港口和地中海在背景中勾勒出这一场景。他被迷住了。"你不由得感到敬畏,"他说,"我认为这种感觉可以传递给观众。"

passage.label: N

**定位** 然而更大的问题是个老问题：在日益拥挤的美国体育版图里，F1 还有容身之地吗？意见不一，尤其因为消费者的观看习惯仍在演变。
**改写** People's opinions differ ↔ Opinions vary “意见不同”=“意见不一”whether Formula One can be promoted in the U.S. ↔Is there room for Formula One in the ever-crowded sports landscape of the United States? “能否推广”=“是否有容身之地”
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
K K 段引人说 I think they can build Formula One in the U.S.，是肯定立场；题干opinions differ 强调分歧，由 H 段提出。I think they can build Formula One in the U.S.
questions.quote: The larger question, though, is a familiar one: Is there room for Formula One in the ever- crowded sports landscape of the United States? Opinions vary, particularly because viewing habits among consumers continue to evolve.

questions.prompt: Compared with other racing series, Formula One focuses more on speed and involves more danger.
questions.explanation:
**答案** K 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
与其他赛车系列相比,一级方程式赛车更注重速度,涉及更多危险。
**锚点** 比别的赛事更重速度、更危险
**定位** 重点在于速度、危险与风险。而在这一点上，F1 比任何其他赛车系列都更突出。
**改写** Compared with other racing series, Formula One focuses more on speed ↔And Formula One has that more than any other racing series “比其他更”比较对齐involves more danger ↔ speed, danger and risk “危险”原词复现
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
I I 段说 the Nascar fan base is a very different fan base，比的是粉丝；题干speed、danger 的比较在 K 段。Other than they're both cars, the Nascar fan base is a very different fan base
questions.quote: It's about speed, danger and risk. And Formula One has that more than any other racing series.

passage.label: A

sentences.text: We're growing more used to chatting to our computers, phones and smart speakers through voice assistants like Amazon's Alexa, Apple's Siri and Microsoft's Cortana.
Blind and partially sighted people have been using text-to-speech converters for decades.

passage.translation: 我们越来越习惯通过Amazon的Alexa、Apple的Siri和Microsoft的Cortana等语音助手与我们的电脑、手机和智能音箱交谈。盲人和视力障碍者使用文本转语音转换器已有数十年。

passage.label: B

sentences.text: Out of these assistants, Siri is the most well-known.
The assistant uses voice inquiries and a natural- language user interface(界面) to answer questions.
The software adapts to users' individual language usages, searches, and preferences, with continuing use.

passage.translation: 在这些助手中,Siri是最知名的。该助手使用语音查询和自然语言用户界面来回答问题。随着持续使用,该软件会适应用户的个人语言使用习惯、搜索和偏好。

passage.label: C

sentences.text: Some think voice could soon take over from typing and clicking as the main way to interact online.
But what are the challenges of moving to "the spoken web"?

passage.translation: 一些人认为语音可能很快将取代打字和点击,成为在线互动的主要方式。但是转向"语音网络"面临哪些挑战呢?

passage.label: D

sentences.text: What use is written online content if you can't read?
That is the situation facing illiterate(不识字的) African farmers.
They are often denied crucial information the web offers many others.

With a literacy rate in some parts of Africa at only 22.6%, farmers are often "underpaid for their produce because they might be unaware of the prevailing prices," says Francis Dittoh, a researcher behind Mr Meteo, a speech-based weather information service.

passage.translation: 如果你不识字,书面在线内容有什么用?这就是非洲不识字农民面临的处境。他们常常无法获得网络为许多其他人提供的关键信息。在非洲某些地区识字率仅为22.6%的情况下,农民往往"因为可能不了解当前价格而在出售农产品时被压价",Mr Meteo这一基于语音的天气信息服务背后的研究员Francis Dittoh说。

passage.label: E

sentences.text: "The most frequently heard complaint is about rainfall predictions," says Mr Dittoh, who lives in Tamale, northern Ghana.
"They tell us the methods their forefathers used to predict the weather don't seem to work as well these days."
This is down to climate change, he believes.
Yet knowing when it's going to rain is vital for farmers wanting to sow seeds, irrigate crops or take their animals out to the fields to feed on grass.

passage.translation: "最常听到的抱怨是关于降雨预测的",住在加纳北部塔马利的Dittoh先生说。"他们告诉我们,他们祖先用来预测天气的方法如今似乎不太管用了。"他认为这是气候变化造成的。然而对于想要播种、灌溉作物或把动物赶到田里吃草的农民来说,知道什么时候会下雨至关重要。

passage.label: F

sentences.text: Mr Dittoh says the idea of converting online weather reports into speech came from the farmers themselves, after a workshop in the village of Guabuligah.
"They came up with this," he says.
Mr Meteo takes the online weather forecast, converts it to a short recording in the appropriate language and makes it available on a basic phone.
Farmers ring up to receive the information.
The local language Dagbani is spoken by 1.2 million people but is not served by any online translation applications.
The service was designed to be cheap and easy to run, says Mr Dittoh.
He plans to begin field tests this month, working with Tamale's Savanna Agricultural Research Institute.

passage.translation: Dittoh先生说,将在线天气报告转换为语音的想法来自农民自己,是在Guabuligah村的一次研讨会之后提出的。"这是他们想出来的",他说。Mr Meteo获取在线天气预报,将其转换为适当语言的简短录音,并在基础手机上提供。农民打电话接收信息。当地语言Dagbani有120万人使用,但没有任何在线翻译应用程序支持。Dittoh先生说,该服务被设计得既便宜又易于运行。他计划本月开始实地测试,与塔马利的萨凡纳农业研究所合作。

passage.label: G

sentences.text: The spoken web could also help the one-in-five adults in Europe and the U.S. with poor reading skills.
But building the spoken web—web-to-voice and voice-to-web—isn't straightforward.
For software to understand that pizza is served at Italian restaurants is easy.
To cover multiple domains and to be able to have a conversation with users on every single topic is still a long way off.

passage.translation: 语音网络还可以帮助欧洲和美国五分之一阅读能力较差的成年人。但是构建语音网络——网络到语音和语音到网络——并不简单。对于软件来说,理解意大利餐厅供应披萨是容易的。要涵盖多个领域并能够就每一个话题与用户对话,仍然遥遥无期。

passage.label: H

sentences.text: So although many computer assistants can answer simple questions about the weather and play music for us, anything resembling a wide-ranging human conversation is decades away.
Artificial intelligence just isn't smart enough yet.
Even turning your voice into text—automatic speech recognition—is one of the hardest problems to solve, as there are as many ways to pronounce things as there are people on the planet.

passage.translation: 因此,尽管许多电脑助手可以回答关于天气的简单问题并为我们播放音乐,但任何类似广泛人类对话的东西都还需要几十年。人工智能还不够智能。即使将你的语音转换为文本——自动语音识别——也是最难解决的问题之一,因为地球上有多少人就有多少种发音方式。

passage.label: I

sentences.text: Siri has often been praised for its ability to interpret our casual language and deliver very specific and accurate results, sometimes even providing additional information.
But it is still somewhat restricted, particularly when the language moves away from stiffer commands into more human interactions.

In one example, the phrase "Send a text to Jason, Clint, Sam, and Lee saying we're having dinner at Silver Cloud restaurant" was interpreted as sending a message to Jason only, containing the text "Clint Sam and Lee saying we're having dinner at Silver Cloud restaurant".

It has also been noted that Siri lacks a proper editing function, as saying "Edit message to say: we're at Silver Cloud restaurant and you should come find us" generates "Clint Sam and Lee saying we're having dinner at Silver Cloud restaurant to say we're at Silver Cloud restaurant and you should come find us".

passage.translation: Siri经常因其能够理解我们的随意语言并提供非常具体和准确的结果而受到赞扬,有时甚至提供额外信息。但它仍然受到一定限制,特别是当语言从较为生硬的命令转向更人性化的互动时。在一个例子中,"给Jason、Clint、Sam和Lee发短信说我们在Silver Cloud餐厅吃饭"这句话被理解为只给Jason发送消息,内容是"Clint Sam and Lee saying we're having dinner at Silver Cloud restaurant"。还有人注意到Siri缺乏适当的编辑功能,因为说"编辑消息为:我们在Silver Cloud餐厅,你应该来找我们"会生成"Clint Sam and Lee saying we're having dinner at Silver Cloud restaurant to say we're at Silver Cloud restaurant and you should come find us"。

passage.label: J

sentences.text: Using voice interaction feels far more intimate than surfing the net the old-fashioned way.
This is intentional as the informal tone of the assistant helps create an emotional attachment.
But if something speaks, it must also listen.
Our phones are always near us and they are collecting data about us all the time.
This has already raised privacy concerns.
The American Civil Liberties Union has stated that digital assistants create a threat to privacy from hackers.
Some people have other concerns.
They worry assistants will one day be used to deliver advertising directly to us.

passage.translation: 使用语音交互比以老式方式上网感觉更加亲密。这是有意为之,因为助手的非正式语气有助于建立情感依附。但如果某物会说话,它也必须会倾听。我们的手机总是在我们身边,它们一直在收集关于我们的数据。这已经引发了隐私担忧。美国公民自由联盟表示,数字助手对黑客造成的隐私威胁。有些人还有其他担忧。他们担心助手有一天会被用来直接向我们投放广告。

passage.label: K

sentences.text: But digital voices need more personality to make them popular.
Robots are not yet witty, Siri is boring.
The benefits of using voice instead of tapping fingers obviously depend on the context.
Doctors completing online forms about their patients by speech, for example, can dictate 150 words a minute, three times faster than typing on a keyboard.
This enables them to spend less time on administration and more time with patients.

passage.translation: 但数字语音需要更多个性才能使它们受欢迎。机器人还不够风趣,Siri很无聊。使用语音而不是敲击手指的好处显然取决于具体情境。例如,医生通过语音完成关于患者的在线表格,可以每分钟口述150个单词,比在键盘上打字快三倍。这使他们能够在行政事务上花更少时间,在患者身上花更多时间。

passage.label: L

sentences.text: Last year, speech recognition company Nuance helped a doctors' surgery in Dukinfield, near Manchester, set up a speech system for the practice's six doctors.
Now they can dictate notes on a patient's health condition and treatment and a smart assistant automatically enters the information into the right fields on a web form.
Previously, the doctors made voice recordings that were then transcribed by secretaries—a process that was costly and likely to cause delays.
The new system means letters to patients now have more detail.

passage.translation: 去年,语音识别公司Nuance帮助曼彻斯特附近Dukinfield的一家诊所为该诊所的六名医生建立了语音系统。现在他们可以口述关于患者健康状况和治疗的笔记,智能助手会自动将信息输入网页表单的正确字段。以前,医生录制语音记录,然后由秘书转录——这一过程成本高且可能导致延误。新系统意味着给患者的信件现在有更多细节。

passage.label: M

sentences.text: Using voice also makes sense when you're doing other things with your hands.
Think about when you're cooking, and you just want to know what the next step in the recipe is.
Your hands are covered with oil; you're not going to get on the iPad, so it's a lot more natural to talk.
And speech obviously makes sense when you're driving.
In the U.S., 29% of drivers admit they surf behind the wheel, according to insurance firm State Farm.
This is up from 13% in 2009.
No wonder using mobile phones while driving causes more crashes a year than drink driving, says the U.S.
National Safety Council.

passage.translation: 当你的手正在做其他事情时,使用语音也很有意义。想想当你在做饭时,你只想知道食谱的下一步是什么。你的手上沾满了油,你不会去拿iPad,所以说话要自然得多。而且在开车时语音显然很有意义。根据保险公司State Farm的数据,在美国,29%的司机承认他们在开车时上网。这一比例从2009年的13%上升。美国国家安全委员会表示,难怪开车时使用手机造成的交通事故比酒驾还多。

groups.instructions: In this section, you are going to read a passage with ten statements attached to it. Each statement contains information given in one of the paragraphs. Identify the paragraph from which the information is derived. You may choose a paragraph more than once. Each paragraph is marked with a letter. Answer the questions by marking the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2.

questions.prompt: According to Francis Dittoh, their speech-based weather information service was meant to be inexpensive and easy to use.

L L 段讲诊所装系统、助手 automatically enters the information into the right fields，落脚在效率与减少延误，没提"多花时间陪病人"，故非本句源头。a smart assistant automatically enters the information into the right fields on a web form

**答案** D 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
不识字的非洲农民往往无法获取网上传递的重要信息。

questions.tip:
**辨邻**
E E 段讲农民抱怨 rainfall predictions 不准、祖辈方法失灵，焦点是天气，没讲"因不识字而拿不到网络信息"，故非本句源头。The most frequently heard complaint is about rainfall predictions

一些手机用户担心广告商会利用语音助手直接向他们发送广告。

当双手被占用时,语音网络很有帮助。
**锚点** 双手被占用时有帮助
**定位** 当你正用双手做别的事情时，使用语音也很合理。
**改写** one's hands are occupied ↔ doing other things with your hands手被占用即手在忙别的The spoken web is helpful ↔ Using voice also makes sense有帮助即合理
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
K K 段讲 depend on the context 并举医生口述提速的好处，没讲"双手被占用"这个场景，故非本句源头。The benefits of using voice instead of tapping fingers obviously depend on the context
questions.quote: Using voice also makes sense when you're doing other things with your hands.

questions.prompt: Some people believe online interaction would soon depend mainly on voice.
questions.explanation:
**答案** C 段（弱锚点）
**题目译文**
有些人认为在线互动将很快主要依赖语音。
**锚点** 上网将主要靠语音

**改写** online interaction would soon depend mainly on voice ↔voice could soon take over from typing and clicking as the main way to interact online取代打字即主要靠语音Some people believe ↔ Some think认为同义对应
questions.quote: Some think voice could soon take over from typing and clicking as the main way to interact online.

questions.prompt: Setting up a spoken web is by no means an easy task.
questions.explanation:
**答案** G 段（弱锚点）
**题目译文**
建立语音网络绝非易事。
**锚点** 建语音网络绝非易事
**定位** 但构建语音网络——网页转语音、语音转网页——并不简单。
**改写** Setting up a spoken web ↔ building the spoken web建语音网络同义by no means an easy task ↔ isn't straightforward绝非易事即并不简单

H H 段讲 automatic speech recognition—is one of the hardest problems，是"建语音网络"之下的一个具体子难题，并非"建语音网络绝非易事"这个总判断的出处。Even turning your voice into text—automatic speech recognition—is one of the hardest problems to solve
questions.quote: But building the spoken web—web-to-voice and voice-to-web—isn't straightforward.

questions.prompt: Weather information is extremely important to farmers.

**答案** E 段（弱锚点）
**题目译文**
天气信息对农民极其重要。
**锚点** 天气信息对农民极重要
**定位** 然而，对于想要播种、灌溉庄稼或把牲畜赶到地里吃草的农民来说，知道何时下雨至关重要。
**改写** Weather information ↔ knowing when it's going to rain天气信息含何时下雨extremely important to farmers ↔ vital for farmers极重要即至关重要
questions.tip:
**辨邻**
D D 段讲农民因不了解 the prevailing prices 而被压价，焦点是价格信息，没讲"天气信息对农民极重要"，故非本句源头。underpaid for their produce because they might be unaware of the prevailing prices F F 段讲 Mr Meteo takes the online weather forecast, converts it to a short recording 这个服务的运作，没讲"天气信息对农民极重要"这个判断，故非本句源头。Mr Meteo takes the online weather forecast, converts it to a short recording in the appropriate language
questions.quote: Yet knowing when it's going to rain is vital for farmers wanting to sow seeds, irrigate crops or take their animals out to the fields to feed on grass.

questions.prompt: Some people are concerned about privacy because their phones are constantly collecting their personal information.
questions.explanation:
**答案** J 段（强锚点）
**题目译文**
有些人担心隐私问题,因为他们的手机在不断收集个人信息。
**锚点** 因手机持续收数据担心隐私
