transcript.text: My name's Janet Parker, and I'm the human resources manager of this company.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Thank you for joining us and coming to this training session, which I hope will help you quickly learn about our company and know what you will do in your position.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: First, I'll briefly introduce the history of our company.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: We're quite an old company specializing in electric toys for more than thirty years.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: The founder, Ronald Stevenson, got the idea of establishing his own company when he finished his apprenticeship.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: With the support of his grandfather, he got enough startup capital, and the company was set up and succeeded in a short period.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: To satisfy the demands of customers, we've expanded the premises considerably over the past years, and the number of staff members has grown up on a regular basis.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Recently, we found the sales of our products creeping up very slowly, and we've decided to introduce new electronic toys to give that a boost.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: So we have to look for more workers to help us, and that's the reason why you are here.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: The first week may be pretty challenging as there will be a lot of new information.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: But don't worry too much about trying to remember everything.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: The important thing is to check with someone if you're unsure what to do.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: According to the contract, you'll be expected to work here for six months.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Some of you asked me if there is a possibility for you to be employed as our full-time member.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: I can't give you a definite answer now.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: It'll depend on your job performance during the employment and whether we have job vacancies then.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: About two hundred full-time staff members in our company, seventy percent of whom are responsible for sending out goods, while the minority of jobs are in the manufacturing line.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: You will work in different departments according to our needs, which I'll explain to you in detail later.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Working in our company, you'll be impressed by our modern machinery and production methods, advanced skills, and friendly working atmosphere.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: However, I must tell you one thing which is not so pleasant.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Because the manager of the payroll department is on sick leave these days, I'm afraid that you won't get paid on time this month.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: But don't worry too much, it'll be solved very soon.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions sixteen to twenty.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 0

transcript.text: Now listen and answer questions sixteen to twenty.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 0

transcript.text: In the second part of this training session, I'll explain what you will be responsible for in the following working days.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: There are five positions, and you'll be working in different departments.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: As I've mentioned before, we're in urgent need of someone who can deal with the salary problem, so our staff can get paid as soon as possible, and that's the primary job for the first person.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Then the second of you will be working in the manufacturing line to help develop new products, and I'm sure you will be pretty busy in the following days.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: The third person will work on the sixth floor, and your main job is to look after the mechanical side.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: It includes checking equipment daily to ensure they are working correctly and doing some repair work if necessary.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Without your help, many processes like manufacturing or packaging won't work well.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Then the fourth person will work in the technology department to deal with problems related to software and hardware.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: We're getting new laptops next week, and you must install new programs.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: And the last of you will work in the after-sale service department.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: You are expected to keep a long-term relationship with customers, including collecting feedback regularly, dealing with customer complaints, enhancing customer satisfaction, et cetera.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Okay, now that's all I want to share with you today.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Are there any questions?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: That is the end of part two.

questions.tip: 姓名拼写是 Part 1 的必拿分。听到 "Can I have your full name?" 就要准备好记录接下来的每一个字母。
questions.quote: Can I have your full name? Yes, it’s Jan Creswick. That’s C-R-E-S-W-I-C-K。

questions.explanation: 工作人员在查询旧记录时，Jan 确认她几年前参加过的课程是“戏剧写作”。
questions.tip: 听到 "Which course did you do?" 这种问句时，后面跟着的专有名词就是答案。拼写时英美式均可（-re 或 -er）。
questions.quote: So you may be on our computer records. Which course did you do? The "Writing for the Theatre" course。

questions.explanation: 工作人员读出电脑里旧的地址后缀 Avenue，被 Jan 纠正为 Place。
questions.tip: 听到地址时，重点防范工作人员读出的“旧信息”。凡是听到 Actually 或者 Oh, sorry 这种转折词，后面的才是真地址。
questions.quote: Oh, so that’s 20 Gregory Avenue. Uh, Gregory Place, actually. Okay. I’ll correct that on the computer。

questions.explanation: Jan 表示她虽然想当演员（actor），但目前实际维持生计的职业是 waitress。
questions.tip: 卷面问的是 Current occupation（当前职业）。雅思常考“理想”与“现实”的区分，want to be 后面的职业通常是干扰项。
questions.quote: And can I ask if you work? Yes, I want to be an actor, but I’m working as a waitress at the moment。

questions.explanation: 工作人员以为是明天的课（30th of May），Jan 立刻纠正说是两周后即 13th of June 开始的那一期。
questions.tip: 月份和日期辨析是重灾区。必须排除工作人员主动提出的 30th of May，这是典型的先导干扰。
questions.quote: So we’re enrolling you on the two-day course that starts tomorrow, the 30th of May. Oh, sorry, no. On the 13th of June. I meant the one starting in two weeks。

questions.explanation: Jan 确认了她计划到达（arrival）的时间是下午 5:30。
questions.tip: 录音中明确提到了晚上到达（evening），所以这个答案是需要加 pm 的，不能不加。
questions.quote: Well, I’ll make sure I’m there in good time so I can meet the others that evening and settle in. Is 5:30 too early to arrive? No, that’s fine。

questions.explanation: 关于饮食限制，Jan 强调她不吃任何含有 milk 成分的食物。
questions.tip: 听到 dietary information 就要立刻警觉。虽然她随后也讨论了 meat，但明确说“不需要记（don't need to note that）”，所以答案不选 meat。
questions.quote: All the food is provided and we use organic produce as often as we can. Oh, that sounds great. But I don’t eat anything that’s made from milk。

questions.explanation: 工作人员给出下午课程的两个选择，Jan 明确表示她对 comedy（喜剧）更感兴趣。
questions.tip: 录音中提到了 comic（形容词）和 classic 两个选项，Jan 确定了前者。填入名词 comedy 最符合语法习惯。
questions.quote: If we do that, there’ll be a choice of doing comic or what we call classic work. Oh, I’d always go with comedy. I’m much more interested in that。

questions.explanation: Jan 解释说她是在 internet 上搜索课程时发现的，而不是通过报纸。
questions.tip: 还是典型的干扰排除。工作人员问是不是看到报纸（newspaper）广告，Jan 明确回答 No 之后引出了正确途径。
questions.quote: Was it the adverts in the Sunday newspaper? No. In fact, I looked for drama courses on the internet and I saw that you were doing one。

questions.explanation: Jan 表示没时间看书（books），她只需要一份宣传广告里提到的 leaflet（传单）。
questions.tip: 听到 books 不要动笔，Jan 的态度是 don't have much time（没空看），只有对 leaflet 的态度是 grateful（想要）。
questions.quote: I don’t have much time to read any of the books you’re recommending, but I’d be grateful for your leaflet—the one you mentioned in your publicity?

8.s: doing comic or what we call classic work

transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.text: I'll warn them.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 0

transcript.text: And another type of activity we do is survival courses, but that's only for groups of five or more, and they've got to be acquaintances.

questions.quote: ...but I’m afraid we had a flood in there last month, and the floor was slightly damaged, so unfortunately it’s out of use just now.

options.text: unavailable.
flooded.
booked.

questions.explanation: 录音提到只要你给我们 enough notice（足够的提前通知），我们可以为你 cater（提供餐饮/做饭），这对应选项 B。
questions.tip: 自己带食物（self-catering）或去外面吃（eat out）都被描述为 flexible 的选项，并没有提到需要“提前通知”。
questions.quote: As long as you give us enough notice, we can cater for you...

have meals cooked for them.
eat at restaurants outside.

questions.tip: 选项 B 和 C（喂动物、开拖拉机）录音明确说是针对 visitors who are really keen（特别感兴趣的游客），而不是题目问的 All visitors。
questions.quote: One of the farm managers shows people around and explains some of the principles of organic farming.

options.text: get information about organic farming.
help to feed the animals.
watch a tractor demonstration.

questions.prompt: On the survival course people have to
questions.explanation: 关于生存课程，录音说主要是关于在没有设备的情况下 collecting food（收集食物），这对应选项 B（找到他们自己的食物）。
questions.tip: 录音明确否定了 map reading（Wait, not exactly），而 run through woodland 是活动发生的地点背景，不是核心任务。
questions.quote: It’s mainly about collecting food and water, lighting a fire without any equipment.

options.text: learn to use map.
find their own food.
run through woodland.

questions.prompt: From the centre it is easy to walk to
questions.explanation: 录音提到有一条 cycle path（自行车道）起始于离这里仅 10 minutes walk（步行10分钟）的地方，符合题干 easy to walk to。
questions.tip: 国家公园和海滩（Exmoor / South Coast）录音都说 a bit far（有点远），除非你非常健壮，否则步行很难到达（需开车30分钟）。
questions.quote: ...and there’s also a cycle path, which starts quite near here, about 10 minutes walk away.

options.text: Exmoor National Park.
the beach.
a cycling route.

questions.prompt: If the weather is bad, visitors can go to a
questions.explanation: 录音说附近的 Sherborne 镇虽然小，但有一个很好的 museum（博物馆）值得参观。
questions.tip: 录音虽然提到了 show films，但那是直接在中心（here）播放的，不是去外面的 cinema（电影院）。
questions.quote: It’s only a small town, but it’s got a very good museum, and an old abbey, which is well worth a visit.

options.text: cinema.
theatre.
museum.

questions.prompt: Group who wish to stay at the centre must pay
questions.explanation: 预定后需要在五天内支付 deposit（定金），余款（balance）到了再付，定金即“部分费用”。
questions.tip: 听到 balance（余款）要反应过来这是指剩下的钱，说明不需要一开始就付 all of the cost。
questions.quote: But once you’ve made a booking, we would need a deposit within five days to secure it. Then you just pay the balance when you’re here.

options.text: part of the cost in advance.
all of the cost in advance.
all of the cost on arrival.

questions.explanation: 录音中工作人员询问你是从哪里得知他们的，男士回答说既不是广告也不是朋友，而是一个广播节目（radio program）。
questions.tip: 你可能听到选项里有“advert”或者“friend”就想直接填，但男士紧接着用“Neither”否定了这两个干扰项，并在之后才给出了正确答案。
questions.quote: And can I ask where you heard about us? Was it in an advert, or did a friend tell you, or- Neither, actually. It was a radio program. Then I just got your number from the phone book.

questions.explanation: 录音中工作人员询问邮编，男士直接报出了对应的字母和数字组合“LS14 2JW”。
questions.tip: 这道题你容易在字母和数字的连读上出错，特别是J和W的读音容易混淆，听到这种信息点必须马上提笔记下清晰的发音。
questions.quote: And do you know your postcode? Yes, it's, uh, LS14 2JW.

questions.explanation: 男士给出了他的办公邮箱“mj@hennings.co.uk”，随后工作人员用“H-E-double N-I-N-G-S”进行了拼写确认。
questions.tip: 你可能会漏听“double N”导致拼写少写一个n，在听到对方念字母拼写时，一定要在纸上同步核对写下来的每一个字母。
questions.quote: It's mj@hennings.co.uk. Is that H-E-double N-I-N-G-S? That's right. Thank you.

questions.explanation: 工作人员列举了两年、三年、五年和终身的会员时长，男士表示自己这次只要“minimum length”（最短时长），对应的也就是刚才列出的最短选项“两年”。
questions.tip: 录音中给出了多个数字作为干扰（2, 3, 5），如果你只是单纯找数字，没有把“minimum”（最短）和上文的“two”结合起来理解，就会填错。
questions.quote: 1st of all, how long do you want the membership for? We do two, three, and five-year memberships, and we also do one for life. Uh, I think I'll just get the minimum length this time around.

questions.explanation: 工作人员给出了三种会员类型（single, joint, family），男士明确表示想办“joint one”（联合会员），因为妻子想和他一起参加活动。
questions.tip: 你可能会听到“children”这个词就急着写family，但其实男士说“haven't got any children”（没有孩子）直接排除了家庭会员。
questions.quote: And then the type of membership. We do single, joint, or family, which covers up to 4 children. Well, we haven't got any children, but I think I'll get the joint one because my wife will probably want to do the activities with me. Yes, fine.

questions.explanation: 工作人员在确认完会员类型后，直接计算并给出了总费用“49 pounds”（49英镑）。
questions.tip: 这是一道直给的数字题，你唯一容易犯的错误就是把“49”的尾音没听清，错填成读音相近的“40”或“90”。
questions.quote: Let me see. That'll be 49 pounds altogether then, please.

questions.explanation: 工作人员询问银行的名称，男士直接回答是“Union Bank”。
questions.tip: 直接听写题最怕拼错，你要确保听清发音并正确拼出“Union”，不要把它写成发音相似却毫无意义的错误单词。
questions.quote: I just need your bank details. Can you give me the name 1st? It's the Union Bank.

questions.explanation: 工作人员提议10月1日开始，但男士反问能否改为“15th”（15号），工作人员随后同意了该日期。
questions.tip: 如果你听到工作人员先说出的“1st of October”就立刻写答案并不再往下听，就会直接掉进干扰陷阱。
questions.quote: When would you like to start payment? Next month on the 1st of October, or... Can you make it the 15th instead? No problem. The membership will begin then, too. Is that all right? That's fine.

questions.explanation: 工作人员说要给一个参考号（reference number），并在男士准备好笔后，报出了正确的字母数字组合“JYZ37”。
questions.tip: 字母“J”和“Z”的发音是这道题最大的混淆点，你极有可能会跟“G”或“C”搞混，平时需要大量练习相似字母的听写反应。
questions.quote: I'll just give you a reference number in case there's any problem. Have you got a pen? Uh, yes. It's JYZ37.

questions.explanation: 在处理完额外信息包的请求后，工作人员主动提出还可以免费寄送一个“video”（视频），男士表示了同意。
questions.tip: 题干上已经列出了“extra information pack”，所以你不能把男士前面提到要额外多要一份的“additional one”当成答案，必须往后听找到并列的全新事物。
questions.quote: There's also a video we can send you if you like. There's no charge. Yes, please. That'll be great.

questions.explanation: 录音中客服要求提供reference number，女士回答说号码是CWX five seven six double eight four，即CWX576884。
questions.tip: 你可能会把录音里的“double eight”直接听成单个数字8，要注意英语中连续两个相同数字习惯用double表达。
questions.quote: Okay. I need one more thing. There's a reference number. It should be in the top right-hand corner of the warranty card we gave you. Let me have a look. Oh, here it is. It's CWX five seven six double eight four.

questions.explanation: 客服询问购买时间，女士回答是在“last summer”，并补充说明大约是“nine months ago”，填入其中任意一个均可。
questions.tip: 你需要注意分辨时间信息，不要被录音随后提到的两年保修期（two-year warranty）干扰而填入错误的数字。
questions.quote: Well, I need to make sure if your washing machine is still within the warranty period. So when did you buy it? Oh, sure. I remember I bought it last summer, so it was about nine months ago. And the card here says this washing machine has a two-year warranty, so it's definitely within the period.

questions.explanation: 客服明确需要current address（当前地址）后，女士报出地址是a hundred and twenty Middle Street, Oxford，卷面上已有120和Oxford，因此填Middle street。
questions.tip: 你可能会拼错Middle这个基础词汇，或者只填了Middle漏掉了street导致信息不完整。
questions.quote: Then I need your address. My old address or my current one? Your current one, as we will send in someone to fix the washing machine for you. It's a hundred and twenty Middle Street, Oxford.

questions.explanation: 客服紧接着询问postcode（邮政编码），女士直接回答了GO19 4KE。
questions.tip: 英文邮编是字母与数字的组合。
questions.quote: And the postcode? It's GO19 4KE.

questions.explanation: 录音中明确提到“The water had soaked the entire floor（水把整个地板都浸透了）”，对应题目中地板湿了的原因是water。
questions.tip: 你可能会听到前一句的“leaking（漏水）”就急于填入，但题干“because of the...”后面需要填名词，直接弄湿地板的物质是水。
questions.quote: But after about thirty minutes when I came back to the house, I found it was leaking. The water had soaked the entire floor.

questions.explanation: 录音提到洗衣机失控（out of control）后，女士说“I just switched off the machine straight away”，其中straight away同义替换了题干的immediately，对应动作是switched off。
questions.tip: 你可能会听到“pressing any button”的干扰，但录音前置了否定描述“not much point in...（没多大意义）”，不要被否定语境中的动作骗了。
questions.quote: At that moment, the washing machine was totally out of control, and the alarm on it also started to sound. I thought there was not much point in pressing any button on the machine, so I just switched off the machine straight away. Then it stopped leaking at once, thank goodness.

questions.explanation: 录音中明确说到“As it is made of wood rather than marble”，直接对应题干给出了地板的材质是wood（木头）。
questions.tip: 录音中紧跟着出现了“marble（大理石）”，你可能没听清前面的否定词“rather than（而不是）”就错填了干扰项。
questions.quote: Oh, then I found my floor was nearly a disaster. As it is made of wood rather than marble, it could not be soaked in water for a long time.

questions.explanation: 客服记录完信息后，说“we'll send a client engineer to your house to fix it”，派去修理的人对应题干就是client engineer。
questions.tip: 你可能会漏听前面的修饰词client，只填了engineer，导致答案不够精准。
questions.quote: Well, I've taken down all the related information. Later, we'll send a client engineer to your house to fix it.

questions.explanation: 客服查完排期后表示“The earliest day we can arrange for you is next Tuesday”，对应题目要求的可用时间为next Tuesday。
questions.tip: 女士在前文提议了“this Saturday”，客服也复述了Saturday，你如果没听到后面的“has been occupied（已被占满）”，就会落入干扰陷阱。
questions.quote: Okay. Could you arrange the repair work as soon as possible, as I'm too busy at work to do the laundry by hand? How about this Saturday? Um, I have to check the schedule of the repairman. Oh, sorry, madam. Saturday has been occupied. The earliest day we can arrange for you is next Tuesday. Is that okay with you?

questions.explanation: 女士描述房屋位置时说“just across from the post office”，其中across from直接同义替换了题干的opposite（在...对面），答案为post office。
questions.tip: 录音先给出了“central market”，你可能会只抓取到“near”后面的这个地点就直接填入，忽略了介词方位关系的严格对应。
questions.quote: Oh, my house is easy to find. It's near the central market, just across from the post office.

5.s: The water had soaked the entire floor

9.s: The earliest day we can arrange for you is next Tuesday

transcript.speaker: Speaker 0

transcript.text: Hello, Grace.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: I'm William.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Thanks for coming in for this interview.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: I understand.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: It's no problem at all.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Okay.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: What's the address?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: It's graceb@travel.co.nz.

transcript.text: I chose it when I was younger, and I just haven't changed it since.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: It's easy to remember.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Now, do you have any particular qualifications, Grace?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: I'm a housewife now, but I used to be in teaching.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Before having children, I worked as a bank teller.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: All right.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: I need to find out when you'll be available during the week.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: You said you have children.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Are they at school?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Yes, both of them are.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: So I can't start work before eight fifteen in the morning or work past three o'clock in the afternoon.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: So you'd be looking for about four or five hours a day, say, nine fifteen AM to two PM?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: That gives you time to get to and from school to work.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: That's perfect.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: It's important for me to be there for my children.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Of course.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: And are you looking to work Monday to Friday?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Yes.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: If it gets to be too much, I can rethink it later.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Now, Grace, you obviously have a lot of work experience, but have you done any volunteer work before?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Um, during the Rugby World Cup, there were many visitors who didn't know their way around or what they should see and do in Auckland City.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: So I worked as a guide to help introduce the city to tourists.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: I really enjoyed it.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Okay, good.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Have you done anything else?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Perhaps when you were at school or university, did you do any volunteer work there?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: When I was at university, the manager of a netball team asked me to be the coach, and I did that.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Great.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: It sounds like you like your sports.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: I used to, but not so much nowadays.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Okay.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 0

transcript.text: Now listen and answer questions six to ten.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 0

transcript.text: If not sports, do you have any other interests?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Oh, yes.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: I love to get out in my garden, and I grow most of my own vegetables.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: I love flowers and flower arranging, but I don't suppose there's much volunteer work associated with those kinds of things.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: [laughs] You'd be surprised.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Any other hobbies?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Like most people, I guess, I like music.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Actually, I can play the guitar, but I haven't done much for a while, so I'm a bit rusty.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: One day, I'd like to have a go at the flute.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Okay.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: That gives me a good idea of the type of work you might be interested in.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Ideally, it'd be something that combines your experience and your hobbies.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: If you're interested in something outdoors, I have a position helping out on a farm.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: That's just for a month.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: It's not too physically demanding, though it does require you to be on your feet all day, and it'd be nice as long as the weather is fine, but I imagine it could be uncomfortable in the rain or the heat.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: In the past, we've had many positions working in community centers.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: They've been working with the disabled or teens.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: The position we have available now is with elderly men and women.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: They have activities like flower arranging, music lessons, sing-alongs, things like that.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Both of those sound great.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: I'm really open to anything.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: That's nice to know.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Just a couple more questions.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Why do you want to do volunteer work?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Well, now that both my children are in school, I'd like to make some friends as I've got the time on my hands.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Also, I like the idea of helping others.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: And last question, how did you find our agency?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: We aren't in the phone book.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Did a friend tell you about us?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: No, I was on my way to school the other day, and I saw your advertisement at the supermarket.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: It's good to know someone sees those ads.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Thank you again for coming in.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: That is the end of part one.

questions.explanation: Grace 提到她曾经受过培训并拿到了 teaching（教学） 的文凭（diploma）。

transcript.text: Hi there.

transcript.text: I heard about the Upper Province Folk Festival, and I'm interested in attending.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: When is it happening this year?

transcript.text: This year's Upper Province Folk Festival will be held on a weekend in June.

transcript.text: You're welcome.

transcript.text: We're here to help.

questions.quote: What are they? The first one is for a post as a receptionist.

questions.explanation: 录音中说明工作主要职责是提供高质量的客户服务（quality customer service）。
questions.tip: 你容易只听到service而漏掉前面的核心修饰词customer或quality customer，填空时要注意抓住完整的词组。
questions.quote: Yes, of course. The job will be to mainly provide quality customer service, both over the phone and in person.

questions.explanation: 当问到工作时间时，录音明确回答你需要在一周内工作几个清晨（early mornings）。
questions.tip: 你可能会听到后面的four days a week，但题目问的是具体的“时段”而非天数，注意抓住修饰mornings的early。
questions.quote: Do you have any information about the hours involved? It says here that you will be expected to work several early mornings, four days a week.

questions.explanation: 录音提到在胜任岗位前，你需要经历几周无薪的培训（unpaid training），对应题目中的without pay。
questions.tip: 你可能听到unpaid后不知道填什么，这里的unpaid是对without pay的同义替换，其后的核心名词training才是真正的答案。
questions.quote: Any other requirements? Yeah. You'll have to go through a couple of weeks of unpaid training before qualifying for the post.

questions.explanation: 录音中男士介绍下一个职位时明确提到，这里有一个司机（driver）的招聘广告。
questions.tip: 这道题非常直接，如果你错过了，可能是因为没有跟上话题从上一个职位向新职位的转换节奏。
questions.quote: Are there any other roles beginning later in the day? Yes. There's an advertisement here for a driver.

questions.explanation: 录音在介绍工作时间时，原词重现了working hours are flexible（灵活的）。
questions.tip: 你可能会被后面一大串关于排班（personal schedule）的解释干扰，要记住紧跟提示词working hours锁定紧随其后的形容词。
questions.quote: Is there any more information? Yep. It says here that working hours are flexible, and the employers are happy to work within your personal schedule since they employ multiple drivers.

questions.explanation: 录音提到具体的职责包括去取购买的杂货（collecting the grocery shopping），这里的collecting完美对应题目的collect。
questions.tip: 你容易只听到shopping而漏掉限定词grocery，导致答案不完整甚至改变了具体的语义。
questions.quote: As well as driving the employers to and from work, they will ask you to perform various duties on their behalf, such as collecting the grocery shopping and picking their children up from school.

questions.explanation: 女士询问是否需要在周末工作，男士否定并说明只需要在工作日上班，言下之意休息日就是周末（weekends）。
questions.tip: 你可能会听到weekdays就急着写上去，但题目问的是“休息日（Day off）”而不是“工作日”，一定要听完后面的not weekends再做判断。
questions.quote: Do they need me to work a day on the weekend as well? No. It says here that they only require you to work on weekdays, not weekends.

questions.explanation: 录音引入第三个职位时，明确说是市中心一家电影院（cinema）的收银员。
questions.tip: 题目要求填的是cashier工作的具体地点，如果你填了town就过于宽泛了，真正的直接工作场所是cinema。
questions.quote: Okay. So it's a post for a cashier in a cinema in the center of town.

questions.explanation: 录音中提到你需要接听电话并处理预订（take bookings），这里的take和题目的make是同义替换。
questions.tip: 你可能会因为前面的tickets或refreshments分心，但注意题目是并列的第三个职责，紧跟连词also往后听就能抓到bookings。

Also, they ask that you be quick on the computers since you'll also need to take bookings over the phone, but you'll receive basic training for that.

questions.explanation: 接待员询问住址时，男士直接给出了具体的街道名称“Ninety-five Cross Street”。
questions.tip: 你可能会因为手速跟不上而漏记数字，或者忽略了基础单词“Cross”的拼写，听到与地址相关的提问后要立刻做好速记准备。
questions.quote: And where are you staying here? At Ninety-five Cross Street.

questions.explanation: 当被问到所在的郊区名字时，男士回答“Walkley”并直接给出了它的完整字母拼写。
questions.tip: 你可能会在听写字母时反应慢半拍或者把元音字母听混，遇到陌生的专有名词一定要重点抓取紧随其后的字母拼读。
questions.quote: And the suburb? Walkley. That's W-A-L-K-L-E-Y.

questions.explanation: 接待员询问联系电话，男士依次念出了这一长串电话数字。
questions.tip: 连续播报一长串数字时，你很容易跟丢或写错某一位，遇到此类题目需要高度集中注意力并提升数字的短时记忆与书写速度。
questions.quote: And can I have a contact phone number? Uh, it's four six eight nine five three two four.

questions.explanation: 医生错误猜测是手肘或手腕受伤，男士立刻否定并澄清自己是扭伤了膝盖 (sprained knee)。
questions.tip: 你可能会听到“elbow”或“wrist”这两个强干扰词就直接填入；记住听到选择性疑问句时，一定要往后听病人的明确肯定或否定回应。
questions.quote: And what was the nature of your injury? Did you hurt your elbow or wrist? Uh, no. I had a sprained knee. That was the original problem.

questions.explanation: 男士先说事情发生在三周前，紧接着补充了具体的发生日期是6月18日。
questions.tip: 你可能会把刚听到的“three weeks”直接写上去，但题干明确要求填的是 Date（日期），你需要过滤掉干扰性的时间段，精准抓取具体日期。
questions.quote: And when did this happen? Uh, it was three weeks ago now, so that was June eighteenth.

questions.explanation: 男士提到之前的医生只让他使用冰袋（ice pack）来进行处理。
questions.tip: 录音中提到了“X-ray”作为强干扰，但男士使用了否定表达“didn't need”，你需要根据语义排除这个选项。
questions.quote: And you say you had medical treatment? Yes. The doctor said I didn't need an X-ray or anything, and he just told me to use an ice pack. Mm-hmm. An ice pack. Fine.

questions.explanation: 男士说明自己走路没问题，但目前依然无法上楼梯 (can't go upstairs)。
questions.tip: 题目让你填的是“unable to”（不能做的事），你可能会被“walk okay”或者“sleeping downstairs”的表面语义带偏，重点要抓与 unable 同义替换的“can't”。
questions.quote: Now, what problems are you experiencing at the moment? Are you having any problems walking? Well, I can walk okay, but I still can't go upstairs, so I've been sleeping downstairs.

questions.explanation: 医生问是不是膝盖还疼，男士否定并指出现在晚上痛得睡不着的地方是背部 (back)。
questions.tip: 你可能会靠惯性填入之前一直在聊的“knee”；要注意“Actually”这个重要的转折信号词，它预示着前文信息被推翻，真正的新答案即将出现。
questions.quote: Now, you say your knee still hurts? Well, no. Actually, it's recovering nicely. It's my back that's hurting me now. It really aches at night, and I can hardly sleep.

questions.explanation: 医生建议男士把手杖 (stick) 收起来，因为这是让他身体不平衡的根源。
questions.tip: 题干上的“stop using”被同义替换成了“put away”，你可能没反应过来这层动作转换，从而漏听了紧挨着的核心名词“stick”。
questions.quote: First, you should put your stick away, as that's probably the source of the problem. It'll be making you unbalanced.

questions.explanation: 医生提到传单上有一些可以在家做的锻炼 (exercises)，坚持每天做就会见效。
questions.tip: 你可能会因为没听到题干上的“regular”而错过答案，其实它被替换成了“every day”；另外，如果你光抓到了“leaflet”，结合题干的“Do regular...”语义完全不通顺，填空时绝不能忽略整体语义的合理性。
questions.quote: We do have a leaflet showing some exercises you can do to help yourself at home. If you do them every day, they'll soon be effective.

questions.explanation: 针对婴儿班，工作人员解释其主要目的是让孩子熟悉水性，因此会提供大量的 toys（玩具）让他们在水中玩耍。
questions.tip: 听到 water babies 定位后，注意卷面的 using 对应原文的 can use to play with。
questions.quote: Well, the main aim is just to familiarize them with the water, so they feel at ease there. They get the children to enjoy themselves. They have lots of toys and things they can use to play with in the water。

questions.explanation: 初学者课程（Beginners）侧重基础，主要教授如何在水中进行 breathing（呼吸）以及练习在水下睁眼。
questions.tip: 听到 beginner 后，紧跟在 teach you techniques for... 之后的动名词就是答案词。
questions.quote: Well, the beginners' classes are really for people who don’t have any experience of swimming. They aim to teach you techniques for breathing in the water, and they get you to do things like put your head underwater and open your eyes。

questions.explanation: 在中级班（Intermediate）中，除了学习基本的泳姿，学员还会接触到 diving（跳水/潜水）和普通的水下游泳。
questions.tip: 这是一个由客户主动提问（What about...?）引出的答案，听到工作人员回答 Yes 时确认记录。
questions.quote: Okay. So, you’d be better in the intermediate class then. That’s where you learn the main swimming strokes: Front stroke, back stroke and so on. What about diving? Yes, they teach you how to do that。

questions.explanation: 中级班非常注重实用性，课程内容包含了在各种水域环境下的 safety（安全）教育。
questions.tip: 听到 intermediate course 的后续内容，寻找卷面 in the water 对应的原文表达 water safety。
questions.quote: Oh no, not scuba. Just ordinary underwater swimming. And in the intermediate course, you also look at water safety, both in the pool and when swimming in other places。

questions.explanation: 客户在询问班级人数后，顺便确认了该课程的受众群体是 adults（成年人）。
questions.tip: 听到数字 8 to 10 或 12 之后，紧接着出现的身份名词即为答案。
questions.quote: Well, the intermediate class is usually around 8 to 10. That’s what we aim at, though occasionally it might go up to 12. Okay, that sounds quite a reasonable size, not too many. And the class is for adults, is it? Yes。

questions.explanation: 高级班（Advanced）的重点在于提升游泳技巧的效率，并针对学员的 speed（速度）进行专项强化训练。
questions.tip: 听到 advanced class 定位。卷面的 improving 对应原文中的 working on your...。
questions.quote: Yes, they focus on developing more efficient swimming techniques and on working on your speed. And they also prepare you for competitive swimming。

questions.explanation: 课程的实际开始日期是 January 13th（1月13日），这也是中级班的第一节课时间。
questions.tip: 高能日期干扰！ 录音中先出现了 January the 8th，但那是“截止注册时间（the latest）”，千万不能填错，要选 first lesson 所在的日期。
questions.quote: Well, the classes are on Tuesdays and the first lesson is on January the 13th. So, you need to register before then. January the 8th is the latest, but it’s filling up quickly...

questions.explanation: 游泳学校会为参与者提供一顶游泳 hat（泳帽），主要是为了方便教练识别不同的学员。
questions.tip: 排除法。客户问需不需要带 towel（毛巾），工作人员否定后引出 provide... a swimming hat。
questions.quote: Do I have to bring my own towel? That’s right. We provide all participants with a swimming hat, though. Well, we do insist on it, actually. It helps the instructor to identify you。

questions.explanation: 工作人员特别提醒，由于需要使用 locker（储物柜），学员需要自备 20 便士的零钱。
questions.tip: 听到 20p coin 时立刻定位。卷面 Bring change for 对应原文的 you need a... for。
questions.quote: Oh, and don’t forget you need a 20p coin for the locker. Oh, okay. Right。

questions.explanation: 除了身体上的锻炼，游泳还能帮助许多人建立更好的 confidence（自信心）。
questions.tip: 听到 health 话题后，等待由并列连词 And 引出的第二个好处。
questions.quote: I really need to get some more exercise, and everyone says swimming is good for your health. Yes. And a lot of people find it improves their confidence, too。

4.s: in the pool and when swimming in other places

9.s: you need a twenty P coin

questions.tip: 英文字母和数字混合在一起连读时很容易听漏或听错，你需要平时多熟悉这种组合的发音节奏。
questions.quote: Do you know your postcode? Let me see if I can remember it. Oh, yes, it's R-O six two L-R.

questions.quote: What about buses, trams, et cetera? Do they provide a good service? Actually, they hardly run on time, so I should say I am not totally impressed.

Poor

questions.quote: What would you like to say about the facilities here? The air is quite fresh compared with other cities. That's because there are some national parks, and I can always take my wife for a walk there.

questions.quote: Well, actually, I am also new here. My family and I just moved in recently. I think you should ask the local people here if you want to get more detailed information.

questions.explanation: 受访者认为游泳池（swimming pool）已经很旧了，非常需要翻修（needs renovating），这刚好对应了题目里的需要改进（needs to be improved）。

transcript.text: You're welcome.

questions.explanation: 录音里明确提到，为了满足大家的需求，垃圾收集时间已经从周四改到了星期二（Tuesdays）。
questions.tip: 你可能会听到前面的时间“Thursdays”，但一定要注意录音紧接着说了“shifted to（改到了）”，所以要填的是新的时间而不是过去作废的时间。
questions.quote: We've recently adjusted our schedule to better meet community needs. While our collection in Avondale used to be on Thursdays, we've shifted to Tuesdays due to popular demand. We recommend setting out your garbage at the designated collection sites the night before to ensure timely pickup.

questions.explanation: 针对“卡车几点来”的提问，对方清楚地回答安排在上午八点十五分（eight fifteen AM）到达并开始收集。
questions.tip: 你可能会听到后面的“6:30”和“7:30”，但这俩时间只是为了解释8点15分能刚好避开这个时段的早高峰，千万不要把干扰信息当成真正的收集时间。
questions.quote: What time should I expect the collection truck on that date? Our trucks are scheduled to arrive and begin collection at eight fifteen AM. This timing helps avoid the rush hour, usually between six thirty AM and seven thirty AM, and ensures that the roads are less congested.

questions.explanation: 题干的“不收（will not collect）”对应原文的“没有设施去回收（do not have the facilities to safely recycle）”，而后面跟着的拒收对象“any [ ]”精准对应原文的“electronics / electronic appliances（任何电子产品）”。不能填单数 electronic，不是原词，并且语法也不对。
questions.tip: 不能填TV。原文说的是“electronic appliances like TVs”，这里的“like TVs”只是举了个具体例子，机构真正拒收的是前面的“电子产品”；而且题干里有“any”，后面直接填单数“TV”语法根本说不通。
questions.quote: I have an old TV that I need to dispose of. Do you recycle electronics? Currently, we do not have the facilities to safely recycle electronic appliances like TVs. These items require special handling due to their components and materials.

questions.explanation: 录音中说明，所有主要的垃圾收集点都在网站上提供的地图（map）上有清晰的标记。
questions.tip: 你可能会在听到“website（网站）”时就急着写下它，但题干已经给出了“via the internet（通过网络）”，这里需要你填的是网络上具体的指示载体，也就是 map。
questions.quote: Do you offer door-to-door garbage collection services? Unfortunately, due to our current staffing challenges, we cannot provide door-to-door service. However, all major garbage collection sites are clearly marked on the map available on our website. This should help you locate the nearest disposal point conveniently.

questions.explanation: 工作人员强烈推荐使用可以在当地杂货店（grocery stores）买到的特殊垃圾分类袋。
questions.tip: 你可能会在听到“purchase（购买）”时忽略了后面紧跟着的商店类型，做题时一定要留意 stores 前面的核心限定词 grocery。
questions.quote: Are there specific preparations we should make with our recycling to assist in the process? Yes, actually. We highly recommend using the special waste sorting bags that are available for purchase at local grocery stores. These bags are designed to keep different types of recyclable materials separated, which greatly facilitates the recycling process at our facilities.

questions.explanation: 针对家庭该如何改进回收，最有效的做法就是先把垃圾分门别类，也就是分到不同的类别（categories）中。
questions.tip: 你可能会在听到后面具体的塑料、金属（plastics, metals）时慌忙去写具体东西，但题干要求填的是“divide（划分）”的方向，抓住总结性的 categories 才是关键。
questions.quote: What more can families do to improve the recycling process at home? One of the most effective things families can do is to start by properly sorting their rubbish into categories such as plastics, metals, paper, and organics. This not only helps in reducing the contamination of recyclables but also improves the efficiency of the recycling process.

questions.explanation: 对于瓶瓶罐罐，录音里要求在扔掉前一定要撕掉所有的标签（labels）并冲洗干净。
questions.tip: 你可能会因为没听到题目原本的“Remove”，而是听到了换了种说法的“ensure to remove”而没跟上，只要听到跟瓶子相关的处理动作，抓紧后面的核心名词 labels 即可。
questions.quote: For recyclables like cans, bottles, and glass, are there specific preparations we should follow? Absolutely. Please ensure to remove any labels and rinse the bottles and cans before placing them in the recycling bin. This reduces contamination and the cost of recycling, and it ensures that more materials can be successfully reclaimed and reused.

questions.explanation: 当提问者问到里面还有液体的果汁（juice）瓶子要不要倒空时，工作人员给予了必须倒空的肯定回答。
questions.tip: 你可能会因为题目里写的是“empty water”而在录音里死等 water，但提问者一开始就设定了物品是 juice bottles，听到倒空液体时直接联想回去即可。
questions.quote: Should I empty juice bottles that still contain liquids? Yes, please empty any containers of their contents before disposal. Liquids can damage the recyclable materials and may complicate the recycling process.

questions.explanation: 关于披萨（pizza）盒这类纸制品，工作人员明确提示里面不能留有食物残渣（food residue）。
questions.tip: 你可能会先盯着题目里的“food”去定位，但录音是先抛出了目标物品 pizza boxes，随后才交代要清理食物，注意这种说话顺序的颠倒。
questions.quote: And how should I handle paper products like pizza boxes? Paper products can often be recycled, but please make sure they are free from food residue. Food contamination can render paper products non-recyclable, as it often leads to mold, which complicates the pulping process.

questions.explanation: 对于鸡蛋（egg）纸盒，录音要求必须把它们和其他纸类回收物分开（separate）。
questions.tip: 你可能会被句子后半段一大串解释分心，其实在出现“separate（分开）”这个关键动作之前，目标物品 egg 已经被抛出来了，顺着听就很容易抓到。
questions.quote: Additionally, regarding egg cartons and similar items, please separate them from other paper recyclables because they are made from different materials that need to be processed separately.

questions.quote: Anyway, could you tell me the exact date when you can move in? Well, the contract with my current tenant is due next week on May 3rd, and I need a day to clean and check the things in the house, so I think the house will be ready on the 5th of May. Is that okay?

questions.tip: 你容易把学生说的预算500美元（five hundred）或最高承受限度600美元（six hundred）当成最终的实际租金。
questions.quote: And what we're most concerned about is the rent. We'd like something around five hundred dollars a month for each of us, but we could go up to six hundred dollars if we have to, but we can't go beyond that. You are lucky. questions.quote: Oh, I nearly forgot. One important thing is that you'll be required to provide a credit check to guarantee your ability to pay the rent every month. This will charge you fifteen dollars.

questions.explanation: 录音中提到共享厨房（kitchen）在几个月前翻新过，完美对应题目里的remodelled。

questions.quote: First, there are three bedrooms combined with two bathrooms. Then, there is a shared kitchen which was refurbished several months ago.

questions.explanation: 录音中房东说如果你想要洗碗机（dishwasher），需要以后自己加，说明房子里现在没有。

questions.quote: Do we have to buy our own cookers? Basic facilities for cooking are available, but if you want a dishwasher, I'm sorry, it needs to be added later.

questions.explanation: 录音中房东说车库（garage）里不仅能停车，还有一个可以用来工作（work）的特殊区域。

questions.explanation: 录音中明确指出虽然有园丁负责景观，但你需要帮忙每周给草地浇水（water the grass）。

questions.quote: Do we have to take care of these plants and flowers? Well, you don't have to worry about that. There will be a professional gardener to do the landscaping in the garden regularly, but you do need to help water the grass once a week. Is it a problem for you?

questions.explanation: 录音提到这项每月15美元的清洁服务负责清理垃圾（rubbish，对应trashing）和回收（recycling）。

questions.explanation: 录音说明虽然没有中央空调，但每个房间的窗户（window）上都安装了空调设备。

questions.quote: Is air conditioning available in the house? If you mean central air conditioning, I'm afraid there isn't at the moment, but each room has a conditioning unit which is installed on the window.

questions.tip: 切记不要重复填数字！ 如果填了 "27 Station Road"，卷面就会变成 "27 27 Station Road"，这在雅思评分中是必错的。
questions.quote: Helpline: And now your address please. Robert: It's 27 Station Road.

questions.explanation: Robert 说的出生日期是 25th of February。
questions.tip: 年份（1975）通常不需要填，因为题目已经暗示了是填写“月和日”，或者受限于字数限制。
questions.quote: Helpline: And your date of birth? Robert: The 25th of February, 1975.

questions.explanation: 接线员问是背部哪里疼，Robert 回答是 Lower（下背部）。
questions.tip: 题目已经有了 "back"，所以你只需要填修饰词 "lower"，不要重复填 "lower back"。
questions.quote: Helpline: Can you tell me which part of the back? Robert: Lower.

questions.explanation: Robert 说他从周一就开始疼了，算下来已经是 3 days（三天了）。

questions.tip: 要注意区分时间点，刚开始（at first）不太痛，变糟糕（got worse）是在下午。
questions.quote: But it wasn't too bad at first... Then this afternoon the pain suddenly got so bad that I...

questions.quote: The 385 will get you there in approximately 40 minutes depending on traffic.

questions.explanation: 录音提到游客喜欢抱动物并“拍照（get your photo taken）”，但这需要支付小额费用。
questions.tip: 题目是 "have a ..."，对应录音中的 "get your photo taken"，需提取名词 photo。
questions.quote: They've stopped that, but most tourists love the fact that you're allowed to hold some of the animals and get your photo taken.

questions.explanation: 这是一道拼写题，录音特意纠正了拼写，是 ROSIE。
questions.tip: 注意听男士说的 "No"，他否定了女生拼的 ROZY，一定要写纠正后的版本。
questions.quote: Is it ROZY? No, it's ROSIE.

questions.explanation: 录音说因为需求火爆，演出已经“延长到了周六（extended to Saturday）”。
questions.tip: 不要填 Tuesday（开始时间）或 Wednesday（特场时间），题目问的是 "run to..."（持续到...）。
questions.quote: Next week, it says it starts on Tuesday... but because of the demand it's been extended to Saturday.

questions.explanation: 录音说周一晚上的预演秀提供门票“折扣（discount）”。
questions.tip: 听到 "Monday" 和 "tickets" 时要竖起耳朵，答案就在紧随其后的 "offering a..." 后面。
questions.quote: Ah, it says there's a special preview show on the Monday and they're offering a discount on tickets that night.

questions.explanation: 录音中提到市中心的“博物馆（museum）”现在有一个通过实践操作的展览（exhibition）。
questions.tip: 题目问去哪里看展览，录音虽然先问了 "What's the museum like?"，但答案就是这个地点。
questions.quote: What's the museum like? It's very popular with children and there's a very hands-on exhibition on at the moment.

questions.explanation: 录音建议孩子们带一个“盒子（box）”把做好的折纸带回家，而且只要一个小的（little one）。
questions.tip: Scissors（剪刀）和 paper（纸）是提供的（provided），不需要带，别填错了。
questions.quote: They just advise children to bring a box to carry the completed origami home in. Just a little one will do.

questions.explanation: 录音明确说咸水湖是在“海洋一侧（ocean side）”。
questions.tip: 不要听到 centre 或 mountain 就填，录音对此进行了明确的否定 "No"。
questions.quote: Is that in the centre of the island near the mountain? No, it's on the ocean side.

questions.explanation: 生问能不能“露营（camp）”，男士回答 "I'm afraid..." 表示否定，即不允许露营。
questions.tip: 题目是 "not allowed to"，对应录音中被委婉否定的动作 camp。
questions.quote: Are you allowed to camp there? That would be lovely, but I'm afraid the land is all...

2.s: will get you there in approximately

3.s: you're allowed to hold some of the animals

7.s: spend a day in the city center

questions.quote: Well it was built about 150 years ago, we regularly arrange parties there. They have a room for hire on the fifth floor.

questions.explanation: 录音中说这个房间最好的一点（best thing）是它有一个很棒的 view（风景/视野），对应题干 good ...。
questions.tip: 虽然前面提到了 big 和 light，但题干结构是 with a good...，名词 view 才是核心答案。

questions.explanation: 听到价格 32 pounds 后，录音补充说你必须至少有 35 位客人（at least 35 guests），对应题干 minimum number。
questions.tip: 注意区分数字含义，32 是单价，45 是座位数，65 是站立人数，只有 35 是最低人数限制。
questions.quote: It’s 32 pounds a head, that includes the hire of the room and the standard buffet, but not drinks, and you have to have at least 35 guests.

questions.explanation: 录音中说四月份的任何 Saturday（周六）都可以，对应题干 Available any ... in April。

questions.quote: Let me see, um, they can do any Saturday in April, but not Fridays or Sundays.

questions.explanation: 中介推荐了另一家酒店，并在被要求后拼写了名字：L-I-M-E-R-I-C-K。

questions.quote: It's in the business district, so public transport's good.

questions.explanation: 女士问有没有 garden（花园），中介确认说有一个小的（small one）可用，对应题干 with a small ...。

questions.tip: 不要填 2 or 3 days，那是女士说她需要考虑的时间，不是中介能保留预定的时间。
questions.quote: Ok, well, if I take your booking today, I can hold it for a week.

questions.explanation: 题目问的是 "Final payment"（尾款），录音说先付35%定金，剩下的 65% 在派对前10天付清。
questions.tip: 这是一道简单的减法题（100% - 35% = 65%），或者直接听录音中的 "the other 65%"。
questions.quote: To confirm the booking, I then need a deposit of 35%. You pay the other 65% 10 days before the party.

questions.explanation: 工作人员询问全名，顾客逐个字母拼写了自己的姓氏：C-A-R-L-T-O-N。
questions.tip: 注意首字母大写，听到 "It's..." 后面的字母拼读要立刻记录。
questions.quote: Agent: First, could I have your full name please? Customer: Sure, it’s Emily Carlton, C-A-R-L-T-O-N.

questions.explanation: 顾客先报了一个号码（...41938），被工作人员确认时发现口误，立刻纠正为 41968。
questions.tip: 典型的“自我纠正”陷阱，必须听到 "Oh no, I misspoke" 后面的数字才是最终答案。
questions.quote: Customer: Oh, it’s 07-235 55 41938. Agent: Sorry, did you say 41938 at the end? Customer: Oh no, I misspoke. It’s 41968.

questions.explanation: 顾客说 5 月底结束工作，想在接下来的那个月（following month）旅行，即 June（六月）。
questions.tip: 需要进行简单的月份推算，不要听到 May 就填，要听后面的 "following month"。
questions.quote: Customer: Well, I’m planning to finish my work by the end of May, so I want to travel the following month. Agent: Great. So June then? Customer: Yes, that’s correct.

questions.explanation: 工作人员问有没有特定想去的地方，顾客明确说想住在 the coast（海岸）附近。
questions.tip: 注意介词搭配 "near the..."，答案直接填名词 coast 即可。
questions.quote: Agent: Do you have a specific area in mind? Customer: Yes, I’d love to stay near the coast.

questions.explanation: 顾客解释选择海岸的原因是想要欣赏 ocean（海洋） 上的日出日落美景（views）。
questions.tip: 题目问的是 Type of View（景观），必须填顾客想看的 ocean；不要被后面中介提到的 garden（花园）干扰，那是房产自带设施。
questions.quote: Agent: Why do you choose it? Customer: Well, I love the idea of enjoying beautiful views of both sunrise and sunset over the ocean.

questions.explanation: 顾客说虽然泳池（pool）和露台（patio）都不错，但她真正想要的是一个 barbecue area（烧烤区）。
questions.tip: 原文出现了 pool 和 patio 作为干扰项，注意转折词 "but if I’m honest, what I really want is..." 引导正确答案。
questions.quote: Agent: Would you like any additional features, like a pool or a patio...? Customer: Hmm, let me think. A pool sounds nice... A patio would be great... but if I’m honest, what I really want is a barbecue area.

questions.explanation: 顾客说虽然读过悬崖（cliffs）和森林（forests）的介绍，但真正让她着迷的是那里的 caves（洞穴）。
questions.tip: "cliffs and forests" 是干扰项，注意转折词 "but what really fascinates me is..." 才是重点。
questions.quote: Agent: Are you interested in exploring any natural attractions? Customer: Definitely. I’ve read about some amazing cliffs and forests, but what really fascinates me is the number of caves there.

questions.explanation: 顾客说她不怎么跑步（jogging）或骑行（cycling），但真的很喜欢打 golf（高尔夫）。
questions.tip: "jogging or cycling" 是否定信息（don't do much），正确答案在 "but I really enjoy..." 后面。
questions.quote: Agent: And what about sports? Customer: Hmm. I don’t do much jogging or cycling, but I really enjoy playing golf.

questions.explanation: 顾客说偶尔游泳（swimming），但真正想尝试的是 surfing（冲浪）。
questions.tip: 同样是转折逻辑，swimming 是干扰项，"what I really want to try is..." 引导答案。
questions.quote: Agent: How about water activities? Customer: Well, I like swimming occasionally, but what I really want to try is surfing.

questions.explanation: 顾客希望去体验当地文化，特别提到了有传统 Irish music（爱尔兰音乐）的酒吧。
questions.tip: 题目已经有了 "Evening Entertainment"，填 music 或者 Irish music 均可。
questions.quote: Agent: Lastly, for evening entertainment, do you have any preferences? Customer: I’d love to experience the local culture, maybe a pub with traditional Irish music.

5.s: views of both sunrise and sunset over the ocean

6.s: what I really want is a barbecue area

questions.explanation: 当旅行社职员问到出生日期时，你不仅能听到女孩先说了3月30日。
questions.tip: 你可能会被职员插话说的“31st”干扰，但这其实是职员自己的生日，不是正确答案。
questions.quote: Date of birth? March the 30th. Oh, I'm the 31st. [laughs] 1988.

questions.explanation: 面对留电话号码的要求，女孩直接报出了自己的一连串手机数字“0903-775115”。
questions.tip: 这是一道比较直接的数字听写题，你只要跟着录音节奏，不漏听、不错记任何一个数字即可得分。
questions.quote: And a contact telephone number, please. Um, I can give you my mobile number. Mm-hmm. 0903-775115. Fine.

questions.explanation: 当被问及旅行目的地时，女孩给出了非常清晰的回答，她想去北欧（Northern Europe）。
questions.tip: 录音紧接着提到了南欧（Southern Europe），但你要注意那是她以前和家人去过的地方，千万别填错。
questions.quote: Now, tell me where you plan to travel to, and I'll see how I can help. Well, I'd like to go to Northern Europe. Have you been there before? No. I know Southern Europe quite well, as I've been there with my family.

questions.explanation: 女孩提到自己想通过坐火车（train）的方式去旅行，因为这样可以随时在想停的地方下车。
questions.tip: 录音里虽然提到了“plane”（飞机），但那是她过去和家人出行的交通方式，不是她这次想要的。
questions.quote: We always went by plane, but now I can choose. I'd like to go by train so I can stop off whenever I want.

questions.explanation: 关于工作意向，女孩说自己考虑过酒店（hotel）工作，因为这份工作可能包住宿。
questions.tip: 题目填空线前面已经有了冠词“a”，所以你只需要填入核心名词“hotel”即可，不要把“work”也填进去。
questions.quote: Now, just as important, what sort of work have you got in mind? Well, I thought about hotel work because then I might get accommodation with the job, and I'd like to work for about half the year.

questions.explanation: 旅行社职员建议女孩考虑一个备选方案（alternative），并举例说明很多学生喜欢在农场（farm）工作。
questions.tip: 只要你牢牢抓住卷面上的“alternative”作为定位信号，在女孩问出“Such as?”（比如呢？）之后，就能立刻抓到正确答案。
questions.quote: Perhaps you should consider an alternative just in case. Such as? Well, lots of students like to work on a farm, and we have lots of requests from people looking for student workers for a few weeks at a time throughout the year.

questions.explanation: 聊到交通花费时，职员建议最好的选择是办一张欧洲通行证（European pass），这样可以在非高峰期无限次乘车。
questions.tip: 录音最开始提到了买单程票（single tickets），但职员马上说这太贵了，你在此处要能够排除掉这个干扰。
questions.quote: Now, travel. Buying single tickets would be expensive, so the best option would be to have a European pass, which would give you unlimited rail travel at off-peak times.

questions.explanation: 女孩询问有没有青年旅社的相关信息，职员回答说可以给她一本小册子（booklet）。
questions.tip: 题目中的“given a”对应了录音里的“give you a”，听到这里直接写下“booklet”即可，千万注意拼写不要漏字母。
questions.quote: Do you have any information about youth hostels which I could use to plan my route? Yes, I'll give you a booklet now, but it's down to you to book your accommodation.

questions.explanation: 职员明确指出在安排行程前，女孩需要为整个旅程购买保险（insurance），并在解释了保障范围后，女孩同意了这个提议（I'll do that）。  另外，题干中的take out 是一个固定搭配，意思是“办理、购买、投保”。
questions.tip: 这道题的对话跨度比较大，你需要跟住职员提出“insurance”的话头，然后耐心等女孩后面表示同意，不能只听一半。
questions.quote: Well, before I make any arrangements for you, you need to have insurance for your entire trip. We can arrange that for you if you like. What does it cover? Any valuable items, jewelry, for example, your money, your mobile, your health, and if you needed to get back home quickly, you'd be covered so you could buy a plane ticket. Right. I'll do that.

questions.explanation: 女孩原本想自己带电脑去联系家人，但职员认为出门带着电脑不方便，更明智的建议是使用网吧（internet café）。
questions.tip: 你可能会听到“laptop”或者“computer”，但这些都是被职员立刻否定的想法，你需要抓取的是职员最终让大家去使用的场所。
questions.quote: I thought I'd take my laptop so I can email and keep in touch with people at home. Hmm. Not a good idea to lug your computer around with you. It's much more sensible to rely on an internet café. That's what we tell people to do. Oh, okay.

transcript.text: You will hear a man and a woman discussing booking a hot air balloon trip.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 0

transcript.text: First, you have some time to look at questions one to five.

transcript.text: Good morning, Smart Travel.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Jason speaking.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Hi, good morning.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: I saw your advert in today's paper about hot air balloon trips.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: It sounds pretty exciting, and I wonder how much it costs.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Well, the price may vary depending on the location, number of participants, and add-ons.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: A single ride may cost you up to two hundred and eighty pounds per person.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: But if you choose group booking, there is a discount.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: And the cheapest flight is one hundred and twenty-five pounds each for a group booking of at least ten people.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Oh, that's not too bad.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: What do you mean by add-ons?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: They are optional items like taking photos for you during the ride, champagne, and sit-down breakfast after the flight.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Upon completing the trip, we will provide each participant with a certificate, and that is entirely free of charge.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Can I book a ride over the phone?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Yes, that's an option.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Reservations can be made one year ahead of your trip by telephone.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: But to pick a specific date, you must book online.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: A confirmation email will be sent to you right afterwards.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: How high can the balloons go?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: A hot air balloon's height is limited by the temperature of the air and how much fuel it can carry.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: And the highest altitude ever recorded for a ride is one thousand eight hundred meters, but most rides stay below three hundred meters.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Oh boy.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: That's impressive.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: How long is a single ride?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: The average hot air balloon ride lasts about an hour.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: The entire ballooning experience, which includes ground preparation, flight, and post-flight packing up and celebration, may take two to three hours.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: And what time are the flights?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Our flights generally meet about an hour before sunrise on the day.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: You will be notified of the exact meeting time the evening before your flight.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Night flights are avoided due to weather conditions.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Fair enough.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 0

transcript.text: Now listen and answer questions six to ten.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 0

transcript.text: Which month do you recommend for a hot air balloon trip?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Autumn is the best time of year to take the trip.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Not only can you see the changing hues of the trees from above, but it is a great way to spend time with the whole family before it gets too cold.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: I see.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: But please note that our flight may be canceled, and you will be notified by phone the day before.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Why is that?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: It can be quite dangerous to fly under bad weather conditions like a thunderstorm.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: So our experienced pilots will not go under such conditions.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: What should I wear for the ride?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: We suggest wearing comfortable clothing like a jacket.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Multiple layers are always better.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Wearing a helmet for safety concerns is also a good idea.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Sandals are not permitted.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Can children or older people participate?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: All children must be above the minimum age of nine years old, and they have to be accompanied by at least a parent or guardian.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: However, an adult has no age limit as long as they meet the health requirements.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: What exactly are the health requirements?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Participants must at least be in fair physical condition.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: For example, they shall have no significant knee, hip, or back problems and no recent surgeries or broken bones.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: They must also stand unassisted for an hour during the flight.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: It is the required position during the whole flight.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: As the balloon comes to land, all passengers will need to adopt the landing position with knees bent in front of them.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Are those rides safe?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Hot air balloon companies are required to have a commercial balloon pilot license, and all our pilots go through rigorous training before they are allowed to fly.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: It is a relatively gentle activity.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: However, the impact of a balloon landing can vary drastically depending on factors like wind speed.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Sometimes it is similar to the momentum of jumping off a small chair.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: If you cannot jump off a small chair, speaking to your doctor before booking a balloon flight is best.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Thank you very much.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: I think that's all I need to know.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

transcript.text: Thanks for calling.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Goodbye.
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: That is the end of part one.

questions.explanation: 旅行结束时，公司会给每位参与者免费颁发一张 certificate（证书）。
questions.tip: 免费 vs 付费干扰！ 像 photos（拍照）和 champagne（香槟）通常是付费或可选的（optional），只有 certificate 被明确强调是 entirely free of charge（完全免费）。
questions.quote: They are optional items, like taking photos for you during the ride, champagne, and sit down breakfast after the flight. Upon completing the trip, we will provide each participant with a certificate. And that is entirely free of charge.

questions.explanation: 如果想要选择具体的日期（exact/specific date），客户必须通过 online（在线）方式进行预订。
questions.tip: 预订方式对比！ 电话（telephone）只能提前一年做普通预约，而定具体日子（pick a specific date）必须用 online，注意题目中的 only 对应原文的 must。
questions.quote: Yes, that’s an option. Reservations can be made one year ahead of your trip by telephone. But to pick a specific date, you must book online.

questions.explanation: 热气球飞行有记录的最高高度（maximum height/highest altitude）是 1,800 米。
questions.tip: 数字干扰！ 不要填 300，原文说大多数飞行保持在 300 米以下（stay below），题目问的是 maximum（最大值）。
questions.quote: A hot air balloon’s height is limited by the temperature of the air, and how much fuel it can carry. And the highest altitude ever recorded for a ride is 1,800 metres. But most rides stay below 300 metres.

questions.explanation: 由于天气原因，night（夜间）的飞行是被避免/取消的（are avoided）。
questions.tip: 听到 flights 时间相关的内容时定位。原文的 avoided 对应题目的 no flights。
questions.quote: Our flights generally meet about an hour before sunrise on the day. You will be notified of the exact meeting time the evening before your flight. Night flights are avoided due to weather conditions.

questions.explanation: 工作人员推荐 autumn（秋天）是一年中最好的飞行季节，因为可以从空中看到树木颜色的变化。
questions.tip: 听到 recommend 或 best time 后捕捉季节词。注意 Autumn 的拼写（末尾有 n）。
questions.quote: Which month do you recommend for a hot air balloon trip? Autumn is the best time of year to take the trip. Not only can you see the changing hues of the trees from above...

questions.explanation: 遇到恶劣天气如 a thunderstorm（雷暴）时，飞行可能会被取消。
questions.tip: 原文说的是单数 a thunderstorm。
questions.quote: It can be quite dangerous to fly under bad weather conditions, like a thunderstorm. So our experienced pilots will not go under such conditions.

questions.explanation: 除了夹克，工作人员建议为了安全起见，最好也戴上 helmet（头盔）。
questions.tip: 推荐 vs 禁止！ 题目问建议穿戴什么。排除 sandals（凉鞋），因为原文说 Sandals are not permitted（不被允许）。
questions.quote: We suggest wearing comfortable clothing, like a jacket. Multiple layers are always better. Wearing a helmet for safety concerns is also a good idea. Sandals are not permitted.

questions.explanation: 虽然儿童有最小年龄限制，但对于成年人来说没有 age（年龄）上限，只要身体健康即可。
questions.tip: 听到 adult 后定位。题目 no ... restriction 对应原文的 no age limit。
questions.quote: All children must be above the minimum age of 9 years old, and they have to be accompanied by at least a parent or guardian. However, an adult has no age limit as long as they meet the health requirements.

questions.explanation: 参与者必须能够在整个飞行过程中保持 stand（站立）姿势且无需他人协助。
questions.tip: 动作辨析！ 题目强调 throughout the flight（整个飞行过程）。排除 landing position（着陆姿势）要求的 knees bent（弯膝盖）。
questions.quote: They must also stand unassisted for an hour during the flight. It is the required position during the whole flight. As the balloon comes to land, all passengers will need to adopt the landing position...

2.s: we will provide each participant with

2.q: at the end of the flight

9.s: an adult has no age limit

transcript.text: That'd suit me better anyway.

transcript.text: Okay, so what are your tips for a horseback riding weekend?
transcript.speaker: Speaker 1

transcript.text: Well, I'd had a sore knee before I went, and I was pretty worried about that.

transcript.text: It was okay, actually, but what you've got to watch for is that you don't have any trouble with your back.

transcript.text: Yeah.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2

questions.quote: But on that first evening, when you've been riding all day, you get the opportunity to go for a swim, and you really enjoy that. So relaxing.

questions.explanation: 录音说到在山谷的尽头有一个瀑布（waterfall），并紧接着说这是一个停下来吃午餐的好地方，所以填waterfall。

questions.quote: And what's on day two? You said something about the national park. No. Day two, you go up this incredible valley. At the end of it, there's a waterfall. It's an amazing place to stop for lunch.

questions.tip: 你可能会被前面提到的老鹰（eagle）干扰，但只要听到“in the afternoon（在下午）”这个定海神针，就能直接锁定后面的真正答案。
questions.quote: We even spotted an eagle while we were sitting there, and in the afternoon, there's a trip that goes to a cave. You can even ride into it.

questions.explanation: 录音提醒你要当心背部（back）不能有毛病，因为骑马会加重它，“trouble with”对应题目的“problems”，所以填back。

questions.explanation: 接待员问在什么区域（what area），顾客直接回答在southwest。
questions.tip: 这是一道直接给答案的送分题，顺着问答逻辑直接捕捉方向词即可。
questions.quote: First of all, uh, what area are you in? I'm in the southwest.

questions.explanation: 接待员问是不是所有的卧室都是double bedrooms，顾客说有一个很小，所以实际上只有两个（two）double rooms。
questions.tip: 你可能一开始听到了“Three”，但题目已经给出了数量词“two”，所以要往后听顾客具体是怎么分类的，不要盲目填自己听到的第一个数字。
questions.quote: How many bedrooms does it have? Three. Are they all double bedrooms? Well, one of the bedrooms is quite small, so it's probably really two double rooms.

questions.explanation: 紧接着上一题，顾客明确说明那个小卧室被布置成了（set up as）一个office。
questions.tip: 你可能会死等题干里的“used as”这个短语，但录音里替换成了“set up as”，要注意去听这间小房子到底被当做了什么用途。
questions.quote: We have the small bedroom set up as an office.

questions.explanation: 顾客在逐一纠正和确认房间列表时，说完厨房餐厅（kitchen diner）后，紧接着就提到了lounge（客厅）。
questions.tip: 接待员在一开始猜了一大串房间名字，你要稳住不要急着写，等顾客自己逐一纠正和确认的才是最终答案。
questions.quote: Well, actually, we don't have a separate dining room. It's a kitchen diner. Then there's the lounge, and as well as that, we have a family room.

groups.instructions: Choose the correct answer.

questions.prompt: Which extra service does agency agree to provide?
questions.explanation: 顾客明确表示希望换床单（would like the sheets changed），接待员也答应了，这里的sheets对应选项A的bed linen。
questions.tip: 录音里把A、B、C三个选项全提了一遍，你要听准顾客拒绝了清冰箱（C），擦玻璃（B）被机构拒绝，只有换床单（A）是双方同意的。
questions.quote: Well, I'm afraid we don't do that, the health and safety regulations. But we do offer other special services. We can put clean sheets on the beds, for example. Uh-huh. Or we can clean out your fridge. A lot of people like that done. I'm not so worried about that, but I would like the sheets changed. That's no problem. We can do that.

cleaning the fridge

questions.prompt: What will be cleaned more thoroughly every three months?
questions.explanation: 顾客问到地毯（carpet）怎么处理，接待员建议每三个月（three months）彻底用洗发水清洗一次。
questions.tip: 你听到顾客提到了“小孩子（young children）”可能会脑补选A儿童房，但这里提到孩子只是为了说明地毯变脏的原因，核心讨论物品依然是地毯。
questions.quote: What about the carpet? As well as the standard vacuum, we can shampoo it if you want. Right. We've got young children, so it gets pretty dirty. I haven't had it done for six months. the carpet
the bathroom

questions.prompt: group fitness class
questions.explanation: 女士表示虽然听起来有趣，但自己完全无法想象去上团操课（can't see myself ever going to a class），对应完全不感兴趣（C）。
questions.tip: 听到前半句的“sound very interesting”你可能以为她现在感兴趣，千万别忽略了紧跟在后面的转折词“but”以及她否定的真实意愿。
questions.quote: We offer a range of group fitness classes such as body step, body tone, and body balance. They all sound very interesting, but I can't see myself ever going to a class.

questions.prompt: general weight training
questions.explanation: 男士推荐普通力量训练后，女士表示听起来不错，并反复确认自己是不是“可以直接开始”（start straight away），对应现在感兴趣（B）。
questions.tip: 你可能没听懂“start straight away”代表她此时此刻想立刻参与的强烈意愿，导致不敢选B。
questions.quote: Well, if that's not an option, perhaps you should try some general weight training exercises in the gym... I like the sound of that. I wouldn't have to get fit first, would I? I could just start straight away?

questions.prompt: group fitness in the pool
questions.explanation: 女士明确表示水上健美操对她并没有什么吸引力（doesn't really appeal to me），对应完全不感兴趣（C）。
questions.tip: 录音里的 aqua aerobics classes（水上健美操）就是题目中的 group fitness in the pool 的同义替换，没反应过来就容易找错定位词。
questions.quote: Well, we have an Olympic-sized swimming pool where you can do aqua aerobics classes. That's group exercise in the swimming pool... Aqua aerobics doesn't really appeal to me.

questions.prompt: swimming
questions.explanation: 女士说自己练游泳可以在“几个月后”自己稍微变健康一点时进行（in a few months），对应未来可能感兴趣（A）。
questions.tip: 你可能会把前一题她对“水上健美操团课”的排斥态度，错误地平移到“个人游泳训练（my own swimming regime）”上从而错选C，要分清这俩是不同的项目。
questions.quote: I'm really not very keen on fixed classes, but working on my own swimming regime would be okay in a few months when I'm a bit fitter, I suppose.

questions.prompt: sauna
questions.explanation: 女士笑着反驳说桑拿根本不能让她放松，对她来说太热了（just too hot for me），对应完全不感兴趣（C）。
questions.tip: 听到男士在推销时说的“relax”你可能就匆忙下结论选了B，做配对题一定得听完对话另一方（本题主角女士）的真实反馈。
questions.quote: We also have a sauna where you can relax after a strong workout. [chuckles] That's not my idea of relaxing. Saunas are just too hot for me.

questions.prompt: child minding
questions.explanation: 女士说头几个月丈夫在家带孩子，但等他恢复上班后（once he goes back to work），自己很可能就会用这个服务了，对应未来可能感兴趣（A）。
questions.tip: 听到“丈夫现在能照顾孩子”，你可能以为她完全不需要而秒选了C，漏听了转折词“But”后面补充说明的未来情况。
questions.quote: Well, my husband will be working at home for the first few months, so he'll be able to look after the baby when I'm exercising. But once he goes back to work, I'll probably be using that service.

questions.prompt: Sea view
questions.explanation: Emily 明确提到 Star Hotel 提供免费在线预订，而且动作快还能订到极好的海景房（sea view rooms）。
questions.tip: 顾客后来确实说了“想看水景（nice view of the water）”，但这只是顾客的需求，真正提供这个设施的只有 Star Hotel。
questions.quote: Emily: The Star Hotel offers online bookings... and you can even book the gorgeous sea view rooms if you act quickly.

questions.prompt: Handicap accessibility
questions.explanation: 当顾客询问残疾人通道时，Emily 回答所有三个选项（all three options）都具备此设施。
questions.tip: 不要因为顾客是在讨论完 Star Hotel 之后才问这个问题，就以为它只属于 Star Hotel，要抓取关键词 "all three"。
questions.quote: Customer: Now, are there handicapped accessible rooms? Emily: Yes, all three options have access for the physically disabled.

questions.prompt: Multiple meal options
questions.explanation: 原文指出另外两家只有简单的早餐，而 Royal Hotel 提供完整的餐厅和客房服务（full restaurant and room service）。
questions.tip: 题目问的是 "Multiple meal options"（多种餐饮选择），这直接对应原文的 "full restaurant"，排除了只提供 "limited menu" 的另外两家。
questions.quote: For a full restaurant and room service, the Royal Hotel is your best bet.

questions.prompt: Private dining
questions.explanation: Emily 介绍 Royal Hotel 的晚餐是在酒店高品质的**私人餐厅（private dining room）**提供的。
questions.tip: 这个信息点紧跟在 Royal Hotel 的午餐介绍之后，不要因为后面即将提到其他酒店就走神。
questions.quote: Dinners are in a nice low-key but high-quality setting in the hotel's private dining room...

questions.prompt: Group discount
questions.explanation: Emily 查阅后确认，Royal Hotel 没有折扣，但 Winchester 提供 15% 的团体折扣。
questions.tip: 这是一个典型的“否定陷阱”，先说了 Royal Hotel "No, sorry"，然后转折指向 Winchester，不要听到 discount 就急着选 Royal。
questions.quote: Emily: No, sorry, not at the Royal Hotel... It looks like there is one at the Winchester, 15% off when you book eight or more rooms.

questions.prompt: Children's play area
questions.explanation: 顾客决定预订 Winchester 后询问关于孩子的问题，Emily 确认那里有孩子们喜欢的 play place（游乐区）。
questions.tip: 此时对话焦点已经完全转移到了 Winchester Hotel，所以后续关于儿童设施的描述都是属于它的。
questions.quote: Customer: We'll book at the Winchester... Emily: Yes, in fact, it has a play place that kids just love...

questions.explanation: Emily 说明只要顾客寄送了 deposit（定金），就会为他们保留房间。
questions.tip: 注意题目是 "send his..."，原文是 "send a..."，要抓取 send 后面的核心名词。
questions.quote: I'll hold the block of rooms for you as soon as you send a deposit.

questions.explanation: Emily 建议顾客一旦确定房间数量，就尽快发出 invitations（邀请/请帖）。
questions.tip: 虽然题目用的动词 "make" 和原文 "send" 不完全一致，但根据语境“立刻去做的事情”，只有 invitations 符合逻辑。
questions.quote: I recommend booking as soon as possible, so you probably want to send the invitations as soon as you know how many rooms to hold.

questions.explanation: Emily 提醒，如果需要机场往返的 transport（交通） 服务，需要在抵达前告知。
questions.tip: 不要填 airport，那是目的地；题目问的是 "help with..."（需要什么方面的帮助/服务）。
questions.quote: ...sometime before you arrive, let us know if you'll be requiring our transport service to and from the airport.

questions.explanation: 录音中 Emily 明确告知，虽然可以给小费，但酒店司机不接受 gifts（礼物）。
questions.tip: 客户问的是 "presents"，但 Emily 回答的规矩是 "do not accept gifts"，填空题要优先填确定的事实或规则中的用词，且 "prepare gifts" 是常见搭配。
questions.quote: It is a free service, so if you would like to tip, you are welcome to do so. But hotel drivers do not accept gifts.

questions.explanation: 男客服将女顾客说的英制宽度换算成了公制单位，明确提到需要140厘米（one hundred and forty centimeters）。
questions.tip: 你可能会听到前面的数字“four”或“six”，但这里问的是以厘米（cm）为单位的宽度，要留意单位转换后的数字。
questions.quote: I want around four foot six inches wide. It's all centimeters now, so you'll be wanting one hundred and forty centimeters.

questions.explanation: 女顾客在听完三种木材颜色选项后，明确表示自己想要自然色（natural）来让房间感觉亮一点。
questions.tip: 你可能会因为前面提到了dark或bleached而填错，一定要听到最后顾客最终拍板的决定。
questions.quote: Now, we do offer this bed in three wood finishes. That's dark, natural, or bleached finish. Hmm. It depends really on the rest of the furniture in the room. Well, that's all quite dark, but actually, I think I'll go for the natural. The room could do with lightening up a bit.

questions.explanation: 加长版床的价格是265英镑且包含配送，顾客之后拒绝了需要额外收费的组装服务，因此总费用依然是265。
questions.tip: 你可能会把组装后的总价290或标准版价格225填进去，要注意区分各项费用并留意顾客到底选了哪种服务。
questions.quote: So for this, uh, let's see, a standard for that width would be two hundred and twenty-five pounds, and with the extra length, we're looking at two hundred and sixty-five pounds. Does that include delivery? Yes, but the bed will be delivered flat-packed, so there's an extra twenty-five pounds if you want assembly. Well, which would bring it to two hundred and ninety pounds. No, flat-packed is fine. My son can do the assembly.

questions.explanation: 男客服推荐了一款对阅读很有用的嵌入式灯（light），女顾客紧接着确认要这个免费配件。
questions.tip: 听到“reading”时要立刻捕捉它前面的关键物品，也就是可以用来阅读的“light”。
questions.quote: And then there are various options which you can have at no extra cost. So, for example, you can have an in-go light, which is very useful for reading. Oh, yes, I'll have that.

questions.explanation: 客服提供木门或玻璃门的选择后，女顾客明确表示儿子会喜欢玻璃（glass）门。
questions.tip: 听到干扰词wooden不要急着写，要听完整个句子，捕捉到最终被选定的材质才是正确答案。
questions.quote: And does it have a cupboard? Yes, and you have a choice of a wooden door or a glass one. Right. I think Roger would like the glass one.

questions.explanation: 顾客专门确认了抽屉（drawer）是否带锁，得到肯定答复后便拍板选了它。
questions.tip: 这道题的强干扰项是shelf，但因为题目条件限制了必须带锁（locked），所以只能选被确认有锁的drawer。
questions.quote: And that comes with two adjustable shelves in the cupboard. And you also have a choice of one more open shelf above the cupboard, or a drawer on top. Does the drawer have a lock? Let me check. Yes, it does. Right. That will be best then. I'll go for that.

questions.explanation: 客服询问名字后，顾客给出了自己的姓氏Rogala并进行了逐个字母拼写（R-O-G-A-L-A）。
questions.tip: 这类人名拼写题一定要紧跟字母发音，不要因为没听过这个陌生的名字就慌张，按着她念的字母原样写下即可。
questions.quote: So if I could just have your name, please. Mrs. S. Rogala, R-O-G-A-L-A.

questions.explanation: 顾客在报完地址后，直接且清晰地念出了邮政编码HE25 4EU。
questions.tip: 数字和字母混杂时非常容易漏听或写错，尤其要注意不要把发音相近的字母“E”和“U”听混了。
questions.quote: Oh, and the postcode's HE25 4EU.

questions.explanation: 客服询问下周配送什么时候方便，顾客回答说早上（morning）通常在家，是最佳收货时间。
questions.tip: 顾客后面紧接着说下午会出门（out in the afternoon），注意别把表示不在家的干扰时间段填进去。
questions.quote: We should get it to you by next week. Will someone be in, or is there somewhere we could leave it? Or a neighbor? Well, I'm usually in in the morning, so that's the best time. I tend to be out in the afternoon.

questions.explanation: 顾客明确交代，如果没人在家（if no one's in），就把货物留在车库（garage）里。
questions.tip: 你可能会听到neighbor或者village，但这只是铺垫，真正的放置地点是由“leave it in”后面的词决定的。
questions.quote: And the nearest neighbors are in the village, but just leave it in the garage if no one's in. It'll be quite safe there. It's just behind the house.

1.s: want around four foot six inches wide

5.s: cupboard? Yes, and you have a choice of a wooden door

6.s: open shelf above the cupboard, or a drawer on top

9.s: get it to you by next week

questions.tip: 你可能会被最先听到的“£24”误导并忽略了整体语义，一定要注意听后面的转折词（but）以及对“学生”身份的具体报价确认。
questions.quote: Uh, so how much does it cost to join? Well, it depends. The basic charge is £24 a season, but for people eligible for concessions, it's £21.50. Oh, I'm a student. You'd get the concession rate then.

questions.explanation: 店员说票价可以减免（off）2 英镑，即 reduction 是 2 英镑。
questions.tip: 不要填 4.50（折后价）或者 6.50（原价），题目问的是 reduction（减免了多少钱）。
questions.quote: That entitles you to free entry to the club films and also to £2 off tickets for all other films on at the cinema. So you'd pay £4.50 instead of £6.50.

questions.explanation: 会员有资格获得三小时的免费（complimentary）parking（停车）。
questions.tip: 需要听出 "complimentary" 就是题目中 "free" 的同义替换。
questions.quote: OK. Now I don't know if this applies to you, but club members are also eligible for three hours complimentary parking when there's a film on.

questions.explanation: 学生确认这部电影的故事背景是不是设在（set in）Argentina（阿根廷），店员表示正确。
questions.tip: 这是一个专有名词，听到地名要立刻反应过来，注意拼写 A-r-g-e-n-t-i-n-a。
questions.quote: Oh, I read the reviews of that. It’s set in Argentina, isn’t it? About a child who’s run away from home?

questions.explanation: 学生猜测是赢得舞蹈比赛，但店员立刻更正是 singing（唱歌） 比赛。
questions.tip: 这是一个典型的“男猜测，女更正”的陷阱，不要听到第一个词 dance 就填，要听后面的确认信息。
questions.quote: Student: And the kid somehow gets on TV and he wins a dance competition or something. Employee: A singing competition, yeah.

questions.explanation: 这是一部无声电影，但放映时会有人在现场用 piano（钢琴） 进行伴奏。
questions.tip: 不要填 organ（管风琴），原文说那是过去旧时候（in those days）的做法，不是现在的安排。
questions.quote: That’s an old silent movie, but in this showing we have someone who will accompany it on the piano, just like they used to in the old cinemas, though it was sometimes an organ accompaniment in those days.

questions.explanation: 店员明确回答这部电影制作于 1922 年。
questions.tip: 原文出现了一堆年份（1926, 1927, 1923）全是干扰项，只有 1922 是这部电影的制作年份。
questions.quote: Student: Must be a pretty old film then. When did they release the first talkies, 1926 or 27? Employee: Yes, this was made in 1922, so well before...

questions.explanation: 虽然片名像战争片，但它实际上被归类为（billed as）一部 comedy（喜剧）。
questions.tip: 小心 war film 这个干扰项，原文说 "they'd think it was a war film"，这是人们的误解。
questions.quote: Well, it’s billed as a comedy, they’d think it was a war film from the title.

questions.explanation: 电影结束后会有导演带来的 talk（讲座/谈话）。
questions.tip: 题目中的 "followed by" 对应原文的 "afterwards"，要抓取核心名词 talk。
questions.quote: There’s a talk afterwards given by the directors, so that should be very popular.

1.s: People of any age can join.
